```h
         if (s1[i++] != 0x80 + (ch & 0x3f)) return -1;
      } else if (ch >= 0xd800 && ch < 0xdc00) {
         stbtt_uint32 c;
         stbtt_uint16 ch2 = s2[2]*256 + s2[3];
         if (i+3 >= len1) return -1;
         c = ((ch - 0xd800) << 10) + (ch2 - 0xdc00) + 0x10000;
         if (s1[i++] != 0xf0 + (c >> 18)) return -1;
         if (s1[i++] != 0x80 + ((c >> 12) & 0x3f)) return -1;
         if (s1[i++] != 0x80 + ((c >>  6) & 0x3f)) return -1;
         if (s1[i++] != 0x80 + ((c      ) & 0x3f)) return -1;
         s2 += 2; // plus another 2 below
         len2 -= 2;
      } else if (ch >= 0xdc00 && ch < 0xe000) {
         return -1;
      } else {
         if (i+2 >= len1) return -1;
         if (s1[i++] != 0xe0 + (ch >> 12)) return -1;
         if (s1[i++] != 0x80 + ((ch >> 6) & 0x3f)) return -1;
         if (s1[i++] != 0x80 + ((ch     ) & 0x3f)) return -1;
      }
      s2 += 2;
      len2 -= 2;
   }
   return i;
}

static int stbtt_CompareUTF8toUTF16_bigendian_internal(char *s1, int len1, char *s2, int len2)
{
   return len1 == stbtt__CompareUTF8toUTF16_bigendian_prefix((stbtt_uint8*) s1, len1, (stbtt_uint8*) s2, len2);
}

// returns results in whatever encoding you request... but note that 2-byte encodings
// will be BIG-ENDIAN... use stbtt_CompareUTF8toUTF16_bigendian() to compare
STBTT_DEF const char *stbtt_GetFontNameString(const stbtt_fontinfo *font, int *length, int platformID, int encodingID, int languageID, int nameID)
{
   stbtt_int32 i,count,stringOffset;
   stbtt_uint8 *fc = font->data;
   stbtt_uint32 offset = font->fontstart;
   stbtt_uint32 nm = stbtt__find_table(fc, offset, "name");
   if (!nm) return NULL;

   count = ttUSHORT(fc+nm+2);
   stringOffset = nm + ttUSHORT(fc+nm+4);
   for (i=0; i < count; ++i) {
      stbtt_uint32 loc = nm + 6 + 12 * i;
      if (platformID == ttUSHORT(fc+loc+0) && encodingID == ttUSHORT(fc+loc+2)
          && languageID == ttUSHORT(fc+loc+4) && nameID == ttUSHORT(fc+loc+6)) {
         *length = ttUSHORT(fc+loc+8);
         return (const char *) (fc+stringOffset+ttUSHORT(fc+loc+10));
      }
   }
   return NULL;
}

static int stbtt__matchpair(stbtt_uint8 *fc, stbtt_uint32 nm, stbtt_uint8 *name, stbtt_int32 nlen, stbtt_int32 target_id, stbtt_int32 next_id)
{
   stbtt_int32 i;
   stbtt_int32 count = ttUSHORT(fc+nm+2);
   stbtt_int32 stringOffset = nm + ttUSHORT(fc+nm+4);

   for (i=0; i < count; ++i) {
      stbtt_uint32 loc = nm + 6 + 12 * i;
      stbtt_int32 id = ttUSHORT(fc+loc+6);
      if (id == target_id) {
         // find the encoding
         stbtt_int32 platform = ttUSHORT(fc+loc+0), encoding = ttUSHORT(fc+loc+2), language = ttUSHORT(fc+loc+4);

         // is this a Unicode encoding?
         if (platform == 0 || (platform == 3 && encoding == 1) || (platform == 3 && encoding == 10)) {
            stbtt_int32 slen = ttUSHORT(fc+loc+8);
            stbtt_int32 off = ttUSHORT(fc+loc+10);

            // check if there's a prefix match
            stbtt_int32 matchlen = stbtt__CompareUTF8toUTF16_bigendian_prefix(name, nlen, fc+stringOffset+off,slen);
            if (matchlen >= 0) {
               // check for target_id+1 immediately following, with same encoding & language
               if (i+1 < count && ttUSHORT(fc+loc+12+6) == next_id && ttUSHORT(fc+loc+12) == platform && ttUSHORT(fc+loc+12+2) == encoding && ttUSHORT(fc+loc+12+4) == language) {
                  slen = ttUSHORT(fc+loc+12+8);
                  off = ttUSHORT(fc+loc+12+10);
                  if (slen == 0) {
                     if (matchlen == nlen)
                        return 1;
                  } else if (matchlen < nlen && name[matchlen] == ' ') {
                     ++matchlen;
                     if (stbtt_CompareUTF8toUTF16_bigendian_internal((char*) (name+matchlen), nlen-matchlen, (char*)(fc+stringOffset+off),slen))
                        return 1;
                  }
               } else {
                  // if nothing immediately following
                  if (matchlen == nlen)
                     return 1;
               }
            }
         }

         // @TODO handle other encodings
      }
   }
   return 0;
}

static int stbtt__matches(stbtt_uint8 *fc, stbtt_uint32 offset, stbtt_uint8 *name, stbtt_int32 flags)
{
   stbtt_int32 nlen = (stbtt_int32) STBTT_strlen((char *) name);
   stbtt_uint32 nm,hd;
   if (!stbtt__isfont(fc+offset)) return 0;

   // check italics/bold/underline flags in macStyle...
   if (flags) {
      hd = stbtt__find_table(fc, offset, "head");
      if ((ttUSHORT(fc+hd+44) & 7) != (flags & 7)) return 0;
   }

   nm = stbtt__find_table(fc, offset, "name");
   if (!nm) return 0;

   if (flags) {
      // if we checked the macStyle flags, then just check the family and ignore the subfamily
      if (stbtt__matchpair(fc, nm, name, nlen, 16, -1))  return 1;
      if (stbtt__matchpair(fc, nm, name, nlen,  1, -1))  return 1;
      if (stbtt__matchpair(fc, nm, name, nlen,  3, -1))  return 1;
   } else {
      if (stbtt__matchpair(fc, nm, name, nlen, 16, 17))  return 1;
      if (stbtt__matchpair(fc, nm, name, nlen,  1,  2))  return 1;
      if (stbtt__matchpair(fc, nm, name, nlen,  3, -1))  return 1;
   }

   return 0;
}

static int stbtt_FindMatchingFont_internal(unsigned char *font_collection, char *name_utf8, stbtt_int32 flags)
{
   stbtt_int32 i;
   for (i=0;;++i) {
      stbtt_int32 off = stbtt_GetFontOffsetForIndex(font_collection, i);
      if (off < 0) return off;
      if (stbtt__matches((stbtt_uint8 *) font_collection, off, (stbtt_uint8*) name_utf8, flags))
         return off;
   }
}

#if defined(__GNUC__) || defined(__clang__)

#pragma GCC diagnostic ignored "-Wcast-qual"
#endif

}

STBTT_DEF int stbtt_GetNumberOfFonts(const unsigned char *data)

}

   return stbtt_InitFont_internal(info, (unsigned char *) data, offset);

STBTT_DEF int stbtt_CompareUTF8toUTF16_bigendian(const char *s1, int len1, const char *s2, int len2)

   return stbtt_CompareUTF8toUTF16_bigendian_internal((char *) s1, len1, (char *) s2, len2);
}
```

`TestCompiledScript/run_emulator_test.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# OpenManager Syscall & ImGui Test Runner for Android Emulator & Physical Devices
set -e

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"

echo "=========================================================="
echo "   Running OpenManager Native C/C++ & ImGui Test Script   "
echo "=========================================================="

# 1. Detect target device/emulator ABI
DEVICE_ABI=$(adb shell getprop ro.product.cpu.abi | tr -d '\r\n')
echo "[*] Target device architecture: ${DEVICE_ABI}"

# 2. Select appropriate compiled binary
BINARY="${SCRIPT_DIR}/bin/${DEVICE_ABI}/test_script"
if [ ! -f "${BINARY}" ]; then
    echo "[!] Exact ABI binary not found at ${BINARY}, checking fallbacks..."
    if [ "${DEVICE_ABI}" = "x86_64" ] && [ -f "${SCRIPT_DIR}/bin/x86_64/test_script" ]; then
        BINARY="${SCRIPT_DIR}/bin/x86_64/test_script"
    elif [ "${DEVICE_ABI}" = "arm64-v8a" ] && [ -f "${SCRIPT_DIR}/bin/arm64-v8a/test_script" ]; then
        BINARY="${SCRIPT_DIR}/bin/arm64-v8a/test_script"
    elif [ -f "${SCRIPT_DIR}/bin/x86_64/test_script" ]; then
        BINARY="${SCRIPT_DIR}/bin/x86_64/test_script"
    elif [ -f "${SCRIPT_DIR}/bin/arm64-v8a/test_script" ]; then
        BINARY="${SCRIPT_DIR}/bin/arm64-v8a/test_script"
    else
        echo "[-] Error: No compiled binary found in ${SCRIPT_DIR}/bin/!"
        exit 1
    fi
fi

echo "[*] Using binary: ${BINARY}"

# 3. Push binary to /data/local/tmp on Android
echo "[*] Pushing binary to Android device (/data/local/tmp/test_script)..."
adb push "${BINARY}" /data/local/tmp/test_script
adb shell chmod 755 /data/local/tmp/test_script

# 4. Execute as standard unprivileged user
echo ""
echo ">>> [TEST 1] Executing as Unprivileged User (ADB Shell) <<<"
adb shell "/data/local/tmp/test_script"
UNPRIV_EXIT=$?
echo "[*] Unprivileged execution finished with exit code: ${UNPRIV_EXIT}"

# 5. Check if Root is available on the target
IS_ROOT=$(adb shell "id -u" | tr -d '\r\n')
echo ""
echo "[*] Current ADB user ID: ${IS_ROOT}"

if [ "${IS_ROOT}" = "0" ]; then
    echo ">>> [TEST 2] Target is natively Root (UID 0), verifying root syscalls... <<<"
    adb shell "/data/local/tmp/test_script"
elif adb shell "which su" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo ">>> [TEST 2] Executing with Root Privileges via su... <<<"
    adb shell "su -c /data/local/tmp/test_script" || adb shell "su 0 /data/local/tmp/test_script"
else
    echo "[!] su binary not present in default PATH; attempting direct root execution via adb root..."
    adb root || true
    adb shell "/data/local/tmp/test_script" || true
fi

echo ""
echo "=========================================================="
echo "   All Syscall & ImGui Tests Completed on Android!        "
echo "=========================================================="

```

```cpp
static void RenderAsciiDashboard(const SyscallProbeResult& res, const ImDrawData* draw_data) {
    std::cout << "\033[1;36m+-------------------------------------------------------------+\033[0m\n";
    std::cout << "\033[1;36m|\033[0m   \033[1;37mOpenManager ImGui Headless Dashboard (ASCII Canvas)\033[0m       \033[1;36m|\033[0m\n";
    std::cout << "\033[1;36m+-------------------------------------------------------------+\033[0m\n";
    std::cout << "\033[1;36m|\033[0m \033[1;33m[1] SYSTEM STATUS\033[0m                                           \033[1;36m|\033[0m\n";
    std::cout << "\033[1;36m|\033[0m   Kernel   : " << std::left << std::setw(46) << (std::string(res.sysname) + " " + res.release + " (" + res.machine + ")") << "\033[1;36m|\033[0m\n";
    std::cout << "\033[1;36m|\033[0m   Process  : PID " << std::left << std::setw(8) << res.pid
              << "UID " << std::setw(6) << res.uid
              << (res.is_root ? "\033[1;32m[ROOT]\033[0m                 " : "\033[1;31m[UNPRIVILEGED]\033[0m         ") << "\033[1;36m|\033[0m\n";

    unsigned long used_ram = (res.total_ram_mb > res.free_ram_mb) ? (res.total_ram_mb - res.free_ram_mb) : 0;
    int ram_pct = res.total_ram_mb > 0 ? (int)((used_ram * 100) / res.total_ram_mb) : 0;
    std::string ram_bar = "[";
    int bar_width = 25;
    int filled = (ram_pct * bar_width) / 100;
    for (int i = 0; i < bar_width; i++) ram_bar += (i < filled) ? '#' : '-';
    ram_bar += "] " + std::to_string(ram_pct) + "%";

    std::cout << "\033[1;36m|\033[0m   RAM Usage: " << std::left << std::setw(46) << ram_bar << "\033[1;36m|\033[0m\n";
    std::cout << "\033[1;36m|\033[0m                                                             \033[1;36m|\033[0m\n";
    std::cout << "\033[1;36m|\033[0m \033[1;33m[2] DEAR IMGUI RENDER ENGINE METRICS\033[0m                        \033[1;36m|\033[0m\n";
    std::cout << "\033[1;36m|\033[0m   ImGui Version  : " << std::left << std::setw(40) << IMGUI_VERSION << "\033[1;36m|\033[0m\n";
    std::cout << "\033[1;36m|\033[0m   Command Lists  : " << std::left << std::setw(40) << (draw_data ? draw_data->CmdListsCount : 0) << "\033[1;36m|\033[0m\n";
    std::cout << "\033[1;36m|\033[0m   Total Vertices : " << std::left << std::setw(40) << (draw_data ? draw_data->TotalVtxCount : 0) << "\033[1;36m|\033[0m\n";
    std::cout << "\033[1;36m|\033[0m   Total Indices  : " << std::left << std::setw(40) << (draw_data ? draw_data->TotalIdxCount : 0) << "\033[1;36m|\033[0m\n";
    std::cout << "\033[1;36m|\033[0m   Syscall Latency: " << std::left << std::setw(40) << (std::to_string(res.syscall_bench_ns) + " ns/call") << "\033[1;36m|\033[0m\n";
    std::cout << "\033[1;36m+-------------------------------------------------------------+\033[0m\n\n";
}

                    (probe_res.total_ram_mb - probe_res.free_ram_mb) : 0;

                ImGui::Text("Syscall Latency : %.2f ns/call", probe_res.syscall_bench_ns);
```

`TestCompiledScript/src/syscall_probe.c`:

```c
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * Syscall & Root Diagnostic Probe (C Implementation)
 */

#ifndef _GNU_SOURCE
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#endif
#include "syscall_probe.h"

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/syscall.h>
#include <sys/utsname.h>
#include <sys/sysinfo.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <errno.h>

#define BENCHMARK_ITERATIONS 50000

int run_syscall_probe(SyscallProbeResult* out) {
    if (!out) return -1;
    memset(out, 0, sizeof(SyscallProbeResult));

    // 1. Direct Low-Level Linux Syscalls for Process Credentials
#ifdef SYS_getpid
    out->pid = (int)syscall(SYS_getpid);
#else
    out->pid = (int)getpid();
#endif

#ifdef SYS_getppid
    out->ppid = (int)syscall(SYS_getppid);
#else
    out->ppid = (int)getppid();
#endif

#ifdef SYS_getuid
    out->uid = (int)syscall(SYS_getuid);
#else
    out->uid = (int)getuid();
#endif

#ifdef SYS_geteuid
    out->euid = (int)syscall(SYS_geteuid);
#else
    out->euid = (int)geteuid();
#endif

#ifdef SYS_getgid
    out->gid = (int)syscall(SYS_getgid);
#else
    out->gid = (int)getgid();
#endif

#ifdef SYS_getegid
    out->egid = (int)syscall(SYS_getegid);
#else
    out->egid = (int)getegid();
#endif

    out->is_root = (out->uid == 0 || out->euid == 0) ? 1 : 0;

    // 2. Syscall: uname (Kernel version & system architecture)
    struct utsname u;
    memset(&u, 0, sizeof(u));
#ifdef SYS_uname
    int uname_res = (int)syscall(SYS_uname, &u);
#else
    int uname_res = uname(&u);
#endif
    if (uname_res == 0) {
        strncpy(out->sysname, u.sysname, sizeof(out->sysname) - 1);
        strncpy(out->nodename, u.nodename, sizeof(out->nodename) - 1);
        strncpy(out->release, u.release, sizeof(out->release) - 1);
        strncpy(out->version, u.version, sizeof(out->version) - 1);
        strncpy(out->machine, u.machine, sizeof(out->machine) - 1);
    }

    // 3. Syscall: sysinfo (Memory & System Resources)
    struct sysinfo s;
    memset(&s, 0, sizeof(s));
#ifdef SYS_sysinfo
    int s_res = (int)syscall(SYS_sysinfo, &s);
#else
    int s_res = sysinfo(&s);
#endif
    if (s_res == 0) {
        unsigned long unit = s.mem_unit ? s.mem_unit : 1;
        out->total_ram_mb = (unsigned long)((s.totalram * unit) / (1024 * 1024));
        out->free_ram_mb = (unsigned long)((s.freeram * unit) / (1024 * 1024));
        out->procs_count = s.procs;
        out->uptime_sec = s.uptime;
    }

    // 4. Read /proc/version
    int fd_ver = open("/proc/version", O_RDONLY);
    if (fd_ver >= 0) {
        ssize_t bytes = read(fd_ver, out->proc_version, sizeof(out->proc_version) - 1);
        if (bytes > 0) {
            out->proc_version[bytes] = '\0';
            // Trim trailing newline
            char* nl = strchr(out->proc_version, '\n');
            if (nl) *nl = '\0';
        }
        close(fd_ver);
    }

    // 5. Check SELinux Enforce
    out->selinux_enforce = -1;
    int fd_se = open("/sys/fs/selinux/enforce", O_RDONLY);
    if (fd_se >= 0) {
        char buf[8] = {0};
        if (read(fd_se, buf, sizeof(buf) - 1) > 0) {
            if (buf[0] == '1') out->selinux_enforce = 1;
            else if (buf[0] == '0') out->selinux_enforce = 0;
        }
        close(fd_se);
    }

    // 6. Superuser binary discovery
    static const char* su_paths[] = {
        "/system/bin/su",
        "/system/xbin/su",
        "/sbin/su",
        "/data/adb/ksu/bin/su",
        "/data/adb/ap/bin/su",
        "/data/adb/magisk/su",
        "/system/bin/ksud",
        "/system/bin/magisk"
    };
    out->su_binary_detected = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(su_paths) / sizeof(su_paths[0]); i++) {
        struct stat st;
        if (stat(su_paths[i], &st) == 0) {
            out->su_binary_detected = 1;
            strncpy(out->su_binary_path, su_paths[i], sizeof(out->su_binary_path) - 1);
            break;
        }
    }

    // 7. Micro-Benchmark: Direct Syscall Latency
    struct timespec t_start, t_end;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t_start);
    for (int i = 0; i < BENCHMARK_ITERATIONS; i++) {
#ifdef SYS_getpid
        (void)syscall(SYS_getpid);
#else
        (void)getpid();
#endif
    }
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t_end);
    double elapsed_ns = (double)(t_end.tv_sec - t_start.tv_sec) * 1e9 +
                        (double)(t_end.tv_nsec - t_start.tv_nsec);
    out->syscall_bench_ns = elapsed_ns / (double)BENCHMARK_ITERATIONS;

    return 0;
}

void print_syscall_probe_result(const SyscallProbeResult* res) {
    if (!res) return;

    printf("\n=======================================================\n");
    printf("   OpenManager Low-Level Syscall & Kernel Diagnostic   \n");
    printf("=======================================================\n");
    printf(" [Process Credentials (via direct syscall)]\n");
    printf("   - PID  : %d | PPID: %d\n", res->pid, res->ppid);
    printf("   - UID  : %d | EUID: %d %s\n", res->uid, res->euid, res->is_root ? "[ROOT ACTIVE]" : "[NON-ROOT]");
    printf("   - GID  : %d | EGID: %d\n", res->gid, res->egid);
    printf("\n [Linux Kernel / Architecture]\n");
    printf("   - OS   : %s (%s)\n", res->sysname, res->machine);
    printf("   - Kernel Release: %s\n", res->release);
    printf("   - Kernel Version: %s\n", res->version);
    if (res->proc_version[0]) {
        printf("   - /proc/version : %s\n", res->proc_version);
    }
    printf("\n [Hardware & Memory via sysinfo]\n");
    printf("   - Total RAM : %lu MB\n", res->total_ram_mb);
    printf("   - Free RAM  : %lu MB\n", res->free_ram_mb);
    printf("   - Live Procs: %u\n", res->procs_count);
    printf("   - Uptime    : %ld sec (%.1f hours)\n", res->uptime_sec, (double)res->uptime_sec / 3600.0);
    printf("\n [Security & Privileges]\n");
    printf("   - Root Elevation: %s\n", res->is_root ? "\033[1;32mYES (UID 0)\033[0m" : "\033[1;33mNO (Standard user)\033[0m");
    const char* se_str = (res->selinux_enforce == 1) ? "\033[1;32mEnforcing (1)\033[0m" :
                         (res->selinux_enforce == 0) ? "\033[1;33mPermissive (0)\033[0m" : "\033[1;30mDisabled / Unknown\033[0m";
    printf("   - SELinux Mode  : %s\n", se_str);
    if (res->su_binary_detected) {
        printf("   - SU Binary     : \033[1;32mFound at %s\033[0m\n", res->su_binary_path);
    } else {
        printf("   - SU Binary     : Not detected in standard paths\n");
    }
    printf("\n [Performance Benchmark]\n");
    printf("   - Direct Syscall Latency : \033[1;36m%.2f ns/call\033[0m (%d iterations)\n",
           res->syscall_bench_ns, BENCHMARK_ITERATIONS);
    printf("=======================================================\n\n");
}
```

`TestCompiledScript/src/syscall_probe.h`:

```h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * Syscall & Root Diagnostic Probe (C Module)
 */

#ifndef SYSCALL_PROBE_H
#define SYSCALL_PROBE_H

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

typedef struct {
    int pid;
    int ppid;
    int uid;
    int euid;
    int gid;
    int egid;
    int is_root;

    char sysname[65];
    char nodename[65];
    char release[65];
    char version[65];
    char machine[65];

    unsigned long total_ram_mb;
    unsigned long free_ram_mb;
    unsigned short procs_count;
    long uptime_sec;

    int selinux_enforce; // -1: unknown/disabled, 0: permissive, 1: enforcing
    char proc_version[256];

    int su_binary_detected;
    char su_binary_path[256];

    double syscall_bench_ns; // average nanoseconds per direct syscall
} SyscallProbeResult;

/**
 * Executes low-level Linux syscalls, gathers system diagnostic data,
 * checks root privileges, and runs micro-benchmarks.
 */
int run_syscall_probe(SyscallProbeResult* out);

/**
 * Prints the probe result cleanly formatted to standard output.
 */
void print_syscall_probe_result(const SyscallProbeResult* res);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif // SYSCALL_PROBE_H

```

```aidl
package me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.remote;

import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.remote.ParcelableCopyOptions;
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.remote.ParcelableDirectoryStream;
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.remote.ParcelableException;
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.remote.ParcelableFileAttributes;
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.remote.ParcelableObject;
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.remote.ParcelablePathListConsumer;
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.remote.ParcelableSerializable;
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.remote.RemotePathObservable;
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.remote.RemoteInputStream;
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.remote.RemoteSeekableByteChannel;
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.RemoteCallback;

interface IRemoteFileSystemProvider {
    RemoteInputStream newInputStream(
        in ParcelableObject file,
        in ParcelableSerializable options,
        out ParcelableException exception
    );

    RemoteSeekableByteChannel newByteChannel(
        in ParcelableObject file,
        in ParcelableSerializable options,
        in ParcelableFileAttributes attributes,
        out ParcelableException exception
    );

    ParcelableDirectoryStream newDirectoryStream(
        in ParcelableObject directory,
        in ParcelableObject filter,
        out ParcelableException exception
    );

    void createDirectory(
        in ParcelableObject directory,
        in ParcelableFileAttributes attributes,
        out ParcelableException exception
    );

    void createSymbolicLink(
        in ParcelableObject link,
        in ParcelableObject target,
        in ParcelableFileAttributes attributes,
        out ParcelableException exception
    );

    void createLink(
        in ParcelableObject link,
        in ParcelableObject existing,
        out ParcelableException exception
    );

    void delete(in ParcelableObject path, out ParcelableException exception);

    ParcelableObject readSymbolicLink(in ParcelableObject link, out ParcelableException exception);

    RemoteCallback copy(
        in ParcelableObject source,
        in ParcelableObject target,
        in ParcelableCopyOptions options,
        in RemoteCallback callback
    );

    RemoteCallback move(
        in ParcelableObject source,
        in ParcelableObject target,
        in ParcelableCopyOptions options,
        in RemoteCallback callback
    );

    boolean isSameFile(
        in ParcelableObject path,
        in ParcelableObject path2,
        out ParcelableException exception
    );

    boolean isHidden(in ParcelableObject path, out ParcelableException exception);

    ParcelableObject getFileStore(in ParcelableObject path, out ParcelableException exception);

    void checkAccess(
        in ParcelableObject path,
        in ParcelableSerializable modes,
        out ParcelableException exception
    );

    ParcelableObject readAttributes(
        in ParcelableObject path,
        in ParcelableSerializable type,
        in ParcelableSerializable options,
        out ParcelableException exception
    );

    RemotePathObservable observe(
        in ParcelableObject path,
        long intervalMillis,
        out ParcelableException exception
    );

    RemoteCallback search(
        in ParcelableObject directory,
        in String query,
        long intervalMillis,
        in ParcelablePathListConsumer listener,
        in RemoteCallback callback
    );
}
```

```mtsx
{
    name: ["ABNF", ".abnf"]
    styles: [
        "repeat" > "constant"
        "option" > "keyword"
        "prose"  > "string"
    ]
    ignoreCase: true
    comment: {startsWith: ";"}
    contains: [
        {match: /[\[\]\/]/, 0: "option"}
        {match: /(?:(?:\b(?<!-)\d+)?\*\d*|\b(?<!-)\d+) ?(?![ \t\r\n0-9*\/)\]])/, 0: "repeat"}
        {match: /%b[01]+(?:(?:\.[01]+)+|-[01]+)?\b/, 0: "number"}
        {match: /%d\d+(?:(?:\.\d+)+|-\d+)?\b/, 0: "number"}
        {match: /%x[0-9a-f]+(?:(?:\.[0-9a-f]+)+|-[0-9a-f]+)?\b/, 0: "number"}
        {match: /<[^>\r\n]*>/, 0: "prose"}
        {match: /(?:%[si])?"[^"\r\n]*"/, 0: "string"}
        {match: /[<>"]/, 0: "error"}
    ]
}
```

```mtsx
        "directive",  #58908A, #58908A
    ]

    defines: [
        "todo": {match: keywordsToRegex("TODO FIXME XXX NOTE todo"), 0: "todo"}
    ]

    contains: [
        { // comment
            match: /(?m)(?:[;|]|^#|[#!](?!\d)|\/\/).*/
            0: "comment"
            0: {include: "todo"}
        }
        { // comment multiline
            start: {match: "/\\*"}
            end: {match: "\\*/"}
            color: "comment"
            contains: [
                {include: "todo"}
            ]
        }
        { // type
            match: /\./ + keywordsToRegex(
                "long ascii asciz byte double float hword int octa quad"
                "short single space string word 2byte 4byte 8byte"
                // ext
            )
            0: "keyword2"
        }
        { // cond
            match: /\./ + keywordsToRegex(
                "if iff if_false ift iftf if_true if_true_false iif else endif"
                "irp iprc repeat rept endr"
            )
            0: "macro"
        }
        { // macro
            match: /\./ + keywordsToRegex(
                "include library macro mexit endm mcall mdelete"
            )
            0: "macro"
        }
        { // directive
            match: /\.[a-z][a-z\d_\-.]*\b:?/
            0: "directive"
        }
        { // label
            match: /(?<!:)\.?\b[a-z][a-z\d_\-.]*:/
            0: "label"
        }
        { // cmd
            match: /(?m)^\s*[a-z][a-z\d_\-.]*\b/
            0: "keyword"
        }
        { // special
            match: /[#!%.@$~?]|:[a-z][a-z\d_\-.]*:/
            0: "meta"
        }
        { // operator
            match: /[\[\]+\-*\/=&<>]/
            0: "operator"
        }
        {match: /,/, 0: "keyword"}
        {builtin: #C_NUMBER#}
        {builtin: #C_QUOTED_STRING#}
    ]
}
```

`app/src/main/assets/syntax/bat.mtsx`:

```mtsx
{
    name: ["Batch", ".bat", ".cmd"]

    // 忽略大小写（批处理命令不区分大小写）
    ignoreCase: true

    // 自定义样式
    styles: [
        "path" > "type"              // 文件路径样式
        "envVar" > "constant"        // 环境变量样式
    ]

    // 行注释（两种方式）
    comment: {startsWith: "::"}      // :: 注释
    comment: {startsWith: "rem ", insertSpace: false}  // rem 注释

    // 括号配对
    bracketPairs: ["()"]

    // 正则定义
    defines: [
        // 环境变量和参数（用于字符串内外复用）
        "variables": [
            // 延迟扩展变量 !var!
            {match: /!\w+!/, 0: "envVar"}

            // 循环变量 %%var 或 %var（在脚本中）
            {match: /%%?\w+/, 0: "envVar"}

            // 环境变量 %VAR%（支持修饰符如 %~dp0）
            {match: /%[\w:,~\-=]+%/, 0: "envVar"}

            // 命令行参数 %0-%9 和 %*
            {match: /%[0-9*]/, 0: "envVar"}

            // 特殊参数修饰符 %~dp0, %~nx1 等
            {match: /%~[fpdnxsatz]*[0-9]/, 0: "envVar"}
        ]
    ]

    contains: [
        // ===== 字符串 =====
        {
            start: {match: /"/}
            end: {match: /(?m)"|$/}
            style: "string"
            contains: [
                // 转义字符（批处理中 ^ 是转义符）
                {match: /\^./, 0: "strEscape"}

                // 字符串内的变量
                {include: "variables"}
            ]
        }

        // ===== 注释 =====
        // rem 命令（不以 :: 开头的注释）
        {match: /(?m)^\s*rem\b.*$/, 0: "comment"}
        {match: /\brem\b.*/, 0: "comment"}

        // ===== 变量（字符串外） =====
        {include: "variables"}

        // ===== 关键字命令 =====
        {match: keywordsToRegex(
            // 基础命令
            "echo set call exit goto if else not exist defined errorlevel"

            // 流程控制
            "for in do shift choice"

            // 文件操作
            "copy xcopy move del erase ren rename mkdir md rmdir rd type"
            "find findstr more attrib"

            // 目录操作
            "cd chdir dir pushd popd"

            // 系统命令
            "cls color date time ver vol path prompt"
            "start cmd pause timeout"

            // 进程管理
            "tasklist taskkill"

            // 网络命令
            "ping telnet ipconfig netstat"

            // 注册表
            "reg regedit"

            // 其他常用命令
            "setlocal endlocal assoc ftype mklink shutdown"

            // 外部工具（常见）
            "adb fastboot java python pip wget curl busybox"
        ), 0: "keyword"}

        // ===== 特殊命令模式 =====
        // goto 标签跳转
        {
            match: /\b(goto)\s+(:?)(\w+)/
            1: "keyword"
            2: "operator"
            3: "label"
        }

        // 标签定义 :label
        {match: /(?m)^\s*:\w+/, 0: "label"}

        // ===== 比较运算符 =====
        {match: /\b(EQU|NEQ|LSS|LEQ|GTR|GEQ)\b/, 0: "operator"}
        {match: /==/, 0: "operator"}

        // ===== 特殊前缀 =====
        // @ 符号（抑制命令回显）
        {match: /@/, 0: "meta"}

        // ===== 重定向和管道 =====
        {match: /[<>|&]+/, 0: "operator"}

        // ===== 数字 =====
        {match: /\b\d+\b/, 0: "number"}

        // ===== 文件路径 =====
        // Windows 路径（支持盘符、反斜杠、特殊字符）
        {match: /[a-zA-Z]:[\\\/][\w\-\u0080-\uffff#$.,\\\/]*/, 0: "path"}

        // 相对路径或网络路径
        {match: /(?:\.{1,2}[\\\/])?[\w\-\u0080-\uffff#$.,]+(?:[\\\/][\w\-\u0080-\uffff#$.,]+)+/, 0: "path"}

        // UNC 路径 \\server\share
        {match: /\\\\[\w\-\u0080-\uffff.]+\\[\w\-\u0080-\uffff#$.,\\\/]*/, 0: "path"}
    ]
}
```

```mtsx
{
    name: ["C", ".c"]

    // 自定义样式
    styles: [
        "preprocessor" > "meta"
        "funcDef" > "keyword", @B
    ]

    // 注释配置
    comment: {startsWith: "//"}
    comment: {startsWith: "/*", endsWith: "*/"}

    // 可复用定义
    defines: [
        // 标识符
        "identifier": /[a-zA-Z_]\w*/

        // 类型名（大写开头或常见类型）
        "typeName": [
            {match: /\b[A-Z]\w*\b/, 0: "type"}
            {match: keywordsToRegex(
                "size_t ssize_t ptrdiff_t intptr_t uintptr_t"
                "int8_t int16_t int32_t int64_t"
                "uint8_t uint16_t uint32_t uint64_t"
                "FILE DIR time_t clock_t"
            ), 0: "type"}
        ]
    ]

    contains: [
        // 字符串和字符
        {builtin: #C_QUOTED_STRING#}

        // 数字
        {builtin: #C_NUMBER#}

        // #include 带尖括号
        {match: /(?m)^[ \t]*(#[ \t]*include)(\s*<[^>]+>)/, 1: "preprocessor", 2: "string"}

        // #include 带引号（由内置字符串处理，这里只高亮指令）
        {match: /(?m)^[ \t]*(#[ \t]*include)\b/, 1: "preprocessor"}

        // #define 宏定义
        {
            start: {match: /(?m)^[ \t]*(#[ \t]*define)\s+(/ + include("identifier") + /)/, 1: "preprocessor", 2: "constant"}
            end: {match: /(?m)(?<!\\)$/}
            style: "default"
            contains: [
                {match: /\/\/[^\r\n]*/, 0: "comment"}
                {
                    style: "comment"
                    start: {match: /\/\*/}
                    end: {match: /\*\//}
                }
                {builtin: #C_QUOTED_STRING#}
                {builtin: #C_NUMBER#}
                {match: /\\$/, 0: "preprocessor"}  // 行续接符
            ]
        }

        // 其他预处理指令
        {match: /(?m)^[ \t]*(#[ \t]*\w+)/, 1: "preprocessor"}

        // 关键字
        {match: keywordsToRegex(
            "auto break case char const continue default do double else enum extern float for"
            "goto if int long register return short signed sizeof static struct switch typedef"
            "union unsigned void volatile while inline restrict _Bool _Complex _Imaginary"
            "_Alignas _Alignof _Atomic _Static_assert _Noreturn _Thread_local _Generic"
        ), 0: "keyword"}

        // 布尔和空值常量
        {match: keywordsToRegex("true false NULL"), 0: "constant"}

        // 类型定义：typedef ... TypeName;
        {match: /\b(typedef)\s+/, 1: "keyword"}

        // struct/union/enum 定义
        {match: /\b(struct|union|enum)\s+(/ + include("identifier") + /)/, 1: "keyword", 2: "type"}

        // 类型名
        {include: "typeName"}

        // 全大写常量（宏）
        {match: /\b[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{2,}\b/, 0: "constant"}

        // 函数调用
        {match: /\b(/ + include("identifier") + /)(?=\s*\()/, 1: "variable"}
    ]
}
```

```mtsx
            "male female child code"
            "spell-out"

        // 字符串（单引号和双引号）
        "strings": [
            {
                start: {match: /"/}
                end: {match: /(?m)"|$/}
                style: "string"
                contains: [
                    {match: /\\./, 0: "strEscape"}
                ]
            }
            {
                start: {match: /'/}
                end: {match: /(?m)'|$/}
                style: "string"
                contains: [
                    {match: /\\./, 0: "strEscape"}
                ]
            }
        ]

        // 数字和单位
        "numbers": [
            // 十六进制颜色
            {match: /#([0-9a-fA-F]{3,8})\b/, 0: "parseColor(auto,1,HEX)"}

            // 数字 + 百分号（百分号后面不是单词字符）
            {match: /\b\d+(\.\d+)?%/, 0: "number"}

            // 数字 + 单位（单位都是字母，可以用 \b）
            {match: /\b\d+(\.\d+)?(ch|cm|deg|dpcm|dpi|dppx|em|ex|fr|grad|hz|in|khz|mm|ms|pc|pt|px|q|rad|rem|s|turn|vh|vmax|vmin|vw)\b/, 0: "number"}

            // 纯数字
            {match: /\b\d+(\.\d+)?\b/, 0: "number"}
        ]

        // url() 函数
        "urlFunction": {
            start: {match: /\b(url)\s*\(/, 1: "keyword"}
            end: {match: /\)|$/}
            contains: [
                {include: "strings"}
                {match: /[^\s)]+/, 0: "string"}
            ]
        }

        // var() 函数 - 单独处理以高亮 CSS 变量
        "varFunction": {
            start: {match: /\b(var)\s*\(/, 1: "keyword"}
            end: {match: /\)|$/}
            contains: [
                // CSS 自定义属性名
                {match: /--[\w-]+/, 0: "customProperty"}
                // 逗号和回退值
                {match: /,/, 0: "operator"}
                {include: "strings"}
                {include: "numbers"}
                {match: include("propertyValues"), 0: "propertyValue"}
            ]
        }

        // 其他 CSS 函数
        "functions": {
            start: {match: /\b(calc|rgb|rgba|hsl|hsla|hwb|lab|lch|oklab|oklch|color|linear-gradient|radial-gradient|repeating-linear-gradient|repeating-radial-gradient|conic-gradient|repeating-conic-gradient|min|max|clamp|attr|counter|counters|cubic-bezier|steps|translate|translateX|translateY|translateZ|translate3d|scale|scaleX|scaleY|scaleZ|scale3d|rotate|rotateX|rotateY|rotateZ|rotate3d|skew|skewX|skewY|matrix|matrix3d|perspective|blur|brightness|contrast|drop-shadow|grayscale|hue-rotate|invert|opacity|saturate|sepia)\s*\(/, 1: "keyword"}
            end: {match: /\)|$/}
            contains: [
                {include: "strings"}
                {include: "numbers"}
                {match: include("propertyValues"), 0: "propertyValue"}
                {match: /\//, 0: "operator"}
                {match: /,/, 0: "operator"}
            ]
        }

        // 块注释在规则块和属性值中复用；根级注释仍由 comment 元数据自动生成
        "blockComment": {
            start: {match: /\/\*/}
            end: {match: /\*\/|$/}
            style: "comment"
        }

        // 属性值子规则由普通规则块和独立声明片段共用，避免两种入口产生不同高亮
        "propertyValueParts": [
            {include: "blockComment"}
            {include: "urlFunction"}
            {include: "varFunction"}
            {include: "functions"}
            {include: "strings"}
            {include: "numbers"}
            {match: include("propertyValues"), 0: "propertyValue"}
            {match: /!important\b/, 0: "meta"}
            {match: /\//, 0: "operator"}
            {match: /,/, 0: "operator"}
        ]

        // 声明片段接受任意合法属性名；根级候选顺序负责让已知标签选择器优先决胜
        "inlineDeclaration": {
            start: {
                match: /(?:\A|(?<=;)|(?<=\*\/))[ \t\r\n]*(?!(?!/ + include("propertyNames") + /\s*:)[a-zA-Z][\w-]*-[\w-]+\s*::?/ + include("pseudoSelectorNames") + /)(?:(--[\w-]+)|(-?[a-zA-Z][\w-]*))\s*:/
                1: "customProperty"
                2: "propertyName"
            }
            end: {match: /;|$/}
            contains: [
                {match: /[{}]/} => FAIL
                {include: "propertyValueParts"}
            ]
        }

        // @media 规则的特性查询（用于 contains）
        "mediaFeatures": [
            // 媒体特性
            {
                start: {match: /\(/}
                end: {match: /\)/}
                contains: [
                    // 属性名
                    {match: include("propertyNames"), 0: "propertyName"}
                    {match: /\b([a-z][\w-]*)\s*(?=:)/, 1: "propertyName"}
                    // 运算符
                    {match: /[:<>=]/, 0: "operator"}
                    // 数值
                    {include: "numbers"}
                    // 关键字值
                    {match: include("propertyValues"), 0: "propertyValue"}
                ]
            }
        ]
    ]

    contains: [
        // @ 规则（支持括号和花括号两种形式）
        {
            start: {match: /(@(?:charset|import|namespace))\b/, 1: "atRule"}
            end: {match: /;/}
            contains: [
                {include: "strings"}
                {include: "urlFunction"}
                {match: include("propertyValues"), 0: "propertyValue"}
            ]
        }

        // @media, @supports 等带条件的 @ 规则
        {
            start: {match: /(@(?:media|supports|document))\b/, 1: "atRule"}
            end: {match: /(?=\{)/}
            contains: [
                {include: "strings"}
                {match: /\b(and|or|not|only)\b/, 0: "keyword"}
                {match: include("propertyValues"), 0: "propertyValue"}
                {include: "mediaFeatures"}
            ]
        }

        // @keyframes, @font-face, @page 等
        {
            start: {match: /(@(?:keyframes|-webkit-keyframes|-moz-keyframes|font-face|page|counter-style|font-feature-values|property|layer))\b/, 1: "atRule"}
            end: {match: /(?=\{)/}
            contains: [
                {include: "strings"}
                {match: /\b[a-zA-Z][\w-]*/, 0: "constant"}
            ]
        }

        // 已知标签先于声明片段决胜，但不能截断 object-fit 等以标签名开头的属性
        {match: include("htmlTags") + /(?![\w-])/, 0: "tagName"}

        // 其余声明仍先于后续选择器竞争；花括号会触发 FAIL 并回退到正常规则
        {include: "inlineDeclaration"}

        // 通配符选择器
        {match: /\*/, 0: "operator"}

        // ID 选择器
        {match: /#[a-zA-Z][\w-]*/, 0: "idSelector"}

        // 类选择器
        {match: /\.[a-zA-Z][\w-]*/, 0: "className"}

        // 伪类和伪元素
        {match: /::?[a-zA-Z][\w-]*/, 0: "pseudoSelector"}

        // 属性选择器
        {
            start: {match: /\[/}
            end: {match: /\]/}
            contains: [
                {match: /[~|^$*]?=/, 0: "operator"}
                {include: "strings"}
                {match: /\b[a-zA-Z][\w-]*/, 0: "propertyName"}
            ]
        }

        // 选择器运算符
        {match: /[>+~]/, 0: "operator"}

        // !important
        {match: /!important\b/, 0: "meta"}

        // 规则块
        {
            start: {match: /\{/}
            end: {match: /\}/}
            contains: [
                // 注释（需要显式添加）
                {include: "blockComment"}

                // 嵌套规则（用于 CSS 嵌套或预处理器）
                {match: /&/, 0: "operator"}

                // CSS 自定义属性（CSS 变量）定义
                {match: /(--[\w-]+)\s*(?=:)/, 1: "customProperty"}

                // 属性名
                {match: /\b([a-zA-Z][\w-]*)\s*(?=:)/, 1: "propertyName"}
                {match: include("propertyNames") + /(?=\s*:)/, 0: "propertyName"}

                // 属性值
                {
                    start: {match: /:/}
                    end: {match: /;|(?=\})/}
                    contains: [{include: "propertyValueParts"}]
                }
            ]
        }

        // 数字（用于选择器中的数字，如 :nth-child(2n+1)）
        {include: "numbers"}
    ]

    codeFormatter: #BUILT_IN_CSS_FORMATTER#
    codeShrinker: #BUILT_IN_CSS_SHRINKER#
}
```

```mtsx
{
    name: ["DTS", ".dts", ".dtsi"]

    comment: {startsWith: "//"}
    comment: {startsWith: "/*", endsWith: "*/"}

    bracketPairs: ["{}", "[]", "()", "<>"]

    styles: [
        "preprocessor" > "meta"
        "nodeLabel" > "label"
        "nodeName", #2B91AF, #78A8C8
        "refPath" > "variable"
        "cellArray" > "default"
    ]

    defines: [
        // 预处理指令关键字
        "ppKeywords": keywordsToRegex(
            "include define undef if ifdef ifndef elif else endif"
        )

        // 转义字符（字符串内）
        "stringEscape": [
            {match: /\\([nrtv\\'"0]|x[0-9a-fA-F]{2})/, 0: "strEscape"}
            {match: /\\./, 0: "error"}
        ]

        // 字符串（双引号）
        "doubleQuotedString": {
            start: {match: /"/}
            end: {match: /(?m)"|$/}
            style: "string"
            contains: [{include: "stringEscape"}]
        }

        // 属性值的各种形式
        "propertyValue": [
            // 引用路径 &label 或 &{/path/to/node}
            {match: /&\{[^}]+\}/, 0: "refPath"}
            {match: /&[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*/, 0: "refPath"}

            // Cell数组 <...>
            {
                start: {match: /</}
                end: {match: />/}
                style: "cellArray"
                contains: [
                    // 引用 &phandle
                    {match: /&[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*/, 0: "refPath"}
                    // 十六进制数
                    {match: /\b0x[0-9a-fA-F]+\b/, 0: "number"}
                    // 十进制数
                    {match: /\b\d+\b/, 0: "number"}
                ]
            }

            // 字节数组 [...]
            {
                start: {match: /\[/}
                end: {match: /\]/}
                style: "string"
                contains: [
                    {match: /\b[0-9a-fA-F]{2}\b/, 0: "number"}
                ]
            }

            // 字符串
            {include: "doubleQuotedString"}

            // 数字
            {match: /\b0x[0-9a-fA-F]+\b/, 0: "number"}
            {match: /\b\d+\b/, 0: "number"}
        ]
    ]

    contains: [
        // 预处理指令 #include, #define 等
        {
            start: {match: /(?m)^\s*(#)\s*/, 1: "preprocessor"}
            end: {match: /(?m)(?<!\\)$/}
            style: "preprocessor"
            contains: [
                {match: /\/\/[^\r\n]*/, 0: "comment"}
                {
                    style: "comment"
                    start: {match: /\/\*/}
                    end: {match: /\*\//}
                }
                // 预处理关键字
                {match: include("ppKeywords"), 0: "preprocessor"}
                // 包含的文件名
                {match: /<[^>]+>/, 0: "string"}
                {include: "doubleQuotedString"}
                // 宏参数
                {match: /\b[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*\b/, 0: "constant"}
            ]
        }

        // /dts-v1/ 声明
        {match: /\/dts-v1\/\s*;/, 0: "keyword"}

        // /plugin/ 声明
        {match: /\/plugin\/\s*;/, 0: "keyword"}

        // /memreserve/ 内存保留声明
        {
            start: {match: /\/memreserve\//, 0: "keyword"}
            end: {match: /;/}
            contains: [
                {match: /\b0x[0-9a-fA-F]+\b/, 0: "number"}
                {match: /\b\d+\b/, 0: "number"}
            ]
        }

        // /delete-node/ 删除节点语句
        {
            match: /(\/delete-node\/)\s+([a-zA-Z0-9_,-]+|&[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*)/
            1: "keyword"
            2: "nodeName"
        }

        // /delete-property/ 删除属性语句
        {
            match: /(\/delete-property\/)\s+([a-zA-Z0-9_,-]+)/
            1: "keyword"
            2: "propKey"
        }

        // 节点定义：label: node@address {
        {
            group: link
            contains: [
                // 节点标签（可选）
                {match: /([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)\s*:\s*/, 1: "nodeLabel"}
                // 节点名称
                {
                    start: {match: /([a-zA-Z0-9_,-]+(?:@[0-9a-fA-F]+)?)\s*/, 1: "nodeName"}
                    end: {match: /(?=\{)/}
                }
            ]
        }

        // 节点引用修改：&label { ... } 或 &{/path} { ... }
        {
            group: link
            contains: [
                {match: /(&)(\{[^}]+\}|[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*)\s*/, 1: "operator", 2: "refPath"}
                {match: /(?=\{)/}
            ]
        }

        // 属性定义：property-name = <value>;
        {
            group: link
            contains: [
                // 属性名
                {match: /([a-zA-Z0-9_,#-]+)\s*/, 1: "propKey"}
                // 等号（可选，布尔属性没有值）
                {match: /=\s*/}
                // 属性值
                {
                    start: {match: /(?=[<\["&0-9a-zA-Z])/}
                    end: {match: /(?=;)/}
                    contains: [{include: "propertyValue"}]
                }
                // 分号
                {match: /;/}
            ]
        }

        // 字符串（独立出现）
        {include: "doubleQuotedString"}

        // 数字（独立出现）
        {match: /\b0x[0-9a-fA-F]+\b/, 0: "number"}
        {match: /\b\d+\b/, 0: "number"}

        // 引用（独立出现）
        {match: /&\{[^}]+\}/, 0: "refPath"}
        {match: /&[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*/, 0: "refPath"}
    ]
}
```

`app/src/main/assets/syntax/html.mtsx`:

```mtsx
// require MT >= 2.26.10
{
    name: ["HTML", ".html", ".htm"]
    ignoreCase: true

    comment: {startsWith: "<!--", endsWith: "-->", addToContains: false}

    bracketPairs: ["<>", "{}", "[]", "()"]

    defines: [
        "phpOpening": /<\?(?:php(?=[ \t\r\n]|\z)|=)/
        "scriptOpening": /<\s*(script)(?=[\s\/>]|/ + include("phpOpening") + /)/
        "scriptJavascriptType": /(?:text\/javascript|application\/javascript|module)?/
        "scriptJsonType": /application\/(?:ld\+)?json|importmap/
        // PHP 字符串、块注释可跨过 ?>；未闭合 PHP 保持到输入末尾。
        "php": {
            start: {match: include("phpOpening"), 0: "!!meta"}
            end: {match: /\?>/, 0: "!!meta"}
            style: "!!default"
            matchEndFirst: false
            childrenSyntax: "PHP-Code"
        }
        "htmlComment": {
            start: {match: /<!--/}
            end: {match: /-->/}
            style: "comment"
            contains: [{include: "php"}]
        }

        // 动态选择器使用不回溯的逐字符前缀；停止条件只在引号外识别真实属性名
        "tagAttributeBeforeType": /(?:(?:"(?:[^"<]++|<(?!\?(?:php(?=[ \t\r\n]|\z)|=)))*+"|'(?:[^'<]++|<(?!\?(?:php(?=[ \t\r\n]|\z)|=)))*+'|(?!(?:[ \t\r\n]+type[ \t\r\n]*=))[^"'<>]))*+/
        // 静态属性按互斥文本块消费；遇到 PHP 则退回逐层解析，避免 PHP 引号截断属性
        "tagAttributeText": /(?:"(?:[^"<]++|<(?!\?(?:php(?=[ \t\r\n]|\z)|=)))*+"|'(?:[^'<]++|<(?!\?(?:php(?=[ \t\r\n]|\z)|=)))*+'|[^"'<>]++)*+/

        // 标签属性的匹配规则
        "tagAttributes": [
            // HTML 注释（可以出现在标签内）
            {include: "htmlComment"}
            {include: "php"}

            // style 属性正文交给 CSS；两种引号分别声明，避免子语法吞掉宿主边界
            {
                start: {match: /(?<!\S)(style)\s*(=\s*)(")/, 1: "attrName", 2: "operator", 3: "string"}
                end: {match: /"/, 0: "string"}
                mustMatchEnd: true
                childrenSyntax: ".css"
            }
            {
                start: {match: /(?<!\S)(style)\s*(=\s*)(')/, 1: "attrName", 2: "operator", 3: "string"}
                end: {match: /'/, 0: "string"}
                mustMatchEnd: true
                childrenSyntax: ".css"
            }

            // xmlns 命名空间声明：xmlns:prefix="uri"
            {match: /(xmlns:)([^='"<>\s]+)/, 1: "attrName", 2: "namespace"}

            // 普通属性名（支持命名空间）：namespace:attrName 或 attrName
            {match: /(?:([^='"<\/>\s]+)(:))?([^='"<\/>\s]+)/, 1: "namespace", 2: "attrName", 3: "attrName"}

            // 普通属性逐层匹配，PHP 内的同类引号和 > 不结束外层属性或标签。
            {match: /=\s*/, 0: "operator"}
            {
                start: {match: /"/}
                end: {match: /"/}
                style: "string"
                contains: [{include: "php"}]
            }
            {
                start: {match: /'/}
                end: {match: /'/}
                style: "string"
                contains: [{include: "php"}]
            }
        ]

        "scriptJavascriptTypeAttribute": {
            match: /(?<!\S)(type)([ \t\r\n]*=[ \t\r\n]*)((['"]?)/ + include("scriptJavascriptType") + /\4)(?=[ \t\r\n>]|\/>)/
            1: "attrName"
            2: "operator"
            3: "string"
        }
        "scriptJsonTypeAttribute": {
            match: /(?<!\S)(type)([ \t\r\n]*=[ \t\r\n]*)((['"]?)(?:/ + include("scriptJsonType") + /)\4)(?=[ \t\r\n>]|\/>)/
            1: "attrName"
            2: "operator"
            3: "string"
        }
        "scriptTypeAssignment": {match: /(?<!\S)type[ \t\r\n]*=/}
        "tagOpeningTail": {
            start: {match: /(?=[ \t\r\n>]|\/>)/}
            end: {match: />/}
            mustMatchEnd: true
            contains: [
                {match: /\/>/} => FAIL
                {include: "tagAttributes"}
            ]
        }

        // HTML 实体引用
        "entityReferences": [
            // 常见命名实体
            {match: /&(?:amp|gt|lt|quot|apos|nbsp|copy|reg|trade|euro|cent|pound|yen|deg|plusmn|times|divide|hellip|mdash|ndash|lsquo|rsquo|ldquo|rdquo|bull|middot|sect|para|dagger|Dagger|permil|prime|Prime|lsaquo|rsaquo|oline|frasl|weierp|image|real|alefsym|larr|uarr|rarr|darr|harr|crarr|lArr|uArr|rArr|dArr|hArr|forall|part|exist|empty|nabla|isin|notin|ni|prod|sum|minus|lowast|radic|prop|infin|ang|and|or|cap|cup|int|there4|sim|cong|asymp|ne|equiv|le|ge|sub|sup|nsub|sube|supe|oplus|otimes|perp|sdot|lceil|rceil|lfloor|rfloor|lang|rang|loz|spades|clubs|hearts|diams);/, 0: "strEscape"}

            // 数字实体（十进制）
            {match: /&#\d+;/, 0: "strEscape"}

            // 数字实体（十六进制）
            {match: /&#x[0-9a-fA-F]+;/, 0: "strEscape"}

            // 错误的实体引用（缺少分号或不存在的实体名）
            {match: /&[a-zA-Z0-9#]*;?/, 0: "error"}
        ]
    ]

    contains: [
        {include: "php"}
        {include: "htmlComment"}

        // DOCTYPE 声明
        {
            start: {match: /<!(DOCTYPE|doctype)\b/, 1: "keyword"}
            end: {match: />|$/}
            style: "meta"
            contains: [
                {match: /(PUBLIC|SYSTEM|"[^"]*"|'[^']*')/, 0: "string"}
            ]
        }

        // CDATA 区块
        {
            start: {match: /<!\[CDATA\[/}
            end: {match: /\]\]>|$/}
            style: "string"
        }

        // 常见 script type 按真实 HTML 用法选择语言；未知值保持缺失回退
        {
            start: {
                match: /<\s*(script)(?=[\s\/>])(/ + include("tagAttributeBeforeType") + /[ \t\r\n]+type[ \t\r\n]*=[ \t\r\n]*(["']?)([^"'<>]*?)\3(?=[ \t\r\n>]|\/>)/ + include("tagAttributeText") + /)(?<!\/)>/
                1: "tagName"
                2: {include: "tagAttributes"}
            }
            end: {match: /<\/\s*(script)\s*>/, 1: "tagName"}
            childrenSyntax: {
                capture: 4
                "" => ".js"
                "text/javascript" => ".js"
                "application/javascript" => ".js"
                "module" => ".js"
                "application/json" => ".json"
                "application/ld+json" => ".json"
                "importmap" => ".json"
            }
        }

        // 未声明动态选择器的 script 正文使用 JavaScript
        {
            start: {
                match: /<\s*(script)(?=[\s\/>])(/ + include("tagAttributeText") + /)(?<!\/)>/
                1: "tagName"
                2: {include: "tagAttributes"}
            }
            end: {match: /<\/\s*(script)\s*>/, 1: "tagName"}
            childrenSyntax: ".js"
        }

        // style 正文固定使用 CSS
        {
            start: {
                match: /<\s*(style)(?=[\s\/>])(/ + include("tagAttributeText") + /)(?<!\/)>/
                1: "tagName"
                2: {include: "tagAttributes"}
            }
            end: {match: /<\/\s*(style)\s*>/, 1: "tagName"}
            childrenSyntax: ".css"
        }

        // 引号属性内的 PHP 不改变属性名；逐层寻找第一个静态 type，保留 JSON 路由。
        {
            start: {
                group: linkAll
                contains: [
                    {
                        start: {match: include("scriptOpening"), 1: "tagName"}
                        end: {include: "scriptJsonTypeAttribute"}
                        mustMatchEnd: true
                        contains: [
                            {match: /\/?>/} => FAIL
                            {include: "scriptTypeAssignment"} => FAIL
                            {include: "php"} => FAIL
                            {include: "tagAttributes"}
                        ]
                    }
                    {include: "tagOpeningTail"}
                ]
            }
            end: {match: /<\/\s*(script)\s*>/, 1: "tagName"}
            childrenSyntax: ".json"
        }

        // 未声明 type 或显式 JavaScript 时，nonce 等普通属性内的 PHP 不影响正文语言。
        {
            start: {
                group: linkAll
                contains: [
                    {
                        start: {match: include("scriptOpening"), 1: "tagName"}
                        end: {
                            group: select
                            contains: [
                                {include: "scriptJavascriptTypeAttribute"}
                                {match: /(?=>)/}
                            ]
                        }
                        mustMatchEnd: true
                        contains: [
                            {match: /\/>/} => FAIL
                            {include: "scriptTypeAssignment"} => FAIL
                            {include: "php"} => FAIL
                            {include: "tagAttributes"}
                        ]
                    }
                    {include: "tagOpeningTail"}
                ]
            }
            end: {match: /<\/\s*(script)\s*>/, 1: "tagName"}
            childrenSyntax: ".js"
        }

        // 动态 type 或整段属性注入无法静态选定语言；隔离原始正文，不注入 PHP。
        {
            start: {
                start: {match: include("scriptOpening"), 1: "tagName"}
                end: {match: />/}
                contains: [
                    {match: /\/>/} => FAIL
                    {include: "tagAttributes"}
                ]
            }
            end: {match: /<\/\s*(script)\s*>/, 1: "tagName"}
        }

        // style 正文固定为 CSS，普通属性或整段属性中的 PHP 不改变这一入口。
        {
            start: {
                start: {match: /<\s*(style)(?=[\s\/>]|/ + include("phpOpening") + /)/, 1: "tagName"}
                end: {match: />/}
                contains: [
                    {match: /\/>/} => FAIL
                    {include: "tagAttributes"}
                ]
            }
            end: {match: /<\/\s*(style)\s*>/, 1: "tagName"}
            childrenSyntax: ".css"
        }

        // pre 标签（预格式化文本）
        {
            start: {
                start: {match: /<\s*(pre)\b/, 1: "tagName"}
                end: {match: />|$/}
                contains: [{include: "tagAttributes"}]
            }
            end: {match: /<\/\s*(pre)\s*>/, 1: "tagName"}
            contains: [{include: "php"} {include: "entityReferences"}]
        }

        // XML 处理指令：<?xml ... ?>
        {
            start: {match: /<\?([^\s\/>]+)/, 1: "keyword"}
            end: {match: /\?>|$/}
            style: "meta"
            contains: [{include: "tagAttributes"}]
        }

        // 自闭合标签和开始标签：<tagName ... /> 或 <tagName ... >
        // 允许 < 和标签名之间有空格，支持命名空间
        {
            start: {match: /<\s*([^\s<>\/]+)/, 1: "tagName"}
            end: {match: /\/?>|$/}
            contains: [{include: "tagAttributes"}]
        }

        // 结束标签：</tagName>
        // 允许 </ 和标签名之间有空格，以及标签名和 > 之间有空格
        {match: /<\/\s*([^\s>]+)\s*>/, 1: "tagName"}

        // HTML 实体引用
        {include: "entityReferences"}
    ]

    codeFormatter: #BUILT_IN_HTML_FORMATTER#
    codeShrinker: #BUILT_IN_HTML_SHRINKER#
}
```

```mtsx
{
    name: ["ArscTranslationEditor"]
    styles: [
        "default", #EE000000, #EED0D0D0
        "tagNameBracket", #000000, #E8BF6A
    ]
    bracketPairs: ["<>", "{}", "[]", "()"]

    defines: [
        "colorMatcher": {
            match: /(?<![;&])#([a-fA-F0-9]{3,8})\b/, 0: "parseColor(auto,1,HEX)"
        }

        "tagName": /[a-zA-Z_][\w:\.\-]*/

        "attrContent": [
            // xmlns:namespace 特殊处理
            {
                match: /(xmlns:)([a-zA-Z_][\w\.\-]*)/
                1: "attrName"
                2: "namespace"
            }
            // namespace:attrName 普通情况
            {
                match: /([a-zA-Z_][\w\.\-]*)(:[a-zA-Z_][\w\.\-]*)/
                1: "namespace"
                2: "attrName"
            }
            // 普通属性名（无命名空间）
            {match: /[a-zA-Z_][\w\.\-]*/, 0: "attrName"}
            // 等号
            {match: /\s*=\s*/, 0: "string"}
            // 双引号属性值
            {
                style: "propVal"
                start: {match: /"/}
                end: {match: /"|$/}
                contains: [
                    {include: "colorMatcher"}
                    {match: /&([a-zA-Z_][\w:\.\-]*|#\d+|#x[0-9a-fA-F]+);/, 0: "strEscape"}
                    {match: /&/, 0: "error"}
                ]
            }
            // 单引号属性值
            {
                style: "propVal"
                start: {match: /'/}
                end: {match: /'|$/}
                contains: [
                    {include: "colorMatcher"}
                    {match: /&([a-zA-Z_][\w:\.\-]*|#\d+|#x[0-9a-fA-F]+);/, 0: "strEscape"}
                    {match: /&/, 0: "error"}
                ]
            }
        ]
    ]

    contains: [
        // 注释
        {
            match: /(?s)<!--.*?-->/
            0: "comment"
        }

        // CDATA 区段
        {
            start: {match: /<!\[CDATA\[/, 0: "meta"}
            end: {match: /\]\]>/, 0: "meta"}
            style: "string"
        }

        // 自闭合标签 <tag ... />
        {
            start: {match: /<(/ + include("tagName") + /)/, 0: "tagNameBracket", 1: "tagName"}
            end: {match: /\/?>|$/, 0: "tagNameBracket"}

        // 实体引用
        {match: /&([a-zA-Z_][\w:\.\-]*|#\d+|#x[0-9a-fA-F]+);/, 0: "strEscape"}

        // 错误的实体引用
        {match: /&/, 0: "error"}

        // 颜色常量
        {include: "colorMatcher"}
    ]
}
```

`app/src/main/assets/syntax/internal/regex.mtsx`:

```mtsx
{
    name: ["Regex"]
    styles: [
        "default", #EE000000, #EED0D0D0
        "escape", #067D17, #6A8759
        "keyword", #1750EB, #6897BB
        "startEnd", #871094, #9876AA
        "class", #808000, #808000
    ]
    bracketPairs: ["[]", "()"]
    hide: true
    defines: [
        "escapes": [
            {match: /\\0[0-7]{1,3}/}
            {match: /\\c./, 0: "escape"}
            {match: /\\k<[0-9A-Za-z]+>/, 0: "escape"}
            {match: /(?i)\\p\{.*?\}/, 0: "escape"}

            // HighSurrogate+LowSurrogate  \uD800-DBFFuDC00-DFFF
            {match: /(?i)\\uD[89AB][0-9A-F]{2}uD[CDEF][0-9A-F]{2}/, 0: "escape"}
            {match: /(?i)\\u[0-9a-f]{4}/, 0: "escape"}

            {match: /\\x[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}/, 0: "escape"}
            {match: /\\x\{[0-9A-Fa-f]+\}/, 0: "escape"}

            // {match: /\\[1-9ABDGHRSVWZabdefhnrstvwz]/, 0: "escape"}
            {match: /\\[0CEFIJKLMNOPQTUXYcgijklmopquxy]/, 0: "error"}
            {match: /\\./, 0: "escape"}
        ]
    ]
    contains: [
        // 转义类
        {include: "escapes"}

        // 元字符
        {match: /[.*+?|]/, 0: "keyword"}
        {match: /[$^]/, 0: "startEnd"}

        // (?:pattern) (?=pattern) (?!pattern) (?<=pattern) (?<!pattern)
        {match: /\(/ + /(\?[:=!]|\?<[=!]|\?<([a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*)>)/, 1: "keyword", 2: "string"}

        // {n,m}
        {match: /\{(\d+)(,(\d+)?)?\}/, 0: "operator"}
        {match: /[{}]/, 0: "error"}

        // []
        {
            // 开头和结尾的 - 为普通字符
            start: {match: /(\[\^?)-?/, 1: "class"}

                {include: "escapes"}
                {match: /-/, 0: "comment"}
            ]
        }
```

```mtsx
{
    name: ["Java", ".java", ".jsp"]
    comment: {startsWith: "//"}
    comment: {startsWith: "/*", endsWith: "*/"}

    contains: [
        // ========== 字符串（最高优先级）==========
        // 文本块 (Java 15+)，必须在普通字符串之前
        {
            style: "string"
            start: {match: /"""/}
            end: {match: /"""/}
        }
        // 单双引号字符串（复用内置 Java 字符串匹配器，含转义处理）
        {builtin: #JAVA_QUOTED_STRING#}

        // ========== 数字 ==========
        // 支持: 二进制、十进制、十六进制、下划线分隔、L/F/D 后缀
        {builtin: #JAVA_NUMBER#}

        // ========== 注解 ==========
        // 匹配 @Annotation 和 @package.Annotation
        {match: /@\w+(?:\.\w+)*/, 0: "meta"}

        // ========== 常量 ==========
        // 全大写下划线分隔常量: MAX_VALUE, HTTP_OK
        {match: /\b[A-Z][A-Z0-9]*(?:_[A-Z0-9]+)+\b(?!\s*\()/, 0: "constant"}
        // 全大写缩写常量: TAG, API (排除 CRC32, URL 等特殊情况)
        {match: /\b(?!(?:CRC32|URL|URI|XML|HTML|JSON|HTTP|HTTPS|UUID)\b)[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+\b(?!\.)(?!\s*\()/, 0: "constant"}

        // ========== 关键字 ==========
        {match: keywordsToRegex(
                // 控制流
                "if else switch case default for while do break continue return"
                // 异常处理
                "try catch finally throw throws"
                // 类与接口
                "class interface enum extends implements"
                // 访问修饰符
                "public protected private"
                // 非访问修饰符
                "static final abstract synchronized volatile transient native strictfp"
                // 类型关键字
                "void boolean byte char short int long float double"
                // 变量与实例
                "new this super instanceof"
                // 包与导入
                "package import"
                // 其他
                "assert goto const"
                // Java 10+ var
                "var"
                // Java 14+ record
                "record"
                // Java 17+ sealed/permits
                "sealed non-sealed permits yield when"
                // 字面量
                "true false null"
            ), 0: "keyword"
        }
    ]

    codeFormatter: #BUILT_IN_JAVA_FORMATTER#
}
```

`app/src/main/assets/syntax/js.mtsx`:

```mtsx
{
    name: ["JavaScript", ".js", ".es", ".mjs", ".cjs"]
    // 注释规则在正文和模板插值中共用，元数据仍供编辑器注释操作使用。
    comment: {startsWith: "//", addToContains: false}
    comment: {startsWith: "/*", endsWith: "*/", addToContains: false}
    defines: [
        "identifierPart": /[$\p{javaUnicodeIdentifierPart}]/
        // 转义与标识符一起消费，避免转义花括号提前结束模块或模板作用域。
        "identifierEscape": /\\u(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{4}|\{[0-9a-fA-F]+\})/
        "identifier": /(?:[$_\p{javaUnicodeIdentifierStart}]|/ + include("identifierEscape") + /)(?:/
            + include("identifierPart") + /|/ + include("identifierEscape") + /)*/
        "spaceChar": /[\s\u00a0\u1680\u2000-\u200a\u2028\u2029\u202f\u205f\u3000\ufeff]/
        "space": include("spaceChar") + /*/
        "inlineSpace": /[^\S\r\n\u2028\u2029]*/
        "lineComment": /\/\/[^\r\n\u2028\u2029]*/
        "closedBlockComment": /\/\*(?:[^*]|\*(?!\/))*\*\//
        "trivia": /(?:/ + include("spaceChar") + /|/ + include("lineComment") + /|/ + include("closedBlockComment") + /)*/
        // 连续匹配成员和别名时保留中间注释的样式。
        "triviaMatcher": {
            match: include("trivia")
            0: {match: include("lineComment") + /|/ + include("closedBlockComment"), 0: "comment"}
        }
        "comments": [
            {match: include("lineComment"), 0: "comment"}
            {
                start: {match: /\/\*/}
                end: {match: /\*\//}
                style: "comment"
            }
        ]
        // 先消费属性名，防止保留字属性触发正则或模块规则；排除展开运算符。
        "propertyAccess": {
            group: linkAll
            style: "default"
            contains: [
                {match: /(?:(?<!\.)|(?<=[0-9]\.))\.(?!\.)/}
                {include: "triviaMatcher"}
                {match: /#?/ + include("identifier")}
            ]
        }
        "escapedChar": [
            {match: /\\(?:\r\n|[\r\n\u2028\u2029])/, 0: "strEscape"}
            {match: /\\(?:u(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{4}|\{[0-9a-fA-F]+\})|x[0-9a-fA-F]{2}|[0-3]?[0-7]{1,2})/, 0: "strEscape"}
            // JS 允许普通字符转义；只有不完整的 x/u 转义在词法层标错。
            {match: /\\[^xu\r\n\u2028\u2029]/, 0: "strEscape"}
            {match: /\\[xu]/, 0: "error"}
        ]
        "single-quoted-string": {
            style: "string"
            start: {match: /'/}
            end: {match: /'|(?=[\r\n])/}
            contains: [
                {include: "escapedChar"}
            ]
        }
        "double-quoted-string": {
            style: "string"
            start: {match: /"/}
            end: {match: /"|(?=[\r\n])/}
            contains: [
                {include: "escapedChar"}
            ]
        }
        "backtick-string": {
            style: "string"
            start: {match: /`/}
            end: {match: /`/}
            contains: [
                {include: "escapedChar"}
                {include: "dollarExp"}
            ]
        }
        "regex": {
            // 固定上下文后向前扫描空白；不猜测右括号及可作变量的 await/yield 后的正则。
            start: {
                match: /(?:(?<=[=,(\[&|!:;?{])|(?<==>)|\A|(?<![.$\p{javaUnicodeIdentifierPart}])(/
                    + keywordsToRegex("return throw case typeof void delete in instanceof")
                    + /)(?!/ + include("identifierPart") + /|\\))/ + include("space") + /(\/)(?![\/*])/
                0: "default"
                1: "keyword"
                2: "meta"
            }
            end: {match: /\/([dgimsuvy]*)|(?=[\r\n\u2028\u2029])/, 1: "operator"}
            style: "meta"
            contains: [
                {match: /\\[^\r\n\u2028\u2029]/, 0: "strEscape"}
                {
                    start: {match: /\[/}
                    end: {match: /\]|(?=[\r\n\u2028\u2029])/}
                    contains: [
                        {match: /\\[^\r\n\u2028\u2029]/, 0: "strEscape"}
                    ]
                }
            ]
        }
        "dollarExp": {
            start: {match: /\$\{/}
            end: {match: /\}/}
            style: "strEscape"
            childrenStyle: "default"
            contains: [
                {include: "braces"}
                {include: "code"}
            ]
        }
        // 仅在插值内平衡对象和函数体；字符串、注释及正则先消费各自的花括号。
        "braces": {
            start: {match: /\{/}
            end: {match: /\}/}
            style: "default"
            contains: [
                {include: "braces"}
                {include: "code"}
            ]
        }
        // as 只在静态模块别名中着色，避免影响同名变量和动态 import(...)。
        "moduleAliases": [
            {
                start: {
                    match: /(?<!/ + include("identifierPart") + /)(/ + keywordsToRegex("import export") + /)(?!/ + include("identifierPart") + /|\\)/
                        + include("space") + /(?:/ + include("identifier") + include("space")
                        + /,/ + include("space") + /)?\{/
                    0: "default"
                    1: "keyword"
                }
                end: {match: /\}/}
                style: "default"
                contains: [
                    {include: "comments"}
                    // link 允许无别名成员；原名和别名均可叫 as，只有中间一项是关键字。
                    {
                        group: link
                        style: "default"
                        contains: [
                            {include: "moduleName"}
                            {include: "triviaMatcher"}
                            {match: /as(?!/ + include("identifierPart") + /|\\)/, 0: "keyword"}
                            {include: "triviaMatcher"}
                            {include: "moduleName"}
                        ]
                    }
                ]
            }
            {
                match: /(?<!/ + include("identifierPart") + /)(/ + keywordsToRegex("import export") + /)(?!/ + include("identifierPart") + /|\\)/
                    + include("space") + /(?:/ + include("identifier") + include("space")
                    + /,/ + include("space") + /)?\*/ + include("space") + /(as)(?!/ + include("identifierPart") + /|\\)/
                1: "keyword"
                2: "keyword"
            }
        ]
        "moduleName": {
            group: select
            style: "default"
            contains: [
                {include: "single-quoted-string"}
                {include: "double-quoted-string"}
                {match: include("identifier")}
            ]
        }
        "code": [
            {include: "comments"}
            {include: "propertyAccess"}
            {include: "single-quoted-string"}
            {include: "double-quoted-string"}
            {include: "regex"}
            {include: "backtick-string"}
            {number: "2|8|10|16|F|E|_", iSuffixes: "n", style: "number"}
            // async 是上下文关键字，普通变量和 async(...) 调用保留默认样式。
            {
                match: /(?<!/ + include("identifierPart") + /)\basync(?!/ + include("identifierPart") + /|\\)(?=/
                    + /[^\S\r\n\u2028\u2029]+(?:function\b|\*?/ + include("identifier")
                    + include("inlineSpace") + /(?:=>|\())|/ + include("inlineSpace")
                    + /\([^()\r\n\u2028\u2029]*\)/ + include("inlineSpace") + /=>)/
                0: "keyword"
            }
            {
                match: /(?<!/ + include("identifierPart") + /)/ + keywordsToRegex(
                    "await break case catch class const continue debugger default delete do else enum export"
                    "extends false finally for function if implements import instanceof interface let"
                    "new null package private protected public return static super switch this with"
                    "throw true try typeof var void while yield"
                ) + /(?!/ + include("identifierPart") + /|\\)/
                0: "keyword"
            }
            // 关键字优先，但右边界须排除转义；普通标识符整体消费，避免内部片段触发规则。
            {match: include("identifier"), 0: "default"}
        ]
    ]
    contains: [
        {match: /\A#![^\r\n\u2028\u2029]*/, 0: "comment"}
        {include: "moduleAliases"}
        {include: "code"}
    ]
    codeFormatter: #BUILT_IN_JS_FORMATTER#
    codeShrinker: #BUILT_IN_JS_SHRINKER#
}
```

`app/src/main/assets/syntax/lua.mtsx`:

```mtsx
{
    name: ["Lua", ".lua"]
    codeFormatter: #BUILT_IN_LUA_FORMATTER#
    comment: {startsWith: "--", addToContains: false}
    defines: [
        "localName": /(?!function\b)[_a-zA-Z][_a-zA-Z0-9]*(?:[ \t\f\x0B\r\n]*<[ \t\f\x0B\r\n]*(?:const|close)[ \t\f\x0B\r\n]*>)?/
    ]
    contains: [
        // loadfile 忽略任意 # 首行，直到 LF；文件头内的分隔符不能开启其他作用域。
        {match: /\A#[^\n]*/, 0: "comment"}
        // 动态 end 有 4096 字符上限；超长分隔符回退到必达闭合处或 EOF 的单次匹配。
        {match: /--\[(={4000,})\[(?:(?!\]\1\])[\s\S])*(?:\]\1\]|\z)/, 0: "comment"}
        // 长括号按起始等号数闭合；编辑中的未闭合正文仍保留注释作用域。
        {
            start: {match: /--\[(=*)\[/, export: 1 => "level"}
            end: {match: /\]/ + var("level") + /\]/}
            style: "comment"
        }
        {match: /--(?!\[=*\[)[^\r\n]*/, 0: "comment"}
        {match: /::[ \t\f\x0B\r\n]*[_a-zA-Z][_a-zA-Z\d]*[ \t\f\x0B\r\n]*::/, 0: "label"}
        {match: /\b__[_a-zA-Z\d]+\b/, 0: "keyword2"}
        // 转义必须先于行尾结束匹配，允许反斜杠换行和 \z 吞掉跨行空白。
        {
            start: {match: /(["'])/, export: 1 => "quote"}
            end: {match: var("quote") + /|(?=[\r\n])/}
            style: "string"
            contains: [
                {match: /\\(?:z[ \t\f\x0B\r\n]*+|\r\n|\n\r|[\r\n])/, 0: "strEscape"}
                {match: /\\(?:[abfnrtv\\"']|x[0-9a-fA-F]{2}|u\{0*(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{1,7}|[0-7][0-9a-fA-F]{7})\}|25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01][0-9]{2}|[0-9]{1,2}(?![0-9]))/, 0: "strEscape"}
                {match: /\\(?:[0-9]{1,3}|[^\r\n])/, 0: "error"}
            ]
        }
        {match: /\[(={4000,})\[(?:(?!\]\1\])[\s\S])*(?:\]\1\]|\z)/, 0: "string"}
        {
            start: {match: /\[(=*)\[/, export: 1 => "level"}
            end: {match: /\]/ + var("level") + /\]/}
            style: "string"
        }
        // 关键字可紧贴点开头的小数；单独匹配以保留关键字配色和标识符边界。
        {
            match: /(/ + keywordsToRegex("return if elseif while until in and or not") + /)(\.[0-9]+(?:[eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?)(?![\w.])/
            1: "keyword"
            2: "number"
        }
        // Lua 的连接符可紧贴数字；单个点和省略号不能充当数字的左边界。
        {match: /(?:(?<![\w.])|(?<=\.\.)(?<!\.\.\.)(?!\.))(?:0[xX](?:[0-9a-fA-F]+(?:\.[0-9a-fA-F]*)?|\.[0-9a-fA-F]+)(?:[pP][+-]?[0-9]+)?|(?:[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]*)?|\.[0-9]+)(?:[eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?)(?![\w.])/, 0: "number"}
        // 只在 local 的变量列表中识别属性，止于赋值或注释，不尝试解析表达式。
        {
            match: /\b(local)\b([ \t\f\x0B\r\n]+/ + include("localName") + /(?:[ \t\f\x0B\r\n]*,[ \t\f\x0B\r\n]*/ + include("localName") + /)*)/
            1: "type"
            // 变量列表仍沿用既有名字配色。
            2: {match: /\b__[_a-zA-Z\d]+\b/, 0: "keyword2"}
            2: {match: keywordsToRegex("global boolean number userdata"), 0: "type"}
            2: {match: keywordsToRegex("thread table"), 0: "keyword"}
            2: {match: /<[ \t\f\x0B\r\n]*(const|close)[ \t\f\x0B\r\n]*>/, 1: "keyword2"}
        }
        {match: keywordsToRegex("local global boolean number userdata"), 0: "type"}
        {match: keywordsToRegex("true false nil"), 0: "constant"}
        {match: keywordsToRegex("return then while and break goto do else elseif end for function if in not or repeat until thread table"), 0: "keyword"}
        {match: /(?<!\.)\.(?=[_a-zA-Z])/, 0: "namespace"}
        {match: /(?<!:):[_a-zA-Z][_a-zA-Z0-9]*\b/, 0: "variable"}
        {match: /#(?=[_a-zA-Z])/, 0: "operator"}
    ]
}
```

`app/src/main/assets/syntax/mhtml.mtsx`:

```mtsx
// require MT >= 2.26.9
{
    name: ["MHTML", ".mhtml", ".mht"]

    defines: [
        // 头字段和折行逐行消费，空行始终留给正文分隔符。
        "partStart": /(?m)^(--([0-9A-Za-z'()+_,.\/:=? -]{1,70}?))[ \t]*\r?\n/
        "headerLine": /(?:[A-Za-z0-9-]++:[^\r\n]*+|[ \t]++[^\r\n]*+)\r?\n/
        "headers": [
            {match: /(?mi)^(Content-Type)(:)[ \t]*(?:\r?\n[ \t]+)?([A-Za-z0-9!#$&^_.+-]+\/[A-Za-z0-9!#$&^_.+-]+)/, 1: "attrName", 2: "operator", 3: "type"}
            {match: /(?m)^([A-Za-z0-9-]+)(:)/, 1: "attrName", 2: "operator"}
            {match: /"(?:\\[^\r\n]|[^"\\\r\n])*+"/, 0: "string"}
            {match: /(?i)\b/ + keywordsToRegex("charset boundary type start") + /(?=[ \t]*=)/, 0: "propKey"}
            {match: /[;=]/, 0: "operator"}
        ]
    ]

    contains: [
        // 文件头只在开头识别，避免把前言和尾声中的普通文本当成 MIME 头。
        {
            start: {match: /\A\uFEFF?(?=[A-Za-z0-9-]+:)/}
            end: {match: /\r?\n\r?\n/}
            contains: [{include: "headers"}]
        }

        // 从实际分隔行保存边界；精确匹配下一段，避免子语法吞掉后续资源。
        // Base64 优先于媒体类型，无论编码字段位于 Content-Type 前还是后。
        {
            start: {
                match: include("partStart") + /((?:(?!(?i:Content-Transfer-Encoding):)/ + include("headerLine") + /)*+(?i:Content-Transfer-Encoding):[ \t]*(?:\r?\n[ \t]+)?(?i:base64)[ \t]*\r?\n(?:/ + include("headerLine") + /)*+)\r?\n/
                export: 2 => "boundary"
                1: "meta"
                3: {include: "headers"}
            }
            end: {match: /(?m)^(?=--/ + var("boundary") + /(?:--)?[ \t]*\r?$)/}
            childrenStyle: "comment"
        }

        // 直接按原文高亮，不解码 quoted-printable；编码后的属性和软换行仅作近似显示。
        {
            start: {
                match: include("partStart") + /((?:(?!(?i:Content-Type):)/ + include("headerLine") + /)*+(?i:Content-Type):[ \t]*(?:\r?\n[ \t]+)?([^; \t\r\n]+)[^\r\n]*+\r?\n(?:/ + include("headerLine") + /)*+)\r?\n/
                export: 2 => "boundary"
                1: "meta"
                3: {include: "headers"}
            }
            end: {match: /(?m)^(?=--/ + var("boundary") + /(?:--)?[ \t]*\r?$)/}
            childrenSyntax: {
                capture: 4
                ignoreCase: true
                "text/html" => "MHTML-HTML"
                "text/css" => "MHTML-CSS"
                "text/javascript" => ".js"
                "application/javascript" => ".js"
                "application/json" => ".json"
                "image/svg+xml" => ".svg"
            }
        }

        // 无媒体类型时只显示编码转义，不猜测正文语言。
        {
            start: {
                match: include("partStart") + /((?:/ + include("headerLine") + /)*+)\r?\n/
                export: 2 => "boundary"
                1: "meta"
                3: {include: "headers"}
            }
            end: {match: /(?m)^(?=--/ + var("boundary") + /(?:--)?[ \t]*\r?$)/}
            contains: [{match: /=(?:[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}|\r?\n)/, 0: "strEscape"}]
        }

        {match: /(?m)^--[0-9A-Za-z'()+_,.\/:=? -]{1,70}--[ \t]*\r?$/, 0: "meta"}
    ]
}
```

```mtsx
            "marker placeholder selection dir has host host-context is lang not nth-child"
            "nth-last-child nth-last-of-type nth-of-type state where"
        )

        // CSS 属性名
        "propertyNames": keywordsToRegex(
            // 布局相关

                // 逗号和回退值
                {match: /,/, 0: "operator"}
                {include: "strings"}
                {include: "numbers"}
```
