```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.appmanager

import android.app.Activity
import android.content.ClipData
import android.content.ClipboardManager
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.drawable.ColorDrawable
import android.os.Build
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.view.Window
import android.widget.Button
import android.widget.ImageView
import android.widget.TextView
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatDialog
import androidx.appcompat.widget.SearchView
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.LinearLayoutManager
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
import com.google.android.material.dialog.MaterialAlertDialogBuilder
import com.google.android.material.tabs.TabLayout
import me.zhanghai.android.files.R
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.AxmlDecoder
import com.topjohnwu.superuser.Shell
import me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist.ApkInstallHelper
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.root.ShizukuShell
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.escapeShellArg
import java.io.File
import java.util.zip.ZipFile

object AppDetailsViewerHelper {

    enum class ComponentType {
        ACTIVITY, SERVICE, RECEIVER, PROVIDER, PERMISSION
    }

    data class ComponentItem(
        val name: String,
        val subtitle: String,
        val type: ComponentType,
        val isExported: Boolean = false,
        val isGranted: Boolean = false
    )

    /**
     * Displays a dialog exploring components: Activities (with launch action), Services,
     * Broadcast Receivers, Content Providers, and Permissions (App Manager Style).
     */
    fun showComponentsViewer(
        activity: Activity,
        packageName: String,
        appLabel: String,
        apkFile: File? = null
    ) {
        val pm = activity.packageManager
        var flags = PackageManager.GET_ACTIVITIES or PackageManager.GET_SERVICES or
            PackageManager.GET_RECEIVERS or PackageManager.GET_PROVIDERS or PackageManager.GET_PERMISSIONS

        val pkgInfo = try {
            if (apkFile != null && apkFile.exists()) {
                pm.getPackageArchiveInfo(apkFile.absolutePath, flags)
            } else {
                pm.getPackageInfo(packageName, flags)
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Toast.makeText(activity, "Error al cargar componentes: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return
        }

        if (pkgInfo == null) {
            Toast.makeText(activity, "No se pudo leer la información del paquete", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return
        }

        val activitiesList = pkgInfo.activities?.map {
            ComponentItem(
                name = it.name,
                subtitle = "Exported: ${it.exported}${if (it.permission != null) " • Permiso: ${it.permission}" else ""}",
                type = ComponentType.ACTIVITY,
                isExported = it.exported
            )
        } ?: emptyList()

        val servicesList = pkgInfo.services?.map {
            ComponentItem(
                name = it.name,
                subtitle = "Exported: ${it.exported}${if (it.permission != null) " • Permiso: ${it.permission}" else ""}",
                type = ComponentType.SERVICE,
                isExported = it.exported
            )
        } ?: emptyList()

        val receiversList = pkgInfo.receivers?.map {
            ComponentItem(
                name = it.name,
                subtitle = "Exported: ${it.exported}${if (it.permission != null) " • Permiso: ${it.permission}" else ""}",
                type = ComponentType.RECEIVER,
                isExported = it.exported
            )
        } ?: emptyList()

        val providersList = pkgInfo.providers?.map {
            ComponentItem(
                name = it.name,
                subtitle = "Authority: ${it.authority} • Exported: ${it.exported}",
                type = ComponentType.PROVIDER,
                isExported = it.exported
            )
        } ?: emptyList()

        val permFlags = pkgInfo.requestedPermissionsFlags
        val permissionsList = pkgInfo.requestedPermissions?.mapIndexed { idx, perm ->
            val granted = if (permFlags != null && idx < permFlags.size) {
                (permFlags[idx] and PackageInfoCompat.REQUESTED_PERMISSION_GRANTED) != 0
            } else {
                pm.checkPermission(perm, packageName) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
            }
            ComponentItem(
                name = perm,
                subtitle = if (granted) "Estado: Concedido (Granted)" else "Estado: No concedido / Denegado",
                type = ComponentType.PERMISSION,
                isGranted = granted
            )
        } ?: emptyList()

        val dialog = AppCompatDialog(activity)
        dialog.supportRequestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE)
        val view = LayoutInflater.from(activity).inflate(R.layout.dialog_app_components_viewer, null)
        dialog.setContentView(view)

        dialog.window?.apply {
            setBackgroundDrawable(ColorDrawable(Color.TRANSPARENT))
            val dm = activity.resources.displayMetrics
            val targetWidth = (dm.widthPixels * 0.95).toInt().coerceAtMost((600 * dm.density).toInt())
            val targetHeight = (dm.heightPixels * 0.85).toInt()
            setLayout(targetWidth, targetHeight)
        }

        view.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvDialogAppTitle).text = appLabel
        view.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvDialogAppSubtitle).text = packageName

        val cachedIcon = NativeAppIconLoader.getCached(packageName)
        if (cachedIcon != null) {
            view.findViewById<ImageView>(R.id.ivDialogAppIcon).setImageDrawable(cachedIcon)
        } else {
            view.findViewById<ImageView>(R.id.ivDialogAppIcon).setImageResource(R.drawable.file_apk_icon)
        }

        view.findViewById<Button>(R.id.btnDialogClose).setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
        }

        val tabLayout = view.findViewById<TabLayout>(R.id.tabLayoutComponents)
        tabLayout.addTab(tabLayout.newTab().setText("Actividades (${activitiesList.size})"))
        tabLayout.addTab(tabLayout.newTab().setText("Servicios (${servicesList.size})"))
        tabLayout.addTab(tabLayout.newTab().setText("Receptores (${receiversList.size})"))
        tabLayout.addTab(tabLayout.newTab().setText("Proveedores (${providersList.size})"))
        tabLayout.addTab(tabLayout.newTab().setText("Permisos (${permissionsList.size})"))

        val rv = view.findViewById<RecyclerView>(R.id.rvComponents)
        val emptyText = view.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvEmptyComponents)
        rv.layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(activity)

        var currentTabIndex = 0
        var filterQuery = ""

        fun getActiveList(): List<ComponentItem> {
            val baseList = when (currentTabIndex) {
                0 -> activitiesList
                1 -> servicesList
                2 -> receiversList
                3 -> providersList
                else -> permissionsList
            }
            if (filterQuery.isBlank()) return baseList
            val q = filterQuery.lowercase()
            return baseList.filter { it.name.lowercase().contains(q) || it.subtitle.lowercase().contains(q) }
        }

        val componentAdapter = object : RecyclerView.Adapter<RecyclerView.ViewHolder>() {
            override fun getItemCount(): Int = getActiveList().size

            override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
                val itemView = LayoutInflater.from(parent.context).inflate(R.layout.item_app_component, parent, false)
                return object : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(itemView) {}
            }

            override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: RecyclerView.ViewHolder, position: Int) {
                val item = getActiveList()[position]
                val v = holder.itemView
                val ivIcon = v.findViewById<ImageView>(R.id.ivComponentIcon)
                val tvName = v.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvComponentName)
                val tvSub = v.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvComponentSubtitle)
                val btnLaunch = v.findViewById<Button>(R.id.btnLaunchComponent)

                tvName.text = item.name
                tvSub.text = item.subtitle

                when (item.type) {
                    ComponentType.ACTIVITY -> {
                        ivIcon.setImageResource(R.drawable.exit_to_app_icon_white_24dp)
                        ivIcon.setColorFilter(Color.parseColor("#42A5F5"))
                        btnLaunch.visibility = View.VISIBLE
                        btnLaunch.setOnClickListener {
                            try {
                                val launchIntent = Intent().apply {
                                    setClassName(packageName, item.name)
                                    addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK)
                                }
                                activity.startActivity(launchIntent)
                                Toast.makeText(activity, "Iniciando: ${item.name.substringAfterLast('.')}", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                            } catch (se: SecurityException) {
                                // Try starting with elevated privileges (Root / Shizuku) for private or unexported activities
                                var startedElevated = false
                                val compName = "$packageName/${item.name}"
                                val amCmd = "am start -n $compName"
                                if (ApkInstallHelper.isRootAvailable()) {
                                    val res = Shell.cmd(amCmd).exec()
                                    if (res.isSuccess) startedElevated = true
                                } else if (ApkInstallHelper.isShizukuAvailable()) {
                                    val res = ShizukuShell.exec(amCmd)
                                    if (res.isSuccess) startedElevated = true
                                }

                                if (startedElevated) {
                                    Toast.makeText(activity, "Iniciando con privilegios: ${item.name.substringAfterLast('.')}", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                                } else {
                                    Toast.makeText(activity, "Seguridad: Actividad privada / requiere permisos", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                                }
                            } catch (e: Exception) {
                                Toast.makeText(activity, "Error: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    ComponentType.SERVICE -> {
                        ivIcon.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_running_apps)
                        ivIcon.setColorFilter(Color.parseColor("#66BB6A"))
                        btnLaunch.visibility = View.GONE
                    }
                    ComponentType.RECEIVER -> {
                        ivIcon.setImageResource(R.drawable.notification_icon_white_24dp)
                        ivIcon.setColorFilter(Color.parseColor("#FFA726"))
                        btnLaunch.visibility = View.GONE
                    }
                    ComponentType.PROVIDER -> {
                        ivIcon.setImageResource(R.drawable.shared_directory_icon_white_24dp)
                        ivIcon.setColorFilter(Color.parseColor("#AB47BC"))
                        btnLaunch.visibility = View.GONE
                    }
                    ComponentType.PERMISSION -> {
                        ivIcon.setImageResource(R.drawable.shield_icon_white_24dp)
                        if (item.isGranted) {
                            ivIcon.setColorFilter(Color.parseColor("#00E676"))
                            tvSub.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#00E676"))
                        } else {
                            ivIcon.setColorFilter(Color.parseColor("#EF5350"))
                            tvSub.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#EF5350"))
                        }
                        btnLaunch.visibility = View.GONE
                    }
                }

                v.setOnClickListener {
                    val clipboard = activity.getSystemService(Context.CLIPBOARD_SERVICE) as? ClipboardManager
                    clipboard?.setPrimaryClip(ClipData.newPlainText("Component", item.name))
                    Toast.makeText(activity, "Copiado: ${item.name}", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            }
        }

        rv.adapter = componentAdapter

        fun refreshList() {
            val list = getActiveList()
            emptyText.visibility = if (list.isEmpty()) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
            componentAdapter.notifyDataSetChanged()
        }

        tabLayout.addOnTabSelectedListener(object : TabLayout.OnTabSelectedListener {
            override fun onTabSelected(tab: TabLayout.Tab?) {
                currentTabIndex = tab?.position ?: 0
                refreshList()
            }
            override fun onTabUnselected(tab: TabLayout.Tab?) {}
            override fun onTabReselected(tab: TabLayout.Tab?) {}
        })

        val searchView = view.findViewById<SearchView>(R.id.searchViewComponents)
        searchView.setOnQueryTextListener(object : SearchView.OnQueryTextListener {
            override fun onQueryTextSubmit(query: String?): Boolean {
                filterQuery = query.orEmpty()
                refreshList()
                return true
            }

            override fun onQueryTextChange(newText: String?): Boolean {
                filterQuery = newText.orEmpty()
                refreshList()
                return true
            }
        })

        refreshList()
        dialog.show()
    }

    /**
     * Decodes and displays AndroidManifest.xml from an APK or installed app in a dedicated viewer.
     */
    fun showManifestViewer(activity: Activity, apkFile: File, appLabel: String) {
        var effectiveApk = apkFile
        var tempCopiedFile: File? = null

        if (!effectiveApk.exists() || !effectiveApk.canRead()) {
            // Attempt elevated copy to cacheDir if root or Shizuku available (for protected system APKs)
            val cacheCopy = File(activity.cacheDir, "manifest_tmp_${System.currentTimeMillis()}.apk")
            var copied = false
            if (ApkInstallHelper.isRootAvailable()) {
                val res = Shell.cmd("cp ${effectiveApk.absolutePath.escapeShellArg()} ${cacheCopy.absolutePath.escapeShellArg()} && chmod 644 ${cacheCopy.absolutePath.escapeShellArg()}").exec()
                if (res.isSuccess && cacheCopy.exists() && cacheCopy.length() > 0L) {
                    copied = true
                }
            } else if (ApkInstallHelper.isShizukuAvailable()) {
                val res = ShizukuShell.exec("cp ${effectiveApk.absolutePath.escapeShellArg()} ${cacheCopy.absolutePath.escapeShellArg()} && chmod 644 ${cacheCopy.absolutePath.escapeShellArg()}")
                if (res.isSuccess && cacheCopy.exists() && cacheCopy.length() > 0L) {
                    copied = true
                }
            }

            if (copied) {
                effectiveApk = cacheCopy
                tempCopiedFile = cacheCopy
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(activity, "El archivo APK no es accesible", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                return
            }
        }

        var xmlText: String? = null
        try {
            ZipFile(effectiveApk).use { zip ->
                val entry = zip.getEntry("AndroidManifest.xml")
                if (entry != null) {
                    val bytes = zip.getInputStream(entry).use { it.readBytes() }
                    xmlText = if (AxmlDecoder.isAxml(bytes)) {
                        AxmlDecoder.decode(bytes)
                    } else {
                        String(bytes, Charsets.UTF_8)
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            xmlText = "// Error al decodificar AndroidManifest.xml: ${e.message}\n"
        } finally {
            tempCopiedFile?.delete()
        }

        if (xmlText.isNullOrBlank()) {
            Toast.makeText(activity, "No se encontró AndroidManifest.xml en el APK", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return
        }

        val dialog = AppCompatDialog(activity)
        dialog.supportRequestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE)
        val view = LayoutInflater.from(activity).inflate(R.layout.dialog_manifest_viewer, null)
        dialog.setContentView(view)

        dialog.window?.apply {
            setBackgroundDrawable(ColorDrawable(Color.TRANSPARENT))
            val dm = activity.resources.displayMetrics
            val targetWidth = (dm.widthPixels * 0.95).toInt().coerceAtMost((650 * dm.density).toInt())
            val targetHeight = (dm.heightPixels * 0.85).toInt()
            setLayout(targetWidth, targetHeight)
        }

        view.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvManifestTitle).text = "AndroidManifest.xml • $appLabel"
        val tvContent = view.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvManifestContent)
        tvContent.text = xmlText

        view.findViewById<Button>(R.id.btnCopyManifest).setOnClickListener {
            val clipboard = activity.getSystemService(Context.CLIPBOARD_SERVICE) as? ClipboardManager
            clipboard?.setPrimaryClip(ClipData.newPlainText("AndroidManifest.xml", xmlText))
            Toast.makeText(activity, "Manifest copiado al portapapeles", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }

        view.findViewById<Button>(R.id.btnCloseManifest).setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
        }

        dialog.show()
    }

    private object PackageInfoCompat {
        const val REQUESTED_PERMISSION_GRANTED = 2
    }
}
```

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.appmanager

import android.content.Context
import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.io.File

data class AppModel(
    val label: String,
    val packageName: String,
    val versionName: String,
    val versionCode: Long,
    val sourceDir: String,
    val splitSourceDirs: List<String>,
    val dataDir: String,
    val targetSdkVersion: Int,
    val minSdkVersion: Int,
    val sizeBytes: Long,
    val isSystem: Boolean,
    val isEnabled: Boolean,
    val firstInstallTime: Long,
    val lastUpdateTime: Long
) {
    val isSplit: Boolean get() = splitSourceDirs.isNotEmpty()
    val splitCount: Int get() = if (splitSourceDirs.isNotEmpty()) splitSourceDirs.size + 1 else 1

    fun toJson(): JSONObject = JSONObject().apply {
        put("label", label)
        put("pkg", packageName)
        put("verName", versionName)
        put("verCode", versionCode)
        put("srcDir", sourceDir)
        put("splits", JSONArray(splitSourceDirs))
        put("dataDir", dataDir)
        put("targetSdk", targetSdkVersion)
        put("minSdk", minSdkVersion)
        put("size", sizeBytes)
        put("isSys", isSystem)
        put("isEnabled", isEnabled)
        put("firstInstall", firstInstallTime)
        put("lastUpdate", lastUpdateTime)
    }

    companion object {
        fun fromJson(json: JSONObject): AppModel {
            val splitsArray = json.optJSONArray("splits")
            val splits = mutableListOf<String>()
            if (splitsArray != null) {
                for (i in 0 until splitsArray.length()) {
                    splits.add(splitsArray.getString(i))
                }
            }
            return AppModel(
                label = json.optString("label"),
                packageName = json.optString("pkg"),
                versionName = json.optString("verName", "1.0"),
                versionCode = json.optLong("verCode", 1L),
                sourceDir = json.optString("srcDir"),
                splitSourceDirs = splits,
                dataDir = json.optString("dataDir"),
                targetSdkVersion = json.optInt("targetSdk", 0),
                minSdkVersion = json.optInt("minSdk", 0),
                sizeBytes = json.optLong("size", 0L),
                isSystem = json.optBoolean("isSys", false),
                isEnabled = json.optBoolean("isEnabled", true),
                firstInstallTime = json.optLong("firstInstall", 0L),
                lastUpdateTime = json.optLong("lastUpdate", 0L)
            )
        }
    }
}

object AppDiskCache {
    private const val FILE_NAME = "installed_apps_v2.json"

    fun load(context: Context): List<AppModel>? {
        return try {
            val file = File(context.cacheDir, FILE_NAME)
            if (!file.exists() || file.length() == 0L) return null
            val text = file.readText()
            val array = JSONArray(text)
            val list = ArrayList<AppModel>(array.length())
            for (i in 0 until array.length()) {
                list.add(AppModel.fromJson(array.getJSONObject(i)))
            }
            list
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            null
        }
    }

    fun save(context: Context, apps: List<AppModel>) {
        try {
            val array = JSONArray()
            for (app in apps) {
                array.put(app.toJson())
            }
            val file = File(context.cacheDir, FILE_NAME)
            file.writeText(array.toString())
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
        }
    }
}
```

```kt
/*

package me.zhanghai.android.files.appmanager

import android.content.Context

import android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo

import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.graphics.Color

import android.net.Uri
import android.os.Build

import android.os.Environment
import android.provider.Settings
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.Menu
import android.view.MenuItem

import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.view.WindowInsetsController
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.appcompat.widget.SearchView
import androidx.core.view.ViewCompat
import androidx.core.view.WindowInsetsCompat
import androidx.core.view.updatePadding

import androidx.recyclerview.widget.LinearLayoutManager

import com.google.android.material.dialog.MaterialAlertDialogBuilder

import java8.nio.file.Paths

import me.zhanghai.android.files.R

import me.zhanghai.android.files.app.clipboardManager
import me.zhanghai.android.files.compat.longVersionCodeCompat
import me.zhanghai.android.files.databinding.ActivityInstalledAppsBinding
import me.zhanghai.android.files.databinding.DialogInstalledAppDetailsBinding
import me.zhanghai.android.files.databinding.InstalledAppItemBinding
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.fileProviderUri
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.createFallbackFileItem
import me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist.ApkInstallHelper
import me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist.ApkQuickEditDialogFragment
import me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist.ApktoolHelper
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.escapeShellArg
import me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist.FileListActivity
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.MimeType
import me.zhanghai.android.files.ui.ThemedFastScroller
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.copyText
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.createSendStreamIntent
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.withChooser
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileInputStream
import java.io.FileOutputStream
import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat
import java.util.Date
import java.util.Locale
import java.util.zip.ZipEntry
import java.util.zip.ZipOutputStream

class InstalledAppsActivity : AppActivity() {

    private lateinit var binding: ActivityInstalledAppsBinding
    private val allApps = mutableListOf<AppModel>()
    private val displayedApps = mutableListOf<AppModel>()
    private lateinit var adapter: AppsAdapter

    private var showSystemApps = false
    private var searchQuery = ""
    private var currentSortOrder = 0 // 0: Name A-Z

    private val dateFormat = SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd", Locale.getDefault())

    companion object {
        @Volatile
        private var sAppCache: List<AppModel>? = null
    }

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityInstalledAppsBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        // 1. Consistent dark status bar
        window.statusBarColor = Color.parseColor("#1F1F1F")
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.R) {
            window.insetsController?.setSystemBarsAppearance(0, WindowInsetsController.APPEARANCE_LIGHT_STATUS_BARS)
        }

        // 2. Query status bar height directly from framework dimensions
        val resId = resources.getIdentifier("status_bar_height", "dimen", "android")
        val statusBarHeight = if (resId > 0) {
            resources.getDimensionPixelSize(resId)
        } else {
            (28 * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
        }

        // 3. Set top padding immediately so Toolbar is NEVER obscured by notifications/status bar
        binding.appBarLayout.updatePadding(top = statusBarHeight)

        // 4. React dynamically to window insets for display cutouts, notches, and navigation bar
        ViewCompat.setOnApplyWindowInsetsListener(binding.rootLayout) { _, insets ->
            val statusBars = insets.getInsets(WindowInsetsCompat.Type.statusBars())
            val displayCutout = insets.getInsets(WindowInsetsCompat.Type.displayCutout())
            val topInset = maxOf(statusBars.top, displayCutout.top, statusBarHeight)
            binding.appBarLayout.updatePadding(top = topInset)

            val navBars = insets.getInsets(WindowInsetsCompat.Type.navigationBars())
            binding.recyclerView.updatePadding(bottom = navBars.bottom + (16 * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt())
            insets
        }

        setSupportActionBar(binding.toolbar)
        supportActionBar?.setDisplayHomeAsUpEnabled(true)
        binding.toolbar.setNavigationOnClickListener { finish() }

        setupTabs()
        setupRecyclerView()
        loadApps()
    }

    private fun setupTabs() {
        val tabUser = binding.tabLayout.newTab().setText(R.string.user_apps)
        val tabSystem = binding.tabLayout.newTab().setText(R.string.system_apps)
        binding.tabLayout.addTab(tabUser)
        binding.tabLayout.addTab(tabSystem)

        binding.tabLayout.addOnTabSelectedListener(object : TabLayout.OnTabSelectedListener {
            override fun onTabSelected(tab: TabLayout.Tab?) {
                showSystemApps = (tab?.position == 1)
                filterApps()
            }
            override fun onTabUnselected(tab: TabLayout.Tab?) {}
            override fun onTabReselected(tab: TabLayout.Tab?) {}
        })
    }

    private fun setupRecyclerView() {
        adapter = AppsAdapter(displayedApps) { app ->
            showAppDetails(app)
        }
        adapter.setHasStableIds(true)
        binding.recyclerView.apply {
            layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(this@InstalledAppsActivity)
            setHasFixedSize(true)
            setItemViewCacheSize(30)
            adapter = this@InstalledAppsActivity.adapter
            ThemedFastScroller.create(this)
        }
    }

    private fun loadApps(forceRefresh: Boolean = false) {
        // 1. In-memory cache (0 ms)
        val memCached = sAppCache
        if (!forceRefresh && memCached != null && memCached.isNotEmpty()) {
            allApps.clear()
            allApps.addAll(memCached)
            applySort()
            updateTabCounts()
            filterApps()
            binding.progressBar.visibility = View.GONE
            return
        }

        // 2. Persistent disk cache (5-10 ms)
        if (!forceRefresh) {
            val diskCached = AppDiskCache.load(this)
            if (diskCached != null && diskCached.isNotEmpty()) {
                allApps.clear()
                allApps.addAll(diskCached)
                sAppCache = diskCached
                applySort()
                updateTabCounts()
                filterApps()
                binding.progressBar.visibility = View.GONE
                // Trigger background refresh silently to catch new installs/updates
                syncAppsInBackground(diskCached)
                return
            }
        }

        if (allApps.isEmpty()) {
            binding.progressBar.visibility = View.VISIBLE
        }
        binding.emptyText.visibility = View.GONE

        // 3. Full scan with progressive emission
        lifecycleScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            scanAndEmitApps()
        }
    }

    private suspend fun scanAndEmitApps() {
        val pm = packageManager
        val packages = try {
            pm.getInstalledPackages(0)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            emptyList<PackageInfo>()
        }
        if (packages.isEmpty()) {
            withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                binding.progressBar.visibility = View.GONE
                binding.emptyText.visibility = View.VISIBLE
            }
            return
        }

        val parsedList = mutableListOf<AppModel>()
        var emittedInitial = false

        val chunks = packages.chunked(30)
        for (chunk in chunks) {
            val batch = chunk.mapNotNull { pkg -> parsePackage(pm, pkg) }
            parsedList.addAll(batch)

            // Stream first batch to UI immediately!
            if (!emittedInitial && parsedList.size >= 25) {
                emittedInitial = true
                val snapshot = ArrayList(parsedList)
                withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                    allApps.clear()
                    allApps.addAll(snapshot)
                    applySort()
                    updateTabCounts()
                    filterApps()
                    binding.progressBar.visibility = View.GONE
                }
            }
        }

        sAppCache = parsedList
        AppDiskCache.save(this@InstalledAppsActivity, parsedList)

        withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
            allApps.clear()
            allApps.addAll(parsedList)
            applySort()
            updateTabCounts()
            filterApps()
            binding.progressBar.visibility = View.GONE
        }
    }

    private fun syncAppsInBackground(existing: List<AppModel>) {
        lifecycleScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            val pm = packageManager
            val packages = try {
                pm.getInstalledPackages(0)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                return@launch
            }
            if (packages.isEmpty()) return@launch

            // Quick check: if count and latest update time match, no need to rescan
            val existingMap = existing.associateBy({ it.packageName }, { it.lastUpdateTime })
            var hasChanges = packages.size != existing.size
            if (!hasChanges) {
                for (pkg in packages) {
                    val cachedTime = existingMap[pkg.packageName]
                    if (cachedTime == null || cachedTime != pkg.lastUpdateTime) {
                        hasChanges = true
                        break
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!hasChanges) return@launch

            // Rescan and update
            scanAndEmitApps()
        }
    }

    private fun parsePackage(pm: PackageManager, pkg: PackageInfo): AppModel? {
        val appInfo = pkg.applicationInfo ?: return null
        val isSystem = (appInfo.flags and ApplicationInfo.FLAG_SYSTEM) != 0
        val isEnabled = appInfo.enabled
        val label = appInfo.nonLocalizedLabel?.toString()
            ?: try {
                pm.getApplicationLabel(appInfo).toString()
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                pkg.packageName
            }

        val splits = appInfo.splitSourceDirs?.toList() ?: emptyList()
        var size = 0L
        val src = appInfo.sourceDir
        if (!src.isNullOrEmpty()) {
            val baseFile = File(src)
            size += baseFile.length()
        }
        for (splitPath in splits) {
            val splitFile = File(splitPath)
            size += splitFile.length()
        }

        val minSdk = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.N) {
            appInfo.minSdkVersion
        } else {
            0
        }

        return AppModel(
            label = label,
            packageName = pkg.packageName,
            versionName = pkg.versionName ?: "1.0",
            versionCode = pkg.longVersionCodeCompat,
            sourceDir = src ?: "",
            splitSourceDirs = splits,
            dataDir = appInfo.dataDir ?: "",
            targetSdkVersion = appInfo.targetSdkVersion,
            minSdkVersion = minSdk,
            sizeBytes = size,
            isSystem = isSystem,
            isEnabled = isEnabled,
            firstInstallTime = pkg.firstInstallTime,
            lastUpdateTime = pkg.lastUpdateTime
        )
    }

    private fun updateTabCounts() {
        var userCount = 0
        var systemCount = 0
        for (app in allApps) {
            if (app.isSystem) systemCount++ else userCount++
        }
        binding.tabLayout.getTabAt(0)?.text = "${getString(R.string.user_apps)} ($userCount)"
        binding.tabLayout.getTabAt(1)?.text = "${getString(R.string.system_apps)} ($systemCount)"
    }

    private fun applySort() {
        when (currentSortOrder) {
            0 -> allApps.sortWith(compareBy(String.CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER) { it.label })
            1 -> allApps.sortWith(compareByDescending(String.CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER) { it.label })
            2 -> allApps.sortWith(compareBy(String.CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER) { it.packageName })
            3 -> allApps.sortByDescending { it.sizeBytes }
            4 -> allApps.sortBy { it.sizeBytes }
            5 -> allApps.sortByDescending { it.lastUpdateTime }
            6 -> allApps.sortByDescending { it.firstInstallTime }
            7 -> allApps.sortByDescending { it.targetSdkVersion }
        }
    }

    private var hasCheckedInitialTarget = false

    private fun checkInitialTargetPackage() {
        if (hasCheckedInitialTarget) return
        val targetPkg = intent.getStringExtra("package_name") ?: return
        hasCheckedInitialTarget = true
        val found = allApps.find { it.packageName == targetPkg }
        if (found != null) {
            showAppDetails(found)
        }
    }

    private fun filterApps() {
        displayedApps.clear()
        val query = searchQuery.trim().lowercase()

        for (app in allApps) {
            if (app.isSystem != showSystemApps) continue
            if (query.isNotEmpty()) {
                val match = app.label.lowercase().contains(query) ||
                    app.packageName.lowercase().contains(query) ||
                    app.versionName.lowercase().contains(query)
                if (!match) continue
            }
            displayedApps.add(app)
        }

        adapter.notifyDataSetChanged()
        binding.emptyText.visibility = if (displayedApps.isEmpty()) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
        checkInitialTargetPackage()
    }

    private fun showSortDialog() {
        val sortOptions = arrayOf(
            "Nombre (A - Z)",
            "Nombre (Z - A)",
            "Nombre de paquete (A - Z)",
            "Tamaño (Mayor a menor)",
            "Tamaño (Menor a mayor)",
            "Fecha de actualización (Recientes primero)",
            "Fecha de instalación",
            "Target SDK (Mayor a menor)"
        )
        MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(this)
            .setTitle("Ordenar aplicaciones")
            .setSingleChoiceItems(sortOptions, currentSortOrder) { dialog, which ->
                currentSortOrder = which
                applySort()
                filterApps()
                dialog.dismiss()
            }
            .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
            .show()
    }

    private fun showAppDetails(app: AppModel) {
        val dialogBinding = DialogInstalledAppDetailsBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        val cachedIcon = NativeAppIconLoader.getCached(app.packageName)
        if (cachedIcon != null) {
            dialogBinding.dialogAppIcon.setImageDrawable(cachedIcon)
        } else {
            dialogBinding.dialogAppIcon.setImageResource(R.drawable.file_apk_icon)
            lifecycleScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
                val icon = NativeAppIconLoader.loadIcon(this@InstalledAppsActivity, app.packageName)
                if (icon != null) {
                    withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                        dialogBinding.dialogAppIcon.setImageDrawable(icon)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        dialogBinding.dialogAppName.text = app.label
        dialogBinding.dialogAppPackage.text = app.packageName
        dialogBinding.dialogAppVersionSize.text = "v${app.versionName} (${app.versionCode}) • ${formatSize(app.sizeBytes)}"
        val minSdkStr = if (app.minSdkVersion > 0) app.minSdkVersion.toString() else "N/A"
        dialogBinding.dialogAppSdk.text = "Min SDK: $minSdkStr • Target SDK: ${app.targetSdkVersion}"

        if (app.isSplit) {
            dialogBinding.dialogAppSplits.visibility = View.VISIBLE
            dialogBinding.dialogAppSplits.text = "APKS: ${app.splitCount} archivos divididos"
        } else {
            dialogBinding.dialogAppSplits.visibility = View.GONE
        }

        val isRoot = ApkInstallHelper.isRootAvailable()
        if (isRoot) {
            dialogBinding.layoutRootActions.visibility = View.VISIBLE
            dialogBinding.tvToggleEnableTitle.text = if (app.isEnabled) "Inhabilitar / Congelar (Root)" else "Habilitar / Descongelar (Root)"
            dialogBinding.tvToggleEnableSubtitle.text = if (app.isEnabled) "Desactivar paquete con pm disable" else "Activar paquete con pm enable"
        } else {
            dialogBinding.layoutRootActions.visibility = View.GONE
        }

        val dialog = MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(this)
            .setView(dialogBinding.root)
            .create()

        // 1. Extraer APK
        dialogBinding.btnActionExtract.setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            extractApk(app)
        }

        // 2. Localizar APK en el explorador
        dialogBinding.btnActionLocateApk.setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            val apkFile = File(app.sourceDir)
            if (apkFile.exists()) {
                val intent = FileListActivity.createViewIntent(Paths.get(apkFile.parentFile!!.absolutePath))
                    .addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TOP)
                startActivity(intent)
                finish()
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "El directorio del APK no es accesible", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }

        // 3. Localizar Datos en el explorador
        dialogBinding.btnActionLocateData.setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            val dataPath = if (app.dataDir.isNotEmpty()) app.dataDir else "/storage/emulated/0/Android/data/${app.packageName}"
            val intent = FileListActivity.createViewIntent(Paths.get(dataPath))
                .addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TOP)
            startActivity(intent)
            finish()
        }

        // 4. Abrir aplicación
        dialogBinding.btnActionLaunch.setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            val launchIntent = packageManager.getLaunchIntentForPackage(app.packageName)
            if (launchIntent != null) {
                startActivity(launchIntent)
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Esta aplicación no tiene interfaz ejecutable", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }

        // 4b. Ver Componentes (App Manager Style)
        dialogBinding.btnActionViewComponents.setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            AppDetailsViewerHelper.showComponentsViewer(this, app.packageName, app.label, File(app.sourceDir))
        }

        // 4c. Ver AndroidManifest.xml decodificado
        dialogBinding.btnActionViewManifest.setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            AppDetailsViewerHelper.showManifestViewer(this, File(app.sourceDir), app.label)
        }

        // 4d. Edición Rápida (Quick Edit)
        dialogBinding.btnActionQuickEdit.setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            val apkFile = File(app.sourceDir)
            val fileItem = Paths.get(apkFile.absolutePath).createFallbackFileItem(apkFile)
            if (fileItem != null) {
                ApkQuickEditDialogFragment.show(fileItem, this)
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "No se pudo preparar el APK para edición", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }

        // 4e. Descompilar a Java (JADX)
        dialogBinding.btnActionDecompileJava.setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            ApktoolHelper.decompileJava(this, Paths.get(app.sourceDir))
        }

        // 5. Ajustes de la aplicación
        dialogBinding.btnActionDetails.setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            val intent = Intent(Settings.ACTION_APPLICATION_DETAILS_SETTINGS).apply {
                data = Uri.parse("package:${app.packageName}")
            }
            startActivity(intent)
        }

        // 6. Copiar información
        dialogBinding.btnActionCopyInfo.setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            showCopyInfoDialog(app)
        }

        // 7. Compartir APK
        dialogBinding.btnActionShare.setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            val apkFile = File(app.sourceDir)
            if (apkFile.exists() && apkFile.canRead()) {
                try {
                    val uri = Paths.get(apkFile.absolutePath).fileProviderUri
                    val shareIntent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_SEND).apply {
                        type = MimeType.APK.value
                        putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_STREAM, uri)
                        addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION)
                    }
                    startActivity(Intent.createChooser(shareIntent, "Compartir ${app.label}"))
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Error al compartir APK: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Se requiere extraer el APK previamente para compartir", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }

        // 8. Google Play Store
        dialogBinding.btnActionPlayStore.setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            try {
                val intent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, Uri.parse("market://details?id=${app.packageName}"))
                startActivity(intent)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                val intent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, Uri.parse("https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=${app.packageName}"))
                startActivity(intent)
            }
        }

        // 9. Desinstalar
        dialogBinding.btnActionUninstall.setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            val intent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_DELETE, Uri.parse("package:${app.packageName}"))
            startActivity(intent)
        }

        // 10. Root: Forzar detención
        dialogBinding.btnActionForceStop.setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            lifecycleScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
                val result = Shell.cmd("am force-stop ${app.packageName.escapeShellArg()}").exec()
                withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                    if (result.isSuccess) {
                        Toast.makeText(this@InstalledAppsActivity, "Aplicación detenida (Root)", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    } else {
                        Toast.makeText(this@InstalledAppsActivity, "Error al forzar detención", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // 11. Root: Limpiar datos
        dialogBinding.btnActionClearData.setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(this)
                .setTitle("¿Limpiar datos?")
                .setMessage("Se eliminarán todos los datos y configuraciones de ${app.label}.")
                .setPositiveButton("Limpiar") { _, _ ->
                    lifecycleScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
                        val result = Shell.cmd("pm clear ${app.packageName.escapeShellArg()}").exec()
                        withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                            if (result.isSuccess) {
                                Toast.makeText(this@InstalledAppsActivity, "Datos restablecidos con éxito", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                            } else {
                                Toast.makeText(this@InstalledAppsActivity, "Error al limpiar datos", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
                .show()
        }

        // 12. Root: Alternar Habilitar/Inhabilitar
        dialogBinding.btnActionToggleEnable.setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            val newEnable = !app.isEnabled
            val cmdStr = if (newEnable) "pm enable ${app.packageName.escapeShellArg()}" else "pm disable-user ${app.packageName.escapeShellArg()}"
            lifecycleScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
                val result = Shell.cmd(cmdStr).exec()
                withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                    if (result.isSuccess) {
                        val msg = if (newEnable) "Aplicación habilitada" else "Aplicación inhabilitada"
                        Toast.makeText(this@InstalledAppsActivity, msg, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                        loadApps(forceRefresh = true)
                    } else {
                        Toast.makeText(this@InstalledAppsActivity, "Error al cambiar estado", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        dialog.show()
    }

    private fun showCopyInfoDialog(app: AppModel) {
        val certSha256 = getCertificateSha256(this, app.packageName)
        val infoItems = arrayOf(
            "Nombre: ${app.label}",
            "Paquete: ${app.packageName}",
            "Versión: ${app.versionName} (${app.versionCode})",
            "Ruta APK: ${app.sourceDir}",
            "Ruta Datos: ${app.dataDir}",
            "Firma SHA-256: $certSha256",
            "Copiar todo el informe"
        )

        MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(this)
            .setTitle("Copiar información")
            .setItems(infoItems) { _, which ->
                val textToCopy = when (which) {
                    0 -> app.label
                    1 -> app.packageName
                    2 -> "${app.versionName} (${app.versionCode})"
                    3 -> app.sourceDir
                    4 -> app.dataDir
                    5 -> certSha256
                    6 -> """
                        App: ${app.label}
                        Package: ${app.packageName}
                        Version: ${app.versionName} (${app.versionCode})
                        Target SDK: ${app.targetSdkVersion}
                        Min SDK: ${app.minSdkVersion}
                        Size: ${formatSize(app.sizeBytes)}
                        APK Path: ${app.sourceDir}
                        Data Path: ${app.dataDir}
                        SHA-256: $certSha256
                    """.trimIndent()
                    else -> ""
                }
                clipboardManager.copyText(textToCopy, this)
            }
            .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
            .show()
    }

    private fun extractApk(app: AppModel) {
        val baseDir = File("/storage/emulated/0/OpenManager/apks")
        baseDir.mkdirs()
        val targetDir = when {
            baseDir.exists() && baseDir.canWrite() -> baseDir
            else -> {
                val downloads = File(Environment.getExternalStoragePublicDirectory(Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS), "OpenManager")
                downloads.mkdirs()
                if (downloads.exists() && downloads.canWrite()) downloads else (getExternalFilesDir(null) ?: filesDir)
            }
        }

        val safeLabel = app.label.replace(Regex("[\\\\/:*?\"<>|\\s]"), "_")

        if (app.isSplit) {
            val options = arrayOf(
                getString(R.string.antisplit_extract_merged),
                getString(R.string.antisplit_extract_apks)
            )
            MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(this)
                .setTitle(app.label)
                .setItems(options) { _, which ->
                    performExtractApp(app, targetDir, safeLabel, mergeAntiSplit = (which == 0))
                }
                .show()
            return
        }

        performExtractApp(app, targetDir, safeLabel, mergeAntiSplit = false)
    }

    private fun performExtractApp(
        app: AppModel,
        targetDir: File,
        safeLabel: String,
        mergeAntiSplit: Boolean
    ) {
        val extension = if (app.isSplit && !mergeAntiSplit) "apks" else "apk"
        val destFile = File(targetDir, "${safeLabel}_v${app.versionName}.$extension")

        val message = if (mergeAntiSplit) {
            getString(R.string.antisplit_merging_progress)
        } else {
            "Extrayendo ${app.label}..."
        }
        Toast.makeText(this, message, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        binding.progressBar.visibility = View.VISIBLE

        lifecycleScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            val success = try {
                if (mergeAntiSplit) {
                    me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist.AntiSplitEngine.mergeInstalledApp(
                        context = this@InstalledAppsActivity,
                        app = app,
                        outputFile = destFile
                    )
                } else if (app.isSplit) {
                    extractSplitApk(app, destFile)
                } else {
                    extractSingleApk(app.sourceDir, destFile)
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                e.printStackTrace()
                false
            }

            withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                binding.progressBar.visibility = View.GONE
                if (success && destFile.exists() && destFile.length() > 0) {
                    val snackbar = Snackbar.make(
                        binding.root,
                        "Extraído: ${destFile.name} (${formatSize(destFile.length())})",
                        Snackbar.LENGTH_LONG
                    )
                    snackbar.setAction("Localizar") {
                        val viewIntent = FileListActivity.createViewIntent(Paths.get(destFile.parentFile!!.absolutePath))
                            .addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TOP)
                        startActivity(viewIntent)
                        finish()
                    }
                    snackbar.show()
                } else {
                    Toast.makeText(
                        this@InstalledAppsActivity,
                        "Error al extraer la aplicación. Revisa los permisos.",
                        Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                    ).show()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun extractSingleApk(sourcePath: String, destFile: File): Boolean {
        return try {
            val src = File(sourcePath)
            if (src.canRead()) {
                FileInputStream(src).channel.use { inChannel ->
                    FileOutputStream(destFile).channel.use { outChannel ->
                        val size = inChannel.size()
                        var transferred = 0L
                        while (transferred < size) {
                            transferred += inChannel.transferTo(transferred, size - transferred, outChannel)
                        }
                    }
                }
                destFile.exists() && destFile.length() > 0
            } else if (ApkInstallHelper.isRootAvailable()) {
                val cmd = Shell.cmd("cp ${sourcePath.escapeShellArg()} ${destFile.absolutePath.escapeShellArg()} && chmod 644 ${destFile.absolutePath.escapeShellArg()}").exec()
                cmd.isSuccess
            } else {
                false
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            if (ApkInstallHelper.isRootAvailable()) {
                val cmd = Shell.cmd("cp ${sourcePath.escapeShellArg()} ${destFile.absolutePath.escapeShellArg()} && chmod 644 ${destFile.absolutePath.escapeShellArg()}").exec()
                cmd.isSuccess
            } else {
                false
            }
        }
    }

    private fun extractSplitApk(app: AppModel, destFile: File): Boolean {
        return try {
            java.io.BufferedOutputStream(FileOutputStream(destFile), 128 * 1024).use { fos ->
                ZipOutputStream(fos).use { zos ->
                    zos.setLevel(java.util.zip.Deflater.BEST_SPEED)

                    // 1. base.apk
                    val baseFile = File(app.sourceDir)
                    if (baseFile.canRead()) {
                        zos.putNextEntry(ZipEntry("base.apk"))
                        baseFile.inputStream().buffered(64 * 1024).use { it.copyTo(zos, bufferSize = 64 * 1024) }
                        zos.closeEntry()
                    } else if (ApkInstallHelper.isRootAvailable()) {
                        val tmpBase = File(cacheDir, "tmp_base_${System.currentTimeMillis()}.apk")
                        try {
                            Shell.cmd("cp ${app.sourceDir.escapeShellArg()} ${tmpBase.absolutePath.escapeShellArg()} && chmod 644 ${tmpBase.absolutePath.escapeShellArg()}").exec()
                            if (tmpBase.exists()) {
                                zos.putNextEntry(ZipEntry("base.apk"))
                                tmpBase.inputStream().buffered(64 * 1024).use { it.copyTo(zos, bufferSize = 64 * 1024) }
                                zos.closeEntry()
                            }
                        } finally {
                            tmpBase.delete()
                        }
                    }

                    // 2. split APKs
                    for (splitPath in app.splitSourceDirs) {
                        val splitFile = File(splitPath)
                        val entryName = splitFile.name
                        if (splitFile.canRead()) {
                            zos.putNextEntry(ZipEntry(entryName))
                            splitFile.inputStream().buffered(64 * 1024).use { it.copyTo(zos, bufferSize = 64 * 1024) }
                            zos.closeEntry()
                        } else if (ApkInstallHelper.isRootAvailable()) {
                            val tmpSplit = File(cacheDir, "tmp_split_${System.currentTimeMillis()}_$entryName")
                            try {
                                Shell.cmd("cp ${splitPath.escapeShellArg()} ${tmpSplit.absolutePath.escapeShellArg()} && chmod 644 ${tmpSplit.absolutePath.escapeShellArg()}").exec()
                                if (tmpSplit.exists()) {
                                    zos.putNextEntry(ZipEntry(entryName))
                                    tmpSplit.inputStream().buffered(64 * 1024).use { it.copyTo(zos, bufferSize = 64 * 1024) }
                                    zos.closeEntry()
                                }
                            } finally {
                                tmpSplit.delete()
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            destFile.exists() && destFile.length() > 0
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
            destFile.delete()
            false
        }
    }

    private fun getCertificateSha256(context: Context, packageName: String): String {
        return try {
            val signatures = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.P) {
                val signingInfo = context.packageManager.getPackageInfo(
                    packageName,
                    PackageManager.GET_SIGNING_CERTIFICATES
                ).signingInfo
                if (signingInfo != null) {
                    if (signingInfo.hasMultipleSigners()) {
                        signingInfo.apkContentsSigners
                    } else {
                        signingInfo.signingCertificateHistory
                    }
                } else null
            } else {
                @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
                context.packageManager.getPackageInfo(
                    packageName,
                    PackageManager.GET_SIGNATURES
                ).signatures
            }
            val cert = signatures?.firstOrNull()?.toByteArray() ?: return "No disponible"
            val md = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
            val digest = md.digest(cert)
            digest.joinToString(":") { "%02X".format(it) }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            "No disponible"
        }
    }

    override fun onCreateOptionsMenu(menu: Menu): Boolean {
        menuInflater.inflate(R.menu.app_manager_menu, menu)
        val searchItem = menu.findItem(R.id.action_search)
        val searchView = searchItem?.actionView as? SearchView
        searchView?.queryHint = getString(R.string.search)
        searchView?.setOnQueryTextListener(object : SearchView.OnQueryTextListener {
            override fun onQueryTextSubmit(query: String?): Boolean {
                searchQuery = query ?: ""
                filterApps()
                return true
            }

            override fun onQueryTextChange(newText: String?): Boolean {
                searchQuery = newText ?: ""
                filterApps()
                return true
            }
        })
        return true
    }

    override fun onOptionsItemSelected(item: MenuItem): Boolean {
        when (item.itemId) {
            android.R.id.home -> {
                finish()
                return true
            }
            R.id.action_sort -> {
                showSortDialog()
                return true
            }
            R.id.action_refresh -> {
                loadApps(forceRefresh = true)
                return true
            }
        }
        return super.onOptionsItemSelected(item)
    }

    private fun formatSize(bytes: Long): String {
        if (bytes <= 0) return "0 B"
        val units = arrayOf("B", "KB", "MB", "GB")
        val digitGroups = (Math.log10(bytes.toDouble()) / Math.log10(1024.0)).toInt()
        val index = digitGroups.coerceIn(0, units.size - 1)
        return String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f %s", bytes / Math.pow(1024.0, index.toDouble()), units[index])
    }

    private fun formatDate(timestamp: Long): String {
        return if (timestamp > 0) dateFormat.format(Date(timestamp)) else "Desconocida"
    }

    inner class AppsAdapter(
        private val items: List<AppModel>,
        private val onClick: (AppModel) -> Unit
    ) : RecyclerView.Adapter<AppsAdapter.ViewHolder>() {

        inner class ViewHolder(val binding: InstalledAppItemBinding) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(binding.root)

        override fun getItemId(position: Int): Long = items[position].packageName.hashCode().toLong()

        override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): ViewHolder {
            val b = InstalledAppItemBinding.inflate(LayoutInflater.from(parent.context), parent, false)
            return ViewHolder(b)
        }

        override fun getItemCount(): Int = items.size

        override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: ViewHolder, position: Int) {
            val app = items[position]
            with(holder.binding) {
                appName.text = app.label
                appPackage.text = app.packageName
                appVersion.text = "v${app.versionName} (${app.versionCode})"
                appSize.text = formatSize(app.sizeBytes)
                appSplitBadge.visibility = if (app.isSplit) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE

                val minSdkStr = if (app.minSdkVersion > 0) app.minSdkVersion.toString() else "?"
                val dateStr = formatDate(app.lastUpdateTime)
                appMetaInfo.text = "SDK: $minSdkStr - ${app.targetSdkVersion}  •  $dateStr"

                val cached = NativeAppIconLoader.getCached(app.packageName)
                if (cached != null) {
                    appIcon.setImageDrawable(cached)
                } else {
                    appIcon.setImageResource(R.drawable.file_apk_icon)
                    val tag = app.packageName
                    appIcon.tag = tag
                    lifecycleScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
                        val drawable = NativeAppIconLoader.loadIcon(this@InstalledAppsActivity, app.packageName)
                        if (drawable != null) {
                            withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                                if (appIcon.tag == tag) {
                                    appIcon.setImageDrawable(drawable)
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                root.setOnClickListener {
                    onClick(app)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.appmanager

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable
import androidx.collection.LruCache

object NativeAppIconLoader {
    private val memoryCache = LruCache<String, Drawable>(300)

    fun getCached(packageName: String): Drawable? = memoryCache.get(packageName)

    fun put(packageName: String, drawable: Drawable) {
        memoryCache.put(packageName, drawable)
    }

    fun loadIcon(context: Context, packageName: String): Drawable? {
        memoryCache.get(packageName)?.let { return it }
        val pm = context.packageManager
        val drawable = try {
            val appInfo = pm.getApplicationInfo(packageName, 0)
            pm.getApplicationIcon(appInfo)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            try {
                pm.getApplicationIcon(packageName)
            } catch (e2: Exception) {
                null
            }
        }
        if (drawable != null) {
            memoryCache.put(packageName, drawable)
        }
        return drawable
    }

    fun clear() {
        memoryCache.evictAll()
    }
}
```

```kt
data class RunningAppModel(

    val ppid: Int = 0,
    val uid: Int = 0,
    val processName: String,
    val packageName: String? = null,
    val label: String,
    val isApp: Boolean = true,
    val isSystem: Boolean = false,
    val memoryBytes: Long = 0L,
    val cpuPercent: Float = 0f,
    val state: String = "R", // R: Running, S: Sleeping, D: Disk Sleep, Z: Zombie
    val threadCount: Int = 1,
    val user: String = "",
    val cmdline: String = "",
    val selinuxContext: String = ""
) : Parcelable
```
