```kt
class RunningAppsActivity : AppActivity() {

    private lateinit var binding: ActivityRunningAppsBinding
    private val allProcesses = mutableListOf<RunningAppModel>()
    private val displayedProcesses = mutableListOf<RunningAppModel>()
    private lateinit var adapter: RunningAppsAdapter

    private var currentTab = 0 // 0: User apps, 1: System apps, 2: All
    private var searchQuery = ""
    private var currentSortOrder = 0 // 0: RAM descending, 1: Name A-Z, 2: PID ascending
    private var isBannerDismissed = false
    private var loadJob: Job? = null

    private val shizukuListener: () -> Unit = {
        runOnUiThread {
            updateElevationUi()
            loadProcesses()
        }
    }

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityRunningAppsBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        // 1. Consistent dark status bar
        window.statusBarColor = Color.parseColor("#1F1F1F")
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.R) {
            window.insetsController?.setSystemBarsAppearance(0, WindowInsetsController.APPEARANCE_LIGHT_STATUS_BARS)
        }

        // 2. Query status bar height directly from framework dimensions
        val resId = resources.getIdentifier("status_bar_height", "dimen", "android")
        val statusBarHeight = if (resId > 0) {
            resources.getDimensionPixelSize(resId)
        } else {
            (28 * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
        }

        binding.appBarLayout.updatePadding(top = statusBarHeight)

        ViewCompat.setOnApplyWindowInsetsListener(binding.rootLayout) { _, insets ->
            val statusBars = insets.getInsets(WindowInsetsCompat.Type.statusBars())
            val displayCutout = insets.getInsets(WindowInsetsCompat.Type.displayCutout())
            val topInset = maxOf(statusBars.top, displayCutout.top, statusBarHeight)
            binding.appBarLayout.updatePadding(top = topInset)

            val navBars = insets.getInsets(WindowInsetsCompat.Type.navigationBars())
            binding.recyclerView.updatePadding(bottom = navBars.bottom + (80 * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt())
            insets
        }

        setSupportActionBar(binding.toolbar)
        supportActionBar?.setDisplayHomeAsUpEnabled(true)
        binding.toolbar.setNavigationOnClickListener { finish() }

        setupTabs()
        setupRecyclerView()
        setupElevationControls()

        ShizukuManager.init(this)
        ShizukuManager.addBinderListener(shizukuListener)

        binding.fabRefresh.setOnClickListener {
            loadProcesses()
        }

        checkAndPromptElevatedPermissions()
        loadProcesses()
    }

    override fun onDestroy() {
        super.onDestroy()
        loadJob?.cancel()
        ShizukuManager.removeBinderListener(shizukuListener)
    }

    private fun setupTabs() {
        binding.tabLayout.addTab(binding.tabLayout.newTab().setText(R.string.running_apps_tab_user))
        binding.tabLayout.addTab(binding.tabLayout.newTab().setText(R.string.running_apps_tab_system))
        binding.tabLayout.addTab(binding.tabLayout.newTab().setText(R.string.running_apps_tab_all))

        binding.tabLayout.addOnTabSelectedListener(object : TabLayout.OnTabSelectedListener {
            override fun onTabSelected(tab: TabLayout.Tab?) {
                currentTab = tab?.position ?: 0
                filterAndSortProcesses()
            }
            override fun onTabUnselected(tab: TabLayout.Tab?) {}
            override fun onTabReselected(tab: TabLayout.Tab?) {}
        })
    }

    private fun setupRecyclerView() {
        adapter = RunningAppsAdapter(
            scope = lifecycleScope,
            items = displayedProcesses,
            onItemClick = { item -> showProcessDetails(item) },
            onKillClick = { item -> killProcess(item) },
            onForceStopClick = { item -> forceStopProcess(item) }
        )
        binding.recyclerView.apply {
            layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(this@RunningAppsActivity)
            setHasFixedSize(true)
            setItemViewCacheSize(30)
            adapter = this@RunningAppsActivity.adapter
            ThemedFastScroller.create(this)
        }
    }

    private fun setupElevationControls() {
        binding.btnBannerRequestRoot.setOnClickListener {
            requestRootPrivileges(interactive = true)
        }
        binding.btnBannerRequestShizuku.setOnClickListener {
            requestShizukuPrivileges()
        }
        binding.btnDismissBanner.setOnClickListener {
            isBannerDismissed = true
            binding.cardPermissionBanner.visibility = View.GONE
        }
        binding.tvElevationBadge.setOnClickListener {
            showElevationChoiceDialog()
        }
    }

    private fun updateElevationUi() {
        val isRoot = RunningAppsLoader.isRootGranted()
        val isShizuku = RunningAppsLoader.isShizukuReady()

        when {
            isRoot -> {
                binding.tvElevationBadge.text = "🛡️ " + getString(R.string.running_apps_elevation_root)
                binding.tvElevationBadge.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#00E676"))
                binding.cardPermissionBanner.visibility = View.GONE
            }
            isShizuku -> {
                binding.tvElevationBadge.text = "⚡ " + getString(R.string.running_apps_elevation_shizuku)
                binding.tvElevationBadge.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#40C4FF"))
                binding.cardPermissionBanner.visibility = View.GONE
            }
            else -> {
                binding.tvElevationBadge.text = "⚠️ " + getString(R.string.running_apps_elevation_unprivileged)
                binding.tvElevationBadge.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#FFB300"))
                if (!isBannerDismissed) {
                    binding.cardPermissionBanner.visibility = View.VISIBLE
                } else {
                    binding.cardPermissionBanner.visibility = View.GONE
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun checkAndPromptElevatedPermissions() {
        updateElevationUi()
        if (RunningAppsLoader.hasElevatedAccess()) return

        // Proactively offer or check root if available, otherwise check Shizuku
        if (LibSuFileServiceLauncher.isSuAvailable()) {
            requestRootPrivileges(interactive = false)
        } else if (ShizukuManager.isAvailable() && !ShizukuManager.hasPermission()) {
            requestShizukuPrivileges()
        }
    }

    private fun requestRootPrivileges(interactive: Boolean) {
        lifecycleScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            try {
                LibSuFileServiceLauncher.initBuilder()
                val result = Shell.cmd("id").exec()
                val isRoot = result.isSuccess && result.out.any { it.contains("uid=0") }
                withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                    if (isRoot) {
                        if (interactive) {
                            Toast.makeText(this@RunningAppsActivity, R.string.running_apps_root_granted_toast, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                        }
                        updateElevationUi()
                        loadProcesses()
                    } else if (interactive) {
                        Toast.makeText(this@RunningAppsActivity, R.string.running_apps_root_failed_toast, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                        updateElevationUi()
                    }
                }
            } catch (_: Throwable) {
                withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                    if (interactive) {
                        Toast.makeText(this@RunningAppsActivity, R.string.running_apps_root_failed_toast, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    }
                    updateElevationUi()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun requestShizukuPrivileges() {
        if (!ShizukuManager.isInstalled(this)) {
            MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(this)
                .setTitle("Shizuku no instalado")
                .setMessage("Para usar Shizuku, debes instalar la aplicación Shizuku en tu dispositivo y activarla.")
                .setPositiveButton("Ver Shizuku") { _, _ ->
                    try {
                        startActivity(Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, Uri.parse("https://shizuku.rikka.app/")))
                    } catch (_: Throwable) {}
                }
                .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
                .show()
            return
        }

        if (!ShizukuManager.isAvailable()) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "El servicio de Shizuku no está iniciado. Ábrelo e inícialo primero.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
            return
        }

        ShizukuManager.requestPermission(this) { granted ->
            if (granted) {
                Toast.makeText(this, R.string.running_apps_shizuku_granted_toast, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                updateElevationUi()
                loadProcesses()
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Permiso de Shizuku no concedido", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                updateElevationUi()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun showElevationChoiceDialog() {
        val isRoot = RunningAppsLoader.isRootGranted()
        val isShizuku = RunningAppsLoader.isShizukuReady()
        val statusText = when {
            isRoot -> "Acceso Superusuario (Root) concedido y activo."
            isShizuku -> "Acceso Shizuku (ADB API) concedido y activo."
            else -> "Modo estándar sin privilegios elevados. En Android moderno solo se listan procesos del propio proceso."
        }

        MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(this)
            .setTitle("Privilegios de Procesos")
            .setMessage("$statusText\n\n¿Deseas solicitar permisos elevados para ver y gestionar todos los procesos?")
            .setPositiveButton("Pedir Root") { _, _ ->
                requestRootPrivileges(interactive = true)
            }
            .setNeutralButton("Pedir Shizuku") { _, _ ->
                requestShizukuPrivileges()
            }
            .setNegativeButton("Cerrar", null)
            .show()
    }

    private fun loadProcesses() {
        loadJob?.cancel()
        binding.progressBar.visibility = View.VISIBLE
        binding.tvEmptyState.visibility = View.GONE

        loadJob = lifecycleScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            val ram = RunningAppsLoader.getRamStats(this@RunningAppsActivity)
            val list = RunningAppsLoader.loadRunningProcesses(this@RunningAppsActivity)

            withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                updateElevationUi()

                // Update RAM monitor card
                val totalStr = Formatter.formatFileSize(this@RunningAppsActivity, ram.totalBytes)
                val usedStr = Formatter.formatFileSize(this@RunningAppsActivity, ram.usedBytes)
                val availStr = Formatter.formatFileSize(this@RunningAppsActivity, ram.availBytes)

                binding.tvRamUsageTitle.text = getString(R.string.running_apps_ram_usage, usedStr, totalStr, ram.usedPercent)
                binding.tvRamAvailable.text = getString(R.string.running_apps_ram_available, availStr)
                binding.pbRamUsage.progress = ram.usedPercent

                allProcesses.clear()
                allProcesses.addAll(list)

                updateCounters()
                filterAndSortProcesses()

                binding.progressBar.visibility = View.GONE
            }
        }
    }

    private fun updateCounters() {
        val total = allProcesses.size
        var userCount = 0
        var sysCount = 0
        for (p in allProcesses) {
            if (p.isApp && !p.isSystem) userCount++ else sysCount++
        }

        binding.tvProcessCounters.text = "$total procesos en ejecución • $userCount apps de usuario"
        binding.tabLayout.getTabAt(0)?.text = "${getString(R.string.running_apps_tab_user)} ($userCount)"
        binding.tabLayout.getTabAt(1)?.text = "${getString(R.string.running_apps_tab_system)} ($sysCount)"
        binding.tabLayout.getTabAt(2)?.text = "${getString(R.string.running_apps_tab_all)} ($total)"
    }

    private fun filterAndSortProcesses() {
        displayedProcesses.clear()
        val query = searchQuery.trim().lowercase()

        for (p in allProcesses) {
            val matchesTab = when (currentTab) {
                0 -> p.isApp && !p.isSystem
                1 -> p.isSystem
                else -> true
            }
            if (!matchesTab) continue

            if (query.isNotEmpty()) {
                val matchesQuery = p.label.lowercase().contains(query) ||
                    p.processName.lowercase().contains(query) ||
                    (p.packageName?.lowercase()?.contains(query) == true) ||
                    p.pid.toString().contains(query)
                if (!matchesQuery) continue
            }

            displayedProcesses.add(p)
        }

        when (currentSortOrder) {
            0 -> displayedProcesses.sortByDescending { it.memoryBytes }
            1 -> displayedProcesses.sortWith(compareBy(String.CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER) { it.label })
            2 -> displayedProcesses.sortBy { it.pid }
        }

        adapter.notifyDataSetChanged()
        binding.tvEmptyState.visibility = if (displayedProcesses.isEmpty()) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
    }

    private fun showProcessDetails(item: RunningAppModel) {
        val dialogBinding = DialogProcessDetailsBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)

        dialogBinding.dialogProcessLabel.text = item.label
        dialogBinding.dialogProcessName.text = item.processName
        dialogBinding.dialogProcessState.text = "ESTADO: ${item.state} (${if (item.isApp) "App" else "Proceso"})"
        dialogBinding.dialogTvPidPpid.text = "${item.pid} / ${item.ppid}"
        val memStr = if (item.memoryBytes > 0) Formatter.formatFileSize(this, item.memoryBytes) else "Desconocido"
        dialogBinding.dialogTvMemory.text = "$memStr (VmRSS)"
        dialogBinding.dialogTvUidUser.text = "${item.uid} (${item.user})"
        dialogBinding.dialogTvThreads.text = "${item.threadCount} hilos"
        dialogBinding.dialogTvSelinux.text = if (item.selinuxContext.isNotEmpty()) item.selinuxContext else "u:r:default:s0"
        dialogBinding.dialogTvCmdline.text = if (item.cmdline.isNotEmpty()) item.cmdline else item.processName

        if (item.packageName != null) {
            val cached = NativeAppIconLoader.getCached(item.packageName)
            if (cached != null) {
                dialogBinding.dialogProcessIcon.setImageDrawable(cached)
            } else {
                lifecycleScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
                    val icon = NativeAppIconLoader.loadIcon(this@RunningAppsActivity, item.packageName)
                    if (icon != null) {
                        withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                            dialogBinding.dialogProcessIcon.setImageDrawable(icon)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            dialogBinding.btnDialogForceStop.visibility = View.VISIBLE
            dialogBinding.btnDialogAppDetails.visibility = View.VISIBLE
            dialogBinding.btnDialogAppSettings.visibility = View.VISIBLE
            dialogBinding.btnDialogLaunchApp.visibility = View.VISIBLE
        } else {
            dialogBinding.dialogProcessIcon.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_running_apps)
            dialogBinding.btnDialogForceStop.visibility = View.GONE
            dialogBinding.btnDialogAppDetails.visibility = View.GONE
            dialogBinding.btnDialogAppSettings.visibility = View.GONE
            dialogBinding.btnDialogLaunchApp.visibility = View.GONE
        }

        val dialog = MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(this)
            .setView(dialogBinding.root)
            .create()

        // 1. Kill
        dialogBinding.btnDialogKillProcess.setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            killProcess(item)
        }

        // 2. Force stop
        dialogBinding.btnDialogForceStop.setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            forceStopProcess(item)
        }

        // 3. App Details
        dialogBinding.btnDialogAppDetails.setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            val intent = Intent(this, InstalledAppsActivity::class.java).apply {
                putExtra("package_name", item.packageName)
            }
            startActivity(intent)
        }

        // 4. App settings
        dialogBinding.btnDialogAppSettings.setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            if (item.packageName != null) {
                val intent = Intent(Settings.ACTION_APPLICATION_DETAILS_SETTINGS).apply {
                    data = Uri.parse("package:${item.packageName}")
                }
                startActivity(intent)
            }
        }

        // 5. Launch app
        dialogBinding.btnDialogLaunchApp.setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            if (item.packageName != null) {
                val launchIntent = packageManager.getLaunchIntentForPackage(item.packageName)
                if (launchIntent != null) {
                    startActivity(launchIntent)
                } else {
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Esta aplicación no tiene interfaz ejecutable", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            }
        }

        // 6. Copy process info
        dialogBinding.btnDialogCopyProcessInfo.setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            val text = """
                Label: ${item.label}
                Process: ${item.processName}
                Package: ${item.packageName ?: "N/A"}
                PID: ${item.pid}
                PPID: ${item.ppid}
                UID: ${item.uid}
                User: ${item.user}
                RAM: $memStr
                State: ${item.state}
                Threads: ${item.threadCount}
                Cmdline: ${item.cmdline}
            """.trimIndent()
            val clipboard = getSystemService(Context.CLIPBOARD_SERVICE) as? ClipboardManager
            clipboard?.setPrimaryClip(ClipData.newPlainText("Process Info", text))
            Toast.makeText(this, "Información del proceso copiada", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }

        dialog.show()
    }

    private fun killProcess(item: RunningAppModel) {
        if (!RunningAppsLoader.hasElevatedAccess() && (item.isSystem || item.uid != android.os.Process.myUid())) {
            MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(this)
                .setTitle("Se requieren permisos elevados")
                .setMessage(R.string.running_apps_kill_unprivileged_warning)
                .setPositiveButton(R.string.running_apps_action_request_root) { _, _ ->
                    requestRootPrivileges(interactive = true)
                }
                .setNeutralButton(R.string.running_apps_action_request_shizuku) { _, _ ->
                    requestShizukuPrivileges()
                }
                .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
                .show()
            return
        }

        lifecycleScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            val success = RunningAppsLoader.killProcess(item.pid)
            withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                if (success) {
                    Toast.makeText(this@RunningAppsActivity, getString(R.string.running_apps_kill_success, item.pid), Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    loadProcesses()
                } else {
                    Toast.makeText(this@RunningAppsActivity, getString(R.string.running_apps_kill_failed), Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun forceStopProcess(item: RunningAppModel) {
        val pkg = item.packageName ?: return
        if (!RunningAppsLoader.hasElevatedAccess()) {
            val intent = Intent(Settings.ACTION_APPLICATION_DETAILS_SETTINGS).apply {
                data = Uri.parse("package:$pkg")
            }
            startActivity(intent)
            Toast.makeText(this@RunningAppsActivity, "Usa 'Forzar detención' en Ajustes", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return
        }

        lifecycleScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            val success = RunningAppsLoader.forceStopApp(pkg)
            withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                if (success) {
                    Toast.makeText(this@RunningAppsActivity, getString(R.string.running_apps_force_stop_success), Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    loadProcesses()
                } else {
                    // Fallback to launching App Settings
                    val intent = Intent(Settings.ACTION_APPLICATION_DETAILS_SETTINGS).apply {
                        data = Uri.parse("package:$pkg")
                    }
                    startActivity(intent)
                    Toast.makeText(this@RunningAppsActivity, "Usa 'Forzar detención' en Ajustes", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    override fun onCreateOptionsMenu(menu: Menu): Boolean {
        menuInflater.inflate(R.menu.menu_running_apps, menu)

        val searchItem = menu.findItem(R.id.action_search)
        val searchView = searchItem?.actionView as? SearchView
        searchView?.queryHint = "Buscar proceso o app..."
        searchView?.setOnQueryTextListener(object : SearchView.OnQueryTextListener {
            override fun onQueryTextSubmit(query: String?): Boolean {
                searchQuery = query.orEmpty()
                filterAndSortProcesses()
                return true
            }

            override fun onQueryTextChange(newText: String?): Boolean {
                searchQuery = newText.orEmpty()
                filterAndSortProcesses()
                return true
            }
        })

        return true
    }

    override fun onOptionsItemSelected(item: MenuItem): Boolean {
        return when (item.itemId) {
            R.id.action_sort -> {
                showSortDialog()
                true
            }
            R.id.action_refresh -> {
                loadProcesses()
                true
            }
            else -> super.onOptionsItemSelected(item)
        }
    }

    private fun showSortDialog() {
        val options = arrayOf(
            getString(R.string.running_apps_sort_ram),
            getString(R.string.running_apps_sort_name),
            getString(R.string.running_apps_sort_pid)
        )
        MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(this)
            .setTitle("Ordenar procesos")
            .setSingleChoiceItems(options, currentSortOrder) { dialog, which ->
                currentSortOrder = which
                filterAndSortProcesses()
                dialog.dismiss()
            }
            .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
            .show()
    }
}
```

```kt
/*

package me.zhanghai.android.files.appmanager.running

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Color
import android.text.format.Formatter
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.widget.ImageButton
import android.widget.ImageView
import android.widget.TextView
import androidx.appcompat.widget.PopupMenu
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import me.zhanghai.android.files.R
import me.zhanghai.android.files.appmanager.NativeAppIconLoader

class RunningAppsAdapter(
    private val scope: CoroutineScope,
    private val items: List<RunningAppModel>,
    private val onItemClick: (RunningAppModel) -> Unit,
    private val onKillClick: (RunningAppModel) -> Unit,
    private val onForceStopClick: (RunningAppModel) -> Unit
) : RecyclerView.Adapter<RunningAppsAdapter.ViewHolder>() {

    init {
        setHasStableIds(true)
    }

    override fun getItemId(position: Int): Long = items[position].pid.toLong()

    override fun getItemCount(): Int = items.size

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): ViewHolder {
        val view = LayoutInflater.from(parent.context).inflate(R.layout.item_running_app, parent, false)
        return ViewHolder(view)
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: ViewHolder, position: Int) {
        val item = items[position]
        val context = holder.itemView.context

        holder.tvLabel.text = item.label
        holder.tvProcessName.text = item.processName
        holder.tvPid.text = "PID: ${item.pid}"
        holder.tvUser.text = item.user

        val memStr = if (item.memoryBytes > 0) {
            Formatter.formatFileSize(context, item.memoryBytes)
        } else {
            "- RAM"
        }
        holder.tvMemory.text = memStr

        // State Badge
        when (item.state) {
            "R" -> {
                holder.tvState.text = "RUNNING"
                holder.tvState.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#00E676"))
            }
            "D" -> {
                holder.tvState.text = "DISK SLEEP"
                holder.tvState.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#FF9800"))
            }
            "Z" -> {
                holder.tvState.text = "ZOMBIE"
                holder.tvState.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#F44336"))
            }
            else -> {
                holder.tvState.text = if (item.isApp) "ACTIVE" else "SLEEP"
                holder.tvState.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#90CAF9"))
            }
        }

        // Icon loading
        holder.ivIcon.tag = item.packageName
        if (item.packageName != null) {
            val cached = NativeAppIconLoader.getCached(item.packageName)
            if (cached != null) {
                holder.ivIcon.setImageDrawable(cached)
            } else {
                holder.ivIcon.setImageResource(R.drawable.file_apk_icon)
                scope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
                    val icon = NativeAppIconLoader.loadIcon(context, item.packageName)
                    if (icon != null) {
                        withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                            if (holder.ivIcon.tag == item.packageName) {
                                holder.ivIcon.setImageDrawable(icon)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            holder.ivIcon.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_running_apps)
        }

        holder.itemView.setOnClickListener { onItemClick(item) }

        holder.btnMenu.setOnClickListener { v ->
            val popup = PopupMenu(context, v)
            popup.menu.add(0, 1, 0, "Detalles del proceso")
            popup.menu.add(0, 2, 1, "Finalizar proceso (kill)")
            if (item.packageName != null) {
                popup.menu.add(0, 3, 2, "Forzar detención")
            }
            popup.setOnMenuItemClickListener { menuItem ->
                when (menuItem.itemId) {
                    1 -> onItemClick(item)
                    2 -> onKillClick(item)
                    3 -> onForceStopClick(item)
                }
                true
            }
            popup.show()
        }
    }

    class ViewHolder(view: View) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(view) {
        val ivIcon: ImageView = view.findViewById(R.id.ivProcessIcon)
        val tvLabel: TextView = view.findViewById(R.id.tvProcessLabel)
        val tvProcessName: TextView = view.findViewById(R.id.tvProcessName)
        val tvPid: TextView = view.findViewById(R.id.tvProcessPid)
        val tvMemory: TextView = view.findViewById(R.id.tvProcessMemory)
        val tvUser: TextView = view.findViewById(R.id.tvProcessUser)
        val tvState: TextView = view.findViewById(R.id.tvProcessStateBadge)
        val btnMenu: ImageButton = view.findViewById(R.id.btnProcessMenu)
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/appmanager/running/RunningAppsLoader.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.appmanager.running

import android.app.ActivityManager
import android.content.Context
import android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo
import android.content.pm.PackageInfo
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Process
import com.topjohnwu.superuser.Shell
import me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist.ApkInstallHelper
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.root.ShizukuManager
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.root.ShizukuShell
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.escapeShellArg
import java.io.BufferedReader
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileReader
import java.util.regex.Pattern

object RunningAppsLoader {

    data class RamStats(
        val totalBytes: Long,
        val availBytes: Long,
        val usedBytes: Long,
        val usedPercent: Int
    )

    /**
     * Reads system RAM usage from ActivityManager and /proc/meminfo.
     */
    fun getRamStats(context: Context): RamStats {
        val am = context.getSystemService(Context.ACTIVITY_SERVICE) as? ActivityManager
        var total = 0L
        var avail = 0L

        if (am != null) {
            val memInfo = ActivityManager.MemoryInfo()
            am.getMemoryInfo(memInfo)
            total = memInfo.totalMem
            avail = memInfo.availMem
        }

        if (total <= 0L) {
            try {
                BufferedReader(FileReader("/proc/meminfo")).use { reader ->
                    var line: String?
                    while (reader.readLine().also { line = it } != null) {
                        val l = line!!
                        if (l.startsWith("MemTotal:")) {
                            val kb = l.substringAfter(':').trim().substringBefore(' ').toLongOrNull() ?: 0L
                            total = kb * 1024L
                        } else if (l.startsWith("MemAvailable:")) {
                            val kb = l.substringAfter(':').trim().substringBefore(' ').toLongOrNull() ?: 0L
                            avail = kb * 1024L
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (_: Throwable) {}
        }

        val used = (total - avail).coerceAtLeast(0L)
        val percent = if (total > 0L) ((used * 100L) / total).toInt().coerceIn(0, 100) else 0

        return RamStats(
            totalBytes = total,
            availBytes = avail,
            usedBytes = used,
            usedPercent = percent
        )
    }

    fun isRootGranted(): Boolean =
        (Shell.isAppGrantedRoot() == true) || ApkInstallHelper.isRootAvailable()

    fun isShizukuReady(): Boolean = ShizukuManager.ready()

    fun hasElevatedAccess(): Boolean = isRootGranted() || isShizukuReady()

    private val APP_PROCESS_REGEX = Pattern.compile(
        "\\*[A-Z]+\\*\\s+UID\\s+(\\d+)\\s+ProcessRecord\\{[0-9a-fA-F]+\\s+(\\d+):([^/\\s]+)"
    )

    /**
     * Discovers all running processes and apps using multi-tier strategy (App Manager Style).
     */
    fun loadRunningProcesses(context: Context): List<RunningAppModel> {
        val pm = context.packageManager
        val installedMap = mutableMapOf<String, PackageInfo>()
        val uidPackageMap = mutableMapOf<Int, String>()

        try {
            val packages = pm.getInstalledPackages(0)
            for (pkg in packages) {
                installedMap[pkg.packageName] = pkg
                val uid = pkg.applicationInfo?.uid ?: 0
                if (uid > 0 && !uidPackageMap.containsKey(uid)) {
                    uidPackageMap[uid] = pkg.packageName
                }
            }
        } catch (_: Throwable) {}

        val processMap = mutableMapOf<Int, RunningAppModel>()

        // 1. Tier 1: dumpsys activity processes (Root / Shizuku / Shell)
        if (isRootGranted()) {
            try {
                val output = Shell.cmd("dumpsys activity processes").exec().out
                parseDumpsysOutput(output, installedMap, processMap, pm)
            } catch (_: Throwable) {}
        } else if (isShizukuReady()) {
            try {
                val res = ShizukuShell.exec("dumpsys activity processes")
                if (res.isSuccess && res.out.isNotEmpty()) {
                    parseDumpsysOutput(res.out.lines(), installedMap, processMap, pm)
                }
            } catch (_: Throwable) {}
        }

        // 2. Tier 2: ps -A or ps command
        try {
            val psOutput = when {
                isRootGranted() -> {
                    Shell.cmd("ps -A -o PID,PPID,USER,RSS,STAT,NAME").exec().out
                }
                isShizukuReady() -> {
                    val res = ShizukuShell.exec("ps -A -o PID,PPID,USER,RSS,STAT,NAME")
                    if (res.isSuccess && res.out.isNotEmpty()) res.out.lines() else emptyList()
                }
                else -> {
                    val p = Runtime.getRuntime().exec(arrayOf("ps", "-A"))
                    p.inputStream.bufferedReader().use { it.readLines() }
                }
            }
            parsePsOutput(psOutput, installedMap, uidPackageMap, processMap, pm)
        } catch (_: Throwable) {}

        // 3. Tier 3: ActivityManager.getRunningAppProcesses()
        try {
            val am = context.getSystemService(Context.ACTIVITY_SERVICE) as? ActivityManager
            val amList = am?.runningAppProcesses
            if (amList != null) {
                for (info in amList) {
                    if (processMap.containsKey(info.pid)) continue
                    val mainPkg = info.pkgList?.firstOrNull() ?: info.processName.substringBefore(':')
                    val pkgInfo = installedMap[mainPkg]
                    val appInfo = pkgInfo?.applicationInfo
                    val isSystem = if (appInfo != null) {
                        (appInfo.flags and ApplicationInfo.FLAG_SYSTEM) != 0
                    } else {
                        info.uid < 10000
                    }
                    val label = if (appInfo != null) {
                        try { pm.getApplicationLabel(appInfo).toString() } catch (_: Throwable) { mainPkg }
                    } else {
                        info.processName
                    }
                    val memBytes = readProcessRssFromProc(info.pid)

                    processMap[info.pid] = RunningAppModel(
                        pid = info.pid,
                        ppid = 0,
                        uid = info.uid,
                        processName = info.processName,
                        packageName = if (pkgInfo != null) mainPkg else null,
                        label = label,
                        isApp = pkgInfo != null,
                        isSystem = isSystem,
                        memoryBytes = memBytes,
                        state = if (info.importance <= ActivityManager.RunningAppProcessInfo.IMPORTANCE_FOREGROUND) "R" else "S",
                        user = "u0_a${info.uid % 100000}"
                    )
                }
            }
        } catch (_: Throwable) {}

        // 4. Tier 4: Direct /proc/[0-9]+ scan
        try {
            val procDir = File("/proc")
            val pids = procDir.listFiles { f -> f.isDirectory && f.name.all { it.isDigit() } }
            if (pids != null) {
                for (dir in pids) {
                    val pid = dir.name.toIntOrNull() ?: continue
                    if (processMap.containsKey(pid)) continue
                    val procModel = readProcPid(pid, installedMap, uidPackageMap, pm) ?: continue
                    processMap[pid] = procModel
                }
            }
        } catch (_: Throwable) {}

        return processMap.values.toList().sortedWith(compareByDescending<RunningAppModel> { it.isApp }
            .thenByDescending { it.memoryBytes }
            .thenBy { it.label.lowercase() })
    }

    fun parseDumpsysOutput(
        lines: List<String>,
        installedMap: Map<String, PackageInfo>,
        processMap: MutableMap<Int, RunningAppModel>,
        pm: PackageManager? = null
    ) {
        for (line in lines) {
            val matcher = APP_PROCESS_REGEX.matcher(line)
            if (matcher.find()) {
                val uid = matcher.group(1)?.toIntOrNull() ?: 0
                val pid = matcher.group(2)?.toIntOrNull() ?: continue
                val processName = matcher.group(3) ?: continue

                val mainPkg = processName.substringBefore(':')
                val pkgInfo = installedMap[mainPkg]
                val appInfo = pkgInfo?.applicationInfo
                val isSystem = if (appInfo != null) {
                    (appInfo.flags and ApplicationInfo.FLAG_SYSTEM) != 0
                } else {
                    uid < 10000
                }
                val label = if (appInfo != null) {
                    try { pm?.getApplicationLabel(appInfo)?.toString() ?: mainPkg } catch (_: Throwable) { mainPkg }
                } else {
                    processName
                }
                val mem = readProcessRssFromProc(pid)

                processMap[pid] = RunningAppModel(
                    pid = pid,
                    uid = uid,
                    processName = processName,
                    packageName = if (pkgInfo != null) mainPkg else null,
                    label = label,
                    isApp = pkgInfo != null,
                    isSystem = isSystem,
                    memoryBytes = mem,
                    state = "R",
                    user = if (uid == 0) "root" else if (uid == 1000) "system" else "u0_a${uid % 100000}"
                )
            }
        }
    }

    fun parsePsOutput(
        lines: List<String>,
        installedMap: Map<String, PackageInfo>,
        uidPackageMap: Map<Int, String>,
        processMap: MutableMap<Int, RunningAppModel>,
        pm: PackageManager? = null
    ) {
        if (lines.isEmpty()) return
        val header = lines.firstOrNull()?.trim() ?: return
        val isHeader = header.contains("PID") || header.contains("USER") || header.contains("CMD")
        val contentLines = if (isHeader) lines.drop(1) else lines

        var colPid = -1
        var colPpid = -1
        var colUser = -1
        var colRss = -1
        var colStat = -1
        var colName = -1

        if (isHeader) {
            val headerTokens = header.split(Regex("\\s+"))
            for ((idx, tok) in headerTokens.withIndex()) {
                when (tok.uppercase()) {
                    "PID" -> colPid = idx
                    "PPID" -> colPpid = idx
                    "USER", "UID" -> colUser = idx
                    "RSS", "VMRSS" -> colRss = idx
                    "STAT", "S" -> colStat = idx
                    "NAME", "CMD", "COMMAND" -> colName = idx
                }
            }
        }

        for (line in contentLines) {
            val trimmedLine = line.trim()
            if (trimmedLine.isEmpty()) continue
            val tokens = trimmedLine.split(Regex("\\s+"))
            if (tokens.size < 4) continue

            var pid = -1
            var ppid = 0
            var user = ""
            var rssKb = 0L
            var stat = "S"
            var name = ""

            if (colPid in tokens.indices && colName in tokens.indices) {
                pid = tokens[colPid].toIntOrNull() ?: -1
                if (colPpid in tokens.indices) ppid = tokens[colPpid].toIntOrNull() ?: 0
                if (colUser in tokens.indices) user = tokens[colUser]
                if (colRss in tokens.indices) {
                    rssKb = tokens[colRss].toLongOrNull() ?: 0L
                }
                if (colStat in tokens.indices) stat = tokens[colStat]
                name = if (colName == tokens.size - 1) {
                    tokens[colName]
                } else if (colName < tokens.size) {
                    tokens.subList(colName, tokens.size).joinToString(" ")
                } else {
                    tokens.last()
                }
            } else {
                for (token in tokens) {
                    if (pid == -1 && token.all { it.isDigit() }) {
                        pid = token.toIntOrNull() ?: -1
                    }
                }
                user = tokens[0]
                name = tokens.last()
                stat = tokens.find { it.length == 1 && it[0] in "RSDZTtW" } ?: "S"

                for (token in tokens) {
                    val num = token.toLongOrNull()
                    if (num != null && num > 100L && num < 10_000_000L && num != pid.toLong()) {
                        rssKb = num
                    }
                }
            }

            if (pid <= 0) continue

            // Update existing entry (e.g. from dumpsys) if RSS was missing
            val existing = processMap[pid]
            if (existing != null) {
                if (existing.memoryBytes <= 0L && rssKb > 0L) {
                    processMap[pid] = existing.copy(memoryBytes = rssKb * 1024L)
                }
                continue
            }

            val cleanName = name.trimStart('[').trimEnd(']')
            val basePkg = cleanName.substringBefore(':')
            val pkgInfo = installedMap[basePkg] ?: (if (user.startsWith("u0_a")) {
                val uidNum = user.removePrefix("u0_a").toIntOrNull()?.let { 10000 + it }
                if (uidNum != null) uidPackageMap[uidNum]?.let { installedMap[it] } else null
            } else null)
            val appInfo = pkgInfo?.applicationInfo
            val isSystem = if (appInfo != null) {
                (appInfo.flags and ApplicationInfo.FLAG_SYSTEM) != 0
            } else {
                user == "root" || user == "system"
            }
            val label = if (appInfo != null) {
                try { pm?.getApplicationLabel(appInfo)?.toString() ?: (pkgInfo?.packageName ?: basePkg) } catch (_: Throwable) { basePkg }
            } else {
                cleanName
            }

            val finalMem = if (rssKb > 0) rssKb * 1024L else readProcessRssFromProc(pid)

            val uid = when {
                user == "root" -> 0
                user == "system" -> 1000
                user.startsWith("u0_a") -> 10000 + (user.removePrefix("u0_a").toIntOrNull() ?: 0)
                else -> 10000
            }

            processMap[pid] = RunningAppModel(
                pid = pid,
                ppid = ppid,
                uid = uid,
                processName = cleanName,
                packageName = pkgInfo?.packageName,
                label = label,
                isApp = pkgInfo != null,
                isSystem = isSystem,
                memoryBytes = finalMem,
                state = stat,
                user = user
            )
        }
    }

    private fun readProcPid(
        pid: Int,
        installedMap: Map<String, PackageInfo>,
        uidPackageMap: Map<Int, String>,
        pm: PackageManager
    ): RunningAppModel? {
        val statusFile = File("/proc/$pid/status")
        if (!statusFile.exists() || !statusFile.canRead()) return null

        var name = ""
        var state = "S"
        var ppid = 0
        var uid = 0
        var vmrss = 0L
        var threads = 1

        try {
            BufferedReader(FileReader(statusFile)).use { reader ->
                var line: String?
                while (reader.readLine().also { line = it } != null) {
                    val l = line!!
                    when {
                        l.startsWith("Name:") -> name = l.substringAfter(':').trim()
                        l.startsWith("State:") -> state = l.substringAfter(':').trim().take(1)
                        l.startsWith("PPid:") -> ppid = l.substringAfter(':').trim().toIntOrNull() ?: 0
                        l.startsWith("Uid:") -> uid = l.substringAfter(':').trim().split(Regex("\\s+"))[0].toIntOrNull() ?: 0
                        l.startsWith("VmRSS:") -> vmrss = (l.substringAfter(':').trim().substringBefore(' ').toLongOrNull() ?: 0L) * 1024L
                        l.startsWith("Threads:") -> threads = l.substringAfter(':').trim().toIntOrNull() ?: 1
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            return null
        }

        if (name.isEmpty()) return null

        var cmdline = ""
        try {
            val cmdFile = File("/proc/$pid/cmdline")
            if (cmdFile.exists() && cmdFile.canRead()) {
                cmdline = cmdFile.readText().replace('\u0000', ' ').trim()
            }
        } catch (_: Throwable) {}

        val effectiveName = if (cmdline.isNotEmpty()) cmdline.split(' ')[0] else name
        val basePkg = effectiveName.substringBefore(':')
        val pkgInfo = installedMap[basePkg] ?: uidPackageMap[uid]?.let { installedMap[it] }
        val appInfo = pkgInfo?.applicationInfo

        val isSystem = if (appInfo != null) {
            (appInfo.flags and ApplicationInfo.FLAG_SYSTEM) != 0
        } else {
            uid < 10000
        }

        val label = if (appInfo != null) {
            try { pm.getApplicationLabel(appInfo).toString() } catch (_: Throwable) { basePkg }
        } else {
            effectiveName
        }

        return RunningAppModel(
            pid = pid,
            ppid = ppid,
            uid = uid,
            processName = effectiveName,
            packageName = if (pkgInfo != null) pkgInfo.packageName else null,
            label = label,
            isApp = pkgInfo != null,
            isSystem = isSystem,
            memoryBytes = vmrss,
            state = state,
            threadCount = threads,
            user = if (uid == 0) "root" else if (uid == 1000) "system" else "u0_a${uid % 100000}",
            cmdline = cmdline
        )
    }

    private fun readProcessRssFromProc(pid: Int): Long {
        try {
            val file = File("/proc/$pid/status")
            if (file.exists() && file.canRead()) {
                BufferedReader(FileReader(file)).use { reader ->
                    var line: String?
                    while (reader.readLine().also { line = it } != null) {
                        if (line!!.startsWith("VmRSS:")) {
                            val kb = line!!.substringAfter(':').trim().substringBefore(' ').toLongOrNull() ?: 0L
                            return kb * 1024L
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (_: Throwable) {}
        return 0L
    }

    /**
     * Kills a process by PID using SIGKILL (-9).
     */
    fun killProcess(pid: Int): Boolean {
        if (pid <= 0) return false
        if (isRootGranted()) {
            val res = Shell.cmd("kill -9 $pid").exec()
            return res.isSuccess
        }
        if (isShizukuReady()) {
            val res = ShizukuShell.exec("kill -9 $pid")
            return res.isSuccess
        }
        return try {
            Process.killProcess(pid)
            true
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            false
        }
    }

    /**
     * Force stops an application via am force-stop.
     */
    fun forceStopApp(packageName: String): Boolean {
        if (packageName.isBlank()) return false
        if (isRootGranted()) {
            val res = Shell.cmd("am force-stop ${packageName.escapeShellArg()}").exec()
            return res.isSuccess
        }
        if (isShizukuReady()) {
            val res = ShizukuShell.exec("am force-stop ${packageName.escapeShellArg()}")
            return res.isSuccess
        }
        return false
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/coil/AppIconFetcher.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2020 Hai Zhang <dreaming.in.code.zh@gmail.com>
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.coil

import android.content.Context
import android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo
import androidx.core.graphics.drawable.toDrawable
import coil.ImageLoader
import coil.decode.DataSource
import coil.fetch.DrawableResult
import coil.fetch.FetchResult
import coil.fetch.Fetcher
import coil.request.Options
import me.zhanghai.android.appiconloader.AppIconLoader
import java.io.Closeable

class AppIconFetcher(
    private val options: Options,
    private val appIconLoader: AppIconLoader,
    private val getApplicationInfo: () -> Pair<ApplicationInfo, Closeable?>
) : Fetcher {
    override suspend fun fetch(): FetchResult {
        val (applicationInfo, closeable) = getApplicationInfo()
        val icon = closeable.use { appIconLoader.loadIcon(applicationInfo) }
        // Not sampled because we only load with one fixed size.
        return DrawableResult(icon.toDrawable(options.context.resources), false, DataSource.DISK)
    }

    abstract class Factory<T : Any>(
        iconSize: Int,
        context: Context,
        shrinkNonAdaptiveIcons: Boolean = false
    ) : Fetcher.Factory<T> {
        private val appIconLoader =
            AppIconLoader(iconSize, shrinkNonAdaptiveIcons, context)

        override fun create(data: T, options: Options, imageLoader: ImageLoader): Fetcher =
            AppIconFetcher(options, appIconLoader) { getApplicationInfo(data) }

        abstract fun getApplicationInfo(data: T): Pair<ApplicationInfo, Closeable?>
    }
}
```

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.coil

import android.content.Context
import android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo
import coil.key.Keyer
import coil.request.Options
import me.zhanghai.android.files.R
import me.zhanghai.android.files.compat.PackageManagerCompat
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.getDimensionPixelSize
import java.io.Closeable

data class AppIconPackageName(val packageName: String)

class AppIconPackageNameKeyer : Keyer<AppIconPackageName> {
    override fun key(data: AppIconPackageName, options: Options): String = data.packageName
}

class AppIconPackageNameFetcherFactory(
    private val context: Context
) : AppIconFetcher.Factory<AppIconPackageName>(
    // This is used by FileListAdapter, and shrinking non-adaptive icons makes it look better as a
    // badge.
    context.getDimensionPixelSize(R.dimen.badge_size_plus_1dp), context, true
) {
    override fun getApplicationInfo(data: AppIconPackageName): Pair<ApplicationInfo, Closeable?> {
        // PackageManager.MATCH_UNINSTALLED_PACKAGES allows using PackageManager.MATCH_ANY_USER
        // without the INTERACT_ACROSS_USERS permission when we are in the system user and it has a
        // managed profile. It may also help corner cases like when the package is hidden.
        return context.packageManager.getApplicationInfo(
            data.packageName, PackageManagerCompat.MATCH_UNINSTALLED_PACKAGES
        ) to null
    }
}
```

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.coil

import android.os.Build
import coil.Coil
import coil.ImageLoader
import coil.decode.GifDecoder
import coil.decode.ImageDecoderDecoder
import coil.decode.SvgDecoder
import me.zhanghai.android.files.app.application

fun initializeCoil() {
    Coil.setImageLoader(
        ImageLoader.Builder(application)
            .components {
                add(AppIconApplicationInfoKeyer())
                add(AppIconApplicationInfoFetcherFactory(application))
                add(AppIconPackageNameKeyer())
                add(AppIconPackageNameFetcherFactory(application))
                add(InstalledAppIconKeyer())
                add(InstalledAppIconFetcherFactory(application))
                add(PathAttributesKeyer())
                add(PathAttributesFetcher.Factory(application))
                add(
                    if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.P) {
                        ImageDecoderDecoder.Factory()
                    } else {
                        GifDecoder.Factory()
                    }
                )
                add(SvgDecoder.Factory(false))
            }
            .build()
    )
}
```

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.coil

import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.os.Build
import coil.decode.DataSource
import coil.size.Dimension
import coil.size.Scale
import coil.size.Size
import coil.size.isOriginal
import coil.size.pxOrElse
import java8.nio.file.Path
import me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist.isRemotePath

val Bitmap.Config.isHardware: Boolean
    get() = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O && this == Bitmap.Config.HARDWARE

fun Bitmap.Config.toSoftware(): Bitmap.Config = if (isHardware) Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888 else this

val Path.dataSource: DataSource
    get() = if (isRemotePath) DataSource.NETWORK else DataSource.DISK

inline fun Size.widthPx(scale: Scale, original: () -> Int): Int =
    if (isOriginal) original() else width.toPx(scale)

inline fun Size.heightPx(scale: Scale, original: () -> Int): Int =
    if (isOriginal) original() else height.toPx(scale)

fun Dimension.toPx(scale: Scale) =
    pxOrElse {
        when (scale) {
            Scale.FILL -> Int.MIN_VALUE
            Scale.FIT -> Int.MAX_VALUE
        }
    }
```

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager

package me.zhanghai.android.files.coil

import android.app.ActivityManager
import android.content.Context
import android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo
import coil.key.Keyer
import coil.request.Options
import me.zhanghai.android.files.compat.PackageManagerCompat
import java.io.Closeable

data class InstalledAppIcon(val packageName: String, val lastUpdateTime: Long = 0)

class InstalledAppIconKeyer : Keyer<InstalledAppIcon> {
    override fun key(data: InstalledAppIcon, options: Options): String =
        "app_icon_hd_${data.packageName}_${data.lastUpdateTime}"
}

class InstalledAppIconFetcherFactory(
    private val context: Context
) : AppIconFetcher.Factory<InstalledAppIcon>(
    // Full resolution launcher icon size (e.g. 192px on xxxhdpi, 144px on xxhdpi, 96px on xhdpi)
    ((context.getSystemService(Context.ACTIVITY_SERVICE) as? ActivityManager)?.launcherLargeIconSize
        ?: (64 * context.resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()).coerceAtLeast(144),
    context,
    false
) {
    override fun getApplicationInfo(data: InstalledAppIcon): Pair<ApplicationInfo, Closeable?> {
        return context.packageManager.getApplicationInfo(
            data.packageName, PackageManagerCompat.MATCH_UNINSTALLED_PACKAGES
        ) to null
    }
}
```

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.coil

import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable
import coil.request.ImageRequest
import coil.target.ImageViewTarget

// Setting the placeholder drawable as error drawable again causes animation glitches, so we just
// ignore the onError() callback.
fun ImageRequest.Builder.ignoreError() {
    val view = (build().target as ImageViewTarget).view
    target(object : ImageViewTarget(view) {
        override fun onError(error: Drawable?) {}
    })
}
```

`app/src/main/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/coil/PathAttributesFetcher.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2020 Hai Zhang <dreaming.in.code.zh@gmail.com>
 * All Rights Reserved.

package me.zhanghai.android.files.coil

import android.content.Context
import android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo
import android.media.MediaMetadataRetriever
import android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor
import androidx.core.graphics.drawable.toDrawable
import coil.ImageLoader
import coil.decode.ImageSource
import coil.fetch.DrawableResult
import coil.fetch.FetchResult
import coil.fetch.Fetcher
import coil.fetch.SourceResult
import coil.key.Keyer
import coil.request.Options
import coil.size.Dimension
import java8.nio.file.Path
import java8.nio.file.attribute.BasicFileAttributes
import me.zhanghai.android.files.R
import me.zhanghai.android.files.compat.use
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.MimeType
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.asMimeType
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.isApk
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.isImage
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.isMedia
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.isPdf
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.isVideo
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.lastModifiedInstant
import me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist.isRemotePath
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.common.AndroidFileTypeDetector
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.common.newInputStream
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.content.resolver.ResolverException
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.document.documentSupportsThumbnail
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.document.isDocumentPath
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.document.resolver.DocumentResolver

import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.isMediaMetadataRetrieverCompatible
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.runWithCancellationSignal
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.setDataSource
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.valueCompat
import okio.buffer
import okio.source
import java.io.Closeable
import java.io.IOException
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.setDataSource as appSetDataSource

class PathAttributesKeyer : Keyer<Pair<Path, BasicFileAttributes>> {
    override fun key(data: Pair<Path, BasicFileAttributes>, options: Options): String {
        val (path, attributes) = data
        return "$path:${attributes.lastModifiedInstant.toEpochMilli()}"
    }
}

class PathAttributesFetcher(
    private val data: Pair<Path, BasicFileAttributes>,
    private val options: Options,
    private val imageLoader: ImageLoader,
    private val appIconFetcherFactory: AppIconFetcher.Factory<Path>,
    private val videoFrameFetcherFactory: VideoFrameFetcher.Factory<Path>,
    private val pdfPageFetcherFactory: PdfPageFetcher.Factory<Path>
) : Fetcher {
    override suspend fun fetch(): FetchResult? {
        val (path, attributes) = data
        val (width, height) = options.size
        // @see android.provider.MediaStore.ThumbnailConstants.MINI_SIZE
        val isThumbnail = width is Dimension.Pixels && width.px <= 512
            && height is Dimension.Pixels && height.px <= 384
        if (isThumbnail) {
            width as Dimension.Pixels
            height as Dimension.Pixels
            if (path.isDocumentPath && attributes.documentSupportsThumbnail) {
                val thumbnail = runWithCancellationSignal { signal ->
                    try {
                        DocumentResolver.getThumbnail(
                            path as DocumentResolver.Path, width.px, height.px, signal
                        )
                    } catch (e: ResolverException) {
                        e.printStackTrace()
                        null
                    }
                }
                if (thumbnail != null) {
                    return DrawableResult(
                        thumbnail.toDrawable(options.context.resources), true, path.dataSource
                    )
                }
            }
            if (path.isRemotePath) {
                // FTP doesn't support random access and requires one connection per parallel read.
                val shouldReadRemotePath = !path.isFtpPath
                    && Settings.READ_REMOTE_FILES_FOR_THUMBNAIL.valueCompat
                if (!shouldReadRemotePath) {
                    error("Cannot read $path for thumbnail")
                }
            }
        }
        val mimeType = AndroidFileTypeDetector.getMimeType(data.first, data.second).asMimeType()
        when {
            mimeType.isApk && path.isGetPackageArchiveInfoCompatible -> {
                try {
                    return appIconFetcherFactory.create(path, options, imageLoader).fetch()
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    e.printStackTrace()
                }
            }
            mimeType.isImage || mimeType == MimeType.GENERIC -> {
                val inputStream = path.newInputStream()
                return SourceResult(
                    ImageSource(inputStream.source().buffer(), options.context),
                    if (mimeType != MimeType.GENERIC) mimeType.value else null, path.dataSource
                )
            }
            mimeType.isMedia && path.isMediaMetadataRetrieverCompatible -> {
                val embeddedPicture = try {
                    MediaMetadataRetriever().use { retriever ->
                        retriever.setDataSource(path)
                        retriever.embeddedPicture
                    }
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    e.printStackTrace()
                    null
                }
                if (embeddedPicture != null) {
                    return SourceResult(
                        ImageSource(
                            embeddedPicture.inputStream().source().buffer(), options.context
                        ), null, path.dataSource
                    )
                }
                if (mimeType.isVideo) {
                    try {
                        return videoFrameFetcherFactory.create(path, options, imageLoader).fetch()
                    } catch (e: Exception) {
                        e.printStackTrace()
                    }
                }
            }
            mimeType.isPdf && (path.isLinuxPath || path.isDocumentPath) -> {
                try {
                    return pdfPageFetcherFactory.create(path, options, imageLoader).fetch()
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    e.printStackTrace()
                }
            }
        }
        return null
    }

    class Factory(private val context: Context) : Fetcher.Factory<Pair<Path, BasicFileAttributes>> {
        private val appIconFetcherFactory = object : AppIconFetcher.Factory<Path>(
            // This is used by FileListAdapter.
            context.getDimensionPixelSize(R.dimen.large_icon_size), context
        ) {
            override fun getApplicationInfo(data: Path): Pair<ApplicationInfo, Closeable?> {
                val (packageInfo, closeable) =
                    context.packageManager.getPackageArchiveInfoCompat(data, 0)
                val applicationInfo = packageInfo?.applicationInfo
                if (applicationInfo == null) {
                    closeable?.close()
                    throw IOException("ApplicationInfo is null")
                }
                return applicationInfo to closeable
            }
        }

        private val videoFrameFetcherFactory = object : VideoFrameFetcher.Factory<Path>() {
            override fun MediaMetadataRetriever.setDataSource(data: Path) {
                appSetDataSource(data)
            }
        }

        private val pdfPageFetcherFactory = object : PdfPageFetcher.Factory<Path>() {
            override fun openParcelFileDescriptor(data: Path): ParcelFileDescriptor =
                when {
                    data.isLinuxPath ->
                        ParcelFileDescriptor.open(data.toFile(), ParcelFileDescriptor.MODE_READ_ONLY)
                    data.isDocumentPath ->
                        DocumentResolver.openParcelFileDescriptor(data as DocumentResolver.Path, "r")
                    else -> throw IllegalArgumentException(data.toString())
                }
        }

        override fun create(
            data: Pair<Path, BasicFileAttributes>,
            options: Options,
            imageLoader: ImageLoader
        ): Fetcher =
            PathAttributesFetcher(
                data, options, imageLoader, appIconFetcherFactory, videoFrameFetcherFactory,
                pdfPageFetcherFactory
            )
    }
}
```

```kt
/*

 * All Rights Reserved.

package me.zhanghai.android.files.coil

import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.pdf.PdfRenderer
import android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor
import androidx.annotation.ColorInt
import androidx.annotation.IntRange
import androidx.core.graphics.createBitmap
import androidx.core.graphics.drawable.toDrawable
import coil.ImageLoader
import coil.decode.DataSource
import coil.decode.DecodeUtils
import coil.fetch.DrawableResult
import coil.fetch.FetchResult
import coil.fetch.Fetcher
import coil.request.ImageRequest
import coil.request.Options
import coil.request.Parameters
import kotlin.math.roundToInt

fun ImageRequest.Builder.pdfBackgroundColor(@ColorInt backgroundColor: Int): ImageRequest.Builder =
    setParameter(PdfPageFetcher.PDF_BACKGROUND_COLOR_KEY, backgroundColor)

fun ImageRequest.Builder.pdfPageIndex(@IntRange(from = 0) pageIndex: Int): ImageRequest.Builder {
    require(pageIndex >= 0) { "pageIndex must be >= 0." }
    return setParameter(PdfPageFetcher.PDF_PAGE_INDEX_KEY, pageIndex)
}

@ColorInt
fun Parameters.pdfBackgroundColor(): Int? = value(PdfPageFetcher.PDF_BACKGROUND_COLOR_KEY) as Int?

@IntRange(from = 0)
fun Parameters.pdfPageIndex(): Int? = value(PdfPageFetcher.PDF_PAGE_INDEX_KEY) as Int?

class PdfPageFetcher(
    private val options: Options,
    private val openParcelFileDescriptor: () -> ParcelFileDescriptor
) : Fetcher {
    override suspend fun fetch(): FetchResult =
        openParcelFileDescriptor().use { pfd ->
            PdfRenderer(pfd).use { renderer ->
                val pageIndex = options.parameters.pdfPageIndex() ?: 0
                renderer.openPage(pageIndex).use { page ->
                    val srcWidth = page.width
                    check(srcWidth > 0) {
                        "PDF page $pageIndex width $srcWidth isn't greater than 0"
                    }
                    val srcHeight = page.height
                    check(srcWidth > 0) {
                        "PDF page $pageIndex height $srcHeight isn't greater than 0"
                    }
                    val dstWidth = options.size.widthPx(options.scale) { srcWidth }
                    val dstHeight = options.size.heightPx(options.scale) { srcHeight }
                    val rawScale = DecodeUtils.computeSizeMultiplier(
                        srcWidth = srcWidth,
                        srcHeight = srcHeight,
                        dstWidth = dstWidth,
                        dstHeight = dstHeight,
                        scale = options.scale
                    )
                    val scale = if (options.allowInexactSize) {
                        rawScale.coerceAtMost(1.0)
                    } else {
                        rawScale
                    }
                    val width = (scale * srcWidth).roundToInt()
                    val height = (scale * srcHeight).roundToInt()
                    val config = options.config.toSoftware()
                    val bitmap = createBitmap(width, height, config)
                    val backgroundColor = options.parameters.pdfBackgroundColor() ?: Color.WHITE
                    bitmap.eraseColor(backgroundColor)
                    page.render(bitmap, null, null, PdfRenderer.Page.RENDER_MODE_FOR_DISPLAY)
                    DrawableResult(
                        drawable = bitmap.toDrawable(options.context.resources),
                        isSampled = scale < 1.0,
                        dataSource = DataSource.DISK
                    )
                }
            }
        }

    companion object {
        const val PDF_BACKGROUND_COLOR_KEY = "coil#pdf_background_color"
        const val PDF_PAGE_INDEX_KEY = "coil#pdf_page_index"
    }

    abstract class Factory<T : Any> : Fetcher.Factory<T> {
        override fun create(data: T, options: Options, imageLoader: ImageLoader): Fetcher =
            PdfPageFetcher(options) { openParcelFileDescriptor(data) }

        protected abstract fun openParcelFileDescriptor(data: T): ParcelFileDescriptor
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/coil/VideoFrameFetcher.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2022 Hai Zhang <dreaming.in.code.zh@gmail.com>
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.coil

import android.graphics.Paint
import android.media.MediaMetadataRetriever
import android.os.Build
import androidx.core.graphics.applyCanvas
import androidx.core.graphics.createBitmap
import androidx.core.graphics.drawable.toDrawable
import coil.ImageLoader
import coil.decode.DataSource
import coil.decode.DecodeUtils
import coil.fetch.DrawableResult
import coil.fetch.FetchResult
import coil.fetch.Fetcher
import coil.request.Options
import coil.request.videoFrameOption
import coil.request.videoFramePercent
import me.zhanghai.android.files.compat.getFrameAtTimeCompat
import me.zhanghai.android.files.compat.getScaledFrameAtTimeCompat
import me.zhanghai.android.files.compat.use
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import kotlin.math.roundToInt
import kotlin.math.roundToLong

class VideoFrameFetcher(
    private val options: Options,
    private val setDataSource: MediaMetadataRetriever.() -> Unit
) : Fetcher {
    override suspend fun fetch(): FetchResult =
        MediaMetadataRetriever().use { retriever ->
            retriever.setDataSource()
            val rotation =
                retriever.extractMetadata(MediaMetadataRetriever.METADATA_KEY_VIDEO_ROTATION)
                    ?.toIntOrNull() ?: 0
            var srcWidth: Int
            var srcHeight: Int
            when (rotation) {
                90, 270 -> {
                    srcWidth =
                        retriever.extractMetadata(MediaMetadataRetriever.METADATA_KEY_VIDEO_HEIGHT)
                            ?.toIntOrNull() ?: 0
                    srcHeight =
                        retriever.extractMetadata(MediaMetadataRetriever.METADATA_KEY_VIDEO_WIDTH)
                            ?.toIntOrNull() ?: 0
                }
                else -> {
                    srcWidth =
                        retriever.extractMetadata(MediaMetadataRetriever.METADATA_KEY_VIDEO_WIDTH)
                            ?.toIntOrNull() ?: 0
                    srcHeight =
                        retriever.extractMetadata(MediaMetadataRetriever.METADATA_KEY_VIDEO_HEIGHT)
                            ?.toIntOrNull() ?: 0
                }
            }
            val durationMillis =
                retriever.extractMetadata(MediaMetadataRetriever.METADATA_KEY_DURATION)
                    ?.toLongOrNull() ?: 0L
            // 1/3 is the first percentage tried by totem-video-thumbnailer.
            // @see https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/totem/-/blob/master/src/totem-video-thumbnailer.c#L543
            val framePercent = options.parameters.videoFramePercent() ?: (1.0 / 3.0)
            val frameMicros = TimeUnit.MICROSECONDS.convert(
                (framePercent * durationMillis).roundToLong(), TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS
            )
            val frameOption = options.parameters.videoFrameOption()
                ?: MediaMetadataRetriever.OPTION_CLOSEST_SYNC
            val bitmapParams = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.P) {
                MediaMetadataRetriever.BitmapParams().apply { preferredConfig = options.config }
            } else {
                null
            }
            val outBitmap = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O_MR1
                && srcWidth > 0 && srcHeight > 0) {
                val dstWidth = options.size.widthPx(options.scale) { srcWidth }
                val dstHeight = options.size.heightPx(options.scale) { srcHeight }
                val rawScale = DecodeUtils.computeSizeMultiplier(
                    srcWidth = srcWidth,
                    srcHeight = srcHeight,
                    dstWidth = dstWidth,
                    dstHeight = dstHeight,
                    scale = options.scale
                )
                val scale = if (options.allowInexactSize) {
                    rawScale.coerceAtMost(1.0)
                } else {
                    rawScale
                }
                val width = (scale * srcWidth).roundToInt()
                val height = (scale * srcHeight).roundToInt()
                retriever.getScaledFrameAtTimeCompat(
                    frameMicros, frameOption, width, height, bitmapParams
                )
            } else {
                retriever.getFrameAtTimeCompat(frameMicros, frameOption, bitmapParams)?.also {
                    srcWidth = it.width
                    srcHeight = it.height
                }
            }
            val dstWidth = options.size.widthPx(options.scale) { srcWidth }
            val dstHeight = options.size.heightPx(options.scale) { srcHeight }
            val rawScale = DecodeUtils.computeSizeMultiplier(
                srcWidth = srcWidth,
                srcHeight = srcHeight,
                dstWidth = dstWidth,
                dstHeight = dstHeight,
                scale = options.scale
            )
            checkNotNull(outBitmap) { "Failed to decode frame at $frameMicros microseconds" }
            val scale = if (options.allowInexactSize) {
                rawScale.coerceAtMost(1.0)
            } else {
                rawScale
            }
            val width = (scale * srcWidth).roundToInt()
            val height = (scale * srcHeight).roundToInt()
            val isValidSize = if (options.allowInexactSize) {
                outBitmap.width <= width && outBitmap.height <= height
            } else {
                outBitmap.width == width && outBitmap.height == height
            }
            val isValidConfig = outBitmap.config?.isHardware != true || options.config.isHardware
            val bitmap = if (isValidSize && isValidConfig) {
                outBitmap
            } else {
                val config = options.config.toSoftware()
                createBitmap(width, height, config).applyCanvas {
                    scale(scale.toFloat(), scale.toFloat())
                    val paint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG or Paint.FILTER_BITMAP_FLAG)
                    drawBitmap(outBitmap, 0f, 0f, paint)
                    outBitmap.recycle()
                }
            }
            DrawableResult(
                drawable = bitmap.toDrawable(options.context.resources),
                isSampled = scale < 1.0,
                dataSource = DataSource.DISK
            )
        }

    abstract class Factory<T : Any> : Fetcher.Factory<T> {
        override fun create(data: T, options: Options, imageLoader: ImageLoader): Fetcher =
            VideoFrameFetcher(options) { setDataSource(data) }

        protected abstract fun MediaMetadataRetriever.setDataSource(data: T)
    }
}
```

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.colorpicker

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable
import android.util.AttributeSet
import androidx.annotation.AttrRes
import androidx.annotation.ColorInt
import androidx.annotation.StyleRes
import androidx.preference.DialogPreference
import androidx.preference.PreferenceViewHolder
import me.zhanghai.android.files.R
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.getFloatByAttr
import kotlin.math.roundToInt

abstract class BaseColorPreference : DialogPreference {
    constructor(context: Context) : super(context)

    constructor(context: Context, attrs: AttributeSet?) : super(context, attrs)

    constructor(context: Context, attrs: AttributeSet?, @AttrRes defStyleAttr: Int) : super(
        context, attrs, defStyleAttr
    )

    constructor(
        context: Context,
        attrs: AttributeSet?,
        @AttrRes defStyleAttr: Int,
        @StyleRes defStyleRes: Int
    ) : super(context, attrs, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes)

    init {
        widgetLayoutResource = R.layout.color_preference_widget
        dialogLayoutResource = R.layout.color_picker_dialog
        setPositiveButtonText(android.R.string.ok)
        setNegativeButtonText(android.R.string.cancel)
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: PreferenceViewHolder) {
        super.onBindViewHolder(holder)

        val swatchView = holder.findViewById(R.id.swatch)
        if (swatchView != null) {
            val swatchDrawable = swatchView.background as GradientDrawable
            swatchDrawable.setColor(value)
            var alpha = 0xFF
            if (!isEnabled) {
                val disabledAlpha = context.getFloatByAttr(android.R.attr.disabledAlpha)
                alpha = (disabledAlpha * alpha).roundToInt()
            }
            swatchDrawable.alpha = alpha
        }
    }

    @get:ColorInt
    abstract var value: Int

    @get:ColorInt
    abstract val defaultValue: Int

    abstract val entryValues: IntArray
}
```

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.colorpicker

import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.widget.AbsListView
import android.widget.BaseAdapter

class ColorPaletteAdapter(private val colors: IntArray) : BaseAdapter() {
    override fun hasStableIds(): Boolean = true

    override fun getCount(): Int = colors.size

    override fun getItem(position: Int): Int = colors[position]

    override fun getItemId(position: Int): Long = getItem(position).toLong()

    override fun getView(position: Int, convertView: View?, parent: ViewGroup): View {
        val swatchView = convertView as ColorSwatchView?
            ?: ColorSwatchView(parent.context).apply {
                layoutParams = AbsListView.LayoutParams(
                    ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
                )
            }
        return swatchView.apply {
            setColor(getItem(position))
        }
    }
}
```
