```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import android.content.Context
import com.reandroid.apk.APKLogger
import com.reandroid.apk.ApkBundle
import com.reandroid.apk.ApkModule
import com.reandroid.apkeditor.common.AndroidManifestHelper
import com.reandroid.app.AndroidManifest
import com.reandroid.archive.ZipEntryMap
import com.reandroid.arsc.chunk.TableBlock
import com.reandroid.arsc.chunk.xml.ResXmlAttribute
import com.reandroid.arsc.chunk.xml.ResXmlElement
import com.reandroid.arsc.container.SpecTypePair
import com.reandroid.arsc.model.ResourceEntry
import com.reandroid.arsc.value.ResValue
import com.reandroid.arsc.value.ValueType
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import me.zhanghai.android.files.appmanager.AppModel
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.escapeShellArg
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileInputStream
import java.io.FileOutputStream
import java.io.IOException
import java.util.UUID
import java.util.zip.ZipFile

object AntiSplitEngine {

    data class AntiSplitOptions(
        val autoSign: Boolean = true,
        val extractNativeLibs: Boolean = true,
        val signingScheme: ApkSignerHelper.SignScheme = ApkSignerHelper.SignScheme.V1_AND_V2
    )

    /**
     * Merges a split archive (.apks, .xapk, .apkm, or .zip) into a single standalone .apk.
     */
    suspend fun mergeArchive(
        context: Context,
        archiveFile: File,
        outputFile: File,
        options: AntiSplitOptions = AntiSplitOptions(),
        logger: ((String) -> Unit)? = null
    ): Boolean = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        val tempDir = File(context.cacheDir, "antisplit_" + UUID.randomUUID())
        try {
            if (!tempDir.exists() && !tempDir.mkdirs()) {
                logger?.invoke("Error: no se pudo crear el directorio temporal")
                return@withContext false
            }

            logger?.invoke("Extrayendo partes de la aplicación...")
            var extractedCount = 0
            ZipFile(archiveFile).use { zip ->
                val entries = zip.entries()
                while (entries.hasMoreElements()) {
                    val entry = entries.nextElement()
                    if (!entry.isDirectory && entry.name.endsWith(".apk", ignoreCase = true)) {
                        val simpleName = File(entry.name).name
                        val targetApk = File(tempDir, simpleName)
                        zip.getInputStream(entry).use { input ->
                            FileOutputStream(targetApk).use { output ->
                                input.copyTo(output)
                            }
                        }
                        extractedCount++
                    }
                }
            }

            if (extractedCount == 0) {
                logger?.invoke("Error: no se encontraron archivos .apk dentro del paquete")
                return@withContext false
            }

            logger?.invoke("Se encontraron $extractedCount partes. Iniciando fusión...")
            return@withContext mergeDirectory(tempDir, outputFile, options, logger)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
            logger?.invoke("Fallo en AntiSplit: ${e.message}")
            return@withContext false
        } finally {
            deleteRecursively(tempDir)
        }
    }

    /**
     * Merges a list of split .apk files into a single standalone .apk.
     */
    suspend fun mergeFiles(
        context: Context,
        apkFiles: List<File>,
        outputFile: File,
        options: AntiSplitOptions = AntiSplitOptions(),
        logger: ((String) -> Unit)? = null
    ): Boolean = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        val tempDir = File(context.cacheDir, "antisplit_" + UUID.randomUUID())
        try {
            if (!tempDir.exists() && !tempDir.mkdirs()) {
                logger?.invoke("Error: no se pudo crear el directorio temporal")
                return@withContext false
            }

            logger?.invoke("Copiando partes para fusión...")
            for (file in apkFiles) {
                if (file.exists() && file.isFile && file.name.endsWith(".apk", ignoreCase = true)) {
                    val target = File(tempDir, file.name)
                    FileInputStream(file).use { input ->
                        FileOutputStream(target).use { output ->
                            input.copyTo(output)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            return@withContext mergeDirectory(tempDir, outputFile, options, logger)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
            logger?.invoke("Fallo en AntiSplit: ${e.message}")
            return@withContext false
        } finally {
            deleteRecursively(tempDir)
        }
    }

    /**
     * Merges an installed split application into a single standalone .apk.
     */
    suspend fun mergeInstalledApp(
        context: Context,
        app: AppModel,
        outputFile: File,
        options: AntiSplitOptions = AntiSplitOptions(),
        logger: ((String) -> Unit)? = null
    ): Boolean = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        val tempDir = File(context.cacheDir, "antisplit_" + UUID.randomUUID())
        try {
            if (!tempDir.exists() && !tempDir.mkdirs()) {
                logger?.invoke("Error: no se pudo crear el directorio temporal")
                return@withContext false
            }

            logger?.invoke("Extrayendo archivos base y complementos...")
            val baseFile = File(app.sourceDir)
            if (baseFile.canRead()) {
                val targetBase = File(tempDir, "base.apk")
                FileInputStream(baseFile).use { input ->
                    FileOutputStream(targetBase).use { output ->
                        input.copyTo(output)
                    }
                }
            } else if (ApkInstallHelper.isRootAvailable()) {
                val targetBase = File(tempDir, "base.apk")
                com.topjohnwu.superuser.Shell.cmd("cp ${app.sourceDir.escapeShellArg()} ${targetBase.absolutePath.escapeShellArg()} && chmod 644 ${targetBase.absolutePath.escapeShellArg()}").exec()
            }

            for (splitPath in app.splitSourceDirs) {
                val splitFile = File(splitPath)
                val targetSplit = File(tempDir, splitFile.name)
                if (splitFile.canRead()) {
                    FileInputStream(splitFile).use { input ->
                        FileOutputStream(targetSplit).use { output ->
                            input.copyTo(output)
                        }
                    }
                } else if (ApkInstallHelper.isRootAvailable()) {
                    com.topjohnwu.superuser.Shell.cmd("cp ${splitPath.escapeShellArg()} ${targetSplit.absolutePath.escapeShellArg()} && chmod 644 ${targetSplit.absolutePath.escapeShellArg()}").exec()
                }
            }

            return@withContext mergeDirectory(tempDir, outputFile, options, logger)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
            logger?.invoke("Fallo en AntiSplit: ${e.message}")
            return@withContext false
        } finally {
            deleteRecursively(tempDir)
        }
    }

    /**
     * Core merge execution using REAndroid on a prepared directory containing .apk files.
     */
    fun mergeDirectory(
        tempDir: File,
        outputFile: File,
        options: AntiSplitOptions = AntiSplitOptions(),
        logger: ((String) -> Unit)? = null
    ): Boolean {
        val apks = tempDir.listFiles { _, name -> name.endsWith(".apk", ignoreCase = true) }
        if (apks.isNullOrEmpty()) {
            logger?.invoke("No se encontraron APKs válidas para fusionar")
            return false
        }

        logger?.invoke("Analizando ${apks.size} módulos...")
        val unsignedApk = File(tempDir, "temp_merged_unsigned.apk")

        try {
            ApkBundle().use { bundle ->
                if (logger != null) {
                    bundle.setAPKLogger(object : APKLogger {
                        override fun logMessage(msg: String?) {
                            if (!msg.isNullOrBlank()) logger.invoke(msg)
                        }
                        override fun logError(msg: String?, tr: Throwable?) {
                            if (!msg.isNullOrBlank()) logger.invoke("Error: $msg")
                        }
                        override fun logVerbose(msg: String?) {}
                    })
                }

                bundle.loadApkDirectory(tempDir, false)

                logger?.invoke("Fusionando recursos, dex y librerías...")
                val mergedModule: ApkModule = bundle.mergeModules(false)

                logger?.invoke("Saneando AndroidManifest...")
                sanitizeManifest(mergedModule)

                try {
                    mergedModule.setExtractNativeLibs(options.extractNativeLibs)
                } catch (ignored: Exception) {}

                mergedModule.refreshTable()
                mergedModule.refreshManifest()

                logger?.invoke("Generando archivo APK consolidado...")
                mergedModule.writeApk(unsignedApk)
            }

            if (!unsignedApk.exists() || unsignedApk.length() == 0L) {
                logger?.invoke("Error: el archivo APK generado está vacío")
                return false
            }

            if (options.autoSign) {
                logger?.invoke("Firmando digitalmente (V1 + V2 + V3)...")
                val parent = outputFile.parentFile
                if (parent != null && !parent.exists()) parent.mkdirs()
                ApkSignerHelper.signFileDirect(unsignedApk, outputFile, options.signingScheme)
            } else {
                val parent = outputFile.parentFile
                if (parent != null && !parent.exists()) parent.mkdirs()
                unsignedApk.copyTo(outputFile, overwrite = true)
            }

            logger?.invoke("Fusión completada con éxito.")
            return outputFile.exists() && outputFile.length() > 0L
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
            logger?.invoke("Excepción durante la fusión: ${e.message}")
            return false
        }
    }

    /**
     * Sanitizes AndroidManifest to convert split APK definition into a standalone monolithic APK.
     */
    fun sanitizeManifest(apkModule: ApkModule) {
        if (!apkModule.hasAndroidManifest()) return
        val manifest = apkModule.androidManifest ?: return

        try {
            AndroidManifestHelper.removeAttributeFromManifestById(
                manifest, AndroidManifest.ID_requiredSplitTypes, null
            )
            AndroidManifestHelper.removeAttributeFromManifestById(
                manifest, AndroidManifest.ID_splitTypes, null
            )
            AndroidManifestHelper.removeAttributeFromManifestByName(
                manifest, AndroidManifest.NAME_splitTypes, null
            )
            AndroidManifestHelper.removeAttributeFromManifestByName(
                manifest, AndroidManifest.NAME_requiredSplitTypes, null
            )
            AndroidManifestHelper.removeAttributeFromManifestByName(
                manifest, AndroidManifest.NAME_splitTypes, null
            )
            AndroidManifestHelper.removeAttributeFromManifestAndApplication(
                manifest, AndroidManifest.ID_extractNativeLibs, null, AndroidManifest.NAME_extractNativeLibs
            )
            AndroidManifestHelper.removeAttributeFromManifestAndApplication(
                manifest, AndroidManifest.ID_isSplitRequired, null, AndroidManifest.NAME_isSplitRequired
            )

            val application: ResXmlElement? = manifest.applicationElement
            if (application != null) {
                val splitMetaDataElements = AndroidManifestHelper.listSplitRequired(application)
                var splitsRemoved = false
                for (meta in splitMetaDataElements) {
                    if (!splitsRemoved) {
                        splitsRemoved = removeSplitsTableEntry(meta, apkModule)
                    }
                    application.remove(meta)
                }
            }
            manifest.refresh()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
        }
    }

    private fun removeSplitsTableEntry(metaElement: ResXmlElement, apkModule: ApkModule): Boolean {
        try {
            val nameAttribute: ResXmlAttribute? = metaElement.searchAttributeByResourceId(AndroidManifest.ID_name)
            if (nameAttribute?.valueAsString != "com.android.vending.splits") {
                return false
            }
            val valueAttribute: ResXmlAttribute? =
                metaElement.searchAttributeByResourceId(AndroidManifest.ID_value)
                    ?: metaElement.searchAttributeByResourceId(AndroidManifest.ID_resource)
            if (valueAttribute == null || valueAttribute.valueType != ValueType.REFERENCE) {
                return false
            }
            if (!apkModule.hasTableBlock()) {
                return false
            }
            val tableBlock: TableBlock = apkModule.tableBlock ?: return false
            val resourceEntry: ResourceEntry = tableBlock.getResource(valueAttribute.data) ?: return false
            val zipEntryMap: ZipEntryMap = apkModule.zipEntryMap ?: return false
            for (entry in resourceEntry) {
                if (entry == null) continue
                val resValue: ResValue = entry.resValue ?: continue
                val path = resValue.valueAsString
                if (path != null) {
                    zipEntryMap.remove(path)
                }
                entry.isNull = true
                val specTypePair: SpecTypePair = entry.typeBlock.parentSpecTypePair
                specTypePair.removeNullEntries(entry.id)
            }
            return true
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            return false
        }
    }

    private fun deleteRecursively(file: File) {
        if (file.isDirectory) {
            file.listFiles()?.forEach { deleteRecursively(it) }
        }
        file.delete()
    }
}
```

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import android.content.Context
import android.os.Build
import com.topjohnwu.superuser.Shell
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.FileItem
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.common.newInputStream
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.linux.isLinuxPath
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.root.LibSuFileServiceLauncher
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.root.ShizukuManager
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.root.ShizukuShell
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.escapeShellArg
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileOutputStream

object ApkInstallHelper {

    fun isRootAvailable(): Boolean {
        return try {
            LibSuFileServiceLauncher.isSuAvailable() || (Shell.isAppGrantedRoot() == true)
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            false
        }
    }

    fun isShizukuAvailable(): Boolean {
        return ShizukuManager.ready()
    }

    suspend fun installApkWithRoot(
        context: Context,
        apkFile: File
    ): Pair<Boolean, String> = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        val targetTmpPath = "/data/local/tmp/om_root_install_${System.currentTimeMillis()}.apk"

        val grantPermFlag = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.M) "-g " else ""
        // Flags: -r (replace existing), -d (allow downgrade), -t (allow test packages), -g (grant permissions)
        val installCmd = "pm install -r -d -t $grantPermFlag${targetTmpPath.escapeShellArg()}"

        val commands = listOf(
            "cp ${apkFile.absolutePath.escapeShellArg()} ${targetTmpPath.escapeShellArg()}",
            "chmod 644 ${targetTmpPath.escapeShellArg()}",
            installCmd,
            "STATUS=$?",
            "rm -f ${targetTmpPath.escapeShellArg()}",
            "exit \$STATUS"
        )
        val script = commands.joinToString(" && ")

        val result = try {
            Shell.cmd(script).exec()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            return@withContext false to "Error al ejecutar en shell root: ${e.message}"
        }

        val output = (result.out + result.err).joinToString("\n").trim()
        val isSuccess = (result.isSuccess || result.code == 0) &&
            (output.contains("Success", ignoreCase = true) || !output.contains("Failure", ignoreCase = true))

        if (isSuccess) {
            true to "Instalación completada con éxito"
        } else {
            val errorMsg = if (output.isNotEmpty()) output else "Código de error: ${result.code}"
            false to errorMsg
        }
    }

    suspend fun installWithRoot(
        context: Context,
        file: FileItem
    ): Pair<Boolean, String> = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        val path = file.path
        val tempApkInCache = if (!path.isLinuxPath) {
            val cacheFile = File(context.cacheDir, "temp_install_${System.currentTimeMillis()}.apk")
            try {
                path.newInputStream().use { input ->
                    FileOutputStream(cacheFile).use { output ->
                        input.copyTo(output)
                    }
                }
                cacheFile
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                return@withContext false to "Error al preparar archivo APK: ${e.message}"
            }
        } else {
            null
        }

        val targetFile = tempApkInCache ?: path.toFile()
        val result = installApkWithRoot(context, targetFile)
        tempApkInCache?.delete()
        result
    }

    suspend fun installApkWithShizuku(
        context: Context,
        apkFile: File
    ): Pair<Boolean, String> = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        if (!ShizukuManager.ready()) {
            return@withContext false to "Shizuku no está listo o no tiene permisos concedidos"
        }

        val targetTmpPath = "/data/local/tmp/om_shizuku_install_${System.currentTimeMillis()}.apk"

        val grantPermFlag = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.M) "-g " else ""
        val installCmd = "pm install -r -d -t $grantPermFlag${targetTmpPath.escapeShellArg()}"

        val commands = listOf(
            "cp ${apkFile.absolutePath.escapeShellArg()} ${targetTmpPath.escapeShellArg()}",
            "chmod 644 ${targetTmpPath.escapeShellArg()}",
            installCmd,
            "STATUS=$?",
            "rm -f ${targetTmpPath.escapeShellArg()}",
            "exit \$STATUS"
        )
        val script = commands.joinToString(" && ")

        val result = try {
            ShizukuShell.exec(script, timeoutSeconds = 60)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            return@withContext false to "Error al ejecutar en shell Shizuku: ${e.message}"
        }

        val output = (result.out + "\n" + result.err).trim()
        val isSuccess = (result.isSuccess || result.code == 0) &&
            (output.contains("Success", ignoreCase = true) || !output.contains("Failure", ignoreCase = true))

        if (isSuccess) {
            true to "Instalación con Shizuku completada con éxito"
        } else {
            val errorMsg = if (output.isNotEmpty()) output else "Código de error: ${result.code}"
            false to errorMsg
        }
    }

    suspend fun installWithShizuku(
        context: Context,
        file: FileItem
    ): Pair<Boolean, String> = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        if (!ShizukuManager.ready()) {
            return@withContext false to "Shizuku no está listo o no tiene permisos concedidos"
        }

        val path = file.path
        val tempApkInCache = if (!path.isLinuxPath) {
            val cacheFile = File(context.cacheDir, "temp_shizuku_install_${System.currentTimeMillis()}.apk")
            try {
                path.newInputStream().use { input ->
                    FileOutputStream(cacheFile).use { output ->
                        input.copyTo(output)
                    }
                }
                cacheFile
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                return@withContext false to "Error al preparar archivo APK: ${e.message}"
            }
        } else {
            null
        }

        val targetFile = tempApkInCache ?: path.toFile()
        val result = installApkWithShizuku(context, targetFile)
        tempApkInCache?.delete()
        result
    }
}
```

```kt
        if (uri != null) {

                    val bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeByteArray(bytes, 0, bytes.size)

                    cbExtractNativeLibs.isChecked = info.isExtractNativeLibs ?: true

                e.printStackTrace()

                    progressBar.isVisible = false
                    if (!isAdded) return@withContext
                    Toast.makeText(context, "Error al analizar manifiesto del APK: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                    try { dismissAllowingStateLoss() } catch (ignored: Exception) {}
                }
            } finally {
                if (!file.path.isLinuxPath && localApk.exists()) {
                    localApk.delete()
                }
            }
        }

            .setView(view)
            .setPositiveButton(android.R.string.ok, null)
            .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)

                val targetSdkRaw = actvTargetSdk.text?.toString()?.takeWhile { it.isDigit() }?.toIntOrNull()

                val selectedLocText = actvInstallLocation.text?.toString()
                val selectedLoc = installLocationMap.find { it.second == selectedLocText }?.first ?: -1

                val autoSign = cbAutoSign.isChecked

                    .setMessage(R.string.apk_quick_edit_saving)
                    .setCancelable(false)
                    .create()
                savingDialog.show()

                lifecycleScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
                    var tempInputFile: File? = null
                    try {
                        val inputApk: File = if (file.path.isLinuxPath) {
                            file.path.toFile()
                        } else {
                            val tmp = File(context.cacheDir, "qe_in_${System.currentTimeMillis()}_${file.name}")
                            file.path.newInputStream().use { inp ->
                                FileOutputStream(tmp).use { out -> inp.copyTo(out) }
                            }
                            tempInputFile = tmp
                            tmp
                        }

                        val baseName = file.name.removeSuffix(".apk")
                        val parentDir = if (file.path.isLinuxPath) {
                            file.path.toFile().parentFile ?: context.cacheDir
                        } else {
                            context.cacheDir
                        }

                        var outputApk = File(parentDir, "${baseName}_edited.apk")
                        var counter = 1
                        while (outputApk.exists()) {
                            outputApk = File(parentDir, "${baseName}_edited_$counter.apk")
                            counter++
                        }

                        val options = ApkQuickEditEngine.QuickEditOptions(
                            appName = newAppName,
                            packageName = newPackage.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() },
                            versionCode = newVerCode,
                            versionName = newVerName,
                            minSdkVersion = minSdkRaw,
                            targetSdkVersion = targetSdkRaw,
                            installLocation = selectedLoc,
                            newIconBytes = selectedIconBytes,
                            debuggable = cbDebuggable.isChecked,
                            extractNativeLibs = cbExtractNativeLibs.isChecked,
                            autoSign = autoSign,
                            signingScheme = ApkSignerHelper.SignScheme.V1_AND_V2
                        )

                        ApkQuickEditEngine.applyQuickEdit(inputApk, outputApk, options) { progress ->
                            lifecycleScope.launch(Dispatchers.Main) {
                                savingDialog.setMessage(progress)
                            }
                        }

                        withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                            try { if (savingDialog.isShowing) savingDialog.dismiss() } catch (ignored: Exception) {}
                            try { alertDialog.dismiss() } catch (ignored: Exception) {}

                            (activity as? FileListActivity)?.activeFragment?.reload()

                            val rootLayout = activity?.findViewById<View>(android.R.id.content)
                            if (rootLayout != null) {
                                val snackbar = Snackbar.make(
                                    rootLayout,
                                    context.getString(R.string.apk_quick_edit_success, outputApk.name),
                                    Snackbar.LENGTH_LONG
                                )
                                snackbar.setAction(R.string.install) {
                                    (activity as? FileListActivity)?.activeFragment?.installApkFile(outputApk)
                                }
                                snackbar.show()
                            } else {
                                Toast.makeText(
                                    context,
                                    context.getString(R.string.apk_quick_edit_success, outputApk.name),
                                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                                ).show()
                            }
                        }
                    } catch (e: Exception) {
                        e.printStackTrace()
                        me.zhanghai.android.files.app.CrashHandler.logHandledException(e, "ApkQuickEdit")
                        withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                            try { if (savingDialog.isShowing) savingDialog.dismiss() } catch (ignored: Exception) {}
                            Toast.makeText(
                                context,
                                context.getString(R.string.apk_quick_edit_error, e.message ?: e.javaClass.simpleName),
                                Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                            ).show()
                        }
                    } finally {
                        tempInputFile?.delete()
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return alertDialog
    }

    @Parcelize
    class Args(val file: FileItem) : ParcelableArgs

    companion object {

            val fm = try {
                fragment.parentFragmentManager
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                fragment.childFragmentManager
            }
            ApkQuickEditDialogFragment().putArgs(Args(file)).show(fm, "ApkQuickEditDialogFragment")
        }

        fun show(file: FileItem, activity: FragmentActivity) {
            ApkQuickEditDialogFragment().putArgs(Args(file)).show(activity.supportFragmentManager, "ApkQuickEditDialogFragment")
        }
    }
```

`app/src/main/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/filelist/ApkQuickEditEngine.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import com.reandroid.apk.ApkModule
import com.reandroid.archive.ByteInputSource
import com.reandroid.arsc.chunk.xml.AndroidManifestBlock
import com.reandroid.arsc.value.ValueType
import java.io.File

object ApkQuickEditEngine {

    const val ATTR_INSTALL_LOCATION = 0x010102b7

    data class QuickEditInfo(
        val appName: String,
        val packageName: String,
        val versionCode: Int,
        val versionName: String,
        val minSdkVersion: Int,
        val targetSdkVersion: Int,
        val installLocation: Int?,
        val iconResourceId: Int = 0,
        val isDebuggable: Boolean = false,
        val isExtractNativeLibs: Boolean? = null
    )

    data class QuickEditOptions(
        val appName: String? = null,
        val packageName: String? = null,
        val versionCode: Int? = null,
        val versionName: String? = null,
        val minSdkVersion: Int? = null,
        val targetSdkVersion: Int? = null,
        val installLocation: Int? = null,
        val newIconBytes: ByteArray? = null,
        val debuggable: Boolean? = null,
        val extractNativeLibs: Boolean? = null,
        val autoSign: Boolean = true,
        val signingScheme: ApkSignerHelper.SignScheme = ApkSignerHelper.SignScheme.V1_AND_V2
    )

    @Throws(Exception::class)
    fun loadQuickEditInfo(apkFile: File): QuickEditInfo {
        ApkModule.loadApkFile(apkFile).use { module ->
            val manifest = module.androidManifest
                ?: throw IllegalStateException("No se pudo cargar el AndroidManifest.xml del APK")

            var appName = manifest.applicationLabelString ?: ""
            if (appName.isEmpty()) {
                val labelRef = manifest.applicationLabelReference
                if (labelRef != null && labelRef != 0 && module.hasTableBlock()) {
                    try {
                        val table = module.tableBlock
                        val res = table.getResource(labelRef)
                        if (res != null) {
                            appName = res.get()?.valueAsString ?: ""
                        }
                    } catch (ignored: Exception) {}
                }
            }

            val pkgName = try { manifest.packageName ?: "" } catch (e: Exception) { "" }
            val verCode = try { manifest.versionCode ?: 0 } catch (e: Exception) { 0 }
            val verName = try { manifest.versionName ?: "" } catch (e: Exception) { "" }
            val minSdk = try { manifest.minSdkVersion ?: 1 } catch (e: Exception) { 1 }
            val targetSdk = try { manifest.targetSdkVersion ?: 1 } catch (e: Exception) { 1 }

            val installAttr = try { manifest.manifestElement?.searchAttributeByResourceId(ATTR_INSTALL_LOCATION) } catch (e: Exception) { null }
            val installLoc = installAttr?.data

            val iconResId = try { manifest.iconResourceId } catch (e: Exception) { 0 }
            val isDebug = try { manifest.isDebuggable } catch (e: Exception) { false }
            val isExtractNative = try { manifest.isExtractNativeLibs } catch (e: Exception) { null }

            return QuickEditInfo(
                appName = appName,
                packageName = pkgName,
                versionCode = verCode,
                versionName = verName,
                minSdkVersion = minSdk,
                targetSdkVersion = targetSdk,
                installLocation = installLoc,
                iconResourceId = iconResId,
                isDebuggable = isDebug,
                isExtractNativeLibs = isExtractNative
            )
        }
    }

    @Throws(Exception::class)
    fun applyQuickEdit(
        inputApk: File,
        outputApk: File,
        options: QuickEditOptions,
        onProgress: ((String) -> Unit)? = null
    ): File {
        onProgress?.invoke("Cargando APK...")
        val unsignedFile = if (options.autoSign) {
            File(outputApk.parentFile ?: inputApk.parentFile, "${outputApk.nameWithoutExtension}_unsigned.tmp")
        } else {
            outputApk
        }

        try {
            ApkModule.loadApkFile(inputApk).use { module ->
                val manifest = module.androidManifest
                    ?: throw IllegalStateException("AndroidManifest.xml no encontrado en el APK")

                onProgress?.invoke("Actualizando atributos del manifiesto...")
                options.packageName?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }?.let {
                    manifest.packageName = it.trim()
                }
                options.appName?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }?.let {
                    manifest.setApplicationLabel(it.trim())
                }
                options.versionCode?.let {
                    manifest.versionCode = it
                }
                options.versionName?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }?.let {
                    manifest.versionName = it.trim()
                }
                options.minSdkVersion?.let {
                    manifest.minSdkVersion = it
                }
                options.targetSdkVersion?.let {
                    manifest.targetSdkVersion = it
                }

                options.installLocation?.let { loc ->
                    val root = manifest.manifestElement
                    if (loc in 0..2) {
                        val attr = root.getOrCreateAndroidAttribute("installLocation", ATTR_INSTALL_LOCATION)
                        attr.valueType = ValueType.DEC
                        attr.data = loc
                    } else if (loc == -1) {
                        val attr = root.searchAttributeByResourceId(ATTR_INSTALL_LOCATION)
                        attr?.removeSelf()
                    }
                }

                options.debuggable?.let { debug ->
                    try { manifest.isDebuggable = debug } catch (ignored: Exception) {}
                }
                options.extractNativeLibs?.let { extract ->
                    try { manifest.isExtractNativeLibs = extract } catch (ignored: Exception) {}
                }

                // Replace launcher icon if new bytes are provided
                options.newIconBytes?.let { iconBytes ->
                    onProgress?.invoke("Actualizando iconos de la aplicación...")
                    val iconResId = try { manifest.iconResourceId } catch (e: Exception) { 0 }
                    if (iconResId != 0) {
                        try {
                            val resFiles = module.listResFiles(iconResId, null)
                            for (rf in resFiles) {
                                if (!rf.isBinaryXml) {
                                    module.add(ByteInputSource(iconBytes, rf.filePath))
                                }
                            }
                        } catch (e: Exception) {
                            e.printStackTrace()
                        }
                    }
                    val roundIconResId = manifest.roundIconResourceId
                    if (roundIconResId != 0 && roundIconResId != iconResId) {
                        try {
                            val resFiles = module.listResFiles(roundIconResId, null)
                            for (rf in resFiles) {
                                if (!rf.isBinaryXml) {
                                    module.add(ByteInputSource(iconBytes, rf.filePath))
                                }
                            }
                        } catch (e: Exception) {
                            e.printStackTrace()
                        }
                    }
                }

                onProgress?.invoke("Guardando archivo APK modificado...")
                module.writeApk(unsignedFile)
            }

            if (options.autoSign) {
                onProgress?.invoke("Firmando y alineando APK...")
                ApkSignerHelper.signFileDirect(unsignedFile, outputApk, options.signingScheme)
                return outputApk
            } else {
                return unsignedFile
            }
        } finally {
            if (options.autoSign && unsignedFile.exists()) {
                unsignedFile.delete()
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import android.app.Activity

import com.android.apksig.ApkVerifier
import com.google.android.material.dialog.MaterialAlertDialogBuilder
import java.io.File

import java.math.BigInteger
import java.security.KeyPairGenerator
import java.security.KeyStore
import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.security.PrivateKey
import java.security.cert.X509Certificate
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat
import java.util.Date
import java.util.Locale

import java8.nio.file.Path
import java8.nio.file.Paths

import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.common.newOutputStream
import org.bouncycastle.asn1.x500.X500Name
import org.bouncycastle.cert.jcajce.JcaX509CertificateConverter
import org.bouncycastle.cert.jcajce.JcaX509v3CertificateBuilder
import org.bouncycastle.operator.jcajce.JcaContentSignerBuilder

object ApkSignerHelper {

    enum class SignScheme {
        V1_AND_V2,
        V1_ONLY,
        V2_ONLY
    }

    private var cachedKeyPair: Pair<PrivateKey, X509Certificate>? = null

    @Synchronized
    fun getTestKeyPair(): Pair<PrivateKey, X509Certificate> {
        cachedKeyPair?.let { return it }
        val kpg = KeyPairGenerator.getInstance("RSA")
        kpg.initialize(2048)
        val kp = kpg.generateKeyPair()
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        val startDate = Date(now - 86400000L)
        val endDate = Date(now + 30L * 365 * 86400000L)
        val serial = BigInteger.valueOf(now)
        val owner = X500Name("CN=Android,O=Android,C=US")
        val certBuilder = JcaX509v3CertificateBuilder(
            owner, serial, startDate, endDate, owner, kp.public
        )
        val signer = JcaContentSignerBuilder("SHA256withRSA").build(kp.private)
        val certHolder = certBuilder.build(signer)
        val cert = JcaX509CertificateConverter().getCertificate(certHolder)
        val pair = Pair(kp.private, cert)
        cachedKeyPair = pair
        return pair
    }

    fun loadCustomKeystore(
        file: File,
        storePass: String,
        alias: String,
        keyPass: String
    ): Pair<PrivateKey, X509Certificate> {
        val types = mutableListOf<String>()
        if (file.name.endsWith(".p12", true) || file.name.endsWith(".pfx", true)) {
            types.add("PKCS12")
            types.add("JKS")
        } else {
            types.add("PKCS12")
            types.add("JKS")
        }
        types.add("BKS")

        var lastException: Exception? = null
        for (ksType in types.distinct()) {
            try {
                val ks = try {
                    if (ksType == "BKS") {
                        try { KeyStore.getInstance("BKS", "BC") } catch (_: Throwable) { KeyStore.getInstance("BKS") }
                    } else {
                        KeyStore.getInstance(ksType)
                    }
                } catch (_: Throwable) {
                    continue
                }
                FileInputStream(file).use { ks.load(it, storePass.toCharArray()) }
                val privateKey = ks.getKey(alias, keyPass.toCharArray()) as? PrivateKey ?: continue
                val cert = ks.getCertificate(alias) as? X509Certificate ?: continue
                return Pair(privateKey, cert)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                lastException = e
            }
        }
        throw lastException ?: IllegalArgumentException("No se encontró la clave privada o certificado para el alias: $alias")
    }

    fun signFileDirect(
        inputFile: File,
        outputFile: File,
        scheme: SignScheme = SignScheme.V1_AND_V2,
        customKey: Pair<PrivateKey, X509Certificate>? = null
    ) {
        val (privateKey, cert) = customKey ?: getTestKeyPair()
        val signerConfig = ApkSigner.SignerConfig.Builder("CERT", privateKey, listOf(cert)).build()
        val v1 = scheme == SignScheme.V1_AND_V2 || scheme == SignScheme.V1_ONLY
        val v2 = scheme == SignScheme.V1_AND_V2 || scheme == SignScheme.V2_ONLY
        val v3 = scheme == SignScheme.V1_AND_V2
        ApkSigner.Builder(listOf(signerConfig))
            .setInputApk(inputFile)
            .setOutputApk(outputFile)
            .setV1SigningEnabled(v1)
            .setV2SigningEnabled(v2)
            .setV3SigningEnabled(v3)
            .build()
            .sign()
    }

    fun signApk(
        activity: Activity,
        apkPath: Path,
        onComplete: ((Path?) -> Unit)? = null
    ) {
        showSignDialog(activity, apkPath, onComplete)
    }

    /**
     * Shows MT Manager style dialog for signing APK with:
     * 1. 3 signing schemes: V1+V2 (recommended), V1 (JAR), V2 (Android 7.0+)
     * 2. Keystore options: testkey (AOSP) or custom keystore (.jks/.keystore)
     * 3. Output file name and overwrite option
     */
    fun showSignDialog(
        activity: Activity,
        apkPath: Path,
        onComplete: ((Path?) -> Unit)? = null
    ) {
        val context = activity
        val dialog = AppCompatDialog(context)
        dialog.supportRequestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE)
        val view = LayoutInflater.from(context).inflate(R.layout.dialog_mt_sign_apk, null)
        dialog.setContentView(view)

        dialog.window?.apply {
            setBackgroundDrawable(ColorDrawable(Color.TRANSPARENT))
            val displayMetrics = context.resources.displayMetrics
            val targetWidth = (displayMetrics.widthPixels * 0.92).toInt().coerceAtMost(
                (450 * displayMetrics.density).toInt()
            )
            setLayout(targetWidth, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT)
        }

        val fileName = apkPath.fileName.toString()
        val baseName = if (fileName.endsWith(".apk", ignoreCase = true)) {
            fileName.substringBeforeLast(".apk")
        } else {
            fileName
        }
        val defaultTargetFileName = "${baseName}_signed.apk"

        val editOutputName = view.findViewById<EditText>(R.id.editOutputName)
        editOutputName.setText(defaultTargetFileName)

        val rbSchemeV1V2 = view.findViewById<RadioButton>(R.id.rbSchemeV1V2)
        val rbSchemeV1 = view.findViewById<RadioButton>(R.id.rbSchemeV1)
        val rbSchemeV2 = view.findViewById<RadioButton>(R.id.rbSchemeV2)

        val rbKeyTestkey = view.findViewById<RadioButton>(R.id.rbKeyTestkey)
        val rbKeyCustom = view.findViewById<RadioButton>(R.id.rbKeyCustom)
        val layoutCustomKeyOptions = view.findViewById<LinearLayout>(R.id.layoutCustomKeyOptions)

        val editKeystorePath = view.findViewById<EditText>(R.id.editKeystorePath)
        val btnBrowseKeystore = view.findViewById<Button>(R.id.btnBrowseKeystore)
        val editKeystorePass = view.findViewById<EditText>(R.id.editKeystorePass)
        val editKeyAlias = view.findViewById<EditText>(R.id.editKeyAlias)
        val editKeyPass = view.findViewById<EditText>(R.id.editKeyPass)

        val cbOverwrite = view.findViewById<CheckBox>(R.id.cbOverwrite)
        val btnCancelSign = view.findViewById<Button>(R.id.btnCancelSign)
        val btnConfirmSign = view.findViewById<Button>(R.id.btnConfirmSign)

        val rgKeystore = view.findViewById<RadioGroup>(R.id.rgKeystore)
        rgKeystore.setOnCheckedChangeListener { _, checkedId ->
            layoutCustomKeyOptions.visibility = if (checkedId == R.id.rbKeyCustom) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
        }

        cbOverwrite.setOnCheckedChangeListener { _, isChecked ->
            if (isChecked) {
                editOutputName.setText(fileName)
                editOutputName.isEnabled = false
            } else {
                editOutputName.setText(defaultTargetFileName)
                editOutputName.isEnabled = true
            }
        }

        btnBrowseKeystore.setOnClickListener {
            // Prompt to enter path or default common location
            val defaultPath = "/storage/emulated/0/Download"
            if (editKeystorePath.text.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                editKeystorePath.setText("$defaultPath/my-release-key.jks")
            }
            Toast.makeText(context, "Ingresa la ruta absoluta de tu archivo .jks o .keystore", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }

        val btnCreateKeystore = view.findViewById<Button>(R.id.btnCreateKeystore)
        btnCreateKeystore?.setOnClickListener {
            val parentDir = try {
                apkPath.parent?.toFile()?.absolutePath ?: "/storage/emulated/0/Download"
            } catch (_: Exception) {
                "/storage/emulated/0/Download"
            }
            if (activity is androidx.fragment.app.FragmentActivity) {
                KeystoreGeneratorDialogFragment.show(activity, parentDir) { result ->
                    val target = result.jksFile ?: result.bksFile
                    target?.let { editKeystorePath.setText(it.absolutePath) }
                    editKeystorePass.setText(result.storePassword)
                    editKeyAlias.setText(result.alias)
                    editKeyPass.setText(result.keyPassword)
                    rbKeyCustom.isChecked = true
                }
            }
        }

        btnCancelSign.setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
        }

        btnConfirmSign.setOnClickListener {
            val outputName = editOutputName.text.toString().trim()
            if (outputName.isEmpty()) {
                Toast.makeText(context, "Por favor ingresa un nombre válido", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                return@setOnClickListener
            }

            val scheme = when {
                rbSchemeV1.isChecked -> SignScheme.V1_ONLY
                rbSchemeV2.isChecked -> SignScheme.V2_ONLY
                else -> SignScheme.V1_AND_V2
            }

            val useCustomKey = rbKeyCustom.isChecked
            val customKeyPath = editKeystorePath.text.toString().trim()
            val customKeyStorePass = editKeystorePass.text.toString()
            val customKeyAlias = editKeyAlias.text.toString().trim()
            val customKeyPass = editKeyPass.text.toString()

            if (useCustomKey && (customKeyPath.isEmpty() || customKeyAlias.isEmpty())) {
                Toast.makeText(context, "Por favor completa la ruta y alias del KeyStore", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                return@setOnClickListener
            }

            dialog.dismiss()

            signApkInternal(
                activity = activity,
                apkPath = apkPath,
                outputFileName = outputName,
                scheme = scheme,
                useCustomKey = useCustomKey,
                customKeyPath = customKeyPath,
                customKeyStorePass = customKeyStorePass,
                customKeyAlias = customKeyAlias,
                customKeyPass = customKeyPass,
                onComplete = onComplete
            )
        }

        dialog.show()
    }

    private fun signApkInternal(
        activity: Activity,
        apkPath: Path,
        outputFileName: String,
        scheme: SignScheme,
        useCustomKey: Boolean,
        customKeyPath: String,
        customKeyStorePass: String,
        customKeyAlias: String,
        customKeyPass: String,
        onComplete: ((Path?) -> Unit)?
    ) {
        val parentDir = apkPath.parent ?: Paths.get("/storage/emulated/0/Download")
        val targetPath = parentDir.resolve(outputFileName)

        val progressDialog = MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(activity)
            .setTitle("Firmando APK")
            .setMessage("Aplicando esquema de firma ${scheme.name}...\nPor favor espera.")
            .setCancelable(false)
            .show()

        kotlin.concurrent.thread {
            var success = false
            var errorMsg: String? = null
            var tempInFile: File? = null
            var tempOutFile: File? = null

            try {
                // 1. Resolve key pair
                val (privateKey, cert) = if (useCustomKey) {
                    val kf = File(customKeyPath)
                    if (!kf.exists() || !kf.canRead()) {
                        throw IllegalArgumentException("No se puede leer el archivo KeyStore:\n$customKeyPath")
                    }
                    loadCustomKeystore(kf, customKeyStorePass, customKeyAlias, customKeyPass)
                } else {
                    getTestKeyPair()
                }

                // 2. Prepare local files for ApkSigner
                tempInFile = if (apkPath.fileSystem == FileSystems.getDefault()) {
                    File(apkPath.toString())
                } else {
                    val temp = File.createTempFile("apk_in_", ".apk", activity.cacheDir)
                    apkPath.newInputStream().use { ins ->
                        temp.outputStream().use { outs -> ins.copyTo(outs) }
                    }
                    temp
                }

                tempOutFile = File.createTempFile("apk_out_", ".apk", activity.cacheDir)

                // 3. Configure Google ApkSigner
                val signerConfig = ApkSigner.SignerConfig.Builder(
                    "CERT",
                    privateKey,
                    listOf(cert)
                ).build()

                val v1Enabled = (scheme == SignScheme.V1_AND_V2 || scheme == SignScheme.V1_ONLY)
                val v2Enabled = (scheme == SignScheme.V1_AND_V2 || scheme == SignScheme.V2_ONLY)
                val v3Enabled = (scheme == SignScheme.V1_AND_V2)

                val builder = ApkSigner.Builder(listOf(signerConfig))
                    .setInputApk(tempInFile)
                    .setOutputApk(tempOutFile)
                    .setV1SigningEnabled(v1Enabled)
                    .setV2SigningEnabled(v2Enabled)
                    .setV3SigningEnabled(v3Enabled)

                val signer = builder.build()
                signer.sign()

                // 4. Copy output file to destination
                if (targetPath.fileSystem == FileSystems.getDefault()) {
                    val destFile = File(targetPath.toString())
                    tempOutFile.copyTo(destFile, overwrite = true)
                } else {
                    tempOutFile.inputStream().use { ins ->
                        targetPath.newOutputStream().use { outs -> ins.copyTo(outs) }
                    }
                }

                success = true
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                e.printStackTrace()
                errorMsg = e.localizedMessage ?: e.javaClass.simpleName
            } finally {
                if (tempInFile != null && tempInFile != File(apkPath.toString())) {
                    tempInFile.delete()
                }
                tempOutFile?.delete()
            }

            activity.runOnUiThread {
                if (activity.isFinishing || activity.isDestroyed) return@runOnUiThread
                try { progressDialog.dismiss() } catch (ignored: Exception) {}
                if (success) {
                    Toast.makeText(
                        activity,
                        "APK firmado exitosamente (${scheme.name}):\n$outputFileName",
                        Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                    ).show()
                    onComplete?.invoke(targetPath)
                } else {
                    MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(activity)
                        .setTitle("Error al firmar APK")
                        .setMessage(errorMsg ?: "Error desconocido al procesar el archivo")
                        .setPositiveButton("Aceptar", null)
                        .show()
                    onComplete?.invoke(null)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Inspects and verifies the APK signatures (V1, V2, V3) and shows certificate information.
     */
    fun showVerifySignatureDialog(activity: Activity, apkPath: Path) {
        val progressDialog = MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(activity)
            .setTitle("Verificando firma")
            .setMessage("Comprobando firmas V1, V2 y certificados...")
            .setCancelable(false)
            .show()

        kotlin.concurrent.thread {
            var tempFile: File? = null
            var v1Ok = false
            var v2Ok = false
            var v3Ok = false
            var certSummary = "No se encontraron certificados"
            var md5Hex = ""
            var sha1Hex = ""
            var sha256Hex = ""
            var errorMsg: String? = null

            try {
                tempFile = if (apkPath.fileSystem == FileSystems.getDefault()) {
                    File(apkPath.toString())
                } else {
                    val temp = File.createTempFile("verify_", ".apk", activity.cacheDir)
                    apkPath.newInputStream().use { ins ->
                        temp.outputStream().use { outs -> ins.copyTo(outs) }
                    }
                    temp
                }

                val verifier = ApkVerifier.Builder(tempFile).build()
                val result = verifier.verify()
                v1Ok = result.isVerifiedUsingV1Scheme
                v2Ok = result.isVerifiedUsingV2Scheme
                v3Ok = result.isVerifiedUsingV3Scheme

                val certs = result.signerCertificates
                if (certs.isNotEmpty()) {
                    val c = certs[0]
                    val df = SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss", Locale.getDefault())
                    val sb = StringBuilder()
                    sb.append("Sujeto: ").append(c.subjectX500Principal.name).append("\n")
                    sb.append("Emisor: ").append(c.issuerX500Principal.name).append("\n")
                    sb.append("Válido desde: ").append(df.format(c.notBefore)).append("\n")
                    sb.append("Válido hasta: ").append(df.format(c.notAfter)).append("\n")
                    sb.append("Número de serie: ").append(c.serialNumber.toString(16)).append("\n")
                    certSummary = sb.toString()

                    val der = c.encoded
                    md5Hex = MessageDigest.getInstance("MD5").digest(der).joinToString(":") { "%02X".format(it) }
                    sha1Hex = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-1").digest(der).joinToString(":") { "%02X".format(it) }
                    sha256Hex = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(der).joinToString(":") { "%02X".format(it) }
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                e.printStackTrace()
                errorMsg = e.localizedMessage ?: e.javaClass.simpleName
            } finally {
                if (tempFile != null && tempFile != File(apkPath.toString())) {
                    tempFile.delete()
                }
            }

            activity.runOnUiThread {
                if (activity.isFinishing || activity.isDestroyed) return@runOnUiThread
                try { progressDialog.dismiss() } catch (ignored: Exception) {}
                if (errorMsg != null) {
                    MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(activity)
                        .setTitle("Error al verificar firma")
                        .setMessage(errorMsg)
                        .setPositiveButton("Cerrar", null)
                        .show()
                    return@runOnUiThread
                }

                val msg = StringBuilder()
                msg.append("Archivo: ").append(apkPath.fileName).append("\n\n")
                msg.append("• Esquema V1 (JAR): ").append(if (v1Ok) "✓ Válido" else "✗ No presente / Inválido").append("\n")
                msg.append("• Esquema V2 (Android 7.0+): ").append(if (v2Ok) "✓ Válido" else "✗ No presente / Inválido").append("\n")
                msg.append("• Esquema V3 (Android 9.0+): ").append(if (v3Ok) "✓ Válido" else "✗ No presente / Inválido").append("\n\n")
                msg.append("Información del Certificado:\n")
                msg.append(certSummary).append("\n")
                if (sha256Hex.isNotEmpty()) {
                    msg.append("MD5:\n").append(md5Hex).append("\n\n")
                    msg.append("SHA-1:\n").append(sha1Hex).append("\n\n")
                    msg.append("SHA-256:\n").append(sha256Hex)
                }

                val fullText = msg.toString()
                MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(activity)
                    .setTitle("Verificación de Firma")
                    .setMessage(fullText)
                    .setPositiveButton("Aceptar", null)
                    .setNeutralButton("Copiar") { _, _ ->
                        val cb = activity.getSystemService(Context.CLIPBOARD_SERVICE) as ClipboardManager
                        cb.setPrimaryClip(ClipData.newPlainText("Firma APK", fullText))
                        Toast.makeText(activity, "Información copiada al portapapeles", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    }
                    .show()
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import java.io.File

/**
 * Standalone Android command-line interface (CLI) entry point for Apktool.
 * Can be invoked directly via `/system/bin/app_process` in OpenManager's terminal,
 * Termex, or any unprivileged/privileged Android shell session:
 *
 * `app_process -Djava.class.path=base.apk /system/bin me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist.ApktoolCli "$@"`
 */
object ApktoolCli {

    @JvmStatic
    fun main(args: Array<String>) {
        if (args.isEmpty() || args[0] in listOf("-h", "--help", "help", "?")) {
            printHelp()
            return
        }

        val command = args[0].lowercase()
        val restArgs = args.sliceArray(1 until args.size)

        try {
            when (command) {
                "-v", "--version", "version", "v" -> {
                    printVersion()
                }
                "d", "decode" -> {
                    runDecode(restArgs)
                }
                "b", "build" -> {
                    runBuild(restArgs)
                }
                "s", "sign" -> {
                    runSign(restArgs)
                }
                else -> {
                    System.err.println("Error: Unknown command '$command'")
                    printHelp()
                    System.exit(1)
                }
            }
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            System.err.println("E: Apktool operation failed: ${t.message ?: t.javaClass.simpleName}")
            t.printStackTrace()
            System.exit(1)
        }
    }

    private fun printVersion() {
        println("OpenManager Apktool v${ApktoolEngine.VERSION} (Android ART Native Edition)")
        println("Smali & Baksmali v3.0.9, Dexlib2 API 34 resilient engine")
        println("AXML 32-bit Architecture Support (ARM64-v8a / ARMv7 / x86_64)")
    }

    private fun printHelp() {
        println("""
            OpenManager Apktool v${ApktoolEngine.VERSION} - Android ART Native Reverse Engineering CLI
            Usage: apktool <command> [options] <file_or_dir>

            Commands:
              d, decode <file.apk>      Decode APK to directory
              b, build <dir>            Build APK package from decoded directory
              s, sign <file.apk>        Sign APK with testkey or custom keystore
              v, version                Show Apktool version information
              h, help                   Show this help message

            Decode options:
              -o, --output <dir>        Output directory for decoded project
              -f, --force               Force overwrite existing output directory
              -s, --no-src              Do not disassemble DEX bytecode into smali
              -r, --no-res              Do not decode binary XML resources

            Build options:
              -o, --output <file.apk>   Output path for built APK
              -f, --force               Force overwrite existing APK file
              -s, --sign                Sign the APK automatically after building

            Sign options:
              -o, --output <file.apk>   Output path for signed APK
              -k, --keystore <file>     Path to custom KeyStore file (default: testkey)
              -p, --pass <password>     Password for KeyStore and key
              -a, --alias <name>        Key alias

            Examples:
              apktool d /sdcard/app.apk -o /sdcard/app_src
              apktool b /sdcard/app_src -o /sdcard/rebuilt.apk --sign
              apktool sign /sdcard/rebuilt.apk -o /sdcard/rebuilt_signed.apk
        """.trimIndent())
    }

    private fun runDecode(args: Array<String>) {
        var inputPath: String? = null
        var outputPath: String? = null
        var force = false
        var noSrc = false
        var noRes = false

        var i = 0
        while (i < args.size) {
            when (val arg = args[i]) {
                "-o", "--output" -> {
                    if (i + 1 < args.size) {
                        outputPath = args[++i]
                    } else {
                        System.err.println("E: Missing value for $arg")
                        System.exit(1)
                    }
                }
                "-f", "--force" -> force = true
                "-s", "--no-src" -> noSrc = true
                "-r", "--no-res" -> noRes = true
                else -> {
                    if (arg.startsWith("-")) {
                        System.err.println("W: Unknown decode option: $arg")
                    } else if (inputPath == null) {
                        inputPath = arg
                    }
                }
            }
            i++
        }

        if (inputPath == null) {
            System.err.println("E: Input APK file not specified.")
            println("Usage: apktool d <file.apk> [-o <out_dir>] [-f] [-s] [-r]")
            System.exit(1)
        }

        val apkFile = File(inputPath)
        if (!apkFile.exists()) {
            System.err.println("E: File not found: ${apkFile.absolutePath}")
            System.exit(1)
        }

        val outDir = if (outputPath != null) {
            File(outputPath)
        } else {
            val baseName = apkFile.name.removeSuffix(".apk")
            File(apkFile.parentFile ?: File("."), baseName)
        }

        val options = ApktoolEngine.DecompileOptions(
            disassembleDex = !noSrc,
            decodeResources = !noRes,
            forceOverwrite = force
        )

        val listener = object : ApktoolEngine.ApktoolListener {
            override fun onProgress(message: String, detail: String, percentage: Int) {
                if (percentage >= 0) {
                    print("\rI: $message ($percentage%)  ")
                }
            }
            override fun onLog(message: String) {
                println("\n$message")
            }
        }

        val startTime = System.currentTimeMillis()
        ApktoolEngine.decompileApk(
            inputApk = apkFile,
            outputDir = outDir,
            options = options,
            listener = listener
        )
        val elapsed = System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime
        println("\nI: Decode finished in ${elapsed}ms -> ${outDir.absolutePath}")
    }

    private fun runBuild(args: Array<String>) {
        var inputPath: String? = null
        var outputPath: String? = null
        var force = false
        var signAfter = false

        var i = 0
        while (i < args.size) {
            when (val arg = args[i]) {
                "-o", "--output" -> {
                    if (i + 1 < args.size) {
                        outputPath = args[++i]
                    } else {
                        System.err.println("E: Missing value for $arg")
                        System.exit(1)
                    }
                }
                "-f", "--force" -> force = true
                "-s", "--sign" -> signAfter = true
                else -> {
                    if (arg.startsWith("-")) {
                        System.err.println("W: Unknown build option: $arg")
                    } else if (inputPath == null) {
                        inputPath = arg
                    }
                }
            }
            i++
        }

        if (inputPath == null) {
            System.err.println("E: Project directory not specified.")
            println("Usage: apktool b <dir> [-o <out.apk>] [-f] [-s]")
            System.exit(1)
        }

        val projectDir = File(inputPath)
        if (!projectDir.exists() || !projectDir.isDirectory) {
            System.err.println("E: Directory not found: ${projectDir.absolutePath}")
            System.exit(1)
        }

        val outApk = if (outputPath != null) {
            File(outputPath)
        } else {
            val distDir = File(projectDir, "dist").apply { mkdirs() }
            File(distDir, "${projectDir.name}.apk")
        }

        val options = ApktoolEngine.RecompileOptions(
            forceOverwrite = force,
            signAfterBuild = signAfter
        )

        val listener = object : ApktoolEngine.ApktoolListener {
            override fun onProgress(message: String, detail: String, percentage: Int) {
                if (percentage >= 0) {
                    print("\rI: $message ($percentage%)  ")
                }
            }
            override fun onLog(message: String) {
                println("\n$message")
            }
        }

        val startTime = System.currentTimeMillis()
        ApktoolEngine.recompileApk(
            projectDir = projectDir,
            outputApk = outApk,
            options = options,
            listener = listener
        )
        val elapsed = System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime
        println("\nI: Build finished in ${elapsed}ms -> ${outApk.absolutePath}")

        if (signAfter) {
            println("I: Signing built APK with testkey...")
            val signedApk = if (outApk.name.endsWith(".apk")) {
                File(outApk.parentFile, "${outApk.name.removeSuffix(".apk")}_signed.apk")
            } else {
                File(outApk.parentFile, "${outApk.name}_signed.apk")
            }
            runSignDirect(outApk, signedApk)
        }
    }

    private fun runSign(args: Array<String>) {
        var inputPath: String? = null
        var outputPath: String? = null

        var i = 0
        while (i < args.size) {
            when (val arg = args[i]) {
                "-o", "--output" -> {
                    if (i + 1 < args.size) {
                        outputPath = args[++i]
                    } else {
                        System.err.println("E: Missing value for $arg")
                        System.exit(1)
                    }
                }
                else -> {
                    if (arg.startsWith("-")) {
                        System.err.println("W: Unknown sign option: $arg")
                    } else if (inputPath == null) {
                        inputPath = arg
                    }
                }
            }
            i++
        }

        if (inputPath == null) {
            System.err.println("E: Input APK not specified.")
            println("Usage: apktool sign <file.apk> [-o <out.apk>]")
            System.exit(1)
        }

        val inFile = File(inputPath)
        if (!inFile.exists()) {
            System.err.println("E: File not found: ${inFile.absolutePath}")
            System.exit(1)
        }

        val outFile = if (outputPath != null) {
            File(outputPath)
        } else {
            val base = inFile.name.removeSuffix(".apk")
            File(inFile.parentFile ?: File("."), "${base}_signed.apk")
        }

        runSignDirect(inFile, outFile)
    }

    private fun runSignDirect(inFile: File, outFile: File) {
        try {
            val (privateKey, cert) = ApkSignerHelper.getTestKeyPair()
            val signerConfig = com.android.apksig.ApkSigner.SignerConfig.Builder(
                "CERT",
                privateKey,
                listOf(cert)
            ).build()

            val tempOut = File.createTempFile("apk_cli_signed_", ".apk")
            val builder = com.android.apksig.ApkSigner.Builder(listOf(signerConfig))
                .setInputApk(inFile)
                .setOutputApk(tempOut)
                .setV1SigningEnabled(true)
                .setV2SigningEnabled(true)
                .setV3SigningEnabled(true)

            val signer = builder.build()
            signer.sign()

            outFile.parentFile?.mkdirs()
            tempOut.copyTo(outFile, overwrite = true)
            tempOut.delete()

            println("I: Successfully signed: ${outFile.absolutePath}")
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            System.err.println("E: Failed to sign APK: ${t.message}")
            t.printStackTrace()
            System.exit(1)
        }
    }
}
```
