`app/src/main/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/filelist/ApktoolEngine.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import com.android.tools.smali.baksmali.Adaptors.ClassDefinition
import com.android.tools.smali.baksmali.BaksmaliOptions
import com.android.tools.smali.baksmali.formatter.BaksmaliWriter
import com.android.tools.smali.dexlib2.DexFileFactory
import com.android.tools.smali.dexlib2.Opcodes
import com.android.tools.smali.dexlib2.dexbacked.DexBackedDexFile
import com.android.tools.smali.smali.Smali
import com.android.tools.smali.smali.SmaliOptions
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.AxmlDecoder
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.AxmlEngine
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileInputStream
import java.io.FileOutputStream
import java.io.StringWriter
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets
import java.util.zip.CRC32
import java.util.zip.ZipEntry
import java.util.zip.ZipInputStream
import java.util.zip.ZipOutputStream

/**
 * Resilient, multi-platform Apktool engine for Android.
 * Runs seamlessly both in-process (via ApktoolExecutionService) and standalone (via ApktoolCli / app_process).
 */
object ApktoolEngine {

    const val VERSION = "2.9.3"

    data class DecompileOptions(
        val disassembleDex: Boolean = true,
        val decodeResources: Boolean = true,
        val forceOverwrite: Boolean = false,
        val apiLevel: Int = 34
    )

    data class RecompileOptions(
        val forceOverwrite: Boolean = false,
        val signAfterBuild: Boolean = false,
        val apiLevel: Int = 34
    )

    interface ApktoolListener {
        fun onProgress(message: String, detail: String, percentage: Int)
        fun onLog(message: String)
    }

    /**
     * Resolves the highest supported Opcodes instance without throwing UnsupportedOperationException on modern DEX versions.
     */
    fun getSafeOpcodes(preferredApi: Int = 34): Opcodes {
        val candidateApis = intArrayOf(preferredApi, 34, 30, 28, 26, 21, 19)
        for (api in candidateApis) {
            try {
                return Opcodes.forApi(api)
            } catch (_: Throwable) {}
        }
        return try {
            Opcodes.getDefault()
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            Opcodes.forApi(20)
        }
    }

    /**
     * Safely loads a DEX file using descending API levels (34 down to 19) to guarantee
     * compatibility with all DEX versions (DEX 035 up to 040+).
     */
    fun loadDexSafely(dexFile: File): DexBackedDexFile {
        val apisToTry = intArrayOf(34, 33, 30, 28, 26, 24, 21, 19)
        for (api in apisToTry) {
            try {
                return DexFileFactory.loadDexFile(dexFile, Opcodes.forApi(api))
            } catch (_: Throwable) {}
        }
        return DexFileFactory.loadDexFile(dexFile, Opcodes.getDefault())
    }

    /**
     * Decompiles an APK archive into a structured project directory:
     * - AndroidManifest.xml (decoded text + .orig binary)
     * - res/ (decoded binary XMLs + .orig binaries, raw assets)
     * - classes*.dex -> smali/, smali_classes2/, etc.
     * - apktool.yml metadata
     */
    fun decompileApk(
        inputApk: File,
        outputDir: File,
        options: DecompileOptions = DecompileOptions(),
        isCancelled: () -> Boolean = { false },
        listener: ApktoolListener? = null
    ) {
        if (!inputApk.exists()) {
            throw IllegalArgumentException("Input APK file not found: ${inputApk.absolutePath}")
        }

        if (outputDir.exists() && options.forceOverwrite) {
            outputDir.deleteRecursively()
        }
        outputDir.mkdirs()
        val canonicalProjectDir = outputDir.canonicalPath + File.separator

        listener?.onLog("I: Using Apktool $VERSION on ${inputApk.name}")
        listener?.onProgress("Contando archivos del APK...", "", -1)

        // Count total entries for progress calculation
        var totalEntries = 0
        try {
            FileInputStream(inputApk).use { inStream ->
                ZipInputStream(inStream).use { zipIn ->
                    while (zipIn.nextEntry != null) {
                        totalEntries++
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (_: Throwable) {}

        if (isCancelled()) throw InterruptedException()

        var currentEntry = 0
        val buffer = ByteArray(65536)

        FileInputStream(inputApk).use { inStream ->
            ZipInputStream(inStream).use { zipIn ->
                var entry = zipIn.nextEntry
                while (entry != null) {
                    if (isCancelled()) throw InterruptedException()

                    currentEntry++
                    val name = entry.name
                    val pct = if (totalEntries > 0) (currentEntry * 100) / totalEntries else -1
                    if (currentEntry % 15 == 0 || currentEntry == totalEntries) {
                        listener?.onProgress("Extrayendo recursos ($pct%)", name, pct)
                    }

                    if (!entry.isDirectory && !name.startsWith("META-INF/")) {
                        try {
                            val targetFile = File(outputDir, name).canonicalFile
                            if (!targetFile.canonicalPath.startsWith(canonicalProjectDir)) {
                                // Defensive Zip Slip protection
                                zipIn.closeEntry()
                                entry = zipIn.nextEntry
                                continue
                            }
                            targetFile.parentFile?.mkdirs()

                            val baos = ByteArrayOutputStream()
                            var bytesRead: Int
                            while (zipIn.read(buffer).also { bytesRead = it } != -1) {
                                if (isCancelled()) throw InterruptedException()
                                baos.write(buffer, 0, bytesRead)
                            }
                            val entryBytes = baos.toByteArray()

                            if (options.decodeResources && name == "AndroidManifest.xml" && AxmlDecoder.isAxml(entryBytes)) {
                                val decoded = try {
                                    AxmlDecoder.decode(entryBytes)
                                } catch (_: Throwable) {
                                    null
                                }
                                if (decoded != null) {
                                    FileOutputStream(targetFile).use { it.write(decoded.toByteArray(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) }
                                    val origFile = File(outputDir, "AndroidManifest.xml.orig")
                                    FileOutputStream(origFile).use { it.write(entryBytes) }
                                } else {
                                    FileOutputStream(targetFile).use { it.write(entryBytes) }
                                }
                            } else if (options.decodeResources && name.startsWith("res/") && name.endsWith(".xml") && AxmlDecoder.isAxml(entryBytes)) {
                                val decoded = try {
                                    AxmlDecoder.decode(entryBytes)
                                } catch (_: Throwable) {
                                    null
                                }
                                if (decoded != null) {
                                    FileOutputStream(targetFile).use { it.write(decoded.toByteArray(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) }
                                    val origFile = File(outputDir, "$name.orig").canonicalFile
                                    if (origFile.canonicalPath.startsWith(canonicalProjectDir)) {
                                        origFile.parentFile?.mkdirs()
                                        FileOutputStream(origFile).use { it.write(entryBytes) }
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    FileOutputStream(targetFile).use { it.write(entryBytes) }
                                }
                            } else {
                                FileOutputStream(targetFile).use { it.write(entryBytes) }
                            }
                        } catch (ie: InterruptedException) {
                            throw ie
                        } catch (entryErr: Throwable) {
                            entryErr.printStackTrace()
                        }
                    }
                    zipIn.closeEntry()
                    entry = zipIn.nextEntry
                }
            }
        }

        if (isCancelled()) throw InterruptedException()

        // Generate apktool.yml metadata
        val yml = """
            version: $VERSION
            apkFileName: ${inputApk.name}
            isFrameworkApk: false
            packageInfo:
              forcedPackageId: '127'
            versionInfo:
              versionCode: '1'
              versionName: '1.0'
            compressionType: false
            doNotCompress:
            - arsc
            - png
            - webp
            - jpg
            - ogg
            - mp3
        """.trimIndent()
        val ymlFile = File(outputDir, "apktool.yml")
        FileOutputStream(ymlFile).use { it.write(yml.toByteArray(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) }

        // Disassemble classes*.dex into smali/ directories if requested
        if (options.disassembleDex) {
            val dexFilesInProject = outputDir.listFiles { f -> f.isFile && f.name.startsWith("classes") && f.name.endsWith(".dex") } ?: emptyArray()
            dexFilesInProject.sortBy { it.name }

            for (dexFile in dexFilesInProject) {
                if (isCancelled()) throw InterruptedException()
                val smaliDirName = if (dexFile.name == "classes.dex") "smali" else "smali_${dexFile.name.removeSuffix(".dex")}"
                val smaliOutDir = File(outputDir, smaliDirName)
                smaliOutDir.mkdirs()

                listener?.onLog("I: Disassembling ${dexFile.name} to $smaliDirName...")
                listener?.onProgress("Desensamblando ${dexFile.name} a smali...", "", -1)

                try {
                    val dexBacked = loadDexSafely(dexFile)
                    val baksmaliOpts = BaksmaliOptions().apply {
                        deodex = false
                        parameterRegisters = true
                    }
                    val totalClasses = dexBacked.classes.size
                    var classCount = 0

                    for (classDef in dexBacked.classes) {
                        if (isCancelled()) throw InterruptedException()
                        classCount++
                        val cType = classDef.type
                        val relPath = cType.removePrefix("L").removeSuffix(";").replace('/', File.separatorChar) + ".smali"
                        val targetSmaliFile = File(smaliOutDir, relPath)
                        targetSmaliFile.parentFile?.mkdirs()

                        try {
                            val sw = StringWriter()
                            BaksmaliWriter(sw).use { w ->
                                ClassDefinition(baksmaliOpts, classDef).writeTo(w)
                            }
                            targetSmaliFile.writeText(sw.toString(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
                        } catch (classEx: Throwable) {
                            // Defensive recovery: write stub for obfuscated/corrupted class definition
                            val fallbackContent = """
                                # Failed to disassemble class $cType: ${classEx.message}
                                .class public $cType
                                .super Ljava/lang/Object;
                            """.trimIndent()
                            targetSmaliFile.writeText(fallbackContent, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
                        }
                    }
                    listener?.onLog("I: Successfully disassembled $classCount classes from ${dexFile.name}")
                } catch (dexEx: Throwable) {
                    listener?.onLog("W: Failed to fully disassemble ${dexFile.name}: ${dexEx.message}")
                }
            }
        }

        listener?.onLog("I: Done! Project created at: ${outputDir.absolutePath}")
    }

    /**
     * Reassembles smali/ directories into DEX files and compiles the project into an APK archive.
     */
    fun recompileApk(
        projectDir: File,
        outputApk: File,
        options: RecompileOptions = RecompileOptions(),
        isCancelled: () -> Boolean = { false },
        listener: ApktoolListener? = null
    ) {
        if (!projectDir.exists() || !projectDir.isDirectory) {
            throw IllegalArgumentException("Project directory not found: ${projectDir.absolutePath}")
        }

        outputApk.parentFile?.mkdirs()
        listener?.onLog("I: Using Apktool $VERSION to recompile ${projectDir.name}")
        listener?.onProgress("Recompilando proyecto APK...", "", -1)

        // 1. Reassemble smali directories into classes*.dex
        val smaliDirs = projectDir.listFiles { f -> f.isDirectory && f.name.startsWith("smali") } ?: emptyArray()
        smaliDirs.sortBy { it.name }

        for (sDir in smaliDirs) {
            if (isCancelled()) throw InterruptedException()
            val dexName = if (sDir.name == "smali") "classes.dex" else "${sDir.name.removePrefix("smali_")}.dex"
            val targetDexFile = File(projectDir, dexName)
            val smaliFiles = mutableListOf<String>()
            sDir.walkTopDown().filter { it.isFile && it.extension == "smali" }.forEach {
                smaliFiles.add(it.absolutePath)
            }

            if (smaliFiles.isNotEmpty()) {
                listener?.onLog("I: Assembling $dexName (${smaliFiles.size} smali files)...")
                listener?.onProgress("Ensamblando $dexName (${smaliFiles.size} archivos smali)...", "", -1)

                val apiLevels = intArrayOf(options.apiLevel, 34, 30, 28)
                var assembleSuccess = false
                var lastAssembleError: Throwable? = null

                for (api in apiLevels) {
                    try {
                        val smaliOpts = SmaliOptions().apply {
                            apiLevel = api
                            outputDexFile = targetDexFile.absolutePath
                            verboseErrors = false
                        }
                        if (Smali.assemble(smaliOpts, smaliFiles)) {
                            assembleSuccess = true
                            listener?.onLog("I: Successfully assembled $dexName using API $api")
                            break
                        }
                    } catch (t: Throwable) {
                        lastAssembleError = t
                    }
                }

                if (!assembleSuccess && lastAssembleError != null) {
                    listener?.onLog("W: Smali assembly warning for $dexName: ${lastAssembleError.message}")
                }
            }
        }

        if (isCancelled()) throw InterruptedException()

        // 2. Count files for progress tracking
        var totalFiles = 0
        fun countFiles(dir: File) {
            val list = dir.listFiles() ?: return
            for (f in list) {
                if (f.isDirectory) {
                    if (!f.name.startsWith("smali")) {
                        countFiles(f)
                    }
                } else {
                    val name = f.name
                    if (name != "apktool.yml" && !name.endsWith(".orig")) {
                        totalFiles++
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        try { countFiles(projectDir) } catch (_: Throwable) {}

        // 3. Packaging into output APK
        var currentFile = 0
        val baseCanonical = projectDir.canonicalPath
        FileOutputStream(outputApk).use { outStream ->
            ZipOutputStream(outStream).use { zipOut ->
                fun addDirectoryToZip(currentDir: File) {
                    val list = currentDir.listFiles() ?: return
                    for (file in list) {
                        if (isCancelled()) throw InterruptedException()

                        val relPath = file.canonicalPath.removePrefix(baseCanonical).trimStart('/', '\\').replace('\\', '/')
                        if (file.isDirectory) {
                            if (!file.name.startsWith("smali")) {
                                addDirectoryToZip(file)
                            }
                        } else {
                            if (relPath == "apktool.yml" || relPath.endsWith(".orig") || relPath.startsWith("smali/") || relPath.startsWith("smali\\")) {
                                continue
                            }

                            currentFile++
                            val pct = if (totalFiles > 0) (currentFile * 100) / totalFiles else -1
                            if (currentFile % 20 == 0 || currentFile == totalFiles) {
                                listener?.onProgress("Empaquetando APK ($pct%)", relPath, pct)
                            }

                            var dataBytes: ByteArray
                            val origFile = File(currentDir, "${file.name}.orig")
                            if (origFile.exists()) {
                                val currentText = try { file.readText(StandardCharsets.UTF_8) } catch (_: Throwable) { "" }
                                val origBytes = origFile.readBytes()
                                val origText = if (AxmlDecoder.isAxml(origBytes)) {
                                    try { AxmlDecoder.decode(origBytes) } catch (_: Throwable) { null }
                                } else {
                                    origBytes.toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
                                }
                                dataBytes = if (currentText == origText || origText == null) {
                                    origBytes
                                } else {
                                    file.readBytes()
                                }
                            } else {
                                dataBytes = file.readBytes()
                            }

                            val entry = ZipEntry(relPath)
                            val lower = relPath.lowercase()
                            val isStored = lower.endsWith(".arsc") || lower.endsWith(".png") ||
                                lower.endsWith(".jpg") || lower.endsWith(".webp") ||
                                lower.endsWith(".ogg") || lower.endsWith(".mp3")

                            if (isStored) {
                                entry.method = ZipEntry.STORED
                                entry.size = dataBytes.size.toLong()
                                entry.compressedSize = dataBytes.size.toLong()
                                val crc = CRC32()
                                crc.update(dataBytes)
                                entry.crc = crc.value
                            } else {
                                entry.method = ZipEntry.DEFLATED
                            }

                            zipOut.putNextEntry(entry)
                            zipOut.write(dataBytes)
                            zipOut.closeEntry()
                        }
                    }
                }

                addDirectoryToZip(projectDir)
                zipOut.finish()
            }
        }

        listener?.onLog("I: Built APK: ${outputApk.absolutePath} (${outputApk.length()} bytes)")
    }
}
```

```kt
/*

package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import android.app.Notification
import android.app.PendingIntent
import android.app.Service
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.os.Build
import android.os.IBinder
import androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat
import androidx.core.app.NotificationManagerCompat
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import me.zhanghai.android.files.R
import me.zhanghai.android.files.app.CrashHandler
import me.zhanghai.android.files.app.NotificationIds
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.AxmlDecoder
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.common.newInputStream
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.common.newOutputStream
import me.zhanghai.android.files.viewer.dex.JadxDecompilerEngine
import com.android.tools.smali.baksmali.Adaptors.ClassDefinition
import com.android.tools.smali.baksmali.BaksmaliOptions
import com.android.tools.smali.baksmali.formatter.BaksmaliWriter
import com.android.tools.smali.dexlib2.DexFileFactory
import com.android.tools.smali.dexlib2.Opcodes
import com.android.tools.smali.smali.Smali
import com.android.tools.smali.smali.SmaliOptions
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileInputStream
import java.io.FileOutputStream
import java.io.StringWriter
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean
import java.util.zip.CRC32
import java.util.zip.ZipEntry
import java.util.zip.ZipInputStream
import java.util.zip.ZipOutputStream
import java8.nio.file.Files
import java8.nio.file.Path
import java8.nio.file.Paths

class ApktoolExecutionService : Service() {

    private val serviceScope = CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO + Job())
    private var activeJob: Job? = null

    override fun onBind(intent: Intent?): IBinder? = null

    override fun onStartCommand(intent: Intent?, flags: Int, startId: Int): Int {
        if (intent == null) {
            stopSelf()
            return START_NOT_STICKY
        }

        val action = intent.action
        if (action == ACTION_CANCEL) {
            cancelCurrentExecution()
            return START_NOT_STICKY
        }

        if (action == ACTION_START_TASK) {
            val taskType = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_TASK_TYPE) ?: TASK_TYPE_DECOMPILE_APK
            val inputPathStr = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_INPUT_PATH) ?: ""
            val outputPathStr = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_OUTPUT_PATH) ?: ""
            val packageName = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_PACKAGE_NAME) ?: "app"
            val displayTitle = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_DISPLAY_TITLE) ?: getString(R.string.apktool_decompile_apk)

            startTask(taskType, inputPathStr, outputPathStr, packageName, displayTitle)
        }

        return START_NOT_STICKY
    }

    private fun startTask(
        taskType: String,
        inputPathStr: String,
        outputPathStr: String,
        packageName: String,
        displayTitle: String
    ) {
        isCancelled.set(false)

        val initialState = TaskState(
            taskType = taskType,
            title = displayTitle,
            packageName = packageName,
            inputPath = inputPathStr,
            outputPath = outputPathStr,
            status = "Iniciando operación...",
            detail = "",
            progress = 0,
            isIndeterminate = true,
            isRunning = true,
            isCancelled = false,
            isCompleted = false
        )
        _taskState.value = initialState

        val initialNotification = buildProgressNotification(
            title = "$displayTitle: $packageName",
            text = "Iniciando operación...",
            progress = 0,
            indeterminate = true,
            outputPath = outputPathStr
        )
        startForeground(NotificationIds.APKTOOL, initialNotification)

        activeJob = serviceScope.launch {
            var success = false
            var errorMsg: String? = null

            try {
                when (taskType) {
                    TASK_TYPE_DECOMPILE_APK -> {
                        executeDecompileApk(inputPathStr, outputPathStr, packageName)
                    }
                    TASK_TYPE_DECOMPILE_JAVA -> {
                        executeDecompileJava(inputPathStr, outputPathStr, packageName)
                    }
                    TASK_TYPE_RECOMPILE_APK -> {
                        executeRecompileApk(inputPathStr, outputPathStr, packageName)
                    }
                }
                success = true
            } catch (ie: InterruptedException) {
                // Cancelled by user
                isCancelled.set(true)
            } catch (t: Throwable) {
                t.printStackTrace()
                CrashHandler.logHandledException(t, "ApktoolExecutionService")
                var current: Throwable? = t
                var rootCause: Throwable = t
                while (current != null) {
                    rootCause = current
                    current = if (current is java.lang.ExceptionInInitializerError) {
                        current.exception ?: current.cause
                    } else {
                        current.cause
                    }
                }
                val detail = rootCause.localizedMessage ?: rootCause.message ?: t.localizedMessage ?: t.message
                val simpleName = rootCause.javaClass.simpleName
                val userFriendlyHint = when {
                    rootCause is java.lang.UnsupportedOperationException -> "Operación no soportada por el sistema o formato incompatible"
                    rootCause is java.io.FileNotFoundException -> "Archivo o directorio no encontrado"
                    rootCause is java.util.zip.ZipException -> "Archivo APK corrupto o protegido con compresión incompatible"
                    rootCause is java.lang.OutOfMemoryError -> "Memoria insuficiente para procesar la aplicación"
                    else -> null
                }
                errorMsg = if (userFriendlyHint != null) {
                    if (!detail.isNullOrBlank()) {
                        "$userFriendlyHint ($simpleName: $detail)"
                    } else {
                        val frame = rootCause.stackTrace.firstOrNull()
                        val loc = if (frame != null) "${frame.className.substringAfterLast('.')}.${frame.methodName}(L:${frame.lineNumber})" else "execute"
                        "$userFriendlyHint ($simpleName en $loc)"
                    }
                } else if (!detail.isNullOrBlank()) {
                    "$simpleName: $detail"
                } else {
                    val frame = rootCause.stackTrace.firstOrNull()
                    val loc = if (frame != null) "${frame.className.substringAfterLast('.')}.${frame.methodName}(L:${frame.lineNumber})" else "execute"
                    "$simpleName en $loc"
                }
            }

            withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                if (isCancelled.get()) {
                    // Clean up output files if task was aborted mid-flight
                    try {
                        val out = File(outputPathStr)
                        if (out.exists()) {
                            out.deleteRecursively()
                        }
                    } catch (ignored: Throwable) {}

                    _taskState.value = _taskState.value?.copy(
                        isRunning = false,
                        isCancelled = true,
                        status = getString(R.string.apktool_cancelled)
                    )
                    NotificationManagerCompat.from(this@ApktoolExecutionService).cancel(NotificationIds.APKTOOL)
                } else if (success) {
                    _taskState.value = _taskState.value?.copy(
                        isRunning = false,
                        isCompleted = true,
                        progress = 100,
                        isIndeterminate = false,
                        status = getString(R.string.apktool_completed)
                    )
                    showCompletionNotification(displayTitle, packageName, outputPathStr)
                } else {
                    _taskState.value = _taskState.value?.copy(
                        isRunning = false,
                        errorMessage = errorMsg ?: "Error en la ejecución de Apktool",
                        status = "Error al completar la tarea"
                    )
                    NotificationManagerCompat.from(this@ApktoolExecutionService).cancel(NotificationIds.APKTOOL)
                }

                stopForeground(STOP_FOREGROUND_REMOVE)
                stopSelf()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun executeDecompileApk(inputApkPathStr: String, outputDirStr: String, packageName: String) {
        val apkFile = File(inputApkPathStr)
        val projectFile = File(outputDirStr)

        ApktoolEngine.decompileApk(
            inputApk = apkFile,
            outputDir = projectFile,
            options = ApktoolEngine.DecompileOptions(
                disassembleDex = true,
                decodeResources = true,
                forceOverwrite = true
            ),
            isCancelled = { isCancelled.get() },
            listener = object : ApktoolEngine.ApktoolListener {
                override fun onProgress(message: String, detail: String, percentage: Int) {
                    updateNotificationAndState(message, detail, percentage, percentage < 0)
                }
                override fun onLog(message: String) {}
            }
        )
    }

    private fun executeDecompileJava(inputApkPathStr: String, outputDirStr: String, packageName: String) {
        val inputFile = File(inputApkPathStr)
        val outputDir = File(outputDirStr)

        updateNotificationAndState("Inicializando motor JADX...", "", -1, true)

        JadxDecompilerEngine.decompileToDirectory(
            inputFile = inputFile,
            outputDir = outputDir,
            isCancelled = { isCancelled.get() },
            onProgress = { current, total, currentClass ->
                val pct = if (total > 0) (current * 100) / total else 0
                val simpleName = currentClass.substringAfterLast('.')
                if (current % 10 == 0 || current == total) {
                    updateNotificationAndState(
                        "Descompilando clases Java ($pct%)",
                        "$current/$total: $simpleName.java",
                        pct,
                        false
                    )
                }
            }
        )
    }

    private fun executeRecompileApk(projectDirStr: String, outputApkPathStr: String, packageName: String) {
        val projectDir = File(projectDirStr)
        val outApkFile = File(outputApkPathStr)

        ApktoolEngine.recompileApk(
            projectDir = projectDir,
            outputApk = outApkFile,
            options = ApktoolEngine.RecompileOptions(
                forceOverwrite = true,
                signAfterBuild = false
            ),
            isCancelled = { isCancelled.get() },
            listener = object : ApktoolEngine.ApktoolListener {
                override fun onProgress(message: String, detail: String, percentage: Int) {
                    updateNotificationAndState(message, detail, percentage, percentage < 0)
                }
                override fun onLog(message: String) {}
            }
        )
    }

    private var lastNotificationTime = 0L

    private fun updateNotificationAndState(
        status: String,
        detail: String,
        progress: Int,
        isIndeterminate: Boolean
    ) {
        _taskState.value = _taskState.value?.copy(
            status = status,
            detail = detail,
            progress = progress,
            isIndeterminate = isIndeterminate
        )

        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        if (now - lastNotificationTime > 300L || progress == 100 || progress == 0) {
            lastNotificationTime = now
            val state = _taskState.value ?: return
            val notification = buildProgressNotification(
                title = "${state.title}: ${state.packageName}",
                text = if (detail.isNotEmpty()) "$status • $detail" else status,
                progress = progress.coerceIn(0, 100),
                indeterminate = isIndeterminate,
                outputPath = state.outputPath
            )
            try {
                NotificationManagerCompat.from(this).notify(NotificationIds.APKTOOL, notification)
            } catch (ignored: Throwable) {}
        }
    }

    private fun buildProgressNotification(
        title: String,
        text: String,
        progress: Int,
        indeterminate: Boolean,
        outputPath: String
    ): Notification {
        val clickIntent = Intent(this, FileListActivity::class.java).apply {
            flags = Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_SINGLE_TOP or Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TOP
            putExtra(FileListActivity.EXTRA_SHOW_APKTOOL_PROGRESS, true)
        }
        val pClick = PendingIntent.getActivity(
            this,
            201,
            clickIntent,
            PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or (if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.M) PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE else 0)
        )

        val cancelIntent = Intent(this, ApktoolExecutionService::class.java).apply {
            action = ACTION_CANCEL
        }
        val pCancel = PendingIntent.getService(
            this,
            202,
            cancelIntent,
            PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or (if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.M) PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE else 0)
        )

        return apktoolNotificationTemplate.createBuilder(this)
            .setContentTitle(title)
            .setContentText(text)
            .setContentIntent(pClick)
            .setOngoing(true)
            .setProgress(100, progress, indeterminate)
            .addAction(R.drawable.close_icon_white_24dp, getString(R.string.apktool_cancel), pCancel)
            .build()
    }

    private fun showCompletionNotification(title: String, packageName: String, outputPath: String) {
        val clickIntent = Intent(this, FileListActivity::class.java).apply {
            flags = Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_SINGLE_TOP or Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TOP
            putExtra(FileListActivity.EXTRA_NAVIGATE_TO_PATH, outputPath)
        }
        val pClick = PendingIntent.getActivity(
            this,
            203,
            clickIntent,
            PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or (if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.M) PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE else 0)
        )

        val completedNotification = NotificationCompat.Builder(this, "apktool_operations")
            .setColor(ContextCompat.getColor(this, R.color.color_primary))
            .setSmallIcon(R.drawable.ic_apktool_notification)
            .setContentTitle("$title completado")
            .setContentText("Guardado en: $outputPath")
            .setContentIntent(pClick)
            .setAutoCancel(true)
            .setOngoing(false)
            .build()

        try {
            NotificationManagerCompat.from(this).notify(NotificationIds.APKTOOL, completedNotification)
        } catch (ignored: Throwable) {}
    }

    private fun cancelCurrentExecution() {
        isCancelled.set(true)
        activeJob?.cancel()
        _taskState.value = _taskState.value?.copy(
            isRunning = false,
            isCancelled = true,
            status = getString(R.string.apktool_cancelled)
        )
        NotificationManagerCompat.from(this).cancel(NotificationIds.APKTOOL)
        stopForeground(STOP_FOREGROUND_REMOVE)
        stopSelf()
    }

    data class TaskState(
        val taskType: String,
        val title: String,
        val packageName: String,
        val inputPath: String,
        val outputPath: String,
        val status: String,
        val detail: String,
        val progress: Int,
        val isIndeterminate: Boolean,
        val isRunning: Boolean,
        val isCancelled: Boolean,
        val isCompleted: Boolean,
        val errorMessage: String? = null
    )

    companion object {
        const val ACTION_START_TASK = "me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist.action.START_APKTOOL_TASK"
        const val ACTION_CANCEL = "me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist.action.CANCEL_APKTOOL_TASK"

        const val EXTRA_TASK_TYPE = "EXTRA_TASK_TYPE"
        const val EXTRA_INPUT_PATH = "EXTRA_INPUT_PATH"
        const val EXTRA_OUTPUT_PATH = "EXTRA_OUTPUT_PATH"
        const val EXTRA_PACKAGE_NAME = "EXTRA_PACKAGE_NAME"
        const val EXTRA_DISPLAY_TITLE = "EXTRA_DISPLAY_TITLE"

        const val TASK_TYPE_DECOMPILE_APK = "TASK_TYPE_DECOMPILE_APK"
        const val TASK_TYPE_DECOMPILE_JAVA = "TASK_TYPE_DECOMPILE_JAVA"
        const val TASK_TYPE_RECOMPILE_APK = "TASK_TYPE_RECOMPILE_APK"

        val isCancelled = AtomicBoolean(false)

        private val _taskState = MutableStateFlow<TaskState?>(null)
        val taskState: StateFlow<TaskState?> = _taskState.asStateFlow()

        fun isRunning(): Boolean = _taskState.value?.isRunning == true

        fun cancelCurrentTask(context: Context) {
            isCancelled.set(true)
            val intent = Intent(context, ApktoolExecutionService::class.java).apply {
                action = ACTION_CANCEL
            }
            context.startService(intent)
        }

        fun startTask(
            context: Context,
            taskType: String,
            inputPath: String,
            outputPath: String,
            packageName: String,
            displayTitle: String
        ) {
            val intent = Intent(context, ApktoolExecutionService::class.java).apply {
                action = ACTION_START_TASK
                putExtra(EXTRA_TASK_TYPE, taskType)
                putExtra(EXTRA_INPUT_PATH, inputPath)
                putExtra(EXTRA_OUTPUT_PATH, outputPath)
                putExtra(EXTRA_PACKAGE_NAME, packageName)
                putExtra(EXTRA_DISPLAY_TITLE, displayTitle)
            }
            ContextCompat.startForegroundService(context, intent)
        }
    }
}
```

```kt
/*

package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import android.app.Activity
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.drawable.ColorDrawable
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.view.Window
import android.widget.Button
import android.widget.ImageView
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.TextView
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatDialog
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
import androidx.lifecycle.lifecycleScope
import com.google.android.material.dialog.MaterialAlertDialogBuilder
import com.google.android.material.progressindicator.LinearProgressIndicator
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileOutputStream
import java8.nio.file.Files
import java8.nio.file.Path
import java8.nio.file.Paths
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.collectLatest
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import me.zhanghai.android.files.R
import me.zhanghai.android.files.appmanager.InstalledAppsActivity
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.common.newInputStream
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.linux.isLinuxPath

object ApktoolHelper {

    private var activeProgressDialog: AppCompatDialog? = null

    fun isApktoolProject(dirPath: Path): Boolean {
        return try {
            Files.isDirectory(dirPath) && (
                Files.exists(dirPath.resolve("apktool.yml")) ||
                Files.exists(dirPath.resolve("AndroidManifest.xml"))
            )
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            false
        }
    }

    /**
     * Resolves a local File instance for an input Path, copying if remote/SAF.
     */
    private fun getLocalFileForPath(activity: Activity, path: Path, prefix: String = "apk_"): File {
        return if (path.isLinuxPath) {
            path.toFile()
        } else {
            val tmp = File(activity.cacheDir, "${prefix}${System.currentTimeMillis()}_${path.fileName}")
            path.newInputStream().use { inp ->
                FileOutputStream(tmp).use { out -> inp.copyTo(out) }
            }
            tmp
        }
    }

    /**
     * Decompiles an APK using Apktool into:
     * OpenManager/ApkTool/<packageName>/decomp_src
     */
    fun decompileApk(
        activity: Activity,
        apkPath: Path,
        onComplete: ((Path?) -> Unit)? = null
    ) {
        if (ApktoolExecutionService.isRunning()) {
            Toast.makeText(activity, "Ya hay una tarea de Apktool en ejecución", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            showProgressDialog(activity)
            return
        }

        val apkFile = try {
            getLocalFileForPath(activity, apkPath, "apktool_")
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Toast.makeText(activity, "Error al preparar archivo APK: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
            return
        }

        val packageName = ApktoolPaths.resolvePackageName(activity, apkFile)
        val outputDir = ApktoolPaths.getApktoolDecompileDir(packageName)

        ApktoolExecutionService.startTask(
            context = activity,
            taskType = ApktoolExecutionService.TASK_TYPE_DECOMPILE_APK,
            inputPath = apkFile.absolutePath,
            outputPath = outputDir.absolutePath,
            packageName = packageName,
            displayTitle = activity.getString(R.string.apktool_decompile_apk)
        )

        showProgressDialog(activity) { successPath ->
            onComplete?.invoke(successPath)
        }
    }

    /**
     * Decompiles an APK directly to Java source files using JADX into:
     * OpenManager/ApkTool/<packageName>/decomp_java
     */
    fun decompileJava(
        activity: Activity,
        apkPath: Path,
        onComplete: ((Path?) -> Unit)? = null
    ) {
        if (ApktoolExecutionService.isRunning()) {
            Toast.makeText(activity, "Ya hay una tarea de Apktool en ejecución", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            showProgressDialog(activity)
            return
        }

        val apkFile = try {
            getLocalFileForPath(activity, apkPath, "jadx_")
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Toast.makeText(activity, "Error al preparar archivo APK: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
            return
        }

        val packageName = ApktoolPaths.resolvePackageName(activity, apkFile)
        val outputDir = ApktoolPaths.getJavaDecompileDir(packageName)

        ApktoolExecutionService.startTask(
            context = activity,
            taskType = ApktoolExecutionService.TASK_TYPE_DECOMPILE_JAVA,
            inputPath = apkFile.absolutePath,
            outputPath = outputDir.absolutePath,
            packageName = packageName,
            displayTitle = activity.getString(R.string.apktool_decompile_java)
        )

        showProgressDialog(activity) { successPath ->
            onComplete?.invoke(successPath)
        }
    }

    /**
     * Recompiles an Apktool project folder into:
     * OpenManager/ApkTool/<packageName>/<packageName>_recompiled.apk
     */
    fun recompileApk(
        activity: Activity,
        projectDir: Path,
        onComplete: ((Path?) -> Unit)? = null
    ) {
        if (ApktoolExecutionService.isRunning()) {
            Toast.makeText(activity, "Ya hay una tarea de Apktool en ejecución", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            showProgressDialog(activity)
            return
        }

        val projectFile = if (projectDir.isLinuxPath) {
            projectDir.toFile()
        } else {
            Toast.makeText(activity, "La carpeta del proyecto debe residir en el almacenamiento accesible", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
            return
        }

        // Determine package name from parent dir or manifest
        var packageName = projectFile.parentFile?.name ?: ""
        if (packageName.isBlank() || packageName.equals("ApkTool", ignoreCase = true)) {
            val manifestFile = File(projectFile, "AndroidManifest.xml")
            if (manifestFile.exists()) {
                try {
                    val xml = manifestFile.readText()
                    val match = Regex("""package\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"""").find(xml)
                    if (match != null) {
                        packageName = match.groupValues[1]
                    }
                } catch (ignored: Throwable) {}
            }
        }
        if (packageName.isBlank()) {
            packageName = projectFile.name.removeSuffix("_src").removeSuffix("_decomp")
        }

        val outputApkFile = ApktoolPaths.getRecompiledApkFile(packageName)

        ApktoolExecutionService.startTask(
            context = activity,
            taskType = ApktoolExecutionService.TASK_TYPE_RECOMPILE_APK,
            inputPath = projectFile.absolutePath,
            outputPath = outputApkFile.absolutePath,
            packageName = packageName,
            displayTitle = activity.getString(R.string.apktool_recompile_apk)
        )

        showProgressDialog(activity) { successPath ->
            onComplete?.invoke(successPath)
        }
    }

    /**
     * Shows or restores the active Apktool / JADX progress dialog.
     * Features:
     * - Cancel button: immediately aborts task, cleans up incomplete output, dismisses dialog.
     * - Hide button: dismisses dialog while task continues executing in foreground service.
     */
    fun showProgressDialog(
        activity: Activity,
        onSuccess: ((Path) -> Unit)? = null
    ) {
        if (activeProgressDialog?.isShowing == true) {
            return
        }

        val appCompatActivity = activity as? AppCompatActivity ?: return
        val dialog = AppCompatDialog(activity)
        activeProgressDialog = dialog
        dialog.supportRequestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE)
        val view = LayoutInflater.from(activity).inflate(R.layout.dialog_apktool_progress, null)
        dialog.setContentView(view)

        dialog.setCancelable(false)
        dialog.window?.apply {
            setBackgroundDrawable(ColorDrawable(Color.TRANSPARENT))
            val displayMetrics = activity.resources.displayMetrics
            val targetWidth = (displayMetrics.widthPixels * 0.92).toInt().coerceAtMost(
                (450 * displayMetrics.density).toInt()
            )
            setLayout(targetWidth, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT)
        }

        val ivIcon = view.findViewById<ImageView>(R.id.ivApktoolIcon)
        val tvTitle = view.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvApktoolTitle)
        val tvPackage = view.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvApktoolPackage)
        val tvStatus = view.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvApktoolStatus)
        val pbProgress = view.findViewById<LinearProgressIndicator>(R.id.pbApktoolProgress)
        val tvDetail = view.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvApktoolDetail)
        val btnCancel = view.findViewById<Button>(R.id.btnCancelApktool)
        val btnHide = view.findViewById<Button>(R.id.btnHideApktool)

        btnHide.setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            activeProgressDialog = null
            Toast.makeText(
                activity,
                activity.getString(R.string.apktool_running_toast),
                Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show()
        }

        btnCancel.setOnClickListener {
            ApktoolExecutionService.cancelCurrentTask(activity)
            dialog.dismiss()
            activeProgressDialog = null
            Toast.makeText(
                activity,
                activity.getString(R.string.apktool_cancelled_toast),
                Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
            ).show()
        }

        appCompatActivity.lifecycleScope.launch {
            ApktoolExecutionService.taskState.collectLatest { state ->
                if (state == null) {
                    if (dialog.isShowing) {
                        dialog.dismiss()
                        activeProgressDialog = null
                    }
                    return@collectLatest
                }

                if (!dialog.isShowing) {
                    return@collectLatest
                }

                tvTitle.text = state.title
                tvPackage.text = state.packageName
                tvStatus.text = state.status
                tvDetail.text = state.detail

                when (state.taskType) {
                    ApktoolExecutionService.TASK_TYPE_DECOMPILE_JAVA -> {
                        ivIcon.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_open_as_code)
                        ivIcon.setColorFilter(Color.parseColor("#64B5F6"))
                    }
                    ApktoolExecutionService.TASK_TYPE_RECOMPILE_APK -> {
                        ivIcon.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_apktool_recompile)
                        ivIcon.setColorFilter(Color.parseColor("#42A5F5"))
                    }
                    ApktoolExecutionService.TASK_TYPE_DECOMPILE_APK -> {
                        ivIcon.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_apktool_decompile)
                        ivIcon.setColorFilter(Color.parseColor("#FFA000"))
                    }
                    else -> {
                        ivIcon.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_apktool)
                        ivIcon.setColorFilter(Color.parseColor("#4CAF50"))
                    }
                }

                pbProgress.isIndeterminate = state.isIndeterminate
                if (!state.isIndeterminate) {
                    pbProgress.progress = state.progress.coerceIn(0, 100)
                }

                if (!state.isRunning) {
                    dialog.dismiss()
                    activeProgressDialog = null

                    if (state.isCompleted) {
                        Toast.makeText(
                            activity,
                            "${state.title}: ${activity.getString(R.string.apktool_completed)}",
                            Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                        ).show()

                        val targetPath = Paths.get(state.outputPath)
                        onSuccess?.invoke(targetPath)

                        if (state.taskType == ApktoolExecutionService.TASK_TYPE_RECOMPILE_APK) {
                            // Launch signature dialog for newly recompiled APK
                            ApkSignerHelper.showSignDialog(activity, targetPath) { signedPath ->
                                (activity as? FileListActivity)?.activeFragment?.reload()
                            }
                        } else {
                            // Automatically navigate file explorer to decompiled directory
                            (activity as? FileListActivity)?.activeFragment?.navigateTo(targetPath)
                        }
                    } else if (!state.isCancelled && state.errorMessage != null) {
                        val errMsg = state.errorMessage
                        val errorDialogTitle = when (state.taskType) {
                            ApktoolExecutionService.TASK_TYPE_DECOMPILE_JAVA -> "Error en Descompilador Java (JADX)"
                            ApktoolExecutionService.TASK_TYPE_RECOMPILE_APK -> "Error al Recompilar APK"
                            else -> activity.getString(R.string.apktool_error_title)
                        }
                        MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(activity)
                            .setTitle(errorDialogTitle)
                            .setMessage(errMsg)
                            .setPositiveButton(android.R.string.ok, null)
                            .setNeutralButton("Copiar") { _, _ ->
                                val clipboard = activity.getSystemService(Context.CLIPBOARD_SERVICE) as? android.content.ClipboardManager
                                clipboard?.setPrimaryClip(android.content.ClipData.newPlainText("Apktool Error", errMsg))
                                Toast.makeText(activity, "Error copiado al portapapeles", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                            }
                            .show()
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        dialog.show()
    }

    /**
     * Displays the Apktool Management Hub dialog
     */
    fun showApktoolHubDialog(activity: Activity, currentPath: Path) {
        val context = activity
        val dialog = AppCompatDialog(context)
        dialog.supportRequestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE)
        val view = LayoutInflater.from(context).inflate(R.layout.dialog_mt_apktool_hub, null)
        dialog.setContentView(view)

        dialog.window?.apply {
            setBackgroundDrawable(ColorDrawable(Color.TRANSPARENT))
            val displayMetrics = context.resources.displayMetrics
            val targetWidth = (displayMetrics.widthPixels * 0.92).toInt().coerceAtMost(
                (450 * displayMetrics.density).toInt()
            )
            setLayout(targetWidth, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT)
        }

        view.findViewById<Button>(R.id.btnCloseApktoolHub).setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
        }

        // 1. Descompilar APK (Apktool)
        view.findViewById<LinearLayout>(R.id.itemDecompileApk).setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            pickApkInDirectory(activity, currentPath, "Selecciona el APK a descompilar") { selectedApk ->
                decompileApk(activity, selectedApk)
            }
        }

        // 1b. Descompilar APK a Java (JADX)
        view.findViewById<LinearLayout>(R.id.itemDecompileJava).setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            pickApkInDirectory(activity, currentPath, "Selecciona el APK a descompilar a Java") { selectedApk ->
                decompileJava(activity, selectedApk)
            }
        }

        // 2. Recompilar APK
        view.findViewById<LinearLayout>(R.id.itemRecompileApk).setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            if (isApktoolProject(currentPath)) {
                recompileApk(activity, currentPath)
            } else {
                pickProjectInDirectory(activity, currentPath, "Selecciona la carpeta de proyecto a recompilar") { selectedProject ->
                    recompileApk(activity, selectedProject)
                }
            }
        }

        // 3. Firmar APK
        view.findViewById<LinearLayout>(R.id.itemSignApk).setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            pickApkInDirectory(activity, currentPath, "Selecciona el APK a firmar") { selectedApk ->
                ApkSignerHelper.showSignDialog(activity, selectedApk) {
                    (activity as? FileListActivity)?.activeFragment?.reload()
                }
            }
        }

        // 4. Verificar firma
        view.findViewById<LinearLayout>(R.id.itemVerifySignature).setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            pickApkInDirectory(activity, currentPath, "Selecciona el APK para verificar firma") { selectedApk ->
                ApkSignerHelper.showVerifySignatureDialog(activity, selectedApk)
            }
        }

        // 5. Extraer aplicaciones
        view.findViewById<LinearLayout>(R.id.itemExtractApps).setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            activity.startActivity(Intent(activity, InstalledAppsActivity::class.java))
        }

        dialog.show()
    }

    private fun pickApkInDirectory(
        activity: Activity,
        directory: Path,
        title: String,
        onPicked: (Path) -> Unit
    ) {
        val apkList = mutableListOf<Path>()
        try {
            if (Files.isDirectory(directory)) {
                Files.newDirectoryStream(directory).use { stream ->
                    for (p in stream) {
                        if (p.fileName.toString().endsWith(".apk", ignoreCase = true)) {
                            apkList.add(p)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
        }

        if (apkList.isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(activity, "No se encontraron archivos .apk en este directorio:\n${directory.fileName}", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
            return
        }

        val adapter = object : android.widget.ArrayAdapter<Path>(
            activity,
            R.layout.item_dialog_action_with_icon,
            apkList
        ) {
            override fun getView(position: Int, convertView: android.view.View?, parent: ViewGroup): android.view.View {
                val row = convertView ?: LayoutInflater.from(context)
                    .inflate(R.layout.item_dialog_action_with_icon, parent, false)
                val item = getItem(position)!!
                val iv = row.findViewById<ImageView>(R.id.ivActionIcon)
                val tv = row.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvActionTitle)
                iv.setImageResource(R.drawable.file_apk_icon)
                tv.text = item.fileName.toString()
                return row
            }
        }
        MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(activity)
            .setTitle(title)
            .setAdapter(adapter) { _, which ->
                onPicked(apkList[which])
            }
            .setNegativeButton("Cancelar", null)
            .show()
    }

    private fun pickProjectInDirectory(
        activity: Activity,
        directory: Path,
        title: String,
        onPicked: (Path) -> Unit
    ) {
        val projList = mutableListOf<Path>()
        try {
            if (Files.isDirectory(directory)) {
                Files.newDirectoryStream(directory).use { stream ->
                    for (p in stream) {
                        if (Files.isDirectory(p) && isApktoolProject(p)) {
                            projList.add(p)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
        }

        if (projList.isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(activity, "No se encontraron carpetas de proyecto Apktool en:\n${directory.fileName}", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
            return
        }

        val adapter = object : android.widget.ArrayAdapter<Path>(
            activity,
            R.layout.item_dialog_action_with_icon,
            projList
        ) {
            override fun getView(position: Int, convertView: android.view.View?, parent: ViewGroup): android.view.View {
                val row = convertView ?: LayoutInflater.from(context)
                    .inflate(R.layout.item_dialog_action_with_icon, parent, false)
                val item = getItem(position)!!
                val iv = row.findViewById<ImageView>(R.id.ivActionIcon)
                val tv = row.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvActionTitle)
                iv.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_apktool)
                iv.setColorFilter(Color.parseColor("#FFA000"))
                tv.text = item.fileName.toString()
                return row
            }
        }
        MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(activity)
            .setTitle(title)
            .setAdapter(adapter) { _, which ->
                onPicked(projList[which])
            }
            .setNegativeButton("Cancelar", null)
            .show()
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/filelist/ApktoolPaths.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import android.content.Context
import android.os.Environment
import me.zhanghai.android.files.app.application
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.AxmlDecoder
import java.io.File
import java.util.zip.ZipInputStream

object ApktoolPaths {

    /**
     * Resolves the primary OpenManager/ApkTool base directory.
     * Uses /storage/emulated/0/OpenManager/ApkTool if accessible, with fallback to external files.
     */
    fun getApktoolBaseDir(): File {
        val candidates = mutableListOf<File>()
        candidates.add(File("/storage/emulated/0/OpenManager/ApkTool"))
        try {
            candidates.add(File(Environment.getExternalStorageDirectory(), "OpenManager/ApkTool"))
        } catch (ignored: Throwable) {}
        try {
            val ext = application.getExternalFilesDir(null)
            if (ext != null) {
                candidates.add(File(ext, "OpenManager/ApkTool"))
            }
        } catch (ignored: Throwable) {}

        for (dir in candidates) {
            try {
                if (!dir.exists()) {
                    dir.mkdirs()
                }
                if (dir.exists() && dir.canWrite()) {
                    return dir
                }
            } catch (ignored: Throwable) {}
        }
        val fallback = File("/storage/emulated/0/OpenManager/ApkTool")
        try { fallback.mkdirs() } catch (ignored: Throwable) {}
        return fallback
    }

    /**
     * Resolves a clean, canonical package name from an APK file.
     * 1. Attempts PackageManager archive parsing.
     * 2. Inspects AndroidManifest.xml inside the ZIP and decodes binary AXML.
     * 3. Falls back to sanitized base file name.
     */
    fun resolvePackageName(context: Context, apkFile: File): String {
        // 1. Try PackageManager
        try {
            val pi = context.packageManager.getPackageArchiveInfo(apkFile.absolutePath, 0)
            if (!pi?.packageName.isNullOrBlank()) {
                return pi!!.packageName
            }
        } catch (ignored: Throwable) {}

        // 2. Decode AndroidManifest.xml from APK ZIP
        try {
            ZipInputStream(apkFile.inputStream().buffered()).use { zis ->
                var entry = zis.nextEntry
                while (entry != null) {
                    if (entry.name == "AndroidManifest.xml") {
                        val bytes = zis.readBytes()
                        val xml = if (AxmlDecoder.isAxml(bytes)) {
                            AxmlDecoder.decode(bytes)
                        } else {
                            String(bytes, Charsets.UTF_8)
                        }
                        val regex = Regex("""package\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"""")
                        val match = regex.find(xml)
                        if (match != null && match.groupValues[1].isNotBlank()) {
                            return match.groupValues[1].trim()
                        }
                        break
                    }
                    entry = zis.nextEntry
                }
            }
        } catch (ignored: Throwable) {}

        // 3. Fallback to clean filename
        val name = apkFile.name
            .removeSuffix(".apk")
            .removeSuffix(".xapk")
            .removeSuffix(".apks")
        return name.replace(Regex("[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]"), "_")
    }

    /**
     * Directory dedicated to a specific package under OpenManager/ApkTool/<packageName>
     */
    fun getPackageDir(packageName: String): File {
        val base = getApktoolBaseDir()
        val sanitized = packageName
            .replace(Regex("[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]"), "_")
            .replace(Regex("""\.+"""), ".")
            .trim('.')
            .ifEmpty { "unknown_package" }
        val pkgDir = File(base, sanitized)
        if (!pkgDir.canonicalPath.startsWith(base.canonicalPath)) {
            val fallback = File(base, "unknown_package")
            if (!fallback.exists()) fallback.mkdirs()
            return fallback
        }
        if (!pkgDir.exists()) {
            pkgDir.mkdirs()
        }
        return pkgDir
    }

    /**
     * Target directory for Java (JADX) decompilation:
     * OpenManager/ApkTool/<packageName>/decomp_java
     */
    fun getJavaDecompileDir(packageName: String): File {
        return File(getPackageDir(packageName), "decomp_java")
    }

    /**
     * Target directory for Apktool source decompilation:
     * OpenManager/ApkTool/<packageName>/decomp_src
     */
    fun getApktoolDecompileDir(packageName: String): File {
        return File(getPackageDir(packageName), "decomp_src")
    }

    /**
     * Target recompiled unsigned APK path:
     * OpenManager/ApkTool/<packageName>/<packageName>_recompiled.apk
     */
    fun getRecompiledApkFile(packageName: String): File {
        return File(getPackageDir(packageName), "${packageName}_recompiled.apk")
    }

    /**
     * Target signed APK path:
     * OpenManager/ApkTool/<packageName>/<packageName>_recompiled_signed.apk
     */
    fun getSignedApkFile(packageName: String): File {
        return File(getPackageDir(packageName), "${packageName}_recompiled_signed.apk")
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/filelist/AppMetadataCache.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import android.content.Context
import androidx.collection.LruCache

object AppMetadataCache {
    private val labelCache = LruCache<String, String>(500)
    private val installedCache = LruCache<String, Boolean>(500)

    @Synchronized
    fun getAppLabel(context: Context, packageName: String): String? {
        if (packageName.isEmpty()) return null
        val cached = labelCache.get(packageName)
        if (cached != null) return if (cached.isEmpty()) null else cached
        return try {
            val pm = context.applicationContext.packageManager
            val info = pm.getApplicationInfo(packageName, 0)
            val label = pm.getApplicationLabel(info).toString()
            labelCache.put(packageName, label)
            installedCache.put(packageName, true)
            label
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            labelCache.put(packageName, "")
            installedCache.put(packageName, false)
            null
        }
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun isInstalled(context: Context, packageName: String): Boolean {
        if (packageName.isEmpty()) return false
        val cached = installedCache.get(packageName)
        if (cached != null) return cached
        return try {
            context.applicationContext.packageManager.getPackageInfo(packageName, 0)
            installedCache.put(packageName, true)
            true
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            installedCache.put(packageName, false)
            false
        }
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun clear() {
        labelCache.evictAll()
        installedCache.evictAll()
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/filelist/BreadcrumbLayout.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2018 Hai Zhang <dreaming.in.code.zh@gmail.com>
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import android.content.Context
import android.content.res.ColorStateList
import android.util.AttributeSet
import android.view.View
import android.widget.HorizontalScrollView
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import androidx.annotation.AttrRes
import androidx.annotation.StyleRes
import androidx.appcompat.widget.PopupMenu
import androidx.core.view.isVisible
import java8.nio.file.Path
import me.zhanghai.android.files.R
import me.zhanghai.android.files.databinding.BreadcrumbItemBinding
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.getColorByAttr
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.getDimensionPixelSize
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.getResourceIdByAttr
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.layoutInflater
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.withTheme

class BreadcrumbLayout : HorizontalScrollView {
    private val tabLayoutHeight = context.getDimensionPixelSize(R.dimen.tab_layout_height)
    // Using a color state list resource somehow results in red color in dark mode on API 21.
    // Run `git revert 5bb2fd1` once we no longer support API 21.
    private val itemColor =
        ColorStateList(
            arrayOf(intArrayOf(android.R.attr.state_activated), intArrayOf()),
            intArrayOf(
                context.getColorByAttr(android.R.attr.textColorPrimary),
                context.getColorByAttr(android.R.attr.textColorSecondary)
            )
        )
    private val popupContext = context.withTheme(
        context.getResourceIdByAttr(androidx.appcompat.R.attr.actionBarPopupTheme)
    )

    private val itemsLayout: LinearLayout

    private lateinit var listener: Listener
    private lateinit var data: BreadcrumbData

    private var isLayoutDirty = true
    private var isScrollToSelectedItemPending = false
    private var isFirstScroll = true

    constructor(context: Context) : super(context)

    constructor(context: Context, attrs: AttributeSet?) : super(
        context, attrs
    )

    constructor(context: Context, attrs: AttributeSet?, @AttrRes defStyleAttr: Int) : super(
        context, attrs, defStyleAttr
    )

    constructor(
        context: Context,
        attrs: AttributeSet?,
        @AttrRes defStyleAttr: Int,
        @StyleRes defStyleRes: Int
    ) : super(context, attrs, defStyleAttr, defStyleRes)

    init {
        isHorizontalScrollBarEnabled = false
        itemsLayout = LinearLayout(context).apply { orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL }
        itemsLayout.setPaddingRelative(paddingStart, paddingTop, paddingEnd, paddingBottom)
        setPaddingRelative(0, 0, 0, 0)
        addView(itemsLayout, LayoutParams(LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT))
    }

    override fun jumpDrawablesToCurrentState() {
        // HACK: AppBarLayout.updateAppBarLayoutDrawableState() calls
        // CoordinatorLayout.jumpDrawablesToCurrentState() to fix a pre-N visual bug according to a
        // comment in AppBarLayout.BaseBehavior.onLayoutChild(), however that results in our ripple
        // disappearing. One way to ignore that call path is to skip when we are in layout, so that
        // we at least preserve the other call path upon being attached to window.
        if (isInLayout) {
            return
        }
        super.jumpDrawablesToCurrentState()
    }

    override fun onMeasure(widthMeasureSpec: Int, heightMeasureSpec: Int) {
        val heightMode = MeasureSpec.getMode(heightMeasureSpec)
        val newHeightMeasureSpec = if (heightMode != MeasureSpec.EXACTLY) {
            val maximumHeight = if (heightMode == MeasureSpec.AT_MOST) {
                MeasureSpec.getSize(heightMeasureSpec)
            } else {
                Int.MAX_VALUE
            }
            val height = tabLayoutHeight.coerceAtMost(maximumHeight)
            MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(height, MeasureSpec.EXACTLY)
        } else {
            heightMeasureSpec
        }
        super.onMeasure(widthMeasureSpec, newHeightMeasureSpec)
    }

    override fun requestLayout() {
        isLayoutDirty = true

        super.requestLayout()
    }

    override fun onLayout(changed: Boolean, left: Int, top: Int, right: Int, bottom: Int) {
        super.onLayout(changed, left, top, right, bottom)

        isLayoutDirty = false
        if (isScrollToSelectedItemPending) {
            scrollToSelectedItem()
            isScrollToSelectedItemPending = false
        }
    }

    fun setListener(listener: Listener) {
        this.listener = listener
    }

    fun setData(data: BreadcrumbData) {
        if (this::data.isInitialized && this.data == data) {
            return
        }
        this.data = data
        inflateItemViews()
        bindItemViews()
        scrollToSelectedItem()
    }

    private fun scrollToSelectedItem() {
        if (isLayoutDirty) {
            isScrollToSelectedItemPending = true
            return
        }
        val selectedItemView = itemsLayout.getChildAt(data.selectedIndex)
        val scrollX = if (layoutDirection == View.LAYOUT_DIRECTION_LTR) {
            selectedItemView.left - itemsLayout.paddingStart
        } else {
            selectedItemView.right - width + itemsLayout.paddingStart
        }
        if (!isFirstScroll && isShown) {
            smoothScrollTo(scrollX, 0)
        } else {
            scrollTo(scrollX, 0)
        }
        isFirstScroll = false
    }

    private fun inflateItemViews() {
        // HACK: Remove/add views at the front so that ripple remains correct, as we are potentially
        // collapsing/expanding breadcrumbs at the front.
        for (index in data.paths.size..<itemsLayout.childCount) {
            itemsLayout.removeViewAt(0)
        }
        for (index in itemsLayout.childCount..<data.paths.size) {
            val binding = BreadcrumbItemBinding.inflate(context.layoutInflater, itemsLayout, false)
            val menu = PopupMenu(popupContext, binding.root)
                .apply { inflate(R.menu.file_list_breadcrumb) }
            binding.root.setOnLongClickListener {
                menu.show()
                true
            }
            binding.text.setTextColor(itemColor)
            binding.arrowImage.imageTintList = itemColor
            binding.root.tag = binding to menu
            itemsLayout.addView(binding.root, 0)
        }
    }

    private fun bindItemViews() {
        for (index in data.paths.indices) {
            @Suppress("UNCHECKED_CAST")
            val tag = itemsLayout.getChildAt(index).tag as Pair<BreadcrumbItemBinding, PopupMenu>
            val (binding, menu) = tag
            binding.text.text = data.nameProducers[index](binding.text.context)
            binding.arrowImage.isVisible = index != data.paths.size - 1
            binding.root.isActivated = index == data.selectedIndex
            val path = data.paths[index]
            binding.root.setOnClickListener {
                if (data.selectedIndex == index) {
                    scrollToSelectedItem()
                } else {
                    listener.navigateTo(path)
                }
            }
            menu.setOnMenuItemClickListener {
                when (it.itemId) {
                    R.id.action_copy_path -> {
                        listener.copyPath(path)
                        true
                    }
                    R.id.action_open_in_new_task -> {
                        listener.openInNewTask(path)
                        true
                    }
                    else -> false
                }
            }
        }
    }

    interface Listener {
        fun navigateTo(path: Path)
        fun copyPath(path: Path)
        fun openInNewTask(path: Path)
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/filelist/BreadcrumbLiveData.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2018 Hai Zhang <dreaming.in.code.zh@gmail.com>
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import android.content.Context
import androidx.lifecycle.LiveData
import androidx.lifecycle.MediatorLiveData
import java8.nio.file.Path
import me.zhanghai.android.files.navigation.NavigationRootMapLiveData
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.valueCompat

class BreadcrumbLiveData(
    private val trailLiveData: LiveData<TrailData>
) : MediatorLiveData<BreadcrumbData>() {
    init {
        addSource(trailLiveData) { loadValue() }
        addSource(NavigationRootMapLiveData) { loadValue() }
    }

    private fun loadValue() {
        val navigationRootMap = NavigationRootMapLiveData.valueCompat
        val trailData = trailLiveData.valueCompat
        val paths = mutableListOf<Path>()
        val nameProducers = mutableListOf<(Context) -> String>()
        var selectedIndex = trailData.currentIndex
        for (path in trailData.trail) {
            val navigationRoot = navigationRootMap[path]
            val itemCount = nameProducers.size
            if (navigationRoot != null && selectedIndex >= itemCount) {
                selectedIndex -= itemCount
                paths.clear()
                paths.add(navigationRoot.path)
                nameProducers.clear()
                nameProducers.add { navigationRoot.getName(it) }
            } else {
                paths.add(path)
                nameProducers.add { path.name }
            }
        }
        value = BreadcrumbData(paths, nameProducers, selectedIndex)
    }
}
```
