`app/src/main/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/filelist/CollatorFileNameExtensions.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2020 Hai Zhang <dreaming.in.code.zh@gmail.com>
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import android.os.Parcelable
import kotlinx.parcelize.Parcelize
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.common.ByteStringBuilder
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.common.toByteString
import java.text.CollationKey
import java.text.Collator
import kotlin.math.min

private val COLLATION_SENTINEL = byteArrayOf(1, 1, 1)

// @see https://github.com/GNOME/glib/blob/mainline/glib/gunicollate.c
//      g_utf8_collate_key_for_filename()
fun Collator.getCollationKeyForFileName(source: String): CollationKey {
    val result = ByteStringBuilder()
    val suffix = ByteStringBuilder()
    var previousIndex = 0
    var index = 0
    val endIndex = source.length
    while (index < endIndex) {
        when {
            source[index] == '.' -> {
                if (previousIndex != index) {
                    val collationKey = getCollationKey(source.substring(previousIndex, index))
                    result.append(collationKey.toByteArray())
                }
                result.append(COLLATION_SENTINEL).append(1)
                previousIndex = index + 1
            }
            source[index].isAsciiDigit() -> {
                if (previousIndex != index) {
                    val collationKey = getCollationKey(source.substring(previousIndex, index))
                    result.append(collationKey.toByteArray())
                }
                result.append(COLLATION_SENTINEL).append(2)
                previousIndex = index
                var leadingZeros: Int
                var digits: Int
                if (source[index] == '0') {
                    leadingZeros = 1
                    digits = 0
                } else {
                    leadingZeros = 0
                    digits = 1
                }
                while (++index < endIndex) {
                    if (source[index] == '0' && digits == 0) {
                        ++leadingZeros
                    } else if (source[index].isAsciiDigit()) {
                        ++digits
                    } else {
                        if (digits == 0) {
                            ++digits
                            --leadingZeros
                        }
                        break
                    }
                }
                while (digits > 1) {
                    result.append(':'.code.toByte())
                    --digits
                }
                if (leadingZeros > 0) {
                    suffix.append(leadingZeros.toByte())
                    previousIndex += leadingZeros
                }
                result.append(source.substring(previousIndex, index).toByteString())
                previousIndex = index
                --index
            }
            else -> {}
        }
        ++index
    }
    if (previousIndex != index) {
        val collationKey = getCollationKey(source.substring(previousIndex, index))
        result.append(collationKey.toByteArray())
    }
    result.append(suffix.toByteString())
    return ByteArrayCollationKey(source, result.toByteString().borrowBytes())
}

private fun Char.isAsciiDigit(): Boolean = this in '0'..'9'

@Parcelize
private class ByteArrayCollationKey(
    @Suppress("CanBeParameter")
    private val source: String,
    private val bytes: ByteArray
) : CollationKey(source), Parcelable {
    override fun compareTo(other: CollationKey): Int {
        other as ByteArrayCollationKey
        return bytes.unsignedCompareTo(other.bytes)
    }

    override fun toByteArray(): ByteArray = bytes.copyOf()
}

private fun ByteArray.unsignedCompareTo(other: ByteArray): Int {
    val size = size
    val otherSize = other.size
    for (index in 0..<min(size, otherSize)) {
        val byte = this[index].toInt() and 0xFF
        val otherByte = other[index].toInt() and 0xFF
        if (byte < otherByte) {
            return -1
        } else if (byte > otherByte) {
            return 1
        }
    }
    return size - otherSize
}
```

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import android.app.Dialog
import android.os.Bundle
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.TextView
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatDialogFragment
import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment
import com.google.android.material.checkbox.MaterialCheckBox
import com.google.android.material.dialog.MaterialAlertDialogBuilder
import kotlinx.parcelize.Parcelize
import me.zhanghai.android.files.R
import me.zhanghai.android.files.settings.Settings
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.ParcelableArgs
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.args
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.getQuantityString
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.putArgs
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.show
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.valueCompat

class ConfirmDeleteFilesDialogFragment : AppCompatDialogFragment() {
    private val args by args<Args>()

    private val listener: Listener
        get() = requireParentFragment() as Listener

    override fun onCreateDialog(savedInstanceState: Bundle?): Dialog {
        val files = args.files
        val isAlreadyInRecycleBin = files.any { it.isInsideRecycleBin }
        val isRecycleBinEnabled = Settings.ENABLE_RECYCLE_BIN.valueCompat

        val message = if (files.size == 1) {
            val file = files.single()
            val messageRes = if (file.attributesNoFollowLinks.isDirectory) {
                R.string.file_delete_message_directory_format
            } else {
                R.string.file_delete_message_file_format
            }
            getString(messageRes, file.name)
        } else {
            val allDirectories = files.all { it.attributesNoFollowLinks.isDirectory }
            val allFiles = files.none { it.attributesNoFollowLinks.isDirectory }
            val messageRes = when {
                allDirectories -> R.plurals.file_delete_message_multiple_directories_format
                allFiles -> R.plurals.file_delete_message_multiple_files_format
                else -> R.plurals.file_delete_message_multiple_mixed_format
            }
            getQuantityString(messageRes, files.size, files.size)
        }

        val builder = MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(requireContext(), theme)

        if (isAlreadyInRecycleBin) {
            builder.setTitle(R.string.recycle_bin_delete_permanently_title)
            builder.setMessage(R.string.recycle_bin_delete_permanently_message)
            builder.setPositiveButton(R.string.recycle_bin_delete_permanently_action) { _, _ ->
                listener.deleteFiles(files, false)
            }
        } else if (isRecycleBinEnabled) {
            val context = requireContext()
            val dp16 = (16 * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
            val dp24 = (24 * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
            val dp8 = (8 * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()

            val checkBox = MaterialCheckBox(context).apply {
                setText(R.string.move_to_recycle_bin_checkbox)
                isChecked = Settings.MOVE_TO_RECYCLE_BIN_DEFAULT.valueCompat
            }
            val tv = TextView(context).apply {
                text = message
                setTextAppearance(com.google.android.material.R.style.TextAppearance_MaterialComponents_Body1)
            }
            val container = LinearLayout(context).apply {
                orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
                setPadding(dp24, dp16, dp24, dp8)
                addView(tv)
                addView(checkBox, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                    LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
                ).apply {
                    topMargin = dp8
                })
            }
            builder.setView(container)
            builder.setPositiveButton(android.R.string.ok) { _, _ ->
                listener.deleteFiles(files, checkBox.isChecked)
            }
        } else {
            builder.setMessage(message)
            builder.setPositiveButton(android.R.string.ok) { _, _ ->
                listener.deleteFiles(files, false)
            }
        }
        return builder.setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null).create()
    }

    companion object {
        fun show(files: FileItemSet, fragment: Fragment) {
            val validFiles = files.filterNotTo(fileItemSetOf()) { it.isParentDirectoryItem }
            if (validFiles.isEmpty()) return
            ConfirmDeleteFilesDialogFragment().putArgs(Args(validFiles)).show(fragment)
        }
    }

    @Parcelize
    class Args(val files: FileItemSet) : ParcelableArgs

    interface Listener {
        fun deleteFiles(files: FileItemSet)
        fun deleteFiles(files: FileItemSet, moveToRecycleBin: Boolean) {
            deleteFiles(files)
        }
    }
}
```

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import android.app.Dialog
import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.View
import android.widget.EditText
import android.widget.RadioGroup
import androidx.annotation.StringRes
import androidx.core.view.isGone
import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment
import com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputEditText
import com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputLayout
import kotlinx.parcelize.Parcelize
import me.zhanghai.android.files.R
import me.zhanghai.android.files.databinding.CreateArchiveDialogBinding
import me.zhanghai.android.files.databinding.NameDialogNameIncludeBinding
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.ParcelableArgs
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.args
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.putArgs
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.setTextWithSelection
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.show
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.takeIfNotEmpty
import me.zhanghai.android.libarchive.Archive

class CreateArchiveDialogFragment : FileNameDialogFragment() {
    private val args by args<Args>()

    override val binding: Binding
        get() = super.binding as Binding

    override val listener: Listener
        get() = super.listener as Listener

    override fun onCreateDialog(savedInstanceState: Bundle?): Dialog {
        val dialog = super.onCreateDialog(savedInstanceState)

        if (savedInstanceState == null) {
            val files = args.files
            var name: String? = null
            if (files.size == 1) {
                name = files.single().path.fileName.toString()
            } else {
                val parent = files.mapTo(mutableSetOf()) { it.path.parent }.singleOrNull()
                if (parent != null && parent.nameCount > 0) {
                    name = parent.fileName.toString()
                }
            }
            name?.let { binding.nameEdit.setTextWithSelection(it) }
        }
        binding.typeGroup.setOnCheckedChangeListener { _, _ -> updatePasswordLayoutVisibility() }
        updatePasswordLayoutVisibility()
        return dialog
    }

    @StringRes
    override val titleRes: Int = R.string.file_create_archive_title

    override fun onInflateBinding(inflater: LayoutInflater): NameDialogFragment.Binding =
        Binding.inflate(inflater)

    override val name: String
        get() {
            val extension = when (val checkedId = binding.typeGroup.checkedRadioButtonId) {
                R.id.zipRadio -> "zip"
                R.id.tarXzRadio -> "tar.xz"
                R.id.sevenZRadio -> "7z"
                else -> throw AssertionError(checkedId)
            }
            return "${super.name}.$extension"
        }

    private val isPasswordSupported: Boolean
        get() = when (val checkedId = binding.typeGroup.checkedRadioButtonId) {
            R.id.zipRadio -> true
            R.id.tarXzRadio, R.id.sevenZRadio -> false
            else -> throw AssertionError(checkedId)
        }

    private fun updatePasswordLayoutVisibility() {
        binding.passwordLayout.isGone = !isPasswordSupported
    }

    override fun onOk(name: String) {
        val (format, filter) = when (val checkedId = binding.typeGroup.checkedRadioButtonId) {
            R.id.zipRadio -> Archive.FORMAT_ZIP to Archive.FILTER_NONE
            R.id.tarXzRadio -> Archive.FORMAT_TAR to Archive.FILTER_XZ
            R.id.sevenZRadio -> Archive.FORMAT_7ZIP to Archive.FILTER_NONE
            else -> throw AssertionError(checkedId)
        }
        val password = if (isPasswordSupported) {
            binding.passwordEdit.text!!.toString().takeIfNotEmpty()
        } else {
            null
        }
        listener.archive(args.files, name, format, filter, password)
    }

    companion object {
        fun show(files: FileItemSet, fragment: Fragment) {
            CreateArchiveDialogFragment().putArgs(Args(files)).show(fragment)
        }
    }

    @Parcelize
    class Args(val files: FileItemSet) : ParcelableArgs

    protected class Binding private constructor(
        root: View,
        nameLayout: TextInputLayout,
        nameEdit: EditText,
        val typeGroup: RadioGroup,
        val passwordLayout: TextInputLayout,
        val passwordEdit: TextInputEditText
    ) : NameDialogFragment.Binding(root, nameLayout, nameEdit) {
        companion object {
            fun inflate(inflater: LayoutInflater): Binding {
                val binding = CreateArchiveDialogBinding.inflate(inflater)
                val bindingRoot = binding.root
                val nameBinding = NameDialogNameIncludeBinding.bind(bindingRoot)
                return Binding(
                    bindingRoot, nameBinding.nameLayout, nameBinding.nameEdit, binding.typeGroup,
                    binding.passwordLayout, binding.passwordEdit
                )
            }
        }
    }

    interface Listener : FileNameDialogFragment.Listener {
        fun archive(files: FileItemSet, name: String, format: Int, filter: Int, password: String?)
    }
}
```

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist
```

```kt
class CreateChoiceBottomSheetDialogFragment : BottomSheetDialogFragment() {

    private var pathDisplay: String = ""
    var onFolderSelected: (() -> Unit)? = null
    var onFileSelected: (() -> Unit)? = null
    var onZipSelected: (() -> Unit)? = null
    var onKeystoreSelected: (() -> Unit)? = null

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        pathDisplay = arguments?.getString(ARG_PATH) ?: ""
    }

    override fun onCreateView(
        inflater: LayoutInflater,
        container: ViewGroup?,
        savedInstanceState: Bundle?
    ): View? {
        return inflater.inflate(R.layout.dialog_create_item_choice, container, false)
    }

    override fun onViewCreated(view: View, savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState)

        val tvPath = view.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvCreatePath)
        if (pathDisplay.isNotEmpty()) {
            tvPath.text = pathDisplay
            tvPath.visibility = View.VISIBLE
        } else {
            tvPath.visibility = View.GONE
        }

        view.findViewById<LinearLayout>(R.id.btnOptionFolder).setOnClickListener {
            dismiss()
            onFolderSelected?.invoke()
        }

        view.findViewById<LinearLayout>(R.id.btnOptionFile).setOnClickListener {
            dismiss()
            onFileSelected?.invoke()
        }

        view.findViewById<LinearLayout>(R.id.btnOptionZip).setOnClickListener {
            dismiss()
            onZipSelected?.invoke()
        }

        view.findViewById<LinearLayout>(R.id.btnOptionKeystore).setOnClickListener {
            dismiss()
            onKeystoreSelected?.invoke()
        }
    }

    companion object {
        private const val TAG = "CreateChoiceBottomSheetDialogFragment"
        private const val ARG_PATH = "arg_path"

        fun show(
            fragmentManager: FragmentManager,
            currentPath: String,
            onFolder: () -> Unit,
            onFile: () -> Unit,
            onZip: () -> Unit,
            onKeystore: (() -> Unit)? = null
        ): CreateChoiceBottomSheetDialogFragment {
            val fragment = CreateChoiceBottomSheetDialogFragment().apply {
                arguments = Bundle().apply {
                    putString(ARG_PATH, currentPath)
                }
                this.onFolderSelected = onFolder
                this.onFileSelected = onFile
                this.onZipSelected = onZip
                this.onKeystoreSelected = onKeystore
            }
            fragment.show(fragmentManager, TAG)

        }
```

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2018 Hai Zhang <dreaming.in.code.zh@gmail.com>
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import android.app.Dialog
import android.content.res.ColorStateList
import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.View
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.TextView
import androidx.annotation.StringRes
import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment
import me.zhanghai.android.files.R
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.show

class CreateFileDialogFragment : FileNameDialogFragment() {
    override val listener: Listener
        get() = super.listener as Listener

    @StringRes
    override val titleRes: Int = R.string.file_create_file_title

    override fun onCreateDialog(savedInstanceState: Bundle?): Dialog {
        val dialog = super.onCreateDialog(savedInstanceState)
        binding.nameLayout.apply {
            setStartIconDrawable(R.drawable.file_icon_white_24dp)
            setStartIconTintList(ColorStateList.valueOf(0xFF42A5F5.toInt()))
            hint = "Nombre del archivo"
            helperText = "Toca una extensión abajo para añadirla rápidamente"
        }
        setupExtensionChips()
        return dialog
    }

    private fun setupExtensionChips() {
        val scroll = binding.extensionsScrollView ?: return
        val layout = binding.extensionsLayout ?: return
        scroll.visibility = View.VISIBLE
        layout.removeAllViews()

        val extensions = listOf(
            ".txt", ".json", ".xml", ".java", ".kt",
            ".smali", ".sh", ".md", ".html", ".c",
            ".cpp", ".py", ".log", ".bin", ".apk"
        )
        val density = resources.displayMetrics.density
        val marginEnd = (6 * density).toInt()

        for (ext in extensions) {
            val chip = TextView(requireContext()).apply {
                text = ext
                textSize = 12.5f
                setTextColor(0xFFE0E0E0.toInt())
                setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_extension_chip)
                isClickable = true
                isFocusable = true
                layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                    LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT,
                    LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
                ).apply {
                    setMargins(0, 0, marginEnd, 0)
                }
                setOnClickListener {
                    applyExtension(ext)
                }
            }
            layout.addView(chip)
        }
    }

    private fun applyExtension(ext: String) {
        val edit = binding.nameEdit
        val currentText = edit.text?.toString() ?: ""
        if (currentText.isEmpty()) {
            val defaultName = "nuevo$ext"
            edit.setText(defaultName)
            edit.setSelection(0, "nuevo".length)
        } else {
            val dot = currentText.lastIndexOf('.')
            val base = if (dot > 0) currentText.substring(0, dot) else currentText
            val newText = base + ext
            edit.setText(newText)
            edit.setSelection(0, base.length)
        }
    }

    override fun onOk(name: String) {
        listener.createFile(name)
    }

    companion object {
        fun show(fragment: Fragment) {
            CreateFileDialogFragment().show(fragment)
        }
    }

    interface Listener : FileNameDialogFragment.Listener {
        fun createFile(name: String)
    }
}
```

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import android.app.Activity
import android.os.Build
import android.system.Os
import android.widget.EditText

import android.widget.TextView
import android.widget.Toast

import me.zhanghai.android.files.terminal.TerminalExpansionManager

object CreateSymlinkHelper {

    fun showDialog(activity: Activity, fileItem: FileItem, currentDir: Path, onComplete: () -> Unit) {
        val targetPath = fileItem.path.toFile().absolutePath
        val defaultLinkName = "link_${fileItem.name}"

        val context = activity
        val container = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            setPadding(48, 24, 48, 16)
        }

        val targetLabel = TextView(context).apply {
            text = context.getString(R.string.create_symlink_target_label)
            textSize = 13f
        }
        container.addView(targetLabel)

        val targetInput = EditText(context).apply {
            setText(targetPath)
        }
        container.addView(targetInput)

        val nameLabel = TextView(context).apply {
            text = context.getString(R.string.create_symlink_name_label)
            textSize = 13f
            setPadding(0, 16, 0, 0)
        }
        container.addView(nameLabel)

        val nameInput = EditText(context).apply {
            setText(defaultLinkName)
        }
        container.addView(nameInput)

        MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(activity)
            .setTitle(R.string.create_symlink_title)
            .setView(container)
            .setPositiveButton(R.string.create_symlink_btn_create) { _, _ ->
                val finalTarget = targetInput.text.toString().trim()
                val finalLinkName = nameInput.text.toString().trim()
                if (finalLinkName.isEmpty()) {
                    Toast.makeText(activity, "Link name cannot be empty", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    return@setPositiveButton
                }

                val linkFile = File(currentDir.toFile(), finalLinkName)
                createSymlink(activity, finalTarget, linkFile, onComplete)
            }
            .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
            .show()
    }

    private fun createSymlink(activity: Activity, target: String, linkFile: File, onComplete: () -> Unit) {
        try {
            Os.symlink(target, linkFile.absolutePath)
            Toast.makeText(
                activity,
                activity.getString(R.string.create_symlink_success, linkFile.name),
                Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
            ).show()
            onComplete()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            // Check if root can execute symlink
            if (TerminalExpansionManager.isRootAvailable()) {
                try {
                    val process = Runtime.getRuntime().exec(
                        arrayOf("su", "-c", "ln -s ${target.escapeShellArg()} ${linkFile.absolutePath.escapeShellArg()}")
                    )
                    process.waitFor()
                    if (process.exitValue() == 0) {
                        Toast.makeText(
                            activity,
                            activity.getString(R.string.create_symlink_success, linkFile.name),
                            Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                        ).show()
                        onComplete()
                        return
                    }
                } catch (ignored: Exception) {}
            }
            Toast.makeText(
                activity,
                activity.getString(R.string.create_symlink_failed, e.message),
                Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show()
        }
    }
}
```

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import android.os.Build

import java.io.InputStream
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets

data class ElfFinding(
    val symbol: String,
    val category: SyscallCategory,
    val risk: SyscallRisk,
    val description: String
)

data class ElfAuditReport(
    val machineArch: String,
    val is64Bit: Boolean,
    val isLittleEndian: Boolean,
    val isPie: Boolean,
    val isDynamic: Boolean,
    val interpreter: String?,
    val isAbiCompatible: Boolean,
    val findings: List<ElfFinding>,
    val totalFindings: Int,
    val deletions: List<String>,
    val rootCalls: List<String>,
    val networkCalls: List<String>,
    val executionCalls: List<String>,
    val ptraceCalls: List<String>,
    val systemCalls: List<String>
) {
    fun toScriptAuditReport(): ScriptRunnerHelper.ScriptAuditReport {
        return ScriptRunnerHelper.ScriptAuditReport(
            deletions = deletions,
            rootCalls = rootCalls,
            networkCalls = networkCalls,
            systemPaths = systemCalls + executionCalls + ptraceCalls
        )
    }
}

object ElfInspector {

    private val supportedAbis: Array<String>
        get() = runCatching { Build.SUPPORTED_ABIS }.getOrNull() ?: arrayOf("arm64-v8a", "armeabi-v7a")

    private val SENSITIVE_SYMBOLS: Map<String, Triple<SyscallCategory, SyscallRisk, String>> = mapOf(
        // Deletions
        "unlink" to Triple(SyscallCategory.DELETION_FS, SyscallRisk.CRITICAL, "Eliminación de archivos (unlink)"),
        "unlinkat" to Triple(SyscallCategory.DELETION_FS, SyscallRisk.CRITICAL, "Eliminación de archivos (unlinkat)"),
        "rmdir" to Triple(SyscallCategory.DELETION_FS, SyscallRisk.CRITICAL, "Eliminación de directorios (rmdir)"),
        "remove" to Triple(SyscallCategory.DELETION_FS, SyscallRisk.CRITICAL, "Borrado de archivo/directorio (remove)"),

        // Symlinks & Path Evasion
        "symlink" to Triple(SyscallCategory.DELETION_FS, SyscallRisk.HIGH, "Creación de enlace simbólico (symlink)"),
        "symlinkat" to Triple(SyscallCategory.DELETION_FS, SyscallRisk.HIGH, "Creación de enlace simbólico relativo (symlinkat)"),
        "readlink" to Triple(SyscallCategory.DELETION_FS, SyscallRisk.MEDIUM, "Lectura de enlace simbólico (readlink)"),
        "readlinkat" to Triple(SyscallCategory.DELETION_FS, SyscallRisk.MEDIUM, "Lectura de enlace simbólico relativo (readlinkat)"),

        // Execution
        "system" to Triple(SyscallCategory.PROCESS_EXEC, SyscallRisk.HIGH, "Ejecución de comando en shell del sistema (system)"),
        "popen" to Triple(SyscallCategory.PROCESS_EXEC, SyscallRisk.HIGH, "Apertura de tubería de proceso (popen)"),
        "execve" to Triple(SyscallCategory.PROCESS_EXEC, SyscallRisk.HIGH, "Sustitución de proceso por nuevo ejecutable (execve)"),
        "execv" to Triple(SyscallCategory.PROCESS_EXEC, SyscallRisk.HIGH, "Ejecución de binario (execv)"),
        "execl" to Triple(SyscallCategory.PROCESS_EXEC, SyscallRisk.HIGH, "Ejecución de binario con lista de argumentos (execl)"),
        "execvp" to Triple(SyscallCategory.PROCESS_EXEC, SyscallRisk.HIGH, "Búsqueda y ejecución en PATH (execvp)"),
        "posix_spawn" to Triple(SyscallCategory.PROCESS_EXEC, SyscallRisk.HIGH, "Creación de nuevo proceso (posix_spawn)"),
        "fork" to Triple(SyscallCategory.PROCESS_EXEC, SyscallRisk.MEDIUM, "Duplicación de proceso hijo (fork)"),

        // Debugging & Injection
        "ptrace" to Triple(SyscallCategory.DEBUG_PTRACE, SyscallRisk.CRITICAL, "Trazado, control e inyección en procesos (ptrace)"),
        "process_vm_readv" to Triple(SyscallCategory.DEBUG_PTRACE, SyscallRisk.HIGH, "Lectura de memoria de proceso remoto"),
        "process_vm_writev" to Triple(SyscallCategory.DEBUG_PTRACE, SyscallRisk.CRITICAL, "Inyección/escritura en memoria de proceso remoto"),

        // Network
        "socket" to Triple(SyscallCategory.NETWORK, SyscallRisk.MEDIUM, "Creación de sockets de red"),
        "connect" to Triple(SyscallCategory.NETWORK, SyscallRisk.MEDIUM, "Conexión a servidores/hosts remotos"),
        "bind" to Triple(SyscallCategory.NETWORK, SyscallRisk.MEDIUM, "Enlace de puertos locales"),
        "listen" to Triple(SyscallCategory.NETWORK, SyscallRisk.MEDIUM, "Apertura de socket en modo escucha"),
        "sendto" to Triple(SyscallCategory.NETWORK, SyscallRisk.MEDIUM, "Transmisión de datos UDP/RAW por red"),
        "recvfrom" to Triple(SyscallCategory.NETWORK, SyscallRisk.MEDIUM, "Recepción de datos por red"),

        // Signals & Termination
        "kill" to Triple(SyscallCategory.SIGNALING, SyscallRisk.HIGH, "Envío de señales de terminación a procesos (kill)"),
        "tkill" to Triple(SyscallCategory.SIGNALING, SyscallRisk.HIGH, "Envío de señales a hilos específicos (tkill)"),
        "tgkill" to Triple(SyscallCategory.SIGNALING, SyscallRisk.HIGH, "Envío de señales a grupos de hilos (tgkill)"),

        // Privilege & Identity
        "setuid" to Triple(SyscallCategory.PRIVILEGE, SyscallRisk.HIGH, "Cambio de usuario efectivo/real (posible root)"),
        "setgid" to Triple(SyscallCategory.PRIVILEGE, SyscallRisk.HIGH, "Cambio de grupo de permisos (setgid)"),
        "seteuid" to Triple(SyscallCategory.PRIVILEGE, SyscallRisk.HIGH, "Cambio de usuario efectivo (seteuid)"),
        "setresuid" to Triple(SyscallCategory.PRIVILEGE, SyscallRisk.HIGH, "Modificación de permisos de usuario (setresuid)"),
        "capset" to Triple(SyscallCategory.PRIVILEGE, SyscallRisk.CRITICAL, "Modificación de capacidades de seguridad Linux"),

        // System Control & Namespaces
        "reboot" to Triple(SyscallCategory.SYSTEM_ADMIN, SyscallRisk.CRITICAL, "Reinicio o apagado del sistema (reboot)"),
        "sys_reboot" to Triple(SyscallCategory.SYSTEM_ADMIN, SyscallRisk.CRITICAL, "Syscall de reinicio directo del kernel (sys_reboot)"),
        "mount" to Triple(SyscallCategory.SYSTEM_ADMIN, SyscallRisk.CRITICAL, "Montaje de sistemas de archivos (mount)"),
        "umount" to Triple(SyscallCategory.SYSTEM_ADMIN, SyscallRisk.CRITICAL, "Desmontaje de sistemas de archivos (umount)"),
        "umount2" to Triple(SyscallCategory.SYSTEM_ADMIN, SyscallRisk.CRITICAL, "Desmontaje forzado de archivos/particiones (umount2)"),
        "chroot" to Triple(SyscallCategory.SYSTEM_ADMIN, SyscallRisk.CRITICAL, "Cambio de directorio raíz (chroot)"),
        "pivot_root" to Triple(SyscallCategory.SYSTEM_ADMIN, SyscallRisk.CRITICAL, "Pivote de sistema de archivos raíz (pivot_root)"),
        "setns" to Triple(SyscallCategory.SYSTEM_ADMIN, SyscallRisk.HIGH, "Cambio de namespace de procesos (setns)"),
        "unshare" to Triple(SyscallCategory.SYSTEM_ADMIN, SyscallRisk.HIGH, "Desvinculación de namespaces del sistema (unshare)"),
        "swapon" to Triple(SyscallCategory.SYSTEM_ADMIN, SyscallRisk.HIGH, "Activación de partición swap")
    )

    fun isElf(path: Path): Boolean {
        return try {
            path.newInputStream().use { isElf(it) }
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            false
        }
    }

    fun isElf(bytes: ByteArray): Boolean {
        if (bytes.size < 4) return false
        return bytes[0] == 0x7F.toByte() &&
            bytes[1] == 'E'.code.toByte() &&
            bytes[2] == 'L'.code.toByte() &&
            bytes[3] == 'F'.code.toByte()
    }

    fun isElf(stream: InputStream): Boolean {
        val magic = ByteArray(4)
        val read = stream.read(magic)
        return read == 4 && isElf(magic)
    }

    fun inspect(path: Path): ElfAuditReport {
        return try {
            val bytes = path.newInputStream().use { stream ->
                // Read up to 2MB to parse headers and dynamic strings
                val buf = ByteArray(2 * 1024 * 1024)
                var total = 0
                var r: Int
                while (stream.read(buf, total, buf.size - total).also { r = it } > 0) {
                    total += r
                    if (total >= buf.size) break
                }
                buf.copyOf(total)
            }
            inspect(bytes)
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            createFallbackReport()
        }
    }

    fun inspect(bytes: ByteArray): ElfAuditReport {
        if (!isElf(bytes) || bytes.size < 52) {
            return createFallbackReport()
        }

        val is64Bit = bytes[4].toInt() == 2
        val isLittleEndian = bytes[5].toInt() == 1

        fun readU16(offset: Int): Int {
            if (offset + 2 > bytes.size) return 0
            val b0 = bytes[offset].toInt() and 0xFF
            val b1 = bytes[offset + 1].toInt() and 0xFF
            return if (isLittleEndian) b0 or (b1 shl 8) else (b0 shl 8) or b1
        }

        fun readU32(offset: Int): Long {
            if (offset + 4 > bytes.size) return 0L
            val b0 = bytes[offset].toLong() and 0xFF
            val b1 = bytes[offset + 1].toLong() and 0xFF
            val b2 = bytes[offset + 2].toLong() and 0xFF
            val b3 = bytes[offset + 3].toLong() and 0xFF
            return if (isLittleEndian) {
                b0 or (b1 shl 8) or (b2 shl 16) or (b3 shl 24)
            } else {
                (b0 shl 24) or (b1 shl 16) or (b2 shl 8) or b3
            }
        }

        fun readU64(offset: Int): Long {
            if (offset + 8 > bytes.size) return 0L
            val lo = readU32(offset)
            val hi = readU32(offset + 4)
            return if (isLittleEndian) lo or (hi shl 32) else (lo shl 32) or hi
        }

        val elfType = readU16(16) // 2 = ET_EXEC, 3 = ET_DYN (PIE)
        val isPie = elfType == 3

        val machine = readU16(18)
        val (archName, isAbiCompatible) = when (machine) {
            3 -> "x86 (32-bit)" to supportedAbis.any { it.startsWith("x86") }
            40 -> "ARM (armeabi-v7a 32-bit)" to supportedAbis.any { it.contains("arm") }
            62 -> "x86_64 (64-bit)" to supportedAbis.contains("x86_64")
            183 -> "AArch64 (arm64-v8a 64-bit)" to supportedAbis.contains("arm64-v8a")
            243 -> "RISC-V (64-bit)" to supportedAbis.any { it.contains("riscv") }
            else -> "Máquina ELF #$machine" to true
        }

        // Program header parsing for PT_INTERP (type 3)
        var interpreter: String? = null
        val phOff = if (is64Bit) readU64(32).toInt() else readU32(28).toInt()
        val phEntSize = if (is64Bit) readU16(54) else readU16(42)
        val phNum = if (is64Bit) readU16(56) else readU16(44)

        if (phOff > 0 && phEntSize > 0 && phNum > 0 && phOff < bytes.size) {
            for (i in 0 until phNum) {
                val curPh = phOff + i * phEntSize
                if (curPh + 16 > bytes.size) break
                val pType = readU32(curPh)
                if (pType == 3L) { // PT_INTERP
                    val pOffset = if (is64Bit) readU64(curPh + 8).toInt() else readU32(curPh + 4).toInt()
                    val pFilesz = if (is64Bit) readU64(curPh + 32).toInt() else readU32(curPh + 16).toInt()
                    if (pOffset in 0 until bytes.size && pFilesz > 0 && pOffset + pFilesz <= bytes.size) {
                        val rawStr = String(bytes, pOffset, pFilesz, StandardCharsets.UTF_8).trimEnd('\u0000')
                        if (rawStr.isNotBlank()) {
                            interpreter = rawStr
                        }
                    }
                    break
                }
            }
        }

        val isDynamic = interpreter != null || elfType == 3

        // Scan for sensitive symbols and syscalls in the binary content
        val findings = mutableListOf<ElfFinding>()
        val deletions = mutableListOf<String>()
        val rootCalls = mutableListOf<String>()
        val networkCalls = mutableListOf<String>()
        val executionCalls = mutableListOf<String>()
        val ptraceCalls = mutableListOf<String>()
        val systemCalls = mutableListOf<String>()

        // Convert the binary strings to search for symbol names cleanly
        val binaryText = buildString {
            var start = 0
            for (i in bytes.indices) {
                val b = bytes[i].toInt()
                if (b in 32..126) {
                    // Printable ASCII
                } else {
                    if (i - start >= 3) {
                        append(String(bytes, start, i - start, StandardCharsets.ISO_8859_1))
                        append('\n')
                    }
                    start = i + 1
                }
            }
        }

        val detectedSet = mutableSetOf<String>()
        for ((symbol, info) in SENSITIVE_SYMBOLS) {
            val (category, risk, desc) = info
            val regex = Regex("""\b${Regex.escape(symbol)}\b""")
            if (regex.containsMatchIn(binaryText) && detectedSet.add(symbol)) {
                val finding = ElfFinding(
                    symbol = symbol,
                    category = category,
                    risk = risk,
                    description = desc
                )
                findings.add(finding)

                when (category) {
                    SyscallCategory.DELETION_FS -> deletions.add("$symbol() - $desc")
                    SyscallCategory.PRIVILEGE -> rootCalls.add("$symbol() - $desc")
                    SyscallCategory.NETWORK -> networkCalls.add("$symbol() - $desc")
                    SyscallCategory.PROCESS_EXEC -> executionCalls.add("$symbol() - $desc")
                    SyscallCategory.DEBUG_PTRACE -> ptraceCalls.add("$symbol() - $desc")
                    SyscallCategory.SYSTEM_ADMIN -> systemCalls.add("$symbol() - $desc")
                    else -> {}
                }
            }
        }

        // Check for hardcoded sensitive paths in string literals
        val dangerousPaths = listOf(
            "/system", "/vendor", "/product", "/apex", "/dev/block",
            "/data/local/tmp", "/data/adb", "/system/bin/su", "su"
        )
        for (dp in dangerousPaths) {
            if (binaryText.contains(dp) && detectedSet.add("PATH:$dp")) {
                if (dp.contains("su")) {
                    rootCalls.add("Referencia binario root ($dp)")
                } else {
                    systemCalls.add("Referencia a ruta del sistema ($dp)")
                }
            }
        }

        val totalFindings = deletions.size + rootCalls.size + networkCalls.size + executionCalls.size + ptraceCalls.size + systemCalls.size

        return ElfAuditReport(
            machineArch = archName,
            is64Bit = is64Bit,
            isLittleEndian = isLittleEndian,
            isPie = isPie,
            isDynamic = isDynamic,
            interpreter = interpreter,
            isAbiCompatible = isAbiCompatible,
            findings = findings,
            totalFindings = totalFindings,
            deletions = deletions,
            rootCalls = rootCalls,
            networkCalls = networkCalls,
            executionCalls = executionCalls,
            ptraceCalls = ptraceCalls,
            systemCalls = systemCalls
        )
    }

    private fun createFallbackReport(): ElfAuditReport {
        val defaultAbi = supportedAbis.firstOrNull() ?: "arm64-v8a"
        return ElfAuditReport(
            machineArch = defaultAbi,
            is64Bit = defaultAbi.contains("64"),
            isLittleEndian = true,
            isPie = true,
            isDynamic = true,
            interpreter = "/system/bin/linker64",
            isAbiCompatible = true,
            findings = emptyList(),
            totalFindings = 0,
            deletions = emptyList(),
            rootCalls = emptyList(),
            networkCalls = emptyList(),
            executionCalls = emptyList(),
            ptraceCalls = emptyList(),
            systemCalls = emptyList()
        )
    }
}
```

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import android.app.Activity
import android.content.ClipData
import android.content.ClipboardManager
import android.content.Context
import android.widget.RadioButton
import android.widget.RadioGroup
import android.widget.TextView
import android.widget.Toast
import com.google.android.material.dialog.MaterialAlertDialogBuilder
import java8.nio.file.Path
import me.zhanghai.android.files.R
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.FileItem
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileOutputStream
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat
import java.util.Date
import java.util.Locale

object ExportFileListHelper {

    fun showDialog(
        activity: Activity,
        currentDir: Path,
        allFiles: List<FileItem>,
        selectedFiles: List<FileItem>?,
        onComplete: () -> Unit
    ) {
        val filesToExport = if (!selectedFiles.isNullOrEmpty()) {
            selectedFiles.filter { !it.isParentDirectoryItem }
        } else {
            allFiles.filter { !it.isParentDirectoryItem }
        }

        if (filesToExport.isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(activity, "No files to export", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return
        }

        val context = activity
        val container = android.widget.LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = android.widget.LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            setPadding(48, 24, 48, 16)
        }

        val scopeInfo = TextView(context).apply {
            text = if (!selectedFiles.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                context.getString(R.string.export_file_list_selected, filesToExport.size)
            } else {
                context.getString(R.string.export_file_list_all, filesToExport.size)
            }
            textSize = 15f
            setPadding(0, 0, 0, 16)
        }
        container.addView(scopeInfo)

        val formatLabel = TextView(context).apply {
            text = context.getString(R.string.export_file_list_format)
            textSize = 13f
        }
        container.addView(formatLabel)

        val radioGroup = RadioGroup(context)
        val formats = listOf(
            0 to context.getString(R.string.export_file_list_names_only),
            1 to context.getString(R.string.export_file_list_names_sizes),
            2 to context.getString(R.string.export_file_list_full_paths),
            3 to context.getString(R.string.export_file_list_full_details)
        )

        var selectedFormat = 0
        for ((id, label) in formats) {
            val rb = RadioButton(context).apply {
                text = label
                this.id = id
                if (id == 0) isChecked = true
            }
            radioGroup.addView(rb)
        }
        container.addView(radioGroup)

        radioGroup.setOnCheckedChangeListener { _, checkedId ->
            selectedFormat = checkedId
        }

        MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(activity)
            .setTitle(R.string.export_file_list_title)
            .setView(container)
            .setPositiveButton(R.string.export_file_list_copy_clipboard) { _, _ ->
                val text = generateExportText(filesToExport, selectedFormat)
                val cm = context.getSystemService(Context.CLIPBOARD_SERVICE) as ClipboardManager
                cm.setPrimaryClip(ClipData.newPlainText("File List", text))
                Toast.makeText(
                    activity,
                    context.getString(R.string.export_file_list_copied, filesToExport.size),
                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                ).show()
                onComplete()
            }
            .setNeutralButton(R.string.export_file_list_save_file) { _, _ ->
                val text = generateExportText(filesToExport, selectedFormat)
                val destFile = File(currentDir.toFile(), "file_list.txt")
                try {
                    FileOutputStream(destFile).use { out ->
                        out.write(text.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
                    }
                    Toast.makeText(
                        activity,
                        context.getString(R.string.export_file_list_saved, destFile.name),
                        Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                    ).show()
                    onComplete()
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    Toast.makeText(activity, "Failed to save file: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            }
            .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
            .show()
    }

    private fun generateExportText(files: List<FileItem>, format: Int): String {
        val dateFormat = SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss", Locale.getDefault())
        val sb = StringBuilder()

        for (file in files) {
            val name = file.name
            val size = formatSize(file.attributes.size())
            val path = file.path.toFile().absolutePath
            val date = dateFormat.format(Date(file.attributes.lastModifiedTime().toMillis()))

            when (format) {
                0 -> sb.appendLine(name)
                1 -> sb.appendLine("$name\t$size")
                2 -> sb.appendLine(path)
                3 -> sb.appendLine("$name\t$size\t$date\t$path")
            }
        }
        return sb.toString().trimEnd()
    }

    private fun formatSize(bytes: Long): String {
        if (bytes <= 0) return "0 B"
        if (bytes < 1024) return "$bytes B"
        val kb = bytes.toDouble() / 1024
        if (kb < 1024) return String.format("%.1f KB", kb)
        val mb = kb / 1024
        if (mb < 1024) return String.format("%.1f MB", mb)
        val gb = mb / 1024
        return String.format("%.2f GB", gb)
    }
}
```

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import android.app.Activity
import android.text.InputType
import android.widget.CheckBox
import android.widget.EditText
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.TextView
import android.widget.Toast
import com.google.android.material.dialog.MaterialAlertDialogBuilder
import java.io.InputStream
import java.io.OutputStream
import java.security.SecureRandom
import java8.nio.file.Path
import java8.nio.file.Paths
import javax.crypto.Cipher
import javax.crypto.CipherInputStream
import javax.crypto.CipherOutputStream
import javax.crypto.SecretKeyFactory
import javax.crypto.spec.IvParameterSpec
import javax.crypto.spec.PBEKeySpec
import javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.FileItem

import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.common.newOutputStream

object FileEncryptDecryptHelper {

    private val MAGIC_HEADER = "OMENC1".toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)
    private const val ITERATIONS = 65536
    private const val KEY_LENGTH = 256

    fun isEncryptedFile(file: FileItem): Boolean {
        return file.name.endsWith(".enc", ignoreCase = true)
    }

    fun showEncryptDialog(activity: Activity, file: FileItem, onDone: () -> Unit) {
        val context = activity
        val pad = (16 * context.resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()

        val layout = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            setPadding(pad, pad / 2, pad, pad / 2)
        }

        val etPassword = EditText(context).apply {
            hint = "Contraseña"
            inputType = InputType.TYPE_CLASS_TEXT or InputType.TYPE_TEXT_VARIATION_PASSWORD
        }
        val etConfirm = EditText(context).apply {
            hint = "Confirmar contraseña"
            inputType = InputType.TYPE_CLASS_TEXT or InputType.TYPE_TEXT_VARIATION_PASSWORD
        }
        val cbDeleteOriginal = CheckBox(context).apply {
            text = "Eliminar archivo original después de cifrar"
            isChecked = false
        }

        layout.addView(etPassword)
        layout.addView(etConfirm)
        layout.addView(cbDeleteOriginal)

        MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(context)
            .setTitle("Cifrar archivo")
            .setMessage("Cifrar '${file.name}' con AES-256")
            .setView(layout)
            .setPositiveButton("Cifrar") { _, _ ->
                val pwd = etPassword.text.toString()
                val confirm = etConfirm.text.toString()
                if (pwd.isEmpty()) {
                    Toast.makeText(context, "La contraseña no puede estar vacía", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    return@setPositiveButton
                }
                if (pwd != confirm) {
                    Toast.makeText(context, "Las contraseñas no coinciden", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    return@setPositiveButton
                }
                encrypt(activity, file.path, pwd, cbDeleteOriginal.isChecked, onDone)
            }
            .setNegativeButton("Cancelar", null)
            .show()
    }

    fun showDecryptDialog(activity: Activity, file: FileItem, onDone: () -> Unit) {
        val context = activity
        val pad = (16 * context.resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()

        val layout = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            setPadding(pad, pad / 2, pad, pad / 2)
        }

        val etPassword = EditText(context).apply {
            hint = "Contraseña"
            inputType = InputType.TYPE_CLASS_TEXT or InputType.TYPE_TEXT_VARIATION_PASSWORD
        }
        val cbDeleteEnc = CheckBox(context).apply {
            text = "Eliminar archivo cifrado después de descifrar"
            isChecked = false
        }

        layout.addView(etPassword)
        layout.addView(cbDeleteEnc)

        MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(context)
            .setTitle("Descifrar archivo")
            .setMessage("Descifrar '${file.name}'")
            .setView(layout)
            .setPositiveButton("Descifrar") { _, _ ->
                val pwd = etPassword.text.toString()
                if (pwd.isEmpty()) {
                    Toast.makeText(context, "Introduce la contraseña", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    return@setPositiveButton
                }
                decrypt(activity, file.path, pwd, cbDeleteEnc.isChecked, onDone)
            }
            .setNegativeButton("Cancelar", null)
            .show()
    }

    private fun encrypt(
        activity: Activity,
        sourcePath: Path,
        password: String,
        deleteOriginal: Boolean,
        onDone: () -> Unit
    ) {
        val fileName = sourcePath.fileName.toString()
        val targetName = "$fileName.enc"
        val targetPath = (sourcePath.parent ?: Paths.get("/storage/emulated/0/Download")).resolve(targetName)

        val progress = MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(activity)
            .setTitle("Cifrando archivo")
            .setMessage("Cifrando $fileName con AES-256...")
            .setCancelable(false)
            .show()

        kotlin.concurrent.thread {
            var success = false
            var errorMsg: String? = null
            try {
                val salt = ByteArray(16).also { SecureRandom().nextBytes(it) }
                val iv = ByteArray(16).also { SecureRandom().nextBytes(it) }

                val keySpec = PBEKeySpec(password.toCharArray(), salt, ITERATIONS, KEY_LENGTH)
                val factory = SecretKeyFactory.getInstance("PBKDF2WithHmacSHA256")
                val keyBytes = factory.generateSecret(keySpec).encoded
                val secretKey = SecretKeySpec(keyBytes, "AES")

                val cipher = Cipher.getInstance("AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding")
                cipher.init(Cipher.ENCRYPT_MODE, secretKey, IvParameterSpec(iv))

                sourcePath.newInputStream().use { inStream ->
                    targetPath.newOutputStream().use { outStream ->
                        outStream.write(MAGIC_HEADER)
                        outStream.write(salt)
                        outStream.write(iv)

                        CipherOutputStream(outStream, cipher).use { cipherOut ->
                            val buf = ByteArray(65536)
                            var read: Int
                            while (inStream.read(buf).also { read = it } != -1) {
                                cipherOut.write(buf, 0, read)
                            }
                            cipherOut.flush()
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (deleteOriginal) {
                    try {
                        sourcePath.deleteIfExists()
                    } catch (e: Exception) {
                        e.printStackTrace()
                    }
                }
                success = true
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                e.printStackTrace()
                errorMsg = e.localizedMessage ?: e.javaClass.simpleName
                try {
                    targetPath.deleteIfExists()
                } catch (ignored: Exception) {}
            }

            activity.runOnUiThread {
                if (activity.isFinishing || activity.isDestroyed) return@runOnUiThread
                try { progress.dismiss() } catch (ignored: Exception) {}
                if (success) {
                    Toast.makeText(activity, "Archivo cifrado:\n$targetName", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                    onDone()
                } else {
                    MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(activity)
                        .setTitle("Error al cifrar")
                        .setMessage(errorMsg ?: "Error desconocido")
                        .setPositiveButton("Aceptar", null)
                        .show()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun decrypt(
        activity: Activity,
        sourcePath: Path,
        password: String,
        deleteEnc: Boolean,
        onDone: () -> Unit
    ) {
        val fileName = sourcePath.fileName.toString()
        val targetName = if (fileName.endsWith(".enc", ignoreCase = true)) {
            fileName.substringBeforeLast(".enc")
        } else {
            "${fileName}_decrypted"
        }
        val targetPath = (sourcePath.parent ?: Paths.get("/storage/emulated/0/Download")).resolve(targetName)

        val progress = MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(activity)
            .setTitle("Descifrando archivo")
            .setMessage("Descifrando $fileName...")
            .setCancelable(false)
            .show()

        kotlin.concurrent.thread {
            var success = false
            var isWrongPassword = false
            var errorMsg: String? = null
            try {
                sourcePath.newInputStream().use { inStream ->
                    val magic = ByteArray(MAGIC_HEADER.size)
                    if (!inStream.readFully(magic) || !magic.contentEquals(MAGIC_HEADER)) {
                        throw IllegalArgumentException("Formato no compatible o archivo no cifrado por OpenManager")
                    }

                    val salt = ByteArray(16)
                    if (!inStream.readFully(salt)) {
                        throw IllegalArgumentException("Archivo corrupto: no se pudo leer la sal")
                    }
                    val iv = ByteArray(16)
                    if (!inStream.readFully(iv)) {
                        throw IllegalArgumentException("Archivo corrupto: no se pudo leer el vector de inicialización")
                    }

                    val keySpec = PBEKeySpec(password.toCharArray(), salt, ITERATIONS, KEY_LENGTH)
                    val factory = SecretKeyFactory.getInstance("PBKDF2WithHmacSHA256")
                    val keyBytes = factory.generateSecret(keySpec).encoded
                    val secretKey = SecretKeySpec(keyBytes, "AES")

                    val cipher = Cipher.getInstance("AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding")
                    cipher.init(Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE, secretKey, IvParameterSpec(iv))

                    targetPath.newOutputStream().use { outStream ->
                        CipherInputStream(inStream, cipher).use { cipherIn ->
                            val buf = ByteArray(65536)
                            var read: Int
                            try {
                                while (cipherIn.read(buf).also { read = it } != -1) {
                                    outStream.write(buf, 0, read)
                                }
                            } catch (e: Exception) {
                                isWrongPassword = true
                                throw e
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (deleteEnc) {
                    try {
                        sourcePath.deleteIfExists()
                    } catch (e: Exception) {
                        e.printStackTrace()
                    }
                }
                success = true
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                e.printStackTrace()
                errorMsg = if (isWrongPassword || e is javax.crypto.BadPaddingException) {
                    "Contraseña incorrecta"
                } else {
                    e.localizedMessage ?: e.javaClass.simpleName
                }
                try {
                    targetPath.deleteIfExists()
                } catch (ignored: Exception) {}
            }

            activity.runOnUiThread {
                if (activity.isFinishing || activity.isDestroyed) return@runOnUiThread
                try { progress.dismiss() } catch (ignored: Exception) {}
                if (success) {
                    Toast.makeText(activity, "Archivo descifrado:\n$targetName", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                    onDone()
                } else {
                    MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(activity)
                        .setTitle("Error al descifrar")
                        .setMessage(errorMsg ?: "Error desconocido")
                        .setPositiveButton("Aceptar", null)
                        .show()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun java.io.InputStream.readFully(b: ByteArray): Boolean {
        var offset = 0
        while (offset < b.size) {
            val count = read(b, offset, b.size - offset)
            if (count == -1) return false
            offset += count
        }
        return true
    }
}
```

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import me.zhanghai.android.files.R
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.FileItem
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.iconRes

object FileIconHelper {
    fun getIconRes(file: FileItem): Int {
        if (file.isParentDirectoryItem) {
            return R.drawable.file_parent_directory_icon
        }
        if (file.attributes.isDirectory) {
            return R.drawable.file_directory_icon
        }
        val lowerName = file.name.lowercase()
        return when {
            lowerName.endsWith(".dex") -> R.drawable.file_dex_icon
            lowerName.endsWith(".arsc") -> R.drawable.file_arsc_icon
            lowerName == "androidmanifest.xml" || lowerName.endsWith(".xml") -> R.drawable.file_xml_mt_icon
            lowerName.endsWith(".so") -> R.drawable.file_so_icon
            lowerName.endsWith(".sh") || lowerName.endsWith(".bash") || lowerName.endsWith(".zsh") -> R.drawable.file_sh_icon
            lowerName.endsWith(".apk") || lowerName.endsWith(".apks") || lowerName.endsWith(".xapk") || lowerName.endsWith(".apkm") -> R.drawable.file_apk_icon
            lowerName.endsWith(".zip") || lowerName.endsWith(".rar") || lowerName.endsWith(".7z") ||
                lowerName.endsWith(".tar") || lowerName.endsWith(".gz") || lowerName.endsWith(".bz2") ||
                lowerName.endsWith(".xz") || lowerName.endsWith(".tgz") || lowerName.endsWith(".zst") -> R.drawable.file_archive_icon
            lowerName.endsWith(".ttf") || lowerName.endsWith(".otf") || lowerName.endsWith(".woff") || lowerName.endsWith(".woff2") -> R.drawable.file_font_icon
            lowerName.endsWith(".mp3") || lowerName.endsWith(".ogg") || lowerName.endsWith(".flac") ||
                lowerName.endsWith(".wav") || lowerName.endsWith(".m4a") || lowerName.endsWith(".aac") ||
                lowerName.endsWith(".opus") || lowerName.endsWith(".wma") -> R.drawable.file_audio_icon
            lowerName.endsWith(".mp4") || lowerName.endsWith(".mkv") || lowerName.endsWith(".avi") ||
                lowerName.endsWith(".mov") || lowerName.endsWith(".flv") || lowerName.endsWith(".webm") ||
                lowerName.endsWith(".3gp") || lowerName.endsWith(".wmv") -> R.drawable.file_video_icon
            lowerName.endsWith(".jpg") || lowerName.endsWith(".jpeg") || lowerName.endsWith(".png") ||
                lowerName.endsWith(".webp") || lowerName.endsWith(".gif") || lowerName.endsWith(".bmp") ||
                lowerName.endsWith(".svg") || lowerName.endsWith(".ico") -> R.drawable.file_image_icon
            lowerName.endsWith(".txt") || lowerName.endsWith(".log") || lowerName.endsWith(".ini") ||
                lowerName.endsWith(".conf") || lowerName.endsWith(".properties") -> R.drawable.file_text_icon
            lowerName.endsWith(".java") || lowerName.endsWith(".kt") || lowerName.endsWith(".c") ||
                lowerName.endsWith(".cpp") || lowerName.endsWith(".h") || lowerName.endsWith(".hpp") ||
                lowerName.endsWith(".py") || lowerName.endsWith(".js") || lowerName.endsWith(".ts") ||
                lowerName.endsWith(".html") || lowerName.endsWith(".css") || lowerName.endsWith(".json") ||
                lowerName.endsWith(".yaml") || lowerName.endsWith(".yml") || lowerName.endsWith(".md") ||
                lowerName.endsWith(".smali") -> R.drawable.file_code_icon
            lowerName.endsWith(".pdf") -> R.drawable.file_pdf_icon
            lowerName.endsWith(".cer") || lowerName.endsWith(".crt") || lowerName.endsWith(".pem") ||
                lowerName.endsWith(".der") || lowerName.endsWith(".p12") || lowerName.endsWith(".bks") ||
                lowerName.endsWith(".jks") -> R.drawable.file_certificate_icon
            else -> file.mimeType.iconRes
        }
    }
}
```

```kt
val FileItem.name: String
    get() = path.name

val FileItem.baseName: String
    get() = if (attributes.isDirectory) name else name.asFileName().baseName

val FileItem.extension: String
    get() = if (attributes.isDirectory) "" else name.asFileName().extensions

fun FileItem.getMimeTypeName(context: Context): String {
        if (attributesNoFollowLinks.isSymbolicLink && isSymbolicLinkBroken) {
            return MimeType.getBrokenSymbolicLinkName(context)
        }
        return mimeType.getName(extension, context)
    }

val FileItem.isArchiveFile: Boolean
    get() = path.isArchiveFile(mimeType)

val FileItem.isInsideRecycleBin: Boolean
    get() = path.isInsideRecycleBin

val FileItem.isListable: Boolean
    get() = attributes.isDirectory || isArchiveFile

val FileItem.listablePath: Path
    get() = if (isArchiveFile) path.createArchiveRootPath() else path

// @see PathAttributesFetcher.fetch
val FileItem.supportsThumbnail: Boolean
    get() {
        if (path.isDocumentPath && attributes.documentSupportsThumbnail) {
            return true
        }
        if (path.isRemotePath) {
            val shouldReadRemotePath = !path.isFtpPath
                && Settings.READ_REMOTE_FILES_FOR_THUMBNAIL.valueCompat
            if (!shouldReadRemotePath) {
                return false
            }
        }
        return when {
            mimeType.isApk && path.isGetPackageArchiveInfoCompatible -> true
            mimeType.isImage -> true
            mimeType.isMedia && path.isMediaMetadataRetrieverCompatible -> true
            mimeType.isPdf && (path.isLinuxPath || path.isDocumentPath) ->
                Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.P
                    || Settings.SHOW_PDF_THUMBNAIL_PRE_28.valueCompat
            else -> false
        }
    }

// @see android.content.pm.parsing.ApkLiteParseUtils.parsePackageSplitNames
// @see android.content.pm.parsing.ParsingPackageUtils.validateName
// @see com.android.server.pm.PackageManagerService.getNextCodePath
private const val PACKAGE_NAME_COMPONENT_PATTERN = "[A-Za-z][0-9A-Z_a-z]*"
private const val PACKAGE_NAME_PATTERN =
    "$PACKAGE_NAME_COMPONENT_PATTERN(?:\\.$PACKAGE_NAME_COMPONENT_PATTERN)+"
private const val BASE64_URL_SAFE_CHARACTER_CLASS = "[0-9A-Za-z\\-_]"
private const val BASE64_URL_SAFE_PATTERN = ("(?:$BASE64_URL_SAFE_CHARACTER_CLASS{4})*"
    + "(?:$BASE64_URL_SAFE_CHARACTER_CLASS{3}=|$BASE64_URL_SAFE_CHARACTER_CLASS{2}==)?")
private val APP_DIRECTORY_REGEX =
    Regex("($PACKAGE_NAME_PATTERN)(?:-$BASE64_URL_SAFE_PATTERN)?")

val FileItem.appDirectoryPackageName: String?
    get() {
        if (!attributes.isDirectory) {
            return null
        }
        return APP_DIRECTORY_REGEX.matchEntire(name)?.groupValues?.get(1)
    }

    FileItem(
        path.createArchiveRootPath(), DummyCollationKey(), DummyArchiveRootBasicFileAttributes(),
        null, null, false, MimeType.DIRECTORY
```

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import android.os.Parcel
import android.os.Parcelable
import java8.nio.file.Path
import me.zhanghai.android.files.compat.writeParcelableListCompat
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.FileItem
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.LinkedMapSet
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.readParcelableListCompat

class FileItemSet() : LinkedMapSet<Path, FileItem>(FileItem::path), Parcelable {
    constructor(parcel: Parcel) : this() {
        addAll(parcel.readParcelableListCompat())
    }

    override fun writeToParcel(parcel: Parcel, flags: Int) {
        parcel.writeParcelableListCompat(toList(), flags)
    }

    override fun describeContents(): Int = 0

    companion object CREATOR : Parcelable.Creator<FileItemSet> {
        override fun createFromParcel(parcel: Parcel): FileItemSet = FileItemSet(parcel)

        override fun newArray(size: Int): Array<FileItemSet?> = arrayOfNulls(size)
    }
}

fun fileItemSetOf(vararg files: FileItem) = FileItemSet().apply { addAll(files) }
fun fileItemSetOf(files: Iterable<FileItem>) = FileItemSet().apply { addAll(files) }
fun Iterable<FileItem>.toFileItemSet(): FileItemSet = FileItemSet().apply { addAll(this@toFileItemSet) }
```

```kt
class FileListActivity : AppActivity() {

    private lateinit var drawerLayout: DrawerLayout
    private lateinit var fragmentA: FileListFragment
    private lateinit var fragmentB: FileListFragment

    private lateinit var mainToolbar: Toolbar
    private lateinit var btnMainBack: ImageButton
    private lateinit var tvPathTitle: TextView
    private lateinit var tvStatsSubtitle: TextView
    private lateinit var btnMainMore: ImageButton

    private lateinit var containerA: FrameLayout
    private lateinit var containerB: FrameLayout
    private lateinit var paneDivider: View

    private lateinit var bottomBarNormal: LinearLayout
    private lateinit var bottomBarSelection: LinearLayout

    private lateinit var btnBottomBack: ImageButton
    private lateinit var btnBottomForward: ImageButton
    private lateinit var btnBottomAdd: ImageButton
    private lateinit var btnBottomSwap: ImageButton
    private lateinit var btnBottomUp: ImageButton

    private lateinit var btnSelectAll: TextView
    private lateinit var btnCopyOpposite: TextView
    private lateinit var btnMoveOpposite: TextView
    private lateinit var btnDeleteSelection: TextView
    private lateinit var btnMoreSelection: TextView

    private lateinit var progressRootStorage: ProgressBar
    private lateinit var tvRootStorageStats: TextView
    private lateinit var progressInternalStorage: ProgressBar
    private lateinit var tvInternalStorageStats: TextView
    private lateinit var layoutCustomStorages: LinearLayout
    private var hasRequestedPermissionThisSession = false
    private var hasRequestedNotificationThisSession = false
    private var allFilesDialog: androidx.appcompat.app.AlertDialog? = null

    private var activePanelIndex = 0 // 0 = Panel A, 1 = Panel B
    val sharedRecycledViewPool = androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView.RecycledViewPool().apply {
        setMaxRecycledViews(0, 36)
    }

    val activeFragment: FileListFragment
        get() = if (activePanelIndex == 0) fragmentA else fragmentB

    fun getOppositeFragment(fragment: FileListFragment): FileListFragment =
        if (fragment == fragmentA) fragmentB else fragmentA

    fun isFragmentA(fragment: FileListFragment): Boolean =
        (::fragmentA.isInitialized && fragment === fragmentA)

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)

        setContentView(R.layout.file_list_activity)
        me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.root.ShizukuManager.init(this)

        drawerLayout = findViewById(R.id.drawerLayout)
        // Permanently lock closed swipe gestures so swiping from screen edge never triggers the drawer (MT Manager style)
        drawerLayout.setDrawerLockMode(DrawerLayout.LOCK_MODE_LOCKED_CLOSED)
        drawerLayout.addDrawerListener(object : DrawerLayout.SimpleDrawerListener() {
            override fun onDrawerOpened(drawerView: View) {
                drawerLayout.setDrawerLockMode(DrawerLayout.LOCK_MODE_UNLOCKED)
                updateDrawerStats()
                refreshCustomStoragesList()
            }
            override fun onDrawerClosed(drawerView: View) {
                drawerLayout.setDrawerLockMode(DrawerLayout.LOCK_MODE_LOCKED_CLOSED)
            }
        })
        mainToolbar = findViewById(R.id.mainToolbar)
        mainToolbar.setNavigationIcon(R.drawable.menu_icon_control_normal_24dp)
        mainToolbar.navigationIcon?.mutate()?.setTint(android.graphics.Color.WHITE)
        mainToolbar.setNavigationOnClickListener {
            drawerLayout.openDrawer(GravityCompat.START)
        }

        btnMainBack = findViewById(R.id.btnMainBack)
        btnMainBack.setOnClickListener {
            activeFragment.navigateUp()
        }

        btnMainMore = findViewById(R.id.btnMainMore)
        btnMainMore.setOnClickListener {
            showMTMoreMenu(it)
        }

        tvPathTitle = findViewById(R.id.tvPathTitle)
        tvStatsSubtitle = findViewById(R.id.tvStatsSubtitle)
        findViewById<View>(R.id.layoutPathTitle)?.let { layout ->
            layout.setOnClickListener {
                showJumpToPathDialog()
            }
            layout.setOnLongClickListener {
                try {
                    val fullPath = activeFragment.currentPath.toDisplayPath(trailingSlash = true)
                    val clipboard = getSystemService(Context.CLIPBOARD_SERVICE) as? android.content.ClipboardManager
                    clipboard?.setPrimaryClip(android.content.ClipData.newPlainText("path", fullPath))
                    android.widget.Toast.makeText(this, "Ruta copiada: $fullPath", android.widget.Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    true
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    false
                }
            }
        }

        containerA = findViewById(R.id.containerPanelA)
        containerB = findViewById(R.id.containerPanelB)
        paneDivider = findViewById(R.id.paneDivider)

        containerA.setOnClickListener { onPanelFocused(fragmentA) }
        containerB.setOnClickListener { onPanelFocused(fragmentB) }

        bottomBarNormal = findViewById(R.id.bottomBarNormal)
        bottomBarSelection = findViewById(R.id.bottomBarSelection)

        btnBottomBack = findViewById(R.id.btnBottomBack)
        btnBottomForward = findViewById(R.id.btnBottomForward)
        btnBottomAdd = findViewById(R.id.btnBottomAdd)
        btnBottomSwap = findViewById(R.id.btnBottomSwap)
        btnBottomUp = findViewById(R.id.btnBottomUp)

        btnSelectAll = findViewById(R.id.btnSelectAll)
        btnCopyOpposite = findViewById(R.id.btnCopyOpposite)
        btnMoveOpposite = findViewById(R.id.btnMoveOpposite)
        btnDeleteSelection = findViewById(R.id.btnDeleteSelection)
        btnMoreSelection = findViewById(R.id.btnMoreSelection)

        if (savedInstanceState == null) {
            val intentA = Intent(intent)
            if (intentA.extraPath == null) {
                intentA.extraPath = Settings.FILE_LIST_DEFAULT_DIRECTORY.valueCompat
            }
            fragmentA = FileListFragment().putArgs(FileListFragment.Args(intentA))

            val intentB = Intent(intent)
            if (intentB.extraPath == null) {
                intentB.extraPath = Settings.FILE_LIST_DEFAULT_DIRECTORY_RIGHT.valueCompat
            }
            fragmentB = FileListFragment().putArgs(FileListFragment.Args(intentB))

            supportFragmentManager.commit {
                add(R.id.containerPanelA, fragmentA, TAG_PANEL_A)
                add(R.id.containerPanelB, fragmentB, TAG_PANEL_B)
            }
        } else {
            fragmentA = supportFragmentManager.findFragmentByTag(TAG_PANEL_A) as FileListFragment
            fragmentB = supportFragmentManager.findFragmentByTag(TAG_PANEL_B) as FileListFragment
            activePanelIndex = savedInstanceState.getInt(KEY_ACTIVE_PANEL, 0)
        }

        if (Settings.AUTO_START_SERVICES.valueCompat == "1") {
            try {
                FtpServerService.start(this)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                e.printStackTrace()
            }
        }

        if (Settings.REQUEST_ROOT_PERMISSION.valueCompat) {
            kotlin.concurrent.thread {
                try {
                    me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.root.LibSuFileServiceLauncher.initBuilder()
                    com.topjohnwu.superuser.Shell.getShell()
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    e.printStackTrace()
                }
            }
        } else if (Settings.REQUEST_SHELL_PERMISSION.valueCompat) {
            if (me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.root.ShizukuManager.isAvailable() &&
                !me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.root.ShizukuManager.hasPermission()
            ) {
                me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.root.ShizukuManager.requestPermission(this) {
                    me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.root.SuperuserDetector.cachedStatus = null
                }
            }
        }

        setupDrawerControls()
        setupBottomBarControls()
        setupBackPressedHandler()
        checkAutoCleanRecycleBin()

        if (savedInstanceState == null && Settings.AUTO_CHECK_UPDATES.valueCompat) {
            me.zhanghai.android.files.update.UpdateChecker.checkUpdate(this, isManual = false)
        }

        val demoFilter = IntentFilter("me.zhanghai.android.files.action.DEMO")
        androidx.core.content.ContextCompat.registerReceiver(
            this,
            demoReceiver,
            demoFilter,
            androidx.core.content.ContextCompat.RECEIVER_EXPORTED
        )
    }

    override fun onDestroy() {
        super.onDestroy()
        try {
            unregisterReceiver(demoReceiver)
        } catch (ignored: Exception) {}
    }

    override fun onPostCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onPostCreate(savedInstanceState)
        syncPanelColors()
        updateTopBarInfo()
        syncBottomBarSelectionState()
        observePanelPathsAndStats()
        updateDrawerStats()
        updateMainToolbarNavigationIcon()
        handleDemoIntent(intent)
        handleApktoolIntent(intent)
    }

    override fun onResume() {
        super.onResume()
        checkAndRequestStoragePermissions()
        updateDrawerStats()
        handleDemoIntent(intent)
        handleApktoolIntent(intent)
    }

    override fun onNewIntent(intent: Intent) {
        super.onNewIntent(intent)
        setIntent(intent)
        handleDemoIntent(intent)
        handleApktoolIntent(intent)
    }

    private val demoReceiver = object : android.content.BroadcastReceiver() {
        override fun onReceive(context: Context, intent: Intent) {
            val action = intent.getStringExtra("action") ?: return
            android.util.Log.i("DemoReceiver", "Received demo action: $action")
            handleDemoAction(action)
        }
    }

    private fun handleApktoolIntent(intent: Intent?) {
        if (intent == null) return

        if (intent.getBooleanExtra(EXTRA_SHOW_APKTOOL_PROGRESS, false)) {
            intent.removeExtra(EXTRA_SHOW_APKTOOL_PROGRESS)
            if (ApktoolExecutionService.isRunning()) {
                ApktoolHelper.showProgressDialog(this)
            }
        }

        val navigatePath = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_NAVIGATE_TO_PATH)
        if (!navigatePath.isNullOrBlank()) {
            intent.removeExtra(EXTRA_NAVIGATE_TO_PATH)
            try {
                val path = Paths.get(navigatePath)
                if (this::fragmentA.isInitialized) {
                    activeFragment.navigateTo(path)
                }
            } catch (ignored: Throwable) {}
        }
    }

    private fun handleDemoIntent(intent: Intent?) {
        if (!BuildConfig.DEBUG) return
        val action = intent?.getStringExtra("SHOW_DEMO_DIALOG") ?: return
        intent.removeExtra("SHOW_DEMO_DIALOG")
        handleDemoAction(action)
    }

    fun handleDemoAction(action: String) {
        android.util.Log.i("DemoReceiver", "Executing demo action: $action")
        window.decorView.postDelayed({
            try {
                when (action) {
                    "drawer" -> drawerLayout.openDrawer(GravityCompat.START)
                    "close_drawer" -> drawerLayout.closeDrawer(GravityCompat.START)
                    "more_menu" -> findViewById<View>(R.id.btnMainMore)?.performClick()
                    "create_choice" -> showCreateDialog()
                    "keystore" -> {
                        if (this::fragmentA.isInitialized) {
                            activeFragment.showKeystoreGeneratorDialog()
                        }
                    }
                    "apktool_hub" -> {
                        if (this::fragmentA.isInitialized) {
                            ApktoolHelper.showApktoolHubDialog(this, activeFragment.currentPath)
                        }
                    }
                    "apps" -> startActivity(Intent(this, InstalledAppsActivity::class.java))
                    "running", "running_apps" -> startActivity(Intent(this, RunningAppsActivity::class.java))
                    "editor" -> {
                        val sampleFile = java.io.File(filesDir, "sample_test.kt")
                        if (!sampleFile.exists()) {
                            sampleFile.writeText("// OpenManager Fast Code Editor\npackage demo\n\nfun main() {\n    println(\"OpenManager 100% Verified!\")\n}\n")
                        }
                        val samplePath = java8.nio.file.Paths.get(sampleFile.absolutePath)
                        val editIntent = Intent(this, me.zhanghai.android.files.viewer.text.TextEditorActivity::class.java).apply {
                            extraPath = samplePath
                        }
                        startActivity(editIntent)
                    }
                    "settings" -> startActivity(Intent(this, me.zhanghai.android.files.settings.SettingsActivity::class.java))
                    "add_storage" -> startActivity(Intent(this, me.zhanghai.android.files.storage.AddStorageDialogActivity::class.java))
                    "ftp" -> startActivity(Intent(this, me.zhanghai.android.files.ftpserver.FtpServerActivity::class.java))
                    "about" -> startActivity(Intent(this, me.zhanghai.android.files.about.AboutActivity::class.java))
                    "script_dialog" -> {
                        val sampleScript = java.io.File(filesDir, "install_module.sh")
                        sampleScript.writeText("#!/system/bin/sh\n# Script de prueba OpenManager\necho \"Ejecutando script con permisos 777...\"\nid\n")
                        sampleScript.setExecutable(true, false)
                        val scriptPath = java8.nio.file.Paths.get(sampleScript.absolutePath)
                        me.zhanghai.android.files.fileproperties.permission.MtPermissionsHelper.applyPermissions(
                            context = this,
                            path = scriptPath,
                            newMode = me.zhanghai.android.files.fileproperties.permission.MtPermissionsHelper.modeFromInt(0b111_111_111)
                        )
                        ScriptRunnerHelper.showScriptActionDialog(this, scriptPath)
                    }
                    "permissions_dialog" -> {
```
