import me.zhanghai.android.files.compat.foregroundCompat
import me.zhanghai.android.files.compat.getDrawableCompat
import me.zhanghai.android.files.compat.isSingleLineCompat
import me.zhanghai.android.files.databinding.FileItemGridBinding
import me.zhanghai.android.files.databinding.FileItemListBinding
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.FileItem
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.fileSize
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.formatMtDate
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.formatShort
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.iconRes
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.isApk
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.archive.isArchivePath
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.common.isEncrypted
import me.zhanghai.android.files.settings.Settings
import me.zhanghai.android.files.ui.AnimatedListAdapter
import me.zhanghai.android.files.ui.CheckableForegroundLinearLayout
import me.zhanghai.android.files.ui.CheckableItemBackground
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.isMaterial3Theme
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.layoutInflater
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.valueCompat
import java.util.Locale

class FileListAdapter(
    private val listener: Listener
) : AnimatedListAdapter<FileItem, FileListAdapter.ViewHolder>(CALLBACK), PopupTextProvider {
    private var isSearching = false

    private lateinit var _viewType: FileViewType
    var viewType: FileViewType
        get() = _viewType
        set(value) {
            _viewType = value
            if (!isSearching) {
                super.replace(list, true)
            }
        }

    private lateinit var _sortOptions: FileSortOptions
    var sortOptions: FileSortOptions
        get() = _sortOptions
        set(value) {
            _sortOptions = value
            if (!isSearching) {
                val parentItem = list.firstOrNull { it.isParentDirectoryItem }
                val otherFiles = if (parentItem != null) list.filterNot { it.isParentDirectoryItem } else list
                val sortedOthers = otherFiles.sortedWith(value.createComparator())
                val sortedList = if (parentItem != null) {
                    listOf(parentItem) + sortedOthers
                } else {
                    sortedOthers
                }
                super.replace(sortedList, false)
                rebuildFilePositionMap()
            }
        }

    var pickOptions: PickOptions? = null
        set(value) {
            field = value
            notifyItemRangeChanged(0, itemCount, PAYLOAD_STATE_CHANGED)
        }

    private val selectedFiles = fileItemSetOf()

    private val filePositionMap = mutableMapOf<Path, Int>()

    private lateinit var _nameEllipsize: TextUtils.TruncateAt
    var nameEllipsize: TextUtils.TruncateAt
        get() = _nameEllipsize
        set(value) {
            _nameEllipsize = value
            notifyItemRangeChanged(0, itemCount, PAYLOAD_STATE_CHANGED)
        }

    var maxLines: Int = 2
        set(value) {
            if (field != value) {
                field = value
                notifyItemRangeChanged(0, itemCount, PAYLOAD_STATE_CHANGED)
            }
        }

    var fileListSize: Int = 0
        set(value) {
            if (field != value) {
                field = value
                notifyItemRangeChanged(0, itemCount, PAYLOAD_STATE_CHANGED)
            }
        }

    fun replaceSelectedFiles(files: FileItemSet) {
        val changedFiles = fileItemSetOf()
        val iterator = selectedFiles.iterator()
        while (iterator.hasNext()) {
            val file = iterator.next()
            if (file !in files) {
                iterator.remove()
                changedFiles.add(file)
            }
        }
        for (file in files) {
            if (file !in selectedFiles) {
                selectedFiles.add(file)
                changedFiles.add(file)
            }
        }
        for (file in changedFiles) {
            val position = filePositionMap[file.path]
            position?.let { notifyItemChanged(it, PAYLOAD_STATE_CHANGED) }
        }
    }

    private fun selectFile(file: FileItem) {
        if (file.isParentDirectoryItem || !isFileSelectable(file)) {
            return
        }
        val selected = file in selectedFiles
        val pickOptions = pickOptions
        if (!selected && pickOptions != null && !pickOptions.allowMultiple) {
            listener.clearSelectedFiles()
        }
        listener.selectFile(file, !selected)
    }

    fun selectAllFiles() {
        val files = fileItemSetOf()
        for (index in 0..<itemCount) {
            val file = getItem(index)
            if (!file.isParentDirectoryItem && isFileSelectable(file)) {
                files.add(file)
            }
        }
        listener.selectFiles(files, true)
    }

    fun invertSelection() {
        val filesToSelect = fileItemSetOf()
        val filesToDeselect = fileItemSetOf()
        for (index in 0..<itemCount) {
            val file = getItem(index)
            if (!file.isParentDirectoryItem && isFileSelectable(file)) {
                if (file in selectedFiles) {
                    filesToDeselect.add(file)
                } else {
                    filesToSelect.add(file)
                }
            }
        }
        if (filesToDeselect.isNotEmpty()) {
            listener.selectFiles(filesToDeselect, false)
        }
        if (filesToSelect.isNotEmpty()) {
            listener.selectFiles(filesToSelect, true)
        }
    }

    fun getPositionForFile(file: FileItem): Int = filePositionMap[file.path] ?: -1

    fun getItemOrNull(position: Int): FileItem? =
        if (position in 0 until itemCount) getItem(position) else null

    fun getSelectableFilesInRange(fromPosition: Int, toPosition: Int): FileItemSet {
        val start = minOf(fromPosition, toPosition).coerceAtLeast(0)
        val end = maxOf(fromPosition, toPosition).coerceAtMost(itemCount - 1)
        val result = fileItemSetOf()
        for (i in start..end) {
            val file = getItem(i)
            if (!file.isParentDirectoryItem && isFileSelectable(file)) {
                result.add(file)
            }
        }
        return result
    }

    val selectableItemCount: Int
        get() {
            var count = 0
            for (i in 0 until itemCount) {
                val file = getItem(i)
                if (!file.isParentDirectoryItem && isFileSelectable(file)) {
                    count++
                }
            }
            return count
        }

    fun isFileSelectable(file: FileItem): Boolean {
        if (file.isParentDirectoryItem) {
            return false
        }
        val pickOptions = pickOptions ?: return true
        return when (pickOptions.mode) {
            PickOptions.Mode.OPEN_FILE, PickOptions.Mode.CREATE_FILE ->
                !file.attributes.isDirectory &&
                    pickOptions.mimeTypes.any { it.match(file.mimeType) }
            PickOptions.Mode.OPEN_DIRECTORY -> file.attributes.isDirectory
        }
    }

    override fun clear() {
        super.clear()

        rebuildFilePositionMap()
    }

    @Deprecated("", ReplaceWith("replaceListAndSearching(list, searching)"))
    override fun replace(list: List<FileItem>, clear: Boolean) {
        throw UnsupportedOperationException()
    }

    fun replaceListAndIsSearching(list: List<FileItem>, isSearching: Boolean) {
        val clear = this.isSearching != isSearching
        this.isSearching = isSearching
        val sortedList = if (!isSearching) {
            val parentItem = list.firstOrNull { it.isParentDirectoryItem }
            val otherFiles = if (parentItem != null) list.filterNot { it.isParentDirectoryItem } else list
            val sortedOthers = otherFiles.sortedWith(sortOptions.createComparator())
            if (parentItem != null) {
                listOf(parentItem) + sortedOthers
            } else {
                sortedOthers
            }
        } else {
            list
        }
        super.replace(sortedList, clear)
        rebuildFilePositionMap()
    }

    private fun rebuildFilePositionMap() {
        filePositionMap.clear()
        for (index in 0..<itemCount) {
            val file = getItem(index)
            filePositionMap[file.path] = index
        }
    }

    override fun getItemViewType(position: Int): Int = viewType.ordinal

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): ViewHolder {
        val viewType = FileViewType.entries[viewType]
        val inflater = parent.context.layoutInflater
        val holder = when (viewType) {
            FileViewType.LIST -> ViewHolder(FileItemListBinding.inflate(inflater, parent, false))
            FileViewType.GRID -> ViewHolder(FileItemGridBinding.inflate(inflater, parent, false))
        }
        return holder.apply {
            itemLayout.apply {
                val context = context
                val isMaterial3Theme = context.isMaterial3Theme
                if (viewType == FileViewType.GRID && isMaterial3Theme) {
                    foregroundCompat =
                        context.getDrawableCompat(R.drawable.file_item_grid_foreground_material3)
                }
                background = if (viewType == FileViewType.GRID && isMaterial3Theme) {
                    CheckableItemBackground.create(4f, 12f, context)
                } else {
                    CheckableItemBackground.create(0f, 0f, context)
                }
            }
            thumbnailOutlineView?.apply {
                val context = context
                if (context.isMaterial3Theme) {
                    background = context.getDrawableCompat(
                        R.drawable.file_item_grid_thumbnail_outline_material3
                    )
                }
            }
            popupMenu = PopupMenu(itemLayout.context, itemLayout)
                .apply { inflate(R.menu.file_item) }
            menuButton.setOnClickListener { popupMenu.show() }
        }
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: ViewHolder, position: Int) {
        throw UnsupportedOperationException()
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: ViewHolder, position: Int, payloads: List<Any>) {
        val file = getItem(position)
        val isDirectory = file.attributes.isDirectory
        val isEnabled = isFileSelectable(file) || isDirectory
        holder.itemLayout.isEnabled = isEnabled
        holder.menuButton.isVisible = false
        val menu = holder.popupMenu.menu
        val path = file.path
        val hasPickOptions = pickOptions != null
        val isReadOnly = path.fileSystem.isReadOnly
        menu.findItem(R.id.action_cut).isVisible = !hasPickOptions && !isReadOnly
        menu.findItem(R.id.action_copy).isVisible = !hasPickOptions
        val checked = file in selectedFiles
        holder.itemLayout.isChecked = checked
        holder.nameText.apply {
            maxLines = this@FileListAdapter.maxLines
            if (this@FileListAdapter.maxLines == 1) {
                val nameEllipsize = nameEllipsize
                ellipsize = nameEllipsize
                isSelected = nameEllipsize == TextUtils.TruncateAt.MARQUEE
            } else {
                ellipsize = TextUtils.TruncateAt.END
                isSelected = false
            }
        }
        val density = holder.itemView.resources.displayMetrics.density
        val targetHeightPx = when (fileListSize) {
            1 -> (52 * density).toInt()
            2 -> (62 * density).toInt()
            else -> (44 * density).toInt()
        }
        val lp = holder.itemLayout.layoutParams
        if (lp != null && lp.height != targetHeightPx) {
            lp.height = targetHeightPx
            holder.itemLayout.layoutParams = lp
        }
        if (file.isParentDirectoryItem) {
            holder.itemLayout.isEnabled = true
            holder.itemLayout.isChecked = false
            holder.menuButton.isVisible = false
            holder.nameText.text = ".."
            holder.descriptionText?.isVisible = false
            holder.itemLayout.setOnClickListener { listener.navigateUp() }
            holder.iconLayout.setOnClickListener { listener.navigateUp() }
            holder.itemLayout.setOnLongClickListener { false }
            holder.iconImage.apply {
                isVisible = true
                setImageResource(R.drawable.file_parent_directory_icon)
            }
            holder.directoryThumbnailImage?.isVisible = false
            holder.thumbnailOutlineView?.isVisible = false
            holder.thumbnailIconImage?.apply {
                dispose()
                isVisible = false
                setImageDrawable(null)
            }
            holder.thumbnailImage.apply {
                dispose()
                isVisible = false
                setImageDrawable(null)
            }
            holder.appIconBadgeImage.apply {
                dispose()
                isVisible = false
                setImageDrawable(null)
            }
            holder.badgeImage.isVisible = false
            return
        }
        if (payloads.isNotEmpty()) {
            return
        }
        bindViewHolderAnimation(holder)
        holder.itemLayout.apply {
            setOnClickListener {
                if (selectedFiles.isEmpty()) {
                    listener.openFile(file)
                } else {
                    selectFile(file)
                }
            }
            setOnLongClickListener {
                listener.showMtMenu(file)
                true
            }
        }
        holder.iconLayout.setOnClickListener { selectFile(file) }
        val attributes = file.attributes
        val isSymlink = file.attributesNoFollowLinks.isSymbolicLink
        if (isSymlink) {
            holder.nameText.text = "${file.name} ->"
        } else {
            holder.nameText.text = file.name
        }

        val appDirectoryPackageName = file.appDirectoryPackageName
        val appLabel = if (isDirectory && appDirectoryPackageName != null) {
            AppMetadataCache.getAppLabel(holder.itemView.context, appDirectoryPackageName)
        } else {
            null
        }

        holder.descriptionText?.isVisible = true
        val lastModificationTime = attributes.lastModifiedTime().toInstant().formatMtDate()
        holder.descriptionText?.text = if (isDirectory) {
            if (appLabel != null) "$lastModificationTime  $appLabel" else lastModificationTime
        } else {
            val size = attributes.fileSize.formatHumanReadable(holder.itemView.context)
            "$lastModificationTime  $size"
        }

        val iconRes = FileIconHelper.getIconRes(file)
        holder.iconImage.apply {
            isVisible = true
            setImageResource(iconRes)
        }
        holder.directoryThumbnailImage?.isVisible = isDirectory
        holder.thumbnailOutlineView?.isVisible = !isDirectory
        val supportsThumbnail = file.supportsThumbnail
        val shouldLoadThumbnailIcon = supportsThumbnail && holder.thumbnailIconImage != null &&
            file.mimeType.isApk
        holder.thumbnailIconImage?.apply {
            dispose()
            isVisible = !isDirectory
            setImageResource(iconRes)
            if (shouldLoadThumbnailIcon) {
                load(path to attributes)
            }
        }
        holder.thumbnailImage.apply {
            dispose()
            setImageDrawable(null)
            if (isDirectory && appLabel != null && appDirectoryPackageName != null) {
                isVisible = true
                load(AppIconPackageName(appDirectoryPackageName)) {
                    listener(
                        onSuccess = { _, _ -> holder.iconImage.isVisible = false },
                        onError = { _, _ ->
                            holder.iconImage.isVisible = true
                            holder.iconImage.setImageResource(R.drawable.file_directory_icon)
                        }
                    )
                }
            } else {
                val shouldLoadThumbnail = supportsThumbnail && !shouldLoadThumbnailIcon
                isVisible = shouldLoadThumbnail
                if (shouldLoadThumbnail) {
                    load(path to attributes) {
                        listener { _, _ ->
                            val iconImage = holder.thumbnailIconImage ?: holder.iconImage
                            iconImage.isVisible = false
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        holder.appIconBadgeImage.apply {
            dispose()
            setImageDrawable(null)
            val hasAppIconBadge = !isDirectory && appDirectoryPackageName != null
            isVisible = hasAppIconBadge
            if (hasAppIconBadge) {
                load(AppIconPackageName(appDirectoryPackageName!!))
            }
        }
        holder.badgeImage.apply {
            val badgeIconRes = if (file.attributesNoFollowLinks.isSymbolicLink) {
                if (file.isSymbolicLinkBroken) {
                    R.drawable.error_badge_icon_18dp
                } else {
                    R.drawable.symbolic_link_badge_icon_18dp
                }
            } else if (file.attributesNoFollowLinks.isEncrypted()) {
                R.drawable.encrypted_badge_icon_18dp
            } else {
                null
            }
            val hasBadge = badgeIconRes != null
            isVisible = hasBadge
            if (hasBadge) {
                setImageResource(badgeIconRes!!)
            } else {
                setImageDrawable(null)
            }
        }
        val isArchivePath = path.isArchivePath
        menu.findItem(R.id.action_copy)
            .setTitle(if (isArchivePath) R.string.file_item_action_extract else R.string.copy)
        menu.findItem(R.id.action_delete).isVisible = !isReadOnly
        menu.findItem(R.id.action_rename).isVisible = !isReadOnly
        menu.findItem(R.id.action_extract).isVisible = file.isArchiveFile
        menu.findItem(R.id.action_archive).isVisible = !isArchivePath
        menu.findItem(R.id.action_add_bookmark).isVisible = isDirectory
        menu.findItem(R.id.action_copy_opposite)?.isVisible = !hasPickOptions
        menu.findItem(R.id.action_move_opposite)?.isVisible = !hasPickOptions && !isReadOnly
        menu.findItem(R.id.action_swap_file_names)?.isVisible = !isReadOnly
        menu.findItem(R.id.action_split_file)?.isVisible = !isDirectory && !isArchivePath
        menu.findItem(R.id.action_merge_files)?.isVisible = FileSplitMergeHelper.isSplitPart(file)
        menu.findItem(R.id.action_create_symlink)?.isVisible = !isArchivePath
        holder.popupMenu.setOnMenuItemClickListener {
            when (it.itemId) {
                R.id.action_open_with -> {
                    listener.openFileWith(file)
                    true
                }
                R.id.action_copy_opposite -> {
                    listener.copyFileToOppositePanel(file)
                    true
                }
                R.id.action_move_opposite -> {
                    listener.moveFileToOppositePanel(file)
                    true
                }
                R.id.action_cut -> {
                    listener.cutFile(file)
                    true
                }
                R.id.action_copy -> {
                    listener.copyFile(file)
                    true
                }
                R.id.action_delete -> {
                    listener.confirmDeleteFile(file)
                    true
                }
                R.id.action_rename -> {
                    listener.showRenameFileDialog(file)
                    true
                }
                R.id.action_extract -> {
                    listener.extractFile(file)
                    true
                }
                R.id.action_archive -> {
                    listener.showCreateArchiveDialog(file)
                    true
                }
                R.id.action_share -> {
                    listener.shareFile(file)
                    true
                }
                R.id.action_copy_path -> {
                    listener.copyPath(file)
                    true
                }
                R.id.action_add_bookmark -> {
                    listener.addBookmark(file)
                    true
                }
                R.id.action_create_shortcut -> {
                    listener.createShortcut(file)
                    true
                }
                R.id.action_swap_file_names -> {
                    listener.swapFileNames(file)
                    true
                }
                R.id.action_split_file -> {
                    listener.splitFile(file)
                    true
                }
                R.id.action_merge_files -> {
                    listener.mergeFiles(file)
                    true
                }
                R.id.action_create_symlink -> {
                    listener.createSymlink(file)
                    true
                }
                R.id.action_permissions -> {
                    listener.showPermissionsDialog(file)
                    true
                }
                R.id.action_properties -> {
                    listener.showPropertiesDialog(file)
                    true
                }
                else -> false
            }
        }
    }

    override fun onViewRecycled(holder: ViewHolder) {
        super.onViewRecycled(holder)
        holder.thumbnailImage.dispose()
        holder.thumbnailImage.setImageDrawable(null)
        holder.thumbnailIconImage?.dispose()
        holder.thumbnailIconImage?.setImageDrawable(null)
        holder.appIconBadgeImage.dispose()
        holder.appIconBadgeImage.setImageDrawable(null)
    }

    override fun getPopupText(view: View, position: Int): CharSequence {
        val file = getItem(position)
        if (file.isParentDirectoryItem) {
            return ".."
        }
        return when (sortOptions.by) {
            FileSortOptions.By.NAME -> file.name.take(1).uppercase(Locale.getDefault())
            FileSortOptions.By.TYPE -> file.extension.uppercase(Locale.getDefault())
            FileSortOptions.By.SIZE -> file.attributes.fileSize.formatHumanReadable(view.context)
            FileSortOptions.By.LAST_MODIFIED ->
                file.attributes.lastModifiedTime().toInstant().formatMtDate()
        }
    }

    override val isAnimationEnabled: Boolean
        get() = Settings.FILE_LIST_ANIMATION.valueCompat

    companion object {
        private val PAYLOAD_STATE_CHANGED = Any()

        private val CALLBACK = object : DiffUtil.ItemCallback<FileItem>() {
            override fun areItemsTheSame(oldItem: FileItem, newItem: FileItem): Boolean =
                oldItem.path == newItem.path

            override fun areContentsTheSame(oldItem: FileItem, newItem: FileItem): Boolean =
                oldItem == newItem
        }
    }

    class ViewHolder private constructor(
        root: View,
        val itemLayout: CheckableForegroundLinearLayout,
        val iconLayout: View,
        val iconImage: ImageView,
        val directoryThumbnailImage: ImageView?,
        val thumbnailOutlineView: View?,
        val thumbnailIconImage: ImageView?,
        val thumbnailImage: ImageView,
        val appIconBadgeImage: ImageView,
        val badgeImage: ImageView,
        val nameText: TextView,
        val descriptionText: TextView?,
        val menuButton: ImageButton
    ) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(root) {
        constructor(binding: FileItemListBinding) : this(
            binding.root,
            binding.itemLayout,
            binding.iconLayout,
            binding.iconImage,
            null,
            null,
            null,
            binding.thumbnailImage,
            binding.appIconBadgeImage,
            binding.badgeImage,
            binding.nameText,
            binding.descriptionText,
            binding.menuButton
        )

        constructor(binding: FileItemGridBinding) : this(
            binding.root,
            binding.itemLayout,
            binding.iconLayout,
            binding.iconImage,
            binding.directoryThumbnailImage,
            binding.thumbnailOutlineView,
            binding.thumbnailIconImage,
            binding.thumbnailImage,
            binding.appIconBadgeImage,
            binding.badgeImage,
            binding.nameText,
            null,
            binding.menuButton
        )

        lateinit var popupMenu: PopupMenu
    }

    interface Listener {
        fun navigateUp()
        fun clearSelectedFiles()
        fun selectFile(file: FileItem, selected: Boolean)
        fun selectFiles(files: FileItemSet, selected: Boolean)
        fun openFile(file: FileItem)
        fun openFileWith(file: FileItem)
        fun cutFile(file: FileItem)
        fun copyFile(file: FileItem)
        fun copyFileToOppositePanel(file: FileItem)
        fun moveFileToOppositePanel(file: FileItem)
        fun confirmDeleteFile(file: FileItem)
        fun showRenameFileDialog(file: FileItem)
        fun extractFile(file: FileItem)
        fun showCreateArchiveDialog(file: FileItem)
        fun shareFile(file: FileItem)
        fun copyPath(file: FileItem)
        fun addBookmark(file: FileItem)
        fun createShortcut(file: FileItem)
        fun swapFileNames(file: FileItem)
        fun splitFile(file: FileItem)
        fun mergeFiles(file: FileItem)
        fun createSymlink(file: FileItem)
        fun showPermissionsDialog(file: FileItem)
        fun showPropertiesDialog(file: FileItem)
        fun showMtMenu(file: FileItem)
    }
}

        RequestPermissionInSettingsContract(android.Manifest.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE),
        this::onRequestStoragePermissionInSettingsResult
    )
    @RequiresApi(Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU)
    private val requestNotificationPermissionLauncher = registerForActivityResult(
        ActivityResultContracts.RequestPermission(), this::onRequestNotificationPermissionResult
    )
    @RequiresApi(Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU)

        this::onRequestNotificationPermissionInSettingsResult
    )

    private var pendingSafIsObb = false
    private var lastPromptedSafPath: Path? = null

    private val requestSafPermissionLauncher = registerForActivityResult(
        ActivityResultContracts.OpenDocumentTree()
    ) { uri ->
        if (uri != null) {
            val flags = Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION or Intent.FLAG_GRANT_WRITE_URI_PERMISSION
            try {
                requireContext().contentResolver.takePersistableUriPermission(uri, flags)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                e.printStackTrace()
            }
            val treeUri = uri.asDocumentTreeUriOrNull()
            if (treeUri != null) {
                val isObb = pendingSafIsObb
                val name = if (isObb) "Android/obb" else "Android/data"
                val documentTree = DocumentTree(null, name, treeUri)
                Storages.addOrReplace(documentTree)
                navigateTo(documentTree.path)
                showToast(getString(R.string.saf_permission_granted_format, name))
            }
        }
    }

    private fun isAndroidData(path: Path): Boolean {
        if (path.isArchivePath) return false
        val pathStr = path.toString()
        return pathStr.contains("/Android/data", ignoreCase = true) ||
               pathStr.endsWith("/Android/data", ignoreCase = true) ||
               pathStr.equals("/Android/data", ignoreCase = true)
    }

    private fun isAndroidObb(path: Path): Boolean {
        if (path.isArchivePath) return false
        val pathStr = path.toString()
        return pathStr.contains("/Android/obb", ignoreCase = true) ||
               pathStr.endsWith("/Android/obb", ignoreCase = true) ||
               pathStr.equals("/Android/obb", ignoreCase = true)
    }

    private fun isAndroidDataOrObb(path: Path): Boolean = isAndroidData(path) || isAndroidObb(path)

    private fun findMatchingDocumentTree(path: Path): Pair<Path, DocumentTree>? {
        val storages = Settings.STORAGES.valueCompat
        val isData = isAndroidData(path)
        val isObb = isAndroidObb(path)
        if (!isData && !isObb) return null

        val pathStr = path.toString()
        val marker = if (isObb) "/Android/obb" else "/Android/data"
        val idx = pathStr.indexOf(marker, ignoreCase = true)
        val subPathStr = if (idx != -1) {
            pathStr.substring(idx + marker.length).trimStart('/')
        } else ""

        val tree = storages.filterIsInstance<DocumentTree>().firstOrNull { t ->
            val uriStr = t.uri.value.toString()
            val customName = t.customName ?: ""
            if (isData) {
                uriStr.contains("Android%2Fdata", ignoreCase = true) ||
                uriStr.contains("Android:data", ignoreCase = true) ||
                customName.contains("Android/data", ignoreCase = true)
            } else {
                uriStr.contains("Android%2Fobb", ignoreCase = true) ||
                uriStr.contains("Android:obb", ignoreCase = true) ||
                customName.contains("Android/obb", ignoreCase = true)
            }
        } ?: return null

        val targetPath = if (subPathStr.isEmpty()) {
            tree.path
        } else {
            try {
                tree.path.resolve(subPathStr)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                tree.path
            }
        }
        return targetPath to tree
    }

    private fun launchSafPermissionForAndroidDataOrObb(path: Path) {
        val isObb = isAndroidObb(path)
        pendingSafIsObb = isObb
        val documentId = if (isObb) "primary:Android/obb" else "primary:Android/data"
        val initialUri = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
            try {
                DocumentsContract.buildTreeDocumentUri(
                    "com.android.externalstorage.documents",
                    documentId
                )
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                null
            }
        } else {
            null
        }
        try {
            requestSafPermissionLauncher.launch(initialUri)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            try {
                requestSafPermissionLauncher.launch(null)
            } catch (e2: Exception) {
                showToast("No se pudo abrir el administrador de archivos: ${e2.message}")
            }
        }
    }

    private fun showSafPermissionPromptDialog(path: Path) {
        val isObb = isAndroidObb(path)
        val builder = MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(requireContext())
            .setTitle(if (isObb) R.string.android_obb_permission_title else R.string.android_data_permission_title)
            .setMessage(if (isObb) R.string.android_obb_permission_message else R.string.android_data_permission_message)
            .setPositiveButton(R.string.grant_permission) { _, _ ->
                launchSafPermissionForAndroidDataOrObb(path)
            }
            .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
        if (LibSuFileServiceLauncher.isSuAvailable()) {
            builder.setNeutralButton(R.string.action_retry_root) { _, _ ->
                retryWithRoot()
            }
        }
        builder.show()
    }

    private val args by args<Args>()
    private val argsPath by lazy { args.intent.extraPath }

    internal val viewModel by viewModels { { FileListViewModel() } }

    private lateinit var binding: Binding


    private lateinit var menuBinding: MenuBinding

    private lateinit var overlayActionMode: ToolbarActionMode

    private lateinit var bottomActionMode: ToolbarActionMode

    private lateinit var layoutManager: GridLayoutManager

    private lateinit var adapter: FileListAdapter

    var onPathOrStatsChanged: ((path: Path, stats: String) -> Unit)? = null
    var onSelectionChanged: ((fragment: FileListFragment, hasSelection: Boolean, count: Int) -> Unit)? = null
    var currentStatsSubtitle: String = ""
        private set

    var lastSelectionAnchorPosition: Int = -1

    val selectableItemCount: Int
        get() = if (isAdded) adapter.selectableItemCount else 0

    fun handleSwipeToSelect(position: Int) {
        val file = adapter.getItemOrNull(position) ?: return
        if (file.isParentDirectoryItem || !adapter.isFileSelectable(file)) {
            adapter.notifyItemChanged(position)
            return
        }

        val currentSelected = viewModel.selectedFiles
        val isAlreadySelected = file in currentSelected

        if (isAlreadySelected) {
            // Swiping an already selected file always toggles/deselects it
            viewModel.selectFile(file, false)
            if (lastSelectionAnchorPosition == position) {
                val remaining = viewModel.selectedFiles
                lastSelectionAnchorPosition = remaining.firstOrNull()?.let { adapter.getPositionForFile(it) } ?: -1
            }
        } else {
            val anchor = lastSelectionAnchorPosition
            if (currentSelected.isNotEmpty() && anchor >= 0 && anchor != position) {
                // Range Selection between anchor and position
                val rangeFiles = adapter.getSelectableFilesInRange(anchor, position)
                if (rangeFiles.isNotEmpty()) {
                    viewModel.selectFiles(rangeFiles, true)
                }
                lastSelectionAnchorPosition = position
            } else {
                // Single item selection
                viewModel.selectFile(file, true)
                lastSelectionAnchorPosition = position
            }
        }
        view?.performHapticFeedback(HapticFeedbackConstants.KEYBOARD_TAP)
        adapter.notifyItemChanged(position)
    }

    private var navigateUpCallback: OnBackPressedCallback? = null

    private val debouncedSearchRunnable = DebouncedRunnable(Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()), 1000) {
        if (!isResumed || !viewModel.isSearchViewExpanded) {
            return@DebouncedRunnable
        }
        val query = viewModel.searchViewQuery
        if (query.isEmpty()) {
            return@DebouncedRunnable
        }
        viewModel.search(query)
    }

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)

        if (activity !is FileListActivity) {
            setHasOptionsMenu(true)
        }
    }

    override fun onCreateView(
        inflater: LayoutInflater,
        container: ViewGroup?,
        savedInstanceState: Bundle?
    ): View =
        Binding.inflate(inflater, container, false)
            .also { binding = it }
            .root

    override fun onActivityCreated(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onActivityCreated(savedInstanceState)

        val activity = requireActivity() as AppCompatActivity
        activity.setTitle(R.string.file_list_title)
        if (activity !is FileListActivity && activity.supportActionBar == null) {
            activity.setSupportActionBar(binding.toolbar)
        }
        if (activity is FileListActivity) {
            setDualPaneUiMode(true)
        }
        binding.toolbar.setNavigationOnClickListener {
            if (activity !is FileListActivity) {
                binding.drawerLayout?.openDrawer(GravityCompat.START)
            }
        }
        overlayActionMode = OverlayToolbarActionMode(binding.overlayToolbar, binding.toolbar)
        bottomActionMode = PersistentBarLayoutToolbarActionMode(
            binding.persistentBarLayout, binding.bottomBarLayout, binding.bottomToolbar
        )
        val contentLayoutInitialPaddingBottom = binding.contentLayout.paddingBottom
        binding.appBarLayout.addOnOffsetChangedListener { _, verticalOffset ->
            binding.contentLayout.updatePaddingRelative(
                bottom = contentLayoutInitialPaddingBottom +
                    binding.appBarLayout.totalScrollRange + verticalOffset
            )
        }
        binding.appBarLayout.syncBackgroundColorTo(binding.overlayToolbar)
        binding.breadcrumbLayout.setListener(this)
        if (!(activity.hasSw600Dp && activity.isOrientationLandscape)) {
            binding.swipeRefreshLayout.setProgressViewEndTarget(
                true, binding.swipeRefreshLayout.progressViewEndOffset
            )
        }
        binding.swipeRefreshLayout.setOnRefreshListener { this.refresh() }
        binding.errorText.setOnClickListener { viewModel.reload() }
        binding.btnErrorHome.setOnClickListener { navigateToHome() }
        binding.btnErrorBack.setOnClickListener { goBackSafely() }
        ShizukuManager.init(activity)
        ShizukuManager.addBinderListener {
            if (isAdded && !isDetached) {
                activity.runOnUiThread {
                    if (binding.layoutError.isVisible) {
                        viewModel.reload()
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        layoutManager = GridLayoutManager(activity, 1)
        binding.recyclerView.layoutManager = layoutManager
        binding.recyclerView.setHasFixedSize(true)
        binding.recyclerView.setItemViewCacheSize(24)
        binding.recyclerView.itemAnimator = null
        (activity as? FileListActivity)?.sharedRecycledViewPool?.let {
            binding.recyclerView.setRecycledViewPool(it)
        }
        adapter = FileListAdapter(this)
        binding.recyclerView.adapter = adapter
        binding.recyclerView.addOnItemTouchListener(object : RecyclerView.SimpleOnItemTouchListener() {
            override fun onInterceptTouchEvent(rv: RecyclerView, e: MotionEvent): Boolean {
                (activity as? FileListActivity)?.onPanelFocused(this@FileListFragment)
                return false
            }
        })
        val swipeSelectionCallback = object : ItemTouchHelper.SimpleCallback(0, ItemTouchHelper.RIGHT) {
            private val backgroundPaint = Paint().apply {
                color = Color.parseColor("#1565C0")
                isAntiAlias = true
            }
            private var triggeredInCurrentSwipe = false
            private var swipingPosition = RecyclerView.NO_POSITION

            override fun onMove(
                recyclerView: RecyclerView,
                viewHolder: RecyclerView.ViewHolder,
                target: RecyclerView.ViewHolder
            ): Boolean = false

            override fun getSwipeDirs(
                recyclerView: RecyclerView,
                viewHolder: RecyclerView.ViewHolder
            ): Int {
                val position = viewHolder.bindingAdapterPosition
                if (position == RecyclerView.NO_POSITION) return 0
                val file = adapter.getItemOrNull(position) ?: return 0
                if (file.isParentDirectoryItem || !adapter.isFileSelectable(file)) {
                    return 0
                }
                return ItemTouchHelper.RIGHT
            }

            override fun onSwiped(viewHolder: RecyclerView.ViewHolder, direction: Int) {
                val position = viewHolder.bindingAdapterPosition
                if (position != RecyclerView.NO_POSITION) {
                    if (!triggeredInCurrentSwipe || swipingPosition != position) {
                        handleSwipeToSelect(position)
                    } else {
                        adapter.notifyItemChanged(position)
                    }
                }
                triggeredInCurrentSwipe = false
                swipingPosition = RecyclerView.NO_POSITION
            }

            // Never let ItemTouchHelper "complete" the swipe: selection is triggered in onChildDraw
            // once the drag passes triggerDxPx, and the row always springs back to its normal
            // position (showing the blue selected state) instead of staying shifted/stuck.
            override fun getSwipeThreshold(viewHolder: RecyclerView.ViewHolder): Float = Float.MAX_VALUE

            override fun getSwipeEscapeVelocity(defaultValue: Float): Float = Float.MAX_VALUE

            override fun getSwipeVelocityThreshold(defaultValue: Float): Float = 0f

            override fun onChildDraw(
                c: Canvas,
                recyclerView: RecyclerView,
                viewHolder: RecyclerView.ViewHolder,
                dX: Float,
                dY: Float,
                actionState: Int,
                isCurrentlyActive: Boolean
            ) {
                val density = recyclerView.resources.displayMetrics.density
                val triggerDxPx = 22f * density
                val maxDx = 32f * density
                val position = viewHolder.bindingAdapterPosition

                if (isCurrentlyActive && position != RecyclerView.NO_POSITION) {
                    if (swipingPosition != position) {
                        swipingPosition = position
                        triggeredInCurrentSwipe = false
                    }
                    if (!triggeredInCurrentSwipe && dX >= triggerDxPx) {
                        triggeredInCurrentSwipe = true
                        handleSwipeToSelect(position)
                    }
                } else if (!isCurrentlyActive && dX <= 0f) {
                    triggeredInCurrentSwipe = false
                    swipingPosition = RecyclerView.NO_POSITION
                }

                val clampedDx = dX.coerceIn(0f, maxDx)
                if (clampedDx > 0f) {
                    val itemView = viewHolder.itemView
                    c.drawRect(
                        itemView.left.toFloat(),
                        itemView.top.toFloat(),
                        itemView.left + clampedDx,
                        itemView.bottom.toFloat(),
                        backgroundPaint
                    )
                }
                super.onChildDraw(c, recyclerView, viewHolder, clampedDx, dY, actionState, isCurrentlyActive)
            }

            override fun clearView(
                recyclerView: RecyclerView,
                viewHolder: RecyclerView.ViewHolder
            ) {
                super.clearView(recyclerView, viewHolder)
                viewHolder.itemView.translationX = 0f
                triggeredInCurrentSwipe = false
                swipingPosition = RecyclerView.NO_POSITION
            }
        }
        ItemTouchHelper(swipeSelectionCallback).attachToRecyclerView(binding.recyclerView)
        val fastScroller = ThemedFastScroller.create(binding.recyclerView)
        binding.recyclerView.setOnApplyWindowInsetsListener(
            ScrollingViewOnApplyWindowInsetsListener(binding.recyclerView, fastScroller)
        )
        binding.speedDialView.inflate(R.menu.file_list_speed_dial)
        binding.speedDialView.setOnActionSelectedListener {
            when (it.id) {
                R.id.action_create_file -> showCreateFileDialog()
                R.id.action_create_directory -> showCreateDirectoryDialog()
            }
            // Returning false causes the speed dial to close without animation.
            //return false
            binding.speedDialView.close()
            true
        }

        val viewLifecycleOwner = viewLifecycleOwner
        val callback = object : OnBackPressedCallback(false) {
            override fun handleOnBackPressed() {
                if (canNavigateUp) {
                    navigateUp()
                }
            }
        }.also { cb ->
            val updateCb = {
                val isPanelActive = (activity as? FileListActivity)?.activeFragment == this@FileListFragment
                cb.isEnabled = isPanelActive && canNavigateUp
            }
            viewModel.currentPathLiveData.observe(viewLifecycleOwner) { updateCb() }
            viewModel.breadcrumbLiveData.observe(viewLifecycleOwner) { updateCb() }
            addOnBackPressedCallback(cb)
        }
        navigateUpCallback = callback
        addOnBackPressedCallback(overlayActionMode.onBackPressedCallback)
        addOnBackPressedCallback(SpeedDialViewOnBackPressedCallback(binding.speedDialView))
        binding.drawerLayout?.let {
            addOnBackPressedCallback(DrawerLayoutOnBackPressedCallback(it))
        }

        if (!viewModel.hasTrail) {
            var path = argsPath
            val intent = args.intent
            var pickOptions: PickOptions? = null
            when (val action = intent.action) {
                Intent.ACTION_GET_CONTENT, Intent.ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT,
                Intent.ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT -> {
                    val mode = if (action == Intent.ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT) {
                        PickOptions.Mode.CREATE_FILE
                    } else {
                        PickOptions.Mode.OPEN_FILE
                    }
                    val mimeType = intent.type?.asMimeTypeOrNull() ?: MimeType.ANY
                    val fileName = if (mode == PickOptions.Mode.CREATE_FILE) {
                        intent.getStringExtra(Intent.EXTRA_TITLE)?.asFileNameOrNull()?.value
                            ?: mimeType.extension?.let { "file.$it" } ?: "file"
                    } else {
                        null
                    }
                    val readOnly = action == Intent.ACTION_GET_CONTENT
                    val extraMimeTypes = if (mode == PickOptions.Mode.OPEN_FILE) {
                        intent.getStringArrayExtra(Intent.EXTRA_MIME_TYPES)
                            ?.mapNotNull { it.asMimeTypeOrNull() }?.takeIfNotEmpty()
                    } else {
                        null
                    }
                    val mimeTypes = extraMimeTypes ?: listOf(mimeType)
                    val localOnly = intent.getBooleanExtra(Intent.EXTRA_LOCAL_ONLY, false)
                    val allowMultiple = mode != PickOptions.Mode.CREATE_FILE &&
                        intent.getBooleanExtra(Intent.EXTRA_ALLOW_MULTIPLE, false)
                    pickOptions =
                        PickOptions(mode, fileName, readOnly, mimeTypes, localOnly, allowMultiple)
                }
                Intent.ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT_TREE -> {
                    val localOnly = intent.getBooleanExtra(Intent.EXTRA_LOCAL_ONLY, false)
                    pickOptions = PickOptions(
                        PickOptions.Mode.OPEN_DIRECTORY, null, false, emptyList(), localOnly, false
                    )
                }
                ACTION_VIEW_DOWNLOADS ->
                    path = Paths.get(
                        Environment.getExternalStoragePublicDirectory(
                            Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS
                        ).path
                    )
                else ->
                    if (path != null) {
                        val mimeType = intent.type?.asMimeTypeOrNull()
                        if (mimeType != null && path.isArchiveFile(mimeType)) {
                            path = path.createArchiveRootPath()
                        }
                    }
            }
            if (path == null) {
                path = Settings.FILE_LIST_DEFAULT_DIRECTORY.valueCompat
            }
            viewModel.resetTo(path)
            if (pickOptions != null) {
                viewModel.pickOptions = pickOptions
            }
        }
        viewModel.currentPathLiveData.observe(viewLifecycleOwner) { onCurrentPathChanged(it) }
        viewModel.searchViewExpandedLiveData.observe(viewLifecycleOwner) {
            onSearchViewExpandedChanged(it)
        }
        viewModel.breadcrumbLiveData.observe(viewLifecycleOwner) {
            binding.breadcrumbLayout.setData(it)
        }
        viewModel.viewTypeLiveData.observe(viewLifecycleOwner) { onViewTypeChanged(it) }
        // Live data only calls observeForever() on its sources when it is active, so we have to
        // make view type live data active first (so that it can load its initial value) before we
        // register another observer that needs to get the view type.
        if (binding.persistentDrawerLayout != null) {
            Settings.FILE_LIST_PERSISTENT_DRAWER_OPEN.observe(viewLifecycleOwner) {
                onPersistentDrawerOpenChanged(it)
            }
        }
        viewModel.sortOptionsLiveData.observe(viewLifecycleOwner) { onSortOptionsChanged(it) }
        viewModel.viewSortPathSpecificLiveData.observe(viewLifecycleOwner) {
            onViewSortPathSpecificChanged(it)
        }
        viewModel.pickOptionsLiveData.observe(viewLifecycleOwner) { onPickOptionsChanged(it) }
        viewModel.selectedFilesLiveData.observe(viewLifecycleOwner) { onSelectedFilesChanged(it) }
        viewModel.pasteStateLiveData.observe(viewLifecycleOwner) { onPasteStateChanged(it) }
        Settings.FILE_NAME_ELLIPSIZE.observe(viewLifecycleOwner) { onFileNameEllipsizeChanged(it) }
        Settings.MAX_LINES_FILE_NAME.observe(viewLifecycleOwner) { adapter.maxLines = it.toIntOrNull() ?: 2 }
        Settings.FILE_LIST_SIZE.observe(viewLifecycleOwner) { adapter.fileListSize = it.toIntOrNull() ?: 0 }
        viewModel.fileListLiveData.observe(viewLifecycleOwner) { onFileListChanged(it) }
        Settings.FILE_LIST_SHOW_HIDDEN_FILES.observe(viewLifecycleOwner) {
            onShowHiddenFilesChanged(it)
        }
    }

    override fun onResume() {
        super.onResume()

        if (activity !is FileListActivity) {
            if (!viewModel.isNotificationPermissionRequested) {
                ensureStorageAccess()
            }
            if (!viewModel.isStorageAccessRequested) {
                ensureNotificationPermission()
            }
        }
        if (viewModel.fileListStateful is Failure) {
            viewModel.reload()
        }
    }

    override fun onCreateOptionsMenu(menu: Menu, inflater: MenuInflater) {
        if (activity is FileListActivity) {
            return
        }
        super.onCreateOptionsMenu(menu, inflater)

        menuBinding = MenuBinding.inflate(menu, inflater)
        menuBinding.viewSortItem.subMenu!!.setGroupDividerEnabledCompat(true)
        setUpSearchView()
    }

    private fun setUpSearchView() {
        val searchView = menuBinding.searchItem.actionView as FixQueryChangeSearchView
        // MenuItem.OnActionExpandListener.onMenuItemActionExpand() is called before SearchView
        // resets the query.
        searchView.setOnSearchClickListener {
            viewModel.isSearchViewExpanded = true
            searchView.setQuery(viewModel.searchViewQuery, false)
            debouncedSearchRunnable()
        }
        // SearchView.OnCloseListener.onClose() is not always called.
        menuBinding.searchItem.setOnActionExpandListener(object : MenuItem.OnActionExpandListener {
            override fun onMenuItemActionExpand(item: MenuItem): Boolean = true

            override fun onMenuItemActionCollapse(item: MenuItem): Boolean {
                viewModel.isSearchViewExpanded = false
                viewModel.stopSearching()
                return true
            }
        })
        searchView.setOnQueryTextListener(object : SearchView.OnQueryTextListener {
            override fun onQueryTextSubmit(query: String): Boolean {
                debouncedSearchRunnable.cancel()
                viewModel.search(query)
                return true
            }

            override fun onQueryTextChange(query: String): Boolean {
                if (searchView.shouldIgnoreQueryChange) {
                    return false
                }
                viewModel.searchViewQuery = query
                debouncedSearchRunnable()
                return false
            }
        })
        if (viewModel.isSearchViewExpanded) {
            menuBinding.searchItem.expandActionView()
        }
    }

    private fun collapseSearchView() {
        if (this::menuBinding.isInitialized && menuBinding.searchItem.isActionViewExpanded) {
            menuBinding.searchItem.collapseActionView()
        }
    }

    override fun onPrepareOptionsMenu(menu: Menu) {
        super.onPrepareOptionsMenu(menu)

        updateViewSortMenuItems()
        updateSelectAllMenuItem()
        updateShowHiddenFilesMenuItem()
    }

    override fun onOptionsItemSelected(item: MenuItem): Boolean {
        val flActivity = activity as? FileListActivity
        if (flActivity != null && flActivity.activeFragment != this) {
            return false
        }
        return when (item.itemId) {
            android.R.id.home -> {
                binding.drawerLayout?.openDrawer(GravityCompat.START)
                if (binding.persistentDrawerLayout != null) {
                    Settings.FILE_LIST_PERSISTENT_DRAWER_OPEN.putValue(
                        !Settings.FILE_LIST_PERSISTENT_DRAWER_OPEN.valueCompat
                    )
                }
                true
            }
            R.id.action_view_list -> {
                viewModel.viewType = FileViewType.LIST
                true
            }
            R.id.action_view_grid -> {
                viewModel.viewType = FileViewType.GRID
                true
            }
            R.id.action_sort_by_name -> {
                viewModel.setSortBy(By.NAME)
                true
            }
            R.id.action_sort_by_type -> {
                viewModel.setSortBy(By.TYPE)
                true
            }
            R.id.action_sort_by_size -> {
                viewModel.setSortBy(By.SIZE)
                true
            }
            R.id.action_sort_by_last_modified -> {
                viewModel.setSortBy(By.LAST_MODIFIED)
                true
            }
            R.id.action_sort_order_ascending -> {
                viewModel.setSortOrder(
                    if (!menuBinding.sortOrderAscendingItem.isChecked) {
                        Order.ASCENDING
                    } else {
                        Order.DESCENDING
                    }
                )
                true
            }
            R.id.action_sort_directories_first -> {
                viewModel.setSortDirectoriesFirst(!menuBinding.sortDirectoriesFirstItem.isChecked)
                true
            }
            R.id.action_view_sort_path_specific -> {
                viewModel.isViewSortPathSpecific = !menuBinding.viewSortPathSpecificItem.isChecked
                true
            }
            R.id.action_new_task -> {
                newTask()
                true
            }
            R.id.action_navigate_up -> {
                navigateUp()
                true
            }
            R.id.action_navigate_to -> {
                showNavigateToPathDialog()
                true
            }
            R.id.action_refresh -> {
                refresh()
                true
            }
            R.id.action_select_all -> {
                selectAllFiles()
                true
            }
            R.id.action_show_hidden_files -> {
                setShowHiddenFiles(!menuBinding.showHiddenFilesItem.isChecked)
                true
            }
            R.id.action_share -> {
                share()
                true
            }
            R.id.action_copy_path -> {
                copyPath()
                true
            }
            R.id.action_open_in_terminal -> {
                openInTerminal()
                true
            }
            R.id.action_add_bookmark -> {
                addBookmark()
                true
            }
            R.id.action_create_shortcut -> {
                createShortcut()
                true
            }
            R.id.action_export_file_list -> {
                val allFiles = viewModel.fileListStateful.value ?: emptyList()
                ExportFileListHelper.showDialog(requireActivity(), currentPath, allFiles, null) { viewModel.reload() }
                true
            }
            else -> super.onOptionsItemSelected(item)
        }
    }

    fun onKeyShortcut(keyCode: Int, event: KeyEvent): Boolean {
        if (bottomActionMode.isActive) {
            val menu = bottomActionMode.menu
            menu.setQwertyMode(
                KeyCharacterMap.load(event.deviceId).keyboardType != KeyCharacterMap.NUMERIC
            )
            if (menu.performShortcut(keyCode, event, 0)) {
                return true
            }
        }
        if (overlayActionMode.isActive) {
            val menu = overlayActionMode.menu
            menu.setQwertyMode(
                KeyCharacterMap.load(event.deviceId).keyboardType != KeyCharacterMap.NUMERIC
            )
            if (menu.performShortcut(keyCode, event, 0)) {
                return true
            }
        }
        return false
    }

    private fun onPersistentDrawerOpenChanged(open: Boolean) {
        binding.persistentDrawerLayout?.let {
            if (open) {
                it.openDrawer(GravityCompat.START)
            } else {
                it.closeDrawer(GravityCompat.START)
            }
        }
        updateSpanCount()
    }

    private fun onCurrentPathChanged(path: Path) {
        clearSelectedFiles()
        updateOverlayToolbar()
        updateBottomToolbar()
        onPathOrStatsChanged?.invoke(path, currentStatsSubtitle)
    }

    private fun onSearchViewExpandedChanged(expanded: Boolean) {
        updateViewSortMenuItems()
    }

    private fun onFileListChanged(stateful: Stateful<List<FileItem>>) {
        val files = stateful.value
        val isSearching = viewModel.searchState.isSearching
        val isLoading = stateful is Loading
        val subtitle = when {
            stateful is Failure -> getString(R.string.error)
            isLoading && (files == null || !isSearching) -> getString(R.string.loading)
            files != null -> getSubtitle(files)
            else -> getString(R.string.empty)
        }
        binding.toolbar.subtitle = subtitle
        currentStatsSubtitle = subtitle
        onPathOrStatsChanged?.invoke(currentPath, subtitle)
        val hasFiles = !files.isNullOrEmpty()
        binding.swipeRefreshLayout.isRefreshing = isLoading && (hasFiles || isSearching)
        binding.progress.fadeToVisibilityUnsafe(isLoading && !(hasFiles || isSearching))
        val showDirectoryProgress = isLoading || isSearching
        binding.directoryProgressBar.visibility = if (showDirectoryProgress) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
        val isFailureWithoutFiles = stateful is Failure && !hasFiles
        val isAndroidDataOrObbCurrent = isAndroidDataOrObb(currentPath) && !currentPath.isDocumentPath

        // Show error layout for any inaccessible directory without files (includes back and home buttons)
        binding.layoutError.fadeToVisibilityUnsafe(isFailureWithoutFiles)
        if (isFailureWithoutFiles && !isAndroidDataOrObbCurrent) {
            val displayPathStr = currentPath.toDisplayPath(trailingSlash = true)
            val deniedSubtitle = "0 Carpetas · 0 Archivos · Permiso denegado"
            binding.toolbar.subtitle = deniedSubtitle
            currentStatsSubtitle = deniedSubtitle
            onPathOrStatsChanged?.invoke(currentPath, deniedSubtitle)
        }
        val throwable = (stateful as? Failure)?.throwable
        if (throwable != null) {
            throwable.printStackTrace()
            if (isAndroidDataOrObbCurrent) {
                val match = findMatchingDocumentTree(currentPath)
                if (match != null) {
                    navigateTo(match.first)
                    return
                }
            }

            val isAccessDenied = throwable is java8.nio.file.AccessDeniedException ||
                throwable is me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.remote.RemoteFileSystemException ||
                throwable.message?.contains("Permission denied", ignoreCase = true) == true ||
                throwable.message?.contains("Root isn't available", ignoreCase = true) == true

            val isNotFound = throwable is java8.nio.file.NoSuchFileException ||
                throwable is java.io.FileNotFoundException

            val isNotDir = throwable is java8.nio.file.NotDirectoryException

            val displayPathStr = currentPath.toDisplayPath(trailingSlash = true)

            if (!hasFiles) {
                when {
                    isAndroidDataOrObbCurrent -> {
                        val isObb = isAndroidObb(currentPath)
                        val hasElevatedAccess = LibSuFileServiceLauncher.isSuAvailable() || ShizukuManager.ready()
                        if (hasElevatedAccess) {
                            if (Settings.ROOT_STRATEGY.valueCompat != RootStrategy.ALWAYS) {
                                Settings.ROOT_STRATEGY.putValue(RootStrategy.AUTOMATIC)
                            }
                            if (lastPromptedSafPath != currentPath) {
                                lastPromptedSafPath = currentPath
                                showToast(if (LibSuFileServiceLauncher.isSuAvailable()) getString(R.string.root_requesting_toast) else getString(R.string.shizuku_connecting_toast))
                                viewModel.reload()
                                return
                            }
                        }
                        binding.ivErrorIcon.setImageResource(R.drawable.directory_icon_white_24dp)
                        binding.ivErrorIcon.imageTintList = android.content.res.ColorStateList.valueOf(android.graphics.Color.parseColor("#2196F3"))
                        binding.tvErrorTitle.text = getString(if (isObb) R.string.android_obb_permission_title else R.string.android_data_permission_title)
                        binding.errorText.text = getString(if (isObb) R.string.android_obb_permission_message else R.string.android_data_permission_message)
                        binding.btnGrantSafPermission.visibility = View.VISIBLE
                        binding.btnGrantSafPermission.setOnClickListener {
                            launchSafPermissionForAndroidDataOrObb(currentPath)
                        }

                        if (ShizukuManager.isAvailable() && !ShizukuManager.hasPermission()) {
                            binding.btnGrantShizukuPermission.visibility = View.VISIBLE
                            binding.btnGrantShizukuPermission.setText(R.string.action_use_shizuku)
                            binding.btnGrantShizukuPermission.setOnClickListener {
                                ShizukuManager.requestPermission(requireActivity()) { granted ->
                                    if (granted) {
                                        Settings.ROOT_STRATEGY.putValue(RootStrategy.AUTOMATIC)
                                        viewModel.reload()
                                    } else {
                                        showToast(getString(R.string.shizuku_permission_denied))
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        } else if (ShizukuManager.isInstalled(requireContext()) && !ShizukuManager.isAvailable()) {
                            binding.btnGrantShizukuPermission.visibility = View.VISIBLE
                            binding.btnGrantShizukuPermission.setText(R.string.action_open_shizuku)
                            binding.btnGrantShizukuPermission.setOnClickListener {
                                ShizukuManager.openShizukuApp(requireContext())
                            }
                        } else {
                            binding.btnGrantShizukuPermission.visibility = View.GONE
                        }

                        binding.btnErrorAction.visibility = if (LibSuFileServiceLauncher.isSuAvailable()) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
                        binding.btnErrorAction.setText(R.string.action_retry_root)
                        binding.btnErrorAction.setIconResource(R.drawable.shield_icon_white_24dp)
                        binding.btnErrorAction.setOnClickListener {
                            retryWithRoot()
                        }
                        if (lastPromptedSafPath != currentPath && !hasElevatedAccess) {
                            lastPromptedSafPath = currentPath
                            showSafPermissionPromptDialog(currentPath)
                        }
                    }
                    isAccessDenied -> {
                        binding.ivErrorIcon.setImageResource(R.drawable.shield_icon_white_24dp)
                        binding.ivErrorIcon.imageTintList = android.content.res.ColorStateList.valueOf(android.graphics.Color.parseColor("#F44336"))
                        binding.tvErrorTitle.setText(R.string.path_access_denied_title)
                        binding.errorText.text = getString(R.string.path_access_denied_error, displayPathStr)
                        binding.btnGrantSafPermission.visibility = View.GONE

                        if (ShizukuManager.isAvailable() && !ShizukuManager.hasPermission()) {
                            binding.btnGrantShizukuPermission.visibility = View.VISIBLE
                            binding.btnGrantShizukuPermission.setText(R.string.action_use_shizuku)
                            binding.btnGrantShizukuPermission.setOnClickListener {
                                ShizukuManager.requestPermission(requireActivity()) { granted ->
                                    if (granted) {
                                        Settings.ROOT_STRATEGY.putValue(RootStrategy.AUTOMATIC)
                                        viewModel.reload()
                                    } else {
                                        showToast(getString(R.string.shizuku_permission_denied))
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        } else if (ShizukuManager.isInstalled(requireContext()) && !ShizukuManager.isAvailable()) {
                            binding.btnGrantShizukuPermission.visibility = View.VISIBLE
                            binding.btnGrantShizukuPermission.setText(R.string.action_open_shizuku)
                            binding.btnGrantShizukuPermission.setOnClickListener {
                                ShizukuManager.openShizukuApp(requireContext())
                            }
                        } else {
                            binding.btnGrantShizukuPermission.visibility = View.GONE
                        }

                        binding.btnErrorAction.visibility = View.VISIBLE
                        binding.btnErrorAction.setText(R.string.action_retry_root)
                        binding.btnErrorAction.setIconResource(R.drawable.shield_icon_white_24dp)
                        binding.btnErrorAction.setOnClickListener {
                            retryWithRoot()
                        }
                    }
                    isNotFound -> {
                        binding.ivErrorIcon.setImageResource(R.drawable.file_generic_icon)
                        binding.ivErrorIcon.imageTintList = android.content.res.ColorStateList.valueOf(android.graphics.Color.parseColor("#FF9800"))
                        binding.tvErrorTitle.setText(R.string.path_not_found_title)
                        binding.errorText.text = getString(R.string.path_not_found_error, displayPathStr)
                        binding.btnGrantSafPermission.visibility = View.GONE
                        binding.btnErrorAction.visibility = View.VISIBLE
                        binding.btnErrorAction.setText(R.string.action_create_folder)
                        binding.btnErrorAction.setIconResource(R.drawable.add_icon_white_24dp)
                        binding.btnErrorAction.setOnClickListener {
                            createCurrentFolderAndReload()
                        }
                    }
                    isNotDir -> {
                        binding.ivErrorIcon.setImageResource(R.drawable.file_generic_icon)
                        binding.ivErrorIcon.imageTintList = android.content.res.ColorStateList.valueOf(android.graphics.Color.parseColor("#9C27B0"))
                        binding.tvErrorTitle.setText(R.string.path_not_directory_title)
                        binding.errorText.text = getString(R.string.path_not_directory_error, displayPathStr)
                        binding.btnGrantSafPermission.visibility = View.GONE
                        binding.btnErrorAction.visibility = View.GONE
                    }
                    else -> {
                        me.zhanghai.android.files.app.CrashHandler.logHandledException(throwable, "FileList")
                        binding.ivErrorIcon.setImageResource(R.drawable.error_badge_icon_18dp)
                        binding.ivErrorIcon.imageTintList = android.content.res.ColorStateList.valueOf(android.graphics.Color.parseColor("#F44336"))
                        binding.tvErrorTitle.setText(R.string.path_error_title)
                        val cleanMsg = cleanErrorMessage(throwable)
                        binding.errorText.text = "No se pudo acceder a la ruta:\n\n$displayPathStr\n\nMotivo: $cleanMsg"
                        binding.btnGrantSafPermission.visibility = View.GONE
                        binding.btnErrorAction.visibility = View.VISIBLE
                        binding.btnErrorAction.text = "Reintentar"
                        binding.btnErrorAction.setIconResource(R.drawable.reset_icon_white_24dp)
                        binding.btnErrorAction.setOnClickListener {
                            viewModel.reload()
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                me.zhanghai.android.files.app.CrashHandler.logHandledException(throwable, "FileList")
                showToast("Error: ${cleanErrorMessage(throwable)}")
            }
        }
        binding.emptyView.fadeToVisibilityUnsafe(stateful is Success && !hasFiles)
        if (files != null) {
            updateAdapterFileList()
        } else {
            val isSearching = viewModel.searchState.isSearching
            val hasParent = !isHomeOrRootPath(currentPath) && currentPath.parentOrArchiveParent != null
            if (!isSearching && hasParent) {
                adapter.replaceListAndIsSearching(listOf(createParentDirectoryItem(currentPath)), false)
            } else {
                adapter.clear()
            }
        }
        if (stateful is Success) {
            viewModel.pendingState?.let { layoutManager.onRestoreInstanceState(it) }
        }
    }

    private fun getSubtitle(files: List<FileItem>): String {
        val regularFiles = files.filterNot { it.isParentDirectoryItem }
        val directoryCount = regularFiles.count { it.attributes.isDirectory }
        val fileCount = regularFiles.size - directoryCount
        return "Carpetas: $directoryCount  Archivos: $fileCount"
    }

    private fun onViewTypeChanged(viewType: FileViewType) {
        updateSpanCount()
        adapter.viewType = viewType
        updateViewSortMenuItems()
    }

    private fun updateSpanCount() {
        layoutManager.spanCount = when (viewModel.viewType) {
            FileViewType.LIST -> 1
            FileViewType.GRID -> {
                var widthDp = resources.configuration.screenWidthDp
                val persistentDrawerLayout = binding.persistentDrawerLayout
                if (persistentDrawerLayout != null &&
                    persistentDrawerLayout.isDrawerOpen(GravityCompat.START)) {
                    widthDp -= getDimensionDp(R.dimen.navigation_max_width).roundToInt()
                }
                (widthDp / 180).coerceAtLeast(2)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun onSortOptionsChanged(sortOptions: FileSortOptions) {
        adapter.sortOptions = sortOptions
        updateViewSortMenuItems()
    }

    private fun onViewSortPathSpecificChanged(pathSpecific: Boolean) {
        updateViewSortMenuItems()
    }

    private fun updateViewSortMenuItems() {
        if (!this::menuBinding.isInitialized) {
            return
        }
        val searchViewExpanded = viewModel.isSearchViewExpanded
        menuBinding.viewSortItem.isVisible = !searchViewExpanded
        if (searchViewExpanded) {
            return
        }
        val viewType = viewModel.viewType
        val checkedViewTypeItem = when (viewType) {
            FileViewType.LIST -> menuBinding.viewListItem
            FileViewType.GRID -> menuBinding.viewGridItem
        }
        checkedViewTypeItem.isChecked = true
        val sortOptions = viewModel.sortOptions
        val checkedSortByItem = when (sortOptions.by) {
            By.NAME -> menuBinding.sortByNameItem
            By.TYPE -> menuBinding.sortByTypeItem
            By.SIZE -> menuBinding.sortBySizeItem
            By.LAST_MODIFIED -> menuBinding.sortByLastModifiedItem
        }
        checkedSortByItem.isChecked = true
        menuBinding.sortOrderAscendingItem.isChecked = sortOptions.order == Order.ASCENDING
        menuBinding.sortDirectoriesFirstItem.isChecked = sortOptions.isDirectoriesFirst
        menuBinding.viewSortPathSpecificItem.isChecked = viewModel.isViewSortPathSpecific
    }

    fun isHomeOrRootPath(path: Path): Boolean {
        if (path.isArchivePath) {
            return false
        }
        val s = path.toString().trimEnd('/')
        return s.isEmpty() || s == "/"
    }

    fun navigateToHome() {
        collapseSearchView()
        navigateTo(Paths.get("/storage/emulated/0"))
    }

    override fun navigateUp() {
        if (!canNavigateUp) return
        collapseSearchView()
        if (!viewModel.navigateUp()) {
            val parent = currentPath.parentOrArchiveParent
            if (parent != null) {
                navigateTo(parent)
            } else {
                navigateToHome()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun goBackSafely() {
        collapseSearchView()
        if (isHomeOrRootPath(currentPath)) {
            return
        }
        if (!viewModel.navigateUp()) {
            val parent = currentPath.parentOrArchiveParent
            if (parent != null) {
                navigateTo(parent)
            } else {
                navigateToHome()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun retryWithRoot() {
        when {
            LibSuFileServiceLauncher.isSuAvailable() || ShizukuManager.ready() -> {
                Settings.ROOT_STRATEGY.putValue(RootStrategy.AUTOMATIC)
                showToast(if (LibSuFileServiceLauncher.isSuAvailable()) getString(R.string.root_requesting_toast) else getString(R.string.shizuku_connecting_toast))
                viewModel.reload()
            }
            ShizukuManager.isAvailable() -> {
                ShizukuManager.requestPermission(requireActivity()) { granted ->
                    if (granted) {
                        Settings.ROOT_STRATEGY.putValue(RootStrategy.AUTOMATIC)
                        viewModel.reload()
                    } else {
                        showToast(getString(R.string.shizuku_permission_denied))
                    }
                }
            }
            ShizukuManager.isInstalled(requireContext()) -> {
                MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(requireContext())
                    .setTitle(R.string.shizuku_not_running_title)
                    .setMessage(R.string.shizuku_not_running_message)
                    .setPositiveButton(R.string.action_open_shizuku) { _, _ ->
                        ShizukuManager.openShizukuApp(requireContext())
                    }
                    .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
                    .show()
            }
            else -> {
                MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(requireContext())
                    .setTitle(R.string.root_shizuku_not_detected_title)
                    .setMessage(R.string.root_shizuku_not_detected_message)
                    .setPositiveButton(R.string.settings_install_shizuku_title) { _, _ ->
                        ShizukuManager.openShizukuApp(requireContext())
                    }
                    .setNeutralButton(R.string.settings_title) { _, _ ->
                        startActivity(Intent(requireContext(), SettingsActivity::class.java))
                    }
                    .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
                    .show()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun createCurrentFolderAndReload() {
        val path = currentPath
        lifecycleScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            try {
                path.createDirectories()
                withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                    showToast(getString(R.string.folder_created_success))
                    viewModel.reload()
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                me.zhanghai.android.files.app.CrashHandler.logHandledException(e, "CreateDir")
                withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                    showToast("No se pudo crear la carpeta: ${cleanErrorMessage(e)}")
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun cleanErrorMessage(throwable: Throwable?): String {
        if (throwable == null) return "Error desconocido"
        val msg = throwable.localizedMessage ?: throwable.message ?: ""
        val stripped = msg.replace(Regex("^(java[a-z0-9.]*\\.[A-Za-z0-9]+Exception:?\\s*)"), "").trim()
        return if (stripped.isNotEmpty()) stripped else throwable.javaClass.simpleName
    }

    fun reload() {
        viewModel.reload()
    }

    fun openTerminal() {
        openInTerminal()
    }

    fun addBookmarkCurrentPath() {
        addBookmark(currentPath)
    }

    fun showSortOptionsDialog() {
        val options = arrayOf(
            "Nombre",
            "Tipo",
            "Tamaño",
            "Fecha de modificación",
            "Invertir orden (Asc/Desc)",
            "Carpetas primero"
        )
        com.google.android.material.dialog.MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(requireContext())
            .setTitle("Ordenar")
            .setItems(options) { _, which ->
                when (which) {
                    0 -> viewModel.setSortBy(By.NAME)
                    1 -> viewModel.setSortBy(By.TYPE)
                    2 -> viewModel.setSortBy(By.SIZE)
                    3 -> viewModel.setSortBy(By.LAST_MODIFIED)
                    4 -> {
                        val newOrder = if (viewModel.sortOptions.order == Order.ASCENDING) {
                            Order.DESCENDING
                        } else {
                            Order.ASCENDING
                        }
                        viewModel.setSortOrder(newOrder)
                    }
                    5 -> viewModel.setSortDirectoriesFirst(!viewModel.sortOptions.isDirectoriesFirst)
                }
            }
            .show()
    }

    private fun showNavigateToPathDialog() {
        NavigateToPathDialogFragment.show(currentPath, this)
    }

    private fun newTask() {
        openInNewTask(currentPath)
    }

    private fun refresh() {
        viewModel.reload()
    }

    private fun setShowHiddenFiles(showHiddenFiles: Boolean) {
        Settings.FILE_LIST_SHOW_HIDDEN_FILES.putValue(showHiddenFiles)
    }

    private fun onShowHiddenFilesChanged(showHiddenFiles: Boolean) {
        updateAdapterFileList()
        updateShowHiddenFilesMenuItem()
    }

    private fun updateAdapterFileList() {
        var files = viewModel.fileListStateful.value ?: return
        if (!Settings.FILE_LIST_SHOW_HIDDEN_FILES.valueCompat) {
            files = files.filterNot { it.isHidden }
        }
        val isSearching = viewModel.searchState.isSearching
        val hasParent = !isHomeOrRootPath(currentPath) && currentPath.parentOrArchiveParent != null
        val displayFiles = if (!isSearching && hasParent) {
            listOf(createParentDirectoryItem(currentPath)) + files
        } else {
            files
        }
        adapter.replaceListAndIsSearching(displayFiles, isSearching)
    }

    private fun updateShowHiddenFilesMenuItem() {
        if (!this::menuBinding.isInitialized) {
            return
        }
        val showHiddenFiles = Settings.FILE_LIST_SHOW_HIDDEN_FILES.valueCompat
