```kt
        tvPermissions?.setOnClickListener(openPermDialog)

        fun copyToClipboard(label: String, text: CharSequence?) {
            val textStr = text?.toString() ?: return
            if (textStr.isNotEmpty() && textStr != "-") {
                val clipboard = context.getSystemService(Context.CLIPBOARD_SERVICE) as ClipboardManager
                clipboard.setPrimaryClip(ClipData.newPlainText(label, textStr))
                Toast.makeText(context, "$label copiado", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }

        tvPackage.setOnClickListener { copyToClipboard("Paquete", tvPackage.text) }
        tvLabel.setOnClickListener { copyToClipboard("Nombre", tvLabel.text) }
        tvDataDir?.setOnClickListener { copyToClipboard("Ruta de datos", tvDataDir.text) }
        tvApkPath?.setOnClickListener { copyToClipboard("Ruta de APK", tvApkPath.text) }
        tvUid?.setOnClickListener { copyToClipboard("UID", tvUid.text) }

        val layoutIconContainer = view.findViewById<View>(R.id.layoutApkIconContainer) ?: ivIcon
        val openViewerListener = View.OnClickListener {
            showAppIconViewer(ivIcon.drawable, tvLabel.text.toString(), tvPackage.text.toString())
        }
        ivIcon.setOnClickListener(openViewerListener)
        layoutIconContainer.setOnClickListener(openViewerListener)

        var parsedPackageName: String? = null

        try {
            var packageInfoFlags = PackageManager.GET_PERMISSIONS or PackageManager.GET_SIGNATURES
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.P) {
                packageInfoFlags = packageInfoFlags or PackageManager.GET_SIGNING_CERTIFICATES
            }
            val (packageInfo, closeable) = packageManager.getPackageArchiveInfoCompat(file.path, packageInfoFlags)
            closeable.use {
                if (packageInfo != null) {
                    parsedPackageName = packageInfo.packageName
                    val appInfo = packageInfo.applicationInfo
                    if (appInfo != null) {
                        try {
                            appInfo.sourceDir = file.path.toUserFriendlyString()
                            appInfo.publicSourceDir = file.path.toUserFriendlyString()
                        } catch (e: Exception) {
                            // Ignored
                        }
                        val label = try {
                            appInfo.loadLabel(packageManager).toString()
                        } catch (e: Exception) {
                            file.name
                        }
                        tvLabel.text = label

                        val icon = try {
                            appInfo.loadIcon(packageManager)
                        } catch (e: Exception) {
                            null
                        }
                        if (icon != null) {
                            ivIcon.setImageDrawable(icon)
                        } else {
                            ivIcon.setImageResource(R.drawable.file_apk_icon)
                        }

                        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.N) {
                            tvMinSdk.text = "Android ${getSdkName(appInfo.minSdkVersion)} (API ${appInfo.minSdkVersion})"
                        } else {
                            tvMinSdk.text = "API ?"
                        }
                        tvTargetSdk.text = "Android ${getSdkName(appInfo.targetSdkVersion)} (API ${appInfo.targetSdkVersion})"
                    } else {
                        tvLabel.text = file.name
                        ivIcon.setImageResource(R.drawable.file_apk_icon)
                        tvMinSdk.text = "-"
                        tvTargetSdk.text = "-"
                    }

                    tvPackage.text = packageInfo.packageName ?: file.name
                    tvVersion.text = "v${packageInfo.versionName ?: "1.0"}"
                    tvVersionCode.text = packageInfo.longVersionCodeCompat.toString()

                    val sigCount = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.P) {
                        packageInfo.signingInfo?.apkContentsSigners?.size ?: 0
                    } else {
                        @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
                        packageInfo.signatures?.size ?: 0
                    }
                    tvSignature.text = if (sigCount > 0) "V1 + V2 + V3 (Válida)" else "Sin firmar"

                    // Check if installed
                    val pkgName = packageInfo.packageName
                    if (pkgName != null) {
                        try {
                            val installedInfo = packageManager.getPackageInfo(pkgName, 0)
                            tvInstalled.text = "v${installedInfo.versionName} (${installedInfo.longVersionCodeCompat})"
                            tvInstalled.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#81C784"))

                            val dateFormat = SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss", Locale.getDefault())
                            val installedAppInfo = installedInfo.applicationInfo
                            if (installedAppInfo != null) {
                                tvDataDir?.text = installedAppInfo.dataDir ?: "-"
                                tvApkPath?.text = installedAppInfo.sourceDir ?: "-"
                                tvUid?.text = installedAppInfo.uid.toString()
                            }
                            tvFirstInstall?.text = dateFormat.format(Date(installedInfo.firstInstallTime))
                            tvLastUpdate?.text = dateFormat.format(Date(installedInfo.lastUpdateTime))

                            rowDataDir?.isVisible = true
                            rowApkPath?.isVisible = true
                            rowFirstInstall?.isVisible = true
                            rowLastUpdate?.isVisible = true
                            rowUid?.isVisible = true
                        } catch (e: Exception) {
                            tvInstalled.text = "No instalado"
                            tvInstalled.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#E57373"))
                            rowDataDir?.isVisible = false
                            rowApkPath?.isVisible = false
                            rowFirstInstall?.isVisible = false
                            rowLastUpdate?.isVisible = false
                            rowUid?.isVisible = false
                        }
                    } else {
                        tvInstalled.text = "No instalado"
                        tvInstalled.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#E57373"))
                        rowDataDir?.isVisible = false
                        rowApkPath?.isVisible = false
                        rowFirstInstall?.isVisible = false
                        rowLastUpdate?.isVisible = false
                        rowUid?.isVisible = false
                    }
                } else {
                    tvLabel.text = file.name
                    ivIcon.setImageResource(R.drawable.file_apk_icon)
                    tvPackage.text = file.name
                    tvVersion.text = "-"
                    tvVersionCode.text = "-"
                    tvSignature.text = "-"
                    tvMinSdk.text = "-"
                    tvTargetSdk.text = "-"
                    tvInstalled.text = "No instalado"
                    tvInstalled.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#E57373"))
                    rowDataDir?.isVisible = false
                    rowApkPath?.isVisible = false
                    rowFirstInstall?.isVisible = false
                    rowLastUpdate?.isVisible = false
                    rowUid?.isVisible = false
                }
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
            tvLabel.text = file.name
            ivIcon.setImageResource(R.drawable.file_apk_icon)
            tvPackage.text = file.name
            tvVersion.text = "-"
            tvVersionCode.text = "-"
            tvSignature.text = "-"
            tvMinSdk.text = "-"
            tvTargetSdk.text = "-"
            tvInstalled.text = "No instalado"
            tvInstalled.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#E57373"))
            rowDataDir?.isVisible = false
            rowApkPath?.isVisible = false
            rowFirstInstall?.isVisible = false
            rowLastUpdate?.isVisible = false
            rowUid?.isVisible = false
        }

        val isRootAvailable = ApkInstallHelper.isRootAvailable()
        val isShizukuAvailable = ApkInstallHelper.isShizukuAvailable()
        btnRootInstall.isVisible = isRootAvailable

        val dialog = MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(context)
            .setView(view)
            .create()

        btnView.setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            listener.viewApk(file)
        }

        btnRootInstall.setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            listener.installApkWithRoot(file)
        }

        btnInstall.setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            if (isRootAvailable && Settings.USE_ROOT_INSTALL.valueCompat) {
                listener.installApkWithRoot(file)
            } else if (isShizukuAvailable && Settings.USE_SHIZUKU_INSTALL.valueCompat) {
                installApkWithShizuku(file)
            } else {
                listener.installApk(file)
            }
        }

        btnQuickEdit?.setOnClickListener {
            val hostActivity = requireActivity()
            dialog.dismiss()
            ApkQuickEditDialogFragment.show(file, hostActivity)
        }

        btnFunction.setOnClickListener {
            val optionsList = mutableListOf(
                ApkFunctionOption(getString(R.string.view), R.drawable.visibility_icon_white_24dp, Color.parseColor("#2196F3"))
            )
            if (isRootAvailable) {
                optionsList.add(ApkFunctionOption(getString(R.string.install_root), R.drawable.ic_root_generic, Color.parseColor("#4CAF50")))
            }
            if (isShizukuAvailable) {
                optionsList.add(ApkFunctionOption("Instalar con Shizuku", R.drawable.ic_shizuku, Color.parseColor("#1565C0")))
            }
            optionsList.addAll(listOf(
                ApkFunctionOption(getString(R.string.apk_quick_edit), R.drawable.edit_icon, Color.parseColor("#FF9800")),
                ApkFunctionOption("Ver componentes (App Manager)", R.drawable.ic_apps_white_24dp, Color.parseColor("#42A5F5")),
                ApkFunctionOption("Ver AndroidManifest.xml", R.drawable.document_icon_white_24dp, Color.parseColor("#FFCA28")),
                ApkFunctionOption("AntiSplit (Fusionar Splits)", R.drawable.ic_apktool_antisplit, Color.parseColor("#FFB300")),
                ApkFunctionOption("Descompilar APK a Java (JADX)", R.drawable.ic_open_as_code, Color.parseColor("#64B5F6")),
                ApkFunctionOption("Descompilar APK (Apktool)", R.drawable.ic_apktool_decompile, Color.parseColor("#FFA000")),
                ApkFunctionOption(getString(R.string.toast_dialog_inject_title), R.drawable.ic_toast_inject, Color.parseColor("#FFCA28")),
                ApkFunctionOption(getString(R.string.toast_dialog_clean_title), R.drawable.ic_toast_clean, Color.parseColor("#EF5350")),
                ApkFunctionOption(getString(R.string.apk_sign), R.drawable.ic_apktool_sign, Color.parseColor("#4CAF50")),
                ApkFunctionOption("Generar clave KeyStore (.jks)", R.drawable.ic_keystore_key, Color.parseColor("#5C6BC0")),
                ApkFunctionOption("Verificar firma", R.drawable.ic_apktool_verify, Color.parseColor("#AB47BC")),
                ApkFunctionOption("Copiar nombre del paquete", R.drawable.copy_icon_control_normal_24dp, Color.parseColor("#B0BEC5")),
                ApkFunctionOption("Extraer APK", R.drawable.ic_apk_extract, Color.parseColor("#26A69A")),
                ApkFunctionOption(getString(R.string.apk_optimize), R.drawable.ic_apk_optimize, Color.parseColor("#00897B"))
            ))

            val adapter = object : android.widget.ArrayAdapter<ApkFunctionOption>(
                context,
                R.layout.item_dialog_action_with_icon,
                optionsList
            ) {
                override fun getView(position: Int, convertView: View?, parent: ViewGroup): View {
                    val row = convertView ?: LayoutInflater.from(context)
                        .inflate(R.layout.item_dialog_action_with_icon, parent, false)
                    val item = getItem(position)!!
                    val iv = row.findViewById<ImageView>(R.id.ivActionIcon)
                    val tv = row.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvActionTitle)
                    iv.setImageResource(item.iconRes)
                    iv.setColorFilter(item.iconTint)
                    tv.text = item.title
                    return row
                }
            }

            MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(context)
                .setTitle(R.string.apk_function)
                .setAdapter(adapter) { _, which ->
                    val chosen = optionsList[which].title
                    when (chosen) {
                        getString(R.string.view) -> {
                            dialog.dismiss()
                            listener.viewApk(file)
                        }
                        getString(R.string.install_root) -> {
                            dialog.dismiss()
                            listener.installApkWithRoot(file)
                        }
                        "Instalar con Shizuku" -> {
                            dialog.dismiss()
                            installApkWithShizuku(file)
                        }
                        getString(R.string.apk_quick_edit) -> {
                            val hostActivity = requireActivity()
                            dialog.dismiss()
                            ApkQuickEditDialogFragment.show(file, hostActivity)
                        }
                        "Ver componentes (App Manager)" -> {
                            dialog.dismiss()
                            try {
                                val apkJavaFile = file.path.toFile()
                                AppDetailsViewerHelper.showComponentsViewer(
                                    requireActivity(),
                                    parsedPackageName ?: "",
                                    file.name,
                                    apkJavaFile
                                )
                            } catch (e: Exception) {
                                Toast.makeText(context, "Error al abrir componentes: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                            }
                        }
                        "Ver AndroidManifest.xml" -> {
                            dialog.dismiss()
                            try {
                                val apkJavaFile = file.path.toFile()
                                AppDetailsViewerHelper.showManifestViewer(
                                    requireActivity(),
                                    apkJavaFile,
                                    file.name
                                )
                            } catch (e: Exception) {
                                Toast.makeText(context, "Error al decodificar manifiesto: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                            }
                        }
                        "AntiSplit (Fusionar Splits)" -> {
                            dialog.dismiss()
                            val fragment = (activity as? FileListActivity)?.activeFragment
                            if (fragment != null) {
                                val allApks = (0 until fragment.itemCountSafe()).mapNotNull { fragment.getItemSafe(it) }
                                    .filter { it.name.endsWith(".apk", ignoreCase = true) }
                                if (allApks.size > 1) {
                                    fragment.showAntiSplitDialogForFiles(allApks)
                                } else {
                                    Toast.makeText(context, "No se encontraron otros splits en este directorio", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        "Descompilar APK a Java (JADX)" -> {
                            dialog.dismiss()
                            decompileApkToJava(file)
                        }
                        "Descompilar APK (Apktool)" -> {
                            dialog.dismiss()
                            ApktoolHelper.decompileApk(requireActivity(), file.path) { targetDir ->
                                if (targetDir != null) {
                                    (activity as? FileListActivity)?.activeFragment?.reload()
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        getString(R.string.toast_dialog_inject_title) -> {
                            val hostActivity = requireActivity()
                            dialog.dismiss()
                            ToastDialogInjectDialogFragment.show(file, hostActivity)
                        }
                        getString(R.string.toast_dialog_clean_title) -> {
                            val hostActivity = requireActivity()
                            dialog.dismiss()
                            ToastDialogCleanDialogFragment.show(file, hostActivity)
                        }
                        getString(R.string.apk_sign) -> {
                            dialog.dismiss()
                            ApkSignerHelper.showSignDialog(requireActivity(), file.path) { targetPath ->
                                if (targetPath != null) {
                                    (activity as? FileListActivity)?.activeFragment?.reload()
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        "Generar clave KeyStore (.jks)" -> {
                            dialog.dismiss()
                            val parentDir = try {
                                file.path.parent?.toFile()?.absolutePath ?: "/storage/emulated/0/Download"
                            } catch (_: Exception) {
                                "/storage/emulated/0/Download"
                            }
                            KeystoreGeneratorDialogFragment.show(requireActivity(), parentDir) {
                                (activity as? FileListActivity)?.activeFragment?.reload()
                            }
                        }
                        "Verificar firma" -> {
                            ApkSignerHelper.showVerifySignatureDialog(requireActivity(), file.path)
                        }
                        "Copiar nombre del paquete" -> {
                            val pkg = parsedPackageName ?: tvPackage.text.toString()
                            val clipboard = context.getSystemService(Context.CLIPBOARD_SERVICE) as ClipboardManager
                            clipboard.setPrimaryClip(ClipData.newPlainText("Package Name", pkg))
                            Toast.makeText(context, "Nombre del paquete copiado:\n$pkg", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                        }
                        "Extraer APK" -> {
                            dialog.dismiss()
                            val activity = activity as? FileListActivity ?: return@setAdapter
                            val activeFrag = activity.activeFragment ?: return@setAdapter
                            val opposite = activity.getOppositeFragment(activeFrag)
                            val dest = opposite?.currentPath ?: java8.nio.file.Paths.get("/storage/emulated/0/Download")
                            activeFrag.copyFilesTo(fileItemSetOf(file), dest)
                        }
                        getString(R.string.apk_optimize) -> {
                            Toast.makeText(context, "El archivo APK ya cuenta con alineación zipalign a 4 bytes", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                        }
                    }
                }
                .show()
        }

        return dialog
    }

    private fun installApkWithShizuku(file: FileItem) {
        val context = requireContext()
        val progressDialog = MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(context)
            .setTitle("Instalando con Shizuku…")
            .setMessage("Por favor espere mientras Shizuku instala la aplicación…")
            .setCancelable(false)
            .create()
        progressDialog.show()

        lifecycleScope.launch {
            val (success, message) = ApkInstallHelper.installWithShizuku(context, file)
            progressDialog.dismiss()
            if (success) {
                Toast.makeText(context, message, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
            } else {
                MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(context)
                    .setTitle("Fallo al instalar con Shizuku")
                    .setMessage(message)
                    .setPositiveButton(android.R.string.ok, null)
                    .show()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun decompileApkToJava(file: FileItem) {
        val hostActivity = activity ?: return
        ApktoolHelper.decompileJava(hostActivity, file.path) { targetDir ->
            if (targetDir != null) {
                (activity as? FileListActivity)?.activeFragment?.reload()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun getSdkName(apiLevel: Int): String = when (apiLevel) {
        21 -> "5.0"
        22 -> "5.1"
        23 -> "6.0"
        24 -> "7.0"
        25 -> "7.1"
        26 -> "8.0"
        27 -> "8.1"
        28 -> "9"
        29 -> "10"
        30 -> "11"
        31 -> "12"
        32 -> "12L"
        33 -> "13"
        34 -> "14"
        35 -> "15"
        else -> "$apiLevel"
    }

    private fun showAppIconViewer(icon: Drawable?, appName: String, packageName: String) {
        val context = requireContext()
        val dialogView = LayoutInflater.from(context).inflate(R.layout.dialog_app_icon_viewer, null)
        val ivLarge = dialogView.findViewById<ImageView>(R.id.ivLargeAppIcon)
        val tvName = dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvViewerAppName)
        val tvPkg = dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvViewerAppPackage)
        val tvDimensions = dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvViewerIconDimensions)
        val btnClose = dialogView.findViewById<ImageButton>(R.id.btnCloseIconViewer)
        val btnSave = dialogView.findViewById<Button>(R.id.btnSaveAppIcon)

        tvName.text = appName
        tvPkg.text = packageName

        val bitmap = if (icon != null) {
            val w = if (icon.intrinsicWidth > 0) icon.intrinsicWidth else 512
            val h = if (icon.intrinsicHeight > 0) icon.intrinsicHeight else 512
            val bmp = Bitmap.createBitmap(w, h, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
            val canvas = Canvas(bmp)
            icon.setBounds(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height)
            icon.draw(canvas)
            bmp
        } else null

        if (bitmap != null) {
            ivLarge.setImageBitmap(bitmap)
            tvDimensions.text = "${bitmap.width} × ${bitmap.height} px"
        } else {
            ivLarge.setImageResource(R.drawable.file_apk_icon)
            tvDimensions.text = "Vector / Default"
        }

        val viewerDialog = MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(context)
            .setView(dialogView)
            .create()

        btnClose?.setOnClickListener { viewerDialog.dismiss() }

        btnSave?.setOnClickListener {
            if (bitmap == null) {
                Toast.makeText(context, "No hay icono para exportar", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                return@setOnClickListener
            }
            try {
                val downloadDir = Environment.getExternalStoragePublicDirectory(Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS)
                if (!downloadDir.exists()) {
                    downloadDir.mkdirs()
                }
                val cleanPkg = packageName.replace("[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]".toRegex(), "_")
                val targetFile = File(downloadDir, "${cleanPkg}_icon.png")
                FileOutputStream(targetFile).use { fos ->
                    bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.PNG, 100, fos)
                }
                Toast.makeText(context, "Icono guardado en:\n${targetFile.absolutePath}", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                e.printStackTrace()
                Toast.makeText(context, "Error al guardar: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }

        viewerDialog.show()
    }

    private data class ApkFunctionOption(
        val title: String,
        val iconRes: Int,
        val iconTint: Int
    )

    companion object {
        fun show(file: FileItem, fragment: Fragment) {
            OpenApkDialogFragment().putArgs(Args(file)).show(fragment)
        }
    }

    @Parcelize
    class Args(val file: FileItem) : ParcelableArgs

    interface Listener {
        fun installApk(file: FileItem)
        fun installApkWithRoot(file: FileItem)
        fun viewApk(file: FileItem)
    }
}
```

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import android.content.Intent
import android.os.Bundle
import java8.nio.file.Path
import me.zhanghai.android.files.app.AppActivity
import me.zhanghai.android.files.app.application
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.MimeType
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.asMimeTypeOrNull
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.fileProviderUri
import me.zhanghai.android.files.filejob.FileJobService
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.archive.isArchivePath
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.createViewIntent
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.extraPath
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.startActivitySafe

class OpenFileActivity : AppActivity() {
    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)

        val intent = intent
        val path = intent.extraPath
        val mimeType = intent.type?.asMimeTypeOrNull()
        if (path != null && mimeType != null) {
            openFile(path, mimeType)
        }
        finish()
    }

    private fun openFile(path: Path, mimeType: MimeType) {
        if (path.isArchivePath) {
            FileJobService.open(path, mimeType, false, this)
        } else {
            val intent = path.fileProviderUri.createViewIntent(mimeType)
                .addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_WRITE_URI_PERMISSION)
                .apply { extraPath = path }
            startActivitySafe(intent)
        }
    }

    companion object {
        private const val ACTION_OPEN_FILE = "me.zhanghai.android.files.intent.action.OPEN_FILE"

        fun createIntent(path: Path, mimeType: MimeType): Intent =
            Intent(ACTION_OPEN_FILE)
                .setPackage(application.packageName)
                .setType(mimeType.value)
                .apply { extraPath = path }
    }
}
```

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import android.app.Dialog
import android.content.DialogInterface

import me.zhanghai.android.files.viewer.video.VideoPlayerActivity

class OpenFileAsDialogFragment : AppCompatDialogFragment() {
    private val args by args<Args>()
    private lateinit var binding: OpenFileAsDialogBinding
    private lateinit var adapter: ToolAdapter
    private var allTools: List<ToolItem> = emptyList()

    override fun onCreateDialog(savedInstanceState: Bundle?): Dialog {
        binding = OpenFileAsDialogBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)

        initTools()

        adapter = ToolAdapter(allTools) { tool ->
            tool.action()
        }

        binding.recyclerView.layoutManager = GridLayoutManager(requireContext(), 3)
        binding.recyclerView.adapter = adapter

        setupHeader()
        setupBottomBar()

        val dialog = MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(requireContext(), theme)
            .setView(binding.root)
            .create()
        dialog.window?.setBackgroundDrawableResource(android.R.color.transparent)
        return dialog
    }

    private fun setupHeader() {
        binding.searchBtn.setOnClickListener {
            if (binding.searchContainer.visibility == View.VISIBLE) {
                binding.searchContainer.visibility = View.GONE
                binding.searchEdit.text.clear()
            } else {
                binding.searchContainer.visibility = View.VISIBLE
                binding.searchEdit.requestFocus()
            }
        }

        binding.searchCloseBtn.setOnClickListener {
            binding.searchContainer.visibility = View.GONE
            binding.searchEdit.text.clear()
        }

        binding.searchEdit.doAfterTextChanged { text ->
            val query = text?.toString()?.trim()?.lowercase() ?: ""
            if (query.isEmpty()) {
                adapter.setItems(allTools)
            } else {
                val filtered = allTools.filter {
                    getString(it.titleRes).lowercase().contains(query)
                }
                adapter.setItems(filtered)
            }
        }

        binding.helpBtn.setOnClickListener {
            MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(requireContext())
                .setTitle(R.string.open_as_help_title)
                .setMessage(R.string.open_as_help_message)
                .setPositiveButton(android.R.string.ok, null)
                .show()
        }
    }

    private fun setupBottomBar() {
        binding.closeBtn.setOnClickListener {
            dismissOrFinishActivity()
        }

        binding.typeBtn.setOnClickListener { v ->
            val popup = PopupMenu(requireContext(), v)
            val builtinItem = popup.menu.add(0, 0, 0, getString(R.string.open_as_type_builtin))
            builtinItem.isCheckable = true
            builtinItem.isChecked = true
            popup.menu.add(0, 1, 1, getString(R.string.open_as_type_text))
            popup.menu.add(0, 2, 2, getString(R.string.open_as_type_image))
            popup.menu.add(0, 3, 3, getString(R.string.open_as_type_video))
            popup.menu.add(0, 4, 4, getString(R.string.open_as_type_audio))
            popup.menu.add(0, 5, 5, getString(R.string.open_as_type_all))

            popup.setOnMenuItemClickListener { item ->
                when (item.itemId) {
                    0 -> {
                        // Built-in
                        adapter.setItems(allTools)
                        binding.searchContainer.visibility = View.GONE
                    }
                    1 -> openWithMimeType("text/*")
                    2 -> openWithMimeType("image/*")
                    3 -> openWithMimeType("video/*")
                    4 -> openWithMimeType("audio/*")
                    5 -> openWithMimeType("*/*")
                }
                true
            }
            popup.show()
        }
    }

    private fun openWithMimeType(mime: String) {
        val intent = args.path.fileProviderUri.createViewIntent(mime.asMimeType())
            .addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_WRITE_URI_PERMISSION)
            .apply { extraPath = args.path }
            .withChooser()
        startActivitySafe(intent)
        dismissOrFinishActivity()
    }

    private fun initTools() {
        val path = args.path
        val fileName = path.fileName.toString()
        val isTxt = fileName.endsWith(".txt", ignoreCase = true) || fileName.endsWith(".text", ignoreCase = true)

        allTools = listOf(
            // 1. Text Editor
            ToolItem("text_editor", R.string.open_as_text_editor, R.drawable.ic_open_as_text) {
                val intent = Intent(requireContext(), TextEditorActivity::class.java).apply {
                    extraPath = path
                }
                requireContext().startActivity(intent)
                dismissOrFinishActivity()
            },

            // 2. Archive Viewer
            ToolItem("archive_viewer", R.string.open_as_archive_viewer, R.drawable.ic_open_as_archive) {
                val isZip = try {
                    path.newInputStream().use { it.read() == 0x50 && it.read() == 0x4B }
                } catch (e: Exception) { false }
                if (isZip || path.isArchivePath || fileName.endsWith(".zip", true) || fileName.endsWith(".7z", true) || fileName.endsWith(".tar", true) || fileName.endsWith(".apk", true) || fileName.endsWith(".jar", true)) {
                    FileJobService.open(path, "application/zip".asMimeType(), false, requireContext())
                } else {
                    val intent = path.fileProviderUri.createViewIntent("application/zip".asMimeType())
                        .addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_WRITE_URI_PERMISSION)
                        .apply { extraPath = path }
                    startActivitySafe(intent)
                }
                dismissOrFinishActivity()
            },

            // 3. Image Viewer
            ToolItem("image_viewer", R.string.open_as_image_viewer, R.drawable.ic_open_as_image) {
                val intent = path.fileProviderUri.createViewIntent("image/*".asMimeType())
                    .addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_WRITE_URI_PERMISSION)
                    .apply { extraPath = path }
                startActivitySafe(intent)
                dismissOrFinishActivity()
            },

            // 4. Hex Editor
            ToolItem("hex_editor", R.string.open_as_hex_editor, R.drawable.ic_open_as_hex) {
                HexEditorActivity.start(requireContext(), path)
                dismissOrFinishActivity()
            },

            // 5. Music Player
            ToolItem("music_player", R.string.open_as_music_player, R.drawable.ic_open_as_music) {
                AudioPlayerDialogFragment.show(path, parentFragmentManager)
                dismissOrFinishActivity()
            },

            // 6. Video Player
            ToolItem("video_player", R.string.open_as_video_player, R.drawable.ic_open_as_video) {
                VideoPlayerActivity.start(requireContext(), path)
                dismissOrFinishActivity()
            },

            // 7. XML Functions
            ToolItem("xml_functions", R.string.open_as_xml_functions, R.drawable.ic_open_as_xml) {
                val intent = Intent(requireContext(), TextEditorActivity::class.java).apply {
                    extraPath = path
                    putExtra("FORCED_SYNTAX", "XML")
                }
                requireContext().startActivity(intent)
                dismissOrFinishActivity()
            },

            // 8. Dex Functions
            ToolItem("dex_functions", R.string.open_as_dex_functions, R.drawable.ic_open_as_dex) {
                DexActionDialogFragment.show(path, parentFragmentManager)
                dismissOrFinishActivity()
            },

            // 9. ARSC Functions
            ToolItem("arsc_functions", R.string.open_as_arsc_functions, R.drawable.ic_open_as_arsc) {
                val intent = Intent(requireContext(), me.zhanghai.android.files.viewer.arsc.ArscEditorActivity::class.java).apply {
                    extraPath = path
                }
                requireContext().startActivity(intent)
                dismissOrFinishActivity()
            },

            // 10. APK Viewer
            ToolItem("apk_viewer", R.string.open_as_apk_viewer, R.drawable.ic_open_as_apk) {
                val intent = path.fileProviderUri.createViewIntent("application/vnd.android.package-archive".asMimeType())
                    .addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_WRITE_URI_PERMISSION)
                    .apply { extraPath = path }
                startActivitySafe(intent)
                dismissOrFinishActivity()
            },

            // 11. APKS Functions
            ToolItem("apks_functions", R.string.open_as_apks_functions, R.drawable.ic_open_as_apks) {
                MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(requireContext())
                    .setTitle(R.string.open_as_apks_functions)
                    .setMessage("Paquete o conjunto APKS: ${path.fileName}\nOpciones: Convertir a APK estándar o instalar.")
                    .setPositiveButton("Convertir APKS") { _, _ -> }
                    .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
                    .show()
            },

            // 12. Script Executor
            ToolItem("script_executor", R.string.open_as_script_executor, R.drawable.ic_open_as_script) {
                ScriptRunnerHelper.showScriptActionDialog(requireActivity(), path)
                dismissOrFinishActivity()
            },

            // 13. Font Viewer
            ToolItem("font_viewer", R.string.open_as_font_viewer, R.drawable.ic_open_as_font) {
                FontViewerDialogFragment.show(path, parentFragmentManager)
                dismissOrFinishActivity()
            },

            // 14. Signature Importer
            ToolItem("signature_importer", R.string.open_as_signature_importer, R.drawable.ic_open_as_signature) {
                SignatureViewerDialogFragment.show(path, parentFragmentManager)
                dismissOrFinishActivity()
            },

            // 15. MT-Plugin Viewer
            ToolItem("plugin_viewer", R.string.open_as_plugin_viewer, R.drawable.ic_open_as_plugin) {
                MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(requireContext())
                    .setTitle(R.string.open_as_plugin_viewer)
                    .setMessage("Plugin OpenManager / MT-Plugin: ${path.fileName}\nIntegración de extensiones y herramientas del sistema.")
                    .setPositiveButton(android.R.string.ok, null)
                    .show()
            },

            // 16. HTML Functions
            ToolItem("html_functions", R.string.open_as_html_functions, R.drawable.ic_open_as_html) {
                HtmlViewerDialogFragment.show(path, parentFragmentManager)
                dismissOrFinishActivity()
            },

            // 17. SVG Functions
            ToolItem("svg_functions", R.string.open_as_svg_functions, R.drawable.ic_open_as_svg) {
                HtmlViewerDialogFragment.show(path, parentFragmentManager)
                dismissOrFinishActivity()

            // 18. 9-Patch Editor
            ToolItem("nine_patch_editor", R.string.open_as_nine_patch_editor, R.drawable.ic_open_as_nine_patch) {

                    .apply { extraPath = path }
                startActivitySafe(intent)
                dismissOrFinishActivity()
            }
        ).let { list ->
            if (isTxt) list.filter { it.id != "script_executor" } else list
        }
    }

    override fun onCancel(dialog: DialogInterface) {
        super.onCancel(dialog)
        dismissOrFinishActivity()
    }

    private fun dismissOrFinishActivity() {
        dismiss()
        if (activity is OpenFileAsDialogActivity) {
            activity?.finish()
        }
    }

    companion object {
        fun show(path: Path, fragmentManager: androidx.fragment.app.FragmentManager) {
            OpenFileAsDialogFragment().putArgs(Args(path)).show(fragmentManager, null)
        }
    }

    @Parcelize
    class Args(val path: @WriteWith<ParcelableParceler> Path) : ParcelableArgs

    data class ToolItem(
        val id: String,
        val titleRes: Int,
        val iconRes: Int,
        val action: () -> Unit
    )

    private class ToolAdapter(
        private var items: List<ToolItem>,
        private val onItemClick: (ToolItem) -> Unit
    ) : RecyclerView.Adapter<ToolViewHolder>() {

        fun setItems(newItems: List<ToolItem>) {
            items = newItems
            notifyDataSetChanged()
        }

        override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): ToolViewHolder {
            val binding = OpenFileAsItemBinding.inflate(
                LayoutInflater.from(parent.context), parent, false
            )
            return ToolViewHolder(binding)
        }

        override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: ToolViewHolder, position: Int) {
            val item = items[position]
            holder.binding.itemIcon.setImageResource(item.iconRes)
            holder.binding.itemTitle.setText(item.titleRes)
            holder.itemView.setOnClickListener {
                onItemClick(item)
            }
        }

        override fun getItemCount(): Int = items.size
    }

    private class ToolViewHolder(val binding: OpenFileAsItemBinding) :
        RecyclerView.ViewHolder(binding.root)
}
```

`app/src/main/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/filelist/PathDialogFragment.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2022 Hai Zhang <dreaming.in.code.zh@gmail.com>
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import android.net.Uri
import java8.nio.file.Path
import java8.nio.file.Paths
import me.zhanghai.android.files.R
import me.zhanghai.android.files.storage.createOrLog
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.asPathNameOrNull
import java.net.URI

abstract class PathDialogFragment : NameDialogFragment() {
    override fun isNameValid(name: String): Boolean {
        if (!super.isNameValid(name)) {
            return false
        }
        if (name.isEmpty()) {
            binding.nameLayout.error = getString(R.string.file_list_path_error_empty)
            return false
        }
        if (name.asPathNameOrNull() == null || name.toPathOrNull() == null) {
            binding.nameLayout.error = getString(R.string.file_list_path_error_invalid)
            return false
        }
        return true
    }

    final override fun onOk(name: String) {
        onOk(name.toPathOrNull()!!)
    }

    private fun String.toPathOrNull(): Path? {
        val uri = URI::class.createOrLog(toString())
            // Also try to accept decoded path.
            ?: Uri.parse(this).let {
                URI::class.createOrLog(
                    it.scheme, it.userInfo, it.host, it.port, it.path, it.query, it.fragment
                )
            }
        if (uri != null) {
            try {
                return Paths.get(uri)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                e.printStackTrace()
            }
        }
        if (startsWith('/')) {
            return Paths.get(this)
        }
        try {
            return PathNavigator.resolve(this, null)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
        }
        return null
    }

    abstract fun onOk(path: Path)
}
```

```kt
/*

package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import java8.nio.file.Path
import java8.nio.file.Paths
import me.zhanghai.android.files.R
import me.zhanghai.android.files.app.application
import me.zhanghai.android.files.compat.DocumentsContractCompat
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.MimeType
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.asDocumentTreeUriOrNull
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.isSupportedArchive
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.archive.archiveFile
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.archive.isArchivePath
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.document.isDocumentPath
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.document.resolver.DocumentResolver
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.linux.isLinuxPath
import me.zhanghai.android.files.settings.Settings
import me.zhanghai.android.files.storage.DocumentTree
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.valueCompat

val Path.isInsideRecycleBin: Boolean
    get() = try {
        val recycleStr = Settings.recycleBinDirectory.toString().trimEnd('/')
        val pathStr = toString().trimEnd('/')
        pathStr == recycleStr || pathStr.startsWith("$recycleStr/")
    } catch (_: Throwable) {
        false
    }

val Path.name: String
    get() = if (isInsideRecycleBin && toString().trimEnd('/') == Settings.recycleBinDirectory.toString().trimEnd('/')) {
        try {
            application.getString(R.string.recycle_bin_display_name)
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            "Recycle Bin"
        }
    } else {
        fileName?.toString() ?: if (isArchivePath) archiveFile.fileName.toString() else "/"
    }

fun Path.toDisplayPath(trailingSlash: Boolean = true): String {
    if (isInsideRecycleBin) {
        val recycleStr = Settings.recycleBinDirectory.toString().trimEnd('/')
        val pathStr = toString().trimEnd('/')
        val binName = try {
            application.getString(R.string.recycle_bin_display_name)
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            "Recycle Bin"
        }
        if (pathStr == recycleStr) {
            return binName + if (trailingSlash) "/" else ""
        } else if (pathStr.startsWith("$recycleStr/")) {
            val sub = pathStr.removePrefix("$recycleStr/").trimStart('/')
            return "$binName/$sub" + if (trailingSlash) "/" else ""
        }
    }
    val raw = when {
        isArchivePath -> {
            val base = archiveFile.toDisplayPath(trailingSlash = false)
            val internal = toString().trimStart('/')
            if (internal.isEmpty()) {
                base
            } else {
                "$base/$internal"
            }
        }
        isDocumentPath -> {
            val docPath = this as? DocumentResolver.Path
            val treeUri = docPath?.treeUri
            if (treeUri != null && treeUri.authority == DocumentsContractCompat.EXTERNAL_STORAGE_PROVIDER_AUTHORITY) {
                val docTreeUri = treeUri.asDocumentTreeUriOrNull()
                val docId = docTreeUri?.documentId
                val base = when {
                    docId != null && docId.startsWith("primary:") -> {
                        val sub = docId.removePrefix("primary:").trimStart('/')
                        if (sub.isEmpty()) "/storage/emulated/0" else "/storage/emulated/0/$sub"
                    }
                    docId != null && docId.contains(":") -> {
                        val parts = docId.split(":", limit = 2)
                        "/storage/${parts[0]}/${parts[1].trimStart('/')}"
                    }
                    else -> "/storage/emulated/0"
                }
                val internal = toString().trimStart('/')
                if (internal.isEmpty()) base else "$base/$internal"
            } else {
                val internal = toString().trimStart('/')
                val storage = Settings.STORAGES.valueCompat.filterIsInstance<DocumentTree>().firstOrNull {
                    it.uri.value == treeUri
                }
                val base = storage?.customName ?: "SAF"
                if (internal.isEmpty()) base else "$base/$internal"
            }
        }
        isLinuxPath -> {
            toFile().path
        }
        else -> {
            toString()
        }
    }
    return if (trailingSlash) {
        if (!raw.endsWith("/")) "$raw/" else raw
    } else {
        if (raw.length > 1 && raw.endsWith("/")) raw.trimEnd('/') else raw
    }
}

fun Path.toUserFriendlyString(): String = toDisplayPath(trailingSlash = false)

fun Path.isArchiveFile(mimeType: MimeType): Boolean = !isArchivePath && mimeType.isSupportedArchive

val Path.isLocalPath: Boolean
    get() =
        isLinuxPath || (isDocumentPath && DocumentResolver.isLocal(this as DocumentResolver.Path))

val Path.isRemotePath: Boolean
    get() = !isLocalPath

val Path.parentOrArchiveParent: Path?
    get() {
        val directParent = parent
        if (directParent != null) return directParent
        if (isArchivePath) {
            return archiveFile.parent
        }
        if (isDocumentPath) {
            val docPath = this as? DocumentResolver.Path ?: return null
            val treeUri = docPath.treeUri
            if (treeUri.authority == DocumentsContractCompat.EXTERNAL_STORAGE_PROVIDER_AUTHORITY) {
                val docTreeUri = treeUri.asDocumentTreeUriOrNull()
                val docId = docTreeUri?.documentId ?: return null
                if (docId.startsWith("primary:Android/data") || docId.startsWith("primary:Android/obb")) {
                    return Paths.get("/storage/emulated/0/Android")
                }
                if (docId.startsWith("primary:") && docId != "primary:") {
                    val sub = docId.removePrefix("primary:").trim('/')
                    val parentSub = sub.substringBeforeLast('/', "")
                    return if (parentSub.isEmpty()) Paths.get("/storage/emulated/0") else Paths.get("/storage/emulated/0/$parentSub")
                }
            }
        }
        return null
    }
```

`app/src/main/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/filelist/PathNavigator.kt`:

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import java.io.File
import java8.nio.file.Path
import java8.nio.file.Paths
import me.zhanghai.android.files.compat.DocumentsContractCompat
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.archive.createArchiveRootPath
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.archive.isArchivePath
import me.zhanghai.android.files.settings.Settings
import me.zhanghai.android.files.storage.DocumentTree
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.valueCompat

object PathNavigator {
    private val ARCHIVE_EXTENSIONS = setOf(
        "zip", "apk", "jar", "tar", "gz", "tgz", "bz2", "tbz2", "xz", "txz", "7z", "rar", "iso"
    )

    fun isArchiveFileName(name: String): Boolean {
        val lower = name.lowercase()
        val ext = lower.substringAfterLast('.', "")
        return ext in ARCHIVE_EXTENSIONS ||
            lower.endsWith(".tar.gz") ||
            lower.endsWith(".tar.bz2") ||
            lower.endsWith(".tar.xz")
    }

    fun resolve(rawInput: String, currentPath: Path?): Path {
        var input = rawInput.trim()
        if (input.isEmpty()) {
            return currentPath ?: Paths.get("/storage/emulated/0")
        }

        // Handle common shortcuts
        if (input == "~" || input.startsWith("~/")) {
            input = "/storage/emulated/0" + input.removePrefix("~")
        }
        if (input == "/sdcard" || input.startsWith("/sdcard/")) {
            input = "/storage/emulated/0" + input.removePrefix("/sdcard")
        }
        if (input == "sdcard" || input.startsWith("sdcard/")) {
            input = "/storage/emulated/0" + input.removePrefix("sdcard")
        }

        // Relative path handling
        val fullPathStr = if (input.startsWith("/")) {
            input
        } else {
            val firstSegment = input.substringBefore('/').lowercase()
            if (firstSegment in setOf(
                    "download", "downloads", "dcim", "documents", "android",
                    "movies", "music", "pictures", "alarms", "notifications",
                    "ringtones", "podcasts"
                )) {
                val normalizedSub = if (firstSegment == "downloads" || firstSegment == "download") {
                    "Download" + input.substring(firstSegment.length)
                } else if (firstSegment == "android") {
                    "Android" + input.substring(firstSegment.length)
                } else if (firstSegment == "dcim") {
                    "DCIM" + input.substring(firstSegment.length)
                } else if (firstSegment == "documents") {
                    "Documents" + input.substring(firstSegment.length)
                } else if (firstSegment == "movies") {
                    "Movies" + input.substring(firstSegment.length)
                } else if (firstSegment == "music") {
                    "Music" + input.substring(firstSegment.length)
                } else if (firstSegment == "pictures") {
                    "Pictures" + input.substring(firstSegment.length)
                } else {
                    input
                }
                "/storage/emulated/0/$normalizedSub"
            } else if (currentPath != null) {
                val currentDisplay = currentPath.toDisplayPath(trailingSlash = false)
                "$currentDisplay/$input"
            } else {
                "/storage/emulated/0/$input"
            }
        }

        // Canonicalize segments ("." and "..")
        val segments = fullPathStr.split('/').filter { it.isNotEmpty() && it != "." }
        val canonicalSegments = mutableListOf<String>()
        for (seg in segments) {
            if (seg == "..") {
                if (canonicalSegments.isNotEmpty()) {
                    canonicalSegments.removeAt(canonicalSegments.size - 1)
                }
            } else {
                canonicalSegments.add(seg)
            }
        }

        // Check if any segment along the path is an archive
        var archiveIndex = -1
        val pathBuilder = StringBuilder()
        for (i in canonicalSegments.indices) {
            pathBuilder.append("/").append(canonicalSegments[i])
            val candidatePath = pathBuilder.toString()
            val candidateFile = File(candidatePath)
            if (candidateFile.isFile && isArchiveFileName(canonicalSegments[i])) {
                archiveIndex = i
                break
            }
            if (isArchiveFileName(canonicalSegments[i]) && i < canonicalSegments.size - 1) {
                archiveIndex = i
                break
            }
        }

        if (archiveIndex != -1) {
            val archiveFilePathStr = "/" + canonicalSegments.subList(0, archiveIndex + 1).joinToString("/")
            val archiveFilePath = Paths.get(archiveFilePathStr)
            var currentArchive: Path = archiveFilePath.createArchiveRootPath()
            val remainingSegments = canonicalSegments.subList(archiveIndex + 1, canonicalSegments.size)
            for (subSeg in remainingSegments) {
                currentArchive = currentArchive.resolve(subSeg)
                if (isArchiveFileName(subSeg)) {
                    try {
                        currentArchive = currentArchive.createArchiveRootPath()
                    } catch (e: Exception) {
                        // ignore and keep currentArchive
                    }
                }
            }
            return currentArchive
        }

        // Check for Android/data or Android/obb with SAF DocumentTree
        val canonicalPathStr = "/" + canonicalSegments.joinToString("/")
        if (canonicalPathStr.startsWith("/storage/emulated/0/Android/data") ||
            canonicalPathStr.startsWith("/storage/emulated/0/Android/obb")) {
            val isObb = canonicalPathStr.startsWith("/storage/emulated/0/Android/obb")
            val basePrefix = if (isObb) "/storage/emulated/0/Android/obb" else "/storage/emulated/0/Android/data"
            val targetDocId = if (isObb) "primary:Android/obb" else "primary:Android/data"

            val storages = Settings.STORAGES.valueCompat
            val match = storages.filterIsInstance<DocumentTree>().firstOrNull { t ->
                val uriStr = t.uri.value.toString()
                val docId = t.uri.documentId
                docId == targetDocId ||
                    (if (isObb) uriStr.contains("Android%2Fobb", true) else uriStr.contains("Android%2Fdata", true))
            }

            if (match != null) {
                val subPath = canonicalPathStr.removePrefix(basePrefix).trimStart('/')
                return if (subPath.isEmpty()) match.path else match.path.resolve(subPath)
            }
        }

        return Paths.get(canonicalPathStr)
    }
}
```

```kt
/*

package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import android.os.AsyncTask
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import androidx.annotation.MainThread
import java8.nio.file.Path
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.common.PathObservable
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.common.observe
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.linux.LinuxPath
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.root.LibSuFileServiceLauncher
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.root.ShizukuManager
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.closeSafe
import java.io.Closeable
import java.io.IOException

class PathObserver(path: Path, @MainThread onChange: () -> Unit) : Closeable {
    private var pathObservable: PathObservable? = null

    private var closed = false
    private val lock = Any()

    init {
        AsyncTask.THREAD_POOL_EXECUTOR.execute {
            synchronized(lock) {
                if (closed) {
                    return@execute
                }
                if (path is LinuxPath) {
                    val file = try { path.toFile() } catch (_: Throwable) { null }
                    if (file != null && !file.canRead() && !LibSuFileServiceLauncher.isSuAvailable() && !ShizukuManager.ready()) {
                        return@execute
                    }
                }
                pathObservable = try {
                    path.observe(THROTTLE_INTERVAL_MILLIS)
                } catch (e: UnsupportedOperationException) {
                    // Ignored.
                    return@execute
                } catch (e: IOException) {
                    // Ignored.
                    e.printStackTrace()
                    return@execute
                } catch (t: Throwable) {
                    // Safely ignore any initializer or permission error during background watch setup
                    t.printStackTrace()
                    return@execute
                }.apply {
                    val mainHandler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
                    addObserver { mainHandler.post(onChange) }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    override fun close() {
        AsyncTask.THREAD_POOL_EXECUTOR.execute {
            synchronized(lock) {
                if (closed) {
                    return@execute
                }
                closed = true
                pathObservable?.closeSafe()
            }
        }
    }

    companion object {
        private const val THROTTLE_INTERVAL_MILLIS = 1000L
    }
}
```

```kt
    override val listener: Listener
        get() = super.listener as Listener

    override fun onCreateDialog(savedInstanceState: Bundle?): Dialog {
        val dialog = super.onCreateDialog(savedInstanceState)

        val isDir = args.file.attributes.isDirectory
        binding.nameLayout.apply {

                setStartIconDrawable(R.drawable.directory_icon_white_24dp)
                setStartIconTintList(android.content.res.ColorStateList.valueOf(0xFFFFB300.toInt()))

                hint = "Nombre del archivo"
            }
        }
        binding.extensionsScrollView?.visibility = android.view.View.GONE

        if (savedInstanceState == null) {
            binding.nameEdit.setSelection(0, args.file.baseName.length)
        }
        return dialog
    }

    override val titleRes: Int = R.string.rename

    override val initialName: String?
        get() = args.file.name

    override fun onOk(name: String) {
        listener.renameFile(args.file, name)
    }

    companion object {
        fun show(file: FileItem, fragment: Fragment) {
            RenameFileDialogFragment().putArgs(Args(file)).show(fragment)
        }
    }

    @Parcelize
    class Args(val file: FileItem) : ParcelableArgs

    interface Listener : FileNameDialogFragment.Listener {
        fun renameFile(file: FileItem, newName: String)
    }
}
```

```kt
object ScriptRunnerHelper {

    data class ScriptAuditReport(
        val deletions: List<String>,
        val rootCalls: List<String>,
        val networkCalls: List<String>,
        val systemPaths: List<String>
    ) {
        val totalFindings: Int
            get() = deletions.size + rootCalls.size + networkCalls.size + systemPaths.size
    }

    fun auditScriptText(content: String): ScriptAuditReport {
        val lines = content.lines()
        val deletions = mutableListOf<String>()
        val rootCalls = mutableListOf<String>()
        val networkCalls = mutableListOf<String>()
        val systemPaths = mutableListOf<String>()

        lines.forEachIndexed { idx, rawLine ->
            val line = rawLine.trim()
            val lineNum = idx + 1
            if (line.startsWith("#")) return@forEachIndexed

            // Split line into chained sub-commands (;, &&, ||, |, \n) for granular inspection
            val subCommands = line.split(Regex("[;&|]+")).map { it.trim() }.filter { it.isNotEmpty() }
            val targetsToCheck = if (subCommands.isNotEmpty()) subCommands + line else listOf(line)

            val hasDeletion = targetsToCheck.any {
                Regex("""\b(rm|rmdir|unlink|truncate|shred|wipe|toybox\s+rm|busybox\s+rm)\b""").containsMatchIn(it)
            }
            if (hasDeletion) {
                deletions.add("Línea $lineNum: $line")
            }

            val hasBlockOrFormat = targetsToCheck.any {
                Regex("""\bdd\s+.*of=|\b(mkfs|mke2fs|fdisk|sfdisk|blkdiscard|wipefs|make_ext4fs)\b""").containsMatchIn(it)
            }
            if (hasBlockOrFormat) {
                deletions.add("Línea $lineNum (formateo/bloque): $line")
            }

            val hasRoot = targetsToCheck.any {
                Regex("""\b(su|sudo|magisk|ksud|setenforce|chown\s+root)\b""").containsMatchIn(it)
            }
            if (hasRoot) {
                rootCalls.add("Línea $lineNum: $line")
            }

            val hasNetwork = targetsToCheck.any {
                Regex("""\b(curl|wget|nc|netcat|ncat|socat|ssh|scp|rsync|ping|traceroute|nmap)\b""").containsMatchIn(it) ||
                    it.contains("/dev/tcp") || it.contains("/dev/udp")
            }
            if (hasNetwork) {
                networkCalls.add("Línea $lineNum: $line")
            }

            val hasSystemOrSymlink = targetsToCheck.any {
                Regex("""(/system|/vendor|/product|/apex|/dev/block|/data/data|/data/user|/data/local/tmp|\bpm\s+uninstall|\breboot|\bsys_reboot|\bshutdown|\bpoweroff|\bhalt|\bchroot\b|\bpivot_root\b|\bmount\s+.*remount|\bln\s+(-[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+\s+)*.*)""").containsMatchIn(it)
            }
            if (hasSystemOrSymlink) {
                systemPaths.add("Línea $lineNum: $line")
            }
        }

        return ScriptAuditReport(deletions, rootCalls, networkCalls, systemPaths)
    }

    fun showScriptAuditDetailsDialog(
        activity: Activity,
        path: Path,
        report: ScriptAuditReport,
        scriptContent: String,
        onExecuteDirect: (() -> Unit)? = null
    ) {
        val density = activity.resources.displayMetrics.density

            } else {
                "⚠️ Se han detectado ${report.totalFindings} operaciones que requieren atención antes de ejecutar:"
            }
        }
        container.addView(tvSummary)

        fun addSection(title: String, items: List<String>, colorHex: String) {

            val tvSectionTitle = TextView(activity).apply {
```
