```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import android.content.Context
import com.android.tools.smali.dexlib2.DexFileFactory
import com.android.tools.smali.dexlib2.iface.ClassDef
import com.android.tools.smali.dexlib2.iface.instruction.ReferenceInstruction
import com.android.tools.smali.dexlib2.iface.reference.MethodReference
import com.reandroid.apk.ApkModule
import com.reandroid.archive.FileInputSource
import me.zhanghai.android.files.viewer.dex.DexEngine
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileOutputStream
import java.util.regex.Matcher
import java.util.regex.Pattern
import java.util.zip.ZipEntry
import java.util.zip.ZipFile

object ToastDialogInjectorEngine {

    data class ToastOptions(
        val message: String,
        val durationLong: Boolean = true,
        val targetActivity: String? = null
    )

    data class DialogOptions(
        val title: String,
        val message: String,
        val positiveButton: String = "OK",
        val positiveUrl: String? = null,
        val negativeButton: String? = null,
        val cancelable: Boolean = true,
        val targetActivity: String? = null
    )

    data class CleanOptions(
        val cleanToasts: Boolean = true,
        val cleanDialogs: Boolean = true
    )

    data class CleanResult(
        val toastsRemoved: Int,
        val dialogsRemoved: Int,
        val dexFilesModified: Int,
        val outputFile: File
    )

    val TOAST_PATTERN: Pattern = Pattern.compile(
        "^[ \\t]*invoke-[^ \\t]+[ \\t]+.*Landroid/widget/Toast;->show\\(\\)V.*$",
        Pattern.MULTILINE
    )

    val DIALOG_PATTERN: Pattern = Pattern.compile(
        "^[ \\t]*invoke-[^ \\t]+[ \\t]+.*L(?:android/app|androidx/appcompat/app|android/support/v7/app|com/google/android/material/dialog)/(?:AlertDialog(?:\\\$Builder)?|Dialog|MaterialAlertDialogBuilder);->show\\(.*$(?:\\r?\\n[ \\t]*move-result(?:-object)?[ \\t]+(v\\d+|p\\d+))?",
        Pattern.MULTILINE
    )

    fun isDialogClass(defClass: String): Boolean {
        return defClass == "Landroid/app/AlertDialog;" ||
            defClass == "Landroid/app/AlertDialog\$Builder;" ||
            defClass == "Landroid/app/Dialog;" ||
            defClass == "Landroidx/appcompat/app/AlertDialog;" ||
            defClass == "Landroidx/appcompat/app/AlertDialog\$Builder;" ||
            defClass == "Landroid/support/v7/app/AlertDialog;" ||
            defClass == "Landroid/support/v7/app/AlertDialog\$Builder;" ||
            defClass == "Lcom/google/android/material/dialog/MaterialAlertDialogBuilder;"
    }

    fun findActivities(apkFile: File): List<String> {
        val activities = mutableListOf<String>()
        var mainActivity: String? = null

        try {
            ApkModule.loadApkFile(apkFile).use { module ->
                val manifest = module.androidManifest
                if (manifest != null) {
                    mainActivity = manifest.mainActivityClassName
                    val actList = manifest.listActivities()
                    for (act in actList) {
                        val nameAttr = act.searchAttributeByName("name")
                        val actName = nameAttr?.valueAsString
                        if (!actName.isNullOrBlank()) {
                            val fullName = manifest.fullClassName(actName)
                            if (!activities.contains(fullName)) {
                                activities.add(fullName)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
        }

        // Put main launcher activity first if identified
        if (!mainActivity.isNullOrBlank() && activities.contains(mainActivity)) {
            activities.remove(mainActivity)
            activities.add(0, mainActivity!!)
        }

        return activities
    }

    fun escapeSmaliString(input: String): String {
        val sb = StringBuilder(input.length + 16)
        for (c in input) {
            when (c) {
                '"' -> sb.append("\\\"")
                '\\' -> sb.append("\\\\")
                '\n' -> sb.append("\\n")
                '\r' -> sb.append("\\r")
                '\t' -> sb.append("\\t")
                '\b' -> sb.append("\\b")
                '\u000c' -> sb.append("\\f")
                else -> {
                    if (c.code < 0x20 || c.code > 0x7E) {
                        sb.append(String.format("\\u%04x", c.code))
                    } else {
                        sb.append(c)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return sb.toString()
    }

    @Throws(Exception::class)
    fun injectToast(
        context: Context,
        inputApk: File,
        outputApk: File,
        options: ToastOptions,
        onProgress: ((String) -> Unit)? = null
    ): File {
        val activities = findActivities(inputApk)
        val targetClass = options.targetActivity?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
            ?: activities.firstOrNull()
            ?: throw IllegalStateException("No se encontraron actividades en el APK")

        val targetDescriptor = "L${targetClass.replace('.', '/')};"
        val workDir = File(context.cacheDir, "inject_toast_${System.currentTimeMillis()}").apply { mkdirs() }

        try {
            onProgress?.invoke("Extrayendo archivos DEX...")
            val dexFiles = extractDexFiles(inputApk, workDir)

            var targetDexEntry: String? = null
            var targetDexFile: File? = null

            for ((entryName, dex) in dexFiles) {
                val dexBacked = DexFileFactory.loadDexFile(dex, DexEngine.defaultOpcodes)
                if (dexBacked.classes.any { it.type == targetDescriptor }) {
                    targetDexEntry = entryName
                    targetDexFile = dex
                    break
                }
            }

            if (targetDexFile == null || targetDexEntry == null) {
                throw IllegalStateException("No se pudo localizar la actividad $targetClass en los archivos DEX")
            }

            onProgress?.invoke("Desensamblando $targetClass...")
            val originalSmali = DexEngine.disassembleClass(targetDexFile, targetDescriptor)
            if (originalSmali.startsWith("# Error")) {
                throw IllegalStateException("Error al desensamblar $targetClass: $originalSmali")
            }

            onProgress?.invoke("Inyectando llamada a Toast...")
            val escapedMsg = escapeSmaliString(options.message)
            val durationConst = if (options.durationLong) "0x1" else "0x0"

            val toastMethodSmali = """
.method private showOpenManagerToast()V
    .registers 3

    const-string v0, "$escapedMsg"
    const/4 v1, $durationConst
    invoke-static {p0, v0, v1}, Landroid/widget/Toast;->makeText(Landroid/content/Context;Ljava/lang/CharSequence;I)Landroid/widget/Toast;
    move-result-object v0
    invoke-virtual {v0}, Landroid/widget/Toast;->show()V
    return-void
.end method
""".trimIndent()

            val modifiedSmali = injectMethodCallIntoClass(
                originalSmali,
                targetDescriptor,
                "showOpenManagerToast",
                toastMethodSmali
            )

            onProgress?.invoke("Reensamblando DEX...")
            val (success, errorMsg) = DexEngine.assembleClassSmali(
                context,
                targetDexFile,
                modifiedSmali,
                targetDescriptor
            )
            if (!success) {
                throw IllegalStateException("Error al reensamblar clase: $errorMsg")
            }

            onProgress?.invoke("Empaquetando APK...")
            val unsignedTemp = File(workDir, "unsigned.apk")
            ApkModule.loadApkFile(inputApk).use { module ->
                module.add(FileInputSource(targetDexFile, targetDexEntry))
                module.writeApk(unsignedTemp)
            }

            onProgress?.invoke("Firmando APK...")
            ApkSignerHelper.signFileDirect(unsignedTemp, outputApk)
            return outputApk
        } finally {
            workDir.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    @Throws(Exception::class)
    fun injectDialog(
        context: Context,
        inputApk: File,
        outputApk: File,
        options: DialogOptions,
        onProgress: ((String) -> Unit)? = null
    ): File {
        val activities = findActivities(inputApk)
        val targetClass = options.targetActivity?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
            ?: activities.firstOrNull()
            ?: throw IllegalStateException("No se encontraron actividades en el APK")

        val targetDescriptor = "L${targetClass.replace('.', '/')};"
        val workDir = File(context.cacheDir, "inject_dialog_${System.currentTimeMillis()}").apply { mkdirs() }

        try {
            onProgress?.invoke("Extrayendo archivos DEX...")
            val dexFiles = extractDexFiles(inputApk, workDir)

            var targetDexEntry: String? = null
            var targetDexFile: File? = null

            for ((entryName, dex) in dexFiles) {
                val dexBacked = DexFileFactory.loadDexFile(dex, DexEngine.defaultOpcodes)
                if (dexBacked.classes.any { it.type == targetDescriptor }) {
                    targetDexEntry = entryName
                    targetDexFile = dex
                    break
                }
            }

            if (targetDexFile == null || targetDexEntry == null) {
                throw IllegalStateException("No se pudo localizar la actividad $targetClass en los archivos DEX")
            }

            onProgress?.invoke("Desensamblando $targetClass...")
            val originalSmali = DexEngine.disassembleClass(targetDexFile, targetDescriptor)
            if (originalSmali.startsWith("# Error")) {
                throw IllegalStateException("Error al desensamblar $targetClass: $originalSmali")
            }

            onProgress?.invoke("Inyectando AlertDialog...")
            val escapedTitle = escapeSmaliString(options.title)
            val fullMessage = if (!options.positiveUrl.isNullOrBlank()) {
                "${options.message}\n\n${options.positiveUrl}"
            } else {
                options.message
            }
            val escapedMsg = escapeSmaliString(fullMessage)
            val escapedPos = escapeSmaliString(options.positiveButton.ifBlank { "OK" })
            val cancelableInt = if (options.cancelable) "0x1" else "0x0"

            val negativeBlock = if (!options.negativeButton.isNullOrBlank()) {
                val escapedNeg = escapeSmaliString(options.negativeButton)
                """
    const-string v1, "$escapedNeg"
    const/4 v2, 0x0
    invoke-virtual {v0, v1, v2}, Landroid/app/AlertDialog${'$'}Builder;->setNegativeButton(Ljava/lang/CharSequence;Landroid/content/DialogInterface${'$'}OnClickListener;)Landroid/app/AlertDialog${'$'}Builder;
""".trimIndent()
            } else {
                ""
            }

            val dialogMethodSmali = """
.method private showOpenManagerDialog()V
    .registers 5

    new-instance v0, Landroid/app/AlertDialog${'$'}Builder;
    invoke-direct {v0, p0}, Landroid/app/AlertDialog${'$'}Builder;-><init>(Landroid/content/Context;)V

    const-string v1, "$escapedTitle"
    invoke-virtual {v0, v1}, Landroid/app/AlertDialog${'$'}Builder;->setTitle(Ljava/lang/CharSequence;)Landroid/app/AlertDialog${'$'}Builder;

    const-string v1, "$escapedMsg"
    invoke-virtual {v0, v1}, Landroid/app/AlertDialog${'$'}Builder;->setMessage(Ljava/lang/CharSequence;)Landroid/app/AlertDialog${'$'}Builder;

    const-string v1, "$escapedPos"
    const/4 v2, 0x0
    invoke-virtual {v0, v1, v2}, Landroid/app/AlertDialog${'$'}Builder;->setPositiveButton(Ljava/lang/CharSequence;Landroid/content/DialogInterface${'$'}OnClickListener;)Landroid/app/AlertDialog${'$'}Builder;
$negativeBlock
    const/4 v1, $cancelableInt
    invoke-virtual {v0, v1}, Landroid/app/AlertDialog${'$'}Builder;->setCancelable(Z)Landroid/app/AlertDialog${'$'}Builder;

    invoke-virtual {v0}, Landroid/app/AlertDialog${'$'}Builder;->show()Landroid/app/AlertDialog;
    return-void
.end method
""".trimIndent()

            val modifiedSmali = injectMethodCallIntoClass(
                originalSmali,
                targetDescriptor,
                "showOpenManagerDialog",
                dialogMethodSmali
            )

            onProgress?.invoke("Reensamblando DEX...")
            val (success, errorMsg) = DexEngine.assembleClassSmali(
                context,
                targetDexFile,
                modifiedSmali,
                targetDescriptor
            )
            if (!success) {
                throw IllegalStateException("Error al reensamblar clase: $errorMsg")
            }

            onProgress?.invoke("Empaquetando APK...")
            val unsignedTemp = File(workDir, "unsigned.apk")
            ApkModule.loadApkFile(inputApk).use { module ->
                module.add(FileInputSource(targetDexFile, targetDexEntry))
                module.writeApk(unsignedTemp)
            }

            onProgress?.invoke("Firmando APK...")
            ApkSignerHelper.signFileDirect(unsignedTemp, outputApk)
            return outputApk
        } finally {
            workDir.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    fun injectMethodCallIntoClass(
        smaliCode: String,
        classDescriptor: String,
        helperMethodName: String,
        helperMethodSmali: String
    ): String {
        val lines = smaliCode.lines().toMutableList()
        val invokeInstruction = "    invoke-direct {p0}, $classDescriptor->$helperMethodName()V"

        // Search for onCreate(Landroid/os/Bundle;)V
        var onCreateIndex = -1
        for (i in lines.indices) {
            val line = lines[i].trim()
            if (line.startsWith(".method") && line.contains("onCreate(Landroid/os/Bundle;)V")) {
                onCreateIndex = i
                break
            }
        }

        if (onCreateIndex != -1) {
            // Find insertion point right after registers/locals and prologue, skipping any annotations
            var insertPos = onCreateIndex + 1
            var inAnnotation = false
            var inParam = false
            while (insertPos < lines.size) {
                val l = lines[insertPos].trim()
                if (l == ".end method") {
                    break
                }
                if (l.startsWith(".annotation")) {
                    inAnnotation = true
                    insertPos++
                    continue
                }
                if (inAnnotation) {
                    if (l.startsWith(".end annotation")) {
                        inAnnotation = false
                    }
                    insertPos++
                    continue
                }
                if (l.startsWith(".param")) {
                    if (!l.endsWith("\"") && !l.contains(",")) {
                        inParam = true
                    }
                    insertPos++
                    continue
                }
                if (inParam) {
                    if (l.startsWith(".end param")) {
                        inParam = false
                    }
                    insertPos++
                    continue
                }
                if (l.startsWith(".registers") || l.startsWith(".locals")) {
                    insertPos++
                    continue
                }
                if (l.startsWith(".prologue")) {
                    insertPos++
                    break
                }
                break
            }
            lines.add(insertPos, invokeInstruction)
        } else {
            // Find superclass from .super directive
            var superClass = "Landroid/app/Activity;"
            for (line in lines) {
                val t = line.trim()
                if (t.startsWith(".super ")) {
                    superClass = t.removePrefix(".super ").trim()
                    break
                }
            }
            val synthesizedOnCreate = """
.method protected onCreate(Landroid/os/Bundle;)V
    .registers 2
    .param p1, "savedInstanceState"

    invoke-super {p0, p1}, $superClass->onCreate(Landroid/os/Bundle;)V

$invokeInstruction

    return-void
.end method
""".trimIndent()
            lines.add(lines.size - 1, synthesizedOnCreate)
        }

        // Append helper method at the end before .end class or at file end
        lines.add(lines.size - 1, "\n$helperMethodSmali\n")
        return lines.joinToString("\n")
    }

    @Throws(Exception::class)
    fun cleanToastsAndDialogs(
        context: Context,
        inputApk: File,
        outputApk: File,
        options: CleanOptions,
        onProgress: ((String) -> Unit)? = null
    ): CleanResult {
        val workDir = File(context.cacheDir, "clean_toasts_${System.currentTimeMillis()}").apply { mkdirs() }
        var totalToasts = 0
        var totalDialogs = 0
        val modifiedDexEntries = mutableMapOf<String, File>()

        try {
            onProgress?.invoke("Extrayendo archivos DEX...")
            val dexFiles = extractDexFiles(inputApk, workDir)

            for ((entryName, dexFile) in dexFiles) {
                onProgress?.invoke("Analizando $entryName...")
                val dexBacked = DexFileFactory.loadDexFile(dexFile, DexEngine.defaultOpcodes)

                // Scan classes for candidates
                val candidateClasses = mutableSetOf<ClassDef>()
                for (cls in dexBacked.classes) {
                    var matches = false
                    for (m in cls.methods) {
                        val impl = m.implementation ?: continue
                        for (inst in impl.instructions) {
                            if (inst is ReferenceInstruction) {
                                val ref = inst.reference
                                if (ref is MethodReference) {
                                    val defClass = ref.definingClass
                                    val name = ref.name
                                    if (options.cleanToasts && defClass == "Landroid/widget/Toast;" && name == "show") {
                                        matches = true
                                        break
                                    }
                                    if (options.cleanDialogs && isDialogClass(defClass) && name == "show") {
                                        matches = true
                                        break
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        if (matches) break
                    }
                    if (matches) {
                        candidateClasses.add(cls)
                    }
                }

                if (candidateClasses.isEmpty()) {
                    continue
                }

                var dexModified = false
                for (cls in candidateClasses) {
                    val originalSmali = DexEngine.disassembleClass(dexFile, cls.type)
                    var smali = originalSmali

                    if (options.cleanToasts) {
                        val matcher = TOAST_PATTERN.matcher(smali)
                        var count = 0
                        val sb = StringBuffer()
                        while (matcher.find()) {
                            matcher.appendReplacement(sb, Matcher.quoteReplacement("    nop # Neutralized Toast.show"))
                            count++
                        }
                        matcher.appendTail(sb)
                        if (count > 0) {
                            totalToasts += count
                            smali = sb.toString()
                        }
                    }

                    if (options.cleanDialogs) {
                        val matcher = DIALOG_PATTERN.matcher(smali)
                        var count = 0
                        val sb = StringBuffer()
                        while (matcher.find()) {
                            val reg = matcher.group(1)
                            val rep = if (reg != null) {
                                "    nop # Neutralized Dialog.show\n    const/4 $reg, 0x0"
                            } else {
                                "    nop # Neutralized Dialog.show"
                            }
                            matcher.appendReplacement(sb, Matcher.quoteReplacement(rep))
                            count++
                        }
                        matcher.appendTail(sb)
                        if (count > 0) {
                            totalDialogs += count
                            smali = sb.toString()
                        }
                    }

                    if (smali != originalSmali) {
                        val (success, _) = DexEngine.assembleClassSmali(context, dexFile, smali, cls.type)
                        if (success) {
                            dexModified = true
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (dexModified) {
                    modifiedDexEntries[entryName] = dexFile
                }
            }

            if (modifiedDexEntries.isEmpty()) {
                throw IllegalStateException("No se encontraron llamadas activas a Toasts o Diálogos para neutralizar")
            }

            onProgress?.invoke("Empaquetando APK limpio...")
            val unsignedTemp = File(workDir, "unsigned.apk")
            ApkModule.loadApkFile(inputApk).use { module ->
                for ((entryName, dexFile) in modifiedDexEntries) {
                    module.add(FileInputSource(dexFile, entryName))
                }
                module.writeApk(unsignedTemp)
            }

            onProgress?.invoke("Firmando y alineando APK...")
            ApkSignerHelper.signFileDirect(unsignedTemp, outputApk)

            return CleanResult(
                toastsRemoved = totalToasts,
                dialogsRemoved = totalDialogs,
                dexFilesModified = modifiedDexEntries.size,
                outputFile = outputApk
            )
        } finally {
            workDir.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    private fun extractDexFiles(inputApk: File, targetDir: File): Map<String, File> {
        val result = mutableMapOf<String, File>()
        ZipFile(inputApk).use { zip ->
            val entries = zip.entries()
            while (entries.hasMoreElements()) {
                val entry = entries.nextElement()
                if (!entry.isDirectory && entry.name.endsWith(".dex", ignoreCase = true)) {
                    val outFile = File(targetDir, entry.name)
                    // Zip Slip protection: ensure entry does not escape targetDir
                    if (!outFile.canonicalPath.startsWith(targetDir.canonicalPath + File.separator)) {
                        continue
                    }
                    outFile.parentFile?.mkdirs()
                    zip.getInputStream(entry).use { input ->
                        FileOutputStream(outFile).use { output ->
                            input.copyTo(output)
                        }
                    }
                    result[entry.name] = outFile
                }
            }
        }
        return result
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/filelist/TrailData.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2018 Hai Zhang <dreaming.in.code.zh@gmail.com>
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import android.os.Parcelable
import java8.nio.file.Path
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.archive.archiveFile
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.archive.isArchivePath

class TrailData private constructor(
    val trail: List<Path>,
    private val states: MutableList<Parcelable?>,
    val currentIndex: Int
) {
    fun navigateTo(lastState: Parcelable, path: Path): TrailData {
        val newTrail = createTrail(path)
        val newStates = mutableListOf<Parcelable?>()
        val newIndex = newTrail.size - 1
        var isPrefix = true
        for (index in newTrail.indices) {
            if (isPrefix && index < trail.size) {
                if (newTrail[index] == trail[index]) {
                    newStates.add(if (index != currentIndex) states[index] else lastState)
                } else {
                    isPrefix = false
                    newStates.add(null)
                }
            } else {
                newStates.add(null)
            }
        }
        if (isPrefix) {
            for (index in newTrail.size..<trail.size) {
                newTrail.add(trail[index])
                newStates.add(if (index != currentIndex) states[index] else lastState)
            }
        }
        return TrailData(newTrail, newStates, newIndex)
    }

    fun navigateUp(): TrailData? {
        if (currentIndex == 0) {
            return null
        }
        val newIndex = currentIndex - 1
        return TrailData(trail, states, newIndex)
    }

    val pendingState: Parcelable?
        get() = states.set(currentIndex, null)

    val currentPath: Path
        get() = trail[currentIndex]

    companion object {
        fun of(path: Path): TrailData {
            val trail: List<Path> = createTrail(path)
            val states = MutableList<Parcelable?>(trail.size) { null }
            val index = trail.size - 1
            return TrailData(trail, states, index)
        }

        private fun createTrail(path: Path): MutableList<Path> {
            var path = path
            val trail = mutableListOf<Path>()
            val archiveFile = if (path.isArchivePath) path.archiveFile else null
            while (true) {
                trail.add(path)
                path = path.parent ?: break
            }
            trail.reverse()
            if (archiveFile != null) {
                val archiveFileParent = archiveFile.parent
                if (archiveFileParent != null) {
                    trail.addAll(0, createTrail(archiveFileParent))
                }
            }
            return trail
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/filelist/TrailLiveData.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2018 Hai Zhang <dreaming.in.code.zh@gmail.com>
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import android.os.Parcelable
import androidx.lifecycle.LiveData
import java8.nio.file.Path

class TrailLiveData : LiveData<TrailData>() {
    fun navigateTo(lastState: Parcelable, path: Path) {
        val oldTrailData = value
        if (oldTrailData == null) {
            resetTo(path)
            return
        }
        value = oldTrailData.navigateTo(lastState, path)
    }

    fun resetTo(path: Path) {
        value = TrailData.of(path)
    }

    fun navigateUp(): Boolean {
        val oldTrailData = value ?: return false
        val trailData = oldTrailData.navigateUp() ?: return false
        value = trailData
        return true
    }

    fun reload() {
        value = value
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/filelist/UnprivilegedDirectoryResolver.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.os.Environment
import android.system.Os
import java8.nio.file.Path
import java8.nio.file.Paths
import me.zhanghai.android.files.app.application
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.FileItem
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.createFallbackFileItem
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.createFastVirtualFileItem
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.loadFileItem
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.archive.isArchivePath
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.common.BasicFileType
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.common.toByteString
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.linux.LinuxPath
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.linux.isLinuxPath
import java.io.File

/**
 * Resolves accessible or known subdirectories and files when browsing restricted
 * Android paths without root privileges, matching MT Manager's unprivileged directory view.
 */
object UnprivilegedDirectoryResolver {

    @Volatile
    private var cachedInstalledPackages: List<String> = emptyList()

    @Volatile
    private var lastPackageCacheTimeMs: Long = 0L

    private const val PACKAGE_CACHE_TTL_MS = 30_000L

    private fun getInstalledPackagesCached(): List<String> {
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        val current = cachedInstalledPackages
        if (current.isNotEmpty() && now - lastPackageCacheTimeMs < PACKAGE_CACHE_TTL_MS) {
            return current
        }
        return try {
            val pkgs = application.packageManager.getInstalledApplications(0)
                .mapNotNull { it.packageName }
            cachedInstalledPackages = pkgs
            lastPackageCacheTimeMs = now
            pkgs
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            current
        }
    }

    data class VirtualEntry(
        val name: String,
        val type: BasicFileType = BasicFileType.DIRECTORY
    )

    private val STATIC_DIRECTORY_MAP: Map<String, List<VirtualEntry>> = mapOf(
        "/" to listOf(
            VirtualEntry("acct"),
            VirtualEntry("apex"),
            VirtualEntry("bin", BasicFileType.SYMBOLIC_LINK),
            VirtualEntry("bugreports", BasicFileType.SYMBOLIC_LINK),
            VirtualEntry("cache"),
            VirtualEntry("config"),
            VirtualEntry("d", BasicFileType.SYMBOLIC_LINK),
            VirtualEntry("data"),
            VirtualEntry("data_mirror"),
            VirtualEntry("debug_ramdisk"),
            VirtualEntry("dev"),
            VirtualEntry("etc", BasicFileType.SYMBOLIC_LINK),
            VirtualEntry("init", BasicFileType.REGULAR_FILE),
            VirtualEntry("init.environ.rc", BasicFileType.REGULAR_FILE),
            VirtualEntry("init.rc", BasicFileType.REGULAR_FILE),
            VirtualEntry("linkerconfig"),
            VirtualEntry("lost+found"),
            VirtualEntry("metadata"),
            VirtualEntry("mnt"),
            VirtualEntry("odm"),
            VirtualEntry("odm_dlkm"),
            VirtualEntry("oem"),
            VirtualEntry("postinstall"),
            VirtualEntry("proc"),
            VirtualEntry("product"),
            VirtualEntry("sdcard", BasicFileType.SYMBOLIC_LINK),
            VirtualEntry("second_stage_resources"),
            VirtualEntry("storage"),
            VirtualEntry("sys"),
            VirtualEntry("system"),
            VirtualEntry("system_dlkm"),
            VirtualEntry("system_ext"),
            VirtualEntry("vendor"),
            VirtualEntry("vendor_dlkm")
        ),
        "/storage" to listOf(
            VirtualEntry("emulated"),
            VirtualEntry("self", BasicFileType.SYMBOLIC_LINK)
        ),
        "/storage/emulated" to listOf(
            VirtualEntry("0")
        ),
        "/storage/self" to listOf(
            VirtualEntry("primary", BasicFileType.SYMBOLIC_LINK)
        ),
        "/mnt" to listOf(
            VirtualEntry("sdcard", BasicFileType.SYMBOLIC_LINK),
            VirtualEntry("user"),
            VirtualEntry("runtime"),
            VirtualEntry("pass_through"),
            VirtualEntry("installer"),
            VirtualEntry("androidwritable")
        ),
        "/mnt/user" to listOf(
            VirtualEntry("0")
        ),
        "/data" to listOf(
            VirtualEntry("app"),
            VirtualEntry("data"),
            VirtualEntry("local"),
            VirtualEntry("media"),
            VirtualEntry("misc"),
            VirtualEntry("system"),
            VirtualEntry("user"),
            VirtualEntry("user_de"),
            VirtualEntry("vendor"),
            VirtualEntry("adb")
        ),
        "/data/local" to listOf(
            VirtualEntry("tmp"),
            VirtualEntry("traces")
        ),
        "/data/user" to listOf(
            VirtualEntry("0")
        ),
        "/data/user_de" to listOf(
            VirtualEntry("0")
        ),
        "/data/media" to listOf(
            VirtualEntry("0")
        )
    )

    fun resolveEntriesForPath(directoryPath: Path): List<FileItem> {
        if (directoryPath.isArchivePath || !directoryPath.isLinuxPath) {
            return emptyList()
        }
        val rawPath = directoryPath.toString()
        val normalized = if (rawPath.length > 1) rawPath.trimEnd('/') else rawPath
        val resultMap = LinkedHashMap<String, FileItem>()

        fun addChildEntry(name: String, forcedType: BasicFileType? = null, fastVirtual: Boolean = false) {
            if (name.isBlank() || name == "." || name == ".." || resultMap.containsKey(name)) return
            val childFile = File(normalized, name)
            val childPath: Path = (directoryPath as? LinuxPath)?.resolve(name.toByteString())
                ?: Paths.get(childFile.absolutePath)
            val item = if (fastVirtual && forcedType != null) {
                childPath.createFastVirtualFileItem(forcedType)
            } else {
                try {
                    if (forcedType == null) {
                        childPath.loadFileItem()
                    } else {
                        try {
                            childPath.loadFileItem()
                        } catch (_: Throwable) {
                            childPath.createFallbackFileItem(childFile, forcedType)
                        }
                    }
                } catch (_: Throwable) {
                    childPath.createFallbackFileItem(childFile, forcedType)
                }
            }
            if (item != null) {
                resultMap[name] = item
            }
        }

        // 1. Check static known hierarchy (e.g. /, /storage, /storage/emulated, /data, /data/local, /mnt)
        STATIC_DIRECTORY_MAP[normalized]?.forEach { entry ->
            val candidateFile = File(normalized, entry.name)
            val existsOrKnown = try {
                candidateFile.exists() || Os.lstat(candidateFile.absolutePath) != null || Os.readlink(candidateFile.absolutePath) != null
            } catch (_: Throwable) {
                // Even if SELinux denies lstat, keep core structural directories so user can traverse into them
                normalized in setOf("/storage", "/storage/emulated", "/data", "/data/local", "/data/user", "/mnt") ||
                    entry.type == BasicFileType.DIRECTORY || entry.type == BasicFileType.SYMBOLIC_LINK
            }
            if (existsOrKnown) {
                addChildEntry(entry.name, entry.type)
            }
        }

        // 2. Discover mounted paths under current directory from /proc/self/mounts
        try {
            val mountsFile = File("/proc/self/mounts")
            if (mountsFile.canRead()) {
                val prefix = if (normalized == "/") "/" else "$normalized/"
                mountsFile.forEachLine { line ->
                    val parts = line.split(' ')
                    if (parts.size >= 2) {
                        val mountPoint = parts[1]
                        if (mountPoint.startsWith(prefix) && mountPoint.length > prefix.length) {
                            val sub = mountPoint.substring(prefix.length).substringBefore('/')
                            if (sub.isNotEmpty()) {
                                addChildEntry(sub, BasicFileType.DIRECTORY)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (_: Throwable) {}

        // 3. Special handling for /data/data, /data/user/0, /data/user_de/0
        if (normalized == "/data/data" || normalized == "/data/user/0" || normalized == "/data/user_de/0") {
            val ownPkg = application.packageName
            addChildEntry(ownPkg, BasicFileType.DIRECTORY, fastVirtual = false)
            for (pkg in getInstalledPackagesCached()) {
                if (pkg == ownPkg) continue
                addChildEntry(pkg, BasicFileType.DIRECTORY, fastVirtual = true)
            }
        }

        // 4. Special handling for /storage/emulated/0/Android/data and /sdcard/Android/data (and obb)
        val lowerNorm = normalized.lowercase()
        if (lowerNorm.endsWith("/android/data") || lowerNorm.endsWith("/android/obb")) {
            val ownPkg = application.packageName
            addChildEntry(ownPkg, BasicFileType.DIRECTORY, fastVirtual = false)
            val isData = lowerNorm.endsWith("/android/data")
            for (pkg in getInstalledPackagesCached()) {
                if (pkg == ownPkg) continue
                if (isData) {
                    addChildEntry(pkg, BasicFileType.DIRECTORY, fastVirtual = true)
                } else {
                    val candidate = File(normalized, pkg)
                    val exists = try {
                        candidate.exists() || Os.lstat(candidate.absolutePath) != null
                    } catch (_: Throwable) {
                        false
                    }
                    if (exists) {
                        addChildEntry(pkg, BasicFileType.DIRECTORY, fastVirtual = true)
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // 5. Special handling for own package inside /data/data/<ownPkg> or /data/user/0/<ownPkg>
        val ownDataDir = application.applicationInfo?.dataDir
        if (ownDataDir != null && (normalized == ownDataDir || normalized == "/data/data/${application.packageName}" || normalized == "/data/user/0/${application.packageName}")) {
            val realDir = File(ownDataDir)
            realDir.listFiles()?.forEach { f ->
                addChildEntry(
                    f.name,
                    if (f.isDirectory) BasicFileType.DIRECTORY else BasicFileType.REGULAR_FILE
                )
            }
        }

        return resultMap.values.toList()
    }
}
```

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist.duplicate

import android.app.Dialog
import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.widget.CheckBox
import android.widget.EditText
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.RadioButton
import android.widget.RadioGroup
import android.widget.TextView
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.appcompat.widget.SwitchCompat
import androidx.fragment.app.DialogFragment
import androidx.fragment.app.FragmentActivity
import androidx.lifecycle.lifecycleScope
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.LinearLayoutManager
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
import com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
import com.google.android.material.dialog.MaterialAlertDialogBuilder
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import me.zhanghai.android.files.R
import java.io.File
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat
import java.util.Date
import java.util.Locale

class DuplicateFinderDialog : DialogFragment() {

    private var targetDirectoryPath: String = "/storage/emulated/0"
    var onDuplicatesDeleted: (() -> Unit)? = null

    private lateinit var layoutSetup: View
    private lateinit var layoutScanning: View
    private lateinit var layoutResults: View

    private lateinit var tvSetupPath: TextView
    private lateinit var switchRecursive: SwitchCompat
    private lateinit var rgMinSize: RadioGroup
    private lateinit var editExtensionFilter: EditText
    private lateinit var btnStartScan: MaterialButton

    private lateinit var tvScanningProgress: TextView
    private lateinit var tvResultsSummary: TextView
    private lateinit var tvResultsSub: TextView
    private lateinit var recyclerDuplicates: RecyclerView
    private lateinit var btnDeleteDuplicates: MaterialButton

    private var scanResult: DuplicateScanResult? = null
    private var adapter: DuplicateRecyclerAdapter? = null

    companion object {
        private const val ARG_PATH = "arg_path"

        fun show(activity: FragmentActivity, path: String, onDeleted: (() -> Unit)? = null) {
            val dialog = DuplicateFinderDialog().apply {
                arguments = Bundle().apply {
                    putString(ARG_PATH, path)
                }
                this.onDuplicatesDeleted = onDeleted
            }
            dialog.show(activity.supportFragmentManager, "DuplicateFinderDialog")
        }
    }

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        targetDirectoryPath = arguments?.getString(ARG_PATH) ?: "/storage/emulated/0"
    }

    override fun onCreateDialog(savedInstanceState: Bundle?): Dialog {
        val ctx = requireContext()
        val view = LayoutInflater.from(ctx).inflate(R.layout.dialog_duplicate_finder, null, false)

        layoutSetup = view.findViewById(R.id.layoutSetup)
        layoutScanning = view.findViewById(R.id.layoutScanning)
        layoutResults = view.findViewById(R.id.layoutResults)

        tvSetupPath = view.findViewById(R.id.tvSetupPath)
        switchRecursive = view.findViewById(R.id.switchRecursive)
        rgMinSize = view.findViewById(R.id.rgMinSize)
        editExtensionFilter = view.findViewById(R.id.editExtensionFilter)
        btnStartScan = view.findViewById(R.id.btnStartScan)

        tvScanningProgress = view.findViewById(R.id.tvScanningProgress)
        tvResultsSummary = view.findViewById(R.id.tvResultsSummary)
        tvResultsSub = view.findViewById(R.id.tvResultsSub)
        recyclerDuplicates = view.findViewById(R.id.recyclerDuplicates)
        btnDeleteDuplicates = view.findViewById(R.id.btnDeleteDuplicates)

        tvSetupPath.text = targetDirectoryPath

        btnStartScan.setOnClickListener {
            startScan()
        }

        view.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.btnSelectOldest).setOnClickListener {
            scanResult?.let {
                DuplicateFinderEngine.selectOldestDuplicates(it.groups)
                adapter?.notifyDataSetChanged()
                updateDeleteButtonLabel()
            }
        }

        view.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.btnSelectNewest).setOnClickListener {
            scanResult?.let {
                DuplicateFinderEngine.selectNewestDuplicates(it.groups)
                adapter?.notifyDataSetChanged()
                updateDeleteButtonLabel()
            }
        }

        view.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.btnInvertSelection).setOnClickListener {
            scanResult?.let { res ->
                for (group in res.groups) {
                    for (file in group.files) {
                        file.isMarkedForDeletion = !file.isMarkedForDeletion
                    }
                }
                adapter?.notifyDataSetChanged()
                updateDeleteButtonLabel()
            }
        }

        view.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.btnClearSelection).setOnClickListener {
            scanResult?.let {
                DuplicateFinderEngine.clearAllSelections(it.groups)
                adapter?.notifyDataSetChanged()
                updateDeleteButtonLabel()
            }
        }

        btnDeleteDuplicates.setOnClickListener {
            confirmDeleteSelected()
        }

        return MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(ctx)
            .setView(view)
            .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
            .create()
    }

    private fun startScan() {
        val minSizeBytes = when (rgMinSize.checkedRadioButtonId) {
            R.id.rbMinSize0 -> 0L
            R.id.rbMinSize100K -> 100 * 1024L
            R.id.rbMinSize1M -> 1024 * 1024L
            else -> 1024L // > 1 KB default
        }
        val recursive = switchRecursive.isChecked
        val filter = editExtensionFilter.text.toString().trim()
        val rootDir = File(targetDirectoryPath)

        layoutSetup.visibility = View.GONE
        layoutScanning.visibility = View.VISIBLE
        layoutResults.visibility = View.GONE

        lifecycleScope.launch {
            val result = DuplicateFinderEngine.scanDuplicates(
                rootDir = rootDir,
                recursive = recursive,
                minSizeBytes = minSizeBytes,
                extensionFilter = filter.ifEmpty { null }
            ) { scanned, duplicates ->
                lifecycleScope.launch {
                    if (isAdded) {
                        tvScanningProgress.text = "Escaneados: $scanned archivos • $duplicates duplicados encontrados..."
                    }
                }
            }

            scanResult = result
            layoutScanning.visibility = View.GONE
            layoutResults.visibility = View.VISIBLE

            if (result.groups.isEmpty()) {
                tvResultsSummary.text = "¡No se encontraron archivos duplicados!"
                tvResultsSub.text = "Se escanearon ${result.totalFilesScanned} archivos en total."
                btnDeleteDuplicates.isEnabled = false
                btnDeleteDuplicates.alpha = 0.5f
            } else {
                tvResultsSummary.text = "${result.totalDuplicateFilesCount} duplicados encontrados (${result.formattedTotalWastedBytes} recuperables)"
                tvResultsSub.text = "Se mantendrá 1 copia intacta de cada grupo."
                btnDeleteDuplicates.isEnabled = true
                btnDeleteDuplicates.alpha = 1.0f

                adapter = DuplicateRecyclerAdapter(result.groups) {
                    updateDeleteButtonLabel()
                }
                recyclerDuplicates.layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(requireContext())
                recyclerDuplicates.adapter = adapter
                updateDeleteButtonLabel()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun updateDeleteButtonLabel() {
        val result = scanResult ?: return
        var markedCount = 0
        var markedBytes = 0L
        for (g in result.groups) {
            for (f in g.files) {
                if (f.isMarkedForDeletion) {
                    markedCount++
                    markedBytes += f.size
                }
            }
        }
        if (markedCount > 0) {
            btnDeleteDuplicates.text = "Eliminar $markedCount Duplicados (${formatBytes(markedBytes)})"
            btnDeleteDuplicates.isEnabled = true
            btnDeleteDuplicates.alpha = 1.0f
        } else {
            btnDeleteDuplicates.text = "Selecciona duplicados a eliminar"
            btnDeleteDuplicates.isEnabled = false
            btnDeleteDuplicates.alpha = 0.5f
        }
    }

    private fun confirmDeleteSelected() {
        val result = scanResult ?: return
        val toDelete = mutableListOf<DuplicateFileItem>()
        var totalBytes = 0L
        for (g in result.groups) {
            for (f in g.files) {
                if (f.isMarkedForDeletion) {
                    toDelete.add(f)
                    totalBytes += f.size
                }
            }
        }
        if (toDelete.isEmpty()) return

        MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(requireContext())
            .setTitle("Confirmar eliminación")
            .setMessage("¿Estás seguro de que deseas eliminar permanentemente ${toDelete.size} archivo(s) duplicado(s)?\n\nSe liberarán ${formatBytes(totalBytes)} de almacenamiento.")
            .setPositiveButton("Eliminar") { _, _ ->
                lifecycleScope.launch {
                    val (deleted, freed) = DuplicateFinderEngine.deleteMarkedDuplicates(toDelete, requireContext())
                    Toast.makeText(
                        requireContext(),
                        "Eliminados $deleted archivo(s). Liberados: ${formatBytes(freed)}",
                        Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                    ).show()
                    onDuplicatesDeleted?.invoke()
                    dismiss()
                }
            }
            .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
            .show()
    }
}

private sealed class DuplicateRecyclerItem {
    data class Header(val group: DuplicateGroup, val index: Int) : DuplicateRecyclerItem()
    data class FileRow(val item: DuplicateFileItem, val group: DuplicateGroup) : DuplicateRecyclerItem()
}

private class DuplicateRecyclerAdapter(
    private val groups: List<DuplicateGroup>,
    private val onSelectionChanged: () -> Unit
) : RecyclerView.Adapter<RecyclerView.ViewHolder>() {

    private val items = mutableListOf<DuplicateRecyclerItem>()
    private val dateFormat = SimpleDateFormat("dd/MM/yy HH:mm", Locale.getDefault())

    init {
        rebuildItems()
    }

    private fun rebuildItems() {
        items.clear()
        for ((groupIndex, group) in groups.withIndex()) {
            items.add(DuplicateRecyclerItem.Header(group, groupIndex + 1))
            for (fileItem in group.files) {
                items.add(DuplicateRecyclerItem.FileRow(fileItem, group))
            }
        }
    }

    override fun getItemViewType(position: Int): Int = when (items[position]) {
        is DuplicateRecyclerItem.Header -> 0
        is DuplicateRecyclerItem.FileRow -> 1
    }

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
        val inflater = LayoutInflater.from(parent.context)
        return if (viewType == 0) {
            val v = inflater.inflate(R.layout.item_duplicate_group_header, parent, false)
            HeaderViewHolder(v)
        } else {
            val v = inflater.inflate(R.layout.item_duplicate_file_row, parent, false)
            FileViewHolder(v)
        }
    }

    override fun getItemCount(): Int = items.size

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: RecyclerView.ViewHolder, position: Int) {
        when (val item = items[position]) {
            is DuplicateRecyclerItem.Header -> {
                val vh = holder as HeaderViewHolder
                vh.tvTitle.text = "Grupo #${item.index} • ${item.group.totalCopies} copias (${item.group.formattedWastedBytes} recuperables)"
                vh.tvWasted.text = "${formatBytes(item.group.sizePerFile)} c/u"
            }
            is DuplicateRecyclerItem.FileRow -> {
                val vh = holder as FileViewHolder
                vh.tvName.text = item.item.name
                vh.tvPath.text = item.item.path
                vh.tvDate.text = dateFormat.format(Date(item.item.lastModified))
                vh.cbMark.setOnCheckedChangeListener(null)
                vh.cbMark.isChecked = item.item.isMarkedForDeletion
                vh.cbMark.setOnCheckedChangeListener { _, isChecked ->
                    item.item.isMarkedForDeletion = isChecked
                    onSelectionChanged()
                }
                vh.itemView.setOnClickListener {
                    vh.cbMark.isChecked = !vh.cbMark.isChecked
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private class HeaderViewHolder(view: View) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(view) {
        val tvTitle: TextView = view.findViewById(R.id.tvGroupTitle)
        val tvWasted: TextView = view.findViewById(R.id.tvGroupWasted)
    }

    private class FileViewHolder(view: View) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(view) {
        val cbMark: CheckBox = view.findViewById(R.id.cbMarkDelete)
        val tvName: TextView = view.findViewById(R.id.tvFileName)
        val tvPath: TextView = view.findViewById(R.id.tvFilePath)
        val tvDate: TextView = view.findViewById(R.id.tvFileDate)
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/filelist/duplicate/DuplicateFinderEngine.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist.duplicate

import android.content.Context
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileInputStream
import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.util.Locale

data class DuplicateFileItem(
    val file: File,
    val size: Long,
    val lastModified: Long,
    val path: String,
    var isMarkedForDeletion: Boolean = false
) {
    val name: String get() = file.name
    val formattedSize: String get() = formatBytes(size)
    val extension: String get() = file.extension.lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
}

data class DuplicateGroup(
    val hash: String,
    val sizePerFile: Long,
    val files: MutableList<DuplicateFileItem>
) {
    val totalCopies: Int get() = files.size
    val wastedBytes: Long get() = (files.size - 1).coerceAtLeast(0) * sizePerFile
    val formattedWastedBytes: String get() = formatBytes(wastedBytes)
}

data class DuplicateScanResult(
    val rootPath: String,
    val groups: List<DuplicateGroup>,
    val totalFilesScanned: Int,
    val totalDuplicateFilesCount: Int,
    val totalWastedBytes: Long
) {
    val formattedTotalWastedBytes: String get() = formatBytes(totalWastedBytes)
}

fun formatBytes(bytes: Long): String {
    if (bytes <= 0) return "0 B"
    val units = arrayOf("B", "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB")
    var b = bytes.toDouble()
    var unitIndex = 0
    while (b >= 1024 && unitIndex < units.size - 1) {
        b /= 1024
        unitIndex++
    }
    return if (unitIndex == 0) "${bytes} B" else String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f %s", b, units[unitIndex])
}

object DuplicateFinderEngine {

    suspend fun scanDuplicates(
        rootDir: File,
        recursive: Boolean = true,
        minSizeBytes: Long = 1024L, // Default > 1 KB to skip empty/trivial files
        extensionFilter: String? = null,
        onProgress: ((scanned: Int, duplicatesFound: Int) -> Unit)? = null
    ): DuplicateScanResult = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        if (!rootDir.exists() || !rootDir.isDirectory) {
            return@withContext DuplicateScanResult(rootDir.absolutePath, emptyList(), 0, 0, 0L)
        }

        var scannedCount = 0
        var duplicatesCount = 0

        val allowedExtensions: Set<String>? = extensionFilter
            ?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() && it != "*" }
            ?.split(",", ";", " ")
            ?.map { it.trim().trimStart('.').lowercase(Locale.ROOT) }
            ?.filter { it.isNotEmpty() }
            ?.toSet()

        // -------------------------------------------------------------
        // Phase 1: Fast Size Indexing (Files with unique size are skipped)
        // -------------------------------------------------------------
        val sizeMap = mutableMapOf<Long, MutableList<File>>()

        fun collectFiles(dir: File) {
            val list = dir.listFiles() ?: return
            for (f in list) {
                if (f.isDirectory) {
                    if (recursive) {
                        collectFiles(f)
                    }
                } else if (f.isFile) {
                    scannedCount++
                    val len = f.length()
                    if (len >= minSizeBytes) {
                        if (allowedExtensions == null || f.extension.lowercase(Locale.ROOT) in allowedExtensions) {
                            val bucket = sizeMap.getOrPut(len) { mutableListOf() }
                            bucket.add(f)
                        }
                    }
                    if (scannedCount % 100 == 0) {
                        onProgress?.invoke(scannedCount, duplicatesCount)
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        collectFiles(rootDir)

        // Keep only size collisions (size >= 2)
        val collisionBuckets = sizeMap.values.filter { it.size >= 2 }

        // -------------------------------------------------------------
        // Phase 2: Partial Hash (First 4KB + Last 4KB)
        // -------------------------------------------------------------
        val partialHashMap = mutableMapOf<String, MutableList<File>>()
        for (bucket in collisionBuckets) {
            for (file in bucket) {
                val partialHash = computePartialHash(file)
                if (partialHash != null) {
                    val key = "${file.length()}_$partialHash"
                    partialHashMap.getOrPut(key) { mutableListOf() }.add(file)
                }
            }
        }

        val partialCollisions = partialHashMap.values.filter { it.size >= 2 }

        // -------------------------------------------------------------
        // Phase 3: Full SHA-256 Hash Confirmation
        // -------------------------------------------------------------
        val fullHashMap = mutableMapOf<String, MutableList<File>>()
        for (bucket in partialCollisions) {
            for (file in bucket) {
                val fullHash = computeFullSha256(file)
                if (fullHash != null) {
                    val key = "${file.length()}_$fullHash"
                    fullHashMap.getOrPut(key) { mutableListOf() }.add(file)
                }
            }
        }

        // Build duplicate groups
        val duplicateGroups = mutableListOf<DuplicateGroup>()
        var totalWastedBytes = 0L

        for ((hashKey, files) in fullHashMap) {
            if (files.size >= 2) {
                val sizePerFile = files[0].length()
                val sortedFiles = files.sortedBy { it.lastModified() }
                
                val groupItems = sortedFiles.mapIndexed { index, file ->
                    DuplicateFileItem(
                        file = file,
                        size = sizePerFile,
                        lastModified = file.lastModified(),
                        path = file.absolutePath,
                        // By default, mark duplicates (keep index 0 unselected, mark index 1..N)
                        isMarkedForDeletion = (index > 0)
                    )
                }.toMutableList()

                val group = DuplicateGroup(
                    hash = hashKey,
                    sizePerFile = sizePerFile,
                    files = groupItems
                )
                duplicateGroups.add(group)
                duplicatesCount += (files.size - 1)
                totalWastedBytes += (files.size - 1) * sizePerFile
            }
        }

        // Sort groups by wasted bytes descending (largest wasted space first)
        duplicateGroups.sortByDescending { it.wastedBytes }

        onProgress?.invoke(scannedCount, duplicatesCount)

        DuplicateScanResult(
            rootPath = rootDir.absolutePath,
            groups = duplicateGroups,
            totalFilesScanned = scannedCount,
            totalDuplicateFilesCount = duplicatesCount,
            totalWastedBytes = totalWastedBytes
        )
    }

    private fun computePartialHash(file: File): String? {
        return try {
            val length = file.length()
            val md = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
            val buffer = ByteArray(4096)
            FileInputStream(file).use { fis ->
                val readFirst = fis.read(buffer, 0, buffer.size)
                if (readFirst > 0) {
                    md.update(buffer, 0, readFirst)
                }
                if (length > 8192) {
                    val skipTarget = length - 4096
                    fis.channel.position(skipTarget)
                    val readLast = fis.read(buffer, 0, buffer.size)
                    if (readLast > 0) {
                        md.update(buffer, 0, readLast)
                    }
                }
            }
            bytesToHex(md.digest())
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            null
        }
    }

    private fun computeFullSha256(file: File): String? {
        return try {
            val md = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
            val buffer = ByteArray(65536)
            FileInputStream(file).use { fis ->
                var bytesRead: Int
                while (fis.read(buffer).also { bytesRead = it } != -1) {
                    md.update(buffer, 0, bytesRead)
                }
            }
            bytesToHex(md.digest())
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            null
        }
    }

    private fun bytesToHex(bytes: ByteArray): String {
        val hexChars = CharArray(bytes.size * 2)
        val hexArray = "0123456789abcdef".toCharArray()
        for (j in bytes.indices) {
            val v = bytes[j].toInt() and 0xFF
            hexChars[j * 2] = hexArray[v ushr 4]
            hexChars[j * 2 + 1] = hexArray[v and 0x0F]
        }
        return String(hexChars)
    }

    /**
     * Smart selection options
     */
    fun selectOldestDuplicates(groups: List<DuplicateGroup>) {
        // Keeps oldest file, marks all newer files for deletion
        for (group in groups) {
            val sorted = group.files.sortedBy { it.lastModified }
            for ((index, item) in sorted.withIndex()) {
                item.isMarkedForDeletion = (index > 0)
            }
        }
    }

    fun selectNewestDuplicates(groups: List<DuplicateGroup>) {
        // Keeps newest file, marks all older files for deletion
        for (group in groups) {
            val sorted = group.files.sortedByDescending { it.lastModified }
            for ((index, item) in sorted.withIndex()) {
                item.isMarkedForDeletion = (index > 0)
            }
        }
    }

    fun selectAllDuplicates(groups: List<DuplicateGroup>) {
        // Marks all duplicate copies (except 1 copy per group)
        for (group in groups) {
            for ((index, item) in group.files.withIndex()) {
                item.isMarkedForDeletion = (index > 0)
            }
        }
    }

    fun clearAllSelections(groups: List<DuplicateGroup>) {
        for (group in groups) {
            for (item in group.files) {
                item.isMarkedForDeletion = false
            }
        }
    }

    suspend fun deleteMarkedDuplicates(
        items: List<DuplicateFileItem>,
        context: Context
    ): Pair<Int, Long> = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        var deletedCount = 0
        var freedBytes = 0L

        for (item in items) {
            if (item.isMarkedForDeletion) {
                val ok = try {
                    if (item.file.delete()) {
                        true
                    } else {
                        // Fallback root deletion if needed
                        val cmd = "rm -f \"${item.file.absolutePath}\""
                        val res = com.topjohnwu.superuser.Shell.cmd(cmd).exec()
                        res.isSuccess
                    }
                } catch (_: Throwable) {
                    false
                }
                if (ok) {
                    deletedCount++
                    freedBytes += item.size
                }
            }
        }
        Pair(deletedCount, freedBytes)
    }
}
```

```kt
    }

    override fun onCreateDialog(savedInstanceState: Bundle?): Dialog {

        cbRecursive = view.findViewById(R.id.cbRecursive)
        editExtensionFilter = view.findViewById(R.id.editExtensionFilter)
        btnStartSearch = view.findViewById(R.id.btnStartSearch)

    private fun startSearch(query: String) {
        val rootDir = File(targetDirectoryPath)
        val recursive = cbRecursive.isChecked
        val caseSensitive = cbCaseSensitive.isChecked
        val wholeWord = cbWholeWord.isChecked
        val isRegex = cbRegex.isChecked
        val filter = editExtensionFilter.text.toString().trim()

        layoutSetup.visibility = View.GONE
        layoutScanning.visibility = View.VISIBLE
        layoutResults.visibility = View.GONE

        lifecycleScope.launch {
            val result = FileTextSearchEngine.searchText(
                rootDir = rootDir,
                query = query,
                recursive = recursive,
                caseSensitive = caseSensitive,
                wholeWord = wholeWord,
                isRegex = isRegex,
                extensionFilter = filter.ifEmpty { null }
            ) { scanned, matches ->
                lifecycleScope.launch {
                    if (isAdded) {
                        tvScanningProgress.text = "Archivos escaneados: $scanned • Coincidencias encontradas: $matches"
                    }
                }
            }

            searchResult = result
            layoutScanning.visibility = View.GONE
            layoutResults.visibility = View.VISIBLE

            if (result.fileMatches.isEmpty()) {
                tvResultsSummary.text = "¡No se encontraron coincidencias!"
                tvResultsSub.text = "Se escanearon ${result.totalFilesSearched} archivos con la consulta '$query'."
                btnReplaceSelected.isEnabled = false
                btnReplaceSelected.alpha = 0.5f
                btnReplaceAll.isEnabled = false
                btnReplaceAll.alpha = 0.5f
            } else {
                tvResultsSummary.text = "${result.totalMatches} coincidencias en ${result.fileMatches.size} archivos"
                tvResultsSub.text = "Consulta: '$query' (${result.totalFilesSearched} archivos escaneados)"

                adapter = TextSearchRecyclerAdapter(
                    fileMatches = result.fileMatches,
                    onSelectionChanged = { updateReplaceButtons() },
                    onOccurrenceClicked = { file, occurrence ->
                        openTextEditorAtLine(file, occurrence.lineNumber)
                    }
                )
                recyclerMatches.layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(requireContext())
                recyclerMatches.adapter = adapter
                updateReplaceButtons()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun openTextEditorAtLine(file: File, lineNumber: Int) {
        try {
            val intent = Intent(requireContext(), TextEditorActivity::class.java).apply {
                extraPath = Paths.get(file.absolutePath)
                putExtra("EXTRA_GOTO_LINE", lineNumber)
            }
            startActivity(intent)
        } catch (e: Throwable) {
            Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "No se pudo abrir el archivo: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }

    private fun updateReplaceButtons() {
        val result = searchResult ?: return
        val selectedCount = result.fileMatches.count { it.isFileSelected }
        val totalFiles = result.fileMatches.size
        val hasReplacement = editReplaceQuery.text.toString().isNotEmpty()

        if (selectedCount > 0) {
            btnReplaceSelected.isEnabled = true
            btnReplaceSelected.alpha = 1.0f
            btnReplaceSelected.text = "Reemplazar en $selectedCount sel."
        } else {
            btnReplaceSelected.isEnabled = false
            btnReplaceSelected.alpha = 0.5f
            btnReplaceSelected.text = "Reemplazar en seleccionados"
        }

        if (totalFiles > 0) {
            btnReplaceAll.isEnabled = true
            btnReplaceAll.alpha = 1.0f
            btnReplaceAll.text = "Reemplazar en todos ($totalFiles)"
        } else {
            btnReplaceAll.isEnabled = false
            btnReplaceAll.alpha = 0.5f
            btnReplaceAll.text = "Reemplazar en todos"
        }
    }

    private fun confirmReplace(selectedFilesOnly: Boolean) {
        val result = searchResult ?: return
        val query = editSearchQuery.text.toString().trim()
        val replacement = editReplaceQuery.text.toString()

        val filesToProcess = if (selectedFilesOnly) {
            result.fileMatches.filter { it.isFileSelected }
        } else {
            result.fileMatches
        }

        if (filesToProcess.isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "No hay archivos seleccionados", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return
        }

        val totalMatches = filesToProcess.sumOf { it.matchCount }
        val targetScope = if (selectedFilesOnly) {
            "${filesToProcess.size} archivo(s) seleccionado(s)"
        } else {
            "TODOS los ${filesToProcess.size} archivo(s)"
        }

        MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(requireContext())
            .setTitle("Confirmar Reemplazo")
            .setMessage(
                "¿Deseas reemplazar '$query' por '$replacement' en $targetScope?\n\n" +
                "Total de ocurrencias a reemplazar: $totalMatches"
            )
            .setPositiveButton("Reemplazar") { _, _ ->
                executeReplacement(filesToProcess, query, replacement, selectedFilesOnly)
            }
            .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
            .show()
    }

    private fun executeReplacement(
        files: List<FileTextMatches>,
        query: String,
        replacement: String,
        selectedFilesOnly: Boolean
    ) {
        lifecycleScope.launch {
            val replaceResult = FileTextSearchEngine.replaceTextInFiles(
                fileMatches = files,
                query = query,
                replacement = replacement,
                selectedFilesOnly = false, // already filtered
                caseSensitive = cbCaseSensitive.isChecked,
                wholeWord = cbWholeWord.isChecked,
                isRegex = cbRegex.isChecked
            )

            Toast.makeText(
                requireContext(),
                "¡Reemplazo exitoso!\nModificados ${replaceResult.filesModified} archivos (${replaceResult.totalReplacements} reemplazos)",
                Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show()

            onFilesModified?.invoke()
            dismiss()
        }
    }

private sealed class SearchRecyclerItem {
    data class FileHeader(val fileMatch: FileTextMatches, var isExpanded: Boolean = true) : SearchRecyclerItem()
    data class OccurrenceRow(val file: File, val occurrence: TextOccurrence) : SearchRecyclerItem()
}

private class TextSearchRecyclerAdapter(
    private val fileMatches: List<FileTextMatches>,
    private val onSelectionChanged: () -> Unit,
    private val onOccurrenceClicked: (File, TextOccurrence) -> Unit
) : RecyclerView.Adapter<RecyclerView.ViewHolder>() {

    private val expandedFiles = mutableSetOf<File>()
    private val items = mutableListOf<SearchRecyclerItem>()

    init {
        // Expand all files by default
        for (fm in fileMatches) {
            expandedFiles.add(fm.file)
        }
        rebuildVisibleItems()
    }

    private fun rebuildVisibleItems() {
        items.clear()
        for (fm in fileMatches) {
            val isExp = expandedFiles.contains(fm.file)
            items.add(SearchRecyclerItem.FileHeader(fm, isExp))
            if (isExp) {
                for (occ in fm.matches) {
                    items.add(SearchRecyclerItem.OccurrenceRow(fm.file, occ))
                }
            }
        }
    }

    override fun getItemViewType(position: Int): Int = when (items[position]) {
        is SearchRecyclerItem.FileHeader -> 0
        is SearchRecyclerItem.OccurrenceRow -> 1
    }

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
        val inflater = LayoutInflater.from(parent.context)
        return if (viewType == 0) {
            val v = inflater.inflate(R.layout.item_text_search_file_header, parent, false)
            HeaderViewHolder(v)
        } else {
            val v = inflater.inflate(R.layout.item_text_search_occurrence, parent, false)
            OccurrenceViewHolder(v)
        }
    }

    override fun getItemCount(): Int = items.size

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: RecyclerView.ViewHolder, position: Int) {
        when (val item = items[position]) {
            is SearchRecyclerItem.FileHeader -> {
                val vh = holder as HeaderViewHolder
                vh.tvFileName.text = item.fileMatch.fileName
                vh.tvFilePath.text = item.fileMatch.relativePath
                vh.tvMatchBadge.text = "${item.fileMatch.matchCount} coinc."
                
                vh.cbSelect.setOnCheckedChangeListener(null)
                vh.cbSelect.isChecked = item.fileMatch.isFileSelected
                vh.cbSelect.setOnCheckedChangeListener { _, isChecked ->
                    item.fileMatch.isFileSelected = isChecked
                    onSelectionChanged()
                }

                vh.ivExpand.rotation = if (item.isExpanded) 180f else 0f
                vh.itemView.setOnClickListener {
                    if (expandedFiles.contains(item.fileMatch.file)) {
                        expandedFiles.remove(item.fileMatch.file)
                    } else {
                        expandedFiles.add(item.fileMatch.file)
                    }
                    rebuildVisibleItems()
                    notifyDataSetChanged()
                }
            }
            is SearchRecyclerItem.OccurrenceRow -> {
                val vh = holder as OccurrenceViewHolder
                vh.tvLineNumber.text = "L${item.occurrence.lineNumber}:"
                vh.tvLineSnippet.text = item.occurrence.lineText
                vh.itemView.setOnClickListener {
                    onOccurrenceClicked(item.file, item.occurrence)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private class HeaderViewHolder(view: View) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(view) {
        val cbSelect: CheckBox = view.findViewById(R.id.cbFileSelect)
        val tvFileName: TextView = view.findViewById(R.id.tvHeaderFileName)
        val tvFilePath: TextView = view.findViewById(R.id.tvHeaderFilePath)
        val tvMatchBadge: TextView = view.findViewById(R.id.tvHeaderMatchBadge)
        val ivExpand: ImageView = view.findViewById(R.id.ivExpandCollapse)
    }

    private class OccurrenceViewHolder(view: View) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(view) {
        val tvLineNumber: TextView = view.findViewById(R.id.tvLineNumber)
        val tvLineSnippet: TextView = view.findViewById(R.id.tvLineSnippet)
    }
}
```
