`app/src/main/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/storage/Storages.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2019 Hai Zhang <dreaming.in.code.zh@gmail.com>
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.storage

import me.zhanghai.android.files.settings.Settings
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.removeFirst
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.valueCompat

object Storages {
    fun addOrReplace(storage: Storage) {
        val storages = Settings.STORAGES.valueCompat.toMutableList().apply {
            val index = indexOfFirst { it.id == storage.id }
            if (index != -1) {
                this[index] = storage
            } else {
                this += storage
            }
        }
        Settings.STORAGES.putValue(storages)
    }

    fun replace(storage: Storage) {
        val storages = Settings.STORAGES.valueCompat.toMutableList()
            .apply { this[indexOfFirst { it.id == storage.id }] = storage }
        Settings.STORAGES.putValue(storages)
    }

    fun move(fromPosition: Int, toPosition: Int) {
        val bookmarkDirectories = Settings.STORAGES.valueCompat.toMutableList()
            .apply { add(toPosition, removeAt(fromPosition)) }
        Settings.STORAGES.putValue(bookmarkDirectories)
    }

    fun remove(storage: Storage) {
        val bookmarkDirectories = Settings.STORAGES.valueCompat.toMutableList()
            .apply { removeFirst { it.id == storage.id } }
        Settings.STORAGES.putValue(bookmarkDirectories)
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/storage/URIExtensions.kt`:

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.storage

import java.net.URI
import java.net.URISyntaxException
import kotlin.reflect.KClass

// @see URI.appendAuthority
fun KClass<URI>.canonicalizeHost(host: String): String =
    if (host.contains(':') && !host.startsWith('[') && !host.endsWith(']')) "[$host]" else host

fun KClass<URI>.createOrLog(uri: String): URI? =
    try {
        URI(uri)
    } catch (e: URISyntaxException) {
        e.printStackTrace()
        null
    }

fun KClass<URI>.createOrLog(
    scheme: String?,
    userInfo: String?,
    host: String?,
    port: Int,
    path: String?,
    query: String?,
    fragment: String?
): URI? =
    try {
        URI(scheme, userInfo, host, port, path, query, fragment)
    } catch (e: URISyntaxException) {
        e.printStackTrace()
        null
    }

fun KClass<URI>.isValidHost(host: String): Boolean =
    try {
        URI(null, null, host, -1, null, null, null)
        true
    } catch (e: URISyntaxException) {
        false
    }
```

`app/src/main/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/storage/WebDavServerAuthenticator.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2024 Hai Zhang <dreaming.in.code.zh@gmail.com>
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.storage

import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.webdav.client.Authentication
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.webdav.client.Authenticator
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.webdav.client.Authority
import me.zhanghai.android.files.settings.Settings
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.valueCompat

object WebDavServerAuthenticator : Authenticator {
    private val transientServers = mutableSetOf<WebDavServer>()

    override fun getAuthentication(authority: Authority): Authentication? {
        val server = synchronized(transientServers) {
            transientServers.find { it.authority == authority }
        } ?: Settings.STORAGES.valueCompat.find {
            it is WebDavServer && it.authority == authority
        } as WebDavServer?
        return server?.authentication
    }

    fun addTransientServer(server: WebDavServer) {
        synchronized(transientServers) { transientServers += server }
    }

    fun removeTransientServer(server: WebDavServer) {
        synchronized(transientServers) { transientServers -= server }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/terminal/ScriptExecutionManager.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.terminal

import android.content.Context
import android.os.PowerManager
import android.system.Os
import android.system.OsConstants
import com.termux.terminal.TerminalSession
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import java.io.File
import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList

object ScriptExecutionManager {

    var activeSession: TerminalSession? = null
        private set

    var activeScriptName: String = ""
        private set

    var activeScriptPath: String? = null
        private set

    var activeCommand: String? = null
        private set

    var activePid: Int = -1
        set(value) {
            field = value
            if (value > 0) {
                notifyPidAssigned(value)
                runCatching {
                    me.zhanghai.android.files.terminal.tracer.SyscallReaderMonitor.startMonitoring(value)
                }
            } else {
                runCatching {
                    me.zhanghai.android.files.terminal.tracer.SyscallReaderMonitor.stopMonitoring()
                }
            }
        }

    var isRoot: Boolean = false
        private set

    var isTermex: Boolean = false
        private set

    var startTimeMillis: Long = 0L
        private set

    var isBackgroundKept: Boolean = false
        private set

    var lastExitCode: Int? = null
        private set

    @Volatile
    var isTerminatedByUser: Boolean = false
        private set

    private var wakeLock: PowerManager.WakeLock? = null

    interface SessionListener {
        fun onPidAssigned(pid: Int) {}
        fun onOutputUpdated() {}
        fun onTitleChanged(title: String) {}
        fun onSessionFinished(exitCode: Int) {}
    }

    private val listeners = CopyOnWriteArrayList<SessionListener>()

    fun addListener(listener: SessionListener) {
        if (!listeners.contains(listener)) {
            listeners.add(listener)
        }
    }

    fun removeListener(listener: SessionListener) {
        listeners.remove(listener)
    }

    fun isRunning(): Boolean {
        return activeSession?.isRunning == true
    }

    fun hasActiveSession(): Boolean {
        return activeSession != null && activeSession?.isRunning == true
    }

    fun startExecution(
        context: Context,
        session: TerminalSession,
        scriptName: String,
        path: String? = null,
        command: String? = null,
        root: Boolean = false,
        termex: Boolean = false
    ) {
        activeSession = session
        activeScriptName = scriptName.ifEmpty { "Script" }
        activeScriptPath = path
        activeCommand = command
        activePid = session.pid
        isRoot = root
        isTermex = termex
        startTimeMillis = System.currentTimeMillis()
        isBackgroundKept = false
        lastExitCode = null
        isTerminatedByUser = false

        ScriptExecutionService.start(context.applicationContext, activeScriptName, activePid)
    }

    fun keepInBackground(context: Context) {
        isBackgroundKept = true
        acquireWakeLock(context)
        ScriptExecutionService.updateNotification(context.applicationContext)
    }

    private val isTerminating = java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean(false)

    fun terminateShell(context: Context): Boolean {
        isTerminatedByUser = true
        if (!isTerminating.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
            return false
        }
        try {
            val session = activeSession
            val pid = activePid
            activeSession = null
            activePid = -1
            activeCommand = null
            activeScriptName = ""

            if (session != null && session.isRunning) {
                runCatching { session.finishIfRunning() }
            }
            runCatching { me.zhanghai.android.files.terminal.tracer.SyscallReaderMonitor.stopMonitoring() }

            if (pid > 0) {
                runCatching { Os.kill(pid, OsConstants.SIGKILL) }
                runCatching { Os.kill(-pid, OsConstants.SIGKILL) }
                if (isRoot) {
                    CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO).launch {
                        runCatching {
                            com.topjohnwu.superuser.Shell.cmd("kill -9 $pid 2>/dev/null || true").exec()
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            releaseWakeLock()
            lastExitCode = -9
            notifySessionFinished(-9)
            return true
        } finally {
            isTerminating.set(false)
        }
    }

    fun onSessionFinished(exitCode: Int, context: Context?) {
        runCatching { me.zhanghai.android.files.terminal.tracer.SyscallReaderMonitor.stopMonitoring() }
        if (isTerminating.get() || isTerminatedByUser) {
            return
        }
        lastExitCode = exitCode
        releaseWakeLock()
        notifySessionFinished(exitCode)
        if (context != null) {
            ScriptExecutionService.onExecutionFinished(context.applicationContext, exitCode)
        }
    }

    fun notifyOutputUpdated() {
        for (listener in listeners) {
            listener.onOutputUpdated()
        }
    }

    fun notifyTitleChanged(title: String) {
        for (listener in listeners) {
            listener.onTitleChanged(title)
        }
    }

    private fun notifyPidAssigned(pid: Int) {
        for (listener in listeners) {
            listener.onPidAssigned(pid)
        }
    }

    private fun notifySessionFinished(exitCode: Int) {
        for (listener in listeners) {
            listener.onSessionFinished(exitCode)
        }
    }

    fun acquireWakeLock(context: Context) {
        if (wakeLock == null) {
            val pm = context.getSystemService(Context.POWER_SERVICE) as? PowerManager
            wakeLock = pm?.newWakeLock(PowerManager.PARTIAL_WAKE_LOCK, "OpenManager:ScriptExecWakeLock")
        }
        wakeLock?.let { wl ->
            if (!wl.isHeld) {
                wl.acquire(2 * 60 * 60 * 1000L) // 2 hours max
            }
        }
    }

    fun releaseWakeLock() {
        wakeLock?.let { wl ->
            if (wl.isHeld) {
                runCatching { wl.release() }
            }
        }
    }

    fun clearSession() {
        releaseWakeLock()
        activeSession = null
        activeScriptName = ""
        activeScriptPath = null
        activeCommand = null
        activePid = -1
        isRoot = false
        isTermex = false
        isBackgroundKept = false
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/terminal/ScriptExecutionService.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.terminal

import android.app.Notification
import android.app.PendingIntent
import android.app.Service
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.IBinder
import android.os.Looper
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat
import androidx.core.app.NotificationManagerCompat
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
import me.zhanghai.android.files.R
import me.zhanghai.android.files.app.NotificationIds

class ScriptExecutionService : Service() {

    private val mainHandler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())

    companion object {
        const val ACTION_START = "me.zhanghai.android.files.terminal.action.START"
        const val ACTION_KILL_SHELL = "me.zhanghai.android.files.terminal.action.KILL_SHELL"
        const val ACTION_KEEP_BACKGROUND = "me.zhanghai.android.files.terminal.action.KEEP_BACKGROUND"
        const val ACTION_UPDATE = "me.zhanghai.android.files.terminal.action.UPDATE"
        const val ACTION_FINISHED = "me.zhanghai.android.files.terminal.action.FINISHED"
        const val ACTION_DISMISS = "me.zhanghai.android.files.terminal.action.DISMISS"

        const val EXTRA_SCRIPT_NAME = "script_name"
        const val EXTRA_PID = "pid"
        const val EXTRA_EXIT_CODE = "exit_code"

        fun start(context: Context, scriptName: String, pid: Int) {
            val intent = Intent(context, ScriptExecutionService::class.java).apply {
                action = ACTION_START
                putExtra(EXTRA_SCRIPT_NAME, scriptName)
                putExtra(EXTRA_PID, pid)
            }
            try {
                ContextCompat.startForegroundService(context, intent)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                runCatching { context.startService(intent) }
            }
        }

        fun updateNotification(context: Context) {
            val intent = Intent(context, ScriptExecutionService::class.java).apply {
                action = ACTION_UPDATE
            }
            runCatching { context.startService(intent) }
        }

        fun onExecutionFinished(context: Context, exitCode: Int) {
            val intent = Intent(context, ScriptExecutionService::class.java).apply {
                action = ACTION_FINISHED
                putExtra(EXTRA_EXIT_CODE, exitCode)
            }
            runCatching { context.startService(intent) }
        }

        fun onTerminatedByUser(context: Context) {
            val intent = Intent(context, ScriptExecutionService::class.java).apply {
                action = ACTION_KILL_SHELL
            }
            runCatching { context.startService(intent) }
        }

        fun stop(context: Context) {
            val intent = Intent(context, ScriptExecutionService::class.java).apply {
                action = ACTION_DISMISS
            }
            runCatching { context.startService(intent) }
        }
    }

    override fun onBind(intent: Intent?): IBinder? = null

    override fun onStartCommand(intent: Intent?, flags: Int, startId: Int): Int {
        if (intent == null) {
            stopSelf()
            return START_NOT_STICKY
        }

        when (intent.action) {
            ACTION_START -> {
                val scriptName = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_SCRIPT_NAME)
                    ?: ScriptExecutionManager.activeScriptName.ifEmpty { "Script" }
                val pid = intent.getIntExtra(EXTRA_PID, ScriptExecutionManager.activePid)
                val notification = buildRunningNotification(scriptName, pid)
                startForeground(NotificationIds.SCRIPT_EXECUTION, notification)
            }
            ACTION_KILL_SHELL -> {
                handleKillShell()
            }
            ACTION_KEEP_BACKGROUND -> {
                handleKeepBackground()
            }
            ACTION_UPDATE -> {
                if (ScriptExecutionManager.isRunning()) {
                    val notification = buildRunningNotification(
                        ScriptExecutionManager.activeScriptName,
                        ScriptExecutionManager.activePid
                    )
                    NotificationManagerCompat.from(this).notify(NotificationIds.SCRIPT_EXECUTION, notification)
                }
            }
            ACTION_FINISHED -> {
                if (ScriptExecutionManager.isTerminatedByUser) {
                    NotificationManagerCompat.from(this).cancel(NotificationIds.SCRIPT_EXECUTION)
                    stopForeground(true)
                    stopSelf()
                } else {
                    val exitCode = intent.getIntExtra(EXTRA_EXIT_CODE, ScriptExecutionManager.lastExitCode ?: 0)
                    handleFinished(exitCode)
                }
            }
            ACTION_DISMISS -> {
                NotificationManagerCompat.from(this).cancel(NotificationIds.SCRIPT_EXECUTION)
                stopForeground(true)
                stopSelf()
            }
        }

        return START_NOT_STICKY
    }

    private fun handleKillShell() {
        val pid = ScriptExecutionManager.activePid
        ScriptExecutionManager.terminateShell(this)

        mainHandler.post {
            Toast.makeText(this, getString(R.string.script_exec_killed_toast, if (pid > 0) pid else 0), Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }

        NotificationManagerCompat.from(this).cancel(NotificationIds.SCRIPT_EXECUTION)
        stopForeground(true)
        stopSelf()
    }

    private fun handleKeepBackground() {
        ScriptExecutionManager.keepInBackground(this)

        mainHandler.post {
            Toast.makeText(this, getString(R.string.script_exec_kept_toast), Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }

        val notification = buildRunningNotification(
            ScriptExecutionManager.activeScriptName,
            ScriptExecutionManager.activePid
        )
        NotificationManagerCompat.from(this).notify(NotificationIds.SCRIPT_EXECUTION, notification)
    }

    private fun handleFinished(exitCode: Int) {
        if (ScriptExecutionManager.isTerminatedByUser || (!ScriptExecutionManager.isRunning() && ScriptExecutionManager.activePid <= 0 && exitCode == -9)) {
            NotificationManagerCompat.from(this).cancel(NotificationIds.SCRIPT_EXECUTION)
            stopForeground(true)
            stopSelf()
            return
        }
        val scriptName = ScriptExecutionManager.activeScriptName.ifEmpty { "Script" }
        val title = if (exitCode == 0) {
            getString(R.string.script_exec_completed_success)
        } else {
            getString(R.string.script_exec_completed_error, exitCode)
        }

        val openIntent = createOpenTerminalPendingIntent()
        val dismissIntent = createActionPendingIntent(ACTION_DISMISS, 98)

        val notification = scriptExecutionNotificationTemplate.createBuilder(this)
            .setContentTitle(title)
            .setContentText("$scriptName • Toca para abrir terminal")
            .setOngoing(false)
            .setAutoCancel(true)
            .setContentIntent(openIntent)
            .addAction(R.drawable.file_sh_icon, getString(R.string.script_exec_notification_view_output), openIntent)
            .addAction(R.drawable.close_icon_white_24dp, getString(R.string.script_exec_notification_dismiss), dismissIntent)
            .build()

        stopForeground(false)
        NotificationManagerCompat.from(this).notify(NotificationIds.SCRIPT_EXECUTION, notification)
    }

    private fun buildRunningNotification(scriptName: String, pid: Int): Notification {
        val openIntent = createOpenTerminalPendingIntent()
        val killIntent = createActionPendingIntent(ACTION_KILL_SHELL, 1)
        val keepIntent = createActionPendingIntent(ACTION_KEEP_BACKGROUND, 2)

        val isKept = ScriptExecutionManager.isBackgroundKept
        val pidStr = if (pid > 0) "PID: $pid" else "Iniciando"
        val statusText = if (isKept) {
            "$pidStr • Activo en 2ndo plano (WakeLock) • Toca para abrir terminal"
        } else {
            "$pidStr • En ejecución • Toca para abrir terminal"
        }

        val subText = when {
            ScriptExecutionManager.isRoot -> "Root (#)"
            ScriptExecutionManager.isTermex -> "Termex (bash)"
            else -> "Sistema (sh)"
        }

        return scriptExecutionNotificationTemplate.createBuilder(this)
            .setContentTitle(getString(R.string.script_exec_notification_running, scriptName))
            .setContentText(statusText)
            .setSubText(subText)
            .setOngoing(true)
            .setContentIntent(openIntent)
            .addAction(
                R.drawable.close_icon_white_24dp,
                getString(R.string.script_exec_notification_kill_action),
                killIntent
            )
            .addAction(
                R.drawable.check_icon_control_normal_24dp,
                getString(R.string.script_exec_notification_keep_background),
                keepIntent
            )
            .build()
    }

    private fun createOpenTerminalPendingIntent(): PendingIntent {
        val intent = Intent(this, TerminalActivity::class.java).apply {
            flags = Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_SINGLE_TOP or Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_REORDER_TO_FRONT
        }
        val flags = PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or
            (if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.M) PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE else 0)
        return PendingIntent.getActivity(this, 0, intent, flags)
    }

    private fun createActionPendingIntent(action: String, requestCode: Int): PendingIntent {
        val intent = Intent(this, ScriptExecutionService::class.java).apply {
            this.action = action
        }
        val flags = PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or
            (if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.M) PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE else 0)
        return PendingIntent.getService(this, requestCode, intent, flags)
    }

    override fun onDestroy() {
        super.onDestroy()
        mainHandler.removeCallbacksAndMessages(null)
    }
}
```

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.terminal
```

```kt
import me.zhanghai.android.files.R

import kotlin.math.roundToInt

class TerminalActivity : AppActivity() {

    private lateinit var toolbar: MaterialToolbar
    private lateinit var terminalView: TerminalView
    private lateinit var extraKeysView: TerminalExtraKeysView
    private var btnZoomOut: TextView? = null
    private var btnZoomIn: TextView? = null
    private var tvZoomSize: TextView? = null
    private var btnCopyScreen: ImageButton? = null
    private var btnScriptAudit: ImageButton? = null
    private var btnDeadManSkull: ImageButton? = null
    private var btnOverflowMenu: ImageButton? = null
    private var layoutDeadManAlertBadge: android.widget.LinearLayout? = null
    private var tvSessionDot: TextView? = null
    private var tvSessionLabel: TextView? = null
    private var tvTerminalBreadcrumb: TextView? = null
    private var layoutSessionBadge: View? = null
    private var lastDeadManTarget: String = ""
    private var lastDeadManCmd: String = ""

    private var terminalSession: TerminalSession? = null
    private var wakeLock: PowerManager.WakeLock? = null
    private var currentPid: Int = -1
    private lateinit var pinchScaleDetector: ScaleGestureDetector
    private var isPinching: Boolean = false

    companion object {
        const val EXTRA_PATH = "me.zhanghai.android.files.terminal.extra.PATH"
        const val EXTRA_CWD = "me.zhanghai.android.files.terminal.extra.CWD"
        const val EXTRA_COMMAND = "me.zhanghai.android.files.terminal.extra.COMMAND"
        const val EXTRA_FORCE_ROOT = "me.zhanghai.android.files.terminal.extra.FORCE_ROOT"
        const val EXTRA_FORCE_TERMEX = "me.zhanghai.android.files.terminal.extra.FORCE_TERMEX"
        const val EXTRA_ACTIVE_SCRIPT_PATH = "me.zhanghai.android.files.terminal.extra.ACTIVE_SCRIPT_PATH"

        fun createIntent(
            context: Context,
            path: String? = null,
            command: String? = null,
            forceRoot: Boolean? = null,
            forceTermex: Boolean? = null,
            activeScriptPath: String? = null
        ): Intent {
            return Intent(context, TerminalActivity::class.java).apply {
                if (path != null) {
                    putExtra(EXTRA_PATH, path)
                    putExtra(EXTRA_CWD, path)
                }
                if (command != null) {
                    putExtra(EXTRA_COMMAND, command)
                }
                if (forceRoot != null) {
                    putExtra(EXTRA_FORCE_ROOT, forceRoot)
                }
                if (forceTermex != null) {
                    putExtra(EXTRA_FORCE_TERMEX, forceTermex)
                }
                if (activeScriptPath != null) {
                    putExtra(EXTRA_ACTIVE_SCRIPT_PATH, activeScriptPath)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_terminal)

        toolbar = findViewById(R.id.toolbar)
        terminalView = findViewById(R.id.terminalView)
        extraKeysView = findViewById(R.id.extraKeysView)
        btnZoomOut = findViewById(R.id.btnZoomOut)
        btnZoomIn = findViewById(R.id.btnZoomIn)
        tvZoomSize = findViewById(R.id.tvZoomSize)
        btnCopyScreen = findViewById(R.id.btnCopyScreen)
        btnScriptAudit = findViewById(R.id.btnScriptAudit)
        btnDeadManSkull = findViewById(R.id.btnDeadManSkull)
        btnOverflowMenu = findViewById(R.id.btnOverflowMenu)
        layoutDeadManAlertBadge = findViewById(R.id.layoutDeadManAlertBadge)
        tvSessionDot = findViewById(R.id.tvSessionDot)
        tvSessionLabel = findViewById(R.id.tvSessionLabel)
        tvTerminalBreadcrumb = findViewById(R.id.tvTerminalBreadcrumb)
        layoutSessionBadge = findViewById(R.id.layoutSessionBadge)

        layoutSessionBadge?.setOnClickListener {
            val modeStr = if (ScriptExecutionManager.isRoot) "Root (UID 0)" else if (ScriptExecutionManager.isTermex) "Termex (bash)" else "Android system shell (sh)"
            Toast.makeText(this, "Entorno: $modeStr", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }

        btnScriptAudit?.setOnClickListener {
            showScriptAuditDialog()
        }
        btnOverflowMenu?.setOnClickListener {
            showOverflowMenu(it)
        }

        btnDeadManSkull?.setOnClickListener {
            if (lastDeadManTarget.isNotEmpty()) {
                DeadManProtectionManager.showDeadManProtectionDialog(this, lastDeadManTarget, lastDeadManCmd)
            }
        }
        layoutDeadManAlertBadge?.setOnClickListener {
            if (lastDeadManTarget.isNotEmpty()) {
                DeadManProtectionManager.showDeadManProtectionDialog(this, lastDeadManTarget, lastDeadManCmd)
            }
        }

        setupToolbar()
        setupPinchZoomDetector()
        setupExtraKeys()
        applyPreferences()
        startTerminalSession()
    }

    override fun onNewIntent(intent: Intent) {
        super.onNewIntent(intent)
        setIntent(intent)
        val cmd = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_COMMAND)
        if (cmd != null && cmd != ScriptExecutionManager.activeCommand) {
            startTerminalSession()
        }
    }

    fun showScriptAuditDialog() {
        val activeScript = ScriptExecutionManager.activeScriptPath
            ?: intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_ACTIVE_SCRIPT_PATH)
            ?: intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_PATH)
        me.zhanghai.android.files.terminal.tracer.ScriptAuditDialogFragment.show(this, activeScript)
    }

    fun showDeadManSkullAlert(target: String, cmd: String) {
        lastDeadManTarget = target
        lastDeadManCmd = cmd
        runOnUiThread {
            btnDeadManSkull?.visibility = View.VISIBLE
            layoutDeadManAlertBadge?.visibility = View.VISIBLE
            DeadManProtectionManager.showDeadManProtectionDialog(this, target, cmd)
        }
    }

    private fun setupToolbar() {
        toolbar.setNavigationOnClickListener {
            finish()
        }

        btnZoomOut?.setOnClickListener {
            it.performHapticFeedback(HapticFeedbackConstants.KEYBOARD_TAP)
            changeFontSizeBy(-1)
        }

        btnZoomIn?.setOnClickListener {
            it.performHapticFeedback(HapticFeedbackConstants.KEYBOARD_TAP)
            changeFontSizeBy(+1)
        }

        tvZoomSize?.setOnClickListener {
            it.performHapticFeedback(HapticFeedbackConstants.KEYBOARD_TAP)
            TerminalSettings.setFontSize(this, TerminalSettings.DEFAULT_FONT_SIZE_SP)
            applyPreferences()
            Toast.makeText(this, "Zoom restablecido (${TerminalSettings.DEFAULT_FONT_SIZE_SP}sp)", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }

        btnCopyScreen?.setOnClickListener {
            it.performHapticFeedback(HapticFeedbackConstants.KEYBOARD_TAP)
            copyTerminalTranscript()
        }
    }

    private fun setupPinchZoomDetector() {
        pinchScaleDetector = ScaleGestureDetector(
            this,
            object : ScaleGestureDetector.SimpleOnScaleGestureListener() {
                private var accumulatedFactor = 1.0f

                override fun onScaleBegin(detector: ScaleGestureDetector): Boolean {
                    isPinching = true
                    accumulatedFactor = 1.0f
                    return true
                }

                override fun onScale(detector: ScaleGestureDetector): Boolean {
                    accumulatedFactor *= detector.scaleFactor
                    if (accumulatedFactor < 0.91f || accumulatedFactor > 1.09f) {
                        val delta = if (accumulatedFactor > 1.0f) 1 else -1
                        changeFontSizeBy(delta)
                        accumulatedFactor = 1.0f
                    }
                    return true
                }

                override fun onScaleEnd(detector: ScaleGestureDetector) {
                    isPinching = false
                    accumulatedFactor = 1.0f
                }
            }
        )
    }

    override fun dispatchTouchEvent(ev: MotionEvent): Boolean {
        if (ev.pointerCount >= 2 || isPinching) {
            pinchScaleDetector.onTouchEvent(ev)
            if (ev.actionMasked == MotionEvent.ACTION_UP || ev.actionMasked == MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL) {
                isPinching = false
            }
            if (ev.pointerCount >= 2) {
                return true
            }
        }
        return super.dispatchTouchEvent(ev)
    }

    private fun changeFontSizeBy(delta: Int) {
        val currentSize = TerminalSettings.getFontSize(this)
        val newSize = (currentSize + delta).coerceIn(
            TerminalSettings.MIN_FONT_SIZE_SP,
            TerminalSettings.MAX_FONT_SIZE_SP
        )
        if (newSize != currentSize) {
            TerminalSettings.setFontSize(this, newSize)
            applyPreferences()
        }
    }

    private fun setupExtraKeys() {
        extraKeysView.onKeyString = { keyStr ->
            if (terminalSession?.isRunning == false) {
                if (keyStr == "\r" || keyStr == "\n") {
                    finish()
                }
            } else {
                terminalSession?.write(keyStr)
            }
        }
        extraKeysView.onOverflowMenuClick = { anchor ->
            showOverflowMenu(anchor)
        }
    }

    private fun applyPreferences() {
        val fontSizeSp = TerminalSettings.getFontSize(this)
        val fontSizePx = TypedValue.applyDimension(
            TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_SP,
            fontSizeSp.toFloat(),
            resources.displayMetrics
        ).roundToInt().coerceAtLeast(10)
        terminalView.setTextSize(fontSizePx)
        terminalView.setTypeface(Typeface.MONOSPACE)
        tvZoomSize?.text = "${fontSizeSp}sp"

        if (TerminalSettings.isKeepBlackTheme(this)) {
            terminalView.setBackgroundColor(Color.BLACK)
            window.statusBarColor = Color.parseColor("#161B22")
            window.navigationBarColor = Color.parseColor("#0F1217")
        }
    }

    private fun updateHudState(
        isRoot: Boolean,
        isTermex: Boolean,
        isRunning: Boolean,
        exitStatus: Int? = null,
        cwd: String? = null
    ) {
        runOnUiThread {
            if (isRunning) {
                tvSessionDot?.text = "●"
                tvSessionDot?.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#3FB950"))
                val label = when {
                    isRoot -> "ROOT (#)"
                    isTermex -> "TERMEX"
                    else -> "SHELL"
                }
                tvSessionLabel?.text = label
            } else {
                tvSessionDot?.text = "●"
                tvSessionDot?.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#F85149"))
                val codeStr = exitStatus?.let { " $it" } ?: ""
                tvSessionLabel?.text = "EXIT$codeStr"
            }

            if (cwd != null) {
                val displayPath = when {
                    cwd.startsWith("/storage/emulated/0") -> cwd.replace("/storage/emulated/0", "~")
                    cwd.startsWith("/data/data/me.zhanghai.android.files") -> cwd.replace("/data/data/me.zhanghai.android.files", "[app]")
                    else -> cwd
                }
                tvTerminalBreadcrumb?.text = displayPath
            }
        }
    }

    private fun startTerminalSession(forceRootOverride: Boolean? = null) {
        val initialCommand = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_COMMAND)

        val sessionClient = object : TerminalSessionClient {
            override fun onTextChanged(changedSession: TerminalSession) {
                terminalView.onScreenUpdated()
                ScriptExecutionManager.notifyOutputUpdated()
            }

            override fun onTerminalDataReceived(session: TerminalSession, data: ByteArray, offset: Int, length: Int) {
                val chunk = String(data, offset, length, Charsets.UTF_8)
                val activeScript = ScriptExecutionManager.activeScriptPath
                    ?: intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_ACTIVE_SCRIPT_PATH)
                    ?: intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_PATH)
                BinaryTracerEngine.parseTerminalChunk(chunk, this@TerminalActivity, session, activeScript)
            }

            override fun onTitleChanged(changedSession: TerminalSession) {
                runOnUiThread {
                    val title = changedSession.title
                    if (!title.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                        toolbar.subtitle = title
                        ScriptExecutionManager.notifyTitleChanged(title)
                        if (title.contains("/") || title.startsWith("~")) {
                            tvTerminalBreadcrumb?.text = title
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            override fun onSessionFinished(finishedSession: TerminalSession) {
                runOnUiThread {
                    toolbar.subtitle = "[Terminado (código ${finishedSession.exitStatus})]"
                    updateHudState(
                        isRoot = ScriptExecutionManager.isRoot,
                        isTermex = ScriptExecutionManager.isTermex,
                        isRunning = false,
                        exitStatus = finishedSession.exitStatus
                    )
                }
                ScriptExecutionManager.onSessionFinished(finishedSession.exitStatus, this@TerminalActivity)
            }

            override fun onCopyTextToClipboard(session: TerminalSession, text: String) {
                val cm = getSystemService(Context.CLIPBOARD_SERVICE) as? ClipboardManager
                cm?.setPrimaryClip(ClipData.newPlainText("terminal", text))
                Toast.makeText(this@TerminalActivity, R.string.terminal_copy, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }

            override fun onPasteTextFromClipboard(session: TerminalSession?) {
                pasteFromClipboard()
            }

            override fun onBell(session: TerminalSession) {}

            override fun onColorsChanged(session: TerminalSession) {
                terminalView.onScreenUpdated()
            }

            override fun onTerminalCursorStateChange(state: Boolean) {}

            override fun setTerminalShellPid(session: TerminalSession, pid: Int) {
                currentPid = pid
                ScriptExecutionManager.activePid = pid
                ScriptExecutionService.updateNotification(this@TerminalActivity)
            }

            override fun getTerminalCursorStyle(): Int {
                return TerminalEmulator.TERMINAL_CURSOR_STYLE_BLOCK
            }

            override fun logError(tag: String?, message: String?) {}
            override fun logWarn(tag: String?, message: String?) {}
            override fun logInfo(tag: String?, message: String?) {}
            override fun logDebug(tag: String?, message: String?) {}
            override fun logVerbose(tag: String?, message: String?) {}
            override fun logStackTraceWithMessage(tag: String?, message: String?, e: Exception?) {}
            override fun logStackTrace(tag: String?, e: Exception?) {}
        }

        val viewClient = object : TerminalViewClient {
            override fun onScale(scale: Float): Float {
                if (scale < 0.90f || scale > 1.10f) {
                    val delta = if (scale > 1.0f) 1 else -1
                    changeFontSizeBy(delta)
                    return 1.0f
                }
                return scale
            }

            override fun onSingleTapUp(e: MotionEvent?) {
                terminalView.requestFocus()
                val imm = getSystemService(Context.INPUT_METHOD_SERVICE) as? InputMethodManager
                imm?.showSoftInput(terminalView, InputMethodManager.SHOW_IMPLICIT)
            }

            override fun shouldBackButtonBeMappedToEscape(): Boolean = false
            override fun shouldEnforceCharBasedInput(): Boolean = false
            override fun shouldUseCtrlSpaceWorkaround(): Boolean = false
            override fun isTerminalViewSelected(): Boolean = true

            override fun copyModeChanged(copyMode: Boolean) {}

            override fun onKeyDown(keyCode: Int, e: KeyEvent?, session: TerminalSession?): Boolean {
                if (session != null && !session.isRunning) {
                    if (keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ENTER || keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_NUMPAD_ENTER) {
                        finish()
                        return true
                    }
                }
                // Volume Up / Down zoom shortcuts
                if (keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_VOLUME_UP) {
                    changeFontSizeBy(+1)
                    return true
                }
                if (keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_VOLUME_DOWN) {
                    changeFontSizeBy(-1)
                    return true
                }
                return false
            }

            override fun onKeyUp(keyCode: Int, e: KeyEvent?): Boolean {
                if (keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_VOLUME_UP || keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_VOLUME_DOWN) {
                    return true
                }
                return false
            }

            override fun onLongPress(event: MotionEvent?): Boolean = false

            override fun readControlKey(): Boolean {
                return extraKeysView.consumeCtrl()
            }

            override fun readAltKey(): Boolean {
                return extraKeysView.consumeAlt()
            }

            override fun readShiftKey(): Boolean = false
            override fun readFnKey(): Boolean = false

            override fun onCodePoint(codePoint: Int, ctrlDown: Boolean, session: TerminalSession?): Boolean {
                return false
            }

            override fun onEmulatorSet() {}

            override fun logError(tag: String?, message: String?) {}
            override fun logWarn(tag: String?, message: String?) {}
            override fun logInfo(tag: String?, message: String?) {}
            override fun logDebug(tag: String?, message: String?) {}
            override fun logVerbose(tag: String?, message: String?) {}
            override fun logStackTraceWithMessage(tag: String?, message: String?, e: Exception?) {}
            override fun logStackTrace(tag: String?, e: Exception?) {}
        }

        // 1. Check if we can seamlessly reattach to existing running session
        if (initialCommand == null && ScriptExecutionManager.hasActiveSession()) {
            val existingSession = ScriptExecutionManager.activeSession!!
            existingSession.updateTerminalSessionClient(sessionClient)
            terminalSession = existingSession
            currentPid = ScriptExecutionManager.activePid

            terminalView.setTerminalViewClient(viewClient)
            terminalView.attachSession(existingSession)

            val mode = if (ScriptExecutionManager.isRoot) "Root (#)" else if (ScriptExecutionManager.isTermex) "Termex (bash)" else "Sistema (sh)"
            toolbar.title = ScriptExecutionManager.activeScriptName
            toolbar.subtitle = if (existingSession.isRunning) "$mode • En ejecución..." else "[Terminado (código ${existingSession.exitStatus})]"
            updateHudState(
                isRoot = ScriptExecutionManager.isRoot,
                isTermex = ScriptExecutionManager.isTermex,
                isRunning = existingSession.isRunning,
                exitStatus = if (existingSession.isRunning) null else existingSession.exitStatus,
                cwd = ScriptExecutionManager.activeScriptPath
            )
            return
        }

        terminalSession?.finishIfRunning()

        if (!initialCommand.isNullOrEmpty() &&
            DeadManProtectionManager.isDfrootProtectionActive(this) &&
            DeadManProtectionManager.containsDangerousSystemCommand(initialCommand)
        ) {
            DeadManProtectionManager.showDirtyFlagProtectionDialog(this) {
                finish()
            }
            return
        }

        val overridePath = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_PATH)
            ?: intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_CWD)
            ?: intent.data?.path

        val forceRoot = forceRootOverride
            ?: if (intent.hasExtra(EXTRA_FORCE_ROOT)) intent.getBooleanExtra(EXTRA_FORCE_ROOT, false) else null
        val forceTermex = if (intent.hasExtra(EXTRA_FORCE_TERMEX)) intent.getBooleanExtra(EXTRA_FORCE_TERMEX, false) else null

        val activeScript = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_ACTIVE_SCRIPT_PATH)
            ?: intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_PATH)
            ?: intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_CWD)

        val config = TerminalExpansionManager.prepareLaunchConfig(
            this,
            forceRoot = forceRoot,
            forceTermex = forceTermex,
            overrideCwd = overridePath,
            initialCommand = initialCommand,
            activeScriptPath = activeScript
        )

        val session = TerminalSession(
            config.executable,
            config.cwd,
            config.args,
            config.env,
            5000,
            sessionClient
        )
        terminalSession = session

        val scriptName = if (initialCommand != null) {
            val lastPathPart = initialCommand.split(" ", ";").lastOrNull { it.contains("/") } ?: initialCommand
            val fileName = File(lastPathPart.trim().trim('"', '\'', ')', '(')).name
            if (fileName.isNotEmpty()) fileName else initialCommand
        } else {
            val dirName = File(config.cwd).name.ifEmpty { "/" }
            "Terminal ($dirName)"
        }

        ScriptExecutionManager.startExecution(
            context = this,
            session = session,
            scriptName = scriptName,
            path = activeScript ?: overridePath,
            command = initialCommand,
            root = config.isRoot,
            termex = config.isTermex
        )

        terminalView.setTerminalViewClient(viewClient)
        terminalView.attachSession(session)

        val mode = if (config.isRoot) "Root (#)" else if (config.isTermex) "Termex (bash)" else "Sistema (sh)"
        toolbar.title = scriptName
        toolbar.subtitle = "$mode • Ejecutando..."
        updateHudState(
            isRoot = config.isRoot,
            isTermex = config.isTermex,
            isRunning = true,
            cwd = config.cwd
        )
    }

    private fun copyTerminalTranscript() {
        val transcript = try {
            terminalSession?.emulator?.screen?.transcriptText?.trim()
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            null
        }
        if (!transcript.isNullOrEmpty()) {
            val cm = getSystemService(Context.CLIPBOARD_SERVICE) as? ClipboardManager
            cm?.setPrimaryClip(ClipData.newPlainText("Terminal Output", transcript))
            Toast.makeText(this, "Salida de terminal copiada al portapapeles", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        } else {
            Toast.makeText(this, "No hay texto en pantalla para copiar", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }

    private fun showOverflowMenu(anchor: View) {
        val popup = PopupMenu(this, anchor)
        popup.menu.apply {
            val wakeTitle = if (wakeLock?.isHeld == true) {
                "${getString(R.string.terminal_wakelock)} (✓)"
            } else {
                getString(R.string.terminal_wakelock)
            }
            add(Menu.NONE, 1, 1, wakeTitle)
            add(Menu.NONE, 12, 2, R.string.tracer_menu_item)
            add(Menu.NONE, 10, 3, R.string.script_menu_keep_background)
            add(Menu.NONE, 11, 4, R.string.script_menu_terminate)
            add(Menu.NONE, 5, 5, R.string.terminal_paste)
            add(Menu.NONE, 6, 5, "Copiar toda la pantalla")
            add(Menu.NONE, 7, 6, "Limpiar pantalla (clear)")
            add(Menu.NONE, 8, 7, "Cambiar a Root (su)")
            add(Menu.NONE, 9, 8, "Nueva sesión limpia")
            add(Menu.NONE, 3, 9, R.string.terminal_reset)
            add(Menu.NONE, 4, 10, R.string.terminal_preferences)
            add(Menu.NONE, 2, 11, R.string.terminal_close)
        }

        popup.setOnMenuItemClickListener { item ->
            when (item.itemId) {
                1 -> {
                    toggleWakeLock()
                    true
                }
                2 -> {
                    finish()
                    true
                }
                3 -> {
                    terminalSession?.reset()
                    terminalView.onScreenUpdated()
                    Toast.makeText(this, R.string.terminal_reset, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    true
                }
                4 -> {
                    val dialog = TerminalPreferencesDialog()
                    dialog.onSettingsChanged = {
                        applyPreferences()
                    }
                    dialog.show(supportFragmentManager, "TerminalPreferences")
                    true
                }
                5 -> {
                    pasteFromClipboard()
                    true
                }
                6 -> {
                    copyTerminalTranscript()
                    true
                }
                7 -> {
                    terminalSession?.write("clear\n")
                    true
                }
                8 -> {
                    terminalSession?.write("su\n")
                    true
                }
                9 -> {
                    startTerminalSession()
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Nueva sesión iniciada", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    true
                }
                10 -> {
                    ScriptExecutionManager.keepInBackground(this)
                    Toast.makeText(this, R.string.script_exec_kept_toast, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    moveTaskToBack(true)
                    true
                }
                11 -> {
                    ScriptExecutionManager.terminateShell(this)
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Proceso terminado", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    finish()
                    true
                }
                12 -> {
                    showScriptAuditDialog()
                    true
                }
                else -> false
            }
        }
        popup.show()
    }

    private fun toggleWakeLock() {
        val pm = getSystemService(Context.POWER_SERVICE) as? PowerManager ?: return
        if (wakeLock == null) {
            wakeLock = pm.newWakeLock(PowerManager.PARTIAL_WAKE_LOCK, "OpenManager:TerminalWakeLock")
        }

        wakeLock?.let { wl ->
            if (wl.isHeld) {
                wl.release()
                Toast.makeText(this, R.string.terminal_wakelock_released, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            } else {
                wl.acquire(60 * 60 * 1000L) // 1 hour max
                Toast.makeText(this, R.string.terminal_wakelock_acquired, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun pasteFromClipboard() {
        val cm = getSystemService(Context.CLIPBOARD_SERVICE) as? ClipboardManager ?: return
        val clip = cm.primaryClip
        if (clip != null && clip.itemCount > 0) {
            val text = clip.getItemAt(0).coerceToText(this)?.toString()
            if (!text.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                terminalSession?.write(text)
            }
        }
    }

    override fun dispatchKeyEvent(event: KeyEvent): Boolean {
        if (terminalSession?.isRunning == false && event.action == KeyEvent.ACTION_DOWN) {
            if (event.keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ENTER || event.keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_NUMPAD_ENTER) {
                finish()
                return true
            }
        }
        return super.dispatchKeyEvent(event)
    }

    override fun onBackPressed() {
        finish()
    }

    override fun onDestroy() {
        super.onDestroy()
        if (wakeLock?.isHeld == true) {
            wakeLock?.release()
        }
        if (terminalSession?.isRunning == true) {
            Toast.makeText(this, R.string.script_exec_running_background_toast, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        } else {
            ScriptExecutionManager.clearSession()
            ScriptExecutionService.stop(this)
        }
    }
}
```

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.terminal

import android.app.Activity

import com.google.android.material.dialog.MaterialAlertDialogBuilder

import me.zhanghai.android.files.app.application
```
