object TerminalExpansionManager {
    const val TERMEX_PACKAGE = "bin.mt.termex"

    // Primary and fallback download URLs for Termex ARM64 APK
    private const val TERMEX_DOWNLOAD_URL =
        "https://github.com/xxnonxxp11/OpenManager/releases/download/v1.9.28/termex_v3008_arm64.apk"
    private const val TERMEX_FALLBACK_URL =
        "https://github.com/xxnonxxp11/OpenManager/releases/download/v1.9.27/termex_v3008_arm64.apk"

    private const val EXTENDED_SYSTEM_PATH =
        "/system/bin:/system/xbin:/vendor/bin:/product/bin:/apex/com.android.runtime/bin:/apex/com.android.art/bin:/sbin:/data/adb/ksu/bin:/data/adb/ap/bin:/data/adb/magisk"

    data class LaunchConfig(
        val executable: String,
        val cwd: String,
        val args: Array<String>,
        val env: Array<String>,
        val isTermex: Boolean,
        val isRoot: Boolean
    )

    fun isTermexInstalled(context: Context = application): Boolean {
        return try {
            context.packageManager.getPackageInfo(TERMEX_PACKAGE, 0)
            true
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            false
        }
    }

    fun getTermexVersion(context: Context = application): String? {
        return try {
            val info = context.packageManager.getPackageInfo(TERMEX_PACKAGE, 0)
            val name = info.versionName ?: "v3.8"
            val abi = Build.SUPPORTED_ABIS.firstOrNull() ?: "arm64"
            "$name $abi"
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            null
        }
    }

    fun isRootAvailable(): Boolean {
        return try {
            me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.root.LibSuFileServiceLauncher.isSuAvailable() ||
                (com.topjohnwu.superuser.Shell.isAppGrantedRoot() == true)
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            false
        }
    }

    /**
     * Finds bash executable either from Termex native library dir or extracted in filesDir/termex/bin.
     */
    fun getBashExecutable(context: Context = application): File? {
        if (!isTermexInstalled(context)) return null
        try {
            val pkgInfo = context.packageManager.getPackageInfo(TERMEX_PACKAGE, 0)
            val nativeLibDir = pkgInfo.applicationInfo?.nativeLibraryDir ?: ""
            val apkPath = pkgInfo.applicationInfo?.sourceDir ?: ""

            val termexDir = File(context.filesDir, "termex")
            val binDir = File(termexDir, "bin").apply { mkdirs() }
            val libDir = File(termexDir, "lib").apply { mkdirs() }

            // 1. Check native library directory (bash, libbash.so)
            val candidates = arrayOf(
                File(nativeLibDir, "bash"),
                File(nativeLibDir, "libbash.so")
            )
            for (cand in candidates) {
                if (cand.exists() && cand.canExecute()) {
                    return cand
                }
            }

            // 2. Check private termex/bin/bash
            val privateBash = File(binDir, "bash")
            if (privateBash.exists() && privateBash.canExecute() && privateBash.length() > 0) {
                return privateBash
            }

            // 3. Extract bash or libbash.so from Termex APK if available
            if (apkPath.isNotEmpty() && File(apkPath).exists()) {
                extractTermexBinary(apkPath, "bash", privateBash)
                if (privateBash.exists() && privateBash.length() > 0) {
                    privateBash.setReadable(true, false)
                    privateBash.setExecutable(true, false)
                    return privateBash
                }
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
        }
        return null
    }

    fun isBashAvailable(context: Context = application): Boolean {
        return getBashExecutable(context) != null
    }

    /**
     * Ensures standalone command-line tools (such as apktool and bash) are deployed
     * in context.filesDir/bin and marked executable.
     */
    fun ensureBinTools(context: Context): File {
        val binDir = File(context.filesDir, "bin").apply { mkdirs() }

        // 1. Record application APK path for app_process CLASSPATH lookup
        val appApkPath = context.applicationInfo?.sourceDir ?: ""
        if (appApkPath.isNotEmpty() && File(appApkPath).exists()) {
            try {
                val apkPathFile = File(binDir, ".apk_path")
                if (!apkPathFile.exists() || apkPathFile.readText() != appApkPath) {
                    apkPathFile.writeText(appApkPath)
                }
            } catch (_: Throwable) {}
        }

        // 2. Deploy or update standalone 'apktool' CLI wrapper script
        val apktoolFile = File(binDir, "apktool")
        val apktoolContent = """
            #!/system/bin/sh
            # OpenManager Standalone Apktool CLI for Android (ART Native)
            BIN_DIR="${'$'}(cd "${'$'}(dirname "${'$'}0")" && pwd)"
            APK_PATH="${'$'}(cat "${'$'}BIN_DIR/.apk_path" 2>/dev/null)"
            if [ -z "${'$'}APK_PATH" ] || [ ! -f "${'$'}APK_PATH" ]; then
                APK_PATH="${'$'}(pm path ${context.packageName} 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 | cut -d: -f2)"
            fi
            if [ -z "${'$'}APK_PATH" ] || [ ! -f "${'$'}APK_PATH" ]; then
                APK_PATH="${'$'}(pm path me.zhanghai.android.files 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 | cut -d: -f2)"
            fi
            if [ -z "${'$'}APK_PATH" ] || [ ! -f "${'$'}APK_PATH" ]; then
                echo "Error: OpenManager APK not found on device." >&2
                exit 1
            fi
            export CLASSPATH="${'$'}APK_PATH"
            exec /system/bin/app_process /system/bin me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist.ApktoolCli "${'$'}@"
        """.trimIndent() + "\n"

        try {
            if (!apktoolFile.exists() || apktoolFile.readText() != apktoolContent) {
                apktoolFile.writeText(apktoolContent)
            }
            apktoolFile.setReadable(true, false)
            apktoolFile.setExecutable(true, false)
        } catch (_: Throwable) {}

        // 3. Deploy bash wrapper script if Termex bash is found
        val bashExecutable = getBashExecutable(context)
        if (bashExecutable != null && bashExecutable.exists()) {
            val bashWrapper = File(binDir, "bash")
            val bashContent = """
                #!/system/bin/sh
                exec "${bashExecutable.absolutePath}" "${'$'}@"
            """.trimIndent() + "\n"
            try {
                if (!bashWrapper.exists() || bashWrapper.readText() != bashContent) {
                    bashWrapper.writeText(bashContent)
                }
                bashWrapper.setReadable(true, false)
                bashWrapper.setExecutable(true, false)
            } catch (_: Throwable) {}
        }

        // 4. Aggressively purge any legacy files or scripts (rm, rmdir, om_tracer, etc.) from binDir.
        // Android 10+ (targetSdk 29+) SELinux strictly blocks untrusted apps from executing
        // scripts or binaries from internal storage (app_data_file) via execve (W^X violation).
        // Only apktool and .apk_path are allowed in binDir. Any other file is deleted immediately.
        binDir.listFiles()?.forEach { file ->
            if (file.name != "apktool" && file.name != ".apk_path") {
                try {
                    file.setWritable(true, false)
                    val deleted = file.delete()
                    if (!deleted || file.exists()) {
                        try {
                            file.writeBytes(ByteArray(0))
                        } catch (_: Throwable) {}
                        val trashFile = File(binDir, ".trash_${System.currentTimeMillis()}_${file.name}")
                        file.renameTo(trashFile)
                        trashFile.delete()
                    }
                } catch (_: Throwable) {}
            }
        }
        if (isRootAvailable()) {
            try {
                com.topjohnwu.superuser.Shell.cmd(
                    "rm -f '${binDir.absolutePath}/rm' '${binDir.absolutePath}/rmdir' '${binDir.absolutePath}/om_tracer' 2>/dev/null || true"
                ).exec()
            } catch (_: Throwable) {}
        }

        return binDir
    }

    private fun ensureShellInitScript(context: Context): File {
        val initFile = File(context.filesDir, "om_shell_rc.sh")
        try {
            val rcContent = """
                alias ll='ls -la'
                alias la='ls -A'
                alias l='ls -CF'
                alias cls='clear'
                alias ..='cd ..'
                alias ...='cd ../..'
                export LANG=en_US.UTF-8
                export COLORTERM=truecolor

                # Shell function interceptors for dead man & deletion policy without SELinux execve violations
                rm() {
                    if [ "${'$'}OM_DEAD_MAN_ACTIVE" = "1" ]; then
                        case "${'$'}*" in
                            *" /"*|*" /*"*|*"-rf / "*|*"-rf /"*|*"-fr / "*|*"-fr /"*|*"/system"*|*"/vendor"*|*"/product"*|*"/apex"*|*"/system_ext"*|*"/dev/block"*)
                                echo "[OM_TRACER:DEADMAN_DELETE:rm:${'$'}*]"
                                echo "[DEAD MAN PROTECTION] Deletion of protected system paths blocked: ${'$'}*" >&2
                                return 1
                                ;;
                        esac
                    fi
                    if [ "${'$'}OM_TRACER_DISABLED" != "1" ]; then
                        echo "[OM_TRACER:DELETE:rm:${'$'}*]"
                        if [ "${'$'}OM_DELETION_POLICY" = "BLOCK_ALL" ]; then
                            echo "[OM_TRACER:BLOCKED] rm ${'$'}*" >&2
                            return 1
                        fi
                    fi
                    if [ -x /system/bin/rm ]; then
                        /system/bin/rm "${'$'}@"
                    else
                        command rm "${'$'}@"
                    fi
                }

                rmdir() {
                    if [ "${'$'}OM_DEAD_MAN_ACTIVE" = "1" ]; then
                        case "${'$'}*" in
                            *"/system"*|*"/vendor"*|*"/product"*|*"/apex"*|*"/system_ext"*|*"/dev/block"*)
                                echo "[OM_TRACER:DEADMAN_DELETE:rmdir:${'$'}*]"
                                echo "[DEAD MAN PROTECTION] Deletion of protected system paths blocked: ${'$'}*" >&2
                                return 1
                                ;;
                        esac
                    fi
                    if [ "${'$'}OM_TRACER_DISABLED" != "1" ]; then
                        echo "[OM_TRACER:DELETE:rmdir:${'$'}*]"
                        if [ "${'$'}OM_DELETION_POLICY" = "BLOCK_ALL" ]; then
                            echo "[OM_TRACER:BLOCKED] rmdir ${'$'}*" >&2
                            return 1
                        fi
                    fi
                    if [ -x /system/bin/rmdir ]; then
                        /system/bin/rmdir "${'$'}@"
                    else
                        command rmdir "${'$'}@"
                    fi
                }

                unlink() {
                    if [ "${'$'}OM_DEAD_MAN_ACTIVE" = "1" ]; then
                        case "${'$'}*" in
                            *" /"*|*" /*"*|*"/system"*|*"/vendor"*|*"/product"*|*"/apex"*|*"/system_ext"*|*"/dev/block"*)
                                echo "[OM_TRACER:DEADMAN_DELETE:unlink:${'$'}*]"
                                echo "[DEAD MAN PROTECTION] Deletion of protected system paths blocked: ${'$'}*" >&2
                                return 1
                                ;;
                        esac
                    fi
                    if [ "${'$'}OM_TRACER_DISABLED" != "1" ]; then
                        echo "[OM_TRACER:DELETE:unlink:${'$'}*]"
                        if [ "${'$'}OM_DELETION_POLICY" = "BLOCK_ALL" ]; then
                            echo "[OM_TRACER:BLOCKED] unlink ${'$'}*" >&2
                            return 1
                        fi
                    fi
                    if [ -x /system/bin/unlink ]; then
                        /system/bin/unlink "${'$'}@"
                    else
                        command unlink "${'$'}@"
                    fi
                }

                export -f rm rmdir unlink 2>/dev/null || true
            """.trimIndent() + "\n"
            if (!initFile.exists() || initFile.readText() != rcContent) {
                initFile.writeText(rcContent)
                initFile.setReadable(true, false)
            }
        } catch (_: Throwable) {}
        return initFile
    }

    fun prepareLaunchConfig(
        context: Context,
        forceRoot: Boolean? = null,
        forceTermex: Boolean? = null,
        overrideCwd: String? = null,
        initialCommand: String? = null,
        activeScriptPath: String? = null
    ): LaunchConfig {
        val initScript = ensureShellInitScript(context)
        val tracerEnabled = ScriptTracerPreferences.isTracerEnabled(context, activeScriptPath)
        val deletionPolicy = ScriptTracerPreferences.getDeletionPolicy(context, activeScriptPath)
        val deadManActive = DeadManProtectionManager.isDeadManProtectionActive(context)
        val tracerEnv = arrayOf(
            "OM_TRACER_DISABLED=" + (if (tracerEnabled) "0" else "1"),
            "OM_DELETION_POLICY=" + deletionPolicy.name,
            "OM_ACTIVE_SCRIPT_PATH=" + (activeScriptPath ?: ""),
            "OM_DEAD_MAN_ACTIVE=" + (if (deadManActive) "1" else "0"),
            "BASH_ENV=" + initScript.absolutePath,
            "ENV=" + initScript.absolutePath
        )
        val asRoot = forceRoot ?: TerminalSettings.isRootSession(context)
        val useTermex = forceTermex ?: (isTermexInstalled(context) && !asRoot)
        val targetCwd = overrideCwd ?: TerminalSettings.getStartPath(context)
        val validCwd = if (File(targetCwd).isDirectory) targetCwd else "/storage/emulated/0"
        val escapedCwd = validCwd.replace("'", "'\\''")
        val histFile = File(context.filesDir, ".om_shell_history").absolutePath
        val binDir = ensureBinTools(context)

        val shellCmd = if (initialCommand != null) {
            ". '${initScript.absolutePath}' 2>/dev/null; cd '$escapedCwd' && ($initialCommand); _mt_status=\$?; exit \$_mt_status"
        } else null

        if (asRoot && isRootAvailable()) {
            val env = arrayOf(
                "TERM=xterm-256color",
                "COLORTERM=truecolor",
                "LANG=en_US.UTF-8",
                "HOME=$validCwd",
                "TMPDIR=${context.cacheDir.absolutePath}",
                "HISTFILE=$histFile",
                "ENV=${initScript.absolutePath}",
                "PATH=$EXTENDED_SYSTEM_PATH:${binDir.absolutePath}"
            ) + tracerEnv
            val args = if (shellCmd != null) {
                arrayOf("su", "-c", shellCmd)
            } else {
                arrayOf("su")
            }
            return LaunchConfig(
                executable = "su",
                cwd = validCwd,
                args = args,
                env = env,
                isTermex = false,
                isRoot = true
            )
        }

        if (useTermex && isTermexInstalled(context)) {
            try {
                val pkgInfo = context.packageManager.getPackageInfo(TERMEX_PACKAGE, 0)
                val nativeLibDir = pkgInfo.applicationInfo?.nativeLibraryDir ?: ""
                val apkPath = pkgInfo.applicationInfo?.sourceDir ?: ""

                val termexDir = File(context.filesDir, "termex")
                val libDir = File(termexDir, "lib")
                libDir.mkdirs()

                // Check if auxiliary libraries need extraction
                val marker = File(libDir, "libandroid-support.so")
                if (!marker.exists() || marker.length() == 0L) {
                    extractTermexAuxLibraries(apkPath, libDir, termexDir)
                }

                val bashBin = getBashExecutable(context)
                if (bashBin != null && bashBin.exists()) {
                    val prompt = "\$([ \$? == 0 ] && echo '\\[\\e[1;32m\\]' || echo '\\[\\e[1;31m\\]')\$([ \$UID == 0 ] && echo '#' || echo '➜') \\[\\e[1;36m\\]\\w\\[\\e[m\\] "
                    val env = arrayOf(
                        "PREFIX=${termexDir.absolutePath}",
                        "LD_LIBRARY_PATH=${libDir.absolutePath}:$nativeLibDir",
                        "PATH=$nativeLibDir:$EXTENDED_SYSTEM_PATH:${binDir.absolutePath}",
                        "SHELL=${bashBin.absolutePath}",
                        "TERM=xterm-256color",
                        "COLORTERM=truecolor",
                        "LANG=en_US.UTF-8",
                        "HOME=$validCwd",
                        "TMPDIR=${context.cacheDir.absolutePath}",
                        "HISTFILE=$histFile",
                        "ENV=${initScript.absolutePath}",
                        "PS1=$prompt"
                    ) + tracerEnv
                    val args = if (shellCmd != null) {
                        arrayOf("bash", "--norc", "-c", shellCmd)
                    } else {
                        arrayOf("bash", "--rcfile", initScript.absolutePath, "-i")
                    }
                    return LaunchConfig(
                        executable = bashBin.absolutePath,
                        cwd = validCwd,
                        args = args,
                        env = env,
                        isTermex = true,
                        isRoot = false
                    )
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                e.printStackTrace()
            }
        }

        // Standard Android shell fallback (mksh / sh)
        val env = arrayOf(
            "PATH=$EXTENDED_SYSTEM_PATH:${binDir.absolutePath}",
            "TERM=xterm-256color",
            "COLORTERM=truecolor",
            "LANG=en_US.UTF-8",
            "HOME=$validCwd",
            "TMPDIR=${context.cacheDir.absolutePath}",
            "HISTFILE=$histFile",
            "ENV=${initScript.absolutePath}",
            "PS1=➜ \${PWD##*/} \$ "
        ) + tracerEnv
        val args = if (shellCmd != null) {
            arrayOf("sh", "-c", shellCmd)
        } else {
            arrayOf("sh", "-i")
        }
        return LaunchConfig(
            executable = "/system/bin/sh",
            cwd = validCwd,
            args = args,
            env = env,
            isTermex = false,
            isRoot = false
        )
    }

    private fun extractTermexAuxLibraries(apkPath: String, libDir: File, termexDir: File) {
        if (apkPath.isEmpty() || !File(apkPath).exists()) return
        try {
            ZipFile(File(apkPath)).use { zip ->
                val entries = zip.entries()
                val isArm64 = Build.SUPPORTED_ABIS.any { it.contains("arm64") }
                val targetPrefix = if (isArm64) "lib/arm64-v8a/lib/" else "lib/armeabi-v7a/lib/"

                while (entries.hasMoreElements()) {
                    val entry = entries.nextElement()
                    if (entry.name.startsWith(targetPrefix)) {
                        var fileName = entry.name.substring(targetPrefix.length)
                        if (fileName.contains("/")) {
                            fileName = fileName.substringAfterLast("/")
                        }
                        if (fileName.endsWith(".rename")) {
                            fileName = fileName.removeSuffix(".rename")
                        } else if (fileName.endsWith(".link")) {
                            fileName = fileName.removeSuffix(".link")
                        }
                        val outFile = File(libDir, fileName)
                        zip.getInputStream(entry).use { input ->
                            FileOutputStream(outFile).use { output ->
                                input.copyTo(output)
                            }
                        }
                        outFile.setReadable(true, false)
                        outFile.setExecutable(true, false)
                    } else if (entry.name == "assets/etc/bash.bashrc") {
                        val etcDir = File(termexDir, "etc")
                        etcDir.mkdirs()
                        val rcFile = File(etcDir, "bash.bashrc")
                        zip.getInputStream(entry).use { input ->
                            FileOutputStream(rcFile).use { output ->
                                input.copyTo(output)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
        }
    }

    private fun extractTermexBinary(apkPath: String, binaryName: String, destinationFile: File) {
        try {
            ZipFile(File(apkPath)).use { zip ->
                val entries = zip.entries()
                val isArm64 = Build.SUPPORTED_ABIS.any { it.contains("arm64") }
                val targetAbi = if (isArm64) "arm64-v8a" else "armeabi-v7a"

                while (entries.hasMoreElements()) {
                    val entry = entries.nextElement()
                    val name = entry.name
                    if (name.contains(targetAbi) && (name.endsWith("/$binaryName") || name.endsWith("/lib$binaryName.so"))) {
                        destinationFile.parentFile?.mkdirs()
                        zip.getInputStream(entry).use { input ->
                            FileOutputStream(destinationFile).use { output ->
                                input.copyTo(output)
                            }
                        }
                        destinationFile.setReadable(true, false)
                        destinationFile.setExecutable(true, false)
                        return
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
        }
    }

    /**
     * Scans storage for any existing Termex APK (e.g. in /sdcard/Download or Downloads).
     */
    fun findLocalTermexApk(context: Context = application): File? {
        val searchDirs = listOfNotNull(
            File("/storage/emulated/0/Download"),
            File("/storage/emulated/0/Downloads"),
            File("/sdcard/Download"),
            File("/sdcard/Downloads"),
            context.getExternalFilesDir(null),
            File("/sdcard")
        )

        for (dir in searchDirs) {
            if (!dir.exists() || !dir.isDirectory) continue
            val found = dir.listFiles { f ->
                f.isFile && f.extension.equals("apk", ignoreCase = true) &&
                    (f.name.contains("termex", ignoreCase = true) || f.name.contains("mterm", ignoreCase = true))
            }?.firstOrNull()
            if (found != null && found.length() > 0) {
                return found
            }
        }
        return null
    }

    /**
     * Launches system PackageInstaller via FileProvider for a given APK file.
     */
    fun installApkFile(activity: Activity, apkFile: File): Boolean {
        return try {
            val uri = FileProvider.getUriForFile(
                activity,
                "${activity.packageName}.file_provider",
                apkFile
            )
            val intent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW).apply {
                setDataAndType(uri, "application/vnd.android.package-archive")
                addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK)
                addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION)
            }
            activity.startActivity(intent)
            true
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
            Toast.makeText(activity, "Error al iniciar instalador: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
            false
        }
    }

    /**
     * Shows an interactive, user-friendly dialog to install the Terminal Expansion Pack (Termex).
     * Provides 3 options:
     * 1. 1-tap install if an APK was detected on local storage.
     * 2. Automatic download & install with progress bar.
     * 3. Select APK from storage.
     */
    fun showExpansionInstallerDialog(activity: Activity, onInstalled: (() -> Unit)? = null) {
        val density = activity.resources.displayMetrics.density
        val localApk = findLocalTermexApk(activity)

        val layout = LinearLayout(activity).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            val pad = (18 * density).toInt()
            setPadding(pad, pad, pad, pad)
        }

        val tvDesc = TextView(activity).apply {
            text = "El Paquete de Expansión de Terminal proporciona un entorno Linux completo con GNU Bash 5.x, utilidades coreutils, tuberías avanzadas y soporte para scripts complejos.\n\nActualmente no se encuentra instalado en este dispositivo."
            setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#CCCCCC"))
            textSize = 13.5f
        }
        layout.addView(tvDesc)

        if (localApk != null) {
            val mb = String.format("%.1f", localApk.length() / (1024.0 * 1024.0))
            val btnLocal = Button(activity).apply {
                text = "📦 Instalar APK detectado (${localApk.name} - ${mb}MB)"
                setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#2E7D32"))
                setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
                val mTop = (16 * density).toInt()
                val lp = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT)
                lp.topMargin = mTop
                layoutParams = lp
            }
            btnLocal.setOnClickListener {
                installApkFile(activity, localApk)
            }
            layout.addView(btnLocal)
        }

        val btnDownload = Button(activity).apply {
            text = "⬇️ Descargar e instalar automáticamente"
            setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#1565C0"))
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            val lp = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT)
            lp.topMargin = (12 * density).toInt()
            layoutParams = lp
        }
        layout.addView(btnDownload)

        val btnPick = Button(activity).apply {
            text = "📂 Seleccionar APK del almacenamiento"
            setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#424242"))
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            val lp = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT)
            lp.topMargin = (10 * density).toInt()
            layoutParams = lp
        }
        layout.addView(btnPick)

        val dialog = MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(activity)
            .setTitle("Expansión de Terminal (Termex)")
            .setView(layout)
            .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
            .create()

        btnDownload.setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            downloadAndInstallTermex(activity, onInstalled)
        }

        btnPick.setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            try {
                val intent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_GET_CONTENT).apply {
                    type = "application/vnd.android.package-archive"
                    addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_OPENABLE)
                }
                activity.startActivity(Intent.createChooser(intent, "Seleccionar APK de Termex"))
            } catch (_: Exception) {
                Toast.makeText(activity, "Coloque termex_v3008_arm64.apk en su carpeta Descargas", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
            }
        }

        dialog.show()
    }

    /**
     * Downloads the Termex APK in background with an interactive progress dialog
     * and automatically invokes the PackageInstaller upon completion.
     */
    fun downloadAndInstallTermex(activity: Activity, onCompleted: (() -> Unit)? = null) {
        val density = activity.resources.displayMetrics.density
        val progressLayout = LinearLayout(activity).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            val pad = (20 * density).toInt()
            setPadding(pad, pad, pad, pad)
        }

        val tvStatus = TextView(activity).apply {
            text = "Conectando al servidor..."
            textSize = 14f
            setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#E0E0E0"))
        }
        val progressBar = ProgressBar(activity, null, android.R.attr.progressBarStyleHorizontal).apply {
            isIndeterminate = true
            val lp = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, (12 * density).toInt())
            lp.topMargin = (14 * density).toInt()
            layoutParams = lp
        }

        progressLayout.addView(tvStatus)
        progressLayout.addView(progressBar)

        val progressDialog = MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(activity)
            .setTitle("Descargando Paquete de Expansión")
            .setView(progressLayout)
            .setCancelable(false)
            .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel) { d, _ ->
                d.dismiss()
            }
            .create()

        progressDialog.show()

        var isCancelled = false
        progressDialog.setOnDismissListener { isCancelled = true }

        CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO).launch {
            val downloadFile = File(activity.cacheDir, "termex_install.apk")
            var downloadSuccess = false
            var errorMsg: String? = null

            val urlsToTry = listOf(TERMEX_DOWNLOAD_URL, TERMEX_FALLBACK_URL)
            for (urlStr in urlsToTry) {
                if (isCancelled) break
                var conn: HttpURLConnection? = null
                try {
                    val url = URL(urlStr)
                    conn = url.openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
                    conn.connectTimeout = 15000
                    conn.readTimeout = 25000
                    conn.instanceFollowRedirects = true

                    val code = conn.responseCode
                    if (code in 200..299) {
                        val contentLength = conn.contentLength.toLong()
                        val totalMb = if (contentLength > 0) String.format("%.1f", contentLength / (1024.0 * 1024.0)) else "?"

                        withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                            if (!isCancelled) {
                                progressBar.isIndeterminate = contentLength <= 0
                                if (contentLength > 0) {
                                    progressBar.max = 100
                                    progressBar.progress = 0
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        conn.inputStream.use { input ->
                            FileOutputStream(downloadFile).use { output ->
                                val buffer = ByteArray(32768)
                                var bytesRead: Int
                                var downloadedBytes = 0L

                                while (input.read(buffer).also { bytesRead = it } != -1) {
                                    if (isCancelled) break
                                    output.write(buffer, 0, bytesRead)
                                    downloadedBytes += bytesRead

                                    val curMb = String.format("%.1f", downloadedBytes / (1024.0 * 1024.0))
                                    val pct = if (contentLength > 0) ((downloadedBytes * 100) / contentLength).toInt() else 0

                                    withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                                        if (!isCancelled) {
                                            if (contentLength > 0) {
                                                progressBar.progress = pct
                                                tvStatus.text = "Descargando: $curMb MB / $totalMb MB ($pct%)"
                                            } else {
                                                tvStatus.text = "Descargando: $curMb MB descargados"
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        if (!isCancelled && downloadFile.length() > 0) {
                            downloadSuccess = true
                            break
                        }
                    }
                } catch (t: Throwable) {
                    errorMsg = t.message
                } finally {
                    conn?.disconnect()
                }
            }

            withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                if (progressDialog.isShowing) {
                    progressDialog.dismiss()
                }

                if (downloadSuccess && downloadFile.exists() && downloadFile.length() > 0) {
                    installApkFile(activity, downloadFile)
                    onCompleted?.invoke()
                } else if (!isCancelled) {
                    Toast.makeText(
                        activity,
                        "No se pudo descargar automáticamente: ${errorMsg ?: "Error de red"}.\nPuede colocar termex_v3008_arm64.apk en /sdcard/Download.",
                        Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                    ).show()
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package me.zhanghai.android.files.terminal

import android.annotation.SuppressLint
import android.content.Context
import android.content.res.ColorStateList
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.Typeface
import android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable
import android.graphics.drawable.LayerDrawable
import android.graphics.drawable.RippleDrawable
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.util.AttributeSet
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.HapticFeedbackConstants
import android.view.MotionEvent
import android.view.View
import android.widget.HorizontalScrollView
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.TextView

class TerminalExtraKeysView @JvmOverloads constructor(
    context: Context,
    attrs: AttributeSet? = null,
    defStyleAttr: Int = 0
) : LinearLayout(context, attrs, defStyleAttr) {

    var onKeyString: ((String) -> Unit)? = null
    var onOverflowMenuClick: ((View) -> Unit)? = null

    var isCtrlActive: Boolean = false
        private set
    var isAltActive: Boolean = false
        private set

    private var ctrlButton: TextView? = null
    private var altButton: TextView? = null
    private val repeatHandler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
    private var activeRepeatRunnable: Runnable? = null

    init {
        orientation = VERTICAL
        // Obsidian terminal bar with hairline top divider
        val topDivider = GradientDrawable().apply {
            shape = GradientDrawable.RECTANGLE
            setColor(Color.parseColor("#0F1217"))
            setStroke(dp(1), Color.parseColor("#21262D"))
        }
        background = topDivider
        setPadding(dp(4), dp(4), dp(4), dp(6))
        buildKeys()
    }

    private fun dp(v: Int): Int = (v * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()

    private fun buildKeys() {
        removeAllViews()

        // -------------------------------------------------------------
        // Row 0: Quick shell syntax chips & interrupt signals (Scrollable)
        // -------------------------------------------------------------
        val scrollSymbols = HorizontalScrollView(context).apply {
            isHorizontalScrollBarEnabled = false
            overScrollMode = OVER_SCROLL_NEVER
            layoutParams = LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(34)).apply {
                bottomMargin = dp(3)
            }
        }
        val row0 = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = HORIZONTAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
            layoutParams = LayoutParams(LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT)
        }
        val row0Keys = arrayOf(
            Pair("/", "/"),
            Pair("-", "-"),
            Pair("|", "|"),
            Pair("$", "$"),
            Pair("~", "~"),
            Pair("*", "*"),
            Pair("&", "&"),
            Pair(">", ">"),
            Pair("\"", "\""),
            Pair("'", "'"),
            Pair("Ctrl+C", "\u0003"),
            Pair("Ctrl+D", "\u0004"),
            Pair("Ctrl+Z", "\u001a"),
            Pair("Clear", "\u000c")
        )
        for ((label, action) in row0Keys) {
            val isCombo = label.length > 2
            val minW = if (isCombo) dp(60) else dp(38)
            val btn = createChipButton(label, action, minW)
            btn.setOnClickListener {
                performHapticFeedback(HapticFeedbackConstants.KEYBOARD_TAP)
                onKeyString?.invoke(action)
            }
            row0.addView(btn)
        }
        scrollSymbols.addView(row0)
        addView(scrollSymbols)

        // -------------------------------------------------------------
        // Row 1: Esc, Tab, PgUp, Home, ▲, End, ⋮
        // -------------------------------------------------------------
        val row1 = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = HORIZONTAL
            layoutParams = LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(38)).apply {
                bottomMargin = dp(3)
            }
        }

        val row1Keys = arrayOf(
            Pair("Esc", "\u001b"),
            Pair("Tab", "\t"),
            Pair("PgUp", "\u001b[5~"),
            Pair("Home", "\u001b[1~"),
            Pair("▲", "\u001b[A"),
            Pair("End", "\u001b[4~"),
            Pair("⋮", "MENU")
        )

        for ((label, action) in row1Keys) {
            val btn = createStandardKeycap(label)
            if (label == "▲") {
                attachRepeatableAction(btn, action)
            } else {
                btn.setOnClickListener {
                    performHapticFeedback(HapticFeedbackConstants.KEYBOARD_TAP)
                    if (action == "MENU") {
                        onOverflowMenuClick?.invoke(btn)
                    } else {
                        dispatchKeyAction(action)
                    }
                }
            }
            row1.addView(btn)
        }
        addView(row1)

        // -------------------------------------------------------------
        // Row 2: Ctrl, Alt, PgDn, ◀, ▼, ▶, ⌫
        // -------------------------------------------------------------
        val row2 = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = HORIZONTAL
            layoutParams = LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(38))
        }

        val row2Keys = arrayOf(
            Pair("Ctrl", "CTRL"),
            Pair("Alt", "ALT"),
            Pair("PgDn", "\u001b[6~"),
            Pair("◀", "\u001b[D"),
            Pair("▼", "\u001b[B"),
            Pair("▶", "\u001b[C"),
            Pair("⌫", "\u007f")
        )

        for ((label, action) in row2Keys) {
            val btn = createStandardKeycap(label)
            when (action) {
                "CTRL" -> {
                    ctrlButton = btn
                    updateModifierKeycap(btn, isCtrlActive)
                    btn.setOnClickListener {
                        performHapticFeedback(HapticFeedbackConstants.KEYBOARD_TAP)
                        isCtrlActive = !isCtrlActive
                        updateModifierStyles()
                    }
                }
                "ALT" -> {
                    altButton = btn
                    updateModifierKeycap(btn, isAltActive)
                    btn.setOnClickListener {
                        performHapticFeedback(HapticFeedbackConstants.KEYBOARD_TAP)
                        isAltActive = !isAltActive
                        updateModifierStyles()
                    }
                }
                "\u001b[D", "\u001b[B", "\u001b[C", "\u007f" -> {
                    attachRepeatableAction(btn, action)
                }
                else -> {
                    btn.setOnClickListener {
                        performHapticFeedback(HapticFeedbackConstants.KEYBOARD_TAP)
                        dispatchKeyAction(action)
                    }
                }
            }
            row2.addView(btn)
        }
        addView(row2)
    }

    private fun dispatchKeyAction(action: String) {
        if (isCtrlActive && action.length == 1) {
            val ch = action[0].uppercaseChar()
            if (ch in 'A'..'Z') {
                consumeCtrl()
                onKeyString?.invoke((ch.code - 64).toChar().toString())
                return
            }
        }
        if (isAltActive && action.length == 1) {
            consumeAlt()
            onKeyString?.invoke("\u001b$action")
            return
        }
        onKeyString?.invoke(action)
    }

    @SuppressLint("ClickableViewAccessibility")
    private fun attachRepeatableAction(btn: TextView, action: String) {
        btn.setOnTouchListener { v, event ->
            when (event.actionMasked) {
                MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> {
                    v.isPressed = true
                    performHapticFeedback(HapticFeedbackConstants.KEYBOARD_TAP)
                    dispatchKeyAction(action)
                    stopRepeating()
                    val runnable = object : Runnable {
                        override fun run() {
                            if (v.isPressed && v.isAttachedToWindow) {
                                performHapticFeedback(HapticFeedbackConstants.KEYBOARD_TAP)
                                dispatchKeyAction(action)
                                repeatHandler.postDelayed(this, 50L)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    activeRepeatRunnable = runnable
                    repeatHandler.postDelayed(runnable, 320L)
                    true
                }
                MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL -> {
                    v.isPressed = false
                    stopRepeating()
                    true
                }
                else -> false
            }
        }
    }

    private fun stopRepeating() {
        activeRepeatRunnable?.let { repeatHandler.removeCallbacks(it) }
        activeRepeatRunnable = null
    }

    override fun onDetachedFromWindow() {
        super.onDetachedFromWindow()
        stopRepeating()
    }

    /**
     * Builds a tactile, developer-grade keycap for rows 1 & 2
     */
    private fun createStandardKeycap(label: String): TextView {
        val tv = TextView(context)
        val lp = LayoutParams(0, LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 1f).apply {
            val m = dp(2)
            setMargins(m, 0, m, 0)
        }
        tv.layoutParams = lp
        tv.gravity = Gravity.CENTER
        tv.text = label
        tv.typeface = Typeface.MONOSPACE

        when (label) {
            "▲", "◀", "▼", "▶" -> {
                tv.textSize = 15f
                tv.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#F0F6FC"))
                tv.setTypeface(Typeface.MONOSPACE, Typeface.BOLD)
                applyKeycapStyle(tv, bgHex = "#282E38", strokeHex = "#3E4756")
            }
            "⌫" -> {
                tv.textSize = 14f
                tv.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#FFA657"))
                tv.setTypeface(Typeface.MONOSPACE, Typeface.BOLD)
                applyKeycapStyle(tv, bgHex = "#21262D", strokeHex = "#30363D")
            }
            "Ctrl", "Alt" -> {
                tv.textSize = 12.5f
                tv.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#58A6FF"))
                tv.setTypeface(Typeface.MONOSPACE, Typeface.BOLD)
                applyKeycapStyle(tv, bgHex = "#161B22", strokeHex = "#30363D")
            }
            "⋮" -> {
                tv.textSize = 15f
                tv.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#58A6FF"))
                tv.setTypeface(Typeface.MONOSPACE, Typeface.BOLD)
                applyKeycapStyle(tv, bgHex = "#21262D", strokeHex = "#30363D")
            }
            else -> {
                // Esc, Tab, Home, End, PgUp, PgDn
                tv.textSize = 12.5f
                tv.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#E6EDF3"))
                applyKeycapStyle(tv, bgHex = "#21262D", strokeHex = "#30363D")
            }
        }
        return tv
    }

    /**
     * Builds a sleek capsule chip for Row 0 with syntax-highlighted accents
     */
    private fun createChipButton(label: String, action: String, minWidthPx: Int): TextView {
        val tv = TextView(context)
        val lp = LayoutParams(LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT).apply {
            val m = dp(2)
            setMargins(m, 0, m, 0)
        }
        tv.layoutParams = lp
        tv.minWidth = minWidthPx
        tv.setPadding(dp(8), 0, dp(8), 0)
        tv.gravity = Gravity.CENTER
        tv.text = label
        tv.textSize = 12f
        tv.typeface = Typeface.MONOSPACE

        when (label) {
            "Ctrl+C" -> {
                tv.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#FF7B72"))
                tv.setTypeface(Typeface.MONOSPACE, Typeface.BOLD)
                applyKeycapStyle(tv, bgHex = "#3D1B1E", strokeHex = "#6E2228", radiusDp = 10)
            }
            "Ctrl+D" -> {
                tv.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#D2A8FF"))
                applyKeycapStyle(tv, bgHex = "#2A1B38", strokeHex = "#582B7D", radiusDp = 10)
            }
            "Ctrl+Z" -> {
                tv.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#FFA657"))
                applyKeycapStyle(tv, bgHex = "#332212", strokeHex = "#663B19", radiusDp = 10)
            }
            "Clear" -> {
                tv.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#79C0FF"))
                tv.setTypeface(Typeface.MONOSPACE, Typeface.BOLD)
                applyKeycapStyle(tv, bgHex = "#122738", strokeHex = "#1D4F75", radiusDp = 10)
            }
            "\"", "'" -> {
                tv.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#A5D6FF"))
                applyKeycapStyle(tv, bgHex = "#161B22", strokeHex = "#30363D", radiusDp = 10)
            }
            "$", "~" -> {
                tv.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#7EE787"))
                applyKeycapStyle(tv, bgHex = "#161B22", strokeHex = "#30363D", radiusDp = 10)
            }
            "|", ">", "&" -> {
                tv.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#FFA657"))
                applyKeycapStyle(tv, bgHex = "#161B22", strokeHex = "#30363D", radiusDp = 10)
            }
            "/", "-", "*" -> {
                tv.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#79C0FF"))
                applyKeycapStyle(tv, bgHex = "#161B22", strokeHex = "#30363D", radiusDp = 10)
            }
            else -> {
                tv.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#E6EDF3"))
                applyKeycapStyle(tv, bgHex = "#161B22", strokeHex = "#30363D", radiusDp = 10)
            }
        }
        return tv
    }

    private fun applyKeycapStyle(
        tv: TextView,
        bgHex: String,
        strokeHex: String,
        radiusDp: Int = 6,
        strokeWidthDp: Int = 1
    ) {
        val shape = GradientDrawable().apply {
            cornerRadius = dp(radiusDp).toFloat()
            setColor(Color.parseColor(bgHex))
            setStroke(dp(strokeWidthDp), Color.parseColor(strokeHex))
        }

        val ripple = RippleDrawable(
            ColorStateList.valueOf(Color.parseColor("#45FFFFFF")),
            shape,
            null
        )
        tv.background = ripple
    }

    private fun updateModifierKeycap(tv: TextView, isActive: Boolean) {
        if (isActive) {
            tv.setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            applyKeycapStyle(
                tv,
                bgHex = "#1F6FEB",
                strokeHex = "#58A6FF",
                radiusDp = 6,
                strokeWidthDp = 2
            )
        } else {
            tv.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#58A6FF"))
            applyKeycapStyle(
                tv,
                bgHex = "#161B22",
                strokeHex = "#30363D",
                radiusDp = 6,
                strokeWidthDp = 1
            )
        }
    }

    private fun updateModifierStyles() {
        ctrlButton?.let { updateModifierKeycap(it, isCtrlActive) }
        altButton?.let { updateModifierKeycap(it, isAltActive) }
    }

    fun consumeCtrl(): Boolean {
        val was = isCtrlActive
        if (was) {
            isCtrlActive = false
            updateModifierStyles()
        }
        return was
    }

    fun consumeAlt(): Boolean {
        val was = isAltActive
        if (was) {
            isAltActive = false
            updateModifierStyles()
        }
        return was
    }
}

package me.zhanghai.android.files.terminal

import android.app.Dialog
import android.graphics.Color
import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.View
import android.widget.EditText
import android.widget.FrameLayout
import android.widget.TextView
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.appcompat.widget.SwitchCompat
import androidx.fragment.app.DialogFragment
import com.google.android.material.dialog.MaterialAlertDialogBuilder
import me.zhanghai.android.files.R

class TerminalPreferencesDialog : DialogFragment() {

    var onSettingsChanged: (() -> Unit)? = null

    override fun onCreateDialog(savedInstanceState: Bundle?): Dialog {
        val ctx = requireContext()
        val builder = MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(ctx)
        builder.setTitle(R.string.terminal_pref_title)

        val container = LayoutInflater.from(ctx).inflate(
            R.layout.terminal_preferences_dialog,
            null,
            false
        )

        val textStartPathValue = container.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.textStartPathValue)
        val textFontSizeValue = container.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.textFontSizeValue)
        val textExpansionValue = container.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.textExpansionValue)
        val switchBlackTheme = container.findViewById<SwitchCompat>(R.id.switchBlackTheme)
        val switchRootSession = container.findViewById<SwitchCompat>(R.id.switchRootSession)

        // Init values
        textStartPathValue.text = TerminalSettings.getStartPath(ctx)
        textFontSizeValue.text = "${TerminalSettings.getFontSize(ctx)}sp"
        switchBlackTheme.isChecked = TerminalSettings.isKeepBlackTheme(ctx)
        switchRootSession.isChecked = TerminalSettings.isRootSession(ctx)

        fun updateExpansionStatus() {
            val isInstalled = TerminalExpansionManager.isTermexInstalled(ctx)
            if (isInstalled) {
                val ver = TerminalExpansionManager.getTermexVersion(ctx) ?: "v3.8 arm64"
                textExpansionValue.text = getString(R.string.terminal_pref_expansion_installed) + " ($ver)"
                textExpansionValue.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#4CAF50"))
            } else {
                textExpansionValue.text = getString(R.string.terminal_pref_expansion_not_installed)
                textExpansionValue.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#FF9800"))
            }
        }
        updateExpansionStatus()

        // Start path click
        container.findViewById<View>(R.id.layoutStartPath).setOnClickListener {
            val edit = EditText(ctx).apply {
                setText(TerminalSettings.getStartPath(ctx))
                setSelection(text.length)
            }
            val frame = FrameLayout(ctx).apply {
                val pad = (16 * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
                setPadding(pad, 0, pad, 0)
                addView(edit)
            }
            MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(ctx)
                .setTitle(R.string.terminal_pref_start_path)
                .setView(frame)
                .setPositiveButton(android.R.string.ok) { _, _ ->
                    val path = edit.text.toString().trim()
                    if (path.isNotEmpty()) {
                        TerminalSettings.setStartPath(ctx, path)
                        textStartPathValue.text = path
                        onSettingsChanged?.invoke()
                    }
                }
                .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
                .show()
        }

        // Font size click
        container.findViewById<View>(R.id.layoutFontSize).setOnClickListener {
            val sizes = arrayOf("11sp", "12sp", "13sp", "14sp", "15sp", "16sp", "18sp", "20sp", "24sp")
            val current = TerminalSettings.getFontSize(ctx)
            var selectedIdx = sizes.indexOfFirst { it.startsWith(current.toString()) }
            if (selectedIdx < 0) selectedIdx = 3

            MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(ctx)
                .setTitle(R.string.terminal_pref_font_size)
                .setSingleChoiceItems(sizes, selectedIdx) { dialog, which ->
                    val sizeVal = sizes[which].replace("sp", "").toIntOrNull() ?: 14
                    TerminalSettings.setFontSize(ctx, sizeVal)
                    textFontSizeValue.text = "${sizeVal}sp"
                    onSettingsChanged?.invoke()
                    dialog.dismiss()
                }
                .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
                .show()
        }

        // Black theme toggle
        switchBlackTheme.setOnCheckedChangeListener { _, isChecked ->
            TerminalSettings.setKeepBlackTheme(ctx, isChecked)
            onSettingsChanged?.invoke()
        }

        // Root session toggle
        switchRootSession.setOnCheckedChangeListener { buttonView, isChecked ->
            if (isChecked) {
                if (!TerminalExpansionManager.isRootAvailable()) {
                    buttonView.isChecked = false
                    Toast.makeText(ctx, R.string.terminal_pref_root_not_found, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                    return@setOnCheckedChangeListener
                }
            }
            TerminalSettings.setRootSession(ctx, isChecked)
            onSettingsChanged?.invoke()
        }

        // Expansion pack click: shows complete installer dialog if not installed
        container.findViewById<View>(R.id.layoutExpansion).setOnClickListener {
            if (!TerminalExpansionManager.isTermexInstalled(ctx)) {
                TerminalExpansionManager.showExpansionInstallerDialog(requireActivity()) {
                    updateExpansionStatus()
                    onSettingsChanged?.invoke()
                }
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(ctx, "Paquete de expansión ya instalado y activo", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }

        builder.setView(container)
        builder.setPositiveButton(android.R.string.ok, null)
        return builder.create()
    }
}

/*

 * All Rights Reserved.

package me.zhanghai.android.files.terminal

import android.content.Context
import android.os.Environment
import androidx.core.content.edit
import androidx.preference.PreferenceManager

object TerminalSettings {
    private const val PREF_START_PATH = "terminal_start_path"
    private const val PREF_FONT_SIZE = "terminal_font_size"
    private const val PREF_KEEP_BLACK_THEME = "terminal_keep_black_theme"
    private const val PREF_ROOT_SESSION = "terminal_root_session"

    const val MIN_FONT_SIZE_SP = 8
    const val MAX_FONT_SIZE_SP = 36
    const val DEFAULT_FONT_SIZE_SP = 14

    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
    private val DEFAULT_START_PATH: String
        get() = try {
            Environment.getExternalStorageDirectory().absolutePath
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            "/storage/emulated/0"
        }

    fun getStartPath(context: Context): String {
        val sp = PreferenceManager.getDefaultSharedPreferences(context)
        return sp.getString(PREF_START_PATH, null) ?: DEFAULT_START_PATH
    }

    fun setStartPath(context: Context, path: String) {
        PreferenceManager.getDefaultSharedPreferences(context).edit {
            putString(PREF_START_PATH, path)
        }
    }

    fun getFontSize(context: Context): Int {
        val sp = PreferenceManager.getDefaultSharedPreferences(context)
        val size = sp.getInt(PREF_FONT_SIZE, DEFAULT_FONT_SIZE_SP)
        return size.coerceIn(MIN_FONT_SIZE_SP, MAX_FONT_SIZE_SP)
    }

    fun setFontSize(context: Context, size: Int) {
        val clamped = size.coerceIn(MIN_FONT_SIZE_SP, MAX_FONT_SIZE_SP)
        PreferenceManager.getDefaultSharedPreferences(context).edit {
            putInt(PREF_FONT_SIZE, clamped)
        }
    }

    fun isKeepBlackTheme(context: Context): Boolean {
        val sp = PreferenceManager.getDefaultSharedPreferences(context)
        return sp.getBoolean(PREF_KEEP_BLACK_THEME, true)
    }

    fun setKeepBlackTheme(context: Context, keepBlack: Boolean) {
        PreferenceManager.getDefaultSharedPreferences(context).edit {
            putBoolean(PREF_KEEP_BLACK_THEME, keepBlack)
        }
    }

    fun isRootSession(context: Context): Boolean {
        val sp = PreferenceManager.getDefaultSharedPreferences(context)
        return sp.getBoolean(PREF_ROOT_SESSION, false)
    }

    fun setRootSession(context: Context, root: Boolean) {
        PreferenceManager.getDefaultSharedPreferences(context).edit {
            putBoolean(PREF_ROOT_SESSION, root)
        }
    }
}

package me.zhanghai.android.files.terminal.tracer

import android.app.Dialog
import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.Typeface
import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.View
import android.widget.Button
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.RadioButton
import android.widget.RadioGroup
import android.widget.TextView
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.appcompat.widget.SwitchCompat
import androidx.core.os.bundleOf
import androidx.fragment.app.DialogFragment
import androidx.fragment.app.FragmentActivity
import com.google.android.material.dialog.MaterialAlertDialogBuilder
import me.zhanghai.android.files.R
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat
import java.util.Date
import java.util.Locale

class BinaryTracerDialog : DialogFragment() {

    private var scriptPath: String? = null

    companion object {
        private const val ARG_SCRIPT_PATH = "arg_script_path"
        private const val TAG = "BinaryTracerDialog"

        fun newInstance(scriptPath: String?): BinaryTracerDialog {
            return BinaryTracerDialog().apply {
                arguments = bundleOf(ARG_SCRIPT_PATH to scriptPath)
            }
        }

        fun show(activity: FragmentActivity, scriptPath: String?) {
            newInstance(scriptPath).show(activity.supportFragmentManager, TAG)
        }
    }

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        scriptPath = arguments?.getString(ARG_SCRIPT_PATH)
    }

    override fun onCreateDialog(savedInstanceState: Bundle?): Dialog {
        val ctx = requireContext()
        val view = LayoutInflater.from(ctx).inflate(R.layout.dialog_binary_tracer, null, false)

        val tvScriptPath = view.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvTracerScriptPath)
        val switchTracer = view.findViewById<SwitchCompat>(R.id.switchTracerEnabled)
        val rgPolicy = view.findViewById<RadioGroup>(R.id.rgDeletionPolicy)
        val rbAsk = view.findViewById<RadioButton>(R.id.rbPolicyAsk)
        val rbBlock = view.findViewById<RadioButton>(R.id.rbPolicyBlock)
        val rbAllow = view.findViewById<RadioButton>(R.id.rbPolicyAllow)

        val tvMetricDeletions = view.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvMetricDeletions)
        val tvMetricSyscalls = view.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvMetricSyscalls)
        val tvMetricKernel = view.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvMetricKernel)
        val tvEmptyLog = view.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tvEmptyLog)
        val layoutEvents = view.findViewById<LinearLayout>(R.id.layoutTracerEvents)

        // Script Path Label
        tvScriptPath.text = if (!scriptPath.isNullOrEmpty()) scriptPath else "Terminal / Sesión interactiva"

        // Tracer Enabled Toggle
        val isEnabled = ScriptTracerPreferences.isTracerEnabled(ctx, scriptPath)
        switchTracer.isChecked = isEnabled
        switchTracer.setOnCheckedChangeListener { _, checked ->
            ScriptTracerPreferences.setTracerEnabled(ctx, scriptPath, checked)
            val msgRes = if (checked) R.string.tracer_enabled_permanent_toast else R.string.tracer_disabled_permanent_toast
            Toast.makeText(ctx, msgRes, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }

        // Deletion Policy Radio Group
        val currentPolicy = ScriptTracerPreferences.getDeletionPolicy(ctx, scriptPath)
        when (currentPolicy) {
            ScriptTracerPreferences.DeletionPolicy.ASK -> rbAsk.isChecked = true
            ScriptTracerPreferences.DeletionPolicy.BLOCK_ALL -> rbBlock.isChecked = true
            ScriptTracerPreferences.DeletionPolicy.ALLOW_ALL -> rbAllow.isChecked = true
        }

        rgPolicy.setOnCheckedChangeListener { _, checkedId ->
            val newPolicy = when (checkedId) {
                R.id.rbPolicyBlock -> ScriptTracerPreferences.DeletionPolicy.BLOCK_ALL
                R.id.rbPolicyAllow -> ScriptTracerPreferences.DeletionPolicy.ALLOW_ALL
                else -> ScriptTracerPreferences.DeletionPolicy.ASK
            }
            ScriptTracerPreferences.setDeletionPolicy(ctx, scriptPath, newPolicy)
        }

        fun refreshMetricsAndEvents() {
            val stats = BinaryTracerEngine.getStats()
            tvMetricDeletions.text = "${stats.totalDeletions} (${stats.blockedDeletions} bloq, ${stats.allowedDeletions} perm)"
            tvMetricSyscalls.text = "${stats.totalSyscalls}"
            tvMetricKernel.text = "${stats.totalKernelReads}"

            val events = BinaryTracerEngine.getEvents().reversed()
            layoutEvents.removeAllViews()

            if (events.isEmpty()) {
                tvEmptyLog.visibility = View.VISIBLE
                layoutEvents.visibility = View.GONE
            } else {
                tvEmptyLog.visibility = View.GONE
                layoutEvents.visibility = View.VISIBLE

                val timeFormat = SimpleDateFormat("HH:mm:ss", Locale.getDefault())
                val density = ctx.resources.displayMetrics.density

                for (event in events) {
                    val itemLayout = LinearLayout(ctx).apply {
                        orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
                        val pad = (8 * density).toInt()
                        setPadding(pad, pad, pad, pad)
                        setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#12FFFFFF"))
                        val params = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                            LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                            LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
                        ).apply {
                            bottomMargin = (6 * density).toInt()
                        }
                        layoutParams = params
                    }

                    // Top row: Tag badge + timestamp + decision
                    val topRow = LinearLayout(ctx).apply {
                        orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
                        gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
                    }

                    val badgeColor = when (event.type) {
                        TraceEventType.DELETION_ATTEMPT -> Color.parseColor("#FF5252") // Red
                        TraceEventType.SYSCALL_BURST -> Color.parseColor("#40C4FF")    // Cyan
                        TraceEventType.KERNEL_PROBE -> Color.parseColor("#69F0AE")     // Green
                        TraceEventType.SECURITY_AUDIT -> Color.parseColor("#FFD740")   // Amber
                        TraceEventType.PROCESS_SPAWN -> Color.parseColor("#B388FF")    // Purple
                    }

                    val tvBadge = TextView(ctx).apply {
                        text = event.type.name.replace("_", " ")
                        setTextColor(badgeColor)
                        textSize = 10f
                        typeface = Typeface.DEFAULT_BOLD
                        setPadding(0, 0, (8 * density).toInt(), 0)
                    }
                    topRow.addView(tvBadge)

                    val tvTime = TextView(ctx).apply {
                        text = timeFormat.format(Date(event.timestamp))
                        setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#80FFFFFF"))
                        textSize = 10f
                        layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1.0f)
                    }
                    topRow.addView(tvTime)

                    if (event.decision != null) {
                        val decisionText = when (event.decision) {
                            DeletionDecision.BLOCKED -> "[BLOQUEADO]"
                            DeletionDecision.ALLOWED -> "[PERMITIDO]"
                            DeletionDecision.PENDING -> "[PENDIENTE]"
                            null -> ""
                        }
                        val decisionColor = when (event.decision) {
                            DeletionDecision.BLOCKED -> Color.parseColor("#FF5252")
                            DeletionDecision.ALLOWED -> Color.parseColor("#69F0AE")
                            DeletionDecision.PENDING -> Color.parseColor("#FFD740")
                            null -> Color.WHITE
                        }
                        val tvDecision = TextView(ctx).apply {
                            text = decisionText
                            setTextColor(decisionColor)
                            textSize = 11f
                            typeface = Typeface.DEFAULT_BOLD
                        }
                        topRow.addView(tvDecision)
                    }

                    itemLayout.addView(topRow)

                    // Target / Summary line
                    val tvTarget = TextView(ctx).apply {
                        text = if (event.count > 1) "${event.target} (x${event.count})" else event.target
                        setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
                        textSize = 12f
                        typeface = Typeface.DEFAULT_BOLD
                        setPadding(0, (2 * density).toInt(), 0, 0)
                    }
                    itemLayout.addView(tvTarget)

                    // Details line
                    if (event.details.isNotEmpty()) {
                        val tvDetails = TextView(ctx).apply {
                            text = event.details
                            setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#B0BEC5"))
                            textSize = 11f
                            setPadding(0, (2 * density).toInt(), 0, 0)
                        }
                        itemLayout.addView(tvDetails)
                    }

                    layoutEvents.addView(itemLayout)
                }
            }
        }

        refreshMetricsAndEvents()

        val dialog = MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(ctx)
            .setTitle(R.string.tracer_title)
            .setView(view)
            .setNeutralButton(R.string.tracer_clear_log, null)
            .setPositiveButton(android.R.string.ok, null)
            .create()

        dialog.setOnShowListener {
            val btnClear = dialog.getButton(Dialog.BUTTON_NEUTRAL)
            btnClear?.setOnClickListener {
                BinaryTracerEngine.clear()
                refreshMetricsAndEvents()
                Toast.makeText(ctx, "Registro limpiado", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }

        return dialog
    }
}
