```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2023 Hai Zhang <dreaming.in.code.zh@gmail.com>
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.util

import android.util.TypedValue
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference
import kotlin.reflect.KClass

inline fun <T> KClass<TypedValue>.useTemp(block: (TypedValue) -> T): T {
    val temp = TypedValue::class.obtainTemp()
    return try {
        block(temp)
    } finally {
        temp.releaseTemp()
    }
}

private val tempTypedValue = AtomicReference(TypedValue())

fun KClass<TypedValue>.obtainTemp(): TypedValue = tempTypedValue.getAndSet(null) ?: TypedValue()

fun TypedValue.releaseTemp() {
    tempTypedValue.compareAndSet(null, this)
}
```

```kt
 * All Rights Reserved.
```

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.util

import android.annotation.SuppressLint
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.view.ViewTreeObserver
import android.view.inputmethod.InputMethodManager
import androidx.core.view.children
import androidx.core.view.isGone
import androidx.core.view.isInvisible
import androidx.core.view.isVisible
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.GlobalScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import me.zhanghai.android.files.app.inputMethodManager

fun View.doOnGlobalLayout(block: () -> Unit): OneShotGlobalLayoutListener =
    OneShotGlobalLayoutListener.add(this, block)

/** @see androidx.core.view.OneShotPreDrawListener */
class OneShotGlobalLayoutListener private constructor(
    private val view: View,
    private val block: () -> Unit
) : ViewTreeObserver.OnPreDrawListener, View.OnAttachStateChangeListener {
    private var viewTreeObserver = view.viewTreeObserver

    override fun onPreDraw(): Boolean {
        removeListener()
        block()
        return true
    }

    override fun onViewAttachedToWindow(view: View) {
        viewTreeObserver = view.viewTreeObserver
    }

    override fun onViewDetachedFromWindow(view: View) {
        removeListener()
    }

    fun removeListener() {
        if (viewTreeObserver.isAlive) {
            viewTreeObserver.removeOnPreDrawListener(this)
        } else {
            view.viewTreeObserver.removeOnPreDrawListener(this)
        }
        view.removeOnAttachStateChangeListener(this)
    }

    companion object {
        fun add(view: View, block: () -> Unit): OneShotGlobalLayoutListener =
            OneShotGlobalLayoutListener(view, block).also {
                view.viewTreeObserver.addOnPreDrawListener(it)
                view.addOnAttachStateChangeListener(it)
            }
    }
}

inline fun <reified T : View> View.findViewByClass(): T? = findViewByClass(T::class.java)

fun <T : View> View.findViewByClass(clazz: Class<T>): T? {
    if (clazz.isInstance(this)) {
        @Suppress("UNCHECKED_CAST")
        return this as T
    }
    if (this is ViewGroup) {
        children.forEach {
            it.findViewByClass(clazz)?.let { return it }
        }
    }
    return null
}

val View.isLayoutDirectionRtl: Boolean
    get() = layoutDirection == View.LAYOUT_DIRECTION_RTL

var View.layoutInStatusBar: Boolean
    get() = systemUiVisibility.hasBits(View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_FULLSCREEN)
    set(value) {
        systemUiVisibility = if (value) {
            systemUiVisibility or View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_FULLSCREEN or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_STABLE
        } else {
            systemUiVisibility andInv View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_FULLSCREEN
        }
    }

var View.layoutInNavigation: Boolean
    get() = systemUiVisibility.hasBits(View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_HIDE_NAVIGATION)
    set(value) {
        systemUiVisibility = if (value) {
            systemUiVisibility or View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_HIDE_NAVIGATION or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_STABLE
        } else {
            systemUiVisibility andInv View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_HIDE_NAVIGATION
        }
    }

suspend fun View.fadeIn(force: Boolean = false) {
    if (!isVisible) {
        alpha = 0f
        isVisible = true
    }
    animate().run {
        alpha(1f)
        if (!(isLaidOut || force) || (isVisible && alpha == 1f)) {
            duration = 0
        } else {
            duration = context.shortAnimTime.toLong()
            interpolator = context.getInterpolator(android.R.interpolator.fast_out_slow_in)
        }
        start()
        awaitEnd()
    }
}

fun View.fadeInUnsafe(force: Boolean = false) {
    GlobalScope.launch(Dispatchers.Main.immediate) { fadeIn(force) }
}

suspend fun View.fadeOut(force: Boolean = false, gone: Boolean = false) {
    animate().run {
        alpha(0f)
        if (!(isLaidOut || force) || (!isVisible || alpha == 0f)) {
            duration = 0
        } else {
            duration = context.shortAnimTime.toLong()
            interpolator = context.getInterpolator(android.R.interpolator.fast_out_linear_in)
        }
        start()
        awaitEnd()
    }
    if (gone) {
        isGone = true
    } else {
        isInvisible = true
    }
}

fun View.fadeOutUnsafe(force: Boolean = false, gone: Boolean = false) {
    GlobalScope.launch(Dispatchers.Main.immediate) { fadeOut(force, gone) }
}

suspend fun View.fadeToVisibility(visible: Boolean, force: Boolean = false, gone: Boolean = false) {
    if (visible) {
        fadeIn(force)
    } else {
        fadeOut(force, gone)
    }
}

fun View.fadeToVisibilityUnsafe(visible: Boolean, force: Boolean = false, gone: Boolean = false) {
    GlobalScope.launch(Dispatchers.Main.immediate) { fadeToVisibility(visible, force, gone) }
}

@SuppressLint("RtlHardcoded")
suspend fun View.slideIn(gravity: Int, force: Boolean = false) {
    isVisible = true
    animate().run {
        when (Gravity.getAbsoluteGravity(gravity, layoutDirection)) {
            Gravity.LEFT, Gravity.RIGHT -> translationX(0f)
            Gravity.TOP, Gravity.BOTTOM -> translationY(0f)
        }
        if (!(isLaidOut || force)) {
            duration = 0
        } else {
            duration = context.shortAnimTime.toLong()
            interpolator = context.getInterpolator(android.R.interpolator.fast_out_slow_in)
        }
        start()
        awaitEnd()
    }
}

suspend fun View.slideInUnsafe(gravity: Int, force: Boolean = false) {
    GlobalScope.launch(Dispatchers.Main.immediate) { slideIn(gravity, force) }
}

@SuppressLint("RtlHardcoded")
suspend fun View.slideOut(gravity: Int, force: Boolean = false, gone: Boolean = false) {
    animate().run {
        when (Gravity.getAbsoluteGravity(gravity, layoutDirection)) {
            Gravity.LEFT -> translationX((-right).toFloat())
            Gravity.RIGHT -> translationX(((parent as View).width - left).toFloat())
            Gravity.TOP -> translationY((-bottom).toFloat())
            Gravity.BOTTOM -> translationY(((parent as View).height - top).toFloat())
        }
        if (!(isLaidOut || force)) {
            duration = 0
        } else {
            duration = context.shortAnimTime.toLong()
            interpolator = context.getInterpolator(android.R.interpolator.fast_out_linear_in)
        }
        start()
        awaitEnd()
    }
    if (gone) {
        isGone = true
    } else {
        isInvisible = true
    }
}

fun View.slideOutUnsafe(gravity: Int, force: Boolean = false, gone: Boolean = false) {
    GlobalScope.launch(Dispatchers.Main.immediate) { slideOut(gravity, force, gone) }
}

suspend fun View.slideToVisibility(
    gravity: Int,
    visible: Boolean,
    force: Boolean = false,
    gone: Boolean = false
) {
    if (visible) {
        slideIn(gravity, force)
    } else {
        slideOut(gravity, force, gone)
    }
}

fun View.slideToVisibilityUnsafe(
    gravity: Int,
    visible: Boolean,
    force: Boolean = false,
    gone: Boolean = false
) {
    GlobalScope.launch(Dispatchers.Main.immediate) {
        slideToVisibility(gravity, visible, force, gone)
    }
}

fun View.showSoftInput() {
    inputMethodManager.showSoftInput(this, 0)
}

fun View.hideSoftInput() {
    inputMethodManager.hideSoftInputFromWindow(windowToken, InputMethodManager.HIDE_NOT_ALWAYS)
}
```

`app/src/main/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/util/WakeWifiLock.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2019 Hai Zhang <dreaming.in.code.zh@gmail.com>
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.util

import android.net.wifi.WifiManager
import android.os.PowerManager
import me.zhanghai.android.files.app.powerManager
import me.zhanghai.android.files.app.wifiManager

class WakeWifiLock(tag: String) {
    private val wakeLock = powerManager.newWakeLock(PowerManager.PARTIAL_WAKE_LOCK, tag)
        .apply { setReferenceCounted(false) }
    private val wifiLock =
        wifiManager.createWifiLock(WifiManager.WIFI_MODE_FULL_HIGH_PERF, tag)
            .apply { setReferenceCounted(false) }

    var isAcquired: Boolean = false
        set(value) {
            if (field == value) {
                return
            }
            if (value) {
                wakeLock.acquire()
                wifiLock.acquire()
            } else {
                wifiLock.release()
                wakeLock.release()
            }
            field = value
        }
}
```

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.viewer.arsc

import android.content.Context
import android.os.Bundle

import android.view.MenuItem
import android.view.View

class ArscEditorActivity : AppActivity() {

    private val displayedStrings = mutableListOf<ArscStringItem>()
    private lateinit var stringsAdapter: StringsAdapter

    private val displayedResources = mutableListOf<ArscResourceItem>()
    private lateinit var resourcesAdapter: ResourcesAdapter

    private val allPackages = mutableListOf<ArscPackageItem>()
    private val displayedPackages = mutableListOf<ArscPackageItem>()
    private lateinit var packagesAdapter: PackagesAdapter

    private var searchQuery = ""

    val isModified: Boolean
        get() = allStrings.any { it.isModified }

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityArscEditorBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        path = intent.extraPath ?: run {
            finish()
            return
        }

        setSupportActionBar(binding.toolbar)
        supportActionBar?.setDisplayHomeAsUpEnabled(true)
        binding.toolbar.setNavigationOnClickListener { handleBack() }
        binding.toolbar.title = path.fileName.toString()

        setupTabs()
        setupRecyclerViews()
        setupBackHandler()
        loadArsc()
    }

    private fun setupTabs() {
        binding.tabLayout.addTab(binding.tabLayout.newTab().setText(R.string.arsc_tab_strings))
        binding.tabLayout.addTab(binding.tabLayout.newTab().setText(R.string.arsc_tab_resources))
        binding.tabLayout.addTab(binding.tabLayout.newTab().setText(R.string.arsc_tab_packages))

        binding.tabLayout.addOnTabSelectedListener(object : TabLayout.OnTabSelectedListener {
            override fun onTabSelected(tab: TabLayout.Tab?) {
                activeTab = tab?.position ?: 0
                updateTabVisibility()
                filterContent()
            }
            override fun onTabUnselected(tab: TabLayout.Tab?) {}
            override fun onTabReselected(tab: TabLayout.Tab?) {}
        })
    }

    private fun updateTabVisibility() {
        binding.rvStrings.visibility = if (activeTab == 0) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
        binding.rvResources.visibility = if (activeTab == 1) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
        binding.rvPackages.visibility = if (activeTab == 2) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
    }

    private fun setupRecyclerViews() {
        stringsAdapter = StringsAdapter(displayedStrings) { item ->
            showEditStringDialog(item)
        }
        binding.rvStrings.layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(this)
        binding.rvStrings.adapter = stringsAdapter

        resourcesAdapter = ResourcesAdapter(displayedResources)
        binding.rvResources.layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(this)

    private fun setupBackHandler() {
        onBackPressedDispatcher.addCallback(this, object : OnBackPressedCallback(true) {
            override fun handleOnBackPressed() {
                handleBack()
            }
        })
    }

    private fun handleBack() {
        if (isModified) {
            MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(this)
                .setTitle(R.string.arsc_editor_title)
                .setMessage(R.string.arsc_unsaved_changes)
                .setPositiveButton(R.string.save) { _, _ ->
                    saveArsc { success ->
                        if (success) finish()
                    }
                }
                .setNegativeButton("Descartar") { _, _ ->
                    finish()
                }
                .setNeutralButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
                .show()
        } else {
            finish()
        }
    }

    private fun loadArsc() {
        binding.progressBar.visibility = View.VISIBLE
        binding.tvEmpty.visibility = View.GONE

        lifecycleScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            try {
                val bytes = path.newInputStream().use { input ->
                    val bos = ByteArrayOutputStream()
                    input.copyTo(bos)
                    bos.toByteArray()
                }
                originalBytes = bytes

                val model = ArscEngine.parse(bytes)

                withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                    allStrings.clear()
                    allStrings.addAll(model.strings)

                    allResources.clear()
                    allResources.addAll(model.resources)

                    allPackages.clear()
                    allPackages.addAll(model.packages)

                    binding.tabLayout.getTabAt(0)?.text = "${getString(R.string.arsc_tab_strings)} (${model.strings.size})"
                    binding.tabLayout.getTabAt(1)?.text = "${getString(R.string.arsc_tab_resources)} (${model.resources.size})"
                    binding.tabLayout.getTabAt(2)?.text = "${getString(R.string.arsc_tab_packages)} (${model.packages.size})"

                    val encodingStr = if (model.isUtf8) "UTF-8" else "UTF-16"
                    binding.toolbar.subtitle = "${model.strings.size} cadenas  •  $encodingStr  •  ${model.packages.size} paquetes"

                    binding.progressBar.visibility = View.GONE
                    filterContent()
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                e.printStackTrace()
                withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                    binding.progressBar.visibility = View.GONE
                    Toast.makeText(this@ArscEditorActivity, "Error al leer ARSC: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun filterContent() {
        val q = searchQuery.trim().lowercase()

        when (activeTab) {
            0 -> {
                displayedStrings.clear()
                if (q.isEmpty()) {
                    displayedStrings.addAll(allStrings)
                } else {
                    for (item in allStrings) {
                        if (item.value.lowercase().contains(q) || item.index.toString() == q) {
                            displayedStrings.add(item)
                        }
                    }
                }
                stringsAdapter.notifyDataSetChanged()
                binding.tvEmpty.visibility = if (displayedStrings.isEmpty()) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
            }
            1 -> {
                displayedResources.clear()
                if (q.isEmpty()) {
                    displayedResources.addAll(allResources)
                } else {
                    for (item in allResources) {
                        if (item.key.lowercase().contains(q) || item.type.lowercase().contains(q)) {
                            displayedResources.add(item)
                        }
                    }
                }
                resourcesAdapter.notifyDataSetChanged()
                binding.tvEmpty.visibility = if (displayedResources.isEmpty()) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
            }
            2 -> {
                displayedPackages.clear()
                if (q.isEmpty()) {
                    displayedPackages.addAll(allPackages)
                } else {
                    for (item in allPackages) {
                        if (item.name.lowercase().contains(q) || item.id.toString(16).contains(q)) {
                            displayedPackages.add(item)
                        }
                    }
                }
                packagesAdapter.notifyDataSetChanged()
                binding.tvEmpty.visibility = if (displayedPackages.isEmpty()) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
            }
        }
    }

    private fun showEditStringDialog(item: ArscStringItem) {
        val context = this
        val editText = EditText(context).apply {
            setText(item.value)
            setSelection(item.value.length)
            setPadding(40, 30, 40, 30)
            textSize = 14f
            setTextColor(android.graphics.Color.WHITE)
        }

        MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(context)
            .setTitle(getString(R.string.arsc_edit_dialog_title, item.index))
            .setView(editText)
            .setPositiveButton(R.string.save) { _, _ ->
                val newValue = editText.text.toString()
                if (newValue != item.value) {
                    item.value = newValue
                    stringsAdapter.notifyDataSetChanged()
                    invalidateOptionsMenu()
                    Snackbar.make(binding.root, "Cadena #${item.index} actualizada", Snackbar.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            }
            .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
            .show()
    }

    private fun saveArsc(onComplete: ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = null) {
        val bytes = originalBytes ?: run {
            Toast.makeText(this, "No hay datos para guardar", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            onComplete?.invoke(false)
            return
        }

        if (!isModified) {
            Toast.makeText(this, R.string.arsc_save_success, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            onComplete?.invoke(true)
            return
        }

        binding.progressBar.visibility = View.VISIBLE

        lifecycleScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            try {
                val newBytes = ArscEngine.rebuildWithModifiedStrings(bytes, allStrings.map { it.value })

                FileJobService.write(path, newBytes, this@ArscEditorActivity) { success ->
                    binding.progressBar.visibility = View.GONE
                    if (success) {
                        originalBytes = newBytes
                        for (item in allStrings) {
                            // Reset modified status
                            allStrings[item.index] = ArscStringItem(item.index, item.value, item.value)
                        }
                        filterContent()
                        invalidateOptionsMenu()
                        Toast.makeText(this@ArscEditorActivity, R.string.arsc_save_success, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                        onComplete?.invoke(true)
                    } else {
                        Toast.makeText(this@ArscEditorActivity, getString(R.string.arsc_save_failed, "I/O error"), Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                        onComplete?.invoke(false)
                    }
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                e.printStackTrace()
                withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                    binding.progressBar.visibility = View.GONE
                    Toast.makeText(this@ArscEditorActivity, getString(R.string.arsc_save_failed, e.message), Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                    onComplete?.invoke(false)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    override fun onCreateOptionsMenu(menu: Menu): Boolean {
        menuInflater.inflate(R.menu.arsc_editor_menu, menu)

                return true
            }

                searchQuery = newText ?: ""
                filterContent()
                return true

        return true
    }

    }
```

`app/src/main/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/viewer/arsc/ArscEngine.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.viewer.arsc

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.nio.ByteBuffer
import java.nio.ByteOrder
import java.nio.charset.Charset
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets

data class ArscStringItem(
    val index: Int,
    var value: String,
    val originalValue: String = value
) {
    val isModified: Boolean get() = value != originalValue
}

data class ArscPackageItem(
    val id: Int,
    val name: String
)

data class ArscResourceItem(
    val type: String,
    val key: String
)

data class ArscModel(
    val strings: List<ArscStringItem>,
    val packages: List<ArscPackageItem>,
    val resources: List<ArscResourceItem>,
    val isUtf8: Boolean,
    val stringPoolOffset: Int,
    val stringPoolSize: Int
)

object ArscEngine {

    const val RES_STRING_POOL_TYPE: Short = 0x0001
    const val RES_TABLE_TYPE: Short = 0x0002
    const val RES_TABLE_PACKAGE_TYPE: Short = 0x0200
    const val UTF8_FLAG: Int = 0x0100

    fun parse(bytes: ByteArray): ArscModel {
        if (bytes.size < 12) {
            throw IllegalArgumentException("El archivo es demasiado pequeño para ser un archivo ARSC válido.")
        }

        val bb = ByteBuffer.wrap(bytes).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
        val type = bb.short
        val headerSize = bb.short
        val tableSize = bb.int

        if (type != RES_TABLE_TYPE) {
            throw IllegalArgumentException("Cabecera ARSC inválida (tipo: 0x${type.toString(16)})")
        }

        // Global String Pool
        val poolOffset = headerSize.toInt()
        bb.position(poolOffset)

        val poolType = bb.short
        val poolHeaderSize = bb.short
        val poolSize = bb.int
        val stringCount = bb.int
        val styleCount = bb.int
        val flags = bb.int
        val stringsStart = bb.int
        val stylesStart = bb.int

        if (poolType != RES_STRING_POOL_TYPE) {
            throw IllegalArgumentException("StringPool inválido en ARSC (tipo: 0x${poolType.toString(16)})")
        }

        val isUtf8 = (flags and UTF8_FLAG) != 0
        val stringsList = mutableListOf<ArscStringItem>()

        val stringOffsets = IntArray(stringCount)
        for (i in 0 until stringCount) {
            stringOffsets[i] = bb.int
        }

        val stringsAbsoluteBase = poolOffset + stringsStart

        for (i in 0 until stringCount) {
            val strPos = stringsAbsoluteBase + stringOffsets[i]
            if (strPos in 0 until bytes.size) {
                val str = if (isUtf8) {
                    readUtf8String(bytes, strPos)
                } else {
                    readUtf16String(bytes, strPos)
                }
                stringsList.add(ArscStringItem(i, str))
            } else {
                stringsList.add(ArscStringItem(i, ""))
            }
        }

        // Parse Packages
        val packagesList = mutableListOf<ArscPackageItem>()
        val resourcesList = mutableListOf<ArscResourceItem>()

        var currentOffset = poolOffset + poolSize
        while (currentOffset + 8 <= bytes.size) {
            bb.position(currentOffset)
            val chunkType = bb.short
            val chunkHeaderSize = bb.short
            val chunkSize = bb.int

            if (chunkSize <= 0 || currentOffset + chunkSize > bytes.size) break

            if (chunkType == RES_TABLE_PACKAGE_TYPE && chunkHeaderSize >= 288) {
                val pkgId = bb.int
                val nameChars = CharArray(128)
                for (j in 0 until 128) {
                    nameChars[j] = bb.char
                }
                val pkgName = String(nameChars).trimEnd('\u0000')
                packagesList.add(ArscPackageItem(pkgId, pkgName))

                // Parse Type & Key String pools inside package
                val typeStringsOff = bb.int
                val lastPublicType = bb.int
                val keyStringsOff = bb.int

                if (keyStringsOff > 0 && currentOffset + keyStringsOff + 28 <= bytes.size) {
                    try {
                        val keyPoolPos = currentOffset + keyStringsOff
                        bb.position(keyPoolPos)
                        val kType = bb.short
                        val kHdrSize = bb.short
                        val kSize = bb.int
                        val kCount = bb.int
                        val kStyleCount = bb.int
                        val kFlags = bb.int
                        val kStringsStart = bb.int

                        if (kType == RES_STRING_POOL_TYPE && kCount in 1..20000) {
                            val kUtf8 = (kFlags and UTF8_FLAG) != 0
                            val kOffsets = IntArray(kCount)
                            for (k in 0 until kCount) {
                                kOffsets[k] = bb.int
                            }
                            val kBase = keyPoolPos + kStringsStart
                            for (k in 0 until kCount) {
                                val entryPos = kBase + kOffsets[k]
                                if (entryPos in 0 until bytes.size) {
                                    val keyStr = if (kUtf8) {
                                        readUtf8String(bytes, entryPos)
                                    } else {
                                        readUtf16String(bytes, entryPos)
                                    }
                                    if (keyStr.isNotEmpty()) {
                                        resourcesList.add(ArscResourceItem("resource", keyStr))
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    } catch (ignored: Exception) {}
                }
            }

            currentOffset += chunkSize
        }

        return ArscModel(
            strings = stringsList,
            packages = packagesList,
            resources = resourcesList,
            isUtf8 = isUtf8,
            stringPoolOffset = poolOffset,
            stringPoolSize = poolSize
        )
    }

    private fun readUtf8String(bytes: ByteArray, offset: Int): String {
        var pos = offset
        if (pos >= bytes.size) return ""

        // Skip UTF-16 length ULEB
        var charLen = bytes[pos].toInt() and 0xFF
        if ((charLen and 0x80) != 0) {
            pos++
            if (pos >= bytes.size) return ""
            charLen = ((charLen and 0x7F) shl 8) or (bytes[pos].toInt() and 0xFF)
        }
        pos++
        if (pos >= bytes.size) return ""

        // Read UTF-8 byte length ULEB
        var byteLen = bytes[pos].toInt() and 0xFF
        if ((byteLen and 0x80) != 0) {
            pos++
            if (pos >= bytes.size) return ""
            byteLen = ((byteLen and 0x7F) shl 8) or (bytes[pos].toInt() and 0xFF)
        }
        pos++

        if (pos + byteLen > bytes.size) {
            byteLen = (bytes.size - pos).coerceAtLeast(0)
        }

        return String(bytes, pos, byteLen, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
    }

    private fun readUtf16String(bytes: ByteArray, offset: Int): String {
        var pos = offset
        if (pos + 2 > bytes.size) return ""

        val b0 = bytes[pos].toInt() and 0xFF
        val b1 = bytes[pos + 1].toInt() and 0xFF
        var len = b0 or (b1 shl 8)
        pos += 2

        if ((len and 0x8000) != 0) {
            if (pos + 2 > bytes.size) return ""
            val b2 = bytes[pos].toInt() and 0xFF
            val b3 = bytes[pos + 1].toInt() and 0xFF
            val high = b2 or (b3 shl 8)
            len = ((len and 0x7FFF) shl 16) or high
            pos += 2
        }

        val byteLen = len * 2
        if (pos + byteLen > bytes.size) {
            return ""
        }

        return String(bytes, pos, byteLen, StandardCharsets.UTF_16LE)
    }

    fun rebuildWithModifiedStrings(originalBytes: ByteArray, modifiedStrings: List<String>): ByteArray {
        val model = parse(originalBytes)
        val poolOffset = model.stringPoolOffset
        val oldPoolSize = model.stringPoolSize

        val newPoolBytes = buildStringPool(modifiedStrings, useUtf8 = true)
        val newPoolSize = newPoolBytes.size

        val sizeDiff = newPoolSize - oldPoolSize
        val newTotalSize = originalBytes.size + sizeDiff

        val result = ByteArray(newTotalSize)

        // 1. Copy table header (0 until poolOffset)
        System.arraycopy(originalBytes, 0, result, 0, poolOffset)

        // 2. Copy new string pool
        System.arraycopy(newPoolBytes, 0, result, poolOffset, newPoolSize)

        // 3. Copy remainder of original file (after old string pool)
        val restOffset = poolOffset + oldPoolSize
        val restLen = originalBytes.size - restOffset
        if (restLen > 0) {
            System.arraycopy(originalBytes, restOffset, result, poolOffset + newPoolSize, restLen)
        }

        // 4. Update root table total size at offset 4
        val bb = ByteBuffer.wrap(result).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
        bb.putInt(4, newTotalSize)

        return result
    }

    private fun buildStringPool(strings: List<String>, useUtf8: Boolean): ByteArray {
        val stringCount = strings.size
        val headerSize = 28
        val offsetsSize = stringCount * 4
        val stringsStart = headerSize + offsetsSize

        val stringDataStream = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        val offsets = IntArray(stringCount)

        for (i in 0 until stringCount) {
            offsets[i] = stringDataStream.size()
            val str = strings[i]
            if (useUtf8) {
                val utf8Bytes = str.toByteArray(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
                val charLen = str.length
                val byteLen = utf8Bytes.size

                writeUleb128(stringDataStream, charLen)
                writeUleb128(stringDataStream, byteLen)
                stringDataStream.write(utf8Bytes)
                stringDataStream.write(0) // Null terminator
            } else {
                val utf16Bytes = str.toByteArray(StandardCharsets.UTF_16LE)
                val charLen = str.length

                if (charLen <= 0x7FFF) {
                    stringDataStream.write(charLen and 0xFF)
                    stringDataStream.write((charLen shr 8) and 0xFF)
                } else {
                    val high = ((charLen shr 16) and 0x7FFF) or 0x8000
                    val low = charLen and 0xFFFF
                    stringDataStream.write(high and 0xFF)
                    stringDataStream.write((high shr 8) and 0xFF)
                    stringDataStream.write(low and 0xFF)
                    stringDataStream.write((low shr 8) and 0xFF)
                }
                stringDataStream.write(utf16Bytes)
                stringDataStream.write(0)
                stringDataStream.write(0) // 2-byte null terminator
            }
        }

        val rawStringData = stringDataStream.toByteArray()
        // Pad strings to 4 bytes boundary
        val pad = (4 - (rawStringData.size % 4)) % 4
        val paddedStringDataSize = rawStringData.size + pad

        val totalChunkSize = stringsStart + paddedStringDataSize

        val bb = ByteBuffer.allocate(totalChunkSize).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
        bb.putShort(RES_STRING_POOL_TYPE)
        bb.putShort(headerSize.toShort())
        bb.putInt(totalChunkSize)
        bb.putInt(stringCount)
        bb.putInt(0) // styleCount
        bb.putInt(if (useUtf8) UTF8_FLAG else 0)
        bb.putInt(stringsStart)
        bb.putInt(0) // stylesStart

        for (off in offsets) {
            bb.putInt(off)
        }

        bb.put(rawStringData)
        for (p in 0 until pad) {
            bb.put(0.toByte())
        }

        return bb.array()
    }

    private fun writeUleb128(os: ByteArrayOutputStream, value: Int) {
        if (value <= 0x7F) {
            os.write(value)
        } else {
            val b0 = ((value shr 8) and 0x7F) or 0x80
            val b1 = value and 0xFF
            os.write(b0)
            os.write(b1)
        }
    }
}
```

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.viewer.audio

import android.app.Dialog
import android.content.DialogInterface
import android.content.res.ColorStateList
import android.graphics.Color
import android.media.MediaPlayer
import android.media.PlaybackParams
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Bundle
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.View
import android.widget.FrameLayout
import android.widget.ImageButton
import android.widget.ImageView
import android.widget.SeekBar
import android.widget.TextView
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatDialogFragment
import androidx.fragment.app.FragmentManager
import com.google.android.material.dialog.MaterialAlertDialogBuilder
import java8.nio.file.Path
import kotlinx.parcelize.Parcelize
import kotlinx.parcelize.WriteWith
import me.zhanghai.android.files.R
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.common.newInputStream
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.linux.isLinuxPath
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.ParcelableArgs
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.ParcelableParceler

import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.putArgs
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.show
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileOutputStream
import java.util.Locale

class AudioPlayerDialogFragment : AppCompatDialogFragment() {
    private val args by args<Args>()

    private var mediaPlayer: MediaPlayer? = null
    private var tempFile: File? = null
    private var isPlaying = false
    private var isLooping = false
    private var speedIndex = 0
    private val speeds = floatArrayOf(1.0f, 1.25f, 1.5f, 2.0f, 0.75f)

    private val handler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
    private var isUserTracking = false

    private lateinit var tvTitle: TextView
    private lateinit var tvSubtitle: TextView
    private lateinit var tvElapsed: TextView
    private lateinit var tvDuration: TextView
    private lateinit var seekBar: SeekBar
    private lateinit var ivPlayPause: ImageView
    private lateinit var btnLoop: ImageButton
    private lateinit var btnSpeed: TextView

    private val progressRunnable = object : Runnable {
        override fun run() {
            mediaPlayer?.let { player ->
                try {
                    if (player.isPlaying && !isUserTracking) {
                        val current = player.currentPosition
                        seekBar.progress = current
                        tvElapsed.text = formatTime(current)
                    }
                    handler.postDelayed(this, 250)
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    // Ignore if player is released or transitioning
                }
            }
        }
    }

    override fun onCreateDialog(savedInstanceState: Bundle?): Dialog {
        val context = requireContext()
        val view = LayoutInflater.from(context).inflate(R.layout.dialog_audio_player, null)

        tvTitle = view.findViewById(R.id.tvAudioTitle)
        tvSubtitle = view.findViewById(R.id.tvAudioSubtitle)
        tvElapsed = view.findViewById(R.id.tvAudioElapsed)
        tvDuration = view.findViewById(R.id.tvAudioDuration)
        seekBar = view.findViewById(R.id.seekBarAudio)
        ivPlayPause = view.findViewById(R.id.ivAudioPlayPause)
        btnLoop = view.findViewById(R.id.btnAudioLoop)
        btnSpeed = view.findViewById(R.id.btnAudioSpeed)

        val btnClose = view.findViewById<ImageButton>(R.id.btnAudioClose)
        val btnRewind = view.findViewById<ImageButton>(R.id.btnAudioRewind)
        val btnForward = view.findViewById<ImageButton>(R.id.btnAudioForward)
        val btnPlayPause = view.findViewById<FrameLayout>(R.id.btnAudioPlayPause)

        val fileName = args.path.fileName.toString()
        tvTitle.text = fileName
        tvTitle.isSelected = true
        val ext = fileName.substringAfterLast('.', "AUDIO").uppercase(Locale.ROOT)
        tvSubtitle.text = "$ext Audio Player"

        btnClose.setOnClickListener { dismiss() }

        btnPlayPause.setOnClickListener {
            togglePlayPause()
        }

        btnRewind.setOnClickListener {
            mediaPlayer?.let { player ->
                try {
                    val newPos = (player.currentPosition - 10000).coerceAtLeast(0)
                    player.seekTo(newPos)
                    seekBar.progress = newPos
                    tvElapsed.text = formatTime(newPos)
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    // Ignore state errors
                }
            }
        }

        btnForward.setOnClickListener {
            mediaPlayer?.let { player ->
                try {
                    val newPos = (player.currentPosition + 10000).coerceAtMost(player.duration)
                    player.seekTo(newPos)
                    seekBar.progress = newPos
                    tvElapsed.text = formatTime(newPos)
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    // Ignore state errors
                }
            }
        }

        btnLoop.setOnClickListener {
            isLooping = !isLooping
            mediaPlayer?.isLooping = isLooping
            val tint = if (isLooping) Color.parseColor("#2196F3") else Color.parseColor("#666666")
            btnLoop.imageTintList = ColorStateList.valueOf(tint)
        }

        btnSpeed.setOnClickListener {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.M) {
                speedIndex = (speedIndex + 1) % speeds.size
                val speed = speeds[speedIndex]
                btnSpeed.text = "${speed}x"
                mediaPlayer?.let { player ->
                    try {
                        val params = player.playbackParams
                        params.speed = speed
                        player.playbackParams = params
                    } catch (e: Exception) {
                        e.printStackTrace()
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        seekBar.setOnSeekBarChangeListener(object : SeekBar.OnSeekBarChangeListener {
            override fun onProgressChanged(sb: SeekBar?, progress: Int, fromUser: Boolean) {
                if (fromUser) {
                    tvElapsed.text = formatTime(progress)
                }
            }

            override fun onStartTrackingTouch(sb: SeekBar?) {
                isUserTracking = true
            }

            override fun onStopTrackingTouch(sb: SeekBar?) {
                isUserTracking = false
                sb?.let {
                    mediaPlayer?.seekTo(it.progress)
                }
            }
        })

        initMediaPlayer()

        return MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(context)
            .setView(view)
            .create()
    }

    private fun initMediaPlayer() {
        val path = args.path
        val context = requireContext()
        val player = MediaPlayer()
        mediaPlayer = player

        try {
            val audioFile: File
            if (path.isLinuxPath) {
                audioFile = path.toFile()
            } else {
                val temp = File(context.cacheDir, "audio_preview_${System.currentTimeMillis()}.${path.fileName.toString().substringAfterLast('.', "tmp")}")
                path.newInputStream().use { input ->
                    FileOutputStream(temp).use { output ->
                        input.copyTo(output)
                    }
                }
                tempFile = temp
                audioFile = temp
            }

            player.setDataSource(audioFile.absolutePath)
            player.setOnPreparedListener { mp ->
                val duration = mp.duration
                seekBar.max = duration
                tvDuration.text = formatTime(duration)
                mp.start()
                isPlaying = true
                ivPlayPause.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_pause_24dp)
                handler.post(progressRunnable)
            }
            player.setOnCompletionListener {
                if (!isLooping) {
                    isPlaying = false
                    ivPlayPause.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_play_arrow_24dp)
                    seekBar.progress = 0
                    tvElapsed.text = formatTime(0)
                }
            }
            player.setOnErrorListener { _, what, extra ->
                Toast.makeText(context, "Error al reproducir audio ($what, $extra)", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                dismissAllowingStateLoss()
                true
            }
            player.prepareAsync()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
            Toast.makeText(context, "No se pudo abrir el audio: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            dismissAllowingStateLoss()
        }
    }

    private fun togglePlayPause() {
        mediaPlayer?.let { player ->
            try {
                if (player.isPlaying) {
                    player.pause()
                    isPlaying = false
                    ivPlayPause.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_play_arrow_24dp)
                } else {
                    player.start()
                    isPlaying = true
                    ivPlayPause.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_pause_24dp)
                    handler.post(progressRunnable)
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                // Ignore state errors if media is releasing
            }
        }
    }

    private fun formatTime(millis: Int): String {
        val totalSec = millis / 1000
        val min = totalSec / 60
        val sec = totalSec % 60
        return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%02d:%02d", min, sec)
    }

    override fun onDismiss(dialog: DialogInterface) {
        super.onDismiss(dialog)
        releasePlayer()
        if (activity is AudioPlayerActivity) {
            activity?.finish()
        }
    }

    override fun onCancel(dialog: DialogInterface) {
        super.onCancel(dialog)
        releasePlayer()
        if (activity is AudioPlayerActivity) {
            activity?.finish()
        }
    }

    override fun onDestroy() {
        super.onDestroy()
        releasePlayer()
    }

    private fun releasePlayer() {
        handler.removeCallbacksAndMessages(null)
        try {
            mediaPlayer?.let { player ->
                if (player.isPlaying) {
                    player.stop()
                }
                player.release()
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
        }
        mediaPlayer = null
        tempFile?.delete()
        tempFile = null
    }

    companion object {
        fun show(path: Path, fragmentManager: FragmentManager) {
            AudioPlayerDialogFragment().putArgs(Args(path)).show(fragmentManager, null)
        }
    }

    @Parcelize
    class Args(val path: @WriteWith<ParcelableParceler> Path) : ParcelableArgs
}
```

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.viewer.binary

import android.app.Dialog

import java8.nio.file.Path
import kotlinx.parcelize.Parcelize
import kotlinx.parcelize.WriteWith
import me.zhanghai.android.files.R
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.common.newInputStream
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.ParcelableArgs

import java.nio.ByteOrder

// DEX Info Dialog
class DexInfoDialogFragment : AppCompatDialogFragment() {
    private val args by args<Args>()

    override fun onCreateDialog(savedInstanceState: Bundle?): Dialog {
        val context = requireContext()
        val path = args.path
        val fileName = path.fileName.toString()

        var version = "DEX"
        var fileSize = 0
        var classCount = 0
        var methodCount = 0
        var fieldCount = 0
        var stringCount = 0

        try {
            path.newInputStream().use { input ->
                val header = ByteArray(112)
                val read = input.read(header)
                if (read >= 112 && header[0] == 0x64.toByte() && header[1] == 0x65.toByte() && header[2] == 0x78.toByte()) {
                    version = "DEX " + String(header, 4, 3)
                    val bb = ByteBuffer.wrap(header).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
                    fileSize = bb.getInt(32)
                    stringCount = bb.getInt(56)
                    fieldCount = bb.getInt(80)
                    methodCount = bb.getInt(88)
                    classCount = bb.getInt(96)
                }
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
        }

        val message = StringBuilder().apply {
            append("• Formato: $version\n")
            append("• Clases definidas: $classCount\n")
            append("• Métodos: $methodCount\n")
            append("• Campos: $fieldCount\n")
            append("• Cadenas de texto: $stringCount\n")
        }.toString()

        return MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(context)
            .setIcon(R.drawable.file_dex_icon)
            .setTitle(fileName)
            .setMessage(message)
            .setNeutralButton("Ver cadenas") { _, _ ->
                extractAndShowDexStrings(path)
            }
            .setNegativeButton("Abrir como texto") { _, _ ->
                val intent = Intent(context, TextEditorActivity::class.java).apply {
                    extraPath = path
                }
                context.startActivity(intent)
            }
            .setPositiveButton("Cerrar", null)
            .create()
    }

    private fun extractAndShowDexStrings(path: Path) {
        val context = requireContext()
        try {
            val strings = mutableListOf<String>()
            path.newInputStream().use { input ->
                val bytes = input.readBytes()
                if (bytes.size >= 112) {
                    val bb = ByteBuffer.wrap(bytes).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
                    val stringCount = bb.getInt(56)
                    val stringIdsOff = bb.getInt(60)

                    for (i in 0 until stringCount.coerceAtMost(5000)) {
                        val off = bb.getInt(stringIdsOff + i * 4)
                        if (off in 0 until bytes.size) {
                            // Skip ULEB128 length
                            var pos = off
                            while (pos < bytes.size && (bytes[pos].toInt() and 0x80) != 0) {
                                pos++
                            }
                            pos++ // past length byte
                            val sb = StringBuilder()
                            while (pos < bytes.size && bytes[pos].toInt() != 0) {
                                val c = bytes[pos].toInt().toChar()
                                if (c in ' '..'~' || c == '\n' || c == '\t') {
                                    sb.append(c)
                                }
                                pos++
                            }
                            if (sb.isNotEmpty()) {
                                strings.add(sb.toString())
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            val temp = File(context.cacheDir, "${path.fileName}_strings.txt")
            temp.writeText(strings.joinToString("\n"))
            val intent = Intent(context, TextEditorActivity::class.java).apply {
                extraPath = java8.nio.file.Paths.get(temp.absolutePath)
            }
            context.startActivity(intent)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
            Toast.makeText(context, "Error al extraer cadenas: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }

    companion object {
        fun show(path: Path, fragmentManager: FragmentManager) {
            DexInfoDialogFragment().putArgs(Args(path)).show(fragmentManager, null)
        }
    }

    @Parcelize
    class Args(val path: @WriteWith<ParcelableParceler> Path) : ParcelableArgs
}

            e.printStackTrace()

            .setIcon(R.drawable.file_arsc_icon)

// ELF / SO Info Dialog
class ElfInfoDialogFragment : AppCompatDialogFragment() {
    private val args by args<Args>()

    override fun onCreateDialog(savedInstanceState: Bundle?): Dialog {
        val context = requireContext()
        val path = args.path
        val fileName = path.fileName.toString()

        var arch = "Desconocida"
        var bitClass = ""
        var endian = ""
        val neededLibs = mutableListOf<String>()

        try {
            path.newInputStream().use { input ->
                val header = ByteArray(64)
                val read = input.read(header)
                if (read >= 20 && header[0] == 0x7F.toByte() && header[1] == 'E'.code.toByte() && header[2] == 'L'.code.toByte() && header[3] == 'F'.code.toByte()) {
                    bitClass = if (header[4] == 2.toByte()) "64-bit" else "32-bit"
                    endian = if (header[5] == 1.toByte()) "Little Endian" else "Big Endian"
                    val bb = ByteBuffer.wrap(header).order(if (header[5] == 1.toByte()) ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN else ByteOrder.BIG_ENDIAN)
                    val machine = bb.getShort(18).toInt() and 0xFFFF
                    arch = when (machine) {
                        0x28 -> "ARM (armeabi-v7a)"
                        0xB7 -> "AArch64 (arm64-v8a)"
                        0x03 -> "x86 (i386)"
                        0x3E -> "x86_64 (amd64)"
                        0xF3 -> "RISC-V"
                        else -> "Código $machine"
                    }
                }
            }

            // Quick scan first 32KB for dependencies like libc.so, etc.
            path.newInputStream().use { input ->
                val sample = ByteArray(32768)
                val len = input.read(sample)
                if (len > 0) {
                    val text = String(sample, 0, len, Charsets.ISO_8859_1)
                    val matches = Regex("""[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.]+\.so""").findAll(text)
                    for (m in matches) {
                        val lib = m.value
                        if (lib != fileName && !neededLibs.contains(lib)) {
                            neededLibs.add(lib)
                            if (neededLibs.size >= 8) break
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
        }

        val message = StringBuilder().apply {
            append("• Arquitectura: $arch ($bitClass)\n")
            append("• Formato: ELF binario nativo ($endian)\n")
            if (neededLibs.isNotEmpty()) {
                append("• Dependencias detectadas:\n  - ")
                append(neededLibs.joinToString("\n  - "))
                append("\n")
            }
        }.toString()

        return MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(context)
            .setIcon(R.drawable.file_so_icon)
            .setTitle(fileName)
            .setMessage(message)
            .setNegativeButton("Abrir como texto") { _, _ ->
                val intent = Intent(context, TextEditorActivity::class.java).apply {
                    extraPath = path
                }
                context.startActivity(intent)
            }
            .setPositiveButton("Cerrar", null)
            .create()
    }

    companion object {
        fun show(path: Path, fragmentManager: FragmentManager) {
            ElfInfoDialogFragment().putArgs(Args(path)).show(fragmentManager, null)
        }
    }

    @Parcelize
    class Args(val path: @WriteWith<ParcelableParceler> Path) : ParcelableArgs
}
```

```kt
class DexActionDialogFragment : AppCompatDialogFragment() {

    private val args by args<Args>()

    override fun onCreateDialog(savedInstanceState: Bundle?): Dialog {
        val path = args.path
        val fileName = path.fileName.toString()
        val binding = DialogDexOpenChoiceBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)

        binding.dexFileName.text = fileName

        var version = "DEX"
        var classCount = 0
        var methodCount = 0
        var fileSize = 0

        try {
            path.newInputStream().use { input ->
                val header = ByteArray(112)
                val read = input.read(header)
                if (read >= 112 && header[0] == 0x64.toByte() && header[1] == 0x65.toByte() && header[2] == 0x78.toByte()) {
                    version = "DEX " + String(header, 4, 3)
                    val bb = ByteBuffer.wrap(header).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
                    fileSize = bb.getInt(32)
                    methodCount = bb.getInt(88)
                    classCount = bb.getInt(96)
                }
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
        }

        val sizeStr = if (fileSize > 0) String.format("%.2f MB", fileSize / (1024.0 * 1024.0)) else ""
        binding.dexFileDetails.text = "$version  •  $sizeStr  •  $classCount clases  •  $methodCount métodos"

        val dialog = MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(requireContext())
            .setView(binding.root)
            .create()

        // 1. Editor DEX+ (Completo)
        binding.btnModeEditorPlus.setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            val intent = Intent(requireContext(), DexEditorActivity::class.java).apply {
                extraPath = path
                putExtra(DexEditorActivity.EXTRA_INITIAL_TAB, 0)
            }
            startActivity(intent)
        }

        // 2. Descompilar con JADX
        binding.btnModeDecompileJava.setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            val options = arrayOf(
                "Explorar y descompilar clases a Java",
                "Exportar todas las clases a .zip de fuentes Java"
            )
            MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(requireContext())
                .setTitle(R.string.dex_decompile_java)
                .setItems(options) { _, which ->
                    if (which == 0) {
                        val intent = Intent(requireContext(), DexEditorActivity::class.java).apply {
                            extraPath = path
                            putExtra(DexEditorActivity.EXTRA_INITIAL_TAB, 0)
                        }
                        startActivity(intent)
                    } else {
                        exportJavaZip(path)
                    }
                }
                .show()
        }

        // 3. Editor de Cadenas (String Pool)
        binding.btnModeStringPool.setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            val intent = Intent(requireContext(), DexEditorActivity::class.java).apply {
                extraPath = path
                putExtra(DexEditorActivity.EXTRA_INITIAL_TAB, 1)
            }
            startActivity(intent)
        }

        // 4. Resumen e Información
        binding.btnModeSummary.setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            DexInfoDialogFragment.show(path, parentFragmentManager)
        }

        // 5. Editor Hexadecimal
        binding.btnModeHex.setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            HexEditorActivity.start(requireContext(), path)
        }

        // 6. Abrir como Texto
        binding.btnModeText.setOnClickListener {
            dialog.dismiss()
            val intent = Intent(requireContext(), TextEditorActivity::class.java).apply {
                extraPath = path
            }
            startActivity(intent)
        }

        return dialog
    }

    private fun exportJavaZip(path: Path) {
        val context = requireContext()
        val progressDialog = MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(context)
            .setTitle(R.string.dex_decompile_progress)
            .setMessage("Preparando archivo DEX...")
            .setCancelable(false)
            .create()
        progressDialog.show()

        lifecycleScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            try {
                val prepared = DexEngine.prepareLocalDexFile(context, path)
                val baseName = path.fileName.toString().removeSuffix(".dex")
                val parentDir = if (path.isLinuxPath) path.toFile().parentFile ?: context.cacheDir else context.cacheDir
                val outZip = File(parentDir, "${baseName}_java_sources.zip")

                JadxDecompilerEngine.decompileToZip(prepared, outZip) { current, total, clsName ->
                    if (current % 15 == 0 || current == total) {
                        lifecycleScope.launch(Dispatchers.Main) {
                            progressDialog.setMessage("Descompilando clase $current/$total\n$clsName")
                        }
                    }
                }

                withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                    progressDialog.dismiss()
                    MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(context)
                        .setTitle(R.string.dex_export_java_sources)
                        .setMessage(context.getString(R.string.dex_decompile_success, outZip.name))
                        .setPositiveButton(android.R.string.ok, null)
                        .show()
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                e.printStackTrace()
                withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                    progressDialog.dismiss()
                    Toast.makeText(context, "Error al descompilar: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    companion object {
        fun show(path: Path, fragmentManager: FragmentManager) {
            DexActionDialogFragment().putArgs(Args(path)).show(fragmentManager, null)
        }
    }

    @Parcelize
    class Args(val path: @WriteWith<ParcelableParceler> Path) : ParcelableArgs
}
```

```kt
/*

package me.zhanghai.android.files.viewer.dex

import android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable
import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.Menu
import android.view.MenuItem
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.core.view.isVisible
import androidx.lifecycle.lifecycleScope
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.LinearLayoutManager
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
import com.google.android.material.dialog.MaterialAlertDialogBuilder
import com.google.android.material.snackbar.Snackbar
import com.google.android.material.tabs.TabLayout
import java8.nio.file.Path
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import me.zhanghai.android.files.R
import me.zhanghai.android.files.app.AppActivity
import me.zhanghai.android.files.app.clipboardManager
import me.zhanghai.android.files.databinding.ActivityDexClassEditorBinding
import me.zhanghai.android.files.databinding.ItemDexMemberBinding
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.common.newOutputStream

import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.copyText
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.extraPath
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileInputStream

class DexClassEditorActivity : AppActivity() {

    private lateinit var binding: ActivityDexClassEditorBinding
    private lateinit var dexFile: File
    private lateinit var classDescriptor: String
    private var originalPath: Path? = null
    private var initialTab: Int = 0

    private val methodsList = mutableListOf<DexMethodModel>()
    private val fieldsList = mutableListOf<DexFieldModel>()

    private lateinit var methodsAdapter: MethodsAdapter
    private lateinit var fieldsAdapter: FieldsAdapter

    private var cachedJavaCode: String? = null
    private var isDecompilingJava = false

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityDexClassEditorBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        val dexPathStr = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_DEX_PATH)
        classDescriptor = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_CLASS_DESCRIPTOR) ?: ""
        originalPath = intent.extraPath
        initialTab = intent.getIntExtra(EXTRA_INITIAL_TAB, 0)

        if (dexPathStr == null || classDescriptor.isEmpty()) {
            finish()
            return
        }

        dexFile = File(dexPathStr)
        val className = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_CLASS_NAME) ?: classDescriptor
        val packageName = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_PACKAGE_NAME) ?: ""

        setSupportActionBar(binding.toolbar)
        supportActionBar?.setDisplayHomeAsUpEnabled(true)
        binding.toolbar.setNavigationOnClickListener { finish() }
        binding.toolbar.title = className
        binding.toolbar.subtitle = if (packageName.isNotEmpty()) packageName else classDescriptor

        setupTabs()
        setupRecyclerViews()
        setupButtons()
        loadClassData()

        if (initialTab == 4) {
            binding.tabLayout.getTabAt(4)?.select()
        }
    }

    private fun setupTabs() {
        binding.tabLayout.addTab(binding.tabLayout.newTab().setText(R.string.dex_tab_smali))
        binding.tabLayout.addTab(binding.tabLayout.newTab().setText(R.string.dex_tab_methods))
        binding.tabLayout.addTab(binding.tabLayout.newTab().setText(R.string.dex_tab_fields))
        binding.tabLayout.addTab(binding.tabLayout.newTab().setText(R.string.dex_tab_class_details))
        binding.tabLayout.addTab(binding.tabLayout.newTab().setText(R.string.dex_tab_java))

        binding.tabLayout.addOnTabSelectedListener(object : TabLayout.OnTabSelectedListener {
            override fun onTabSelected(tab: TabLayout.Tab?) {
                when (tab?.position) {
                    0 -> showView(binding.layoutSmali)
                    1 -> showView(binding.rvMethods)
                    2 -> showView(binding.rvFields)
                    3 -> showView(binding.layoutClassDetails)
                    4 -> {
                        showView(binding.layoutJava)
                        loadJavaCode()
                    }
                }
            }
            override fun onTabUnselected(tab: TabLayout.Tab?) {}
            override fun onTabReselected(tab: TabLayout.Tab?) {}
        })
    }

    private fun showView(view: View) {
        binding.layoutSmali.visibility = if (view == binding.layoutSmali) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
        binding.rvMethods.visibility = if (view == binding.rvMethods) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
        binding.rvFields.visibility = if (view == binding.rvFields) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
        binding.layoutClassDetails.visibility = if (view == binding.layoutClassDetails) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
        binding.layoutJava.visibility = if (view == binding.layoutJava) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
    }

    private fun setupRecyclerViews() {
        methodsAdapter = MethodsAdapter(methodsList)
        binding.rvMethods.layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(this)
        binding.rvMethods.adapter = methodsAdapter

        fieldsAdapter = FieldsAdapter(fieldsList)
        binding.rvFields.layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(this)
        binding.rvFields.adapter = fieldsAdapter
    }

    private fun setupButtons() {
        binding.btnCopySmali.setOnClickListener {
            val code = binding.etSmaliCode.text.toString()
            clipboardManager.copyText(code, this)
            Toast.makeText(this, R.string.dex_smali_copied, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }

        binding.btnSaveSmali.setOnClickListener {
            saveAndCompileSmali()
        }

        binding.btnCopyJava.setOnClickListener {
            val code = binding.etJavaCode.text.toString()
            clipboardManager.copyText(code, this)
            Toast.makeText(this, R.string.dex_java_copied, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }

        binding.btnExportJava.setOnClickListener {
            exportJavaFile()
        }
    }

    private fun loadClassData() {
        binding.progressBar.visibility = View.VISIBLE

        lifecycleScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            val smaliText = DexEngine.disassembleClass(dexFile, classDescriptor)
            val (methods, fields) = DexEngine.getClassMembers(dexFile, classDescriptor)

            withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                binding.etSmaliCode.setText(smaliText)

                methodsList.clear()
                methodsList.addAll(methods)
                methodsAdapter.notifyDataSetChanged()

                fieldsList.clear()
                fieldsList.addAll(fields)
                fieldsAdapter.notifyDataSetChanged()

                binding.tabLayout.getTabAt(1)?.text = "${getString(R.string.dex_tab_methods)} (${methods.size})"
                binding.tabLayout.getTabAt(2)?.text = "${getString(R.string.dex_tab_fields)} (${fields.size})"

                binding.tvDetailDescriptor.text = classDescriptor
                binding.tvDetailSourceFile.text = "${binding.toolbar.title}.java"

                binding.progressBar.visibility = View.GONE
            }
        }
    }

    private fun loadJavaCode(forceReload: Boolean = false) {
        if (cachedJavaCode != null && !forceReload) {
            binding.etJavaCode.setText(cachedJavaCode)
            return
        }
        if (isDecompilingJava) return
        isDecompilingJava = true
        binding.progressBar.visibility = View.VISIBLE
        binding.etJavaCode.setText(R.string.dex_decompile_progress)

        lifecycleScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            val javaCode = JadxDecompilerEngine.decompileClass(dexFile, classDescriptor)
            withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                cachedJavaCode = javaCode
                binding.etJavaCode.setText(javaCode)
                binding.progressBar.visibility = View.GONE
                isDecompilingJava = false
            }
        }
    }

    private fun exportJavaFile() {
        val code = cachedJavaCode ?: binding.etJavaCode.text.toString()
        if (code.isBlank() || code.startsWith("// [JADX] No se encontró")) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "No hay código Java válido para exportar", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return
        }
        val simpleName = binding.toolbar.title.toString()
        val fileName = "$simpleName.java"
        val parentDir = dexFile.parentFile ?: cacheDir
        val outFile = File(parentDir, fileName)

        try {
            outFile.writeText(code, Charsets.UTF_8)
            Toast.makeText(this, "Guardado como ${outFile.name}", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Error al guardar archivo: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
        }
    }

    private fun saveAndCompileSmali() {
        val code = binding.etSmaliCode.text.toString()
        binding.progressBar.visibility = View.VISIBLE

        lifecycleScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            val (success, message) = DexEngine.assembleClassSmali(
                this@DexClassEditorActivity,
                dexFile,
                code,
                classDescriptor
            )

            // Invalidate Java cache since Smali modified bytecode
            cachedJavaCode = null

            // If original path is different (e.g. non-linux or content), sync back
            var writeBackError: String? = null
            if (success && originalPath != null && !originalPath!!.isLinuxPath) {
                try {
                    FileInputStream(dexFile).use { input ->
                        originalPath!!.newOutputStream().use { output ->
                            input.copyTo(output)
                        }
                    }
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    e.printStackTrace()
                    writeBackError = e.localizedMessage ?: e.message
                }
            }

            withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                binding.progressBar.visibility = View.GONE
                if (writeBackError != null) {
                    MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(this@DexClassEditorActivity)
                        .setTitle("Advertencia al guardar")
                        .setMessage("El código Smali se compiló pero no se pudo sincronizar en el archivo original:\n\n$writeBackError")
                        .setPositiveButton(android.R.string.ok, null)
                        .show()
                } else if (success) {
                    val snackbar = Snackbar.make(binding.root, R.string.dex_compile_success, Snackbar.LENGTH_LONG)
                    snackbar.show()
                } else {
                    MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(this@DexClassEditorActivity)
                        .setTitle(R.string.dex_compile_failed)
                        .setMessage(message)
                        .setPositiveButton(android.R.string.ok, null)
                        .show()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    override fun onCreateOptionsMenu(menu: Menu): Boolean {
        menuInflater.inflate(R.menu.dex_class_editor_menu, menu)
        return true
    }

    override fun onOptionsItemSelected(item: MenuItem): Boolean {
        when (item.itemId) {
            android.R.id.home -> {
                finish()
                return true
            }
            R.id.action_copy -> {
                if (binding.layoutJava.isVisible) {
                    val code = binding.etJavaCode.text.toString()
                    clipboardManager.copyText(code, this)
                    Toast.makeText(this, R.string.dex_java_copied, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                } else {
                    val code = binding.etSmaliCode.text.toString()
                    clipboardManager.copyText(code, this)
                    Toast.makeText(this, R.string.dex_smali_copied, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
                return true
            }
            R.id.action_save -> {
                saveAndCompileSmali()
                return true
            }
            R.id.action_export_java -> {
                exportJavaFile()
                return true
            }
        }
        return super.onOptionsItemSelected(item)
    }

    inner class MethodsAdapter(
        private val items: List<DexMethodModel>
    ) : RecyclerView.Adapter<MethodsAdapter.ViewHolder>() {

        inner class ViewHolder(val binding: ItemDexMemberBinding) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(binding.root)

        override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): ViewHolder {
            val b = ItemDexMemberBinding.inflate(LayoutInflater.from(parent.context), parent, false)
            return ViewHolder(b)
        }

        override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: ViewHolder, position: Int) {
            val item = items[position]
            with(holder.binding) {
                tvMemberBadge.text = if (item.isConstructor) "C" else "M"
                val bg = tvMemberBadge.background as? GradientDrawable
                    ?: GradientDrawable().apply { shape = GradientDrawable.OVAL }
                bg.setColor(if (item.isConstructor) 0xFFFFA726.toInt() else 0xFF2196F3.toInt())
                tvMemberBadge.background = bg

                tvMemberName.text = item.name
                tvMemberFlags.text = item.accessFlagsString
                tvMemberSignature.text = item.signature

                root.setOnClickListener {
                    binding.tabLayout.getTabAt(0)?.select()
                }
            }
        }

        override fun getItemCount(): Int = items.size
    }

    inner class FieldsAdapter(
        private val items: List<DexFieldModel>
    ) : RecyclerView.Adapter<FieldsAdapter.ViewHolder>() {

        inner class ViewHolder(val binding: ItemDexMemberBinding) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(binding.root)

        override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): ViewHolder {
            val b = ItemDexMemberBinding.inflate(LayoutInflater.from(parent.context), parent, false)
            return ViewHolder(b)
        }

        override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: ViewHolder, position: Int) {
            val item = items[position]
            with(holder.binding) {
                tvMemberBadge.text = "F"
                val bg = tvMemberBadge.background as? GradientDrawable
                    ?: GradientDrawable().apply { shape = GradientDrawable.OVAL }
                bg.setColor(0xFF4CAF50.toInt())
                tvMemberBadge.background = bg

                tvMemberName.text = item.name
                tvMemberFlags.text = item.accessFlagsString
                tvMemberSignature.text = item.displayType

                root.setOnClickListener {
                    binding.tabLayout.getTabAt(0)?.select()
                }
            }
        }

        override fun getItemCount(): Int = items.size
    }
```
