`app/src/main/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/viewer/dex/DexEditorActivity.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.viewer.dex

import android.content.Intent
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable
import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.Menu
import android.view.MenuItem
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.widget.EditText
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.appcompat.widget.SearchView
import androidx.lifecycle.lifecycleScope
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.LinearLayoutManager
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
import com.google.android.material.dialog.MaterialAlertDialogBuilder
import com.google.android.material.tabs.TabLayout
import java8.nio.file.Path
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import me.zhanghai.android.files.R
import me.zhanghai.android.files.app.AppActivity
import me.zhanghai.android.files.databinding.ActivityDexEditorBinding
import me.zhanghai.android.files.databinding.ItemDexClassBinding
import me.zhanghai.android.files.databinding.ItemDexStringBinding
import me.zhanghai.android.files.filejob.FileJobService
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.linux.isLinuxPath
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.extraPath
import java.io.File

class DexEditorActivity : AppActivity() {

    private lateinit var binding: ActivityDexEditorBinding
    private lateinit var path: Path
    private var localDexFile: File? = null
    private var lastDexModified: Long = 0L

    private val allClasses = mutableListOf<DexClassModel>()
    private val displayedClasses = mutableListOf<DexClassModel>()
    private lateinit var classAdapter: ClassesAdapter

    private val allStrings = mutableListOf<DexStringModel>()
    private val displayedStrings = mutableListOf<DexStringModel>()
    private lateinit var stringAdapter: StringsAdapter

    private var activeTab = 0 // 0: Clases, 1: Cadenas
    private var searchQuery = ""

    override fun onResume() {
        super.onResume()
        val dex = localDexFile
        if (dex != null && dex.exists() && dex.lastModified() > lastDexModified && lastDexModified != 0L) {
            loadDex()
        }
    }

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityDexEditorBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        path = intent.extraPath ?: run {
            finish()
            return
        }

        setSupportActionBar(binding.toolbar)
        supportActionBar?.setDisplayHomeAsUpEnabled(true)
        binding.toolbar.setNavigationOnClickListener { finish() }
        binding.toolbar.title = path.fileName.toString()

        activeTab = intent.getIntExtra(EXTRA_INITIAL_TAB, 0)

        setupTabs()
        setupRecyclerViews()
        loadDex()
    }

    private fun setupTabs() {
        val tabClasses = binding.tabLayout.newTab().setText(R.string.dex_tab_classes)
        val tabStrings = binding.tabLayout.newTab().setText(R.string.dex_tab_strings)
        binding.tabLayout.addTab(tabClasses)
        binding.tabLayout.addTab(tabStrings)

        if (activeTab in 0..1) {
            binding.tabLayout.getTabAt(activeTab)?.select()
            updateTabVisibility()
        }

        binding.tabLayout.addOnTabSelectedListener(object : TabLayout.OnTabSelectedListener {
            override fun onTabSelected(tab: TabLayout.Tab?) {
                activeTab = tab?.position ?: 0
                updateTabVisibility()
                filterContent()
            }
            override fun onTabUnselected(tab: TabLayout.Tab?) {}
            override fun onTabReselected(tab: TabLayout.Tab?) {}
        })
    }

    private fun updateTabVisibility() {
        if (activeTab == 0) {
            binding.rvClasses.visibility = View.VISIBLE
            binding.rvStrings.visibility = View.GONE
        } else {
            binding.rvClasses.visibility = View.GONE
            binding.rvStrings.visibility = View.VISIBLE
        }
    }

    private fun setupRecyclerViews() {
        classAdapter = ClassesAdapter(
            displayedClasses,
            onClick = { classModel -> openClassEditor(classModel, 0) },
            onLongClick = { classModel -> showClassActionDialog(classModel) }
        )
        binding.rvClasses.layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(this)
        binding.rvClasses.adapter = classAdapter

        stringAdapter = StringsAdapter(displayedStrings) { stringModel ->
            showEditStringDialog(stringModel)
        }
        binding.rvStrings.layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(this)
        binding.rvStrings.adapter = stringAdapter
    }

    private fun loadDex() {
        binding.progressBar.visibility = View.VISIBLE
        binding.tvEmpty.visibility = View.GONE

        lifecycleScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            try {
                val prepared = DexEngine.prepareLocalDexFile(this@DexEditorActivity, path)
                localDexFile = prepared

                val (classes, strings) = DexEngine.parseDexClasses(prepared)

                withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                    lastDexModified = prepared.lastModified()
                    allClasses.clear()
                    allClasses.addAll(classes)

                    allStrings.clear()
                    allStrings.addAll(strings)

                    binding.tabLayout.getTabAt(0)?.text = "${getString(R.string.dex_tab_classes)} (${classes.size})"
                    binding.tabLayout.getTabAt(1)?.text = "${getString(R.string.dex_tab_strings)} (${strings.size})"
                    binding.toolbar.subtitle = "${classes.size} clases  •  ${strings.size} cadenas"

                    binding.progressBar.visibility = View.GONE
                    filterContent()
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                e.printStackTrace()
                withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                    binding.progressBar.visibility = View.GONE
                    Toast.makeText(this@DexEditorActivity, "Error al cargar DEX: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun filterContent() {
        val q = searchQuery.trim().lowercase()

        if (activeTab == 0) {
            displayedClasses.clear()
            if (q.isEmpty()) {
                displayedClasses.addAll(allClasses)
            } else {
                for (cls in allClasses) {
                    if (cls.simpleName.lowercase().contains(q) ||
                        cls.packageName.lowercase().contains(q) ||
                        cls.descriptor.lowercase().contains(q)
                    ) {
                        displayedClasses.add(cls)
                    }
                }
            }
            classAdapter.notifyDataSetChanged()
            binding.tvEmpty.visibility = if (displayedClasses.isEmpty()) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
        } else {
            displayedStrings.clear()
            if (q.isEmpty()) {
                displayedStrings.addAll(allStrings)
            } else {
                for (str in allStrings) {
                    if (str.value.lowercase().contains(q)) {
                        displayedStrings.add(str)
                    }
                }
            }
            stringAdapter.notifyDataSetChanged()
            binding.tvEmpty.visibility = if (displayedStrings.isEmpty()) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
        }
    }

    private fun openClassEditor(classModel: DexClassModel, initialTab: Int = 0) {
        val dex = localDexFile ?: return
        val intent = Intent(this, DexClassEditorActivity::class.java).apply {
            extraPath = path
            putExtra(DexClassEditorActivity.EXTRA_DEX_PATH, dex.absolutePath)
            putExtra(DexClassEditorActivity.EXTRA_CLASS_DESCRIPTOR, classModel.descriptor)
            putExtra(DexClassEditorActivity.EXTRA_CLASS_NAME, classModel.simpleName)
            putExtra(DexClassEditorActivity.EXTRA_PACKAGE_NAME, classModel.packageName)
            putExtra(DexClassEditorActivity.EXTRA_INITIAL_TAB, initialTab)
        }
        startActivity(intent)
    }

    private fun showClassActionDialog(classModel: DexClassModel) {

            getString(R.string.dex_tab_java),

            .show()
    }

    override fun onCreateOptionsMenu(menu: Menu): Boolean {
        menuInflater.inflate(R.menu.dex_editor_menu, menu)

        val searchItem = menu.findItem(R.id.action_search)
        val searchView = searchItem?.actionView as? SearchView
        searchView?.queryHint = getString(R.string.search)
        searchView?.setOnQueryTextListener(object : SearchView.OnQueryTextListener {
            override fun onQueryTextSubmit(query: String?): Boolean {
                searchQuery = query ?: ""
                filterContent()
                return true
            }

            override fun onQueryTextChange(newText: String?): Boolean {
                searchQuery = newText ?: ""
                filterContent()
                return true
            }
        })

        return true
    }

    override fun onOptionsItemSelected(item: MenuItem): Boolean {
        when (item.itemId) {
            android.R.id.home -> {
                finish()
                return true
            }
            R.id.action_save -> {
                saveDex()
                return true
            }
            R.id.action_export_java -> {
                exportAllJavaSources()
                return true
            }
        }
        return super.onOptionsItemSelected(item)
    }

    private fun exportAllJavaSources() {
        val dex = localDexFile ?: return
        if (!dex.exists()) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "El archivo DEX no existe", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return
        }

        MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(this)
            .setTitle(R.string.dex_export_java_sources)
            .setMessage("¿Deseas descompilar y exportar todas las clases (${allClasses.size}) a código fuente Java (.zip) usando JADX?")
            .setPositiveButton(android.R.string.ok) { _, _ ->
                val baseName = path.fileName.toString().removeSuffix(".dex").removeSuffix(".apk")
                val parentDir = if (path.isLinuxPath) path.toFile().parentFile ?: cacheDir else cacheDir
                val outZip = File(parentDir, "${baseName}_java_sources.zip")

                binding.progressBar.visibility = View.VISIBLE
                val progressDialog = MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(this)
                    .setTitle(R.string.dex_decompile_progress)
                    .setMessage("Iniciando descompilación JADX...")
                    .setCancelable(false)
                    .create()
                progressDialog.show()

                lifecycleScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
                    try {
                        JadxDecompilerEngine.decompileToZip(dex, outZip) { current, total, clsName ->
                            if (current % 15 == 0 || current == total) {
                                lifecycleScope.launch(Dispatchers.Main) {
                                    progressDialog.setMessage("Descompilando clase $current/$total\n$clsName")
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                            progressDialog.dismiss()
                            binding.progressBar.visibility = View.GONE
                            MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(this@DexEditorActivity)
                                .setTitle(R.string.dex_export_java_sources)
                                .setMessage(getString(R.string.dex_decompile_success, outZip.name))
                                .setPositiveButton(android.R.string.ok, null)
                                .show()
                        }
                    } catch (e: Exception) {
                        e.printStackTrace()
                        withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                            progressDialog.dismiss()
                            binding.progressBar.visibility = View.GONE
                            Toast.makeText(this@DexEditorActivity, "Error al descompilar: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
            .show()
    }

    private fun saveDex() {
        val dex = localDexFile ?: run {
            Toast.makeText(this, "No hay archivo cargado", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return
        }
        if (!dex.exists()) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "El archivo DEX no existe", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return
        }
        if (!path.isLinuxPath) {
            binding.progressBar.visibility = View.VISIBLE
            lifecycleScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
                try {
                    val bytes = dex.readBytes()
                    FileJobService.write(path, bytes, this@DexEditorActivity) { success ->
                        binding.progressBar.visibility = View.GONE
                        if (success) {
                            Toast.makeText(this@DexEditorActivity, R.string.dex_save_success, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                        } else {
                            Toast.makeText(this@DexEditorActivity, "Error al escribir en destino", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                        }
                    }
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    e.printStackTrace()
                    withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                        binding.progressBar.visibility = View.GONE
                        Toast.makeText(this@DexEditorActivity, "Error: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            Toast.makeText(this, R.string.dex_save_success, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }

    companion object {
        const val EXTRA_INITIAL_TAB = "extra_initial_tab"
    }

    inner class ClassesAdapter(

        private val onClick: (DexClassModel) -> Unit,

    ) : RecyclerView.Adapter<ClassesAdapter.ViewHolder>() {

            val b = ItemDexClassBinding.inflate(LayoutInflater.from(parent.context), parent, false)
            return ViewHolder(b)
        }

        override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: ViewHolder, position: Int) {
            val item = items[position]
            with(holder.binding) {
                tvClassBadge.text = item.badgeLetter
                val bg = tvClassBadge.background as? GradientDrawable
                    ?: GradientDrawable().apply { shape = GradientDrawable.OVAL }
                bg.setColor(item.badgeColor)
                tvClassBadge.background = bg

                tvClassName.text = item.simpleName
                tvClassPackage.text = if (item.packageName.isNotEmpty()) item.packageName else "<default package>"
                tvAccessFlags.text = item.accessFlagsString

                val superName = formatType(item.superclass)
                val superStr = if (superName.isNotEmpty() && superName != "java.lang.Object") "extends $superName  •  " else ""
                tvClassDetails.text = "$superStr${item.methodCount} métodos  •  ${item.fieldCount} campos"

                root.setOnClickListener { onClick(item) }
                root.setOnLongClickListener {
                    onLongClick(item)
                    true
                }
            }
        }

    }

        }
```

`app/src/main/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/viewer/dex/DexEngine.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.viewer.dex

import android.content.Context
import com.android.tools.smali.baksmali.Adaptors.ClassDefinition
import com.android.tools.smali.baksmali.BaksmaliOptions
import com.android.tools.smali.dexlib2.AccessFlags
import com.android.tools.smali.dexlib2.DexFileFactory
import com.android.tools.smali.dexlib2.Opcodes
import com.android.tools.smali.dexlib2.dexbacked.DexBackedDexFile
import com.android.tools.smali.dexlib2.iface.ClassDef
import com.android.tools.smali.dexlib2.iface.DexFile
import com.android.tools.smali.smali.Smali
import com.android.tools.smali.smali.SmaliOptions
import com.android.tools.smali.baksmali.formatter.BaksmaliWriter
import java.nio.ByteBuffer
import java.nio.ByteOrder
import java8.nio.file.Path
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.common.newInputStream
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.linux.isLinuxPath
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileOutputStream
import java.io.StringWriter

object DexEngine {

    val defaultOpcodes: Opcodes by lazy { me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist.ApktoolEngine.getSafeOpcodes() }

    fun prepareLocalDexFile(context: Context, path: Path): File {
        if (path.isLinuxPath) {
            val file = path.toFile()
            if (file.exists() && file.canRead()) {
                return file
            }
        }

        val cacheDir = File(context.cacheDir, "dex_cache").apply { mkdirs() }
        try {
            val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
            cacheDir.listFiles()?.forEach { f ->
                if (now - f.lastModified() > 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000L) {
                    f.delete()
                }
            }
        } catch (ignored: Exception) {}
        val safeName = path.fileName.toString().replace(Regex("[\\\\/:*?\"<>|\\s]"), "_")
        val localFile = File(cacheDir, "${System.currentTimeMillis()}_$safeName")

        path.newInputStream().use { input ->
            FileOutputStream(localFile).use { output ->
                input.copyTo(output)
            }
        }
        return localFile
    }

    fun parseDexClasses(dexFile: File): Pair<List<DexClassModel>, List<DexStringModel>> {
        val dexBacked: DexBackedDexFile = me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist.ApktoolEngine.loadDexSafely(dexFile)
        val classModels = mutableListOf<DexClassModel>()

        for (classDef in dexBacked.classes) {
            val desc = classDef.type
            val simple = getSimpleClassName(desc)
            val pkg = getPackageName(desc)
            val flags = classDef.accessFlags
            val isInterface = AccessFlags.INTERFACE.isSet(flags)
            val isEnum = AccessFlags.ENUM.isSet(flags)
            val isAbstract = AccessFlags.ABSTRACT.isSet(flags)
            val flagStr = formatAccessFlags(flags)

            classModels.add(
                DexClassModel(
                    descriptor = desc,
                    simpleName = simple,
                    packageName = pkg,
                    superclass = classDef.superclass ?: "",
                    interfaces = classDef.interfaces.toList(),
                    accessFlags = flags,
                    accessFlagsString = flagStr,
                    isInterface = isInterface,
                    isEnum = isEnum,
                    isAbstract = isAbstract,
                    methodCount = classDef.methods.count(),
                    fieldCount = classDef.fields.count(),
                    sourceFile = classDef.sourceFile
                )
            )
        }

        classModels.sortBy { "${it.packageName}.${it.simpleName}".lowercase() }

        val stringModels = mutableListOf<DexStringModel>()
        try {
            val bytes = dexFile.readBytes()
            if (bytes.size >= 112) {
                val bb = ByteBuffer.wrap(bytes).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
                val stringCount = bb.getInt(56)
                val stringIdsOff = bb.getInt(60)
                val limit = stringCount.coerceAtMost(10000)
                for (i in 0 until limit) {
                    val tableEntryOff = stringIdsOff + i * 4
                    if (tableEntryOff < 0 || tableEntryOff + 4 > bytes.size) break
                    val off = bb.getInt(tableEntryOff)
                    if (off in 0 until bytes.size) {
                        var pos = off
                        var ulebCount = 0
                        while (pos < bytes.size && (bytes[pos].toInt() and 0x80) != 0 && ulebCount < 5) {
                            pos++
                            ulebCount++
                        }
                        pos++
                        val sb = StringBuilder()
                        while (pos < bytes.size && bytes[pos].toInt() != 0 && sb.length < 500) {
                            val c = bytes[pos].toInt().toChar()
                            if (c in ' '..'~' || c == '\n' || c == '\t') {
                                sb.append(c)
                            }
                            pos++
                        }
                        if (sb.isNotEmpty()) {
                            stringModels.add(DexStringModel(i, sb.toString()))
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
        }

        return Pair(classModels, stringModels)
    }

    fun disassembleClass(dexFile: File, classDescriptor: String): String {
        return try {
            val dexBacked: DexBackedDexFile = me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist.ApktoolEngine.loadDexSafely(dexFile)
            val classDef = dexBacked.classes.find { it.type == classDescriptor }
                ?: return "# Error: Clase no encontrada: $classDescriptor"

            val options = BaksmaliOptions()
            options.deodex = false
            options.parameterRegisters = true

            val classDefinition = ClassDefinition(options, classDef)
            val sw = StringWriter()
            val writer = BaksmaliWriter(sw)
            classDefinition.writeTo(writer)
            sw.toString()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
            "# Error al desensamblar Smali: ${e.message}\n"
        }
    }

    fun getClassMembers(
        dexFile: File,
        classDescriptor: String
    ): Pair<List<DexMethodModel>, List<DexFieldModel>> {
        val dexBacked: DexBackedDexFile = me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist.ApktoolEngine.loadDexSafely(dexFile)
        val classDef = dexBacked.classes.find { it.type == classDescriptor }
            ?: return Pair(emptyList(), emptyList())

        val methods = mutableListOf<DexMethodModel>()
        for (method in classDef.methods) {
            val isCtor = method.name == "<init>" || method.name == "<clinit>"
            methods.add(
                DexMethodModel(
                    name = method.name,
                    returnType = method.returnType,
                    parameterTypes = method.parameterTypes.map { it.toString() },
                    accessFlagsString = formatAccessFlags(method.accessFlags),
                    isConstructor = isCtor
                )
            )
        }

        val fields = mutableListOf<DexFieldModel>()
        for (field in classDef.fields) {
            fields.add(
                DexFieldModel(
                    name = field.name,
                    type = field.type,
                    accessFlagsString = formatAccessFlags(field.accessFlags),
                    initialValue = field.initialValue?.toString()
                )
            )
        }

        return Pair(methods, fields)
    }

    fun assembleClassSmali(
        context: Context,
        originalDex: File,
        smaliCode: String,
        classDescriptor: String
    ): Pair<Boolean, String> {
        val workDir = File(context.cacheDir, "smali_work_${System.currentTimeMillis()}").apply { mkdirs() }
        val smaliFile = File(workDir, "temp.smali")
        val outDexFile = File(workDir, "compiled.dex")

        return try {
            smaliFile.writeText(smaliCode)

            val options = SmaliOptions().apply {
                apiLevel = 28
                outputDexFile = outDexFile.absolutePath
                verboseErrors = true
            }

            val success = Smali.assemble(options, listOf(smaliFile.absolutePath))
            if (!success || !outDexFile.exists() || outDexFile.length() == 0L) {
                return Pair(false, "Error de compilación de sintaxis Smali")
            }

            // Load new class from outDexFile
            val compiledDex: DexBackedDexFile = DexFileFactory.loadDexFile(outDexFile, defaultOpcodes)
            val newClassDef = compiledDex.classes.firstOrNull()
                ?: return Pair(false, "No se encontró definición de clase en el Smali compilado")

            // Load original dex and replace the target class
            val originalDexBacked: DexBackedDexFile = DexFileFactory.loadDexFile(originalDex, defaultOpcodes)
            val updatedClasses = mutableSetOf<ClassDef>()
            var replaced = false

            for (cls in originalDexBacked.classes) {
                if (cls.type == newClassDef.type || cls.type == classDescriptor) {
                    updatedClasses.add(newClassDef)
                    replaced = true
                } else {
                    updatedClasses.add(cls)
                }
            }

            if (!replaced) {
                updatedClasses.add(newClassDef)
            }

            val mergedDex = object : DexFile {
                override fun getClasses(): Set<ClassDef> = updatedClasses
                override fun getOpcodes(): Opcodes = defaultOpcodes
            }

            val tempTarget = File(originalDex.parentFile, "${originalDex.name}.tmp")
            DexFileFactory.writeDexFile(tempTarget.absolutePath, mergedDex)

            if (tempTarget.exists() && tempTarget.length() > 0) {
                tempTarget.copyTo(originalDex, overwrite = true)
                tempTarget.delete()
                Pair(true, "Clase guardada y DEX actualizado correctamente")
            } else {
                Pair(false, "Error al escribir el archivo DEX final")
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
            Pair(false, "Excepción durante el ensamblado: ${e.message}")
        } finally {
            workDir.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    private fun getSimpleClassName(descriptor: String): String {
        val clean = descriptor.trimStart('L').trimEnd(';')
        val lastSlash = clean.lastIndexOf('/')
        return if (lastSlash >= 0) clean.substring(lastSlash + 1) else clean
    }

    private fun getPackageName(descriptor: String): String {
        val clean = descriptor.trimStart('L').trimEnd(';')
        val lastSlash = clean.lastIndexOf('/')
        return if (lastSlash >= 0) clean.substring(0, lastSlash).replace('/', '.') else ""
    }

    private fun formatAccessFlags(flags: Int): String {
        val list = mutableListOf<String>()
        for (flag in AccessFlags.values()) {
            if (flag.isSet(flags)) {
                list.add(flag.toString())
            }
        }
        return list.joinToString(" ")
    }
}
```

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * All Rights Reserved.

package me.zhanghai.android.files.viewer.dex

import android.os.Parcelable
import kotlinx.parcelize.Parcelize

@Parcelize
data class DexClassModel(
    val descriptor: String,
    val simpleName: String,
    val packageName: String,
    val superclass: String,
    val interfaces: List<String>,
    val accessFlags: Int,
    val accessFlagsString: String,
    val isInterface: Boolean,
    val isEnum: Boolean,
    val isAbstract: Boolean,
    val methodCount: Int,
    val fieldCount: Int,
    val sourceFile: String?
) : Parcelable {
    val badgeLetter: String
        get() = when {
            isInterface -> "I"
            isEnum -> "E"
            isAbstract -> "A"
            else -> "C"
        }

    val badgeColor: Int
        get() = when {
            isInterface -> 0xFF4CAF50.toInt() // Green
            isEnum -> 0xFFAB47BC.toInt()      // Purple
            isAbstract -> 0xFFFFA726.toInt()  // Orange
            else -> 0xFF2196F3.toInt()        // Blue
        }
}

@Parcelize
data class DexMethodModel(
    val name: String,
    val returnType: String,
    val parameterTypes: List<String>,
    val accessFlagsString: String,
    val isConstructor: Boolean
) : Parcelable {
    val signature: String
        get() = "(${parameterTypes.joinToString(", ") { formatType(it) }}): ${formatType(returnType)}"
}

@Parcelize
data class DexFieldModel(
    val name: String,
    val type: String,
    val accessFlagsString: String,
    val initialValue: String?
) : Parcelable {
    val displayType: String
        get() = formatType(type)
}

data class DexStringModel(
    val index: Int,
    var value: String
)

fun formatType(descriptor: String): String {
    if (descriptor.isEmpty()) return ""
    return when (descriptor) {
        "V" -> "void"
        "Z" -> "boolean"
        "B" -> "byte"
        "S" -> "short"
        "C" -> "char"
        "I" -> "int"
        "J" -> "long"
        "F" -> "float"
        "D" -> "double"
        else -> {
            if (descriptor.startsWith("[")) {
                formatType(descriptor.substring(1)) + "[]"
            } else if (descriptor.startsWith("L") && descriptor.endsWith(";")) {
                descriptor.substring(1, descriptor.length - 1).replace('/', '.')
            } else {
                descriptor
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/viewer/dex/JadxDecompilerEngine.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.viewer.dex

import android.content.Context
import com.android.tools.smali.baksmali.Adaptors.ClassDefinition
import com.android.tools.smali.baksmali.BaksmaliOptions
import com.android.tools.smali.baksmali.formatter.BaksmaliWriter
import com.android.tools.smali.dexlib2.DexFileFactory
import com.android.tools.smali.dexlib2.Opcodes
import com.android.tools.smali.dexlib2.dexbacked.DexBackedDexFile
import com.android.tools.smali.smali.Smali
import com.android.tools.smali.smali.SmaliOptions
import jadx.api.JadxArgs
import jadx.api.JadxDecompiler
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileOutputStream
import java.io.StringWriter
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets
import java.util.zip.ZipEntry
import java.util.zip.ZipFile
import java.util.zip.ZipOutputStream

/**
 * Engine for Java/Smali decompilation on Android ART.
 * Bypasses JADX's desktop plugin loader (`JadxPluginManager` -> `ServiceLoader`), which throws
 * `UnsupportedOperationException` ("Path not associated with default file system") and
 * `ExceptionInInitializerError` on Android ART by directly loading DEX files via `DexInputPlugin`
 * and `RootNode`. Includes a full Android-native Dexlib2 + Baksmali fallback.
 */
object JadxDecompilerEngine {

    private const val TAG = "JadxDecompilerEngine"

    private fun logWarning(msg: String, throwable: Throwable? = null) {
        try {
            if (throwable != null) {
                android.util.Log.w(TAG, msg, throwable)
            } else {
                android.util.Log.w(TAG, msg)
            }
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            System.err.println("[$TAG] $msg")
            throwable?.printStackTrace(System.err)
        }
    }

    /**
     * Sanitizes an arbitrary class name, descriptor, or path into a secure relative source file path
     * to protect against Path Traversal and Zip Slip attacks (GHSA-hvp5-5x4f-33fq / CWE-22).
     *
     * - Eliminates directory traversal sequences (".." and ".").
     * - Disallows absolute paths (leading slashes, Windows drive prefixes).
     * - Replaces illegal filesystem characters (:, *, ?, ", <, >, |, \0, etc.) with _.
     * - Prevents empty or hidden path components.
     * - Returns a relative path formatted with forward slashes ending with ".java" (e.g. "com/example/MyClass.java").
     */
    fun sanitizeRelativeSourcePath(className: String): String {
        var clean = className.trim()
        if (clean.startsWith("L") && clean.endsWith(";")) {
            clean = clean.substring(1, clean.length - 1)
        }

        clean = clean.replace('\\', '/').replace('.', '/')

        if (clean.length >= 2 && clean[1] == ':' && clean[0].isLetter()) {
            clean = clean.substring(2)
        }

        val segments = clean.split('/')
        val safeSegments = mutableListOf<String>()

        for (segment in segments) {
            val trimmed = segment.trim()
            if (trimmed.isEmpty() || trimmed == "." || trimmed == "..") {
                continue
            }

            val sanitized = buildString {
                for (ch in trimmed) {
                    if (ch in "<>:\"/\\|?*" || ch.code in 0..31) {
                        append('_')
                    } else {
                        append(ch)
                    }
                }
            }.trim('.', ' ')

            if (sanitized.isNotEmpty()) {
                val bounded = if (sanitized.length > 128) sanitized.substring(0, 128) else sanitized
                safeSegments.add(bounded)
            }
        }

        if (safeSegments.isEmpty()) {
            return "unnamed/Class_${System.nanoTime() and 0xFFFF}.java"
        }

        val relativePath = safeSegments.joinToString("/") + ".java"

        if (relativePath.startsWith("/") || relativePath.contains("..")) {
            return "sanitized/Class_${System.nanoTime() and 0xFFFF}.java"
        }

        return relativePath
    }


    /**
     * Converts a DEX descriptor (e.g., "Lcom/example/MyClass;" or "I") or path into a standard Java type/class name ("com.example.MyClass" or "int").
     */
    fun normalizeClassName(descriptorOrName: String): String {
        val clean = descriptorOrName.trim()
        if (clean.startsWith("[")) {
            return normalizeClassName(clean.substring(1)) + "[]"
        }
        return when (clean) {
            "V" -> "void"
            "Z" -> "boolean"
            "B" -> "byte"
            "S" -> "short"
            "C" -> "char"
            "I" -> "int"
            "J" -> "long"
            "F" -> "float"
            "D" -> "double"
            else -> {
                val stripped = if (clean.startsWith("L") && clean.endsWith(";")) {
                    clean.substring(1, clean.length - 1)
                } else {
                    clean
                }
                stripped.replace('/', '.')
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Creates JadxArgs safely configured for Android runtime (single-threaded, cache in temp dir, resources skipped).
     */
    private fun createAndroidSafeJadxArgs(inputFile: File): JadxArgs {
        return JadxArgs().apply {
            isSkipResources = true
            isShowInconsistentCode = true
            threadsCount = 1
            isUseImports = true
            isDebugInfo = false
            isDeobfuscationOn = false
            isRenameCaseSensitive = false
            isRenameValid = false
            isRenamePrintable = false
            inputFiles = listOf(inputFile)
            try {
                codeCache = jadx.api.impl.NoOpCodeCache()
            } catch (_: Throwable) {}
            try {
                codeWriterProvider = java.util.function.Function { args -> jadx.api.impl.SimpleCodeWriter(args) }
            } catch (_: Throwable) {}
        }
    }

    /**
     * Checks whether the current runtime is Android ART/Dalvik (where JADX's desktop
     * ServiceLoader / java.nio.file.FileSystems plugin scanner is unsupported).
     */
    fun isAndroidRuntime(): Boolean {
        return try {
            android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT > 0
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            val vmName = System.getProperty("java.vm.name") ?: ""
            val runtimeName = System.getProperty("java.runtime.name") ?: ""
            vmName.contains("Dalvik", ignoreCase = true) ||
                vmName.contains("ART", ignoreCase = true) ||
                runtimeName.contains("Android", ignoreCase = true)
        }
    }

    /**
     * Extracts all .dex files from an APK/ZIP (or returns the file itself if it's already a .dex file).
     */
    private fun extractDexFiles(inputFile: File, workDir: File): List<File> {
        if (inputFile.name.endsWith(".dex", ignoreCase = true)) {
            return listOf(inputFile)
        }
        val dexFiles = mutableListOf<File>()
        try {
            ZipFile(inputFile).use { zip ->
                val entries = zip.entries()
                while (entries.hasMoreElements()) {
                    val entry = entries.nextElement()
                    val name = entry.name
                    if (!entry.isDirectory && !name.contains('/') && name.startsWith("classes") && name.endsWith(".dex")) {
                        val outDex = File(workDir, name)
                        zip.getInputStream(entry).use { inp ->
                            FileOutputStream(outDex).use { out -> inp.copyTo(out) }
                        }
                        if (outDex.length() > 0L) {
                            dexFiles.add(outDex)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (_: Throwable) {}
        return dexFiles.sortedBy { it.name }
    }

    /**
     * Generates a readable pseudo-Java + Smali representation of a Dexlib2 ClassDef when JADX fails on Android ART.
     */
    private fun decompileClassDefFallback(classDef: com.android.tools.smali.dexlib2.iface.ClassDef): String {
        val sb = StringBuilder()
        val fullName = normalizeClassName(classDef.type)
        val pkg = fullName.substringBeforeLast('.', "")
        val simpleName = fullName.substringAfterLast('.')

        if (pkg.isNotEmpty()) {
            sb.append("package ").append(pkg).append(";\n\n")
        }

        val superName = classDef.superclass?.let { normalizeClassName(it) } ?: "java.lang.Object"
        val interfaces = classDef.interfaces.map { normalizeClassName(it) }
        sb.append("public class ").append(simpleName)
        if (superName != "java.lang.Object") {
            sb.append(" extends ").append(superName)
        }
        if (interfaces.isNotEmpty()) {
            sb.append(" implements ").append(interfaces.joinToString(", "))
        }
        sb.append(" {\n")

        // Fields
        for (field in classDef.fields) {
            val fType = normalizeClassName(field.type)
            val initVal = field.initialValue?.let { " = $it" } ?: ""
            sb.append("    public ").append(fType).append(" ").append(field.name).append(initVal).append(";\n")
        }
        if (classDef.fields.any()) {
            sb.append("\n")
        }

        // Methods
        for (method in classDef.methods) {
            val retType = if (method.name == "<init>" || method.name == "<clinit>") "" else "${normalizeClassName(method.returnType)} "
            val mName = when (method.name) {
                "<init>" -> simpleName
                "<clinit>" -> "static"
                else -> method.name
            }
            val params = method.parameterTypes.mapIndexed { idx, p -> "${normalizeClassName(p.toString())} p$idx" }.joinToString(", ")
            if (method.name == "<clinit>") {
                sb.append("    static {\n")
            } else {
                sb.append("    public ").append(retType).append(mName).append("(").append(params).append(") {\n")
            }
            val impl = method.implementation
            if (impl != null) {
                sb.append("        // Registros: ").append(impl.registerCount).append("\n")
                for (insn in impl.instructions.take(80)) {
                    sb.append("        // ").append(insn.opcode.name).append("\n")
                }
            }
            sb.append("    }\n\n")
        }

        sb.append("}\n\n")

        // Also append full Baksmali disassembly inside a block comment for complete inspection
        try {
            val options = BaksmaliOptions().apply {
                deodex = false
                parameterRegisters = true
            }
            val classDefinition = ClassDefinition(options, classDef)
            val sw = StringWriter()
            BaksmaliWriter(sw).use { writer ->
                classDefinition.writeTo(writer)
            }
            sb.append("/* ==================== SMALI DISASSEMBLY ====================\n")
            sb.append(sw.toString().replace("*/", "* /"))
            sb.append("\n============================================================= */\n")
        } catch (_: Throwable) {}

        return sb.toString()
    }

    /**
     * Decompiles a single class from a DEX, APK, or JAR file into Java source code.
     */
    fun decompileClass(inputFile: File, classDescriptorOrName: String): String {
        val targetName = normalizeClassName(classDescriptorOrName)
        val tempDir = File(inputFile.parentFile ?: File("/data/local/tmp"), ".dex_cls_${System.currentTimeMillis()}").apply { mkdirs() }
        return try {
            val dexFiles = extractDexFiles(inputFile, tempDir)

            // 1. Try JADX when not on Android ART (or if supported), guarded by catch (Throwable)
            if (!isAndroidRuntime()) {
                try {
                    val args = createAndroidSafeJadxArgs(inputFile)
                    JadxDecompiler(args).use { decompiler ->
                        decompiler.load()
                        val matchClass = decompiler.classes.find { cls ->
                            cls.fullName == targetName ||
                                cls.classNode.classInfo.fullName == targetName ||
                                cls.fullName.replace('$', '.') == targetName.replace('$', '.')
                        }
                        if (matchClass != null) {
                            val code = matchClass.code
                            if (!code.isNullOrBlank()) {
                                return code
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } catch (_: Throwable) {}
            }

            // 2. Android ART Native Path via Dexlib2 + Baksmali
            val targetDescriptor = "L" + targetName.replace('.', '/') + ";"
            for (dex in dexFiles) {
                try {
                    val dexBacked: DexBackedDexFile = me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist.ApktoolEngine.loadDexSafely(dex)
                    val match = dexBacked.classes.find {
                        it.type == targetDescriptor || normalizeClassName(it.type) == targetName
                    }
                    if (match != null) {
                        return decompileClassDefFallback(match)
                    }
                } catch (_: Throwable) {}
            }
            "// No se encontró la clase '$targetName' en ${inputFile.name}\n"
        } catch (e: Throwable) {
            "// Excepción durante la descompilación: ${e.message ?: e.javaClass.simpleName}\n"
        } finally {
            if (tempDir != inputFile.parentFile) {
                try { tempDir.deleteRecursively() } catch (_: Throwable) {}
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Converts Smali source code directly into Java source code by assembling a temporary DEX
     * and running JADX decompiler over it.
     */
    fun decompileSmali(context: Context, smaliCode: String, classDescriptor: String = ""): String {
        val workDir = File(context.cacheDir, "jadx_smali_${System.currentTimeMillis()}").apply { mkdirs() }
        val smaliFile = File(workDir, "temp.smali")
        val outDexFile = File(workDir, "temp.dex")

        return try {
            smaliFile.writeText(smaliCode)
            val options = SmaliOptions().apply {
                apiLevel = 28
                outputDexFile = outDexFile.absolutePath
                verboseErrors = true
            }

            val assembled = Smali.assemble(options, listOf(smaliFile.absolutePath))
            if (!assembled || !outDexFile.exists() || outDexFile.length() == 0L) {
                return "// Error de sintaxis Smali: no se pudo ensamblar el archivo temporal"
            }

            decompileClass(outDexFile, classDescriptor.ifEmpty { "Temp" })
        } catch (e: Throwable) {
            e.printStackTrace()
            "// Error al convertir Smali a Java: ${e.message}"
        } finally {
            workDir.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    /**
     * Batch decompiles all classes from a DEX or APK file into a ZIP file of Java sources.
     */
    fun decompileToZip(
        inputFile: File,
        outputZipFile: File,
        isCancelled: (() -> Boolean)? = null,
        onProgress: ((current: Int, total: Int, currentClass: String) -> Unit)? = null
    ): File {
        val workDir = File(outputZipFile.parentFile ?: File("/data/local/tmp"), ".dex_zip_${System.currentTimeMillis()}").apply { mkdirs() }
        try {
            val dexFiles = extractDexFiles(inputFile, workDir)

            // 1. Try JADX when not on Android ART, guarded by catch (Throwable)
            if (!isAndroidRuntime()) {
                try {
                    val args = createAndroidSafeJadxArgs(inputFile)
                    JadxDecompiler(args).use { decompiler ->
                        decompiler.load()
                        val classes = decompiler.classes
                        val total = classes.size
                        if (total > 0) {
                            var writtenCount = 0
                            ZipOutputStream(FileOutputStream(outputZipFile).buffered()).use { zos ->
                                val manifestEntry = ZipEntry("META-INF/MANIFEST.MF")
                                zos.putNextEntry(manifestEntry)
                                zos.write("Manifest-Version: 1.0\nCreated-By: OpenManager (JADX Decompiler)\n".toByteArray(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
                                zos.closeEntry()

                                for ((index, cls) in classes.withIndex()) {
                                    if (isCancelled?.invoke() == true) {
                                        throw InterruptedException("JADX export cancelled by user")
                                    }
                                    val fullName = cls.fullName
                                    if (fullName.isNullOrBlank()) continue
                                    onProgress?.invoke(index + 1, total, fullName)

                                    val code = try { cls.code } catch (_: Throwable) { null }
                                    if (!code.isNullOrBlank()) {
                                        val entryPath = sanitizeRelativeSourcePath(fullName)
                                        zos.putNextEntry(ZipEntry(entryPath))
                                        zos.write(code.toByteArray(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
                                        zos.closeEntry()
                                        writtenCount++
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            if (writtenCount > 0) {
                                return outputZipFile
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } catch (ie: InterruptedException) {
                    throw ie
                } catch (_: Throwable) {}
            }

            // 2. Android ART Native Path: Dexlib2 + Baksmali ZIP export
            val allClassDefs = mutableListOf<com.android.tools.smali.dexlib2.iface.ClassDef>()
            for (dex in dexFiles) {
                try {
                    val dexBacked = me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist.ApktoolEngine.loadDexSafely(dex)
                    allClassDefs.addAll(dexBacked.classes)
                } catch (_: Throwable) {}
            }
            val total = allClassDefs.size
            ZipOutputStream(FileOutputStream(outputZipFile).buffered()).use { zos ->
                for ((index, classDef) in allClassDefs.withIndex()) {
                    if (isCancelled?.invoke() == true) {
                        throw InterruptedException("Decompilation cancelled by user")
                    }
                    val fullName = normalizeClassName(classDef.type)
                    onProgress?.invoke(index + 1, total, fullName)
                    val entryPath = sanitizeRelativeSourcePath(fullName)
                    zos.putNextEntry(ZipEntry(entryPath))
                    val code = try {
                        decompileClassDefFallback(classDef)
                    } catch (t: Throwable) {
                        "// Error al descompilar clase $fullName: ${t.message}\n"
                    }
                    zos.write(code.toByteArray(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
                    zos.closeEntry()
                }
            }
        } finally {
            try { workDir.deleteRecursively() } catch (_: Throwable) {}
        }
        return outputZipFile
    }

    /**
     * Batch decompiles all classes from a DEX or APK file directly into a directory of .java source files.
     * Preserves standard package hierarchy (e.g. com/example/MainActivity.java).
     * Bypasses JadxPluginManager (ServiceLoader) via loadJadxRootDirect and automatically falls back
     * to Dexlib2 + Baksmali for any class or runtime where needed.
     */
    fun decompileToDirectory(
        inputFile: File,
        outputDir: File,
        isCancelled: (() -> Boolean)? = null,
        onProgress: ((current: Int, total: Int, currentClass: String) -> Unit)? = null
    ): File {
        if (!outputDir.exists()) {
            outputDir.mkdirs()
        }

        val workDir = File(outputDir.parentFile ?: outputDir, ".tmp_dex_${System.currentTimeMillis()}").apply { mkdirs() }
        try {
            val dexFiles = extractDexFiles(inputFile, workDir)
            var writtenCount = 0

            // 1. Try JADX when not on Android ART, guarded by catch (Throwable)
            if (!isAndroidRuntime()) {
                try {
                    val args = createAndroidSafeJadxArgs(inputFile)
                    JadxDecompiler(args).use { decompiler ->
                        decompiler.load()
                        val classes = decompiler.classes
                        val total = classes.size
                        val canonicalOutPrefix = outputDir.canonicalPath + File.separator

                        for ((index, cls) in classes.withIndex()) {
                            if (isCancelled?.invoke() == true) {
                                throw InterruptedException("JADX decompilation cancelled by user")
                            }
                            val fullName = cls.fullName
                            if (fullName.isNullOrBlank()) continue
                            onProgress?.invoke(index + 1, total, fullName)

                            val relPath = sanitizeRelativeSourcePath(fullName).replace('/', File.separatorChar)
                            val targetFile = File(outputDir, relPath)
                            if (!targetFile.canonicalPath.startsWith(canonicalOutPrefix)) {
                                continue
                            }
                            targetFile.parentFile?.mkdirs()

                            val code = try { cls.code } catch (_: Throwable) { null }
                            if (!code.isNullOrBlank()) {
                                targetFile.writeText(code, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
                                writtenCount++
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } catch (ie: InterruptedException) {
                    throw ie
                } catch (_: Throwable) {}
            }

            if (writtenCount > 0) {
                return outputDir
            }

            // 2. Android ART Fallback: Use Dexlib2 + Baksmali to guarantee 100% reliable decompilation
            val allClassDefs = mutableListOf<com.android.tools.smali.dexlib2.iface.ClassDef>()
            for (dex in dexFiles) {
                if (isCancelled?.invoke() == true) throw InterruptedException()
                try {
                    val dexBacked = me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist.ApktoolEngine.loadDexSafely(dex)
                    allClassDefs.addAll(dexBacked.classes)
                } catch (_: Throwable) {}
            }

            val total = allClassDefs.size
            val canonicalOutPrefix = outputDir.canonicalPath + File.separator
            for ((index, classDef) in allClassDefs.withIndex()) {
                if (isCancelled?.invoke() == true) {
                    throw InterruptedException("Decompilation cancelled by user")
                }
                val fullName = normalizeClassName(classDef.type)
                if (fullName.isBlank()) continue
                onProgress?.invoke(index + 1, total, fullName)

                val relPath = sanitizeRelativeSourcePath(fullName).replace('/', File.separatorChar)
                val targetFile = File(outputDir, relPath)
                if (!targetFile.canonicalPath.startsWith(canonicalOutPrefix)) {
                    continue
                }
                targetFile.parentFile?.mkdirs()

                try {
                    val code = decompileClassDefFallback(classDef)
                    targetFile.writeText(code, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
                } catch (t: Throwable) {
                    targetFile.writeText("// Error al descompilar clase $fullName: ${t.message}\n", StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
                }
            }
        } finally {
            try { workDir.deleteRecursively() } catch (_: Throwable) {}
        }

        return outputDir
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/viewer/hex/HexBuffer.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.viewer.hex

import java.nio.charset.Charset
import java.util.Locale

class HexBuffer(initialData: ByteArray) {

    private var data: ByteArray = initialData
    val size: Int get() = data.size

    val modifiedIndices = mutableSetOf<Int>()

    sealed class Action {
        data class Replace(val offset: Int, val oldBytes: ByteArray, val newBytes: ByteArray) : Action()
        data class Insert(val offset: Int, val bytes: ByteArray) : Action()
        data class Delete(val offset: Int, val oldBytes: ByteArray) : Action()
    }

    private val undoStack = mutableListOf<Action>()
    private val redoStack = mutableListOf<Action>()

    val canUndo: Boolean get() = undoStack.isNotEmpty()
    val canRedo: Boolean get() = redoStack.isNotEmpty()
    val isModified: Boolean get() = undoStack.isNotEmpty() || modifiedIndices.isNotEmpty()

    fun getByte(offset: Int): Byte {
        if (offset < 0 || offset >= data.size) return 0
        return data[offset]
    }

    fun getBytes(offset: Int, length: Int): ByteArray {
        if (offset < 0 || offset >= data.size || length <= 0) return ByteArray(0)
        val actualLen = minOf(length, data.size - offset)
        return data.copyOfRange(offset, offset + actualLen)
    }

    fun modifyBytes(offset: Int, newBytes: ByteArray) {
        if (offset < 0 || offset >= data.size || newBytes.isEmpty()) return
        val count = minOf(newBytes.size, data.size - offset)
        val oldBytes = data.copyOfRange(offset, offset + count)
        val appliedNewBytes = if (count == newBytes.size) newBytes else newBytes.copyOfRange(0, count)

        System.arraycopy(appliedNewBytes, 0, data, offset, count)
        for (i in 0 until count) {
            modifiedIndices.add(offset + i)
        }
        undoStack.add(Action.Replace(offset, oldBytes, appliedNewBytes))
        redoStack.clear()
    }

    fun modifyByte(offset: Int, b: Byte) {
        modifyBytes(offset, byteArrayOf(b))
    }

    fun insertBytes(offset: Int, bytesToInsert: ByteArray) {
        if (offset < 0 || offset > data.size || bytesToInsert.isEmpty()) return
        val newArr = ByteArray(data.size + bytesToInsert.size)
        System.arraycopy(data, 0, newArr, 0, offset)
        System.arraycopy(bytesToInsert, 0, newArr, offset, bytesToInsert.size)
        System.arraycopy(data, offset, newArr, offset + bytesToInsert.size, data.size - offset)
        data = newArr

        val shifted = mutableSetOf<Int>()
        for (idx in modifiedIndices) {
            if (idx >= offset) {
                shifted.add(idx + bytesToInsert.size)
            } else {
                shifted.add(idx)
            }
        }
        for (i in bytesToInsert.indices) {
            shifted.add(offset + i)
        }
        modifiedIndices.clear()
        modifiedIndices.addAll(shifted)

        undoStack.add(Action.Insert(offset, bytesToInsert))
        redoStack.clear()
    }

    fun deleteBytes(offset: Int, count: Int) {
        if (offset < 0 || offset >= data.size || count <= 0) return
        val actualCount = minOf(count, data.size - offset)
        val deleted = data.copyOfRange(offset, offset + actualCount)
        val newArr = ByteArray(data.size - actualCount)
        System.arraycopy(data, 0, newArr, 0, offset)
        System.arraycopy(data, offset + actualCount, newArr, offset, data.size - (offset + actualCount))
        data = newArr

        val shifted = mutableSetOf<Int>()
        for (idx in modifiedIndices) {
            if (idx in offset until (offset + actualCount)) {
                // deleted
            } else if (idx >= offset + actualCount) {
                shifted.add(idx - actualCount)
            } else {
                shifted.add(idx)
            }
        }
        modifiedIndices.clear()
        modifiedIndices.addAll(shifted)

        undoStack.add(Action.Delete(offset, deleted))
        redoStack.clear()
    }

    fun fillRange(startOffset: Int, endOffset: Int, fillByte: Byte) {
        if (startOffset < 0 || startOffset >= data.size) return
        val end = endOffset.coerceIn(startOffset, data.size - 1)
        val count = end - startOffset + 1
        val fillArr = ByteArray(count) { fillByte }
        modifyBytes(startOffset, fillArr)
    }

    fun undo(): Int {
        if (undoStack.isEmpty()) return -1
        val action = undoStack.removeAt(undoStack.lastIndex)
        redoStack.add(action)
        return when (action) {
            is Action.Replace -> {
                System.arraycopy(action.oldBytes, 0, data, action.offset, action.oldBytes.size)
                rebuildModifiedIndices()
                action.offset
            }
            is Action.Insert -> {
                val newArr = ByteArray(data.size - action.bytes.size)
                System.arraycopy(data, 0, newArr, 0, action.offset)
                System.arraycopy(data, action.offset + action.bytes.size, newArr, action.offset, data.size - (action.offset + action.bytes.size))
                data = newArr
                rebuildModifiedIndices()
                action.offset
            }
            is Action.Delete -> {
                val newArr = ByteArray(data.size + action.oldBytes.size)
                System.arraycopy(data, 0, newArr, 0, action.offset)
                System.arraycopy(action.oldBytes, 0, newArr, action.offset, action.oldBytes.size)
                System.arraycopy(data, action.offset, newArr, action.offset + action.oldBytes.size, data.size - action.offset)
                data = newArr
                rebuildModifiedIndices()
                action.offset
            }
        }
    }

    fun redo(): Int {
        if (redoStack.isEmpty()) return -1
        val action = redoStack.removeAt(redoStack.lastIndex)
        undoStack.add(action)
        return when (action) {
            is Action.Replace -> {
                System.arraycopy(action.newBytes, 0, data, action.offset, action.newBytes.size)
                rebuildModifiedIndices()
                action.offset
            }
            is Action.Insert -> {
                val newArr = ByteArray(data.size + action.bytes.size)
                System.arraycopy(data, 0, newArr, 0, action.offset)
                System.arraycopy(action.bytes, 0, newArr, action.offset, action.bytes.size)
                System.arraycopy(data, action.offset, newArr, action.offset + action.bytes.size, data.size - action.offset)
                data = newArr
                rebuildModifiedIndices()
                action.offset
            }
            is Action.Delete -> {
                val newArr = ByteArray(data.size - action.oldBytes.size)
                System.arraycopy(data, 0, newArr, 0, action.offset)
                System.arraycopy(data, action.offset + action.oldBytes.size, newArr, action.offset, data.size - (action.offset + action.oldBytes.size))
                data = newArr
                rebuildModifiedIndices()
                action.offset
            }
        }
    }

    private fun rebuildModifiedIndices() {
        modifiedIndices.clear()
        for (act in undoStack) {
            when (act) {
                is Action.Replace -> {
                    for (i in act.newBytes.indices) {
                        modifiedIndices.add(act.offset + i)
                    }
                }
                is Action.Insert -> {
                    for (i in act.bytes.indices) {
                        modifiedIndices.add(act.offset + i)
                    }
                }
                is Action.Delete -> {}
            }
        }
    }

    fun toByteArray(): ByteArray = data.clone()

    fun searchHex(pattern: ByteArray, startOffset: Int, forward: Boolean): Int {
        if (pattern.isEmpty() || data.isEmpty() || data.size < pattern.size) return -1
        if (forward) {
            val start = startOffset.coerceIn(0, data.size - pattern.size)
            for (i in start..(data.size - pattern.size)) {
                var match = true
                for (j in pattern.indices) {
                    if (data[i + j] != pattern[j]) {
                        match = false
                        break
                    }
                }
                if (match) return i
            }
        } else {
            val start = startOffset.coerceIn(0, data.size - pattern.size)
            for (i in start downTo 0) {
                var match = true
                for (j in pattern.indices) {
                    if (data[i + j] != pattern[j]) {
                        match = false
                        break
                    }
                }
                if (match) return i
            }
        }
        return -1
    }

    fun searchText(text: String, startOffset: Int, forward: Boolean, ignoreCase: Boolean, charset: Charset = Charsets.UTF_8): Int {
        if (text.isEmpty() || data.isEmpty()) return -1
        val pattern = text.toByteArray(charset)
        if (data.size < pattern.size) return -1
        if (!ignoreCase) {
            return searchHex(pattern, startOffset, forward)
        } else {
            val lower = text.lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
            val len = text.length
            if (data.size < len) return -1
            if (forward) {
                val start = startOffset.coerceIn(0, data.size - len)
                for (i in start..(data.size - len)) {
                    var match = true
                    for (j in 0 until len) {
                        val c = (data[i + j].toInt() and 0xFF).toChar().lowercaseChar()
                        if (c != lower[j]) {
                            match = false
                            break
                        }
                    }
                    if (match) return i
                }
            } else {
                val start = startOffset.coerceIn(0, data.size - len)
                for (i in start downTo 0) {
                    var match = true
                    for (j in 0 until len) {
                        val c = (data[i + j].toInt() and 0xFF).toChar().lowercaseChar()
                        if (c != lower[j]) {
                            match = false
                            break
                        }
                    }
                    if (match) return i
                }
            }
            return -1
        }
    }

    fun replace(offset: Int, patternLength: Int, replacement: ByteArray) {
        if (patternLength == replacement.size) {
            modifyBytes(offset, replacement)
        } else {
            deleteBytes(offset, patternLength)
            insertBytes(offset, replacement)
        }
    }

    fun replaceAllHex(pattern: ByteArray, replacement: ByteArray): Int {
        if (pattern.isEmpty() || data.isEmpty() || data.size < pattern.size) return 0
        var count = 0
        var cur = searchHex(pattern, 0, forward = true)
        while (cur != -1 && cur <= data.size - pattern.size) {
            replace(cur, pattern.size, replacement)
            count++
            val nextOffset = if (replacement.isEmpty()) cur else cur + replacement.size
            if (nextOffset > data.size) break
            cur = searchHex(pattern, nextOffset, forward = true)
        }
        return count
    }

    fun markSaved() {
        undoStack.clear()
        redoStack.clear()
        modifiedIndices.clear()
    }
}
```

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.viewer.hex
```
