```kt
class HexEditorActivity : AppActivity() {

    private lateinit var binding: ActivityHexEditorBinding
    private lateinit var path: Path

    private var buffer: HexBuffer = HexBuffer(ByteArray(0))
    private lateinit var adapter: HexRowAdapter
    private var monoTypeface: Typeface = Typeface.MONOSPACE

    private var currentOffset: Int = 0
    private var isReadOnly: Boolean = false
    private var currentCharset: Charset = Charsets.UTF_8

    // Search state
    private var isSearchHexMode = true
    private var lastSearchQuery = ""
    private var lastMatchOffset = -1

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityHexEditorBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        path = intent.extraPath ?: run {
            finish()
            return
        }

        try {
            monoTypeface = Typeface.createFromAsset(assets, "Mono.ttf")
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            monoTypeface = Typeface.MONOSPACE
        }

        setupToolbar()
        setupInspectorChips()
        setupSearchPanel()
        setupRecyclerView()
        loadFileContent()

        onBackPressedDispatcher.addCallback(this, object : OnBackPressedCallback(true) {
            override fun handleOnBackPressed() {
                if (binding.searchBarContainer.visibility == View.VISIBLE) {
                    closeSearch()
                    return
                }
                if (buffer.isModified) {
                    showUnsavedChangesDialog()
                } else {
                    finish()
                }
            }
        })
    }

    private fun setupToolbar() {
        binding.toolbar.title = path.fileName.toString()
        binding.toolbar.subtitle = getString(R.string.hex_editor_bytes_count, 0)
        setSupportActionBar(binding.toolbar)
        binding.toolbar.setNavigationOnClickListener {
            onBackPressedDispatcher.onBackPressed()
        }
    }

    private fun setupRecyclerView() {
        adapter = HexRowAdapter(buffer, monoTypeface) { clickedOffset ->
            selectOffset(clickedOffset)
        }
        binding.rvHex.layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(this)
        binding.rvHex.adapter = adapter
    }

    private fun setupInspectorChips() {
        binding.cardHex.tvCardLabel.text = "HEX"
        binding.cardDec.tvCardLabel.text = "DEC (U8)"
        binding.cardInt8.tvCardLabel.text = "INT8"
        binding.cardInt16.tvCardLabel.text = "INT16 (LE)"
        binding.cardInt32.tvCardLabel.text = "INT32 (LE)"
        binding.cardChar.tvCardLabel.text = "ASCII"
        binding.cardBin.tvCardLabel.text = "BINARIO"
        binding.cardFloat.tvCardLabel.text = "FLOAT32"

        val copyListener = View.OnClickListener { v ->
            val text = when (v) {
                binding.cardHex.root -> binding.cardHex.tvCardValue.text
                binding.cardDec.root -> binding.cardDec.tvCardValue.text
                binding.cardInt8.root -> binding.cardInt8.tvCardValue.text
                binding.cardInt16.root -> binding.cardInt16.tvCardValue.text
                binding.cardInt32.root -> binding.cardInt32.tvCardValue.text
                binding.cardChar.root -> binding.cardChar.tvCardValue.text
                binding.cardBin.root -> binding.cardBin.tvCardValue.text
                binding.cardFloat.root -> binding.cardFloat.tvCardValue.text
                else -> ""
            }
            if (text.isNotEmpty() && text != "-") {
                copyToClipboard(text.toString())
            }
        }

        binding.cardHex.root.setOnClickListener(copyListener)
        binding.cardDec.root.setOnClickListener(copyListener)
        binding.cardInt8.root.setOnClickListener(copyListener)
        binding.cardInt16.root.setOnClickListener(copyListener)
        binding.cardInt32.root.setOnClickListener(copyListener)
        binding.cardChar.root.setOnClickListener(copyListener)
        binding.cardBin.root.setOnClickListener(copyListener)
        binding.cardFloat.root.setOnClickListener(copyListener)

        binding.btnEditByte.setOnClickListener {
            if (isReadOnly) {
                showToast(R.string.hex_editor_readonly)
            } else {
                showEditByteDialog(currentOffset)
            }
        }

        binding.btnCopyHex.setOnClickListener {
            val hex = String.format("%02X", buffer.getByte(currentOffset).toInt() and 0xFF)
            copyToClipboard(hex)
        }

        binding.btnCopyAscii.setOnClickListener {
            val b = buffer.getByte(currentOffset).toInt() and 0xFF
            val ch = if (b in 32..126) b.toChar().toString() else "."
            copyToClipboard(ch)
        }
    }

    private fun setupSearchPanel() {
        binding.btnSearchMode.setOnClickListener {
            isSearchHexMode = !isSearchHexMode
            binding.btnSearchMode.text = if (isSearchHexMode) "HEX" else "TXT"
            binding.cbMatchCase.visibility = if (isSearchHexMode) View.GONE else View.VISIBLE
            binding.etSearch.hint = if (isSearchHexMode) {
                getString(R.string.hex_editor_search_hint)
            } else {
                "Buscar texto…"
            }
        }

        binding.btnSearchNext.setOnClickListener { performSearch(forward = true) }
        binding.btnSearchPrev.setOnClickListener { performSearch(forward = false) }

        binding.btnToggleReplace.setOnClickListener {
            val isVisible = binding.replaceContainer.visibility == View.VISIBLE
            binding.replaceContainer.visibility = if (isVisible) View.GONE else View.VISIBLE
        }

        binding.btnCloseSearch.setOnClickListener { closeSearch() }

        binding.btnReplace.setOnClickListener { performReplaceCurrent() }
        binding.btnReplaceAll.setOnClickListener { performReplaceAll() }
    }

    private fun loadFileContent() {
        lifecycleScope.launch {
            binding.progressBar.visibility = View.VISIBLE
            val maxSafeBytes = 25L * 1024L * 1024L // 25 MB
            val fileSize = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                try {
                    java8.nio.file.Files.size(path)
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    -1L
                }
            }
            if (fileSize > maxSafeBytes) {
                binding.progressBar.visibility = View.GONE
                MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(this@HexEditorActivity)
                    .setTitle("Archivo demasiado grande")
                    .setMessage("El archivo supera el límite seguro de 25 MB para edición hexadecimal en memoria (${formatFileSize(fileSize)}).\n\nPara evitar cierres forzados por memoria insuficiente (OOM), no se puede cargar en este modo.")
                    .setPositiveButton(android.R.string.ok) { _, _ -> finish() }
                    .setCancelable(false)
                    .show()
                return@launch
            }

            val rawBytes = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                try {
                    path.newInputStream().use { stream -> stream.readBytes() }
                } catch (e: OutOfMemoryError) {
                    System.gc()
                    null
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    null
                }
            }
            binding.progressBar.visibility = View.GONE

            if (rawBytes == null) {
                showToast("Error al leer el archivo o memoria insuficiente")
                finish()
                return@launch
            }

            buffer = HexBuffer(rawBytes)
            adapter.updateBuffer(buffer)
            selectOffset(0)
            updateToolbarInfo()
        }
    }

    private fun selectOffset(offset: Int) {
        if (buffer.size == 0) return
        currentOffset = offset.coerceIn(0, buffer.size - 1)
        adapter.selectedOffset = currentOffset

        val data = HexInspector.inspect(buffer, currentOffset)
        binding.cardHex.tvCardValue.text = data.hexStr
        binding.cardDec.tvCardValue.text = data.uint8Str
        binding.cardInt8.tvCardValue.text = data.int8Str
        binding.cardInt16.tvCardValue.text = data.int16LEStr
        binding.cardInt32.tvCardValue.text = data.int32LEStr
        binding.cardChar.tvCardValue.text = data.charStr
        binding.cardBin.tvCardValue.text = data.binStr
        binding.cardFloat.tvCardValue.text = data.float32LEStr

        val isMod = buffer.modifiedIndices.contains(currentOffset)
        val modLabel = if (isMod) " • [Modificado]" else ""
        binding.tvSelectionInfo.text = String.format("Offset: 0x%08X (%d)%s", currentOffset, currentOffset, modLabel)
        updateToolbarInfo()
    }

    private fun updateToolbarInfo() {
        val sizeFormatted = formatFileSize(buffer.size.toLong())
        val dirtyMark = if (buffer.isModified) "* " else ""
        binding.toolbar.title = "$dirtyMark${path.fileName}"
        binding.toolbar.subtitle = String.format("%s • Offset: 0x%08X", sizeFormatted, currentOffset)
    }

    private fun formatFileSize(size: Long): String {
        return when {
            size < 1024 -> "$size B"
            size < 1024 * 1024 -> String.format("%.1f KB", size / 1024.0)
            else -> String.format("%.2f MB", size / (1024.0 * 1024.0))
        }
    }

    private fun performSearch(forward: Boolean) {
        val query = binding.etSearch.text.toString().trim()
        if (query.isEmpty()) return

        val searchStart = if (forward) {
            if (lastSearchQuery == query && lastMatchOffset != -1) lastMatchOffset + 1 else currentOffset
        } else {
            if (lastSearchQuery == query && lastMatchOffset != -1) lastMatchOffset - 1 else currentOffset
        }

        lastSearchQuery = query

        val matchOffset: Int
        val matchLength: Int

        if (isSearchHexMode) {
            val hexPattern = parseHexPattern(query)
            if (hexPattern == null || hexPattern.isEmpty()) {
                binding.tvSearchStatus.text = getString(R.string.hex_editor_invalid_hex)
                return
            }
            matchOffset = buffer.searchHex(hexPattern, searchStart, forward)
            matchLength = hexPattern.size
        } else {
            val ignoreCase = !binding.cbMatchCase.isChecked
            matchOffset = buffer.searchText(query, searchStart, forward, ignoreCase, currentCharset)
            matchLength = query.toByteArray(currentCharset).size
        }

        if (matchOffset != -1) {
            lastMatchOffset = matchOffset
            adapter.highlightRange = matchOffset until (matchOffset + matchLength)
            selectOffset(matchOffset)
            binding.rvHex.scrollToPosition(matchOffset / 16)
            binding.tvSearchStatus.text = getString(R.string.hex_editor_match_status, matchOffset)
        } else {
            binding.tvSearchStatus.text = getString(R.string.hex_editor_not_found)
        }
    }

    private fun performReplaceCurrent() {
        if (isReadOnly) {
            showToast(R.string.hex_editor_readonly)
            return
        }
        val targetQuery = binding.etSearch.text.toString().trim()
        val replaceQuery = binding.etReplace.text.toString().trim()
        if (targetQuery.isEmpty() || lastMatchOffset == -1) return

        val targetBytes = if (isSearchHexMode) parseHexPattern(targetQuery) else targetQuery.toByteArray(currentCharset)
        val replaceBytes = if (isSearchHexMode) parseHexPattern(replaceQuery) else replaceQuery.toByteArray(currentCharset)

        if (targetBytes == null || replaceBytes == null) {
            showToast(R.string.hex_editor_invalid_hex)
            return
        }

        buffer.replace(lastMatchOffset, targetBytes.size, replaceBytes)
        adapter.updateBuffer(buffer)
        selectOffset(lastMatchOffset)
        performSearch(forward = true)
    }

    private fun performReplaceAll() {
        if (isReadOnly) {
            showToast(R.string.hex_editor_readonly)
            return
        }
        val targetQuery = binding.etSearch.text.toString().trim()
        val replaceQuery = binding.etReplace.text.toString().trim()
        if (targetQuery.isEmpty()) return

        val targetBytes = if (isSearchHexMode) parseHexPattern(targetQuery) else targetQuery.toByteArray(currentCharset)
        val replaceBytes = if (isSearchHexMode) parseHexPattern(replaceQuery) else replaceQuery.toByteArray(currentCharset)

        if (targetBytes == null || replaceBytes == null) {
            showToast(R.string.hex_editor_invalid_hex)
            return
        }

        val count = buffer.replaceAllHex(targetBytes, replaceBytes)
        adapter.updateBuffer(buffer)
        selectOffset(currentOffset)
        showToast("Reemplazos realizados: $count")
        binding.tvSearchStatus.text = "Reemplazos: $count"
    }

    private fun closeSearch() {
        binding.searchBarContainer.visibility = View.GONE
        adapter.highlightRange = null
        lastMatchOffset = -1
    }

    private fun showEditByteDialog(offset: Int) {
        val dialogBinding = DialogHexEditByteBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        dialogBinding.tvTargetOffset.text = String.format("Offset: 0x%08X (%d)", offset, offset)

        val curByte = buffer.getByte(offset).toInt() and 0xFF
        dialogBinding.etValue.setText(String.format("%02X", curByte))
        dialogBinding.etValue.selectAll()

        dialogBinding.rgInputType.setOnCheckedChangeListener { _, checkedId ->
            if (checkedId == R.id.rbHex) {
                dialogBinding.tilValue.hint = getString(R.string.hex_editor_input_hex_hint)
            } else {
                dialogBinding.tilValue.hint = getString(R.string.hex_editor_input_text_hint)
            }
        }

        val updatePreview: () -> Unit = {
            val text = dialogBinding.etValue.text.toString()
            if (dialogBinding.rbHex.isChecked) {
                val bytes = parseHexPattern(text)
                if (bytes != null) {
                    val ascii = bytes.map { b ->
                        val u = b.toInt() and 0xFF
                        if (u in 32..126) u.toChar() else '.'
                    }.joinToString("")
                    dialogBinding.tvPreview.text = "Bytes: ${bytes.size}  |  Texto: $ascii"
                } else {
                    dialogBinding.tvPreview.text = "Hex inválido"
                }
            } else {
                val bytes = text.toByteArray(currentCharset)
                val hexStr = bytes.joinToString(" ") { String.format("%02X", it.toInt() and 0xFF) }
                dialogBinding.tvPreview.text = "Bytes: ${bytes.size}  |  Hex: $hexStr"
            }
        }

        dialogBinding.etValue.addTextChangedListener(object : TextWatcher {
            override fun beforeTextChanged(s: CharSequence?, start: Int, count: Int, after: Int) {}
            override fun onTextChanged(s: CharSequence?, start: Int, before: Int, count: Int) {
                updatePreview()
            }
            override fun afterTextChanged(s: Editable?) {}
        })

        MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(this)
            .setTitle(R.string.hex_editor_edit_byte)
            .setView(dialogBinding.root)
            .setPositiveButton(android.R.string.ok) { _, _ ->
                val text = dialogBinding.etValue.text.toString()
                val bytes = if (dialogBinding.rbHex.isChecked) {
                    parseHexPattern(text)
                } else {
                    text.toByteArray(currentCharset)
                }

                if (bytes == null || bytes.isEmpty()) {
                    showToast(R.string.hex_editor_invalid_hex)
                    return@setPositiveButton
                }

                if (dialogBinding.rbOverwrite.isChecked) {
                    buffer.modifyBytes(offset, bytes)
                } else {
                    buffer.insertBytes(offset, bytes)
                }

                adapter.updateBuffer(buffer)
                selectOffset(offset)
            }
            .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
            .show()
    }

    private fun showGotoOffsetDialog() {
        val dialogBinding = DialogHexGotoBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        dialogBinding.etOffset.setText(String.format("0x%X", currentOffset))
        dialogBinding.etOffset.selectAll()

        dialogBinding.btnQuickStart.setOnClickListener {
            dialogBinding.etOffset.setText("0x0")
        }
        dialogBinding.btnQuickEnd.setOnClickListener {
            dialogBinding.etOffset.setText(String.format("0x%X", (buffer.size - 1).coerceAtLeast(0)))
        }
        dialogBinding.btnQuickMinus1K.setOnClickListener {
            val cur = parseOffset(dialogBinding.etOffset.text.toString()) ?: currentOffset
            val next = (cur - 1024).coerceAtLeast(0)
            dialogBinding.etOffset.setText(String.format("0x%X", next))
        }
        dialogBinding.btnQuickPlus1K.setOnClickListener {
            val cur = parseOffset(dialogBinding.etOffset.text.toString()) ?: currentOffset
            val next = (cur + 1024).coerceAtMost((buffer.size - 1).coerceAtLeast(0))
            dialogBinding.etOffset.setText(String.format("0x%X", next))
        }

        MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(this)
            .setTitle(R.string.hex_editor_goto_offset)
            .setView(dialogBinding.root)
            .setPositiveButton(android.R.string.ok) { _, _ ->
                val target = parseOffset(dialogBinding.etOffset.text.toString())
                if (target == null || target < 0 || target >= buffer.size) {
                    showToast(R.string.hex_editor_invalid_offset)
                    return@setPositiveButton
                }
                selectOffset(target)
                binding.rvHex.scrollToPosition(target / 16)
            }
            .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
            .show()
    }

    private fun showInsertBytesDialog() {
        if (isReadOnly) {
            showToast(R.string.hex_editor_readonly)
            return
        }
        val dialogBinding = DialogHexInsertBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        dialogBinding.etOffset.setText(String.format("0x%X", currentOffset))

        MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(this)
            .setTitle(R.string.hex_editor_insert_bytes)
            .setView(dialogBinding.root)
            .setPositiveButton(android.R.string.ok) { _, _ ->
                val off = parseOffset(dialogBinding.etOffset.text.toString()) ?: currentOffset
                val count = dialogBinding.etCount.text.toString().toIntOrNull() ?: 1
                val fillByte = parseByte(dialogBinding.etFillByte.text.toString()) ?: 0

                val newBytes = ByteArray(count) { fillByte }
                buffer.insertBytes(off, newBytes)
                adapter.updateBuffer(buffer)
                selectOffset(off)
            }
            .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
            .show()
    }

    private fun showDeleteBytesDialog() {
        if (isReadOnly) {
            showToast(R.string.hex_editor_readonly)
            return
        }
        val input = android.widget.EditText(this).apply {
            hint = "Cantidad de bytes a eliminar"
            inputType = android.text.InputType.TYPE_CLASS_NUMBER
            setText("1")
        }

        MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(this)
            .setTitle(R.string.hex_editor_delete_bytes)
            .setMessage(String.format("Eliminar bytes a partir del offset 0x%08X", currentOffset))
            .setView(input)
            .setPositiveButton(R.string.delete) { _, _ ->
                val count = input.text.toString().toIntOrNull() ?: 1
                buffer.deleteBytes(currentOffset, count)
                adapter.updateBuffer(buffer)
                selectOffset(currentOffset)
            }
            .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
            .show()
    }

    private fun showFillRangeDialog() {
        if (isReadOnly) {
            showToast(R.string.hex_editor_readonly)
            return
        }
        val dialogBinding = DialogHexFillBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        dialogBinding.etStartOffset.setText(String.format("0x%X", currentOffset))
        dialogBinding.etEndOffset.setText(String.format("0x%X", (currentOffset + 15).coerceAtMost(buffer.size - 1)))

        MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(this)
            .setTitle(R.string.hex_editor_fill_range)
            .setView(dialogBinding.root)
            .setPositiveButton(android.R.string.ok) { _, _ ->
                val start = parseOffset(dialogBinding.etStartOffset.text.toString()) ?: currentOffset
                val end = parseOffset(dialogBinding.etEndOffset.text.toString()) ?: currentOffset
                val fillByte = parseByte(dialogBinding.etFillByte.text.toString()) ?: 0

                buffer.fillRange(start, end, fillByte)
                adapter.updateBuffer(buffer)
                selectOffset(start)
            }
            .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
            .show()
    }

    private fun showFileInfoDialog() {
        lifecycleScope.launch {
            val md5: String
            val sha1: String
            val sha256: String
            withContext(Dispatchers.Default) {
                val bytes = buffer.toByteArray()
                md5 = hashBytes(bytes, "MD5")
                sha1 = hashBytes(bytes, "SHA-1")
                sha256 = hashBytes(bytes, "SHA-256")
            }

            val msg = StringBuilder()
                .append("Archivo: ").append(path.fileName).append("\n")
                .append("Tamaño: ").append(buffer.size).append(" bytes (").append(formatFileSize(buffer.size.toLong())).append(")\n\n")
                .append("MD5:\n").append(md5).append("\n\n")
                .append("SHA-1:\n").append(sha1).append("\n\n")
                .append("SHA-256:\n").append(sha256)
                .toString()

            MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(this@HexEditorActivity)
                .setTitle(R.string.hex_editor_file_info)
                .setMessage(msg)
                .setPositiveButton("Copiar Hashes") { _, _ ->
                    copyToClipboard(msg)
                }
                .setNegativeButton(R.string.close, null)
                .show()
        }
    }

    private fun showEncodingDialog() {
        val encodings = arrayOf("UTF-8", "ASCII", "ISO-8859-1", "UTF-16LE", "UTF-16BE", "GBK")
        val currentIdx = encodings.indexOfFirst { it.equals(currentCharset.name(), ignoreCase = true) }.coerceAtLeast(0)

        MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(this)
            .setTitle(R.string.hex_editor_encoding)
            .setSingleChoiceItems(encodings, currentIdx) { dialog, which ->
                try {
                    currentCharset = Charset.forName(encodings[which])
                    showToast("Codificación: ${encodings[which]}")
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    showToast("Codificación no soportada")
                }
                dialog.dismiss()
            }
            .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
            .show()
    }

    private fun saveFile(onComplete: ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = null) {
        if (!buffer.isModified) {
            showToast(R.string.hex_editor_saved_success)
            onComplete?.invoke(true)
            return
        }

        if (DeadManProtectionManager.isDfrootProtectionActive(this) &&
            DeadManProtectionManager.isProtectedFromModification(path)
        ) {
            DeadManProtectionManager.showDirtyFlagProtectionDialog(this)
            return
        }
        performSaveFile(onComplete)
    }

    private fun performSaveFile(onComplete: ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = null) {
        val content = buffer.toByteArray()
        FileJobService.write(path, content, this) { successful ->
            if (successful) {
                buffer.markSaved()
                adapter.notifyDataSetChanged()
                updateToolbarInfo()
                showToast(R.string.hex_editor_saved_success)
            } else {
                showToast(getString(R.string.hex_editor_save_failed, "I/O error"))
            }
            onComplete?.invoke(successful)
        }
    }

    private fun showUnsavedChangesDialog() {
        MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(this)
            .setTitle(R.string.hex_editor_title)
            .setMessage(R.string.hex_editor_unsaved_changes)
            .setPositiveButton(R.string.save) { _, _ ->
                saveFile { successful ->
                    if (successful) {
                        finish()
                    }
                }
            }
            .setNegativeButton("Descartar") { _, _ ->
                finish()
            }
            .setNeutralButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
            .show()
    }

    override fun onCreateOptionsMenu(menu: Menu): Boolean {
        menuInflater.inflate(R.menu.hex_editor_menu, menu)
        return true
    }

    override fun onPrepareOptionsMenu(menu: Menu): Boolean {
        menu.findItem(R.id.action_undo)?.isEnabled = buffer.canUndo && !isReadOnly
        menu.findItem(R.id.action_redo)?.isEnabled = buffer.canRedo && !isReadOnly
        menu.findItem(R.id.action_save)?.isEnabled = buffer.isModified && !isReadOnly
        menu.findItem(R.id.action_readonly_toggle)?.isChecked = isReadOnly
        return super.onPrepareOptionsMenu(menu)
    }

    override fun onOptionsItemSelected(item: MenuItem): Boolean {
        return when (item.itemId) {
            R.id.action_undo -> {
                val restoredOffset = buffer.undo()
                adapter.updateBuffer(buffer)
                if (restoredOffset != -1) {
                    selectOffset(restoredOffset)
                }
                updateToolbarInfo()
                invalidateOptionsMenu()
                true
            }
            R.id.action_redo -> {
                val restoredOffset = buffer.redo()
                adapter.updateBuffer(buffer)
                if (restoredOffset != -1) {
                    selectOffset(restoredOffset)
                }
                updateToolbarInfo()
                invalidateOptionsMenu()
                true
            }
            R.id.action_search -> {
                binding.searchBarContainer.visibility = View.VISIBLE
                binding.etSearch.requestFocus()
                true
            }
            R.id.action_save -> {
                saveFile()
                true
            }
            R.id.action_goto -> {
                showGotoOffsetDialog()
                true
            }
            R.id.action_edit -> {
                showEditByteDialog(currentOffset)
                true
            }
            R.id.action_insert -> {
                showInsertBytesDialog()
                true
            }
            R.id.action_delete -> {
                showDeleteBytesDialog()
                true
            }
            R.id.action_fill -> {
                showFillRangeDialog()
                true
            }
            R.id.action_encoding -> {
                showEncodingDialog()
                true
            }
            R.id.action_file_info -> {
                showFileInfoDialog()
                true
            }
            R.id.action_readonly_toggle -> {
                isReadOnly = !isReadOnly
                item.isChecked = isReadOnly
                showToast(if (isReadOnly) R.string.hex_editor_readonly else R.string.hex_editor_edit_mode)
                invalidateOptionsMenu()
                true
            }
            else -> super.onOptionsItemSelected(item)
        }
    }

    private fun parseHexPattern(hexStr: String): ByteArray? {
        val clean = hexStr.replace("\\s+".toRegex(), "").replace("0x", "", ignoreCase = true)
        if (clean.isEmpty() || clean.length % 2 != 0) return null
        return try {
            val len = clean.length / 2
            val result = ByteArray(len)
            for (i in 0 until len) {
                result[i] = clean.substring(i * 2, i * 2 + 2).toInt(16).toByte()
            }
            result
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            null
        }
    }

    private fun parseOffset(str: String): Int? {
        val clean = str.trim()
        return try {
            if (clean.startsWith("0x", ignoreCase = true)) {
                clean.substring(2).toInt(16)
            } else {
                clean.toInt()
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            null
        }
    }

    private fun parseByte(str: String): Byte? {
        val clean = str.trim().replace("0x", "", ignoreCase = true)
        return try {
            clean.toInt(16).toByte()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            null
        }
    }

    private fun hashBytes(bytes: ByteArray, algorithm: String): String {
        return try {
            val digest = MessageDigest.getInstance(algorithm)
            val hash = digest.digest(bytes)
            hash.joinToString("") { String.format("%02x", it) }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            "Error"
        }
    }

    private fun copyToClipboard(text: String) {
        val clipboard = getSystemService<ClipboardManager>()
        clipboard?.setPrimaryClip(ClipData.newPlainText("hex", text))
        showToast(R.string.hex_editor_copied_toast)
    }

    companion object {
        fun start(context: Context, path: Path) {
            val intent = Intent(context, HexEditorActivity::class.java).apply {
                extraPath = path
            }
            context.startActivity(intent)
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/viewer/hex/HexInspector.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.viewer.hex

import java.nio.ByteBuffer
import java.nio.ByteOrder

data class HexInspectorData(
    val offset: Int,
    val hexStr: String,
    val uint8Str: String,
    val int8Str: String,
    val int16LEStr: String,
    val int32LEStr: String,
    val float32LEStr: String,
    val binStr: String,
    val charStr: String
)

object HexInspector {

    fun inspect(buffer: HexBuffer, offset: Int): HexInspectorData {
        if (offset < 0 || offset >= buffer.size) {
            return HexInspectorData(
                offset = offset,
                hexStr = "-",
                uint8Str = "-",
                int8Str = "-",
                int16LEStr = "-",
                int32LEStr = "-",
                float32LEStr = "-",
                binStr = "-",
                charStr = "-"
            )
        }

        val b0 = buffer.getByte(offset).toInt() and 0xFF
        val hexStr = String.format("0x%02X", b0)
        val uint8Str = b0.toString()
        val int8Str = buffer.getByte(offset).toInt().toString()

        val binStr = String.format("%8s", Integer.toBinaryString(b0)).replace(' ', '0')
        val charStr = if (b0 in 32..126) "'${b0.toChar()}'" else "·"

        // Int16 LE
        val int16LEStr = if (offset + 1 < buffer.size) {
            val bytes = buffer.getBytes(offset, 2)
            val v = ByteBuffer.wrap(bytes).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).short
            String.format("0x%04X (%d)", v.toInt() and 0xFFFF, v)
        } else {
            "-"
        }

        // Int32 LE
        val int32LEStr = if (offset + 3 < buffer.size) {
            val bytes = buffer.getBytes(offset, 4)
            val v = ByteBuffer.wrap(bytes).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).int
            String.format("0x%08X (%d)", v, v)
        } else {
            "-"
        }

        // Float32 LE
        val float32LEStr = if (offset + 3 < buffer.size) {
            val bytes = buffer.getBytes(offset, 4)
            val v = ByteBuffer.wrap(bytes).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).float
            String.format("%.4f", v)
        } else {
            "-"
        }

        return HexInspectorData(
            offset = offset,
            hexStr = hexStr,
            uint8Str = uint8Str,
            int8Str = int8Str,
            int16LEStr = int16LEStr,
            int32LEStr = int32LEStr,
            float32LEStr = float32LEStr,
            binStr = binStr,
            charStr = charStr
        )
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/viewer/hex/HexRowAdapter.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.viewer.hex

import android.annotation.SuppressLint
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.Typeface
import android.text.Spannable
import android.text.SpannableStringBuilder
import android.text.style.BackgroundColorSpan
import android.text.style.ForegroundColorSpan
import android.view.GestureDetector
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.MotionEvent
import android.view.ViewGroup
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
import me.zhanghai.android.files.databinding.ItemHexRowBinding

class HexRowAdapter(
    private var buffer: HexBuffer,
    private val typeface: Typeface,
    private val onByteSelected: (Int) -> Unit
) : RecyclerView.Adapter<HexRowAdapter.ViewHolder>() {

    var selectedOffset: Int = 0
        set(value) {
            val count = itemCount
            if (count == 0) {
                field = value
                return
            }
            val oldRow = (field / 16).coerceIn(0, count - 1)
            field = value
            val newRow = (value / 16).coerceIn(0, count - 1)
            if (oldRow == newRow) {
                notifyItemChanged(oldRow)
            } else {
                notifyItemChanged(oldRow)
                notifyItemChanged(newRow)
            }
        }

    var highlightRange: IntRange? = null
        set(value) {
            field = value
            notifyDataSetChanged()
        }

    fun updateBuffer(newBuffer: HexBuffer) {
        this.buffer = newBuffer
        notifyDataSetChanged()
    }

    override fun getItemCount(): Int = (buffer.size + 15) / 16

    @SuppressLint("ClickableViewAccessibility")
    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): ViewHolder {
        val binding = ItemHexRowBinding.inflate(LayoutInflater.from(parent.context), parent, false)
        binding.tvOffset.typeface = typeface
        binding.tvHex.typeface = typeface
        binding.tvAscii.typeface = typeface

        val holder = ViewHolder(binding)

        val hexGestureDetector = GestureDetector(parent.context, object : GestureDetector.SimpleOnGestureListener() {
            override fun onSingleTapUp(e: MotionEvent): Boolean {
                val pos = holder.bindingAdapterPosition
                if (pos == RecyclerView.NO_POSITION) return false
                val rowOffset = pos * 16
                val x = e.x - binding.tvHex.paddingLeft
                if (x >= 0) {
                    val charWidth = binding.tvHex.paint.measureText("0")
                    val charPos = (x / charWidth).toInt()
                    val byteInRow = if (charPos < 24) {
                        (charPos / 3).coerceIn(0, 7)
                    } else {
                        (8 + ((charPos - 25).coerceAtLeast(0) / 3)).coerceIn(8, 15)
                    }
                    val targetOffset = rowOffset + byteInRow
                    if (targetOffset < buffer.size) {
                        onByteSelected(targetOffset)
                        return true
                    }
                }
                return false
            }
        })

        val asciiGestureDetector = GestureDetector(parent.context, object : GestureDetector.SimpleOnGestureListener() {
            override fun onSingleTapUp(e: MotionEvent): Boolean {
                val pos = holder.bindingAdapterPosition
                if (pos == RecyclerView.NO_POSITION) return false
                val rowOffset = pos * 16
                val x = e.x - binding.tvAscii.paddingLeft
                if (x >= 0) {
                    val charWidth = binding.tvAscii.paint.measureText("·")
                    val byteInRow = (x / charWidth).toInt().coerceIn(0, 15)
                    val targetOffset = rowOffset + byteInRow
                    if (targetOffset < buffer.size) {
                        onByteSelected(targetOffset)
                        return true
                    }
                }
                return false
            }
        })

        binding.tvHex.setOnTouchListener { v, event ->
            val handled = hexGestureDetector.onTouchEvent(event)
            if (handled) {
                v.performClick()
            }
            handled
        }

        binding.tvAscii.setOnTouchListener { v, event ->
            val handled = asciiGestureDetector.onTouchEvent(event)
            if (handled) {
                v.performClick()
            }
            handled
        }

        return holder
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: ViewHolder, position: Int) {
        val rowOffset = position * 16
        val b = holder.binding

        b.tvOffset.text = String.format("%08X:", rowOffset)

        // 1. Build Hex column
        val hexSb = SpannableStringBuilder()
        for (i in 0 until 16) {
            val curOffset = rowOffset + i
            if (curOffset < buffer.size) {
                val byteVal = buffer.getByte(curOffset).toInt() and 0xFF
                val start = hexSb.length
                hexSb.append(String.format("%02X", byteVal))
                val end = hexSb.length

                applySpans(hexSb, start, end, curOffset)

                hexSb.append(" ")
                if (i == 7) {
                    hexSb.append(" ")
                }
            } else {
                hexSb.append("   ")
                if (i == 7) {
                    hexSb.append(" ")
                }
            }
        }
        b.tvHex.text = hexSb

        // 2. Build ASCII column
        val asciiSb = SpannableStringBuilder()
        for (i in 0 until 16) {
            val curOffset = rowOffset + i
            if (curOffset < buffer.size) {
                val byteVal = buffer.getByte(curOffset).toInt() and 0xFF
                val ch = if (byteVal in 32..126) byteVal.toChar() else '·'
                val start = asciiSb.length
                asciiSb.append(ch)
                val end = asciiSb.length

                applySpans(asciiSb, start, end, curOffset)
            } else {
                asciiSb.append(" ")
            }
        }
        b.tvAscii.text = asciiSb
    }

    private fun applySpans(sb: SpannableStringBuilder, start: Int, end: Int, offset: Int) {
        if (offset == selectedOffset) {
            sb.setSpan(
                BackgroundColorSpan(Color.parseColor("#1976D2")),
                start,
                end,
                Spannable.SPAN_EXCLUSIVE_EXCLUSIVE
            )
            sb.setSpan(
                ForegroundColorSpan(Color.WHITE),
                start,
                end,
                Spannable.SPAN_EXCLUSIVE_EXCLUSIVE
            )
        } else if (highlightRange != null && offset in highlightRange!!) {
            sb.setSpan(
                BackgroundColorSpan(Color.parseColor("#388E3C")),
                start,
                end,
                Spannable.SPAN_EXCLUSIVE_EXCLUSIVE
            )
            sb.setSpan(
                ForegroundColorSpan(Color.WHITE),
                start,
                end,
                Spannable.SPAN_EXCLUSIVE_EXCLUSIVE
            )
        } else if (buffer.modifiedIndices.contains(offset)) {
            sb.setSpan(
                ForegroundColorSpan(Color.parseColor("#FFA726")), // Amber/Orange
                start,
                end,
                Spannable.SPAN_EXCLUSIVE_EXCLUSIVE
            )
        }
    }

    class ViewHolder(val binding: ItemHexRowBinding) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(binding.root)
}
```

```kt
class ImageViewerActivity : AppActivity() {
    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)

        // Calls ensureSubDecor().
        findViewById<View>(android.R.id.content)
        if (savedInstanceState == null) {
            val intent = intent
            val position = intent.getIntExtra(EXTRA_POSITION, 0)
            val fragment = ImageViewerFragment()
                .putArgs(ImageViewerFragment.Args(intent, position))
            supportFragmentManager.commit { add(android.R.id.content, fragment) }
        }
    }

    companion object {
        private val EXTRA_POSITION = "${ImageViewerActivity::class.java.name}.extra.POSITION"

        fun putExtras(intent: Intent, paths: List<Path>, position: Int) {
            // All extra put here must be framework classes, or we may crash the resolver activity.
            intent.extraPathList = paths
            intent.putExtra(EXTRA_POSITION, position)
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/viewer/image/ImageViewerAdapter.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2019 Hai Zhang <dreaming.in.code.zh@gmail.com>
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.viewer.image

import android.graphics.BitmapFactory
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import androidx.core.view.isVisible
import androidx.lifecycle.LifecycleOwner
import androidx.lifecycle.lifecycleScope
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
import coil.dispose
import coil.load
import coil.size.Size
import com.davemorrissey.labs.subscaleview.ImageSource
import com.davemorrissey.labs.subscaleview.SubsamplingScaleImageView
import com.davemorrissey.labs.subscaleview.SubsamplingScaleImageView.DefaultOnImageEventListener
import java8.nio.file.Path
import java8.nio.file.attribute.BasicFileAttributes
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import me.zhanghai.android.files.coil.fadeIn
import me.zhanghai.android.files.databinding.ImageViewerItemBinding
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.MimeType
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.asMimeType
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.asMimeTypeOrNull
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.fileProviderUri
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.common.AndroidFileTypeDetector
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.common.newInputStream
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.common.readAttributes
import me.zhanghai.android.files.ui.SimpleAdapter
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.fadeInUnsafe
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.fadeOutUnsafe
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.layoutInflater
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.shortAnimTime
import kotlin.math.max

class ImageViewerAdapter(
    private val lifecycleOwner: LifecycleOwner,
    private val listener: (View) -> Unit
) : SimpleAdapter<Path, ImageViewerAdapter.ViewHolder>() {
    override val hasStableIds: Boolean
        get() = true

    override fun getItemId(position: Int): Long = getItem(position).hashCode().toLong()

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): ViewHolder =
        ViewHolder(ImageViewerItemBinding.inflate(parent.context.layoutInflater, parent, false))

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: ViewHolder, position: Int) {
        val path = getItem(position)
        val binding = holder.binding
        binding.image.setOnPhotoTapListener { view, _, _ -> listener(view) }
        binding.largeImage.setOnClickListener(listener)
        loadImage(binding, path)
    }

    override fun onViewRecycled(holder: ViewHolder) {
        super.onViewRecycled(holder)

        val binding = holder.binding
        binding.image.dispose()
        binding.largeImage.recycle()
    }

    private fun loadImage(binding: ImageViewerItemBinding, path: Path) {
        binding.progress.fadeInUnsafe(true)
        binding.errorText.fadeOutUnsafe()
        binding.image.isVisible = false
        binding.largeImage.isVisible = false
        lifecycleOwner.lifecycleScope.launch {
            val imageInfo = try {
                withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { path.loadImageInfo() }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                e.printStackTrace()
                showError(binding, e)
                return@launch
            }
            loadImageWithInfo(binding, path, imageInfo)
        }
    }

    private fun Path.loadImageInfo(): ImageInfo {
        val attributes = readAttributes(BasicFileAttributes::class.java)
        val mimeType = AndroidFileTypeDetector.getMimeType(this, attributes).asMimeType()
        val bitmapOptions = BitmapFactory.Options().apply { inJustDecodeBounds = true }
        newInputStream().use { BitmapFactory.decodeStream(it, null, bitmapOptions) }
        return ImageInfo(
            attributes, bitmapOptions.outWidth, bitmapOptions.outHeight,
            bitmapOptions.outMimeType?.asMimeTypeOrNull() ?: mimeType
        )
    }

    private fun loadImageWithInfo(
        binding: ImageViewerItemBinding,
        path: Path,
        imageInfo: ImageInfo
    ) {
        if (!imageInfo.shouldUseLargeImageView) {
            binding.image.apply {
                isVisible = true
                load(path to imageInfo.attributes) {
                    size(Size.ORIGINAL)
                    fadeIn(context.shortAnimTime)
                    listener(
                        onSuccess = { _, _ -> binding.progress.fadeOutUnsafe() },
                        onError = { _, result -> showError(binding, result.throwable) }
                    )
                }
            }
        } else {
            binding.largeImage.apply {
                setDoubleTapZoomDuration(300)
                orientation = SubsamplingScaleImageView.ORIENTATION_USE_EXIF
                // Otherwise OnImageEventListener.onReady() is never called.
                isVisible = true
                alpha = 0f
                setOnImageEventListener(object : DefaultOnImageEventListener() {
                    override fun onReady() {
                        setDoubleTapZoomScale(binding.largeImage.cropScale)
                        binding.progress.fadeOutUnsafe()
                        binding.largeImage.fadeInUnsafe(true)
                    }

                    override fun onImageLoadError(e: Exception) {
                        e.printStackTrace()
                        showError(binding, e)
                    }
                })
                setImageRestoringSavedState(ImageSource.uri(path.fileProviderUri))
            }
        }
    }

    private val ImageInfo.shouldUseLargeImageView: Boolean
        get() {
            // See BitmapFactory.cpp encodedFormatToString()
            if (mimeType == MimeType.IMAGE_GIF) {
                return false
            }
            if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) {
                return false
            }
            // 4 bytes per pixel for ARGB_8888.
            if (width * height * 4 > MAX_BITMAP_SIZE) {
                return true
            }
            if (width > 2048 || height > 2048) {
                val ratio = width.toFloat() / height
                if (ratio < 0.5 || ratio > 2) {
                    return true
                }
            }
            return false
        }

    private val SubsamplingScaleImageView.cropScale: Float
        get() {
            val viewWidth = (width - paddingLeft - paddingRight)
            val viewHeight = (height - paddingTop - paddingBottom)
            val orientation = appliedOrientation
            val rotated90Or270 = orientation == SubsamplingScaleImageView.ORIENTATION_90
                || orientation == SubsamplingScaleImageView.ORIENTATION_270
            val imageWidth = if (rotated90Or270) sHeight else sWidth
            val imageHeight = if (rotated90Or270) sWidth else sHeight
            return max(viewWidth.toFloat() / imageWidth, viewHeight.toFloat() / imageHeight)
        }

    private fun showError(binding: ImageViewerItemBinding, throwable: Throwable) {
        binding.progress.fadeOutUnsafe()
        binding.errorText.text = throwable.toString()
        binding.errorText.fadeInUnsafe(true)
        binding.image.isVisible = false
        binding.largeImage.isVisible = false
    }

    companion object {
        // @see android.graphics.RecordingCanvas#MAX_BITMAP_SIZE
        private const val MAX_BITMAP_SIZE = 100 * 1024 * 1024
    }

    class ViewHolder(val binding: ImageViewerItemBinding) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(binding.root)

    private class ImageInfo(
        val attributes: BasicFileAttributes,
        val width: Int,
        val height: Int,
        val mimeType: MimeType
    )
}
```

```kt
/*

package me.zhanghai.android.files.viewer.image

import android.content.Intent
import android.graphics.Color
import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.Menu
import android.view.MenuInflater
import android.view.MenuItem
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import androidx.core.view.doOnPreDraw
import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment
import androidx.interpolator.view.animation.FastOutSlowInInterpolator
import androidx.viewpager2.widget.ViewPager2
import dev.chrisbanes.insetter.applySystemWindowInsetsToPadding
import java8.nio.file.Path
import kotlinx.parcelize.Parcelize
import kotlinx.parcelize.WriteWith
import me.zhanghai.android.files.R
import me.zhanghai.android.files.databinding.ImageViewerFragmentBinding
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.fileProviderUri
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.common.delete
import me.zhanghai.android.files.ui.DepthPageTransformer
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.ParcelableArgs
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.ParcelableListParceler
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.ParcelableState
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.args
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.createSendImageIntent
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.extraPath
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.extraPathList
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.finish
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.getState
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.mediumAnimTime
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.putState
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.showToast
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.startActivitySafe
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.withChooser
import me.zhanghai.android.systemuihelper.SystemUiHelper
import java.io.IOException

class ImageViewerFragment : Fragment(), ConfirmDeleteDialogFragment.Listener {
    private val args by args<Args>()
    private val argsPaths by lazy { args.intent.extraPathList }

    private lateinit var paths: MutableList<Path>

    private lateinit var binding: ImageViewerFragmentBinding

    private lateinit var systemUiHelper: SystemUiHelper

    private lateinit var adapter: ImageViewerAdapter

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)

        paths = (savedInstanceState?.getState<State>()?.paths ?: argsPaths).toMutableList()

        setHasOptionsMenu(true)
    }

    override fun onCreateView(
        inflater: LayoutInflater,
        container: ViewGroup?,
        savedInstanceState: Bundle?
    ): View =
        ImageViewerFragmentBinding.inflate(inflater, container, false)
            .also { binding = it }
            .root

    override fun onActivityCreated(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onActivityCreated(savedInstanceState)

        if (paths.isEmpty()) {
            // TODO: Show a toast.
            finish()
            return
        }

        val activity = activity as AppCompatActivity
        activity.setSupportActionBar(binding.toolbar)
        activity.supportActionBar!!.setDisplayHomeAsUpEnabled(true)
        // Our app bar will draw the status bar background.
        activity.window.statusBarColor = Color.TRANSPARENT
        binding.appBarLayout.applySystemWindowInsetsToPadding(left = true, top = true, right = true)
        systemUiHelper = SystemUiHelper(
            activity, SystemUiHelper.LEVEL_IMMERSIVE, SystemUiHelper.FLAG_IMMERSIVE_STICKY
        ) { visible: Boolean ->
            binding.appBarLayout.animate()
                .alpha(if (visible) 1f else 0f)
                .translationY(if (visible) 0f else -binding.appBarLayout.bottom.toFloat())
                .setDuration(mediumAnimTime.toLong())
                .setInterpolator(FastOutSlowInInterpolator())
                .start()
        }
        // This will set up window flags.
        systemUiHelper.show()
        adapter = ImageViewerAdapter(viewLifecycleOwner) { systemUiHelper.toggle() }.apply {
            replace(paths)
        }
        binding.viewPager.apply {
            // 1 is the default for the old androidx.viewpager.widget.ViewPager.
            offscreenPageLimit = 1
            adapter = this@ImageViewerFragment.adapter
            // ViewPager saves its position and will restore it later.
            setCurrentItem(args.position, false)
            setPageTransformer(DepthPageTransformer)
            registerOnPageChangeCallback(object : ViewPager2.OnPageChangeCallback() {
                override fun onPageSelected(position: Int) {
                    updateTitle()
                }
            })
        }
    }

    override fun onViewStateRestored(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onViewStateRestored(savedInstanceState)

        if (paths.isEmpty()) {
            // We did finish the activity in onActivityCreated(), however we will still be called
            // here before the activity is actually finished.
            return
        }

        updateTitle()
    }

    override fun onSaveInstanceState(outState: Bundle) {
        super.onSaveInstanceState(outState)

        outState.putState(State(paths))
    }

    override fun onCreateOptionsMenu(menu: Menu, inflater: MenuInflater) {
        super.onCreateOptionsMenu(menu, inflater)

        inflater.inflate(R.menu.image_viewer, menu)
    }

    override fun onOptionsItemSelected(item: MenuItem): Boolean =
        when (item.itemId) {
            R.id.action_delete -> {
                confirmDelete()
                true
            }
            R.id.action_share -> {
                share()
                true
            }
            else -> super.onOptionsItemSelected(item)
        }

    private fun confirmDelete() {
        ConfirmDeleteDialogFragment.show(currentPath, this)
    }

    override fun delete(path: Path) {
        try {
            path.delete()
        } catch (e: IOException) {
            e.printStackTrace()
            showToast(e.toString())
            return
        }
        paths.removeAll(listOf(path))
        if (paths.isEmpty()) {
            finish()
            return
        }
        adapter.replace(paths)
        // ViewPager only asynchronously sets current item to 0, which isn't a desirable behavior
        // for us and will make updateTitle() crash for index out of bounds.
        if (binding.viewPager.currentItem > paths.lastIndex) {
            binding.viewPager.currentItem = paths.lastIndex
        }
        updateTitle()
        // Work around blank screen due to ViewPager2.PageTransformer not being called (and thus the
        // next item keeps its 0 alpha) when we have offscreenPageLimit = 1.
        binding.viewPager.doOnPreDraw { binding.viewPager.requestTransform() }
    }

    private fun updateTitle() {
        val path = currentPath
        requireActivity().title = path.fileName.toString()
        val size = paths.size
        binding.toolbar.subtitle = if (size > 1) {
            getString(
                R.string.image_viewer_subtitle_format, binding.viewPager.currentItem + 1, size
            )
        } else {
            null
        }
    }

    private fun share() {
        val path = currentPath
        val intent = path.fileProviderUri.createSendImageIntent()
            .apply { extraPath = path }
            .withChooser()
        startActivitySafe(intent)
    }

    private val currentPath: Path
        get() = paths[binding.viewPager.currentItem]

    @Parcelize
    class Args(val intent: Intent, val position: Int) : ParcelableArgs

    @Parcelize
    private class State(val paths: @WriteWith<ParcelableListParceler> List<Path>) : ParcelableState
}
```

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.viewer.saveas

import android.os.Bundle
import android.os.Environment
import java8.nio.file.Path
import java8.nio.file.Paths
import me.zhanghai.android.files.R
import me.zhanghai.android.files.app.AppActivity
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.MimeType
import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.asMimeTypeOrNull
import me.zhanghai.android.files.filejob.FileJobService
import me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist.FileListActivity
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.saveAsPath
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.showToast

class SaveAsActivity : AppActivity() {
    private val createFileLauncher =
        registerForActivityResult(FileListActivity.CreateFileContract(), ::onCreateFileResult)

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)

        val intent = intent
        val mimeType = intent.type?.asMimeTypeOrNull() ?: MimeType.ANY
        val path = intent.saveAsPath
        if (path == null) {
            showToast(R.string.save_as_error)
            finish()
            return
        }
        val title = path.fileName.toString()
        val initialPath =
            Paths.get(
                Environment.getExternalStoragePublicDirectory(Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS).path
            )
        createFileLauncher.launch(Triple(mimeType, title, initialPath))
    }

    private fun onCreateFileResult(result: Path?) {
        if (result == null) {
            finish()
            return
        }
        FileJobService.save(intent.saveAsPath!!, result, this)
        finish()
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/viewer/sqlite/SqliteViewerActivity.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.viewer.sqlite

import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.database.sqlite.SQLiteDatabase
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.Typeface
import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.View
import android.widget.AdapterView
import android.widget.ArrayAdapter
import android.widget.Button
import android.widget.ProgressBar
import android.widget.Spinner
import android.widget.TableLayout
import android.widget.TableRow
import android.widget.TextView
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.appcompat.widget.Toolbar
import androidx.lifecycle.lifecycleScope
import java8.nio.file.Path
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import me.zhanghai.android.files.R
import me.zhanghai.android.files.app.AppActivity
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.common.newInputStream
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.linux.isLinuxPath
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.extraPath
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileOutputStream

class SqliteViewerActivity : AppActivity() {
    private lateinit var toolbar: Toolbar
    private lateinit var spnTables: Spinner
    private lateinit var tvTableInfo: TextView
    private lateinit var tableData: TableLayout
    private lateinit var pbLoading: ProgressBar
    private lateinit var tvEmpty: TextView
    private lateinit var btnPrevPage: Button
    private lateinit var btnNextPage: Button
    private lateinit var tvPageInfo: TextView

    private var db: SQLiteDatabase? = null
    private var tempFile: File? = null
    private var currentTable: String = ""
    private var currentPage: Int = 1
    private var totalRows: Int = 0
    private val pageSize: Int = 100
    private var loadJob: Job? = null

    private data class TablePageData(
        val columnNames: List<String>,
        val rows: List<List<String>>,
        val totalRows: Int,
        val page: Int,
        val totalPages: Int
    )

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_sqlite_viewer)

        toolbar = findViewById(R.id.toolbarSqlite)
        spnTables = findViewById(R.id.spnTables)
        tvTableInfo = findViewById(R.id.tvTableInfo)
        tableData = findViewById(R.id.tableData)
        pbLoading = findViewById(R.id.pbLoading)
        tvEmpty = findViewById(R.id.tvEmpty)
        btnPrevPage = findViewById(R.id.btnPrevPage)
        btnNextPage = findViewById(R.id.btnNextPage)
        tvPageInfo = findViewById(R.id.tvPageInfo)

        toolbar.setNavigationOnClickListener { finish() }

        val path = intent.extraPath
        if (path == null) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Ruta no válida", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            finish()
            return
        }

        toolbar.title = path.fileName.toString()
        toolbar.subtitle = "Base de datos SQLite"

        btnPrevPage.setOnClickListener {
            if (currentPage > 1) {
                currentPage--
                loadTableData()
            }
        }

        btnNextPage.setOnClickListener {
            if (currentPage * pageSize < totalRows) {
                currentPage++
                loadTableData()
            }
        }

        initDatabaseAsync(path)
    }

    private fun escapeSqlIdentifier(name: String): String = "`" + name.replace("`", "``") + "`"

    private fun initDatabaseAsync(path: Path) {
        pbLoading.visibility = View.VISIBLE
        tvEmpty.visibility = View.GONE

        lifecycleScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            try {
                val dbFile: File
                if (path.isLinuxPath) {
                    dbFile = path.toFile()
                } else {
                    val temp = File(cacheDir, "sqlite_${System.currentTimeMillis()}.db")
                    path.newInputStream().use { input ->
                        FileOutputStream(temp).use { output ->
                            input.copyTo(output)
                        }
                    }
                    tempFile = temp
                    dbFile = temp
                }

                val openedDb = SQLiteDatabase.openDatabase(dbFile.absolutePath, null, SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READONLY)
                db = openedDb
                val tables = queryTables(openedDb)

                withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                    pbLoading.visibility = View.GONE
                    if (tables.isEmpty()) {
                        tvEmpty.text = "No se encontraron tablas en la base de datos"
                        tvEmpty.visibility = View.VISIBLE
                        return@withContext
                    }

                    val adapter = ArrayAdapter(this@SqliteViewerActivity, android.R.layout.simple_spinner_dropdown_item, tables)
                    spnTables.adapter = adapter
                    spnTables.onItemSelectedListener = object : AdapterView.OnItemSelectedListener {
                        override fun onItemSelected(parent: AdapterView<*>?, view: View?, position: Int, id: Long) {
                            currentTable = tables[position]
                            currentPage = 1
                            loadTableData()
                        }

                        override fun onNothingSelected(parent: AdapterView<*>?) {}
                    }
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                e.printStackTrace()
                withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                    pbLoading.visibility = View.GONE
                    Toast.makeText(this@SqliteViewerActivity, "Error al abrir SQLite: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                    finish()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun queryTables(database: SQLiteDatabase): List<String> {
        val list = mutableListOf<String>()
        val cursor = database.rawQuery(
            "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY name",
            null
        )
        cursor?.use {
            while (it.moveToNext()) {
                list.add(it.getString(0))
            }
        }
        return list
    }

    private fun loadTableData() {
        val database = db ?: return
        if (currentTable.isEmpty()) return

        loadJob?.cancel()

        tableData.removeAllViews()
        pbLoading.visibility = View.VISIBLE
        tvEmpty.visibility = View.GONE

        val tableToQuery = currentTable
        val pageToQuery = currentPage

        loadJob = lifecycleScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            try {
                val escapedTable = escapeSqlIdentifier(tableToQuery)
                var rowCount = 0

                // Count rows defensively
                val countCursor = database.rawQuery("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM $escapedTable", null)
                countCursor.use {
                    if (it.moveToFirst()) {
                        rowCount = it.getInt(0)
                    }
                }

                val offset = (pageToQuery - 1) * pageSize
                val cursor = database.rawQuery(
                    "SELECT * FROM $escapedTable LIMIT $pageSize OFFSET $offset",
                    null
                )

                val colNames = mutableListOf<String>()
                val rowsData = mutableListOf<List<String>>()

                cursor.use { c ->
                    colNames.addAll(c.columnNames)
                    while (c.moveToNext()) {
                        val row = mutableListOf<String>()
                        for (i in 0 until c.columnCount) {
                            val value = try {
                                c.getString(i) ?: "<null>"
                            } catch (e: Exception) {
                                "<blob>"
                            }
                            row.add(value)
                        }
                        rowsData.add(row)
                    }
                }

                val totalPages = ((rowCount + pageSize - 1) / pageSize).coerceAtLeast(1)
                val pageData = TablePageData(colNames, rowsData, rowCount, pageToQuery, totalPages)

                withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                    renderTableData(pageData)
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                e.printStackTrace()
                withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                    pbLoading.visibility = View.GONE
                    Toast.makeText(this@SqliteViewerActivity, "Error al consultar tabla: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun renderTableData(data: TablePageData) {
        totalRows = data.totalRows
        tvTableInfo.text = "${data.totalRows} filas, ${data.columnNames.size} cols"
        tvPageInfo.text = "Pág. ${data.page} / ${data.totalPages}"
        btnPrevPage.isEnabled = data.page > 1
        btnNextPage.isEnabled = data.page < data.totalPages

        pbLoading.visibility = View.GONE

        if (data.totalRows == 0 || data.rows.isEmpty()) {
            tvEmpty.visibility = View.VISIBLE
            return
        }

        val density = resources.displayMetrics.density
        val padH = (12 * density).toInt()
        val padV = (10 * density).toInt()

        // Header Row
        val headerRow = TableRow(this).apply {
            setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#333333"))
        }
        for (name in data.columnNames) {
            val tv = TextView(this).apply {
                text = name
                setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#2196F3"))
                textSize = 13f
                setTypeface(null, Typeface.BOLD)
                setPadding(padH, padV, padH, padV)
                gravity = Gravity.START or Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
            }
            headerRow.addView(tv)
        }
        tableData.addView(headerRow)

        // Data Rows
        for ((rowIndex, rowData) in data.rows.withIndex()) {
            val row = TableRow(this).apply {
                setBackgroundColor(if (rowIndex % 2 == 0) Color.parseColor("#242424") else Color.parseColor("#1E1E1E"))
            }
            for (value in rowData) {
                val tv = TextView(this).apply {
                    text = value
                    setTextColor(if (value == "<null>") Color.parseColor("#777777") else Color.WHITE)
                    textSize = 12f
                    setPadding(padH, padV, padH, padV)
                    setTextIsSelectable(true)
                    gravity = Gravity.START or Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
                }
                row.addView(tv)
            }
            tableData.addView(row)
        }
    }

    override fun onDestroy() {
        super.onDestroy()
        loadJob?.cancel()
        try {
            db?.close()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
        }
        db = null
        tempFile?.delete()
        tempFile = null
    }

    companion object {
        fun start(context: Context, path: Path) {
            val intent = Intent(context, SqliteViewerActivity::class.java).apply {
                extraPath = path
            }
            context.startActivity(intent)
        }
    }
}
```
