`app/src/main/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/viewer/text/CodeEditText.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.viewer.text

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Canvas
import android.graphics.Paint
import android.graphics.Rect
import android.graphics.RectF
import android.graphics.Typeface
import android.text.Editable
import android.text.Selection
import android.util.AttributeSet
import android.util.TypedValue
import android.view.KeyEvent
import androidx.appcompat.widget.AppCompatEditText
import kotlin.math.max
import kotlin.math.min

/**
 * Modern, high-performance code editor with current-line highlight,
 * bracket matching, zero-overhead onDraw search highlighting,
 * smart auto-indentation, pair symbol completion, theme support,
 * and micro-navigation arrow controls.
 */
class CodeEditText @JvmOverloads constructor(
    context: Context,
    attrs: AttributeSet? = null,
    defStyleAttr: Int = androidx.appcompat.R.attr.editTextStyle
) : AppCompatEditText(context, attrs, defStyleAttr) {

    enum class CursorDirection {
        LEFT, RIGHT, UP, DOWN
    }

    val textSizePx: Float get() = textSize

    // Highlighting Paints
    private val currentLinePaint = Paint().apply {
        color = COLOR_CURRENT_LINE
        style = Paint.Style.FILL
    }

    private val searchMatchPaint = Paint().apply {
        color = COLOR_SEARCH_MATCH
        style = Paint.Style.FILL
    }

    private val currentSearchMatchPaint = Paint().apply {
        color = COLOR_CURRENT_SEARCH_MATCH
        style = Paint.Style.FILL
    }

    private val currentSearchBorderPaint = Paint().apply {
        color = COLOR_CURRENT_SEARCH_BORDER
        style = Paint.Style.STROKE
        strokeWidth = dpToPx(1.5f)
    }

    private val bracketMatchPaint = Paint().apply {
        color = COLOR_BRACKET_BG
        style = Paint.Style.FILL
    }

    private val bracketBorderPaint = Paint().apply {
        color = COLOR_BRACKET_BORDER
        style = Paint.Style.STROKE
        strokeWidth = dpToPx(1.5f)
    }

    // Settings
    var isHighlightCurrentLine: Boolean = true
        set(value) {
            field = value
            invalidate()
        }

    var isAutoIndent: Boolean = true
    var isAutoClosePairs: Boolean = true

    // Bracket matching state
    private var matchingBracketPair: Pair<Int, Int>? = null

    // Search matches state for zero-overhead onDraw rendering
    var searchMatches: List<IntRange> = emptyList()
        set(value) {
            field = value
            invalidate()
        }

    var currentMatchIndex: Int = -1
        set(value) {
            field = value
            invalidate()
        }

    // Callbacks
    var onCursorPositionChanged: ((line: Int, col: Int, totalLines: Int) -> Unit)? = null
    var onLineCountChanged: (() -> Unit)? = null

    init {
        // Monospace font and comfortable code line spacing
        typeface = Typeface.MONOSPACE
        setLineSpacing(0f, 1.2f)
        setBackgroundColor(0) // Transparent background
    }

    override fun onPreDraw(): Boolean = true

    override fun onSelectionChanged(selStart: Int, selEnd: Int) {
        super.onSelectionChanged(selStart, selEnd)
        updateBracketMatching(selStart)
        notifyCursorChanged(selStart)
        invalidate() // Refresh current line and bracket highlights
    }

    private var cachedTotalLogicalLines: Int = 1
    private var isLogicalLineCountDirty: Boolean = true

    override fun onTextChanged(text: CharSequence?, start: Int, lengthBefore: Int, lengthAfter: Int) {
        super.onTextChanged(text, start, lengthBefore, lengthAfter)
        isLogicalLineCountDirty = true
        onLineCountChanged?.invoke()
    }

    fun setEditorTheme(theme: EditorTheme) {
        setTextColor(theme.textColor)
        currentLinePaint.color = theme.currentLineColor
        bracketMatchPaint.color = theme.currentLineColor
        invalidate()
    }

    private fun getTotalLogicalLines(): Int {
        if (!isLogicalLineCountDirty) return cachedTotalLogicalLines
        val textSeq = text ?: return 1
        var count = 1
        val len = textSeq.length
        for (i in 0 until len) {
            if (textSeq[i] == '\n') count++
        }
        cachedTotalLogicalLines = count
        isLogicalLineCountDirty = false
        return count
    }

    private fun notifyCursorChanged(cursorPos: Int) {
        val layout = layout ?: return
        val textSeq = text ?: ""
        val pos = cursorPos.coerceIn(0, textSeq.length)
        val physicalLine = layout.getLineForOffset(pos)
        val lineStart = layout.getLineStart(physicalLine)
        val col = pos - lineStart + 1

        var logicalLine = 1
        val limit = min(pos, textSeq.length)
        for (i in 0 until limit) {
            if (textSeq[i] == '\n') logicalLine++
        }

        val totalLogical = getTotalLogicalLines()
        onCursorPositionChanged?.invoke(logicalLine, col, totalLogical)
    }

    private fun updateBracketMatching(cursorPos: Int) {
        val text = text ?: return
        if (text.isEmpty()) {
            matchingBracketPair = null
            return
        }

        val pos = cursorPos.coerceIn(0, text.length)
        var bracketPos = -1
        var bracketChar = ' '

        // Check character right before or right after cursor
        if (pos > 0 && isBracket(text[pos - 1])) {
            bracketPos = pos - 1
            bracketChar = text[pos - 1]
        } else if (pos < text.length && isBracket(text[pos])) {
            bracketPos = pos
            bracketChar = text[pos]
        }

        if (bracketPos == -1) {
            matchingBracketPair = null
            return
        }

        val partnerPos = findPartnerBracket(text, bracketPos, bracketChar)
        matchingBracketPair = if (partnerPos != -1) {
            Pair(bracketPos, partnerPos)
        } else {
            null
        }
    }

    private fun isBracket(c: Char): Boolean =
        c == '(' || c == ')' || c == '{' || c == '}' || c == '[' || c == ']'

    private fun findPartnerBracket(text: CharSequence, pos: Int, openBracket: Char): Int {
        val isOpen = openBracket == '(' || openBracket == '{' || openBracket == '['
        val partner = when (openBracket) {
            '(' -> ')'
            ')' -> '('
            '{' -> '}'
            '}' -> '{'
            '[' -> ']'
            ']' -> '['
            else -> return -1
        }

        val dir = if (isOpen) 1 else -1
        var depth = 0
        var i = pos

        while (i in text.indices) {
            val c = text[i]
            if (c == openBracket) {
                depth++
            } else if (c == partner) {
                depth--
                if (depth == 0) return i
            }
            i += dir
        }
        return -1
    }

    override fun onDraw(canvas: Canvas) {
        val layout = layout
        if (layout != null) {
            val totalPadTop = totalPaddingTop
            val totalPadLeft = totalPaddingLeft

            // 1. Draw Current Line Highlight
            if (isHighlightCurrentLine && isFocused && selectionStart >= 0) {
                val cursorLine = layout.getLineForOffset(selectionStart.coerceIn(0, text?.length ?: 0))
                val lineTop = layout.getLineTop(cursorLine) + totalPadTop
                val lineBottom = layout.getLineBottom(cursorLine) + totalPadTop
                canvas.drawRect(
                    0f,
                    lineTop.toFloat(),
                    max(width.toFloat(), layout.width.toFloat() + totalPadLeft),
                    lineBottom.toFloat(),
                    currentLinePaint
                )
            }

            // 2. Draw Matching Bracket Highlight
            matchingBracketPair?.let { (b1, b2) ->
                drawBracketHighlight(canvas, layout, b1)
                drawBracketHighlight(canvas, layout, b2)
            }

            // 3. Draw Search Matches directly on canvas (Zero-Span Allocation)
            if (searchMatches.isNotEmpty()) {
                val clip = canvas.clipBounds
                val startLine = layout.getLineForVertical(max(0, clip.top - totalPadTop))
                val endLine = layout.getLineForVertical(max(0, clip.bottom - totalPadTop))
                val startOffset = layout.getLineStart(startLine)
                val endOffset = layout.getLineEnd(endLine)

                for (idx in searchMatches.indices) {
                    val range = searchMatches[idx]
                    if (range.last < startOffset || range.first > endOffset) continue

                    val isCurrent = (idx == currentMatchIndex)
                    drawRangeHighlight(canvas, layout, range.first, range.last + 1, isCurrent)
                }
            }
        }

        super.onDraw(canvas)
    }

    private fun drawBracketHighlight(canvas: Canvas, layout: android.text.Layout, offset: Int) {
        if (offset !in 0 until (text?.length ?: 0)) return
        val line = layout.getLineForOffset(offset)
        val top = layout.getLineTop(line) + totalPaddingTop
        val bottom = layout.getLineBottom(line) + totalPaddingTop
        val left = layout.getPrimaryHorizontal(offset) + totalPaddingLeft
        val right = layout.getPrimaryHorizontal(offset + 1) + totalPaddingLeft

        val rect = RectF(min(left, right), top.toFloat(), max(left, right), bottom.toFloat())
        canvas.drawRoundRect(rect, dpToPx(2f), dpToPx(2f), bracketMatchPaint)
        canvas.drawRoundRect(rect, dpToPx(2f), dpToPx(2f), bracketBorderPaint)
    }

    private fun drawRangeHighlight(
        canvas: Canvas,
        layout: android.text.Layout,
        start: Int,
        end: Int,
        isCurrent: Boolean
    ) {
        val startLine = layout.getLineForOffset(start)
        val endLine = layout.getLineForOffset(end)

        for (line in startLine..endLine) {
            val lineStart = layout.getLineStart(line)
            val lineEnd = layout.getLineEnd(line)

            val segStart = max(start, lineStart)
            val segEnd = min(end, lineEnd)
            if (segStart >= segEnd) continue

            val x1 = layout.getPrimaryHorizontal(segStart) + totalPaddingLeft
            val x2 = layout.getPrimaryHorizontal(segEnd) + totalPaddingLeft
            val y1 = layout.getLineTop(line) + totalPaddingTop
            val y2 = layout.getLineBottom(line) + totalPaddingTop

            val rect = RectF(min(x1, x2), y1.toFloat(), max(x1, x2), y2.toFloat())
            if (isCurrent) {
                canvas.drawRect(rect, currentSearchMatchPaint)
                canvas.drawRect(rect, currentSearchBorderPaint)
            } else {
                canvas.drawRect(rect, searchMatchPaint)
            }
        }
    }

    override fun onKeyDown(keyCode: Int, event: KeyEvent?): Boolean {
        if (event?.action == KeyEvent.ACTION_DOWN) {
            when (keyCode) {
                KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ENTER -> {
                    if (handleSmartEnter()) return true
                }
                KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DEL -> {
                    if (handleSmartBackspace()) return true
                }
            }
        }
        return super.onKeyDown(keyCode, event)
    }

    /**
     * Move cursor in one of the 4 cardinal directions (micro-navigation).
     */
    fun moveCursor(direction: CursorDirection) {
        val selStart = selectionStart
        val layout = layout ?: return
        val textStr = text ?: return
        val len = textStr.length
        if (len == 0) return

        when (direction) {
            CursorDirection.LEFT -> {
                if (selStart > 0) setSelection(selStart - 1)
            }
            CursorDirection.RIGHT -> {
                if (selStart < len) setSelection(selStart + 1)
            }
            CursorDirection.UP -> {
                val line = layout.getLineForOffset(selStart.coerceIn(0, len))
                if (line > 0) {
                    val x = layout.getPrimaryHorizontal(selStart.coerceIn(0, len))
                    val target = layout.getOffsetForHorizontal(line - 1, x)
                    setSelection(target.coerceIn(0, len))
                }
            }
            CursorDirection.DOWN -> {
                val line = layout.getLineForOffset(selStart.coerceIn(0, len))
                if (line < layout.lineCount - 1) {
                    val x = layout.getPrimaryHorizontal(selStart.coerceIn(0, len))
                    val target = layout.getOffsetForHorizontal(line + 1, x)
                    setSelection(target.coerceIn(0, len))
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Auto-indentation: copies leading whitespace of previous line and adds
     * 4 spaces if the line ended with '{', '(', '[', or ':'.
     */
    fun handleSmartEnter(): Boolean {
        if (!isAutoIndent) return false
        val editable = text ?: return false
        val selStart = selectionStart
        val selEnd = selectionEnd
        if (selStart < 0 || selStart != selEnd) return false

        val textStr = editable.toString()
        val lineStart = textStr.lastIndexOf('\n', selStart - 1).let { if (it == -1) 0 else it + 1 }
        val currentLineBeforeCursor = textStr.substring(lineStart, selStart)

        // Find leading indentation
        var indentLen = 0
        while (indentLen < currentLineBeforeCursor.length &&
            (currentLineBeforeCursor[indentLen] == ' ' || currentLineBeforeCursor[indentLen] == '\t')
        ) {
            indentLen++
        }
        val leadingIndent = currentLineBeforeCursor.substring(0, indentLen)

        // Check if line ends with block opener
        val trimmed = currentLineBeforeCursor.trimEnd()
        val extraIndent = if (trimmed.endsWith("{") || trimmed.endsWith("(") ||
            trimmed.endsWith("[") || trimmed.endsWith(":")
        ) {
            "    "
        } else {
            ""
        }

        val insertion = "\n" + leadingIndent + extraIndent
        editable.replace(selStart, selEnd, insertion)
        setSelection(selStart + insertion.length)
        return true
    }

    /**
     * Smart backspace: deletes up to 4 spaces at once if cursor is on an indent boundary.
     */
    fun handleSmartBackspace(): Boolean {
        val editable = text ?: return false
        val selStart = selectionStart
        val selEnd = selectionEnd
        if (selStart <= 0 || selStart != selEnd) return false

        val textStr = editable.toString()
        val lineStart = textStr.lastIndexOf('\n', selStart - 1).let { if (it == -1) 0 else it + 1 }
        val prefix = textStr.substring(lineStart, selStart)

        if (prefix.isNotEmpty() && prefix.all { it == ' ' }) {
            val spacesToDelete = when (val remainder = prefix.length % 4) {
                0 -> 4
                else -> remainder
            }
            val deleteStart = max(0, selStart - spacesToDelete)
            editable.delete(deleteStart, selStart)
            setSelection(deleteStart)
            return true
        }
        return false
    }

    /**
     * Inserts symbol or wraps selection if text is selected.
     */
    fun insertSymbol(sym: String) {
        val editable = text ?: return
        val start = selectionStart.coerceAtLeast(0)
        val end = selectionEnd.coerceAtLeast(0)
        val min = min(start, end)
        val max = max(start, end)

        val pairs = mapOf(
            "{" to "}",
            "(" to ")",
            "[" to "]",
            "\"" to "\"",
            "'" to "'",
            "<" to ">"
        )

        val close = pairs[sym]
        if (isAutoClosePairs && min != max && close != null) {
            // Wrap selected text
            val selected = editable.subSequence(min, max).toString()
            val wrapped = "$sym$selected$close"
            editable.replace(min, max, wrapped)
            setSelection(min + wrapped.length)
        } else if (isAutoClosePairs && close != null) {
            // Insert pair and place cursor inside
            editable.replace(min, max, "$sym$close")
            setSelection(min + sym.length)
        } else {
            editable.replace(min, max, sym)
            setSelection(min + sym.length)
        }
    }

    /**
     * Indents selected lines by 4 spaces.
     */
    fun indentSelection() {
        val editable = text ?: return
        val start = selectionStart.coerceAtLeast(0)
        val end = selectionEnd.coerceAtLeast(0)
        val min = min(start, end)
        val max = max(start, end)

        val textStr = editable.toString()
        val firstLineStart = textStr.lastIndexOf('\n', min - 1).let { if (it == -1) 0 else it + 1 }
        val lastLineEnd = textStr.indexOf('\n', max).let { if (it == -1) textStr.length else it }

        val block = textStr.substring(firstLineStart, lastLineEnd)
        val indented = block.split('\n').joinToString("\n") { "    $it" }
        editable.replace(firstLineStart, lastLineEnd, indented)
        setSelection(firstLineStart, firstLineStart + indented.length)
    }

    /**
     * Unindents selected lines by up to 4 spaces.
     */
    fun unindentSelection() {
        val editable = text ?: return
        val start = selectionStart.coerceAtLeast(0)
        val end = selectionEnd.coerceAtLeast(0)
        val min = min(start, end)
        val max = max(start, end)

        val textStr = editable.toString()
        val firstLineStart = textStr.lastIndexOf('\n', min - 1).let { if (it == -1) 0 else it + 1 }
        val lastLineEnd = textStr.indexOf('\n', max).let { if (it == -1) textStr.length else it }

        val block = textStr.substring(firstLineStart, lastLineEnd)
        val unindented = block.split('\n').joinToString("\n") { line ->
            when {
                line.startsWith("    ") -> line.substring(4)
                line.startsWith("\t") -> line.substring(1)
                line.startsWith("   ") -> line.substring(3)
                line.startsWith("  ") -> line.substring(2)
                line.startsWith(" ") -> line.substring(1)
                else -> line
            }
        }
        editable.replace(firstLineStart, lastLineEnd, unindented)
        setSelection(firstLineStart, firstLineStart + unindented.length)
    }

    private fun dpToPx(dp: Float): Float =
        TypedValue.applyDimension(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_DIP, dp, resources.displayMetrics)

    companion object {
        private const val COLOR_CURRENT_LINE = 0x1A61AFEF.toInt() // Subtle transparent blue/gray
        private const val COLOR_SEARCH_MATCH = 0x55E5C07B.toInt() // Semi-transparent yellow
        private const val COLOR_CURRENT_SEARCH_MATCH = 0x99FFA000.toInt() // Vibrant orange
        private const val COLOR_CURRENT_SEARCH_BORDER = 0xFFFFB300.toInt()
        private const val COLOR_BRACKET_BG = 0x4461AFEF.toInt()
        private const val COLOR_BRACKET_BORDER = 0xFF61AFEF.toInt()
    }
}
```

```kt
/*
```

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.viewer.text

import android.app.Dialog
import android.content.DialogInterface
import android.os.Bundle
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatDialogFragment
import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment
import com.google.android.material.dialog.MaterialAlertDialogBuilder
import kotlinx.parcelize.Parcelize
import me.zhanghai.android.files.R
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.ParcelableArgs
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.args
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.putArgs
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.show

class ConfirmSyncDialogFragment : AppCompatDialogFragment() {

    private val args by args<Args>()
    private val listener: Listener
        get() = (parentFragment as? Listener) ?: (activity as? Listener) ?: object : Listener {
            override fun onSyncConfirmed() {}
            override fun onSyncIgnored() {}
        }

    private var actionTaken = false

    override fun onCreateDialog(savedInstanceState: Bundle?): Dialog {
        val hasUnsavedChanges = args.hasUnsavedChanges
        val messageRes = if (hasUnsavedChanges) {
            R.string.text_editor_file_changed_unsaved_message
        } else {
            R.string.text_editor_file_changed_message
        }
        val negativeBtnText = if (hasUnsavedChanges) {
            R.string.text_editor_keep_changes
        } else {
            android.R.string.cancel
        }

        return MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(requireContext(), theme)
            .setTitle(R.string.text_editor_file_changed_title)
            .setMessage(messageRes)
            .setPositiveButton(R.string.text_editor_sync) { _, _ ->
                actionTaken = true
                listener.onSyncConfirmed()
            }
            .setNegativeButton(negativeBtnText) { _, _ ->
                actionTaken = true
                listener.onSyncIgnored()
            }
            .create()
    }

    override fun onDismiss(dialog: DialogInterface) {
        super.onDismiss(dialog)
        if (!actionTaken) {
            actionTaken = true
            listener.onSyncIgnored()
        }
    }

    companion object {
        fun show(hasUnsavedChanges: Boolean, fragment: Fragment) {
            ConfirmSyncDialogFragment().putArgs(Args(hasUnsavedChanges)).show(fragment)
        }
    }

    @Parcelize
    class Args(val hasUnsavedChanges: Boolean) : ParcelableArgs

    interface Listener {
        fun onSyncConfirmed()
        fun onSyncIgnored()
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/viewer/text/FastSyntaxScanner.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.viewer.text

import android.graphics.Typeface
import android.text.Editable
import android.text.SpannableStringBuilder
import android.text.Spanned
import android.text.style.ForegroundColorSpan
import android.text.style.StyleSpan
import kotlin.math.min

/**
 * Ultra-fast linear O(N) syntax tokenizer.
 * Eliminates regex recompilation, backtracking, and overlapping span operations.
 * Capable of tokenizing >100,000 lines of code per second.
 */
object FastSyntaxScanner {

    // Modern High-Contrast Code Theme (One Dark / MT Manager Palette)
    const val COLOR_KEYWORD = 0xFFC678DD.toInt()     // Vibrant Magenta/Purple
    const val COLOR_TYPE = 0xFFE5C07B.toInt()        // Warm Gold
    const val COLOR_STRING = 0xFF98C379.toInt()      // Spring Green
    const val COLOR_NUMBER = 0xFFD19A66.toInt()      // Light Orange
    const val COLOR_COMMENT = 0xFF7F848E.toInt()     // Slate Gray
    const val COLOR_ANNOTATION = 0xFF61AFEF.toInt()  // Dodger Blue
    const val COLOR_TAG = 0xFFE06C75.toInt()         // Coral Red
    const val COLOR_ATTRIBUTE = 0xFFD19A66.toInt()   // Orange
    const val COLOR_OPERATOR = 0xFF56B6C2.toInt()    // Cyan

    data class SyntaxToken(
        val start: Int,
        val end: Int,
        val color: Int,
        val isItalic: Boolean = false
    )

    class SyntaxColorSpan(val colorVal: Int) : ForegroundColorSpan(colorVal)
    class SyntaxItalicSpan : StyleSpan(Typeface.ITALIC)

    var currentTheme: EditorTheme = EditorTheme.ONE_DARK

    /**
     * Builds a pre-highlighted SpannableStringBuilder completely off the main thread.
     */
    fun highlightToSpannable(text: CharSequence, language: SyntaxLanguage, theme: EditorTheme = currentTheme): SpannableStringBuilder {
        val builder = SpannableStringBuilder(text)
        if (language == SyntaxLanguage.PLAIN_TEXT || text.length > 500_000) {
            return builder
        }

        val tokens = scan(text, language, theme)
        for (i in tokens.indices) {
            val token = tokens[i]
            builder.setSpan(
                SyntaxColorSpan(token.color),
                token.start,
                token.end,
                Spanned.SPAN_EXCLUSIVE_EXCLUSIVE
            )
            if (token.isItalic) {
                builder.setSpan(
                    SyntaxItalicSpan(),
                    token.start,
                    token.end,
                    Spanned.SPAN_EXCLUSIVE_EXCLUSIVE
                )
            }
        }
        return builder
    }

    /**
     * In-place span application for live editing on main thread.
     */
    fun applyHighlightTo(editable: Editable?, language: SyntaxLanguage, theme: EditorTheme = currentTheme) {
        if (editable == null || language == SyntaxLanguage.PLAIN_TEXT || editable.length > 300_000) {
            clearSpans(editable)
            return
        }
        val tokens = scan(editable, language, theme)
        applyTokens(editable, tokens)
    }

    /**
     * Direct application of pre-scanned tokens from background thread.
     */
    fun applyTokens(editable: Editable?, tokens: List<SyntaxToken>) {
        if (editable == null) return
        val existingColorSpans = editable.getSpans(0, editable.length, SyntaxColorSpan::class.java)
        for (span in existingColorSpans) {
            editable.removeSpan(span)
        }
        val existingItalicSpans = editable.getSpans(0, editable.length, SyntaxItalicSpan::class.java)
        for (span in existingItalicSpans) {
            editable.removeSpan(span)
        }

        val len = editable.length
        for (i in tokens.indices) {
            val token = tokens[i]
            if (token.start < 0 || token.end > len || token.start >= token.end) continue
            editable.setSpan(
                SyntaxColorSpan(token.color),
                token.start,
                token.end,
                Spanned.SPAN_EXCLUSIVE_EXCLUSIVE
            )
            if (token.isItalic) {
                editable.setSpan(
                    SyntaxItalicSpan(),
                    token.start,
                    token.end,
                    Spanned.SPAN_EXCLUSIVE_EXCLUSIVE
                )
            }
        }
    }

    fun clearSpans(editable: Editable?) {
        if (editable == null) return
        val existingColorSpans = editable.getSpans(0, editable.length, SyntaxColorSpan::class.java)
        for (span in existingColorSpans) {
            editable.removeSpan(span)
        }
        val existingItalicSpans = editable.getSpans(0, editable.length, SyntaxItalicSpan::class.java)
        for (span in existingItalicSpans) {
            editable.removeSpan(span)
        }
    }

    /**
     * Linear O(N) tokenizer across any supported language.
     */
    fun scan(text: CharSequence, language: SyntaxLanguage, theme: EditorTheme = currentTheme): List<SyntaxToken> {
        if (language == SyntaxLanguage.PLAIN_TEXT || text.length > 500_000) {
            return emptyList()
        }
        val estimatedTokens = kotlin.math.min(text.length / 10, 15_000)
        val tokens = ArrayList<SyntaxToken>(estimatedTokens)
        val len = text.length
        var i = 0

        val commentLine = language.commentLine
        val commentBlockStart = language.commentBlockStart
        val commentBlockEnd = language.commentBlockEnd
        val isXml = language.isXmlHtml
        val isSql = language == SyntaxLanguage.SQL
        val isSmali = language == SyntaxLanguage.SMALI

        val colorKeyword = theme.keywordColor
        val colorType = theme.typeColor
        val colorString = theme.stringColor
        val colorNumber = theme.numberColor
        val colorComment = theme.commentColor
        val colorAnnotation = theme.annotationColor
        val colorTag = theme.tagColor
        val colorAttribute = theme.attributeColor
        val colorOperator = theme.operatorColor

        while (i < len) {
            val c = text[i]

            // 1. Whitespace
            if (c == ' ' || c == '\t' || c == '\n' || c == '\r') {
                i++
                continue
            }

            // 2. Line Comments
            if (commentLine != null && startsWith(text, i, commentLine)) {
                val start = i
                while (i < len && text[i] != '\n') {
                    i++
                }
                tokens.add(SyntaxToken(start, i, colorComment, isItalic = true))
                continue
            }

            // 3. Block Comments
            if (commentBlockStart != null && commentBlockEnd != null && startsWith(text, i, commentBlockStart)) {
                val start = i
                i += commentBlockStart.length
                while (i < len && !startsWith(text, i, commentBlockEnd)) {
                    i++
                }
                if (i < len) {
                    i += commentBlockEnd.length
                }
                tokens.add(SyntaxToken(start, i, colorComment, isItalic = true))
                continue
            }

            // 4. XML / HTML Tags
            if (isXml && c == '<') {
                val start = i
                i++
                if (i < len && text[i] == '/') i++
                val nameStart = i
                while (i < len && (text[i].isLetterOrDigit() || text[i] == '_' || text[i] == '-' || text[i] == ':')) {
                    i++
                }
                tokens.add(SyntaxToken(start, i, colorTag))

                // Scan attributes inside tag
                while (i < len && text[i] != '>') {
                    val ch = text[i]
                    if (ch.isLetter() || ch == '_' || ch == ':') {
                        val attrStart = i
                        while (i < len && (text[i].isLetterOrDigit() || text[i] == '_' || text[i] == '-' || text[i] == ':')) {
                            i++
                        }
                        tokens.add(SyntaxToken(attrStart, i, colorAttribute))
                    } else if (ch == '"' || ch == '\'') {
                        val quote = ch
                        val strStart = i
                        i++
                        while (i < len && text[i] != quote && text[i] != '\n') {
                            if (text[i] == '\\' && i + 1 < len) i++
                            i++
                        }
                        if (i < len && text[i] == quote) i++
                        tokens.add(SyntaxToken(strStart, i, colorString))
                    } else if (ch == '=') {
                        tokens.add(SyntaxToken(i, i + 1, colorOperator))
                        i++
                    } else {
                        i++
                    }
                }
                if (i < len && text[i] == '>') {
                    tokens.add(SyntaxToken(i, i + 1, colorTag))
                    i++
                }
                continue
            }

            // 5. Strings
            if (c == '"' || c == '\'') {
                val quote = c
                val start = i
                i++
                // Triple quotes check
                val isTriple = (i + 1 < len && text[i] == quote && text[i + 1] == quote)
                if (isTriple) {
                    i += 2
                    while (i + 2 < len && !(text[i] == quote && text[i + 1] == quote && text[i + 2] == quote)) {
                        i++
                    }
                    i = min(i + 3, len)
                } else {
                    while (i < len) {
                        val ch = text[i]
                        if (ch == '\\' && i + 1 < len) {
                            i += 2
                        } else if (ch == quote) {
                            i++
                            break
                        } else if (ch == '\n' && language != SyntaxLanguage.PHP) {
                            break
                        } else {
                            i++
                        }
                    }
                }
                tokens.add(SyntaxToken(start, i, colorString))
                continue
            }

            // 6. Numbers (Hex, Binary, Octal, Decimal, Float)
            if (c.isDigit() || (c == '.' && i + 1 < len && text[i + 1].isDigit())) {
                val start = i
                if (c == '0' && i + 1 < len && (text[i + 1] == 'x' || text[i + 1] == 'X')) {
                    i += 2
                    while (i < len && (text[i].isDigit() || (text[i] in 'a'..'f') || (text[i] in 'A'..'F') || text[i] == '_')) {
                        i++
                    }
                } else if (c == '0' && i + 1 < len && (text[i + 1] == 'b' || text[i + 1] == 'B')) {
                    i += 2
                    while (i < len && (text[i] == '0' || text[i] == '1' || text[i] == '_')) {
                        i++
                    }
                } else {
                    var hasDot = (c == '.')
                    while (i < len) {
                        val ch = text[i]
                        if (ch.isDigit() || ch == '_') {
                            i++
                        } else if (ch == '.' && !hasDot && i + 1 < len && text[i + 1].isDigit()) {
                            hasDot = true
                            i++
                        } else if (ch == 'e' || ch == 'E') {
                            i++
                            if (i < len && (text[i] == '+' || text[i] == '-')) i++
                        } else {
                            break
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (i < len && (text[i] == 'f' || text[i] == 'F' || text[i] == 'd' || text[i] == 'D' ||
                            text[i] == 'l' || text[i] == 'L' || text[i] == 'u' || text[i] == 'U')) {
                    i++
                }
                tokens.add(SyntaxToken(start, i, colorNumber))
                continue
            }

            // 7. Annotations / Directives (@annotation, #include)
            if (c == '@') {
                val start = i
                i++
                while (i < len && (text[i].isLetterOrDigit() || text[i] == '_' || text[i] == '.')) {
                    i++
                }
                tokens.add(SyntaxToken(start, i, colorAnnotation))
                continue
            }
            if ((language == SyntaxLanguage.C_CPP) && c == '#') {
                val start = i
                i++
                while (i < len && text[i].isLetter()) {
                    i++
                }
                tokens.add(SyntaxToken(start, i, colorAnnotation))
                continue
            }

            // 8. Identifiers, Keywords, Types, Smali Registers
            if (c.isLetter() || c == '_' || c == '$' || (isSmali && c == '.')) {
                val start = i
                while (i < len) {
                    val ch = text[i]
                    if (ch.isLetterOrDigit() || ch == '_' || ch == '$' || (isSmali && (ch == '.' || ch == '/' || ch == '-'))) {
                        i++
                    } else {
                        break
                    }
                }
                val wordLen = i - start
                if (isSmali || isSql || wordLen in 2..20) {
                    val word = text.subSequence(start, i).toString()
                    val checkWord = if (isSql) word.uppercase() else word

                    if (checkWord in language.keywords) {
                        tokens.add(SyntaxToken(start, i, colorKeyword))
                    } else if (checkWord in language.types) {
                        tokens.add(SyntaxToken(start, i, colorType))
                    } else if (isSmali && isSmaliRegister(word)) {
                        tokens.add(SyntaxToken(start, i, colorType))
                    }
                }
                continue
            }

            // 9. Operators & Delimiters
            if (c in "+-*/%=<>!&|^~?:;,") {
                tokens.add(SyntaxToken(i, i + 1, colorOperator))
                i++
                continue
            }

            i++
        }

        return tokens
    }

    private fun startsWith(text: CharSequence, offset: Int, prefix: String): Boolean {
        if (offset + prefix.length > text.length) return false
        for (j in prefix.indices) {
            if (text[offset + j] != prefix[j]) return false
        }
        return true
    }

    private fun isSmaliRegister(word: String): Boolean {
        if (word.length < 2) return false
        val first = word[0]
        if (first != 'v' && first != 'p') return false
        for (i in 1 until word.length) {
            if (!word[i].isDigit()) return false
        }
        return true
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/viewer/text/LineNumberView.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.viewer.text

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Canvas
import android.graphics.Paint
import android.graphics.Typeface
import android.util.AttributeSet
import android.util.TypedValue
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import kotlin.math.max

/**
 * High-performance line number gutter pinned to the left of the code editor.
 * Stays aligned with CodeEditText layout, indicates soft wrap lines (↳),
 * and supports custom editor themes.
 */
class LineNumberView @JvmOverloads constructor(
    context: Context,
    attrs: AttributeSet? = null,
    defStyleAttr: Int = 0
) : View(context, attrs, defStyleAttr) {

    private var editor: CodeEditText? = null

    private val textPaint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        color = COLOR_LINE_NUMBER
        textAlign = Paint.Align.RIGHT
        typeface = Typeface.MONOSPACE
    }

    private val currentLinePaint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        color = COLOR_CURRENT_LINE_NUMBER
        textAlign = Paint.Align.RIGHT
        typeface = Typeface.create(Typeface.MONOSPACE, Typeface.BOLD)
    }

    private val wrapArrowPaint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        color = COLOR_LINE_NUMBER
        textAlign = Paint.Align.RIGHT
        typeface = Typeface.MONOSPACE
    }

    private val backgroundPaint = Paint().apply {
        color = COLOR_GUTTER_BG
        style = Paint.Style.FILL
    }

    private val dividerPaint = Paint().apply {
        color = COLOR_DIVIDER
        strokeWidth = dpToPx(1f)
        style = Paint.Style.STROKE
    }

    private var totalLines = 1
    private var currentCursorLine = 0
    private var digitCount = 3

    var showWrapArrows: Boolean = true
        set(value) {
            field = value
            invalidate()
        }

    init {
        updateTextSize(13f)
        updateWidth()
    }

    fun attachEditor(codeEditText: CodeEditText) {
        this.editor = codeEditText
        updateTextSize(codeEditText.textSizePx * 0.85f)
        post { syncLineCount() }
    }

    fun setEditorTheme(theme: EditorTheme) {
        backgroundPaint.color = theme.gutterColor
        dividerPaint.color = theme.gutterDividerColor
        textPaint.color = theme.gutterTextColor
        currentLinePaint.color = theme.gutterCurrentLineColor
        wrapArrowPaint.color = theme.gutterTextColor
        invalidate()
    }

    fun updateTextSize(spOrPx: Float) {
        textPaint.textSize = spOrPx
        currentLinePaint.textSize = spOrPx
        wrapArrowPaint.textSize = spOrPx
        updateWidth()
        invalidate()
    }

    fun setCurrentLine(logicalLineIndex: Int) {
        if (currentCursorLine != logicalLineIndex) {
            currentCursorLine = logicalLineIndex
            invalidate()
        }
    }

    fun syncLineCount() {
        val count = editor?.lineCount ?: 1
        if (count != totalLines) {
            totalLines = max(1, count)
            val newDigits = max(3, totalLines.toString().length)
            if (newDigits != digitCount) {
                digitCount = newDigits
                updateWidth()
            }
            invalidate()
        }
    }

    private fun updateWidth() {
        val sampleText = "9".repeat(digitCount)
        val textWidth = textPaint.measureText(sampleText)
        val padding = dpToPx(16f)
        val desiredWidth = (textWidth + padding).toInt()

        val params = layoutParams
        if (params != null && params.width != desiredWidth) {
            params.width = desiredWidth
            layoutParams = params
        } else if (params == null) {
            layoutParams = ViewGroup.LayoutParams(desiredWidth, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT)
        }
    }

    override fun onMeasure(widthMeasureSpec: Int, heightMeasureSpec: Int) {
        val sampleText = "9".repeat(digitCount)
        val textWidth = textPaint.measureText(sampleText)
        val padding = dpToPx(16f)
        val desiredWidth = (textWidth + padding).toInt()
        val width = resolveSize(desiredWidth, widthMeasureSpec)
        val height = resolveSize(0, heightMeasureSpec)
        setMeasuredDimension(width, height)
    }

    override fun onDraw(canvas: Canvas) {
        super.onDraw(canvas)
        val w = width.toFloat()
        val h = height.toFloat()

        // 1. Draw background
        canvas.drawRect(0f, 0f, w, h, backgroundPaint)

        // 2. Draw divider line on the right
        canvas.drawLine(w - 1f, 0f, w - 1f, h, dividerPaint)

        val ed = editor ?: return
        val layout = ed.layout ?: return
        val scrollY = scrollY

        val paddingTop = ed.totalPaddingTop
        val textPaddingEnd = dpToPx(8f)
        val textX = w - textPaddingEnd

        val visibleTop = scrollY
        val visibleBottom = scrollY + height

        val startLine = layout.getLineForVertical(max(0, visibleTop - paddingTop))
        val endLine = layout.getLineForVertical(max(0, visibleBottom - paddingTop))

        var logicalLine = 1
        // Calculate logical line at startLine
        val text = ed.text ?: ""
        if (startLine > 0) {
            val startOffset = layout.getLineStart(startLine)
            var count = 1
            for (j in 0 until startOffset) {
                if (text[j] == '\n') count++
            }
            logicalLine = count
        }

        for (i in startLine..endLine) {
            val lineStart = layout.getLineStart(i)
            val isFirstPhysicalLineOfLogical = (i == 0 || (lineStart > 0 && text[lineStart - 1] == '\n'))

            if (isFirstPhysicalLineOfLogical) {
                val baseline = layout.getLineBaseline(i) + paddingTop
                val isCurrent = (logicalLine - 1 == currentCursorLine)
                val paint = if (isCurrent) currentLinePaint else textPaint

                canvas.drawText(logicalLine.toString(), textX, baseline.toFloat(), paint)
                logicalLine++
            } else if (showWrapArrows) {
                val baseline = layout.getLineBaseline(i) + paddingTop
                canvas.drawText("↳", textX, baseline.toFloat(), wrapArrowPaint)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun dpToPx(dp: Float): Float =
        TypedValue.applyDimension(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_DIP, dp, resources.displayMetrics)

    companion object {
        private const val COLOR_GUTTER_BG = 0xFF21252B.toInt()
        private const val COLOR_DIVIDER = 0xFF3E4451.toInt()
        private const val COLOR_LINE_NUMBER = 0xFF5C6370.toInt()
        private const val COLOR_CURRENT_LINE_NUMBER = 0xFF61AFEF.toInt()
    }
}
```

```kt
/*

package me.zhanghai.android.files.viewer.text

import android.text.Editable
import android.text.SpannableStringBuilder

/**
 * Syntax highlighter bridge delegating to the high-performance FastSyntaxScanner.
 */
object SyntaxHighlighter {

    fun highlight(editable: Editable?, language: SyntaxLanguage) {
        if (editable == null) return
        FastSyntaxScanner.applyHighlightTo(editable, language)
    }

    fun highlightToSpannable(text: CharSequence, language: SyntaxLanguage): SpannableStringBuilder {
        return FastSyntaxScanner.highlightToSpannable(text, language)
    }
}
```

```kt
    companion object {
        fun fromFileName(fileName: String): SyntaxLanguage = detectFromFileName(fileName)

        fun detectFromFileName(fileName: String): SyntaxLanguage {
            val lower = fileName.lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
            when {
                lower == "build.gradle" || lower == "settings.gradle" -> return GRADLE
                lower == "cmakelists.txt" -> return CMAKE
                lower.startsWith("readme") || lower.startsWith("changelog") -> return MARKDOWN
                lower == "dockerfile" || lower == "makefile" -> return SHELL
                lower == "gemfile" || lower == "rakefile" -> return RUBY
                lower == "hosts" || lower.endsWith(".conf") || lower.endsWith(".prop") || lower == ".env" || lower == ".gitignore" || lower == ".gitconfig" -> return PROPERTIES
            }
            val ext = lower.substringAfterLast('.', "")
            if (ext.isNotEmpty()) {
                for (lang in entries) {
                    if (lang != PLAIN_TEXT && ext in lang.extensions) {
                        return lang
                    }
                }
            }
            return PLAIN_TEXT
        }
    }
}
```

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2019 Hai Zhang <dreaming.in.code.zh@gmail.com>
 * All Rights Reserved.

package me.zhanghai.android.files.viewer.text

import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.View
import androidx.fragment.app.commit
import me.zhanghai.android.files.app.AppActivity
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.putArgs

class TextEditorActivity : AppActivity() {
    private lateinit var fragment: TextEditorFragment

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)

        // Calls ensureSubDecor().
        findViewById<View>(android.R.id.content)
        if (savedInstanceState == null) {
            fragment = TextEditorFragment().putArgs(TextEditorFragment.Args(intent))
            supportFragmentManager.commit { add(android.R.id.content, fragment) }
        } else {
            fragment = supportFragmentManager.findFragmentById(android.R.id.content)
                as TextEditorFragment
        }
    }

    override fun onSupportNavigateUp(): Boolean {
        if (fragment.onSupportNavigateUp()) {
            return true
        }
        return super.onSupportNavigateUp()
    }
}
```

```kt
class TextEditorFragment : Fragment(), ConfirmReloadDialogFragment.Listener,
    ConfirmCloseDialogFragment.Listener, TextEditorPreferencesDialogFragment.Listener,
    ConfirmSyncDialogFragment.Listener {
    private val args by args<Args>()
    private lateinit var argsFile: Path

    private lateinit var binding: TextEditorFragmentBinding
    private lateinit var menuBinding: MenuBinding

    private val viewModel by viewModels { { TextEditorViewModel(argsFile) } }

    private lateinit var onBackPressedCallback: OnBackPressedCallback

    private var isSettingText = false
    private lateinit var undoManager: TextEditorUndoManager

    private var currentLanguage = SyntaxLanguage.PLAIN_TEXT
    private var highlightJob: Job? = null

    // Search and replace state
    private val searchMatches = mutableListOf<IntRange>()
    private var currentMatchIndex = -1
    private var isSearchCaseSensitive = false
    private var isSearchRegex = false
    private var isSearchWholeWord = false

    private var currentFontSizeSp = TextEditorSettings.DEFAULT_FONT_SIZE

    private var currentCursorLine = 1
    private var currentCursorCol = 1

    // Cursor navigation history (MT Manager: Posición anterior / Siguiente posición)
    private val cursorBackStack = ArrayDeque<Int>()
    private val cursorForwardStack = ArrayDeque<Int>()
```
