`app/src/test/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/provider/archive/LibarchiveSecurityTest.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.archive

import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.archive.archiver.ArchiveSecurityPreferences
import me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.archive.archiver.ArchiveSecuritySanitizer
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Before
import org.junit.Test
import java.nio.ByteBuffer
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets

class LibarchiveSecurityTest {

    @Before
    fun setUp() {
        ArchiveSecurityPreferences.resetStats()
    }

    @Test
    fun testCve2026_15028_sanitizeBuffer_neutralizes_sun_holesdata() {
        // Construct a synthetic TAR PAX extended header block containing the CVE-2026-15028 attack vector
        val paxHeader = "30 path=test_file.txt\n45 SUN.holesdata=0,1024,\n20 comment=malicious\n"
        val buffer = paxHeader.toByteArray(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII)
        val originalSize = buffer.size

        val sanitizedCount = ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.sanitizeBuffer(buffer, 0, buffer.size)

        assertEquals("Should neutralize exactly 1 occurrence of SUN.holesdata", 1, sanitizedCount)
        assertEquals("Buffer length must remain identical", originalSize, buffer.size)

        val resultString = String(buffer, StandardCharsets.US_ASCII)
        assertFalse("Buffer must no longer contain SUN.holesdata", resultString.contains("SUN.holesdata"))
        assertTrue("Buffer must now contain neutral SUN.xolesdata", resultString.contains("SUN.xolesdata"))
        assertTrue("Rest of the PAX header must remain completely intact", resultString.contains("path=test_file.txt"))
        assertEquals(1, ArchiveSecurityPreferences.getCve2026_15028Count())
    }

    @Test
    fun testCve2026_15028_sanitizeBuffer_multiple_occurrences() {
        val paxHeader = "45 SUN.holesdata=0,1024\n45 SUN.holesdata=\n"
        val buffer = paxHeader.toByteArray(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII)

        val sanitizedCount = ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.sanitizeBuffer(buffer, 0, buffer.size)

        assertEquals("Should neutralize all occurrences", 2, sanitizedCount)
        val resultString = String(buffer, StandardCharsets.US_ASCII)
        assertFalse(resultString.contains("SUN.holesdata"))
        assertEquals(2, ArchiveSecurityPreferences.getCve2026_15028Count())
    }

    @Test
    fun testCve2026_15028_sanitizeBuffer_clean_tar_untouched() {
        val normalTarData = "ustar  \u0000root\u0000root\u00000000644\u00000001750\u00000001750\u000000000000000\u0000"
        val buffer = normalTarData.toByteArray(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII)
        val copy = buffer.clone()

        val sanitizedCount = ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.sanitizeBuffer(buffer, 0, buffer.size)

        assertEquals("Clean tar data must not be modified", 0, sanitizedCount)
        assertTrue("Buffer contents must remain identical", buffer.contentEquals(copy))
    }

    @Test
    fun testCve2026_15028_sanitizeDirectBuffer() {
        val paxContent = "50 SUN.holesdata=0,1024,2048,1024\n"
        val bytes = paxContent.toByteArray(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII)
        val directBuffer = ByteBuffer.allocateDirect(bytes.size)
        directBuffer.put(bytes)
        directBuffer.flip()

        val count = ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.sanitizeDirectBuffer(directBuffer)

        assertEquals(1, count)
        val outputBytes = ByteArray(bytes.size)
        directBuffer.get(outputBytes)
        val outputStr = String(outputBytes, StandardCharsets.US_ASCII)
        assertFalse(outputStr.contains("SUN.holesdata"))
        assertTrue(outputStr.contains("SUN.xolesdata"))
    }

    @Test
    fun testCve2026_14164_rar5_signature_detection() {
        // RAR5 magic signature: 52 61 72 21 1A 07 01 00
        val rar5Header = byteArrayOf(0x52, 0x61, 0x72, 0x21, 0x1A, 0x07, 0x01, 0x00)
        assertTrue("Must detect RAR5 header", ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.isRar5Header(rar5Header))

        // RAR4 legacy signature: 52 61 72 21 1A 07 00
        val rar4Header = byteArrayOf(0x52, 0x61, 0x72, 0x21, 0x1A, 0x07, 0x00, 0x00)
        assertFalse("RAR4 header must not be detected as RAR5", ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.isRar5Header(rar4Header))

        // Standard ZIP header: 50 4B 03 04
        val zipHeader = byteArrayOf(0x50, 0x4B, 0x03, 0x04, 0x14, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00)
        assertFalse("ZIP header must not be detected as RAR5", ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.isRar5Header(zipHeader))
    }

    @Test
    fun testMalformedSunHolesdataValidation() {
        assertTrue("Empty value is malformed", ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.isMalformedSunHolesdata(""))
        assertTrue("Trailing comma is malformed (CVE-2026-15028 trigger)", ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.isMalformedSunHolesdata("0,1024,"))
        assertTrue("Odd number of numbers is malformed", ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.isMalformedSunHolesdata("0,1024,2048"))
        assertTrue("Non-numeric characters are malformed", ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.isMalformedSunHolesdata("0,abc"))

        assertFalse("Valid pair is not malformed", ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.isMalformedSunHolesdata("0,1024"))
        assertFalse("Multiple valid pairs are not malformed", ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.isMalformedSunHolesdata("0,1024,2048,1024"))
    }

    @Test
    fun testCve2026_15028_streamSanitizer_handles_chunk_boundary_splits() {
        // Test all possible split positions across chunk boundary from k = 1 to 12
        for (k in 1..12) {
            val sanitizer = ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.StreamSanitizer()
            val chunk1Prefix = "30 path=test.txt\n45 "
            val chunk2Suffix = "=0,1024,\n20 comment=malicious\n"

            val split1 = ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.SUN_HOLESDATA_BYTES.copyOfRange(0, k)
            val split2 = ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.SUN_HOLESDATA_BYTES.copyOfRange(k, ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.SUN_HOLESDATA_BYTES.size)

            val chunk1 = (chunk1Prefix.toByteArray(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII) + split1)
            val chunk2 = (split2 + chunk2Suffix.toByteArray(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII))

            val count1 = sanitizer.sanitizeChunk(chunk1, 0, chunk1.size)
            val count2 = sanitizer.sanitizeChunk(chunk2, 0, chunk2.size)

            val reassembled = String(chunk1 + chunk2, StandardCharsets.US_ASCII)
            assertFalse(
                "Reassembled stream for split k=$k must NEVER contain SUN.holesdata",
                reassembled.contains("SUN.holesdata")
            )
            assertTrue(
                "Total sanitized count for split k=$k must be at least 1",
                (count1 + count2) >= 1
            )
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun testCve2026_15028_streamSanitizer_direct_chunk_boundary_split() {
        val sanitizer = ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.StreamSanitizer()
        val split1 = ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.SUN_HOLESDATA_BYTES.copyOfRange(0, 5) // "SUN.h"
        val split2 = ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.SUN_HOLESDATA_BYTES.copyOfRange(5, 13) // "olesdata"

        val buf1 = ByteBuffer.allocateDirect(split1.size)
        buf1.put(split1)
        buf1.flip()
        sanitizer.sanitizeDirectChunk(buf1)

        val buf2 = ByteBuffer.allocateDirect(split2.size + 10)
        buf2.put(split2)
        buf2.put("=0,1024,\n".toByteArray(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII))
        buf2.flip()
        sanitizer.sanitizeDirectChunk(buf2)

        val out1 = ByteArray(buf1.remaining()).also { buf1.get(it) }
        val out2 = ByteArray(buf2.remaining()).also { buf2.get(it) }
        val reassembled = String(out1 + out2, StandardCharsets.US_ASCII)
        assertFalse(
            "Direct buffer reassembled stream must not contain SUN.holesdata",
            reassembled.contains("SUN.holesdata")
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun testCve2026_14164_valid_rar5_header_passes_validation() {
        val validArchive = createSyntheticRar5Archive()
        val result = ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.validateRar5(validArchive)
        assertTrue("Valid RAR5 header must pass validation", result is ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.Rar5ValidationResult.Valid)
    }

    @Test
    fun testCve2026_14164_tampered_crc_rejected() {
        val tamperedArchive = createSyntheticRar5Archive(tamperCrc = true)
        val result = ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.validateRar5(tamperedArchive)
        assertTrue("Tampered CRC32 must be rejected", result is ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.Rar5ValidationResult.Corrupt)
        val reason = (result as ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.Rar5ValidationResult.Corrupt).reason
        assertTrue(reason.contains("CRC32 mismatch"))
    }

    @Test
    fun testCve2026_14164_truncated_header_rejected() {
        val truncatedArchive = createSyntheticRar5Archive(truncateBytes = 2)
        val result = ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.validateRar5(truncatedArchive)
        assertTrue("Truncated archive header must be rejected", result is ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.Rar5ValidationResult.Corrupt)
    }

    @Test
    fun testCve2026_14164_invalid_initial_block_type_rejected() {
        val invalidTypeArchive = createSyntheticRar5Archive(headerType = 2L)
        val result = ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.validateRar5(invalidTypeArchive)
        assertTrue("Invalid initial block type must be rejected", result is ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.Rar5ValidationResult.Corrupt)
        val reason = (result as ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.Rar5ValidationResult.Corrupt).reason
        assertTrue(reason.contains("Invalid initial RAR5 header block type"))
    }

    @Test
    fun testCve2026_14164_corrupt_vint_exceeding_10_bytes_rejected() {
        val magic = ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.RAR5_SIGNATURE
        val fakeCrc = byteArrayOf(0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00)
        val corruptVint = ByteArray(11) { 0x80.toByte() }
        val corruptPayload = magic + fakeCrc + corruptVint

        val result = ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.validateRar5(corruptPayload)
        assertTrue("VINT exceeding 10 bytes must be rejected", result is ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.Rar5ValidationResult.Corrupt)
        val reason = (result as ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.Rar5ValidationResult.Corrupt).reason
        assertTrue(reason.contains("exceeds 10 bytes"))
    }

    @Test
    fun testCve2026_14164_oversized_header_rejected() {
        val magic = ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.RAR5_SIGNATURE
        val fakeCrc = byteArrayOf(0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00)
        val oversizedVint = encodeVint(3_000_000L)
        val payload = magic + fakeCrc + oversizedVint

        val result = ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.validateRar5(payload)
        assertTrue("Oversized block header must be rejected", result is ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.Rar5ValidationResult.Corrupt)
        val reason = (result as ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.Rar5ValidationResult.Corrupt).reason
        assertTrue(reason.contains("exceeds 2MB limit"))
    }

    @Test
    fun testCve2026_14164_non_rar5_returns_not_rar5() {
        val zipBytes = byteArrayOf(0x50, 0x4B, 0x03, 0x04, 0x14, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00)
        val result = ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.validateRar5(zipBytes)
        assertTrue("Non-RAR5 file must return NotRar5", result is ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.Rar5ValidationResult.NotRar5)
    }

    private fun createSyntheticRar5Archive(
        headerType: Long = 1L,
        headerFlags: Long = 0L,
        tamperCrc: Boolean = false,
        truncateBytes: Int = 0,
        customPayload: ByteArray? = null
    ): ByteArray {
        val magic = ArchiveSecuritySanitizer.RAR5_SIGNATURE

        val payload = customPayload ?: run {
            val typeBytes = encodeVint(headerType)
            val flagsBytes = encodeVint(headerFlags)
            val arcFlagsBytes = byteArrayOf(0x00)
            typeBytes + flagsBytes + arcFlagsBytes
        }

        val sizeVint = encodeVint(payload.size.toLong())

        val crc = java.util.zip.CRC32()
        crc.update(sizeVint)
        crc.update(payload)
        var crcVal = crc.value
        if (tamperCrc) {
            crcVal = crcVal xor 0xFFFFFFFFL
        }

        val crcBytes = byteArrayOf(
            (crcVal and 0xFF).toByte(),
            ((crcVal shr 8) and 0xFF).toByte(),
            ((crcVal shr 16) and 0xFF).toByte(),
            ((crcVal shr 24) and 0xFF).toByte()
        )

        val full = magic + crcBytes + sizeVint + payload
        return if (truncateBytes > 0) full.copyOfRange(0, full.size - truncateBytes) else full
    }

    private fun encodeVint(value: Long): ByteArray {
        val bytes = mutableListOf<Byte>()
        var v = value
        while (true) {
            var b = (v and 0x7FL).toInt()
            v = v ushr 7
            if (v != 0L) {
                b = b or 0x80
            }
            bytes.add(b.toByte())
            if (v == 0L) break
        }
        return bytes.toByteArray()
    }
}
```

```kt
        assertEquals("", successResult.err)

        val failResult = ShizukuShell.Result(false, "", "Permission denied", 1)
        assertFalse(failResult.isSuccess)
        assertEquals(1, failResult.code)
        assertEquals("Permission denied", failResult.err)
```

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.security

import me.zhanghai.android.files.file.AxmlDecoder
import me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist.ApktoolPaths
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.ShellEscapeUtils
import me.zhanghai.android.files.util.escapeShellArg
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import java.io.File

class SecurityHardeningTest {

    @Test
    fun testAxmlDecoderSafetyOnCorruptedInput() {
        // Empty bytes
        assertFalse(AxmlDecoder.isAxml(byteArrayOf()))
        assertEquals("", AxmlDecoder.decode(byteArrayOf()))

        // Plain text XML should pass through
        val plainXml = "<manifest package=\"com.test\" />"
        assertFalse(AxmlDecoder.isAxml(plainXml.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)))
        assertEquals(plainXml, AxmlDecoder.decode(plainXml.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)))

        // Truncated header with AXML magic
        val truncatedAxml = byteArrayOf(0x03, 0x00, 0x08, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00)
        assertTrue(AxmlDecoder.isAxml(truncatedAxml))
        val decoded = AxmlDecoder.decode(truncatedAxml)
        assertTrue(decoded.contains("<?xml"))
    }

    @Test
    fun testShellArgumentEscaping() {
        // Standard string
        assertEquals("'hello'", ShellEscapeUtils.escape("hello"))
        assertEquals("'hello'", "hello".escapeShellArg())

        // String with single quote
        assertEquals("'hello'\\''world'", "hello'world".escapeShellArg())

        // Command injection attempt with semicolons
        val inject1 = "; rm -rf / ;"
        val escaped1 = inject1.escapeShellArg()
        assertEquals("'; rm -rf / ;'", escaped1)

        // Command injection attempt with subshell expansion $()
        val inject2 = "foo\$(id)"
        val escaped2 = inject2.escapeShellArg()
        assertEquals("'foo\$(id)'", escaped2)

        // Command injection attempt with backticks
        val inject3 = "foo`id`"
        val escaped3 = inject3.escapeShellArg()
        assertEquals("'foo`id`'", escaped3)

        // Command injection attempt with quotes and AND operator
        val inject4 = "test\" && reboot"
        val escaped4 = inject4.escapeShellArg()
        assertEquals("'test\" && reboot'", escaped4)
    }

    @Test
    fun testApktoolPathTraversalHardening() {
        val baseDir = ApktoolPaths.getApktoolBaseDir()

        // Path traversal payload
        val maliciousPkg1 = "../../../../system"
        val dir1 = ApktoolPaths.getPackageDir(maliciousPkg1)
        assertTrue(
            "Sanitized package dir must reside inside baseDir: ${dir1.canonicalPath}",
            dir1.canonicalPath.startsWith(baseDir.canonicalPath)
        )
        assertFalse(
            "Package dir must not contain path traversal dots: ${dir1.name}",
            dir1.name.contains("..")
        )

        // Slashes in package name
        val maliciousPkg2 = "com.test/../../evil"
        val dir2 = ApktoolPaths.getPackageDir(maliciousPkg2)
        assertTrue(
            "Sanitized package dir must reside inside baseDir: ${dir2.canonicalPath}",
            dir2.canonicalPath.startsWith(baseDir.canonicalPath)
        )

        // Valid package name
        val validPkg = "com.y.om"
        val dir3 = ApktoolPaths.getPackageDir(validPkg)
        assertEquals(File(baseDir, "com.y.om").canonicalPath, dir3.canonicalPath)
    }

    @Test
    fun testSqliteIdentifierEscaping() {
        fun escapeSqlIdentifier(name: String): String = "`" + name.replace("`", "``") + "`"

        assertEquals("`users`", escapeSqlIdentifier("users"))
        assertEquals("`table with spaces`", escapeSqlIdentifier("table with spaces"))
        // Injection attempt using backtick closing
        val injection = "users`; DROP TABLE test; --"
        val escaped = escapeSqlIdentifier(injection)
        assertEquals("`users``; DROP TABLE test; --`", escaped)
    }

    @Test
    fun testFtpServerPasswordGenerationAndSecurity() {
        val pw1 = me.zhanghai.android.files.ftpserver.FtpServerService.generateRandomPassword(8)
        val pw2 = me.zhanghai.android.files.ftpserver.FtpServerService.generateRandomPassword(8)
        assertEquals(8, pw1.length)
        assertEquals(8, pw2.length)
        // Two independently generated passwords must have high entropy
        org.junit.Assert.assertNotEquals(pw1, pw2)

        // Valid characters: only alphanumeric, avoiding ambiguous chars (0, O, 1, l, I)
        val allowedChars = "abcdefghjkmnpqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789".toSet()
        for (c in pw1) {
            assertTrue("Password character '$c' must be in allowed set", allowedChars.contains(c))
        }

        // Test anonymous vs authenticated write policy
        fun evaluateFtpWritable(isAnonymous: Boolean, prefWritable: Boolean): Boolean {
            return prefWritable && !isAnonymous
        }

        // Anonymous must NEVER have write permission, even if pref is true
        assertFalse(evaluateFtpWritable(isAnonymous = true, prefWritable = true))
        assertFalse(evaluateFtpWritable(isAnonymous = true, prefWritable = false))

        // Authenticated users only have write permission if explicitly enabled
        assertTrue(evaluateFtpWritable(isAnonymous = false, prefWritable = true))
        assertFalse(evaluateFtpWritable(isAnonymous = false, prefWritable = false))
    }

    @Test
    fun testMinaObjectSerializationDecoderNeutralizedForCve2024_52046() {
        // CVE-2024-52046: Ensure unsafe Java ObjectSerialization classes have been permanently
        // eliminated from the MINA runtime and classpath.
        val decoderAbsent = try {
            Class.forName("org.apache.mina.filter.codec.serialization.ObjectSerializationDecoder")
            false

            true
        } catch (e: NoClassDefFoundError) {
            true
        }
        assertTrue(
            "ObjectSerializationDecoder must be permanently stripped from classpath",
            decoderAbsent
        )

        val streamAbsent = try {
            Class.forName("org.apache.mina.filter.codec.serialization.ObjectSerializationInputStream")
            false
        } catch (e: ClassNotFoundException) {
            true
        } catch (e: NoClassDefFoundError) {
            true
        }
        assertTrue(
            "ObjectSerializationInputStream must be permanently stripped from classpath",
            streamAbsent
        )

        // Verify standard safe MINA networking classes remain functional
        val sessionClass = Class.forName("org.apache.mina.core.session.IoSession")
        assertTrue("IoSession must remain available for FTP operation", sessionClass.isInterface)
    }

    @Test
    fun testNetworkSecurityConfigHardening() {
        val xmlFile = File("src/main/res/xml/network_security_config.xml")
        assertTrue("network_security_config.xml must exist at corrected path", xmlFile.exists())
        val xmlContent = xmlFile.readText()

        // Verify base-config disallows global cleartext
        assertTrue("base-config must disallow cleartext traffic by default",
            xmlContent.contains("<base-config cleartextTrafficPermitted=\"false\">"))

        // Verify base-config only trusts system certificates (not user certificates in production)
        val baseConfigSection = xmlContent.substringAfter("<base-config").substringBefore("</base-config>")
        assertTrue("base-config must trust system certificates",
            baseConfigSection.contains("<certificates src=\"system\""))
        assertFalse("base-config must NOT trust user certificates in production",
            baseConfigSection.contains("<certificates src=\"user\""))

        // Verify debug-overrides encapsulates user certificates
        assertTrue("debug-overrides must exist for development proxying",
            xmlContent.contains("<debug-overrides>"))
        val debugSection = xmlContent.substringAfter("<debug-overrides>").substringBefore("</debug-overrides>")
        assertTrue("debug-overrides should contain user certificates",
            debugSection.contains("<certificates src=\"user\""))

        // Verify AndroidManifest.xml uses the corrected network security config and has no global cleartext attribute
        val manifestFile = File("src/main/AndroidManifest.xml")
        assertTrue("AndroidManifest.xml must exist", manifestFile.exists())
        val manifestContent = manifestFile.readText()
        assertTrue("Manifest must link network_security_config without typo",
            manifestContent.contains("android:networkSecurityConfig=\"@xml/network_security_config\""))
        assertFalse("Manifest must not declare global usesCleartextTraffic=true",
            manifestContent.contains("android:usesCleartextTraffic=\"true\""))
    }

    @Test
    fun testHiddenApiExemptionsAreNarrowedAndHardened() {
        val jniFile = File("src/main/jni/hiddenapi.c")

        )
    }

    @Test
    fun testKernelAndSyscallHardeningAgainstSymlinkAndChainedCommands() {
        // 1. Verify DeadManProtectionManager catches chained commands and symlink evasions
        val dangerousChained = "echo safe && rm -rf /system"
        assertTrue(
            "DeadManProtectionManager must detect dangerous command inside chained operator &&",
            me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.root.DeadManProtectionManager.containsDangerousSystemCommand(dangerousChained)
        )

        val quotedCmd = "rm -rf \"/system\""
        assertTrue(
            "DeadManProtectionManager must detect quoted system deletion target",
            me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.root.DeadManProtectionManager.isCatastrophicSystemDeletion(quotedCmd, "/system")
        )

        val busyboxCmd = "busybox rm -rf /vendor"
        assertTrue(
            "DeadManProtectionManager must detect busybox rm variant",
            me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.root.DeadManProtectionManager.isCatastrophicSystemDeletion(busyboxCmd, "/vendor")
        )

        val chrootCmd = "chroot /sdcard/fake_env /system/bin/sh"
        assertTrue(
            "DeadManProtectionManager must detect chroot evasion attempt",
            me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.root.DeadManProtectionManager.containsDangerousSystemCommand(chrootCmd)
        )

        // 2. Verify traversal path evasion blocked in isProtectedFromModification
        val traversalPath = "/data/local/tmp/../../system/bin/sh"
        assertTrue(
            "DeadManProtectionManager must block modification targeting system via path traversal",
            me.zhanghai.android.files.provider.root.DeadManProtectionManager.isProtectedFromModification("sh", traversalPath)
        )

        // 3. Verify ElfInspector defines sensitive symbols for symlink and evasion syscalls
        val elfFile = File("src/main/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/filelist/ElfInspector.kt")
        assertTrue("ElfInspector.kt must exist", elfFile.exists())
        val elfCode = elfFile.readText()
        val requiredElfSyscalls = listOf(
            "symlink", "symlinkat", "readlink", "readlinkat",
            "chroot", "pivot_root", "setns", "unshare", "sys_reboot"
        )
        for (sc in requiredElfSyscalls) {
            assertTrue("ElfInspector must audit sensitive symbol: $sc", elfCode.contains("\"$sc\" to Triple"))
        }

        // 4. Verify ScriptRunnerHelper audits chained commands and symlink creation
        val scriptWithSymlinkAndChain = "echo init && ln -s /system /sdcard/syslink && chroot /sdcard/syslink"
        val auditReport = me.zhanghai.android.files.filelist.ScriptRunnerHelper.auditScriptText(scriptWithSymlinkAndChain)
        assertTrue(
            "ScriptRunnerHelper must flag chained commands with symlink and chroot in systemPaths",
            auditReport.systemPaths.isNotEmpty()
        )

        // 5. Verify SyscallReaderMonitor checks /proc/<pid>/cwd for protected partitions
        val monitorFile = File("src/main/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/terminal/tracer/SyscallReaderMonitor.kt")
        assertTrue("SyscallReaderMonitor.kt must exist", monitorFile.exists())
        val monitorCode = monitorFile.readText()
        assertTrue(
            "SyscallReaderMonitor must inspect process working directory via /proc/<pid>/cwd",
            monitorCode.contains("/proc/\$targetPid/cwd")
        )
    }
}
```

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * All Rights Reserved.
```

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.terminal

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import me.zhanghai.android.files.terminal.tracer.BinaryTracerEngine
import me.zhanghai.android.files.terminal.tracer.DeletionDecision
import me.zhanghai.android.files.terminal.tracer.TraceEventType
import me.zhanghai.android.files.terminal.tracer.SyscallCategory
import me.zhanghai.android.files.terminal.tracer.SyscallResolver
import me.zhanghai.android.files.terminal.tracer.SyscallRisk

import java.io.File

class TerminalLogicTest {

    private fun formatShellCommand(cwd: String, initialCommand: String): String {
        val escapedCwd = cwd.replace("'", "'\\''")
        return "cd '$escapedCwd' && ($initialCommand); _mt_status=\$?; exit \$_mt_status"
    }

    private fun simulateJniArgvConstruction(cmd: String, args: Array<String>?): Array<String> {
        val size = args?.size ?: 0
        var prependCmd = false
        if (size == 0) {
            prependCmd = true
        } else if (args != null && args[0].startsWith("-")) {
            prependCmd = true
        }

        val totalArgs = size + (if (prependCmd) 1 else 0)
        val result = ArrayList<String>(totalArgs)
        if (prependCmd) {
            val progName = File(cmd).name
            result.add(if (progName.isNotEmpty()) progName else "sh")
        }
        if (args != null) {
            result.addAll(args)
        }
        return result.toTypedArray()
    }

    @Test
    fun testShellCommandEscapesSingleQuotes() {
        val cwd = "/storage/emulated/0/My Folder's Documents"
        val cmd = "sh \"/storage/emulated/0/a.sh\""
        val formatted = formatShellCommand(cwd, cmd)

        assertTrue(formatted.contains("'/storage/emulated/0/My Folder'\\''s Documents'"))
        assertTrue(formatted.contains("(sh \"/storage/emulated/0/a.sh\")"))
        assertTrue(formatted.endsWith("; _mt_status=\$?; exit \$_mt_status"))
    }

    @Test
    fun testArgv0IntegrityStandardShell() {
        val cmd = "sh \"/storage/emulated/0/a.sh\""
        val shellCmd = formatShellCommand("/storage/emulated/0", cmd)
        val args = arrayOf("sh", "-c", shellCmd)

        // Ensure args[0] is program name 'sh', NOT '-c'
        assertNotEquals("-c", args[0])
        assertEquals("sh", args[0])
        assertEquals("-c", args[1])
        assertEquals(shellCmd, args[2])
    }

    @Test
    fun testArgv0IntegrityRootAndTermex() {
        val cmd = "sh \"/storage/emulated/0/a.sh\""
        val shellCmd = formatShellCommand("/storage/emulated/0", cmd)

        val rootArgs = arrayOf("su", "-c", shellCmd)
        assertEquals("su", rootArgs[0])
        assertEquals("-c", rootArgs[1])

        val termexArgs = arrayOf("bash", "--norc", "-c", shellCmd)
        assertEquals("bash", termexArgs[0])
        assertEquals("--norc", termexArgs[1])
        assertEquals("-c", termexArgs[2])
    }

    @Test
    fun testJniAutoPrependsProgramNameWhenOmitted() {
        // Test when caller erroneously passed only ["-c", "cmd"]
        val flawedArgs = arrayOf("-c", "echo hello")
        val fixedArgv = simulateJniArgvConstruction("/system/bin/sh", flawedArgs)

        assertEquals(3, fixedArgv.size)
        assertEquals("sh", fixedArgv[0])
        assertEquals("-c", fixedArgv[1])
        assertEquals("echo hello", fixedArgv[2])
    }

    @Test
    fun testJniKeepsArgvWhenProgramNameAlreadyPresent() {
        val goodArgs = arrayOf("sh", "-c", "echo hello")
        val argv = simulateJniArgvConstruction("/system/bin/sh", goodArgs)

        assertEquals(3, argv.size)
        assertEquals("sh", argv[0])
        assertEquals("-c", argv[1])
        assertEquals("echo hello", argv[2])
    }

    @Test
    fun testJniHandlesEmptyOrNullArgs() {
        val argvNull = simulateJniArgvConstruction("/system/bin/sh", null)
        assertEquals(1, argvNull.size)
        assertEquals("sh", argvNull[0])

        val argvEmpty = simulateJniArgvConstruction("/system/bin/sh", emptyArray())
        assertEquals(1, argvEmpty.size)
        assertEquals("sh", argvEmpty[0])
    }

    @Test
    fun testDefaultFontSizeIsReadable() {
        fun getFontSize(storedSize: Int): Int {
            return if (storedSize < 13) 14 else storedSize
        }
        fun setFontSize(size: Int): Int {
            return size.coerceIn(10, 32)
        }

        assertEquals(14, getFontSize(12)) // upgrades legacy 12 to 14
        assertEquals(14, getFontSize(14))
        assertEquals(16, getFontSize(16))
        assertEquals(10, setFontSize(8))  // clamps minimum
        assertEquals(32, setFontSize(40)) // clamps maximum
    }

    @Test
    fun testScriptExecutionManagerLifecycle() {
        var finishedCode: Int? = null
        val listener = object : ScriptExecutionManager.SessionListener {
            override fun onSessionFinished(exitCode: Int) {
                finishedCode = exitCode
            }
        }
        ScriptExecutionManager.addListener(listener)

        ScriptExecutionManager.activePid = 1234
        assertEquals(1234, ScriptExecutionManager.activePid)

        ScriptExecutionManager.onSessionFinished(0, null)
        assertEquals(0, finishedCode)
        assertEquals(0, ScriptExecutionManager.lastExitCode)

        ScriptExecutionManager.clearSession()
        assertEquals(-1, ScriptExecutionManager.activePid)
        assertEquals("", ScriptExecutionManager.activeScriptName)

        ScriptExecutionManager.removeListener(listener)
    }

    @Test
    fun testElfArchitectureHeaderParsing() {
        fun parseElfMachine(bytes: ByteArray): Int {
            if (bytes.size < 20) return -1
            if (bytes[0] != 0x7F.toByte() || bytes[1] != 'E'.code.toByte() ||
                bytes[2] != 'L'.code.toByte() || bytes[3] != 'F'.code.toByte()) {
                return -1
            }
            val isLittleEndian = bytes[5].toInt() == 1
            return if (isLittleEndian) {
                (bytes[18].toInt() and 0xFF) or ((bytes[19].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8)
            } else {
                ((bytes[18].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or (bytes[19].toInt() and 0xFF)
            }
        }

        // Fake AArch64 (183 = 0x00B7)
        val aarch64Header = ByteArray(20).apply {
            this[0] = 0x7F.toByte(); this[1] = 'E'.code.toByte(); this[2] = 'L'.code.toByte(); this[3] = 'F'.code.toByte()
            this[4] = 2 // 64-bit
            this[5] = 1 // Little endian
            this[18] = 0xB7.toByte()
            this[19] = 0x00.toByte()
        }
        assertEquals(183, parseElfMachine(aarch64Header))

        // Fake x86_64 (62 = 0x003E)
        val x86_64Header = ByteArray(20).apply {
            this[0] = 0x7F.toByte(); this[1] = 'E'.code.toByte(); this[2] = 'L'.code.toByte(); this[3] = 'F'.code.toByte()
            this[4] = 2 // 64-bit
            this[5] = 1 // Little endian
            this[18] = 0x3E.toByte()
            this[19] = 0x00.toByte()
        }
        assertEquals(62, parseElfMachine(x86_64Header))

        // Non-ELF file
        val textHeader = "#!/bin/sh\necho test\n".toByteArray()
        assertEquals(-1, parseElfMachine(textHeader))
    }

    @Test
    fun testCrlfToLfSanitization() {
        val windowsScript = "#!/system/bin/sh\r\necho \"step 1\"\r\necho \"step 2\"\r\n"
        val unixScript = windowsScript.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")

        assertTrue(windowsScript.contains("\r\n"))
        assertTrue(!unixScript.contains("\r"))
        assertEquals("#!/system/bin/sh\necho \"step 1\"\necho \"step 2\"\n", unixScript)
    }

    @Test
    fun testTracerHighFrequencySyscallAggregation() {
        BinaryTracerEngine.clear()

        // 1. Record burst of 50,000 syscalls
        BinaryTracerEngine.recordSyscallBurst("SYS_getpid", 50000L, "Benchmark 1")
        assertEquals(50000L, BinaryTracerEngine.totalSyscallsCount.get())
        assertEquals(50000L, BinaryTracerEngine.getSyscallCounters()["SYS_getpid"])

        // 2. Record second burst - should aggregate into existing recent event O(1)
        BinaryTracerEngine.recordSyscallBurst("SYS_getpid", 50000L, "Benchmark 2")
        assertEquals(100000L, BinaryTracerEngine.totalSyscallsCount.get())
        assertEquals(100000L, BinaryTracerEngine.getSyscallCounters()["SYS_getpid"])

        // Ring buffer should hold 1 consolidated event rather than 100,000 objects
        val events = BinaryTracerEngine.getEvents()
        assertEquals(1, events.size)
        assertEquals(100000L, events[0].count)
        assertEquals("SYS_getpid", events[0].target)
        assertEquals(TraceEventType.SYSCALL_BURST, events[0].type)
    }

    @Test
    fun testTracerDeletionInterceptionAndDecisionLifecycle() {
        BinaryTracerEngine.clear()

        // 1. Initial attempt
        val event = BinaryTracerEngine.recordDeletionAttempt("rm -rf /data/local/tmp/test.tmp", "/data/local/tmp/test.tmp", DeletionDecision.PENDING)
        val stats1 = BinaryTracerEngine.getStats()
        assertEquals(1L, stats1.totalDeletions)
        assertEquals(0L, stats1.blockedDeletions)
        assertEquals(0L, stats1.allowedDeletions)

        // 2. User blocks the deletion (non-fatal, script continues)
        BinaryTracerEngine.recordDecision(event.id, DeletionDecision.BLOCKED)
        val stats2 = BinaryTracerEngine.getStats()
        assertEquals(1L, stats2.totalDeletions)
        assertEquals(1L, stats2.blockedDeletions)
        assertEquals(0L, stats2.allowedDeletions)
        assertEquals(DeletionDecision.BLOCKED, event.decision)

        // 3. User allows subsequent deletion
        val event2 = BinaryTracerEngine.recordDeletionAttempt("unlink /data/local/tmp/dummy.tmp", "/data/local/tmp/dummy.tmp", DeletionDecision.ALLOWED)
        val stats3 = BinaryTracerEngine.getStats()
        assertEquals(2L, stats3.totalDeletions)
        assertEquals(1L, stats3.blockedDeletions)
        assertEquals(1L, stats3.allowedDeletions)
    }

    @Test

        val match = regex.find(chunk)
        assertTrue(match != null)
        assertEquals("DEADMAN_DELETE", match!!.groupValues[1])
        assertEquals("rm -rf /system", match.groupValues[2])
        assertEquals("/system", match.groupValues[3].trim())
    }

    @Test
    fun testElfInspectorHeaderValidationAndArchitecture() {
        // Invalid non-ELF bytes
        val nonElf = byteArrayOf(0x00, 0x01, 0x02, 0x03)
        assertTrue(!ElfInspector.isElf(nonElf))

        // Valid ARM64 Little-Endian PIE header
        val header = ByteArray(64)
        header[0] = 0x7F
        header[1] = 'E'.code.toByte()
        header[2] = 'L'.code.toByte()
        header[3] = 'F'.code.toByte()
        header[4] = 2 // 64-bit
        header[5] = 1 // Little Endian
        header[6] = 1 // Version
        // e_type at offset 16: ET_DYN = 3 (PIE)
        header[16] = 3
        header[17] = 0
        // e_machine at offset 18: EM_AARCH64 = 183 (0x00B7)
        header[18] = 0xB7.toByte()
        header[19] = 0x00

        assertTrue(ElfInspector.isElf(header))
        val report = ElfInspector.inspect(header)
        assertEquals(true, report.is64Bit)
        assertEquals(true, report.isLittleEndian)
        assertEquals(true, report.isPie)
        assertTrue(report.machineArch.contains("AArch64"))
    }

    @Test
    fun testElfInspectorSymbolAndSyscallDetection() {
        // Construct ELF header + embedded sensitive strings
        val header = ByteArray(256)
        header[0] = 0x7F
        header[1] = 'E'.code.toByte()
        header[2] = 'L'.code.toByte()
        header[3] = 'F'.code.toByte()
        header[4] = 2 // 64-bit
        header[5] = 1 // Little Endian
        header[16] = 3 // ET_DYN
        header[18] = 0xB7.toByte() // AArch64

        // Embed symbols into the data section: unlink, system, ptrace, socket, reboot
        val symbols = "unlink\u0000system\u0000ptrace\u0000socket\u0000reboot\u0000/system/bin/su\u0000"
        val symBytes = symbols.toByteArray(Charsets.ISO_8859_1)
        System.arraycopy(symBytes, 0, header, 64, symBytes.size)

        val report = ElfInspector.inspect(header)
        assertTrue(report.totalFindings > 0)
        assertTrue(report.deletions.any { it.contains("unlink") })
        assertTrue(report.executionCalls.any { it.contains("system") })
        assertTrue(report.ptraceCalls.any { it.contains("ptrace") })
        assertTrue(report.networkCalls.any { it.contains("socket") })
        assertTrue(report.systemCalls.any { it.contains("reboot") })
        assertTrue(report.rootCalls.any { it.contains("su") })

        val scriptAuditReport = report.toScriptAuditReport()
        assertEquals(report.totalFindings, scriptAuditReport.totalFindings)
    }

    @Test
    fun testBinaryTracerProcSyscallLiveTracking() {
        BinaryTracerEngine.clear()

        // 1. Record live proc syscall for unlinkat
        BinaryTracerEngine.recordProcSyscall(1234, 35, "0xffffff9c 0x7ffffff 0x0")
        val stats1 = BinaryTracerEngine.getStats()
        assertEquals(1L, stats1.totalSyscalls)
        assertTrue(stats1.activeSyscall != null)
        assertEquals("sys_unlinkat", stats1.activeSyscall!!.name)
        assertEquals(SyscallCategory.DELETION_FS, stats1.activeSyscall!!.category)
        assertEquals(SyscallRisk.CRITICAL, stats1.activeSyscall!!.risk)

        // 2. Update I/O stats
        BinaryTracerEngine.updateProcIo(1500L, 200L, 1024000L, 512000L)
        val stats2 = BinaryTracerEngine.getStats()
        assertEquals(1500L, stats2.ioReadSyscalls)
        assertEquals(200L, stats2.ioWriteSyscalls)
        assertEquals(1024000L, stats2.ioBytesRead)
        assertEquals(512000L, stats2.ioBytesWritten)

        // 3. Events ring buffer should contain the recorded high-risk syscall event
        val events = BinaryTracerEngine.getEvents()
        assertTrue(events.any { it.target.contains("sys_unlinkat") })

        // 4. Verify clearing
        BinaryTracerEngine.clear()
        val statsCleared = BinaryTracerEngine.getStats()
        assertEquals(0L, statsCleared.totalSyscalls)
        assertEquals(0L, statsCleared.ioReadSyscalls)
        assertEquals(null, statsCleared.activeSyscall)
    }

    @Test
    fun testTerminalExtraKeysCtrlAndAltCombos() {
        // Test Ctrl combination mapping: (char.code - 64).toChar()
        fun computeCtrlCode(ch: Char): String {
            val upper = ch.uppercaseChar()
            return if (upper in 'A'..'Z') (upper.code - 64).toChar().toString() else upper.toString()
        }

        assertEquals("\u0003", computeCtrlCode('c'))
        assertEquals("\u0003", computeCtrlCode('C'))
        assertEquals("\u0004", computeCtrlCode('d'))
        assertEquals("\u001a", computeCtrlCode('z'))
        assertEquals("\u000c", computeCtrlCode('l'))

        // Test Alt prefix mapping
        fun computeAltCode(ch: Char): String = "\u001b$ch"
        assertEquals("\u001bf", computeAltCode('f'))
        assertEquals("\u001bb", computeAltCode('b'))
    }

    @Test
    fun testTerminalBreadcrumbPathFormatting() {
        fun formatBreadcrumb(cwd: String): String {
            return when {
                cwd.startsWith("/storage/emulated/0") -> cwd.replace("/storage/emulated/0", "~")
                cwd.startsWith("/data/data/me.zhanghai.android.files") -> cwd.replace("/data/data/me.zhanghai.android.files", "[app]")
                else -> cwd
            }
        }

        assertEquals("~", formatBreadcrumb("/storage/emulated/0"))
        assertEquals("~/Download/scripts", formatBreadcrumb("/storage/emulated/0/Download/scripts"))
        assertEquals("[app]/cache", formatBreadcrumb("/data/data/me.zhanghai.android.files/cache"))
        assertEquals("/system/bin", formatBreadcrumb("/system/bin"))
    }
}
```

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.update

class UpdateCheckerLogicTest {

    @Test
    fun testVersionComparison() {
        // Newer versions
        assertTrue(UpdateChecker.isVersionNewer("1.9.51", "1.9.50"))
        assertTrue(UpdateChecker.isVersionNewer("v1.9.51", "1.9.50"))
        assertTrue(UpdateChecker.isVersionNewer("1.10.0", "1.9.50"))
        assertTrue(UpdateChecker.isVersionNewer("2.0.0", "1.9.50"))
        assertTrue(UpdateChecker.isVersionNewer("1.9.50.1", "1.9.50"))

        // Equal or older versions
        assertFalse(UpdateChecker.isVersionNewer("1.9.50", "1.9.50"))
        assertFalse(UpdateChecker.isVersionNewer("v1.9.50", "1.9.50"))
        assertFalse(UpdateChecker.isVersionNewer("1.9.49", "1.9.50"))
        assertFalse(UpdateChecker.isVersionNewer("1.8.99", "1.9.50"))
        assertFalse(UpdateChecker.isVersionNewer("1.9.50", "1.9.50.1"))

    @Test

            ReleaseAsset("OpenManager-v1.9.51-debug.apk", 36879410L, "https://github.com/uamo11/OpenManager/releases/download/v1.9.51/OpenManager-v1.9.51-debug.apk")

        // Debug build must pick debug APK
        val debugAsset = UpdateChecker.selectAssetForDevice(assets, isDebug = true)
        assertNotNull(debugAsset)

        // Release build must pick release APK

    }

                  "size": 36622438,
                  "browser_download_url": "https://github.com/uamo11/OpenManager/releases/download/v1.9.51/OpenManager-v1.9.51-release.apk"
                }
              ]
            }
        """.trimIndent()

        // Test Release parsing
        val releaseInfo = UpdateChecker.parseReleaseJson(mockJson, isDebug = false)
        assertNotNull(releaseInfo)

        assertEquals("1.9.51", releaseInfo.version)
        assertEquals("OpenManager-v1.9.51-release.apk", releaseInfo.targetAsset.name)
        assertEquals(36622438L, releaseInfo.targetAsset.size)
        assertFalse(releaseInfo.isDebugChannel)

    }
```

`app/src/test/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/viewer/arsc/ArscEngineTest.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.viewer.arsc

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import java.nio.ByteBuffer
import java.nio.ByteOrder

class ArscEngineTest {

    private fun createMinimalArscTable(strings: List<String>): ByteArray {
        val headerSize = 12
        // Package Count = 0
        val packageCount = 0

        val stringPoolBytes = buildMockStringPool(strings)
        val totalSize = headerSize + stringPoolBytes.size

        val bb = ByteBuffer.allocate(totalSize).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
        bb.putShort(ArscEngine.RES_TABLE_TYPE)
        bb.putShort(headerSize.toShort())
        bb.putInt(totalSize)
        bb.putInt(packageCount)
        bb.put(stringPoolBytes)

        return bb.array()
    }

    private fun buildMockStringPool(strings: List<String>): ByteArray {
        val stringCount = strings.size
        val poolHeaderSize = 28
        val offsetsSize = stringCount * 4
        val stringsStart = poolHeaderSize + offsetsSize

        val dataStream = java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream()
        val offsets = IntArray(stringCount)

        for (i in 0 until stringCount) {
            offsets[i] = dataStream.size()
            val utf8 = strings[i].toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)
            dataStream.write(strings[i].length) // charLen
            dataStream.write(utf8.size) // byteLen
            dataStream.write(utf8)
            dataStream.write(0) // null
        }

        val raw = dataStream.toByteArray()
        val pad = (4 - (raw.size % 4)) % 4
        val paddedSize = raw.size + pad
        val totalPoolSize = stringsStart + paddedSize

        val bb = ByteBuffer.allocate(totalPoolSize).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
        bb.putShort(ArscEngine.RES_STRING_POOL_TYPE)
        bb.putShort(poolHeaderSize.toShort())
        bb.putInt(totalPoolSize)
        bb.putInt(stringCount)
        bb.putInt(0) // styleCount
        bb.putInt(ArscEngine.UTF8_FLAG)
        bb.putInt(stringsStart)
        bb.putInt(0) // stylesStart

        for (off in offsets) {
            bb.putInt(off)
        }
        bb.put(raw)
        for (p in 0 until pad) {
            bb.put(0.toByte())
        }

        return bb.array()
    }

    @Test
    fun testParseAndRebuildArsc() {
        val originalStrings = listOf("OpenManager", "app_name", "version_1.0", "settings")
        val arscBytes = createMinimalArscTable(originalStrings)

        val model = ArscEngine.parse(arscBytes)
        assertNotNull(model)
        assertEquals(4, model.strings.size)
        assertEquals("OpenManager", model.strings[0].value)
        assertEquals("app_name", model.strings[1].value)
        assertEquals("version_1.0", model.strings[2].value)
        assertEquals("settings", model.strings[3].value)

        // Modify strings
        val modified = listOf("OpenManager Pro", "app_name", "v2.0-mt", "settings")
        val rebuiltBytes = ArscEngine.rebuildWithModifiedStrings(arscBytes, modified)
        assertTrue(rebuiltBytes.size > 0)

        // Re-parse and verify
        val newModel = ArscEngine.parse(rebuiltBytes)
        assertEquals(4, newModel.strings.size)
        assertEquals("OpenManager Pro", newModel.strings[0].value)
        assertEquals("app_name", newModel.strings[1].value)
        assertEquals("v2.0-mt", newModel.strings[2].value)
        assertEquals("settings", newModel.strings[3].value)
    }
}
```

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.viewer.dex

import com.android.tools.smali.smali.Smali
import com.android.tools.smali.smali.SmaliOptions
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import java.io.File
import java.util.zip.ZipFile

class JadxDecompilerEngineTest {

    @Test
    fun testNormalizeClassName() {
        assertEquals("com.example.MyClass", JadxDecompilerEngine.normalizeClassName("Lcom/example/MyClass;"))
        assertEquals("com.example.MyClass", JadxDecompilerEngine.normalizeClassName("com/example/MyClass"))
        assertEquals("com.example.MyClass", JadxDecompilerEngine.normalizeClassName("com.example.MyClass"))
        assertEquals("com.example.MyClass\$Inner", JadxDecompilerEngine.normalizeClassName("Lcom/example/MyClass\$Inner;"))
    }

    @Test
    fun testDecompileClassFromDex() {
        val tempDir = File.createTempFile("jadx_test", "").apply {
            delete()
            mkdirs()
        }

        try {
            val smaliFile = File(tempDir, "Calculator.smali")
            val dexFile = File(tempDir, "classes.dex")

            val smaliCode = """
                .class public Lcom/openmanager/test/Calculator;
                .super Ljava/lang/Object;

                .method public constructor <init>()V
                    .registers 1
                    invoke-direct {p0}, Ljava/lang/Object;-><init>()V
                    return-void
                .end method

                .method public add(II)I
                    .registers 4
                    add-int v0, p1, p2
                    return v0
                .end method
            """.trimIndent()

            smaliFile.writeText(smaliCode)

            val options = SmaliOptions().apply {
                apiLevel = 28
                outputDexFile = dexFile.absolutePath
            }

            val assembled = Smali.assemble(options, listOf(smaliFile.absolutePath))
            assertTrue("Smali assembly must succeed", assembled)
            assertTrue("DEX file must exist", dexFile.exists())

            // Test single class decompilation
            val javaCode = JadxDecompilerEngine.decompileClass(dexFile, "Lcom/openmanager/test/Calculator;")
            assertNotNull(javaCode)
            assertTrue("Decompiled code must contain class declaration: $javaCode", javaCode.contains("class Calculator"))
            assertTrue("Decompiled code must contain method add: $javaCode", javaCode.contains("add(int"))

            // Test export to ZIP
            val zipFile = File(tempDir, "sources.zip")
            var progressCalls = 0
            JadxDecompilerEngine.decompileToZip(dexFile, zipFile) { _, _, _ ->
                progressCalls++
            }

            assertTrue("Zip file must exist", zipFile.exists())
            assertTrue("Zip file must have size > 0", zipFile.length() > 0)
            assertTrue("Progress callback must be invoked", progressCalls > 0)

            // Verify Zip entry
            ZipFile(zipFile).use { zf ->
                val entry = zf.getEntry("com/openmanager/test/Calculator.java")
                assertNotNull("com/openmanager/test/Calculator.java entry must exist in ZIP", entry)
            }

            // Test export to directory (Apktool JADX mode)
            val outDir = File(tempDir, "decomp_java")
            var dirProgressCalls = 0
            JadxDecompilerEngine.decompileToDirectory(dexFile, outDir) { _, _, _ ->
                dirProgressCalls++
            }
            val javaFile = File(outDir, "com/openmanager/test/Calculator.java")
            assertTrue("Calculator.java must be written to directory", javaFile.exists())
            assertTrue("Directory progress callback must be invoked", dirProgressCalls > 0)
            val dirCode = javaFile.readText()
            assertTrue("Directory Java file must contain class Calculator: $dirCode", dirCode.contains("class Calculator"))
        } finally {
            tempDir.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun testSanitizeRelativeSourcePath_normalClass() {
        assertEquals(
            "com/example/MainActivity.java",
            JadxDecompilerEngine.sanitizeRelativeSourcePath("com.example.MainActivity")
        )
        assertEquals(
            "com/example/MyClass.java",
            JadxDecompilerEngine.sanitizeRelativeSourcePath("Lcom/example/MyClass;")
        )
        assertEquals(
            "com/example/MyClass\$Inner.java",
            JadxDecompilerEngine.sanitizeRelativeSourcePath("Lcom/example/MyClass\$Inner;")
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun testSanitizeRelativeSourcePath_pathTraversalSequencesNeutralized() {
        val payload1 = "../../../../../../system/etc/hosts"
        val path1 = JadxDecompilerEngine.sanitizeRelativeSourcePath(payload1)
        org.junit.Assert.assertFalse("Path must not contain traversal dots: $path1", path1.contains(".."))
        org.junit.Assert.assertFalse("Path must not start with slash: $path1", path1.startsWith("/"))
        assertEquals("system/etc/hosts.java", path1)

        val payload2 = "com/example/../../malicious/Payload"
        val path2 = JadxDecompilerEngine.sanitizeRelativeSourcePath(payload2)
        org.junit.Assert.assertFalse("Path must not contain traversal dots: $path2", path2.contains(".."))
        assertEquals("com/example/malicious/Payload.java", path2)
    }

    @Test
    fun testSanitizeRelativeSourcePath_windowsBackslashTraversalNeutralized() {
        val payload = "..\\..\\..\\Windows\\System32\\cmd"
        val path = JadxDecompilerEngine.sanitizeRelativeSourcePath(payload)
        org.junit.Assert.assertFalse("Path must not contain backslashes: $path", path.contains("\\"))
        org.junit.Assert.assertFalse("Path must not contain traversal dots: $path", path.contains(".."))
        assertEquals("Windows/System32/cmd.java", path)
    }

    @Test
    fun testSanitizeRelativeSourcePath_illegalCharactersSanitized() {
        val payload = "com.example.Class:with*illegal?chars\"<bar>|"
        val path = JadxDecompilerEngine.sanitizeRelativeSourcePath(payload)
        org.junit.Assert.assertFalse("Path must not contain illegal chars", path.contains(":") || path.contains("*") || path.contains("?") || path.contains("\"") || path.contains("<") || path.contains(">") || path.contains("|"))
        assertEquals("com/example/Class_with_illegal_chars__bar__.java", path)
    }

    @Test
    fun testSanitizeRelativeSourcePath_pureTraversalFallsBackToSafeName() {
        val payload = "../../../.."
        val path = JadxDecompilerEngine.sanitizeRelativeSourcePath(payload)
        org.junit.Assert.assertFalse("Path must not contain traversal dots: $path", path.contains(".."))
        assertTrue("Fallback path must start with unnamed/Class_: $path", path.startsWith("unnamed/Class_"))
        assertTrue("Fallback path must end with .java: $path", path.endsWith(".java"))
    }
}
```

```kt
package me.zhanghai.android.files.viewer.hex

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class HexBufferTest {

    @Test
    fun testEmptyBufferBounds() {
        val buffer = HexBuffer(ByteArray(0))
        assertEquals(0, buffer.size)
        assertEquals(-1, buffer.searchHex(byteArrayOf(0x01, 0x02), 0, forward = true))
        assertEquals(-1, buffer.searchHex(byteArrayOf(0x01, 0x02), 0, forward = false))
        assertEquals(-1, buffer.searchText("test", 0, forward = true, ignoreCase = false))
        assertEquals(-1, buffer.searchText("test", 0, forward = false, ignoreCase = true))
        assertEquals(0, buffer.replaceAllHex(byteArrayOf(0x01), byteArrayOf(0x02)))
    }

    @Test
    fun testPatternLargerThanBuffer() {
        val data = byteArrayOf(0x41, 0x42) // "AB"
        val buffer = HexBuffer(data)
        val pattern = byteArrayOf(0x41, 0x42, 0x43, 0x44) // "ABCD"
        assertEquals(-1, buffer.searchHex(pattern, 0, forward = true))
        assertEquals(-1, buffer.searchHex(pattern, 0, forward = false))
        assertEquals(-1, buffer.searchText("ABCDEF", 0, forward = true, ignoreCase = true))
        assertEquals(-1, buffer.searchText("ABCDEF", 0, forward = false, ignoreCase = true))
    }

    @Test
    fun testSearchHexForwardAndBackward() {
        // "Hello World Hello"
        val text = "Hello World Hello"
        val buffer = HexBuffer(text.toByteArray())

        val pattern = "Hello".toByteArray()
        val first = buffer.searchHex(pattern, 0, forward = true)
        assertEquals(0, first)

        val second = buffer.searchHex(pattern, 5, forward = true)
        assertEquals(12, second)

        val backward = buffer.searchHex(pattern, 16, forward = false)
        assertEquals(12, backward)

        val backwardStart = buffer.searchHex(pattern, 10, forward = false)
        assertEquals(0, backwardStart)
    }

    @Test
    fun testSearchTextCaseInsensitive() {
        val text = "OpenManager MT Suite"
        val buffer = HexBuffer(text.toByteArray())

        val pos = buffer.searchText("mt suite", 0, forward = true, ignoreCase = true)
        assertEquals(12, pos)

        val notFound = buffer.searchText("notfound", 0, forward = true, ignoreCase = true)
        assertEquals(-1, notFound)
    }

    @Test
    fun testModifyAndUndoRedo() {
        val data = byteArrayOf(1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
        val buffer = HexBuffer(data)

        assertFalse(buffer.isModified)
        assertFalse(buffer.canUndo)

        buffer.modifyByte(2, 99.toByte())
        assertTrue(buffer.isModified)
        assertTrue(buffer.canUndo)
        assertEquals(99.toByte(), buffer.toByteArray()[2])

        val restored = buffer.undo()
        assertEquals(2, restored)
        assertEquals(3.toByte(), buffer.toByteArray()[2])
        assertFalse(buffer.isModified)
        assertTrue(buffer.canRedo)

        buffer.redo()
        assertEquals(99.toByte(), buffer.toByteArray()[2])
        assertTrue(buffer.isModified)
    }

    @Test
    fun testReplaceAllHex() {
        val data = "foo bar foo baz foo".toByteArray()
        val buffer = HexBuffer(data)

        val count = buffer.replaceAllHex("foo".toByteArray(), "OM".toByteArray())
        assertEquals(3, count)
        val result = String(buffer.toByteArray())
        assertEquals("OM bar OM baz OM", result)
    }
}
```

`app/src/test/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/viewer/text/CodeEditorLogicTest.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.viewer.text

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import java.util.regex.Pattern

class CodeEditorLogicTest {

    private fun findPartnerBracket(text: CharSequence, pos: Int, openBracket: Char): Int {
        val isOpen = openBracket == '(' || openBracket == '{' || openBracket == '['
        val partner = when (openBracket) {
            '(' -> ')'
            ')' -> '('
            '{' -> '}'
            '}' -> '{'
            '[' -> ']'
            ']' -> '['
            else -> return -1
        }

        val dir = if (isOpen) 1 else -1
        var depth = 0
        var i = pos

        while (i in text.indices) {
            val c = text[i]
            if (c == openBracket) {
                depth++
            } else if (c == partner) {
                depth--
                if (depth == 0) return i
            }
            i += dir
        }
        return -1
    }

    @Test
    fun testBracketMatching() {
        val code = "function test() { if (a[0] == 1) { return (x + y); } }"

        // match '(' at index 13 with ')' at index 14
        val p1 = findPartnerBracket(code, 13, '(')
        assertEquals(14, p1)

        // match '{' at index 16 with '}' at index 53
        val p2 = findPartnerBracket(code, 16, '{')
        assertEquals(53, p2)

        // match '[' at index 23 with ']' at index 25
        val p3 = findPartnerBracket(code, 23, '[')
        assertEquals(25, p3)

        // match backwards '}' at index 53 with '{' at index 16
        val p4 = findPartnerBracket(code, 53, '}')
        assertEquals(16, p4)
    }

    @Test
    fun testSearchPatternMatching() {
        val text = "OpenManager openmanager OPENMANAGER MTManager"

        // Plain search case insensitive
        val matchesCaseInsensitive = mutableListOf<Int>()
        var idx = 0
        while (idx < text.length) {
            val found = text.indexOf("openmanager", idx, ignoreCase = true)
            if (found == -1) break
            matchesCaseInsensitive.add(found)
            idx = found + 11
        }
        assertEquals(3, matchesCaseInsensitive.size)

        // Case sensitive
        val matchesCaseSensitive = mutableListOf<Int>()
        idx = 0
        while (idx < text.length) {
            val found = text.indexOf("openmanager", idx, ignoreCase = false)
            if (found == -1) break
            matchesCaseSensitive.add(found)
            idx = found + 11
        }
        assertEquals(1, matchesCaseSensitive.size)

        // Regex search
        val regex = Pattern.compile("(?i)[a-z]+manager")
        val matcher = regex.matcher(text)
        val regexMatches = mutableListOf<String>()
        while (matcher.find()) {
            regexMatches.add(matcher.group())
        }
        assertEquals(4, regexMatches.size) // OpenManager, openmanager, OPENMANAGER, MTManager
    }

    @Test
    fun testLineEndingConversion() {
        val crlfText = "line1\r\nline2\r\nline3\r\n"
        assertTrue(crlfText.contains("\r\n"))

        val normalized = crlfText.replace("\r\n", "\n")
        assertEquals("line1\nline2\nline3\n", normalized)

        val restoredCrlf = normalized.replace("\n", "\r\n")
        assertEquals(crlfText, restoredCrlf)
    }
}
```

`app/src/test/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/viewer/text/FastSyntaxScannerTest.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.viewer.text

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class FastSyntaxScannerTest {

    @Test
    fun testJavaCodeTokenization() {
        val code = """
            package com.example;
            
            // Single line comment
            public class Main {
                /* Block comment */
                public static void main(String[] args) {
                    int count = 42;
                    String msg = "Hello, OpenManager!";
                }
            }
        """.trimIndent()

        val tokens = FastSyntaxScanner.scan(code, SyntaxLanguage.JAVA)
        assertTrue(tokens.isNotEmpty())

        // Verify tokens are non-overlapping and within bounds
        for (i in tokens.indices) {
            val token = tokens[i]
            assertTrue(token.start >= 0)
            assertTrue(token.end <= code.length)
            assertTrue(token.start < token.end)
            if (i > 0) {
                assertTrue(token.start >= tokens[i - 1].end)
            }
        }

        // Verify specific tokens exist
        val comments = tokens.filter { it.color == FastSyntaxScanner.COLOR_COMMENT }
        assertEquals(2, comments.size)
        assertTrue(comments.all { it.isItalic })

        val strings = tokens.filter { it.color == FastSyntaxScanner.COLOR_STRING }
        assertEquals(1, strings.size)
        assertEquals("\"Hello, OpenManager!\"", code.substring(strings[0].start, strings[0].end))

        val numbers = tokens.filter { it.color == FastSyntaxScanner.COLOR_NUMBER }
        assertEquals(1, numbers.size)
        assertEquals("42", code.substring(numbers[0].start, numbers[0].end))
    }

    @Test
    fun testSmaliCodeTokenization() {
        val smali = """
            .class public Lcom/example/Test;
            .super Ljava/lang/Object;
            
            # Direct method
            .method public static test(I)V
                .registers 2
                const/4 v0, 0x1
                return-void
            .end method
        """.trimIndent()

        val tokens = FastSyntaxScanner.scan(smali, SyntaxLanguage.SMALI)
        assertTrue(tokens.isNotEmpty())

        // Verify smali directive token
        val directives = tokens.filter {
            smali.substring(it.start, it.end) == ".class" ||
            smali.substring(it.start, it.end) == ".method"
        }
        assertEquals(2, directives.size)
        assertTrue(directives.all { it.color == FastSyntaxScanner.COLOR_KEYWORD })

        // Verify smali register token v0
        val registers = tokens.filter { smali.substring(it.start, it.end) == "v0" }
        assertEquals(1, registers.size)
        assertEquals(FastSyntaxScanner.COLOR_TYPE, registers[0].color)

        // Verify hex number 0x1
        val hex = tokens.filter { smali.substring(it.start, it.end) == "0x1" }
        assertEquals(1, hex.size)
        assertEquals(FastSyntaxScanner.COLOR_NUMBER, hex[0].color)
    }

    @Test
    fun testXmlCodeTokenization() {
        val xml = """
            <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
            <!-- Application manifest -->
            <manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
                package="me.zhanghai.android.files">
                <application android:allowBackup="true" />
            </manifest>
        """.trimIndent()

        val tokens = FastSyntaxScanner.scan(xml, SyntaxLanguage.XML)
        assertTrue(tokens.isNotEmpty())

        val comment = tokens.filter { it.color == FastSyntaxScanner.COLOR_COMMENT }
        assertEquals(1, comment.size)
        assertEquals("<!-- Application manifest -->", xml.substring(comment[0].start, comment[0].end))

        val tags = tokens.filter { it.color == FastSyntaxScanner.COLOR_TAG }
        assertTrue(tags.isNotEmpty())

        val attrs = tokens.filter { it.color == FastSyntaxScanner.COLOR_ATTRIBUTE }
        assertTrue(attrs.isNotEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun testPerformanceOnLargeCode() {
        // Build 5,000 lines of code (~150KB)
        val sb = java.lang.StringBuilder()
        for (i in 1..5000) {
            sb.append("    int val").append(i).append(" = ").append(i * 10).append(";\n")
            sb.append("    String text").append(i).append(" = \"item_").append(i).append("\"; // comment\n")
        }
        val text = sb.toString()

        val startTime = System.currentTimeMillis()
        val tokens = FastSyntaxScanner.scan(text, SyntaxLanguage.JAVA)
        val elapsed = System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime

        assertTrue(tokens.isNotEmpty())
        // Should tokenize 10,000 lines in less than 500ms
        assertTrue("Elapsed $elapsed ms was too slow", elapsed < 500)
    }
}
```

`app/src/test/java/me/zhanghai/android/files/viewer/text/TextEditorFileSynchronizationTest.kt`:

```kt
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026 OpenManager
 * All Rights Reserved.
 */

package me.zhanghai.android.files.viewer.text

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class TextEditorFileSynchronizationTest {

    private class SyncTracker(
        var lastLoadedModifiedTime: Long = 0L,
        var lastLoadedFileSize: Long = 0L,
        var isSelfSaving: Boolean = false
    ) {
        fun hasExternalChange(currentModTime: Long, currentSize: Long): Boolean {
            if (isSelfSaving) return false
            if (lastLoadedModifiedTime <= 0L) return false
            if (currentModTime <= 0L) return false

            return currentModTime > lastLoadedModifiedTime ||
                (currentModTime != lastLoadedModifiedTime && currentSize != lastLoadedFileSize)
        }

        fun acknowledgeExternalChange(currentModTime: Long, currentSize: Long) {
            if (currentModTime > 0L) {
                lastLoadedModifiedTime = currentModTime
                lastLoadedFileSize = currentSize
            }
        }

        fun onSaveSuccess(newModTime: Long, newSize: Long) {
            lastLoadedModifiedTime = newModTime
            lastLoadedFileSize = newSize
            isSelfSaving = false
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun testNoChangeDetectedWhenFileUnmodified() {
        val tracker = SyncTracker(
            lastLoadedModifiedTime = 1700000000000L,
            lastLoadedFileSize = 1024L
        )

        // Querying with the same timestamp and size must NOT trigger external change
        assertFalse(tracker.hasExternalChange(1700000000000L, 1024L))
    }

    @Test
    fun testExternalChangeDetectedOnNewerTimestamp() {
        val tracker = SyncTracker(
            lastLoadedModifiedTime = 1700000000000L,
            lastLoadedFileSize = 1024L
        )

        // File modified 5 seconds later
        val laterModTime = 1700000005000L
        assertTrue(
            "Should detect external modification when timestamp is newer",
            tracker.hasExternalChange(laterModTime, 1024L)
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun testExternalChangeDetectedOnSizeChangeWithDifferentTimestamp() {
        val tracker = SyncTracker(
            lastLoadedModifiedTime = 1700000000000L,
            lastLoadedFileSize = 1024L
        )

        // File size changed to 2048 with different timestamp
        assertTrue(
            "Should detect external modification when size changed",
            tracker.hasExternalChange(1700000001000L, 2048L)
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun testSelfSavingDoesNotTriggerExternalChange() {
        val tracker = SyncTracker(
            lastLoadedModifiedTime = 1700000000000L,
            lastLoadedFileSize = 1024L,
            isSelfSaving = true
        )

        // Even if disk timestamp is newer while saving, isSelfSaving suppresses notification
        assertFalse(
            "Self saving must suppress external change notification",
            tracker.hasExternalChange(1700000002000L, 1200L)
        )

        // Once saved, tracker updates to new time and clears isSelfSaving
        tracker.onSaveSuccess(1700000002000L, 1200L)
        assertFalse(
            "After save completes, state should be clean",
            tracker.hasExternalChange(1700000002000L, 1200L)
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun testAcknowledgeExternalChangePreventsRepeatedDialogs() {
        val tracker = SyncTracker(
            lastLoadedModifiedTime = 1700000000000L,
            lastLoadedFileSize = 1024L
        )

        val externalModTime = 1700000010000L
        val externalSize = 1500L
        assertTrue(tracker.hasExternalChange(externalModTime, externalSize))

        // User chooses "Conservar mis cambios" / Cancel -> acknowledge
        tracker.acknowledgeExternalChange(externalModTime, externalSize)

        // Subsequent queries with that timestamp must now return false
        assertFalse(
            "After acknowledging, it must not badger the user repeatedly",
            tracker.hasExternalChange(externalModTime, externalSize)
        )

        // If changed AGAIN later, it triggers again
        val nextModTime = 1700000020000L
        assertTrue(
            "Subsequent change after acknowledgement must trigger again",
            tracker.hasExternalChange(nextModTime, externalSize)
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun testDialogModeSelectionLogic() {
        fun getDialogActionText(hasUnsavedChanges: Boolean): Pair<String, String> {
            val title = "Archivo modificado externamente"
            val negativeBtn = if (hasUnsavedChanges) "Conservar mis cambios" else "Cancelar"
            return title to negativeBtn
        }

        val cleanMode = getDialogActionText(hasUnsavedChanges = false)
        assertEquals("Archivo modificado externamente", cleanMode.first)
        assertEquals("Cancelar", cleanMode.second)

        val dirtyMode = getDialogActionText(hasUnsavedChanges = true)
        assertEquals("Archivo modificado externamente", dirtyMode.first)
        assertEquals("Conservar mis cambios", dirtyMode.second)
    }
}
```

```kt
    @Test
    fun testCursorNavigationHistoryLogic() {
        val backStack = ArrayDeque<Int>()
        val forwardStack = ArrayDeque<Int>()
        var currentOffset = 0

        fun jumpTo(offset: Int) {
            backStack.addLast(currentOffset)
            forwardStack.clear()
            currentOffset = offset
        }

        fun goBack(): Int? {
            if (backStack.isEmpty()) return null
            forwardStack.addLast(currentOffset)
            currentOffset = backStack.removeLast()
            return currentOffset
        }

        fun goForward(): Int? {
            if (forwardStack.isEmpty()) return null
            backStack.addLast(currentOffset)
            currentOffset = forwardStack.removeLast()
            return currentOffset
        }

        jumpTo(500)
        assertEquals(500, currentOffset)
        assertEquals(1, backStack.size)

        jumpTo(1200)
        assertEquals(1200, currentOffset)
        assertEquals(2, backStack.size)

        val back1 = goBack()
        assertEquals(500, back1)
        assertEquals(1, forwardStack.size)

        val back2 = goBack()
        assertEquals(0, back2)
        assertEquals(2, forwardStack.size)

        val forward1 = goForward()
        assertEquals(500, forward1)
        assertEquals(1, forwardStack.size)
    }

    @Test
    fun testAccessoryBarAutoWrapLogic() {
        val pairs = mapOf(
            "{" to "}",
            "(" to ")",
            "[" to "]",
            "\"" to "\"",
            "'" to "'",
            "<" to ">"
        )

        fun wrapOrPair(selectedText: String?, sym: String): String {
            val close = pairs[sym]
            return if (!selectedText.isNullOrEmpty() && close != null) {
                "$sym$selectedText$close"
            } else if (close != null) {
                "$sym$close"
            } else {
                sym
            }
        }

        // Selection wrapping
        assertEquals("\"selected\"", wrapOrPair("selected", "\""))
        assertEquals("{block}", wrapOrPair("block", "{"))
        assertEquals("[array]", wrapOrPair("array", "["))
        assertEquals("<tag>", wrapOrPair("tag", "<"))

        // Pair insertion when no selection
        assertEquals("{}", wrapOrPair("", "{"))
        assertEquals("()", wrapOrPair(null, "("))
        assertEquals("\"\"", wrapOrPair("", "\""))

        // Non-paired symbol
        assertEquals("=", wrapOrPair("foo", "="))
    }

        // Test clamping logic used in onScale
        val initialSize = 14f
        val zoomedIn = (initialSize * 1.5f).coerceIn(
            TextEditorSettings.MIN_FONT_SIZE,
            TextEditorSettings.MAX_FONT_SIZE
        )
        assertEquals(21f, zoomedIn, 0.01f)

            TextEditorSettings.MIN_FONT_SIZE,
            TextEditorSettings.MAX_FONT_SIZE
        )
        assertEquals(8f, zoomMinClamped, 0.01f)

        val zoomMaxClamped = (initialSize * 4.0f).coerceIn(
            TextEditorSettings.MIN_FONT_SIZE,
            TextEditorSettings.MAX_FONT_SIZE
        )
        assertEquals(38f, zoomMaxClamped, 0.01f)
    }
```

`appmanager_reference/androidx/documentfile/provider/DocumentFileUtils.java`:

```java
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later

package androidx.documentfile.provider;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.content.pm.ResolveInfo;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.provider.DocumentsContract;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.annotation.Nullable;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;

import io.github.muntashirakon.io.Paths;

public final class DocumentFileUtils {
    @NonNull
    public static DocumentFile newTreeDocumentFile(@Nullable DocumentFile parent, @NonNull Context context, @NonNull Uri uri) {
        return new TreeDocumentFile(parent, context, uri);
    }

    public static boolean isSingleDocumentFile(@Nullable DocumentFile documentFile) {
        return documentFile instanceof SingleDocumentFile;
    }

    public static boolean isTreeDocumentFile(@Nullable DocumentFile documentFile) {
        return documentFile instanceof TreeDocumentFile;
    }

    @NonNull
    public static String resolveAltNameForSaf(@NonNull DocumentFile documentFile) {
        // For Document Uris, an invalid Uri can return no display name
        if (DocumentFileUtils.isSingleDocumentFile(documentFile)) {
            // It's impossible to figure out the correct display name, but since this path is incorrect,
            // return the full last path segment
            return documentFile.getUri().getLastPathSegment();
        }
        if (DocumentFileUtils.isTreeDocumentFile(documentFile)) {
            // The last path segment of the last path segment is the real name
            return resolveAltNameForTreeUri(documentFile.getUri());
        }
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid DocumentFile, expected a SAF document.");
    }

    public static String resolveAltNameForTreeUri(@NonNull Uri treeUri) {
        // The last path segment of the last path segment is the real name
        List<String> segments = treeUri.getPathSegments();
        String primaryName = segments.get(1);
        if (segments.size() == 2) {
            return primaryName;
        }
        String secondaryName = segments.get(3);
        if (secondaryName.startsWith(primaryName + File.separator)) {
            secondaryName = Paths.getLastPathSegment(secondaryName.substring(primaryName.length() + 1));
        }
        if (!secondaryName.isEmpty()) {
            return secondaryName;
        }
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid Uri, expected a tree Uri.");
    }

    @Nullable
    public static ResolveInfo getUriSource(@NonNull Context context, @NonNull Uri uri) {
        String authority = uri.getAuthority();
        if (authority == null) {
            return null;
        }
        PackageManager pm = context.getPackageManager();
        Intent intent = new Intent(DocumentsContract.PROVIDER_INTERFACE);
        List<ResolveInfo> infos = pm.queryIntentContentProviders(intent, 0);
        for (ResolveInfo info : infos) {
            if (Objects.equals(authority, info.providerInfo.authority)) {
                return info;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }
}
```
