`appmanager_reference/io/github/muntashirakon/AppManager/actions/Action.java`:

```java
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
package io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.actions;

import android.content.Context;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;
import android.text.TextUtils;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.annotation.Nullable;

import org.json.JSONException;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.history.IJsonSerializer;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.history.JsonDeserializer;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.progress.ProgressHandler;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.types.UserPackagePair;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.utils.ThreadUtils;
import io.github.muntashirakon.util.LocalizedString;

/**
 * Common persistent contract for a self-contained Action.
 * <p>
 * Concrete Actions own payload decoding, target handling, state comparison, mutation,
 * and revert behavior. This class only owns common configuration and transport.
 */
public abstract class Action implements IJsonSerializer, Parcelable, LocalizedString {
    public static final int CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION = 1;

    private final String mId;
    @Nullable
    private final String mName;
    private final int mSchemaVersion;
    private final ActionKind mKind;
    private final ActionTargetSpec mTarget;
    private final ActionParameters mOnParameters;
    @Nullable
    private final ActionParameters mOffParameters;
    private final Strictness mStrictness;
    private final RevertMode mRevertMode;

    protected Action(@NonNull ActionKind kind, @NonNull ActionTargetSpec target,
                     @NonNull ActionParameters onParameters, @Nullable ActionParameters offParameters) {
        this(UUID.randomUUID().toString(), null, CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION, kind, target, onParameters,
                offParameters, Strictness.STRICT,
                offParameters == null ? RevertMode.NONE : RevertMode.EXPLICIT);
    }

    protected Action(@NonNull String id, @Nullable String name, int schemaVersion,
                     @NonNull ActionKind kind, @NonNull ActionTargetSpec target,
                     @NonNull ActionParameters onParameters, @Nullable ActionParameters offParameters,
                     @NonNull Strictness strictness, @NonNull RevertMode revertMode) {
        if (id.trim().isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Action id cannot be empty");
        if (target.getScope() != kind.getScope()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Action scope does not match kind");
        }
        if (revertMode == RevertMode.EXPLICIT && offParameters == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Explicit revert requires off parameters");
        }
        if (revertMode != RevertMode.EXPLICIT && offParameters != null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Only explicit revert may have off parameters");
        }
        mId = id;
        mName = name;
        mSchemaVersion = schemaVersion;
        mKind = kind;
        mTarget = target;
        mOnParameters = onParameters;
        mOffParameters = offParameters;
        mStrictness = strictness;
        mRevertMode = revertMode;
    }

    protected Action(@NonNull Parcel in, @NonNull ActionKind kind) {
        mId = in.readString();
        mName = in.readString();
        mSchemaVersion = in.readInt();
        mKind = kind;
        mTarget = in.readParcelable(ActionTargetSpec.class.getClassLoader());
        mOnParameters = in.readParcelable(ActionParameters.class.getClassLoader());
        mOffParameters = in.readParcelable(ActionParameters.class.getClassLoader());
        mStrictness = Strictness.valueOf(in.readString());
        mRevertMode = RevertMode.valueOf(in.readString());
    }

    @NonNull
    public final String getId() {
        return mId;
    }

    @Nullable
    public final String getName() {
        return mName;
    }

    public final int getSchemaVersion() {
        return mSchemaVersion;
    }

    @NonNull
    public final ActionKind getKind() {
        return mKind;
    }

    @NonNull
    public final ActionTargetSpec getTarget() {
        return mTarget;
    }

    @NonNull
    public final ActionParameters getOnParameters() {
        return mOnParameters;
    }

    @Nullable
    public final ActionParameters getOffParameters() {
        return mOffParameters;
    }

    @NonNull
    public final ActionParameters requireOffParameters() {
        if (mOffParameters == null) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(mKind + " has no reverse parameters");
        }
        return mOffParameters;
    }

    @NonNull
    public final Strictness getStrictness() {
        return mStrictness;
    }

    @NonNull
    public final RevertMode getRevertMode() {
        return mRevertMode;
    }

    @NonNull
    public abstract List<ActionResult> execute(@NonNull ActionContext context,
                                               @NonNull ActionMode mode,
                                               @NonNull List<ActionExecutionRecord> previousRecords);

    /**
     * Number of progress units this action is expected to consume.
     */
    public int getProgressMax(@NonNull ActionContext context) {
        return 1;
    }

    protected final void reportProgress(@NonNull ActionContext context,
                                        @NonNull ActionProgress progress) {
        context.dispatch(progress);
    }

    protected final void reportProgress(@NonNull ActionContext context,
                                        @Nullable CharSequence label, int max, float current,
                                        @NonNull ActionProgress.State state,
                                        @NonNull List<ActionResult> results) {
        reportProgress(context, new ActionProgress(label, max, current, state,
                context.executionMode, results));
    }

    protected final void reportProgress(@NonNull ActionContext context,
                                        @Nullable CharSequence label, int max, float current) {
        reportProgress(context, label, max, current, ActionProgress.State.UPDATED,
                java.util.Collections.emptyList());
    }

    protected final void reportIndeterminateProgress(@NonNull ActionContext context,
                                                     @Nullable CharSequence label) {
        reportProgress(context, label, ActionProgress.INDETERMINATE, 0);
    }

    @NonNull
    protected final ActionResult actionResult(@Nullable UserPackagePair target,
                                              @NonNull ActionResultStatus status,
                                              @Nullable ActionState observedState,
                                              @Nullable ActionState writtenState,
                                              @Nullable String message) {
        return actionResult(target, status, ActionConflict.NO_CONFLICT, observedState,
                writtenState, message);
    }

    @NonNull
    protected final ActionResult actionResult(@Nullable UserPackagePair target,
                                              @NonNull ActionResultStatus status,
                                              @NonNull ActionConflict conflict,
                                              @Nullable ActionState observedState,
                                              @Nullable ActionState writtenState,
                                              @Nullable String message) {
        return new ActionResult(getId(), target, status, conflict,
                observedState, writtenState, message);
    }

    /**
     * Creates an isolated progress stream for a nested operation such as backup or restore.
     * The parent stream remains reserved for the ActionPlan.
     */
    @Nullable
    protected final ProgressHandler newSubProgressHandler(@NonNull ActionContext context) {
        ProgressHandler parent = context.progressHandler;
        if (parent == null) {
            return null;
        }
        ProgressHandler child = parent.newSubProgressHandler();
        Object message = parent.getLastMessage();
        ThreadUtils.postOnMainThread(() -> child.onProgressStart(-1, 0, message));
        return child;
    }

    protected final void finishSubProgressHandler(@Nullable ProgressHandler child) {
        if (child != null) {
            ThreadUtils.postOnMainThread(() -> child.onResult(null));
        }
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    public CharSequence toLocalizedString(@NonNull Context context) {
        return TextUtils.isEmpty(mName) ? mKind.toLocalizedString(context) : mName;
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return (mName == null ? mKind.name() : mName) + "[" + mId + "]";
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    public JSONObject serializeToJson() throws JSONException {
        JSONObject object = new JSONObject();
        object.put("id", mId);
        if (mName != null) object.put("name", mName);
        object.put("schema", mSchemaVersion);
        object.put("kind", mKind.name());
        object.put("target", mTarget.serializeToJson());
        object.put("on", mOnParameters.serializeToJson());
        if (mOffParameters != null) object.put("off", mOffParameters.serializeToJson());
        object.put("strict", mStrictness == Strictness.STRICT);
        object.put("revert", mRevertMode.name());
        return object;
    }

    @NonNull
    public static Action fromJson(@NonNull JSONObject object) throws JSONException {
        String id = object.getString("id");
        String name = object.has("name") ? object.getString("name") : null;
        int schema = object.optInt("schema", CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION);
        ActionKind kind = ActionKind.valueOf(object.getString("kind"));
        ActionTargetSpec target = ActionTargetSpec.DESERIALIZER.deserialize(object.getJSONObject("target"));
        ActionParameters on = ActionParameters.DESERIALIZER.deserialize(object.getJSONObject("on"));
        ActionParameters off = object.has("off")
                ? ActionParameters.DESERIALIZER.deserialize(object.getJSONObject("off")) : null;
        Strictness strictness = object.optBoolean("strict", true)
                ? Strictness.STRICT : Strictness.NON_STRICT;
        RevertMode revert = RevertMode.valueOf(object.optString("revert",
                off == null ? RevertMode.NONE.name() : RevertMode.EXPLICIT.name()));
        return create(kind, id, name, schema, target, on, off, strictness, revert);
    }

    @NonNull
    protected final ActionParameters requireParameters(@NonNull ActionMode mode) {
        return mode == ActionMode.ON ? getOnParameters() : requireOffParameters();
    }

    protected final boolean requireBoolean(@NonNull ActionParameters parameters,
                                           @NonNull String key) {
        Object value = parameters.get(key);
        if (!(value instanceof Boolean)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected boolean parameter: " + key);
        }
        return (Boolean) value;
    }

    protected final int requireInt(@NonNull ActionParameters parameters, @NonNull String key) {
        Object value = parameters.get(key);
        if (!(value instanceof Integer)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected int parameter: " + key);
        }
        return (Integer) value;
    }

    @NonNull
    protected final int[] requireIntArray(@NonNull ActionParameters parameters, @NonNull String key) {
        Object value = parameters.get(key);
        if (!(value instanceof int[])) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected int[] parameter: " + key);
        }
        return (int[]) value;
    }

    @NonNull
    protected final String requireString(@NonNull ActionParameters parameters, @NonNull String key) {
        Object value = parameters.get(key);
        if (!(value instanceof String)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected String parameter: " + key);
        }
        return (String) value;
    }

    @NonNull
    protected final String[] requireStringArray(@NonNull ActionParameters parameters, @NonNull String key) {
        Object value = parameters.get(key);
        if (!(value instanceof String[])) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected String[] parameter: " + key);
        }
        return (String[]) value;
    }

    protected final boolean optionalBoolean(@NonNull ActionParameters parameters, @NonNull String key, boolean defaultValue) {
        Object value = parameters.get(key);
        if (value == null) {
            return defaultValue;
        }
        if (!(value instanceof Boolean)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected boolean parameter: " + key);
        }
        return (boolean) value;
    }

    @Nullable
    protected final String optionalString(@NonNull ActionParameters parameters, @NonNull String key) {
        Object value = parameters.get(key);
        if (value != null && !(value instanceof String)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected String parameter: " + key);
        }
        return (String) value;
    }

    @Nullable
    protected final String[] optionalStringArray(@NonNull ActionParameters parameters, @NonNull String key) {
        Object value = parameters.get(key);
        if (value != null && !(value instanceof String[])) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected String[] parameter: " + key);
        }
        return (String[]) value;
    }

    @NonNull
    private static Action create(@NonNull ActionKind kind, @NonNull String id, @Nullable String name,
                                 int schema, @NonNull ActionTargetSpec target,
                                 @NonNull ActionParameters on, @Nullable ActionParameters off,
                                 @NonNull Strictness strictness, @NonNull RevertMode revert) {
        if (kind == ActionKind.FREEZE) {
            return new FreezeAction(id, name, schema, target, on, off, strictness, revert);
        }
        if (kind == ActionKind.FORCE_STOP) {
            return new ForceStopAction(id, name, schema, target, on, strictness, revert);
        }
        if (kind == ActionKind.COMPONENT_STATE) {
            return new ComponentStateAction(id, name, schema, target, on, off, strictness, revert);
        }
        if (kind == ActionKind.PERMISSION_STATE) {
            return new PermissionStateAction(id, name, schema, target, on, off, strictness, revert);
        }
        if (kind == ActionKind.APP_OP_MODE) {
            return new AppOpModeAction(id, name, schema, target, on, off, strictness, revert);
        }
        if (kind == ActionKind.TRACKER_BLOCKING) {
            return new TrackerStateAction(id, name, schema, target, on, off, strictness, revert);
        }
        if (kind == ActionKind.NETWORK_POLICY) {
            return new NetworkPolicyAction(id, name, schema, target, on, off, strictness, revert);
        }
        if (kind == ActionKind.SENSOR_ACCESS) {
            return new SensorAccessAction(id, name, schema, target, on, off, strictness, revert);
        }
        if (kind == ActionKind.BATTERY_OPTIMIZATION) {
            return new BatteryOptimizationAction(id, name, schema, target, on, off, strictness, revert);
        }
        if (kind == ActionKind.CLEAR_CACHE) {
            return new ClearCacheAction(id, name, schema, target, on, strictness, revert);
        }
        if (kind == ActionKind.CLEAR_DATA) {
            return new ClearDataAction(id, name, schema, target, on, strictness, revert);
        }
        if (kind == ActionKind.DEXOPT) {
            return new DexOptAction(id, name, schema, target, on, strictness, revert);
        }
        if (kind == ActionKind.BACKUP) {
            return new BackupAction(id, name, schema, target, on, strictness, revert);
        }
        if (kind == ActionKind.BACKUP_APK) {
            return new BackupApkAction(id, name, schema, target, on, strictness, revert);
        }
        if (kind == ActionKind.RESTORE_BACKUP) {
            return new RestoreBackupAction(id, name, schema, target, on, strictness, revert);
        }
        if (kind == ActionKind.DELETE_BACKUP) {
            return new DeleteBackupAction(id, name, schema, target, on, strictness, revert);
        }
        if (kind == ActionKind.UNINSTALL) {
            return new UninstallAction(id, name, schema, target, on, strictness, revert);
        }
        if (kind == ActionKind.INSTALL_EXISTING) {
            return new InstallExistingAction(id, name, schema, target, on, strictness, revert);
        }
        if (kind == ActionKind.MAGISK_HIDE) {
            return new MagiskHideAction(id, name, schema, target, on, off, strictness, revert);
        }
        if (kind == ActionKind.MAGISK_DENYLIST) {
            return new MagiskDenylistAction(id, name, schema, target, on, off, strictness, revert);
        }
        if (kind == ActionKind.SETTING) {
            return new SettingAction(id, name, schema, target, on, off, strictness, revert);
        }
        if (kind == ActionKind.REBOOT) {
            return new RebootAction(id, name, schema, target, on, strictness, revert);
        }
        if (kind == ActionKind.DEVICE_STATE) {
            return new DeviceStateAction(id, name, schema, target, on, off, strictness, revert);
        }
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("No concrete Action implementation registered for " + kind);
    }

    public static final JsonDeserializer.Creator<Action> DESERIALIZER = object -> {
        try {
            return fromJson(object);
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException | JSONException e) {
            throw new JSONException(e.getMessage());
        }
    };

    @Override
    public final void writeToParcel(@NonNull Parcel dest, int flags) {
        dest.writeString(mKind.name());

        dest.writeParcelable(mOffParameters, flags);
        dest.writeString(mStrictness.name());
        dest.writeString(mRevertMode.name());
    }

    @Override
    public final int describeContents() {
        return 0;
    }
```

`appmanager_reference/io/github/muntashirakon/AppManager/actions/ActionContext.java`:

```java
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
package io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.actions;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.annotation.Nullable;
import androidx.annotation.AnyThread;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.IdentityHashMap;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;

import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.types.UserPackagePair;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.progress.ProgressHandler;

/**
 * Runtime-only inputs used when resolving configured and inherited targets.
 */
public final class ActionContext implements Parcelable {
    @NonNull
    public final String executionId;
    @NonNull
    public final String planId;
    @NonNull
    public final ActionExecutionMode executionMode;
    @Nullable
    public final UserPackagePair triggerTarget;
    @NonNull
    public final List<UserPackagePair> selectedTargets;
    public final long startedAt;
    public final boolean automatic;
    @Nullable
    public final transient ProgressHandler progressHandler;
    private final Map<ProgressListener, Object> mProgressListeners = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private final ArrayDeque<Runnable> mPendingProgress = new ArrayDeque<>();
    @Nullable
    private ActionProgress mLatestProgress;
    private boolean mDispatchingProgress;
    private int mPlanProgressMax;
    private int mActionProgressOffset;
    private int mActionProgressWorkload = -1;
    private final Map<Action, List<UserPackagePair>> mResolvedTargets;

    public ActionContext(@Nullable UserPackagePair triggerTarget,
                         @NonNull List<UserPackagePair> selectedTargets,
                         @NonNull String planId, @NonNull ActionExecutionMode executionMode,
                         long startedAt, boolean automatic) {
        this(triggerTarget, selectedTargets, planId, executionMode, startedAt, automatic, null);
    }

    public ActionContext(@Nullable UserPackagePair triggerTarget,
                         @NonNull List<UserPackagePair> selectedTargets,
                         @NonNull String planId, @NonNull ActionExecutionMode executionMode,
                         long startedAt, boolean automatic,
                         @Nullable ProgressHandler progressHandler) {
        this(triggerTarget, selectedTargets, planId, executionMode, startedAt, automatic,
                progressHandler, null);
    }

    public ActionContext(@Nullable UserPackagePair triggerTarget,
                         @NonNull List<UserPackagePair> selectedTargets,
                         @NonNull String planId, @NonNull ActionExecutionMode executionMode,
                         long startedAt, boolean automatic,
                         @Nullable ProgressHandler progressHandler,
                         @Nullable ProgressListener progressListener) {
        executionId = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
        this.planId = planId;
        this.executionMode = executionMode;
        this.triggerTarget = triggerTarget;
        this.selectedTargets = Collections.unmodifiableList(new ArrayList<>(selectedTargets));
        this.startedAt = startedAt;
        this.automatic = automatic;
        this.progressHandler = progressHandler;
        if (progressListener != null) {
            mProgressListeners.put(progressListener, new Object());
        }
        mResolvedTargets = new IdentityHashMap<>();
    }

    @NonNull
    List<UserPackagePair> resolveTargets(@NonNull PackageScopedAction action) {
        synchronized (mResolvedTargets) {
            List<UserPackagePair> cached = mResolvedTargets.get(action);
            if (cached != null) {
                return cached;
            }
            PackageTargetSpec spec = action.getTarget().getPackageTarget();
            LinkedHashSet<UserPackagePair> targets = new LinkedHashSet<>(spec.getConfiguredTargets());
            if (spec.includesSelected()) {
                targets.addAll(selectedTargets);
            }
            if (spec.includesInherited() && triggerTarget != null) {
                targets.add(triggerTarget);
            }
            cached = Collections.unmodifiableList(new ArrayList<>(targets));
            mResolvedTargets.put(action, cached);
            return cached;
        }
    }

    private ActionContext(@NonNull Parcel in) {
        executionId = in.readString();
        planId = in.readString();
        executionMode = ActionExecutionMode.values()[in.readInt()];
        triggerTarget = in.readParcelable(UserPackagePair.class.getClassLoader());
        selectedTargets = Collections.unmodifiableList(in.createTypedArrayList(UserPackagePair.CREATOR));
        startedAt = in.readLong();
        automatic = in.readInt() != 0;
        progressHandler = null;
        mResolvedTargets = new IdentityHashMap<>();
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(@NonNull Parcel dest, int flags) {
        dest.writeString(executionId);
        dest.writeString(planId);
        dest.writeInt(executionMode.ordinal());
        dest.writeParcelable(triggerTarget, flags);
        dest.writeTypedList(selectedTargets);
        dest.writeLong(startedAt);
        dest.writeInt(automatic ? 1 : 0);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents() {
        return 0;
    }

    @FunctionalInterface
    public interface ProgressListener {
        @AnyThread
        void onProgress(@NonNull ActionProgress progress);
    }

    /**
     * Registers an observer and replays the latest snapshot in publication order.
     */
    public void addProgressListener(@NonNull ProgressListener listener) {
        synchronized (mProgressListeners) {
            if (mProgressListeners.containsKey(listener)) {
                return;
            }
            Object registration = new Object();
            mProgressListeners.put(listener, registration);
            ActionProgress latest = mLatestProgress;
            if (latest != null) {
                mPendingProgress.add(() -> notifyProgressListener(listener, registration, latest));
            }
        }
        drainProgress();
    }

    /**
     * Unregisters an observer. A callback already being delivered may finish.
     */
    public void removeProgressListener(@NonNull ProgressListener listener) {
        synchronized (mProgressListeners) {
            mProgressListeners.remove(listener);
        }
    }

    @Nullable
    public ActionProgress getLatestProgress() {
        synchronized (mProgressListeners) {
            return mLatestProgress;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Applies an Action's numeric range before notifying the observers.
     */
    void beginActionProgress(int planMax, int offset, int workload) {
        synchronized (mProgressListeners) {
            if (mActionProgressWorkload >= 0) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("An Action progress range is already active");
            }
            mPlanProgressMax = planMax;
            mActionProgressOffset = offset;
            mActionProgressWorkload = workload;
        }
    }

    void endActionProgress() {
        synchronized (mProgressListeners) {
            mActionProgressWorkload = -1;
        }
    }

    @AnyThread
    public void dispatch(@NonNull ActionProgress progress) {
        synchronized (mProgressListeners) {
            ActionProgress event = progress;
            if (mActionProgressWorkload >= 0) {
                float localProgress;
                if (progress.max == ActionProgress.INDETERMINATE) {
                    localProgress = progress.state == ActionProgress.State.COMPLETED
                            ? mActionProgressWorkload : 0;
                } else {
                    localProgress = progress.max == 0 ? 0
                            : progress.current * mActionProgressWorkload / progress.max;
                }
                event = new ActionProgress(progress.label, mPlanProgressMax,
                        mPlanProgressMax == ActionProgress.INDETERMINATE
                                ? 0 : mActionProgressOffset + localProgress,
                        ActionProgress.State.UPDATED, executionMode, progress.results);
            }
            mLatestProgress = event;
            ActionProgress snapshot = event;
            Map<ProgressListener, Object> listeners = new LinkedHashMap<>(mProgressListeners);
            mPendingProgress.add(() -> {
                for (Map.Entry<ProgressListener, Object> listener : listeners.entrySet()) {
                    notifyProgressListener(listener.getKey(), listener.getValue(), snapshot);
                }
            });
        }
        drainProgress();
    }

    private void notifyProgressListener(@NonNull ProgressListener listener,
                                        @NonNull Object registration,
                                        @NonNull ActionProgress progress) {
        synchronized (mProgressListeners) {
            if (mProgressListeners.get(listener) != registration) {
                // Token didn't match: old listener?
                return;
            }
        }
        try {
            listener.onProgress(progress);
        } catch (RuntimeException ignored) {
            // Observer failures must not affect execution or other observers.
        }
    }

    private void drainProgress() {
        synchronized (mProgressListeners) {
            if (mDispatchingProgress) {
                return;
            }
            mDispatchingProgress = true;
        }
        while (true) {
            Runnable delivery;
            synchronized (mProgressListeners) {
                delivery = mPendingProgress.poll();
                if (delivery == null) {
                    mDispatchingProgress = false;
                    return;
                }
            }
            delivery.run();
        }
    }

    public static final Creator<ActionContext> CREATOR = new Creator<ActionContext>() {
        @NonNull
        @Override
        public ActionContext createFromParcel(Parcel in) {
            return new ActionContext(in);
        }

        @NonNull
        @Override
        public ActionContext[] newArray(int size) {
            return new ActionContext[size];
        }
    };
}
```

```java
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
package io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.actions;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.annotation.Nullable;

import org.json.JSONException;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.history.IJsonSerializer;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.history.JsonDeserializer;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.types.UserPackagePair;

/**
 * Journal entry written after each successful action execution.
 */
public final class ActionExecutionRecord implements IJsonSerializer, Parcelable {
    @NonNull
    public final String executionId;
    @NonNull
    public final String actionId;
    @NonNull
    public final String planId;
    @NonNull
    public final String stateKey;
    @Nullable
    public final UserPackagePair target;
    @Nullable
    public final ActionState originalState;
    @Nullable
    public final ActionState writtenState;
    public final long appliedAt;
    @NonNull
    public final ActionResultStatus status;

    public ActionExecutionRecord(@NonNull String executionId, @NonNull String actionId, @NonNull String planId,
                                 @NonNull String stateKey, @Nullable UserPackagePair target,
                                 @Nullable ActionState originalState, @Nullable ActionState writtenState,
                                 long appliedAt, @NonNull ActionResultStatus status) {
        this.executionId = executionId;
        this.actionId = actionId;
        this.planId = planId;
        this.stateKey = stateKey;
        this.target = target;
        this.originalState = originalState;
        this.writtenState = writtenState;
        this.appliedAt = appliedAt;
        this.status = status;
    }

    private ActionExecutionRecord(@NonNull JSONObject object) throws JSONException {
        executionId = object.getString("execution");
        actionId = object.getString("action");
        planId = object.getString("plan");
        stateKey = object.getString("key");
        target = object.has("package") ? new UserPackagePair(object.getString("package"), object.getInt("user")) : null;
        originalState = object.has("original") ? ActionState.DESERIALIZER.deserialize(object.getJSONObject("original")) : null;
        writtenState = object.has("written") ? ActionState.DESERIALIZER.deserialize(object.getJSONObject("written")) : null;
        appliedAt = object.getLong("applied_at");
        status = ActionResultStatus.valueOf(object.getString("status"));
    }

    public static final JsonDeserializer.Creator<ActionExecutionRecord> DESERIALIZER = ActionExecutionRecord::new;

    @NonNull
    @Override
    public JSONObject serializeToJson() throws JSONException {
        JSONObject object = new JSONObject();
        object.put("execution", executionId);
        object.put("action", actionId);
        object.put("plan", planId);
        object.put("key", stateKey);
        if (target != null) {
            object.put("package", target.getPackageName());
            object.put("user", target.getUserId());
        }
        if (originalState != null) {
            object.put("original", originalState.serializeToJson());
        }
        if (writtenState != null) {
            object.put("written", writtenState.serializeToJson());
        }
        object.put("applied_at", appliedAt);
        object.put("status", status.name());
        return object;
    }

    private ActionExecutionRecord(@NonNull Parcel in) {
        executionId = in.readString();
        actionId = in.readString();
        planId = in.readString();
        stateKey = in.readString();
        target = in.readParcelable(UserPackagePair.class.getClassLoader());
        originalState = in.readParcelable(ActionState.class.getClassLoader());
        writtenState = in.readParcelable(ActionState.class.getClassLoader());
        appliedAt = in.readLong();
        status = ActionResultStatus.valueOf(in.readString());
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(@NonNull Parcel dest, int flags) {
        dest.writeString(executionId);
        dest.writeString(actionId);
        dest.writeString(planId);
        dest.writeString(stateKey);
        dest.writeParcelable(target, flags);
        dest.writeParcelable(originalState, flags);
        dest.writeParcelable(writtenState, flags);
        dest.writeLong(appliedAt);
        dest.writeString(status.name());
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents() {
        return 0;
    }

    public static final Creator<ActionExecutionRecord> CREATOR = new Creator<ActionExecutionRecord>() {
        @NonNull
        @Override
        public ActionExecutionRecord createFromParcel(Parcel in) {
            return new ActionExecutionRecord(in);
        }

        @NonNull
        @Override
        public ActionExecutionRecord[] newArray(int size) {
            return new ActionExecutionRecord[size];
        }
    };
}
```

`appmanager_reference/io/github/muntashirakon/AppManager/actions/ActionParameters.java`:

```java
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
package io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.actions;

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.annotation.Nullable;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONException;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;

import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.history.IJsonSerializer;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.history.JsonDeserializer;

/**
 * Named parameters for an Action.
 */
public final class ActionParameters implements IJsonSerializer, Parcelable {
    private final Bundle mParameters;

    public ActionParameters() {
        mParameters = new Bundle();
    }

    public ActionParameters(@NonNull Bundle parameters) {
        mParameters = new Bundle(parameters);
    }

    private ActionParameters(@NonNull JSONObject object) throws JSONException {
        mParameters = fromJsonObject(object);
    }

    private ActionParameters(@NonNull Parcel in) {
        Bundle parameters = in.readBundle(ActionParameters.class.getClassLoader());
        mParameters = parameters == null ? new Bundle() : parameters;
    }

    @NonNull
    public ActionParameters put(@NonNull String key, @Nullable Object value) {
        if (value == null) {
            mParameters.putString(key, null);
        } else if (value instanceof String) {
            mParameters.putString(key, (String) value);
        } else if (value instanceof Boolean) {
            mParameters.putBoolean(key, (Boolean) value);
        } else if (value instanceof Integer) {
            mParameters.putInt(key, (Integer) value);
        } else if (value instanceof Long) {
            mParameters.putLong(key, (Long) value);
        } else if (value instanceof Double) {
            mParameters.putDouble(key, (Double) value);
        } else if (value instanceof Float) {
            mParameters.putFloat(key, (Float) value);
        } else if (value instanceof String[]) {
            mParameters.putStringArray(key, (String[]) value);
        } else if (value instanceof int[]) {
            mParameters.putIntArray(key, (int[]) value);
        } else if (value instanceof Bundle) {
            mParameters.putBundle(key, (Bundle) value);
        } else if (value instanceof Parcelable) {
            mParameters.putParcelable(key, (Parcelable) value);
        } else {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported action parameter: " + value.getClass());
        }
        return this;
    }

    public boolean containsKey(@NonNull String key) {
        return mParameters.containsKey(key);
    }

    @Nullable
    public Object get(@NonNull String key) {
        return mParameters.get(key);
    }

    @NonNull
    public Bundle asBundle() {
        return new Bundle(mParameters);
    }

    @NonNull
    public Set<String> keySet() {
        return Collections.unmodifiableSet(mParameters.keySet());
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    public JSONObject serializeToJson() throws JSONException {
        return toJsonObject(mParameters);
    }

    public static final JsonDeserializer.Creator<ActionParameters> DESERIALIZER = ActionParameters::new;

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(@NonNull Parcel dest, int flags) {
        dest.writeBundle(mParameters);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents() {
        return 0;
    }

    public static final Creator<ActionParameters> CREATOR = new Creator<ActionParameters>() {
        @NonNull
        @Override
        public ActionParameters createFromParcel(Parcel in) {
            return new ActionParameters(in);
        }

        @NonNull
        @Override
        public ActionParameters[] newArray(int size) {
            return new ActionParameters[size];
        }
    };

    @NonNull
    private static JSONObject toJsonObject(@NonNull Bundle bundle) throws JSONException {
        JSONObject object = new JSONObject();
        for (String key : bundle.keySet()) {
            object.put(key, toJsonValue(bundle.get(key)));
        }
        return object;
    }

    @NonNull
    private static Object toJsonValue(Object value) throws JSONException {
        if (value == null || value instanceof String || value instanceof Boolean
                || value instanceof Number) {
            return value == null ? JSONObject.NULL : value;
        }
        if (value instanceof Bundle) {
            return toJsonObject((Bundle) value);
        }
        if (value instanceof String[]) {
            return new JSONArray(value);
        }
        if (value instanceof int[]) {
            return new JSONArray(value);
        }
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported JSON action parameter: " + value.getClass());
    }

    @NonNull
    private static Bundle fromJsonObject(@NonNull JSONObject object) throws JSONException {
        Bundle bundle = new Bundle();
        JSONArray names = object.names();
        if (names == null) {
            return bundle;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < names.length(); ++i) {
            String name = names.getString(i);
            Object value = object.get(name);
            putJsonValue(bundle, name, value);
        }
        return bundle;
    }

    private static void putJsonValue(@NonNull Bundle bundle, @NonNull String key,
                                     @NonNull Object value) throws JSONException {
        if (value == JSONObject.NULL) {
            bundle.putString(key, null);
        } else if (value instanceof String) {
            bundle.putString(key, (String) value);
        } else if (value instanceof Boolean) {
            bundle.putBoolean(key, (Boolean) value);
        } else if (value instanceof Integer) {
            bundle.putInt(key, (Integer) value);
        } else if (value instanceof Long) {
            bundle.putLong(key, (Long) value);
        } else if (value instanceof Double) {
            bundle.putDouble(key, (Double) value);
        } else if (value instanceof JSONObject) {
            bundle.putBundle(key, fromJsonObject((JSONObject) value));
        } else if (value instanceof JSONArray) {
            JSONArray array = (JSONArray) value;
            if (array.length() == 0 || array.get(0) instanceof String) {
                List<String> values = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int i = 0; i < array.length(); ++i) values.add(array.getString(i));
                bundle.putStringArray(key, values.toArray(new String[0]));
            } else {
                int[] values = new int[array.length()];
                for (int i = 0; i < array.length(); ++i) values[i] = array.getInt(i);
                bundle.putIntArray(key, values);
            }
        } else {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported JSON action parameter: " + value.getClass());
        }
    }
}
```

`appmanager_reference/io/github/muntashirakon/AppManager/actions/ActionPlan.java`:

```java
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
package io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.actions;

import android.content.Context;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONException;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.history.IJsonSerializer;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.history.JsonDeserializer;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.logs.Logger;
import io.github.muntashirakon.util.LocalizedString;

/**
 * Ordered collection of actions.
 */
public final class ActionPlan implements IJsonSerializer, Parcelable, LocalizedString {
    private final String mId;
    private final String mName;
    private final List<Action> mActions;
    private final List<ActionExecutionRecord> mExecutionRecords;

    public ActionPlan(@NonNull String name, @NonNull List<Action> actions) {
        this(UUID.randomUUID().toString(), name, actions, Collections.emptyList());
    }

    public ActionPlan(@NonNull String id, @NonNull String name, @NonNull List<Action> actions) {
        this(id, name, actions, Collections.emptyList());
    }

    private ActionPlan(@NonNull String id, @NonNull String name, @NonNull List<Action> actions,
                       @NonNull List<ActionExecutionRecord> executionRecords) {
        if (id.isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Empty plan id");
        }
        mId = id;
        mName = name;
        mActions = Collections.unmodifiableList(new ArrayList<>(actions));
        mExecutionRecords = new ArrayList<>(executionRecords);
    }

    private ActionPlan(@NonNull JSONObject object) throws JSONException {
        mId = object.getString("id");
        mName = object.getString("name");
        JSONArray array = object.getJSONArray("actions");
        ArrayList<Action> definitions = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < array.length(); ++i) {
            definitions.add(Action.DESERIALIZER.deserialize(array.getJSONObject(i)));
        }
        mActions = Collections.unmodifiableList(definitions);
        ArrayList<ActionExecutionRecord> records = new ArrayList<>();
        JSONArray recordArray = object.optJSONArray("records");
        if (recordArray != null) {
            for (int i = 0; i < recordArray.length(); ++i) {
                records.add(ActionExecutionRecord.DESERIALIZER.deserialize(recordArray.getJSONObject(i)));
            }
        }
        mExecutionRecords = records;
    }

    public static final JsonDeserializer.Creator<ActionPlan> DESERIALIZER = ActionPlan::new;

    @NonNull
    public String getId() {
        return mId;
    }

    @NonNull
    public String getName() {
        return mName;
    }

    @NonNull
    public List<Action> getActions() {
        return mActions;
    }

    @NonNull
    public List<ActionExecutionRecord> getExecutionRecords() {
        return Collections.unmodifiableList(mExecutionRecords);
    }

    @NonNull
    public synchronized List<ActionResult> execute(@NonNull ActionContext context,
                                                   @NonNull ActionMode mode,
                                                   @NonNull Logger logger) {
        List<ActionResult> results = new ArrayList<>();
        List<ActionWork> actionWork = new ArrayList<>(mActions.size());
        int offset = 0;
        boolean singleIndeterminate = context.executionMode == ActionExecutionMode.SINGLETON
                && mActions.size() == 1;
        for (Action action : mActions) {
            int maxProgress = action.getProgressMax(context);
            if (maxProgress < ActionProgress.INDETERMINATE) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("Invalid Action progress maximum: " + maxProgress);
            }
            int workload = maxProgress == ActionProgress.INDETERMINATE ? 1 : maxProgress;
            actionWork.add(new ActionWork(action, offset, workload));
            offset += workload;
            if (maxProgress != ActionProgress.INDETERMINATE) {
                singleIndeterminate = false;
            }
        }
        int progressMax = singleIndeterminate ? ActionProgress.INDETERMINATE : offset;
        if (context.progressHandler != null) {
            context.addProgressListener(new ActionContext.ProgressListener() {
                @Override
                public void onProgress(@NonNull ActionProgress progress) {
                    try {
                        context.progressHandler.postActionProgress(progress);
                    } finally {
                        if (progress.state == ActionProgress.State.COMPLETED) {
                            // The terminal event may still be queued when execute() returns.
                            context.removeProgressListener(this);
                        }
                    }
                }
            });
        }
        // Dispatch initial progress, 0
        context.dispatch(new ActionProgress(null, progressMax, 0,
                ActionProgress.State.STARTED, context.executionMode, results));
        int completedWork = 0;
        try {
            logger.println("====> Started action plan: " + mName + " with mode: " + mode);
            for (ActionWork work : actionWork) {
                Action action = work.action;
                logger.println("====> Started action: " + action.getKind() + " (" + action.getId() + ")");
                List<ActionExecutionRecord> previous = new ArrayList<>();
                for (ActionExecutionRecord record : mExecutionRecords) {
                    if (record.actionId.equals(action.getId())) {
                        previous.add(record);
                    }
                }
                List<ActionResult> actionResults;
                context.beginActionProgress(progressMax, work.offset, work.workload);
                try {
                    actionResults = action.execute(context, mode, previous);
                } finally {
                    context.endActionProgress();
                }
                results.addAll(actionResults);
                completedWork += work.workload;
                for (ActionResult result : actionResults) {
                    if (result.status != ActionResultStatus.SUCCESS) {
                        logger.println("[!] action=" + action.getKind() + ", target=" + result.target
                                + ", status=" + result.status
                                + (result.message == null ? "" : ", message=" + result.message));
                    }
                    ActionState original = result.observedState;
                    ActionState written = result.writtenState;
                    ActionState state = original == null ? written : original;
                    if (state != null) {
                        mExecutionRecords.add(new ActionExecutionRecord(context.executionId,
                                action.getId(), mId, state.getStateKey(), result.target, original,
                                written, System.currentTimeMillis(), result.status));
                    }
                }
            }
        } finally {
            // Dispatch final progress, completedWork
            context.dispatch(new ActionProgress(null, progressMax,
                    progressMax == ActionProgress.INDETERMINATE ? 0 : completedWork,
                    ActionProgress.State.COMPLETED, context.executionMode, results));
        }
        return Collections.unmodifiableList(results);
    }

    private static final class ActionWork {
        @NonNull
        final Action action;
        final int offset;
        final int workload;

        ActionWork(@NonNull Action action, int offset, int workload) {
            this.action = action;
            this.offset = offset;
            this.workload = workload;
        }
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    public CharSequence toLocalizedString(@NonNull Context context) {
        return mName;
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return mName + "[" + mId + "]";
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    public JSONObject serializeToJson() throws JSONException {
        JSONObject object = new JSONObject();
        object.put("id", mId);
        object.put("name", mName);
        JSONArray array = new JSONArray();
        for (Action action : mActions) {
            array.put(action.serializeToJson());
        }
        object.put("actions", array);
        JSONArray records = new JSONArray();
        for (ActionExecutionRecord record : mExecutionRecords) {
            records.put(record.serializeToJson());
        }
        object.put("records", records);
        return object;
    }

    private ActionPlan(@NonNull Parcel in) {
        mId = in.readString();
        mName = in.readString();
        mActions = Collections.unmodifiableList(in.createTypedArrayList(Action.CREATOR));
        mExecutionRecords = new ArrayList<>(in.createTypedArrayList(ActionExecutionRecord.CREATOR));
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(@NonNull Parcel dest, int flags) {
        dest.writeString(mId);
        dest.writeString(mName);
        dest.writeTypedList(mActions);
        dest.writeTypedList(mExecutionRecords);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents() {
        return 0;
    }

    public static final Creator<ActionPlan> CREATOR = new Creator<ActionPlan>() {
        @NonNull
        @Override
        public ActionPlan createFromParcel(Parcel in) {
            return new ActionPlan(in);
        }

        @NonNull
        @Override
        public ActionPlan[] newArray(int size) {
            return new ActionPlan[size];
        }
    };
}
```

`appmanager_reference/io/github/muntashirakon/AppManager/actions/ActionProgress.java`:

```java
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
package io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.actions;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.annotation.Nullable;
import androidx.annotation.VisibleForTesting;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Progress emitted by an {@link Action} during execution.
 */
public final class ActionProgress {
    public enum State {STARTED, UPDATED, COMPLETED}

    @NonNull
    public final State state;
    @NonNull
    public final ActionExecutionMode executionMode;
    @NonNull
    public final List<ActionResult> results;
    /**
     * Maximum value used when the current operation has no measurable progress.
     */
    public static final int INDETERMINATE = -1;

    @Nullable
    public final CharSequence label;
    public final int max;
    public final float current;

    public ActionProgress(@Nullable CharSequence label, int max, float current) {
        this(label, max, current, State.UPDATED, ActionExecutionMode.BATCH,
                Collections.emptyList());
    }

    public ActionProgress(@Nullable CharSequence label, int max, float current,
                          @NonNull State state, @NonNull ActionExecutionMode executionMode,
                          @NonNull List<ActionResult> results) {
        if (max < 0 && max != INDETERMINATE) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid progress maximum: " + max);
        }
        if (Float.isNaN(current) || Float.isInfinite(current)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid progress value: " + current);
        }
        if (max == INDETERMINATE && current != 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Indeterminate progress has no numeric position");
        }
        if (max != INDETERMINATE && (current < 0 || current > max)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Progress value must be within [0, max]: " + current + "/" + max);
        }
        this.label = label == null ? null : label.toString();
        this.max = max;
        this.current = current;
        this.state = state;
        this.executionMode = executionMode;
        this.results = Collections.unmodifiableList(new ArrayList<>(results));
    }

    @VisibleForTesting
    @NonNull
    public static ActionProgress indeterminate(@Nullable CharSequence label) {
        return new ActionProgress(label, INDETERMINATE, 0);
    }

    @VisibleForTesting
    @NonNull
    public static ActionProgress determinate(@Nullable CharSequence label, int max, float current) {
        if (max < 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Determinate progress requires a non-negative max");
        }
        return new ActionProgress(label, max, current);
    }

    public boolean isIndeterminate() {
        return max == INDETERMINATE;
    }
}
```

```java
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
package io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.actions;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.annotation.Nullable;

import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.types.UserPackagePair;

/**
 * A per-target execution outcome.
 */
public final class ActionResult implements Parcelable {
    @NonNull
    public final String actionId;
    @Nullable
    public final UserPackagePair target;
    @NonNull
    public final ActionResultStatus status;
    @NonNull
    public final ActionConflict conflict;
    @Nullable
    public final ActionState observedState;
    @Nullable
    public final ActionState writtenState;
    @Nullable
    public final String message;

    public ActionResult(@NonNull String actionId, @Nullable UserPackagePair target,
                        @NonNull ActionResultStatus status, @NonNull ActionConflict conflict,
                        @Nullable ActionState observedState, @Nullable ActionState writtenState,
                        @Nullable String message) {
        this.actionId = actionId;
        this.target = target;
        this.status = status;
        this.conflict = conflict;
        this.observedState = observedState;
        this.writtenState = writtenState;
        this.message = message;
    }

    @NonNull
    public ActionResult withStateSnapshots(@Nullable ActionState observedState,
                                           @Nullable ActionState writtenState) {
        return new ActionResult(actionId, target, status, conflict, observedState,
                writtenState, message);
    }

    private ActionResult(@NonNull Parcel in) {
        actionId = in.readString();
        target = in.readParcelable(UserPackagePair.class.getClassLoader());
        status = ActionResultStatus.valueOf(in.readString());
        conflict = ActionConflict.valueOf(in.readString());
        observedState = in.readParcelable(ActionState.class.getClassLoader());
        writtenState = in.readParcelable(ActionState.class.getClassLoader());
        message = in.readString();
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(@NonNull Parcel dest, int flags) {
        dest.writeString(actionId);
        dest.writeParcelable(target, flags);
        dest.writeString(status.name());
        dest.writeString(conflict.name());
        dest.writeParcelable(observedState, flags);
        dest.writeParcelable(writtenState, flags);
        dest.writeString(message);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents() {
        return 0;
    }

    public static final Creator<ActionResult> CREATOR = new Creator<ActionResult>() {
        @NonNull
        @Override
        public ActionResult createFromParcel(Parcel in) {
            return new ActionResult(in);
        }

        @NonNull
        @Override
        public ActionResult[] newArray(int size) {
            return new ActionResult[size];
        }
    };
}
```

```java
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
package io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.actions;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;

import org.json.JSONException;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.history.IJsonSerializer;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.history.JsonDeserializer;

public final class ActionState implements IJsonSerializer, Parcelable {
    private final String stateKey;
    private final ActionValue value;

    public ActionState(@NonNull String stateKey, @NonNull ActionValue value) {
        if (stateKey.isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Empty state key");
        }
        this.stateKey = stateKey;
        this.value = value;
    }

    @NonNull
    public String getStateKey() {
        return stateKey;
    }

    @NonNull
    public ActionValue getValue() {
        return value;
    }

    public boolean isSame(@NonNull ActionState other) {
        return stateKey.equals(other.stateKey) && value.isSameValue(other.value);
    }

    private ActionState(@NonNull JSONObject object) throws JSONException {
        this(object.getString("key"), ActionValue.of(object.get("value")));
    }

    public static final JsonDeserializer.Creator<ActionState> DESERIALIZER = ActionState::new;

    @NonNull
    @Override
    public JSONObject serializeToJson() throws JSONException {
        JSONObject o = new JSONObject();
        o.put("key", stateKey);
        o.put("value", value.serializeToJson().get("value"));
        return o;
    }

    private ActionState(@NonNull Parcel in) {
        stateKey = in.readString();
        value = in.readParcelable(ActionValue.class.getClassLoader());
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(@NonNull Parcel dest, int flags) {
        dest.writeString(stateKey);
        dest.writeParcelable(value, flags);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents() {
        return 0;
    }

    public static final Creator<ActionState> CREATOR = new Creator<ActionState>() {
        @NonNull
        @Override
        public ActionState createFromParcel(Parcel in) {
            return new ActionState(in);
        }

        @NonNull
        @Override
        public ActionState[] newArray(int size) {
            return new ActionState[size];
        }
    };
}
```

`appmanager_reference/io/github/muntashirakon/AppManager/actions/ActionTargetSpec.java`:

```java
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
package io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.actions;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.annotation.Nullable;

import org.json.JSONException;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.history.IJsonSerializer;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.history.JsonDeserializer;

public final class ActionTargetSpec implements IJsonSerializer, Parcelable {
    private final ActionScope mScope;
    @Nullable
    private final PackageTargetSpec mPackageTarget;
    @Nullable
    private final GlobalTargetSpec mGlobalTarget;

    public ActionTargetSpec(@NonNull PackageTargetSpec target) {
        mScope = ActionScope.PACKAGE;
        mPackageTarget = target;
        mGlobalTarget = null;
    }

    public ActionTargetSpec(@NonNull GlobalTargetSpec target) {
        mScope = ActionScope.GLOBAL;
        mPackageTarget = null;
        mGlobalTarget = target;
    }

    private ActionTargetSpec(@NonNull JSONObject object) throws JSONException {
        mScope = ActionScope.valueOf(object.getString("scope"));
        JSONObject target = object.getJSONObject("target");
        if (mScope == ActionScope.PACKAGE) {
            mPackageTarget = PackageTargetSpec.DESERIALIZER.deserialize(target);
            mGlobalTarget = null;
        } else {
            mPackageTarget = null;
            mGlobalTarget = GlobalTargetSpec.DESERIALIZER.deserialize(target);
        }
    }

    public static final JsonDeserializer.Creator<ActionTargetSpec> DESERIALIZER = ActionTargetSpec::new;

    @NonNull
    public ActionScope getScope() {
        return mScope;
    }

    @NonNull
    public PackageTargetSpec getPackageTarget() {
        if (mPackageTarget == null) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Not a package target");
        }
        return mPackageTarget;
    }

    @NonNull
    public GlobalTargetSpec getGlobalTarget() {
        if (mGlobalTarget == null) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Not a global target");
        }
        return mGlobalTarget;
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    public JSONObject serializeToJson() throws JSONException {
        JSONObject object = new JSONObject();
        object.put("scope", mScope.name());
        object.put("target", (mScope == ActionScope.PACKAGE ? mPackageTarget : mGlobalTarget).serializeToJson());
        return object;
    }

    private ActionTargetSpec(@NonNull Parcel in) {
        mScope = ActionScope.valueOf(in.readString());
        if (mScope == ActionScope.PACKAGE) {
            mPackageTarget = in.readParcelable(PackageTargetSpec.class.getClassLoader());
            mGlobalTarget = null;
        } else {
            mPackageTarget = null;
            mGlobalTarget = in.readParcelable(GlobalTargetSpec.class.getClassLoader());
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(@NonNull Parcel dest, int flags) {
        dest.writeString(mScope.name());
        dest.writeParcelable(mScope == ActionScope.PACKAGE ? mPackageTarget : mGlobalTarget, flags);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents() {
        return 0;
    }

    public static final Creator<ActionTargetSpec> CREATOR = new Creator<ActionTargetSpec>() {
        @NonNull
        @Override
        public ActionTargetSpec createFromParcel(Parcel in) {
            return new ActionTargetSpec(in);
        }

        @NonNull
        @Override
        public ActionTargetSpec[] newArray(int size) {
            return new ActionTargetSpec[size];
        }
    };
}
```

`appmanager_reference/io/github/muntashirakon/AppManager/actions/ActionValue.java`:

```java
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
package io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.actions;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONException;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.util.Objects;

import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.history.IJsonSerializer;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.history.JsonDeserializer;

/**
 * Payload for an action state.
 */
public final class ActionValue implements IJsonSerializer, Parcelable {
    private final Object mValue;

    private ActionValue(Object value) {
        if (value == null || value == JSONObject.NULL || value instanceof String
                || value instanceof Boolean || value instanceof Number
                || value instanceof JSONObject || value instanceof JSONArray) {
            mValue = value == null ? JSONObject.NULL : value;
        } else {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Action values must be JSON-compatible");
        }
    }

    private ActionValue(@NonNull JSONObject object) throws JSONException {
        this(object.get("value"));
    }

    @NonNull
    public static ActionValue of(@NonNull Object value) {
        return new ActionValue(value);
    }

    public Object getValue() {
        return mValue;
    }

    public boolean isSameValue(@NonNull ActionValue other) {
        if (mValue instanceof JSONObject && other.mValue instanceof JSONObject) {
            return mValue.toString().equals(other.mValue.toString());
        }
        if (mValue instanceof JSONArray && other.mValue instanceof JSONArray) {
            return mValue.toString().equals(other.mValue.toString());
        }
        return Objects.equals(mValue, other.mValue);
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    public JSONObject serializeToJson() throws JSONException {
        JSONObject object = new JSONObject();
        object.put("value", mValue);
        return object;
    }

    public static final JsonDeserializer.Creator<ActionValue> DESERIALIZER = ActionValue::new;

    private ActionValue(@NonNull Parcel in) {
        try {
            switch (in.readInt()) {
                case 0:
                    mValue = JSONObject.NULL;
                    break;
                case 1:
                    mValue = in.readString();
                    break;
                case 2:
                    mValue = in.readInt() != 0;
                    break;
                case 3:
                    mValue = in.readInt();
                    break;
                case 4:
                    mValue = in.readLong();
                    break;
                case 5:
                    mValue = in.readDouble();
                    break;
                case 6:
                    mValue = new JSONObject(Objects.requireNonNull(in.readString()));
                    break;
                case 7:
                    mValue = new JSONArray(Objects.requireNonNull(in.readString()));
                    break;
                default:
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid action value type");
            }
        } catch (JSONException e) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid action value", e);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(@NonNull Parcel dest, int flags) {
        if (mValue == JSONObject.NULL) {
            dest.writeInt(0);
        } else if (mValue instanceof String) {
            dest.writeInt(1);
            dest.writeString((String) mValue);
        } else if (mValue instanceof Boolean) {
            dest.writeInt(2);
            dest.writeInt((Boolean) mValue ? 1 : 0);
        } else if (mValue instanceof Integer) {
            dest.writeInt(3);
            dest.writeInt((Integer) mValue);
        } else if (mValue instanceof Long) {
            dest.writeInt(4);
            dest.writeLong((Long) mValue);
        } else if (mValue instanceof Number) {
            dest.writeInt(5);
            dest.writeDouble(((Number) mValue).doubleValue());
        } else if (mValue instanceof JSONObject || mValue instanceof JSONArray) {
            dest.writeInt(mValue instanceof JSONObject ? 6 : 7);
            dest.writeString(mValue.toString());
        } else
            throw new IllegalStateException("Unsupported action value type: " + mValue.getClass());
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents() {
        return 0;
    }

    public static final Creator<ActionValue> CREATOR = new Creator<ActionValue>() {
        @NonNull
        @Override
        public ActionValue createFromParcel(Parcel in) {
            return new ActionValue(in);
        }

        @NonNull
        @Override
        public ActionValue[] newArray(int size) {
            return new ActionValue[size];
        }
    };
}
```

`appmanager_reference/io/github/muntashirakon/AppManager/actions/AppOpModeAction.java`:

```java
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
package io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.actions;

import android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo;
import android.os.Parcel;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.annotation.Nullable;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONException;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.compat.AppOpsManagerCompat;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.compat.PackageManagerCompat;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.rules.compontents.ExternalComponentsImporter;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.types.UserPackagePair;

public final class AppOpModeAction extends PackageScopedAction {
    public static final String PARAM_APP_OPS = "app_ops";
    public static final String PARAM_MODE = "mode";

    public AppOpModeAction(@NonNull ActionTargetSpec target, @NonNull ActionParameters onParameters,
                           @Nullable ActionParameters offParameters) {
        this(UUID.randomUUID().toString(), null, CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION, target, onParameters,
                offParameters);
    }

    public AppOpModeAction(@NonNull String id, @Nullable String name, int schemaVersion,
                           @NonNull ActionTargetSpec target, @NonNull ActionParameters onParameters,
                           @Nullable ActionParameters offParameters) {
        this(id, name, schemaVersion, target, onParameters, offParameters, Strictness.STRICT,
                offParameters == null ? RevertMode.NONE : RevertMode.EXPLICIT);
    }

    public AppOpModeAction(@NonNull String id, @Nullable String name, int schemaVersion,
                           @NonNull ActionTargetSpec target, @NonNull ActionParameters onParameters,
                           @Nullable ActionParameters offParameters, @NonNull Strictness strictness,
                           @NonNull RevertMode revertMode) {
        super(id, name, schemaVersion, ActionKind.APP_OP_MODE, target, onParameters, offParameters,
                strictness, revertMode);
    }

    private AppOpModeAction(@NonNull Parcel in, @NonNull ActionKind kind) {
        super(in, kind);
    }

    @NonNull
    static AppOpModeAction fromParcel(@NonNull Parcel in, @NonNull ActionKind kind) {
        return new AppOpModeAction(in, kind);
    }

    private int[] mAppOps;
    private int mMode;
    private AppOpsManagerCompat mAppOpsManager;

    @Override
    protected void onPreExecute(@NonNull ActionContext context, @NonNull ActionMode mode,
                                @NonNull List<UserPackagePair> targets,
                                @NonNull List<ActionExecutionRecord> previousRecords) {
        validateAppOpParameters();
        ActionParameters parameters = requireParameters(mode);
        mAppOps = requireIntArray(parameters, PARAM_APP_OPS);
        mMode = requireInt(parameters, PARAM_MODE);
        mAppOpsManager = new AppOpsManagerCompat();
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    protected ActionResult onExecute(@NonNull ActionContext context, @NonNull ActionMode mode,
                                     @NonNull UserPackagePair target,
                                     @NonNull List<ActionExecutionRecord> previousRecords) throws Throwable {
        ExternalComponentsImporter.setModeToFilteredAppOps(mAppOpsManager, target,
                resolveAppOps(target, mAppOps), mMode);
        return actionResult(target, ActionResultStatus.SUCCESS, null);
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    protected ActionState getCurrentState(@NonNull UserPackagePair target) throws Throwable {
        JSONArray states = new JSONArray();
        try {
            ApplicationInfo applicationInfo = getApplicationInfo(target);
            List<AppOpsManagerCompat.OpEntry> entries =
                    AppOpsManagerCompat.getConfiguredOpsForPackage(mAppOpsManager,
                            applicationInfo.packageName, applicationInfo.uid);
            for (int appOp : resolveAppOps(target, mAppOps)) {
                states.put(new JSONObject()
                        .put("op", appOp)
                        .put("mode", AppOpsManagerCompat.getModeFromOpEntriesOrDefault(appOp,
                                entries)));
            }
        } catch (JSONException exception) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Could not build app-op state", exception);
        }
        return state(target, states.toString());
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    protected ActionState getOnState(@NonNull UserPackagePair target) throws Throwable {
        return desiredState(target, getOnParameters());
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    protected ActionState getOffState(@NonNull UserPackagePair target) throws Throwable {
        return desiredState(target, requireOffParameters());
    }

    @NonNull
    private ApplicationInfo getApplicationInfo(@NonNull UserPackagePair target) throws Throwable {
        return PackageManagerCompat.getApplicationInfo(target.getPackageName(),
                PackageManagerCompat.MATCH_STATIC_SHARED_AND_SDK_LIBRARIES, target.getUserId());
    }

    @NonNull
    private int[] resolveAppOps(@NonNull UserPackagePair target, @NonNull int[] appOps)
            throws Throwable {
        if (appOps.length != 1 || appOps[0] != AppOpsManagerCompat.OP_NONE) {
            return sortedAppOps(appOps);
        }
        ApplicationInfo applicationInfo = getApplicationInfo(target);
        List<AppOpsManagerCompat.OpEntry> entries =
                AppOpsManagerCompat.getConfiguredOpsForPackage(mAppOpsManager,
                        applicationInfo.packageName, applicationInfo.uid);
        int[] requestedOps = new int[entries.size()];
        for (int i = 0; i < entries.size(); ++i) {
            requestedOps[i] = entries.get(i).getOp();
        }
        return sortedAppOps(requestedOps);
    }

    @NonNull
    private ActionState desiredState(@NonNull UserPackagePair target,
                                     @NonNull ActionParameters parameters) throws Throwable {
        JSONArray states = new JSONArray();
        int desiredMode = requireInt(parameters, PARAM_MODE);
        try {
            for (int appOp : resolveAppOps(target, requireIntArray(parameters, PARAM_APP_OPS))) {
                states.put(new JSONObject().put("op", appOp).put("mode", desiredMode));
            }
        } catch (JSONException exception) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Could not build app-op state", exception);
        }
        return state(target, states.toString());
    }

    private void validateAppOpParameters() {
        int[] onOps = sortedAppOps(requireIntArray(getOnParameters(), PARAM_APP_OPS));
        int[] offOps = sortedAppOps(requireIntArray(requireOffParameters(), PARAM_APP_OPS));
        if (!Arrays.equals(onOps, offOps)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("ON and OFF must use the same app-ops");
        }
    }

    @NonNull
    private static int[] sortedAppOps(@NonNull int[] appOps) {
        int[] sorted = appOps.clone();
        Arrays.sort(sorted);
        return sorted;
    }

    @NonNull
    private static ActionState state(@NonNull UserPackagePair target, @NonNull String value) {
        return new ActionState("package:" + target.getPackageName() + ":"
                + target.getUserId() + ":app_ops", ActionValue.of(value));
    }
}
```

```java
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
package io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.actions;

import android.os.Parcel;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.annotation.Nullable;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.backup.BackupException;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.backup.BackupManager;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.batchops.struct.BatchBackupOptions;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.progress.ProgressHandler;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.types.UserPackagePair;

public final class BackupAction extends PackageScopedAction {
    public BackupAction(@NonNull ActionTargetSpec target, @NonNull ActionParameters onParameters) {
        this(UUID.randomUUID().toString(), null, CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION, target, onParameters,
                Strictness.STRICT, RevertMode.NONE);
    }

    public BackupAction(@NonNull String id, @Nullable String name, int schemaVersion,
                        @NonNull ActionTargetSpec target,
                        @NonNull ActionParameters onParameters,
                        @NonNull Strictness strictness, @NonNull RevertMode revertMode) {
        super(id, name, schemaVersion, ActionKind.BACKUP, target, onParameters, null, strictness,
                revertMode);
    }

    private BackupAction(@NonNull Parcel parcel, @NonNull ActionKind kind) {
        super(parcel, kind);
    }

    @NonNull
    static BackupAction fromParcel(@NonNull Parcel parcel, @NonNull ActionKind kind) {
        return new BackupAction(parcel, kind);
    }

    private BatchBackupOptions mOptions;
    private BackupManager mBackupManager;

    @Override
    protected void onPreExecute(@NonNull ActionContext context, @NonNull ActionMode mode,
                                @NonNull List<UserPackagePair> targets,
                                @NonNull List<ActionExecutionRecord> previousRecords) {
        if (mode == ActionMode.OFF) return;
        mOptions = createOptions(getOnParameters());
        mBackupManager = new BackupManager();
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    protected ActionResult onExecute(@NonNull ActionContext context, @NonNull ActionMode mode,
                                     @NonNull UserPackagePair target,
                                     @NonNull List<ActionExecutionRecord> previousRecords)
            throws BackupException {
        ProgressHandler subProgressHandler = newSubProgressHandler(context);
        try {
            mBackupManager.backup(mOptions.getBackupOpOptions(target.getPackageName(),
                    target.getUserId()), subProgressHandler);
            return actionResult(target, ActionResultStatus.SUCCESS, null);
        } finally {
            finishSubProgressHandler(subProgressHandler);
        }
    }

    @NonNull
    private BatchBackupOptions createOptions(@NonNull ActionParameters parameters) {
        return new BatchBackupOptions(requireInt(parameters, "flags"),
                optionalStringArray(parameters, "backup_names"),
                optionalStringArray(parameters, "relative_dirs"));
    }
}
```
