```java
package io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.actions;

import android.os.Parcel;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.annotation.Nullable;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.compat.DeviceIdleManagerCompat;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.types.UserPackagePair;

public final class BatteryOptimizationAction extends PackageScopedAction {
    public BatteryOptimizationAction(@NonNull ActionTargetSpec target,
                                     @NonNull ActionParameters onParameters,
                                     @NonNull ActionParameters offParameters) {
        this(UUID.randomUUID().toString(), null, CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION, target, onParameters,
                offParameters, Strictness.STRICT, RevertMode.EXPLICIT);
    }

    public BatteryOptimizationAction(@NonNull String id, @Nullable String name, int schemaVersion,
                                     @NonNull ActionTargetSpec target,
                                     @NonNull ActionParameters onParameters,
                                     @NonNull ActionParameters offParameters,
                                     @NonNull Strictness strictness,
                                     @NonNull RevertMode revertMode) {
        super(id, name, schemaVersion, ActionKind.BATTERY_OPTIMIZATION, target, onParameters,
                offParameters, strictness, revertMode);
    }

    private BatteryOptimizationAction(@NonNull Parcel parcel, @NonNull ActionKind kind) {
        super(parcel, kind);
    }

    @NonNull
    static BatteryOptimizationAction fromParcel(@NonNull Parcel parcel, @NonNull ActionKind kind) {
        return new BatteryOptimizationAction(parcel, kind);
    }

    private boolean mOptimized;

    @Override
    protected void onPreExecute(@NonNull ActionContext context, @NonNull ActionMode mode,
                                @NonNull List<UserPackagePair> targets,
                                @NonNull List<ActionExecutionRecord> previousRecords) {
        mOptimized = requireBoolean(requireParameters(mode), "optimized");
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    protected ActionResult onExecute(@NonNull ActionContext context, @NonNull ActionMode mode,
                                     @NonNull UserPackagePair target,
                                     @NonNull List<ActionExecutionRecord> previousRecords) {
        boolean successful;
        if (mOptimized) {
            successful = DeviceIdleManagerCompat.enableBatteryOptimization(target.getPackageName());
        } else {
            successful = DeviceIdleManagerCompat.disableBatteryOptimization(target.getPackageName());
        }
        return actionResult(target, successful
                ? ActionResultStatus.SUCCESS : ActionResultStatus.FAILED, null);
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    protected ActionState getCurrentState(@NonNull UserPackagePair target) {
        return state(DeviceIdleManagerCompat.isBatteryOptimizedApp(target.getPackageName()));
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    protected ActionState getOnState(@NonNull UserPackagePair target) {
        return state(requireBoolean(requireParameters(ActionMode.ON), "optimized"));
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    protected ActionState getOffState(@NonNull UserPackagePair target) {
        return state(requireBoolean(requireParameters(ActionMode.OFF), "optimized"));
    }

    @NonNull
    private static ActionState state(boolean optimized) {
        return new ActionState("package:battery_optimization",
                ActionValue.of(optimized));
    }
}
```

```java
import androidx.annotation.Nullable;

public final class ClearCacheAction extends PackageScopedAction {
    public ClearCacheAction(@NonNull ActionTargetSpec target,

                Strictness.STRICT, RevertMode.NONE);

    public ClearCacheAction(@NonNull String id,

                            @NonNull ActionTargetSpec target,
                            @NonNull ActionParameters onParameters,
```

`appmanager_reference/io/github/muntashirakon/AppManager/actions/ComponentStateAction.java`:

```java
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
package io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.actions;

import android.os.Parcel;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.annotation.Nullable;

import org.json.JSONException;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.TreeMap;
import java.util.UUID;

import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.rules.compontents.ComponentsBlocker;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.rules.compontents.ComponentUtils;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.types.UserPackagePair;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.utils.PackageUtils;

public final class ComponentStateAction extends PackageScopedAction {
    public static final String PARAM_SIGNATURES = "signatures";
    public static final String PARAM_BLOCKED = "blocked";

    public ComponentStateAction(@NonNull ActionTargetSpec target, @NonNull ActionParameters onParameters,
                                @Nullable ActionParameters offParameters) {
        this(UUID.randomUUID().toString(), null, CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION, target, onParameters,
                offParameters);
    }

    public ComponentStateAction(@NonNull String id, @Nullable String name, int schemaVersion,
                                @NonNull ActionTargetSpec target, @NonNull ActionParameters onParameters,
                                @Nullable ActionParameters offParameters) {
        this(id, name, schemaVersion, target, onParameters, offParameters, Strictness.STRICT,
                offParameters == null ? RevertMode.NONE : RevertMode.EXPLICIT);
    }

    public ComponentStateAction(@NonNull String id, @Nullable String name, int schemaVersion,
                                @NonNull ActionTargetSpec target, @NonNull ActionParameters onParameters,
                                @Nullable ActionParameters offParameters, @NonNull Strictness strictness,
                                @NonNull RevertMode revertMode) {
        super(id, name, schemaVersion, ActionKind.COMPONENT_STATE, target, onParameters,
                offParameters, strictness, revertMode);
    }

    private ComponentStateAction(@NonNull Parcel in, @NonNull ActionKind kind) {
        super(in, kind);
    }

    @NonNull
    static ComponentStateAction fromParcel(@NonNull Parcel in, @NonNull ActionKind kind) {
        return new ComponentStateAction(in, kind);
    }

    private String[] mSignatures;
    private final Map<UserPackagePair, Map<String, Boolean>> mComponentsByTarget =
            new LinkedHashMap<>();

    @Override
    protected void onPreExecute(@NonNull ActionContext context, @NonNull ActionMode mode,
                                @NonNull List<UserPackagePair> targets,
                                @NonNull List<ActionExecutionRecord> previousRecords) {
        validateParameters();
        mSignatures = requireStringArray(requireParameters(mode), PARAM_SIGNATURES);
        mComponentsByTarget.clear();
        for (UserPackagePair target : targets) {
            Map<String, Boolean> components = new TreeMap<>();
            for (String component : PackageUtils.getFilteredComponents(target.getPackageName(),
                    target.getUserId(), mSignatures).keySet()) {
                components.put(component, false);
            }
            mComponentsByTarget.put(target, components);
        }
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    protected ActionResult onExecute(@NonNull ActionContext context, @NonNull ActionMode mode,
                                     @NonNull UserPackagePair target,
                                     @NonNull List<ActionExecutionRecord> previousRecords) {
        Map<String, Boolean> components = componentsFor(target);
        if (components.isEmpty()) {
            return actionResult(target, ActionResultStatus.UNSUPPORTED,
                    "No components matched the configured signatures");
        }
        if (requireBoolean(requireParameters(mode), PARAM_BLOCKED)) {
            ComponentUtils.blockFilteredComponents(target, mSignatures);
        } else {
            ComponentUtils.unblockFilteredComponents(target, mSignatures);
        }
        return actionResult(target, ActionResultStatus.SUCCESS, null);
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    protected ActionState getCurrentState(@NonNull UserPackagePair target) throws Throwable {
        Map<String, Boolean> components = componentsFor(target);
        if (components.isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }
        try (ComponentsBlocker blocker = ComponentsBlocker.getInstance(target.getPackageName(),
                target.getUserId())) {
            for (String component : components.keySet()) {
                boolean blocked = blocker.isComponentBlocked(component)
                        || PackageUtils.isComponentDisabledByUser(target.getPackageName(), component,
                        target.getUserId());
                components.put(component, blocked);
            }
        }
        return state(target, components);
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    protected ActionState getOnState(@NonNull UserPackagePair target) {
        return desiredState(target, requireBoolean(getOnParameters(), PARAM_BLOCKED));
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    protected ActionState getOffState(@NonNull UserPackagePair target) {
        return desiredState(target, requireBoolean(requireOffParameters(), PARAM_BLOCKED));
    }

    @NonNull
    private Map<String, Boolean> componentsFor(@NonNull UserPackagePair target) {
        Map<String, Boolean> components = mComponentsByTarget.get(target);
        if (components == null) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Target was not prepared");
        }
        return components;
    }

    @Nullable
    private ActionState desiredState(@NonNull UserPackagePair target, boolean blocked) {
        Map<String, Boolean> components = componentsFor(target);
        if (components.isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }
        Map<String, Boolean> desired = new TreeMap<>();
        for (String component : components.keySet()) {
            desired.put(component, blocked);
        }
        return state(target, desired);
    }

    @NonNull
    private static ActionState state(@NonNull UserPackagePair target,
                                     @NonNull Map<String, Boolean> components) {
        JSONObject value = new JSONObject();
        try {
            for (Map.Entry<String, Boolean> entry : new TreeMap<>(components).entrySet()) {
                value.put(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
            }
        } catch (JSONException exception) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Could not build component state", exception);
        }
        return new ActionState("package:" + target.getPackageName() + ":"
                + target.getUserId() + ":components", ActionValue.of(value.toString()));
    }

    private void validateParameters() {
        boolean onBlocked = requireBoolean(getOnParameters(), PARAM_BLOCKED);
        boolean offBlocked = requireBoolean(requireOffParameters(), PARAM_BLOCKED);
        if (onBlocked == offBlocked) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("ON and OFF blocked states must be opposites");
        }
        String[] onSignatures = sortedSignatures(
                requireStringArray(getOnParameters(), PARAM_SIGNATURES));
        String[] offSignatures = sortedSignatures(
                requireStringArray(requireOffParameters(), PARAM_SIGNATURES));
        if (!Arrays.equals(onSignatures, offSignatures)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("ON and OFF must use the same signatures");
        }
    }

    @NonNull
    private static String[] sortedSignatures(@NonNull String[] signatures) {
        String[] sorted = signatures.clone();
        Arrays.sort(sorted);
        return sorted;
    }
}
```

`appmanager_reference/io/github/muntashirakon/AppManager/actions/DeviceStateAction.java`:

```java
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
package io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.actions;

import android.content.Intent;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Build;
import android.provider.Settings;
import android.provider.SettingsHidden;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.annotation.Nullable;

import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.UUID;

import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.utils.ContextUtils;

public final class DeviceStateAction extends GlobalScopedAction {
    public static final String PARAM_ENABLED = "enabled";
    public static final String TARGET_STATE = "state";

    public static final String STATE_AIRPLANE_MODE = "airplane_mode";
    public static final String STATE_LOCATION = "location";
    public static final String STATE_DEVELOPER_OPTIONS = "developer_options";
    public static final String STATE_USB_DEBUGGING = "usb_debugging";
    public static final String STATE_WIRELESS_DEBUGGING = "wireless_debugging";
    public static final String STATE_AUTO_ROTATE = "auto_rotate";

    public DeviceStateAction(@NonNull String state, boolean onEnabled, boolean offEnabled) {
        this(UUID.randomUUID().toString(), null, CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
                globalTargetWith(TARGET_STATE, normalizeState(state)), parameters(onEnabled),
                parameters(offEnabled), Strictness.STRICT, RevertMode.EXPLICIT);
    }

    public DeviceStateAction(@NonNull ActionTargetSpec target,
                             @NonNull ActionParameters onParameters,
                             @NonNull ActionParameters offParameters) {
        this(UUID.randomUUID().toString(), null, CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION, target, onParameters,
                offParameters, Strictness.STRICT, RevertMode.EXPLICIT);
    }

    public DeviceStateAction(@NonNull String id, @Nullable String name, int schemaVersion,
                             @NonNull ActionTargetSpec target,
                             @NonNull ActionParameters onParameters,
                             @NonNull ActionParameters offParameters,
                             @NonNull Strictness strictness, @NonNull RevertMode revertMode) {
        super(id, name, schemaVersion, ActionKind.DEVICE_STATE, target, onParameters, offParameters,
                strictness, revertMode);
    }

    private DeviceStateAction(@NonNull Parcel parcel, @NonNull ActionKind kind) {
        super(parcel, kind);
    }

    @NonNull
    static DeviceStateAction fromParcel(@NonNull Parcel parcel, @NonNull ActionKind kind) {
        return new DeviceStateAction(parcel, kind);
    }

    private String mState;
    private boolean mEnabled;

    @Override
    protected void onPreExecute(@NonNull ActionContext context, @NonNull ActionMode mode,
                                @NonNull List<ActionExecutionRecord> previousRecords)
            throws IllegalStateException {
        if (mode == ActionMode.OFF && getOffParameters() == null) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Device state has no reverse operation");
        }
        mState = normalizeState(requireTargetString(TARGET_STATE));
        mEnabled = requireBoolean(requireParameters(mode), PARAM_ENABLED);
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    protected ActionResult onExecute(@NonNull ActionContext context, @NonNull ActionMode mode,
                                     @NonNull List<ActionExecutionRecord> previousRecords) {
        boolean supported;
        switch (mState) {
            case STATE_AIRPLANE_MODE:
                supported = setAirplaneMode(mEnabled);
                break;
            case STATE_LOCATION:
                supported = setLocation(mEnabled);
                break;
            case STATE_DEVELOPER_OPTIONS:
                supported = setGlobalSetting(Settings.Global.DEVELOPMENT_SETTINGS_ENABLED, mEnabled);
                break;
            case STATE_USB_DEBUGGING:
                supported = setGlobalSetting(Settings.Global.ADB_ENABLED, mEnabled);
                break;
            case STATE_WIRELESS_DEBUGGING:
                supported = setWirelessDebugging(mEnabled);
                break;
            case STATE_AUTO_ROTATE:
                supported = setSystemSetting(Settings.System.ACCELEROMETER_ROTATION, mEnabled);
                break;
            default:
                return globalResult(ActionResultStatus.UNSUPPORTED,
                        "Unsupported device state: " + mState);
        }
        return globalResult(supported ? ActionResultStatus.SUCCESS : ActionResultStatus.UNSUPPORTED,
                supported ? null : "Device state is not supported on this device");
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    protected ActionState getCurrentState() throws IllegalArgumentException {
        return readState(mState == null ? normalizeState(requireTargetString(TARGET_STATE)) : mState);
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    protected ActionState getOnState() {
        return state(mState, requireBoolean(requireParameters(ActionMode.ON), PARAM_ENABLED));
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    protected ActionState getOffState() {
        return state(mState, requireBoolean(requireParameters(ActionMode.OFF), PARAM_ENABLED));
    }

    @NonNull
    private ActionState readState(@NonNull String state) {
        boolean enabled;
        switch (state) {
            case STATE_AIRPLANE_MODE:
                enabled = Settings.Global.getInt(ContextUtils.getContext().getContentResolver(),
                        Settings.Global.AIRPLANE_MODE_ON, 0) != 0;
                break;
            case STATE_LOCATION:
                enabled = Settings.Secure.getInt(ContextUtils.getContext().getContentResolver(),
                        Settings.Secure.LOCATION_MODE, Settings.Secure.LOCATION_MODE_OFF)
                        != Settings.Secure.LOCATION_MODE_OFF;
                break;
            case STATE_DEVELOPER_OPTIONS:
                enabled = getGlobalSetting(Settings.Global.DEVELOPMENT_SETTINGS_ENABLED);
                break;
            case STATE_USB_DEBUGGING:
                enabled = getGlobalSetting(Settings.Global.ADB_ENABLED);
                break;
            case STATE_WIRELESS_DEBUGGING:
                if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.R) {
                    throw new IllegalStateException("Wireless debugging is unavailable");
                }
                enabled = getGlobalSetting(SettingsHidden.Global.ADB_WIFI_ENABLED);
                break;
            case STATE_AUTO_ROTATE:
                enabled = Settings.System.getInt(ContextUtils.getContext().getContentResolver(),
                        Settings.System.ACCELEROMETER_ROTATION, 0) != 0;
                break;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported device state: " + state);
        }
        return state(state, enabled);
    }

    private boolean getGlobalSetting(@NonNull String key) {
        return Settings.Global.getInt(ContextUtils.getContext().getContentResolver(), key, 0) != 0;
    }

    @NonNull
    private static ActionState state(@NonNull String state, boolean enabled) {
        return new ActionState("global:device:" + state,
                ActionValue.of(enabled));
    }

    private boolean setAirplaneMode(boolean enabled) {
        boolean successful = setGlobalSetting(Settings.Global.AIRPLANE_MODE_ON, enabled);
        if (successful) {
            ContextUtils.getContext().sendBroadcast(new Intent(Intent.ACTION_AIRPLANE_MODE_CHANGED)
                    .putExtra("state", enabled));
        }
        return successful;
    }

    private boolean setLocation(boolean enabled) {
        return Settings.Secure.putInt(ContextUtils.getContext().getContentResolver(),
                Settings.Secure.LOCATION_MODE,
                enabled ? Settings.Secure.LOCATION_MODE_HIGH_ACCURACY
                        : Settings.Secure.LOCATION_MODE_OFF);
    }

    private boolean setGlobalSetting(@NonNull String key, boolean enabled) {
        return Settings.Global.putInt(ContextUtils.getContext().getContentResolver(), key,
                enabled ? 1 : 0);
    }

    private boolean setSystemSetting(@NonNull String key, boolean enabled) {
        return Settings.System.putInt(ContextUtils.getContext().getContentResolver(), key,
                enabled ? 1 : 0);
    }

    private boolean setWirelessDebugging(boolean enabled) {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.R) {
            return false;
        }
        return setGlobalSetting(SettingsHidden.Global.ADB_WIFI_ENABLED, enabled);
    }

    @NonNull
    private static ActionParameters parameters(boolean enabled) {
        return new ActionParameters().put(PARAM_ENABLED, enabled);
    }

    @NonNull
    private static String normalizeState(@NonNull String state) {
        String normalized = state.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        switch (normalized) {
            case STATE_AIRPLANE_MODE:
            case STATE_LOCATION:
            case STATE_DEVELOPER_OPTIONS:
            case STATE_USB_DEBUGGING:
            case STATE_WIRELESS_DEBUGGING:
            case STATE_AUTO_ROTATE:
                return normalized;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported device state: " + state);
        }
    }
}
```

`appmanager_reference/io/github/muntashirakon/AppManager/actions/DexOptAction.java`:

```java
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
package io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.actions;

import android.os.Build;
import android.os.Parcel;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.annotation.Nullable;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.apk.dexopt.DexOptimizer;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.compat.PackageManagerCompat;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.types.UserPackagePair;

public final class DexOptAction extends PackageScopedAction {
    public DexOptAction(@NonNull ActionTargetSpec target, @NonNull ActionParameters onParameters) {
        this(UUID.randomUUID().toString(), null, CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION, target, onParameters,
                Strictness.STRICT, RevertMode.NONE);
    }

    public DexOptAction(@NonNull String id, @Nullable String name, int schemaVersion,
                        @NonNull ActionTargetSpec target, @NonNull ActionParameters onParameters,
                        @NonNull Strictness strictness, @NonNull RevertMode revertMode) {
        super(id, name, schemaVersion, ActionKind.DEXOPT, target, onParameters, null,
                strictness, revertMode);
    }

    private DexOptAction(@NonNull Parcel parcel, @NonNull ActionKind kind) {
        super(parcel, kind);
    }

    @NonNull
    static DexOptAction fromParcel(@NonNull Parcel parcel, @NonNull ActionKind kind) {
        return new DexOptAction(parcel, kind);
    }

    @Nullable
    private String mCompilerFilter;
    private boolean mClearApplicationProfileData;
    private boolean mCheckProfiles;
    private boolean mForceCompilation;
    private boolean mBootComplete;

    @Override
    protected void onPreExecute(@NonNull ActionContext context, @NonNull ActionMode mode,
                                @NonNull List<UserPackagePair> targets,
                                @NonNull List<ActionExecutionRecord> previousRecords) {
        if (mode == ActionMode.OFF) {
            return;
        }
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.N) {
            return;
        }
        ActionParameters parameters = getOnParameters();
        mCompilerFilter = optionalString(parameters, "compiler_filter");
        mClearApplicationProfileData = optionalBoolean(parameters, "clear_profile_data", false);
        mCheckProfiles = optionalBoolean(parameters, "check_profiles", false);
        mForceCompilation = optionalBoolean(parameters, "force_compilation", false);
        mBootComplete = optionalBoolean(parameters, "boot_complete", false);
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    protected ActionResult onExecute(@NonNull ActionContext context, @NonNull ActionMode mode,
                                     @NonNull UserPackagePair target,
                                     @NonNull List<ActionExecutionRecord> previousRecords) {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.N) {
            return actionResult(target, ActionResultStatus.UNSUPPORTED,
                    "Dex optimization is unavailable");
        }
        DexOptimizer optimizer = new DexOptimizer(PackageManagerCompat.getPackageManager(),
                target.getPackageName());
        boolean successful = true;
        if (mClearApplicationProfileData) {
            successful &= optimizer.clearApplicationProfileData();
        }
        if (mCompilerFilter != null) {
            successful &= optimizer.performDexOptMode(mCheckProfiles, mCompilerFilter,
                    mForceCompilation, mBootComplete, null);
        } else successful &= optimizer.forceDexOpt();
        return actionResult(target,
                successful ? ActionResultStatus.SUCCESS : ActionResultStatus.FAILED, null);
    }
}
```

```java
package io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.actions;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.RemoteException;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.annotation.Nullable;
import androidx.annotation.VisibleForTesting;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;

import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.compat.PackageManagerCompat;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.types.UserPackagePair;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.utils.FreezeUtils;

public final class FreezeAction extends PackageScopedAction {
    public static final String PARAM_FREEZE = "freeze";
    public static final String PARAM_FREEZE_TYPE = "freeze_type";

    public FreezeAction(@NonNull ActionTargetSpec target, @NonNull ActionParameters onParameters,
                        @Nullable ActionParameters offParameters) {
        this(UUID.randomUUID().toString(), null, CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION, target, onParameters,
                offParameters, Strictness.STRICT,
                offParameters == null ? RevertMode.NONE : RevertMode.EXPLICIT);
    }

    public FreezeAction(@NonNull String id, @Nullable String name, int schemaVersion,
                        @NonNull ActionTargetSpec target, @NonNull ActionParameters onParameters,
                        @Nullable ActionParameters offParameters, @NonNull Strictness strictness,
                        @NonNull RevertMode revertMode) {
        super(id, name, schemaVersion, ActionKind.FREEZE, target, onParameters, offParameters,
                strictness, revertMode);
    }

    private FreezeAction(@NonNull Parcel in, @NonNull ActionKind kind) {
        super(in, kind);
    }

    @NonNull
    static FreezeAction fromParcel(@NonNull Parcel in, @NonNull ActionKind kind) {
        return new FreezeAction(in, kind);
    }

    private boolean mFreeze;
    private int mFreezeType;

    @Override
    protected void onPreExecute(@NonNull ActionContext context, @NonNull ActionMode mode,
                                @NonNull List<UserPackagePair> targets,
                                @NonNull List<ActionExecutionRecord> previousRecords)
            throws IllegalArgumentException {
        ActionParameters params = requireParameters(mode);
        mFreeze = requireBoolean(params, PARAM_FREEZE);
        mFreezeType = getFreezeType(requireInt(params, PARAM_FREEZE_TYPE));
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    protected ActionResult onExecute(@NonNull ActionContext context, @NonNull ActionMode mode,
                                     @NonNull UserPackagePair target,
                                     @NonNull List<ActionExecutionRecord> previousRecords)
            throws Throwable {
        if (mFreeze) {
            FreezeUtils.freeze(target.getPackageName(), target.getUserId(), mFreezeType);
        } else {
            FreezeUtils.unfreeze(target.getPackageName(), target.getUserId());
        }
        return actionResult(target, ActionResultStatus.SUCCESS, null);
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    protected ActionState getCurrentState(@NonNull UserPackagePair target)
            throws RemoteException, PackageManager.NameNotFoundException {
        ApplicationInfo applicationInfo = PackageManagerCompat.getApplicationInfo(
                target.getPackageName(), PackageManagerCompat.MATCH_STATIC_SHARED_AND_SDK_LIBRARIES,
                target.getUserId());
        return state(target, FreezeUtils.isFrozen(applicationInfo));
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    protected ActionState getOnState(@NonNull UserPackagePair target) throws IllegalArgumentException {
        return state(target, requireBoolean(requireParameters(ActionMode.ON), PARAM_FREEZE));
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    protected ActionState getOffState(@NonNull UserPackagePair target) throws IllegalArgumentException {
        return state(target, requireBoolean(requireParameters(ActionMode.OFF), PARAM_FREEZE));
    }

    @NonNull
    private static ActionState state(@NonNull UserPackagePair target, boolean frozen) {
        return new ActionState("package:" + target.getPackageName() + ":"
                + target.getUserId() + ":freeze", ActionValue.of(frozen));
    }

    @VisibleForTesting
    public int getFreezeType(@NonNull ActionMode mode) {
        ActionParameters params = requireParameters(mode);
        return getFreezeType(requireInt(params, PARAM_FREEZE_TYPE));
    }

    private int getFreezeType(int freezeType) {
        if (freezeType != FreezeUtils.FREEZE_DISABLE
                && freezeType != FreezeUtils.FREEZE_HIDE
                && freezeType != FreezeUtils.FREEZE_SUSPEND
                && freezeType != FreezeUtils.FREEZE_ADV_SUSPEND) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid freeze type: " + freezeType);
        }
        return freezeType;
    }
}
```

`appmanager_reference/io/github/muntashirakon/AppManager/actions/GlobalScopedAction.java`:

```java
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
package io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.actions;

import android.content.Context;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.text.TextUtils;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.annotation.Nullable;

import org.json.JSONException;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.util.List;

import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.R;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.utils.ContextUtils;

public abstract class GlobalScopedAction extends Action {
    protected GlobalScopedAction(@NonNull ActionKind kind, @NonNull ActionTargetSpec target,
                                 @NonNull ActionParameters onParameters,
                                 @Nullable ActionParameters offParameters) {
        super(kind, target, onParameters, offParameters);
        assert getTarget().getScope() == ActionScope.GLOBAL;
    }

    protected GlobalScopedAction(@NonNull String id, @Nullable String name, int schemaVersion,
                                 @NonNull ActionKind kind, @NonNull ActionTargetSpec target,
                                 @NonNull ActionParameters onParameters,
                                 @Nullable ActionParameters offParameters,
                                 @NonNull Strictness strictness,
                                 @NonNull RevertMode revertMode) {
        super(id, name, schemaVersion, kind, target, onParameters, offParameters, strictness,
                revertMode);
        assert getTarget().getScope() == ActionScope.GLOBAL;
    }

    protected GlobalScopedAction(@NonNull Parcel parcel, @NonNull ActionKind kind) {
        super(parcel, kind);
        assert getTarget().getScope() == ActionScope.GLOBAL;
    }

    @NonNull
    protected final JSONObject globalTargetParameters() {
        return getTarget().getGlobalTarget().getParameters();
    }

    @NonNull
    protected final String requireTargetString(@NonNull String key) {
        String value = globalTargetParameters().optString(key, null);
        if (TextUtils.isEmpty(value)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing global target parameter: " + key);
        }
        return value;
    }

    @NonNull
    protected final ActionResult globalResult(@NonNull ActionResultStatus status,
                                              @Nullable String message) {
        return globalResult(status, null, null, message);
    }

    @NonNull
    protected final ActionResult globalResult(@NonNull ActionResultStatus status,
                                              @Nullable ActionState observedState,
                                              @Nullable ActionState writtenState,
                                              @Nullable String message) {
        return actionResult(null, status, observedState, writtenState, message);
    }

    @NonNull
    protected final ActionResult globalResult(@NonNull ActionResultStatus status,
                                              @NonNull ActionConflict conflict,
                                              @Nullable ActionState observedState,
                                              @Nullable ActionState writtenState,
                                              @Nullable String message) {
        return actionResult(null, status, conflict, observedState, writtenState, message);
    }

    protected void onPreExecute(@NonNull ActionContext context, @NonNull ActionMode mode,
                                @NonNull List<ActionExecutionRecord> previousRecords)
            throws Throwable {
    }

    /**
     * Performs the action after the lifecycle has determined that execution is required.
     */
    @NonNull
    protected abstract ActionResult onExecute(@NonNull ActionContext context,
                                              @NonNull ActionMode mode,
                                              @NonNull List<ActionExecutionRecord> previousRecords)
            throws Throwable;

    protected void onPostExecute(@NonNull ActionContext context, @NonNull ActionMode mode,
                                 @NonNull List<ActionResult> results) throws Throwable {
    }

    @Nullable
    protected ActionState getCurrentState() throws Throwable {
        return null;
    }

    @Nullable
    protected ActionState getOnState() throws Throwable {
        return null;
    }

    @Nullable
    protected ActionState getOffState() throws Throwable {
        return null;
    }

    @NonNull
    protected CharSequence getProgressLabel(@NonNull ActionContext context) {
        Context ctx = ContextUtils.getContext();
        return ctx.getString(R.string.action_running, toLocalizedString(ctx));
    }

    @Override
    public int getProgressMax(@NonNull ActionContext context) {
        return ActionProgress.INDETERMINATE;
    }

    @Override
    @NonNull
    public final List<ActionResult> execute(@NonNull ActionContext context,
                                            @NonNull ActionMode mode,
                                            @NonNull List<ActionExecutionRecord> previousRecords) {
        List<ActionResult> results = new java.util.ArrayList<>(1);
        ActionState currentState = null;
        int progressMax = getProgressMax(context);
        if (progressMax < ActionProgress.INDETERMINATE) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Invalid global action progress maximum: " + progressMax);
        }
        CharSequence label;
        try {
            label = getProgressLabel(context);
        } catch (RuntimeException ignored) {
            label = getName();
        }
        reportProgress(context, label, progressMax, 0, ActionProgress.State.STARTED, results);
        try {
            onPreExecute(context, mode, previousRecords);
            ActionResult result;
            ActionState onState = getOnState();
            ActionState offState = getOffState();
            if (mode == ActionMode.OFF && getOffParameters() == null) {
                result = globalResult(ActionResultStatus.UNSUPPORTED,
                        "Action has no reverse operation");
            } else if (onState == null && offState == null) {
                // Stateless actions, such as reboot, have no state to compare. They still use
                // the same lifecycle and must implement their operation in onExecute().
                result = onExecute(context, mode, previousRecords);
            } else {
                currentState = getCurrentState();
                if (currentState == null || onState == null || offState == null) {
                    throw new IllegalStateException("Global action must provide all states or none");
                }
                ActionState requestedState = mode == ActionMode.ON ? onState : offState;
                if (currentState.isSame(requestedState)) {
                    result = globalResult(ActionResultStatus.UNCHANGED, currentState, currentState,
                            null);
                } else if (mode == ActionMode.OFF && getStrictness() == Strictness.STRICT
                        && !currentState.isSame(onState)) {
                    result = globalResult(ActionResultStatus.SKIPPED_STRICT_MISMATCH,
                            ActionConflict.EXTERNAL_CHANGE, currentState, null,
                            "Current state does not match the expected ON state");
                } else {
                    result = onExecute(context, mode, previousRecords);
                    ActionState writtenState = result.writtenState;
                    if (writtenState == null && result.status == ActionResultStatus.SUCCESS) {
                        try {
                            writtenState = getCurrentState();
                        } catch (Throwable ignored) {
                            // The mutation succeeded, but its resulting state was unreadable.
                        }
                    }
                    result = result.withStateSnapshots(currentState, writtenState);
                }
            }
            results.add(result);
        } catch (Throwable throwable) {
            results.add(globalResult(ActionResultStatus.FAILED, currentState, null,
                    throwable.getMessage()));
        } finally {
            try {
                onPostExecute(context, mode, results);
            } catch (Throwable ignored) {
                // Cleanup failures must not discard the execution result.
            } finally {
                reportProgress(context, label, progressMax,
                        progressMax == ActionProgress.INDETERMINATE ? 0 : progressMax,
                        ActionProgress.State.COMPLETED, results);
            }
        }
        return results;
    }

    @NonNull
    protected static ActionTargetSpec globalTarget(@NonNull JSONObject parameters) {
        return new ActionTargetSpec(new GlobalTargetSpec(parameters));
    }

    @NonNull
    protected static ActionTargetSpec emptyGlobalTarget() {
        return globalTarget(new JSONObject());
    }

    @NonNull
    protected static ActionTargetSpec globalTargetWith(@NonNull String key, @NonNull String value) {
        try {
            return globalTarget(new JSONObject().put(key, value));
        } catch (JSONException exception) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Could not create global target", exception);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.actions;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;

import org.json.JSONException;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.history.IJsonSerializer;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.history.JsonDeserializer;

public final class GlobalTargetSpec implements IJsonSerializer, Parcelable {
    private final JSONObject mParameters;

    public GlobalTargetSpec(@NonNull JSONObject parameters) {
        mParameters = parameters;
    }

    public static final JsonDeserializer.Creator<GlobalTargetSpec> DESERIALIZER = object ->
            new GlobalTargetSpec(new JSONObject(object.toString()));

    @NonNull
    public JSONObject getParameters() {
        return mParameters;
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    public JSONObject serializeToJson() throws JSONException {
        return new JSONObject(mParameters.toString());
    }

    private GlobalTargetSpec(@NonNull Parcel in) {
        try {
            mParameters = new JSONObject(in.readString());
        } catch (JSONException | IllegalArgumentException e) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid global target", e);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(@NonNull Parcel dest, int flags) {
        dest.writeString(mParameters.toString());
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents() {
        return 0;
    }

    public static final Creator<GlobalTargetSpec> CREATOR = new Creator<GlobalTargetSpec>() {
        @NonNull
        @Override
        public GlobalTargetSpec createFromParcel(Parcel in) {
            return new GlobalTargetSpec(in);
        }

        @NonNull
        @Override
        public GlobalTargetSpec[] newArray(int size) {
            return new GlobalTargetSpec[size];
        }
    };
}
```

`appmanager_reference/io/github/muntashirakon/AppManager/actions/MagiskDenylistAction.java`:

```java
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
package io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.actions;

import android.os.Parcel;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.annotation.Nullable;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONException;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Collection;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.magisk.MagiskDenyList;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.magisk.MagiskProcess;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.types.UserPackagePair;

public final class MagiskDenylistAction extends PackageScopedAction {
    public static final String PARAM_PROCESS_NAMES = "process_names";
    public static final String PARAM_ENABLED = "enabled";
    public static final String PARAM_ISOLATED = "isolated";
    public static final String PARAM_APP_ZYGOTE = "app_zygote";

    public MagiskDenylistAction(@NonNull ActionTargetSpec target,
                                @NonNull ActionParameters onParameters,
                                @NonNull ActionParameters offParameters) {
        this(UUID.randomUUID().toString(), null, CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION, target, onParameters,
                offParameters, Strictness.STRICT, RevertMode.EXPLICIT);
    }

    public MagiskDenylistAction(@NonNull String id, @Nullable String name, int schemaVersion,
                                @NonNull ActionTargetSpec target,
                                @NonNull ActionParameters onParameters,
                                @NonNull ActionParameters offParameters,
                                @NonNull Strictness strictness, @NonNull RevertMode revertMode) {
        super(id, name, schemaVersion, ActionKind.MAGISK_DENYLIST, target, onParameters,
                offParameters, strictness, revertMode);
    }

    private MagiskDenylistAction(@NonNull Parcel parcel, @NonNull ActionKind kind) {
        super(parcel, kind);
    }

    @NonNull
    static MagiskDenylistAction fromParcel(@NonNull Parcel parcel, @NonNull ActionKind kind) {
        return new MagiskDenylistAction(parcel, kind);
    }

    private String[] mProcessNames;
    private boolean mEnabled;
    private boolean mIsolated;
    private boolean mAppZygote;

    @Override
    protected void onPreExecute(@NonNull ActionContext context, @NonNull ActionMode mode,
                                @NonNull List<UserPackagePair> targets,
                                @NonNull List<ActionExecutionRecord> previousRecords) {
        validateProcessParameters();
        ActionParameters parameters = requireParameters(mode);
        mProcessNames = requireStringArray(parameters, PARAM_PROCESS_NAMES);
        mEnabled = requireBoolean(parameters, PARAM_ENABLED);
        mIsolated = optionalBoolean(parameters, PARAM_ISOLATED, false);
        mAppZygote = optionalBoolean(parameters, PARAM_APP_ZYGOTE, false);
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    protected ActionResult onExecute(@NonNull ActionContext context, @NonNull ActionMode mode,
                                     @NonNull UserPackagePair target,
                                     @NonNull List<ActionExecutionRecord> previousRecords) {
        boolean successful = true;
        String message = null;
        for (String processName : mProcessNames) {
            MagiskProcess process = new MagiskProcess(target.getPackageName(), processName);
            process.setEnabled(mEnabled);
            process.setIsolatedProcess(mIsolated);
            process.setAppZygote(mAppZygote);
            try {
                if (!MagiskDenyList.apply(process, true)) {
                    successful = false;
                    message = "Magisk DenyList operation failed for " + processName;
                    break;
                }
            } catch (Throwable exception) {
                successful = false;
                message = exception.getMessage();
                break;
            }
        }
        return actionResult(target,
                successful ? ActionResultStatus.SUCCESS : ActionResultStatus.FAILED, message);
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    protected ActionState getCurrentState(@NonNull UserPackagePair target) {
        Collection<String> enabledProcesses = MagiskDenyList.getProcesses(target.getPackageName());
        return processState(target, mProcessNames, enabledProcesses, false);
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    protected ActionState getOnState(@NonNull UserPackagePair target) {
        ActionParameters parameters = getOnParameters();
        return processState(target, requireStringArray(parameters, PARAM_PROCESS_NAMES), null,
                requireBoolean(parameters, PARAM_ENABLED));
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    protected ActionState getOffState(@NonNull UserPackagePair target) {
        ActionParameters parameters = requireOffParameters();
        return processState(target, requireStringArray(parameters, PARAM_PROCESS_NAMES), null,
                requireBoolean(parameters, PARAM_ENABLED));
    }

    private void validateProcessParameters() {
        ActionParameters onParameters = getOnParameters();
        ActionParameters offParameters = requireOffParameters();
        String[] onProcesses = requireStringArray(onParameters, PARAM_PROCESS_NAMES).clone();
        String[] offProcesses = requireStringArray(offParameters, PARAM_PROCESS_NAMES).clone();
        Arrays.sort(onProcesses);
        Arrays.sort(offProcesses);
        if (!Arrays.equals(onProcesses, offProcesses)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "ON and OFF must use the same Magisk DenyList process names");
        }
    }

    @NonNull
    private static ActionState processState(@NonNull UserPackagePair target,
                                            @NonNull String[] processNames,
                                            @Nullable Collection<String> enabledProcesses,
                                            boolean enabled) {
        String[] sortedProcessNames = processNames.clone();
        Arrays.sort(sortedProcessNames);
        JSONArray states = new JSONArray();
        try {
            for (String processName : sortedProcessNames) {
                boolean processEnabled = enabledProcesses == null
                        ? enabled : enabledProcesses.contains(processName);
                states.put(new JSONObject()
                        .put("name", processName)
                        .put("enabled", processEnabled));
            }
        } catch (JSONException exception) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Could not build Magisk DenyList state", exception);
        }
        return new ActionState("package:" + target.getPackageName() + ":magisk_denylist",
                ActionValue.of(states.toString()));
    }
}
```

```java
        String[] sortedProcessNames = processNames.clone();
        Arrays.sort(sortedProcessNames);
        JSONArray states = new JSONArray();
        try {
            for (String processName : sortedProcessNames) {
                boolean processEnabled = enabledProcesses == null
                        ? enabled : enabledProcesses.contains(processName);
                states.put(new JSONObject()
                        .put("name", processName)
                        .put("enabled", processEnabled));
            }
        } catch (JSONException exception) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Could not build MagiskHide state", exception);
        }
        return new ActionState("package:" + target.getPackageName() + ":magisk_hide",
                ActionValue.of(states.toString()));
    }
}
```

`appmanager_reference/io/github/muntashirakon/AppManager/actions/PackageScopedAction.java`:

```java
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
package io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.actions;

import android.content.Context;
import android.os.Parcel;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.annotation.Nullable;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.types.UserPackagePair;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.utils.ContextUtils;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.utils.PackageUtils;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.R;

/**
 * Common base for Actions whose state belongs to a package/user pair.
 */
public abstract class PackageScopedAction extends Action {
    protected PackageScopedAction(@NonNull ActionKind kind, @NonNull ActionTargetSpec target,
                                  @NonNull ActionParameters onParameters,
                                  @Nullable ActionParameters offParameters) {
        super(kind, target, onParameters, offParameters);
        assert getTarget().getScope() == ActionScope.PACKAGE;
    }

    protected PackageScopedAction(@NonNull String id, @Nullable String name, int schemaVersion,
                                  @NonNull ActionKind kind, @NonNull ActionTargetSpec target,
                                  @NonNull ActionParameters onParameters,
                                  @Nullable ActionParameters offParameters,
                                  @NonNull Strictness strictness,
                                  @NonNull RevertMode revertMode) {
        super(id, name, schemaVersion, kind, target, onParameters, offParameters,
                strictness, revertMode);
        assert getTarget().getScope() == ActionScope.PACKAGE;
    }

    protected PackageScopedAction(@NonNull Parcel parcel, @NonNull ActionKind kind) {
        super(parcel, kind);
        assert getTarget().getScope() == ActionScope.PACKAGE;
    }

    @NonNull
    protected final List<UserPackagePair> resolveTargets(@NonNull ActionContext context) {
        return context.resolveTargets(this);
    }

    @Override
    public final int getProgressMax(@NonNull ActionContext context) {
        return resolveTargets(context).size();
    }

    @NonNull
    protected CharSequence getProgressLabel(@NonNull ActionContext context,
                                            @NonNull UserPackagePair target) {
        Context ctx = ContextUtils.getContext();
        CharSequence appLabel = PackageUtils.getPackageLabel(ctx.getPackageManager(),
                target.getPackageName(), target.getUserId());
        return context.executionMode == ActionExecutionMode.SINGLETON
                ? ctx.getString(R.string.action_running_on_package, appLabel)
                : ctx.getString(R.string.action_running_for_package, toLocalizedString(ctx), appLabel);
    }

    @Nullable
    private CharSequence progressLabel(@NonNull ActionContext context, @NonNull UserPackagePair target) {
        try {
            return getProgressLabel(context, target);
        } catch (RuntimeException ignored) {
            return target.getPackageName();
        }
    }

    @NonNull
    protected final ActionResult actionResult(@NonNull UserPackagePair target,
                                              @NonNull ActionResultStatus status,
                                              @Nullable String message) {
        return super.actionResult(target, status, null, null, message);
    }

    protected void onPreExecute(@NonNull ActionContext context, @NonNull ActionMode mode,
                                @NonNull List<UserPackagePair> targets,
                                @NonNull List<ActionExecutionRecord> previousRecords) throws Throwable {
    }

    @NonNull
    protected abstract ActionResult onExecute(@NonNull ActionContext context, @NonNull ActionMode mode,
                                              @NonNull UserPackagePair target,
                                              @NonNull List<ActionExecutionRecord> previousRecords) throws Throwable;

    protected void onPostExecute(@NonNull ActionContext context, @NonNull ActionMode mode,
                                 @NonNull List<UserPackagePair> targets,
                                 @NonNull List<ActionResult> results) throws Throwable {
    }

    @Nullable
    protected ActionState getCurrentState(@NonNull UserPackagePair target) throws Throwable {
        return null;
    }

    @Nullable
    protected ActionState getOnState(@NonNull UserPackagePair target) throws Throwable {
        return null;
    }

    @Nullable
    protected ActionState getOffState(@NonNull UserPackagePair target) throws Throwable {
        return null;
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    public final List<ActionResult> execute(@NonNull ActionContext context, @NonNull ActionMode mode,
                                            @NonNull List<ActionExecutionRecord> previousRecords) {
        List<UserPackagePair> targets = resolveTargets(context);
        List<ActionResult> results = new ArrayList<>(targets.size());
        int progressMax = targets.size();
        int targetIndex = 0;
        reportProgress(context, null, progressMax, 0, ActionProgress.State.STARTED, results);
        try {
            onPreExecute(context, mode, targets, previousRecords);
            for (UserPackagePair target : targets) {
                CharSequence label = progressLabel(context, target);
                reportProgress(context, label, progressMax, targetIndex);
                ActionResult result;
                ActionState currentState = null;
                try {
                    ActionState onState = getOnState(target);
                    ActionState offState = getOffState(target);
                    if (mode == ActionMode.OFF && getOffParameters() == null) {
                        result = actionResult(target, ActionResultStatus.UNSUPPORTED,
                                "Action has no reverse operation");
                    } else if (onState == null && offState == null) {
                        // Stateless actions, such as clear-data, have no state to compare.
                        result = onExecute(context, mode, target, previousRecords);
                    } else {
                        currentState = getCurrentState(target);
                        if (currentState == null || onState == null || offState == null) {
                            throw new IllegalStateException(
                                    "Package action must provide all states or none");
                        }
                        ActionState requestedState = mode == ActionMode.ON ? onState : offState;
                        if (currentState.isSame(requestedState)) {
                            result = actionResult(target, ActionResultStatus.UNCHANGED,
                                    currentState, currentState, null);
                        } else if (mode == ActionMode.OFF && getStrictness() == Strictness.STRICT
                                && !currentState.isSame(onState)) {
                            result = actionResult(target, ActionResultStatus.SKIPPED_STRICT_MISMATCH,
                                    ActionConflict.EXTERNAL_CHANGE, currentState, null,
                                    "Current state does not match the expected ON state");
                        } else {
                            result = onExecute(context, mode, target, previousRecords);
                            ActionState writtenState = result.writtenState;
                            if (writtenState == null && result.status == ActionResultStatus.SUCCESS) {
                                try {
                                    writtenState = getCurrentState(target);
                                } catch (Throwable ignored) {
                                    // The mutation succeeded, but its resulting state was unreadable.
                                }
                            }
                            result = result.withStateSnapshots(currentState, writtenState);
                        }
                    }
                } catch (Throwable throwable) {
                    result = actionResult(target, ActionResultStatus.FAILED,
                            currentState, null, throwable.getMessage());
                }
                results.add(result);
                targetIndex++;
                reportProgress(context, label, progressMax, targetIndex);
            }
        } catch (Throwable throwable) {
            for (; targetIndex < targets.size(); targetIndex++) {
                UserPackagePair target = targets.get(targetIndex);
                results.add(actionResult(target, ActionResultStatus.FAILED,
                        throwable.getMessage()));
                reportProgress(context, progressLabel(context, target), progressMax,
                        targetIndex + 1);
            }
        } finally {
            try {
                onPostExecute(context, mode, targets, results);
            } catch (Throwable ignored) {
                // Cleanup failures must not discard per-target execution results.
            } finally {
                reportProgress(context, null, progressMax, progressMax,
                        ActionProgress.State.COMPLETED, results);
            }
        }
        return results;
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    public CharSequence toLocalizedString(@NonNull Context context) {
        return super.toLocalizedString(context);
    }
}

```

```java
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
package io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.actions;

import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Parcelable;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.core.os.ParcelCompat;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONException;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;

import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.history.IJsonSerializer;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.history.JsonDeserializer;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.types.UserPackagePair;

public final class PackageTargetSpec implements IJsonSerializer, Parcelable {
    private final List<UserPackagePair> mConfiguredTargets;
    private final boolean mIncludeSelected;
    private final boolean mIncludeInherited;

    public PackageTargetSpec(@NonNull List<UserPackagePair> configuredTargets,
                             boolean includeSelected, boolean includeInherited) {
        mConfiguredTargets = Collections.unmodifiableList(new ArrayList<>(configuredTargets));
        mIncludeSelected = includeSelected;
        mIncludeInherited = includeInherited;
    }

    private PackageTargetSpec(@NonNull JSONObject object) throws JSONException {
        JSONArray targets = object.getJSONArray("configured");
        ArrayList<UserPackagePair> pairs = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < targets.length(); ++i) {
            JSONObject target = targets.getJSONObject(i);
            pairs.add(new UserPackagePair(target.getString("package"), target.getInt("user")));
        }
        mConfiguredTargets = Collections.unmodifiableList(pairs);
        mIncludeSelected = object.optBoolean("selected");
        mIncludeInherited = object.optBoolean("inherited");
    }

    public static final JsonDeserializer.Creator<PackageTargetSpec> DESERIALIZER = PackageTargetSpec::new;

    @NonNull
    public List<UserPackagePair> getConfiguredTargets() {
        return mConfiguredTargets;
    }

    public boolean includesSelected() {
        return mIncludeSelected;
    }

    public boolean includesInherited() {
        return mIncludeInherited;
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    public JSONObject serializeToJson() throws JSONException {
        JSONObject object = new JSONObject();
        JSONArray targets = new JSONArray();
        for (UserPackagePair target : mConfiguredTargets) {
            JSONObject item = new JSONObject();
            item.put("package", target.getPackageName());
            item.put("user", target.getUserId());
            targets.put(item);
        }
        object.put("configured", targets);
        object.put("selected", mIncludeSelected);
        object.put("inherited", mIncludeInherited);
        return object;
    }

    private PackageTargetSpec(@NonNull Parcel in) {
        mConfiguredTargets = Collections.unmodifiableList(in.createTypedArrayList(UserPackagePair.CREATOR));
        mIncludeSelected = ParcelCompat.readBoolean(in);
        mIncludeInherited = ParcelCompat.readBoolean(in);
    }

    @Override
    public void writeToParcel(@NonNull Parcel dest, int flags) {
        dest.writeTypedList(mConfiguredTargets);
        ParcelCompat.writeBoolean(dest, mIncludeSelected);
        ParcelCompat.writeBoolean(dest, mIncludeInherited);
    }

    @Override
    public int describeContents() {
        return 0;
    }

    public static final Creator<PackageTargetSpec> CREATOR = new Creator<PackageTargetSpec>() {
        @NonNull
        @Override
        public PackageTargetSpec createFromParcel(Parcel in) {
            return new PackageTargetSpec(in);
        }

        @NonNull
        @Override
        public PackageTargetSpec[] newArray(int size) {
            return new PackageTargetSpec[size];
        }
    };
}
```

`appmanager_reference/io/github/muntashirakon/AppManager/actions/PermissionStateAction.java`:

```java
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
package io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.actions;

import android.content.pm.PackageInfo;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.os.Parcel;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.annotation.Nullable;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONException;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.compat.AppOpsManagerCompat;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.compat.PackageManagerCompat;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.permission.PermissionChangeResult;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.permission.PermissionControllerRegistry;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.types.UserPackagePair;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.compat.PermissionCompat;

public final class PermissionStateAction extends PackageScopedAction {
    public static final String PARAM_PERMISSIONS = "permissions";
    public static final String PARAM_GRANTED = "granted";

    public PermissionStateAction(@NonNull ActionTargetSpec target, @NonNull ActionParameters onParameters,
                                 @Nullable ActionParameters offParameters) {
        this(UUID.randomUUID().toString(), null, CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION, target, onParameters,
                offParameters);
    }

    public PermissionStateAction(@NonNull String id, @Nullable String name, int schemaVersion,
                                 @NonNull ActionTargetSpec target, @NonNull ActionParameters onParameters,
                                 @Nullable ActionParameters offParameters) {
        this(id, name, schemaVersion, target, onParameters, offParameters, Strictness.STRICT,
                offParameters == null ? RevertMode.NONE : RevertMode.EXPLICIT);
    }

    public PermissionStateAction(@NonNull String id, @Nullable String name, int schemaVersion,
                                 @NonNull ActionTargetSpec target, @NonNull ActionParameters onParameters,
                                 @Nullable ActionParameters offParameters, @NonNull Strictness strictness,
                                 @NonNull RevertMode revertMode) {
        super(id, name, schemaVersion, ActionKind.PERMISSION_STATE, target, onParameters,
                offParameters, strictness, revertMode);
    }

    private PermissionStateAction(@NonNull Parcel in, @NonNull ActionKind kind) {
        super(in, kind);
    }

    @NonNull
    static PermissionStateAction fromParcel(@NonNull Parcel in, @NonNull ActionKind kind) {
        return new PermissionStateAction(in, kind);
    }

    private String[] mPermissions;
    private boolean mGranted;
    private PermissionControllerRegistry mControllers;
    private AppOpsManagerCompat mAppOpsManager;

    @Override
    protected void onPreExecute(@NonNull ActionContext context, @NonNull ActionMode mode,
                                @NonNull List<UserPackagePair> targets,
                                @NonNull List<ActionExecutionRecord> previousRecords) {
        validatePermissionParameters();
        ActionParameters parameters = requireParameters(mode);
        mPermissions = requireStringArray(parameters, PARAM_PERMISSIONS);
        mGranted = requireBoolean(parameters, PARAM_GRANTED);
        mControllers = PermissionControllerRegistry.getInstance();
        mAppOpsManager = new AppOpsManagerCompat();
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    protected ActionResult onExecute(@NonNull ActionContext context, @NonNull ActionMode mode,
                                     @NonNull UserPackagePair target,
                                     @NonNull List<ActionExecutionRecord> previousRecords) {
        try {
            PackageInfo packageInfo = getPackageInfo(target);
            for (String permission : mPermissions) {
                PermissionChangeResult change = mControllers.trySetGrantedForBatch(packageInfo,
                        permission, target.getUserId(), mAppOpsManager, mGranted);
                if (!change.isSuccessful()) {
                    throw new IllegalStateException(change.getMessage(), change.getCause());
                }
            }
            return actionResult(target, ActionResultStatus.SUCCESS, null);
        } catch (Throwable exception) {
            return actionResult(target, ActionResultStatus.FAILED, exception.getMessage());
        }
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    protected ActionState getCurrentState(@NonNull UserPackagePair target) {
        JSONArray states = new JSONArray();
        try {
            for (String permission : sortedPermissions(mPermissions)) {
                states.put(new JSONObject()
                        .put("name", permission)
                        .put("granted", PermissionCompat.checkPermission(permission,
                                target.getPackageName(), target.getUserId())
                                == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED));
            }
        } catch (JSONException exception) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Could not build permission state", exception);
        }
        return state(target, states.toString());
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    protected ActionState getOnState(@NonNull UserPackagePair target) {
        return desiredState(target, getOnParameters());
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    protected ActionState getOffState(@NonNull UserPackagePair target) {
        return desiredState(target, requireOffParameters());
    }

    @NonNull
    private PackageInfo getPackageInfo(@NonNull UserPackagePair target) throws Throwable {
        return PackageManagerCompat.getPackageInfo(target.getPackageName(),
                PackageManager.GET_PERMISSIONS
                        | PackageManagerCompat.MATCH_STATIC_SHARED_AND_SDK_LIBRARIES,
                target.getUserId());
    }

    private void validatePermissionParameters() {
        String[] onPermissions = sortedPermissions(
                requireStringArray(getOnParameters(), PARAM_PERMISSIONS));
        String[] offPermissions = sortedPermissions(
                requireStringArray(requireOffParameters(), PARAM_PERMISSIONS));
        if (!Arrays.equals(onPermissions, offPermissions)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("ON and OFF must use the same permissions");
        }
    }

    @NonNull
    private ActionState desiredState(@NonNull UserPackagePair target,
                                     @NonNull ActionParameters parameters) {
        JSONArray states = new JSONArray();
        boolean granted = requireBoolean(parameters, PARAM_GRANTED);
        try {
            for (String permission : sortedPermissions(
                    requireStringArray(parameters, PARAM_PERMISSIONS))) {
                states.put(new JSONObject()
                        .put("name", permission)
                        .put("granted", granted));
            }
        } catch (JSONException exception) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Could not build permission state", exception);
        }
        return state(target, states.toString());
    }

    @NonNull
    private static ActionState state(@NonNull UserPackagePair target, @NonNull String value) {
        return new ActionState("package:" + target.getPackageName() + ":"
                + target.getUserId() + ":permissions", ActionValue.of(value));
    }

    @NonNull
    private static String[] sortedPermissions(@NonNull String[] permissions) {
        String[] sorted = permissions.clone();
        Arrays.sort(sorted);
        return sorted;
    }
}
```

`appmanager_reference/io/github/muntashirakon/AppManager/actions/RebootAction.java`:

```java
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
package io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.actions;

import android.os.Parcel;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.annotation.Nullable;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.UUID;

import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.utils.RestartUtils;

public final class RebootAction extends GlobalScopedAction {
    public static final String PARAM_MODE = "mode";

    public static final String MODE_NORMAL = "normal";
    public static final String MODE_RECOVERY = "recovery";
    public static final String MODE_BOOTLOADER = "bootloader";
    public static final String MODE_USERSPACE = "userspace";
    public static final String MODE_DOWNLOAD = "download";
    public static final String MODE_EDL = "edl";

    public RebootAction(@NonNull String mode) {
        this(UUID.randomUUID().toString(), null, CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION, emptyGlobalTarget(),
                new ActionParameters().put(PARAM_MODE, normalizeMode(mode)), Strictness.STRICT,
                RevertMode.NONE);
    }

    public RebootAction(@NonNull String id, @Nullable String name, int schemaVersion,
                        @NonNull ActionTargetSpec target,
                        @NonNull ActionParameters onParameters,
                        @NonNull Strictness strictness, @NonNull RevertMode revertMode) {
        super(id, name, schemaVersion, ActionKind.REBOOT, target, onParameters, null,
                strictness, revertMode);
    }

    private RebootAction(@NonNull Parcel parcel, @NonNull ActionKind kind) {
        super(parcel, kind);
    }

    @NonNull
    static RebootAction fromParcel(@NonNull Parcel parcel, @NonNull ActionKind kind) {
        return new RebootAction(parcel, kind);
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    protected ActionResult onExecute(@NonNull ActionContext context, @NonNull ActionMode mode,
                                     @NonNull List<ActionExecutionRecord> previousRecords) {
        if (mode == ActionMode.OFF) {
            return globalResult(ActionResultStatus.UNSUPPORTED, "Reboot has no reverse operation");
        }

        String modeName = normalizeMode(requireString(getOnParameters(), PARAM_MODE));
        boolean success;
        switch (modeName) {
            case MODE_NORMAL:
                success = RestartUtils.restart(RestartUtils.RESTART_NORMAL);
                break;
            case MODE_RECOVERY:
                success = RestartUtils.restart(RestartUtils.RESTART_RECOVERY);
                break;
            case MODE_BOOTLOADER:
                success = RestartUtils.restart(RestartUtils.RESTART_BOOTLOADER);
                break;
            case MODE_USERSPACE:
                success = RestartUtils.restart(RestartUtils.RESTART_USERSPACE);
                break;
            case MODE_DOWNLOAD:
                success = RestartUtils.restart(RestartUtils.RESTART_DOWNLOAD);
                break;
            case MODE_EDL:
                success = RestartUtils.restart(RestartUtils.RESTART_EDL);
                break;
            default:
                return globalResult(ActionResultStatus.FAILED,
                        "Unsupported reboot mode: " + modeName);
        }
        if (success) {
            return globalResult(ActionResultStatus.SUCCESS, null);
        } else {
            return globalResult(ActionResultStatus.FAILED, "Unable to reboot to " + modeName);
        }
    }

    @NonNull
    private static String normalizeMode(@NonNull String mode) {
        String normalizedMode = mode.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        switch (normalizedMode) {
            case MODE_NORMAL:
            case MODE_RECOVERY:
            case MODE_BOOTLOADER:
            case MODE_USERSPACE:
            case MODE_DOWNLOAD:
            case MODE_EDL:
                return normalizedMode;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported reboot mode: " + mode);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
package io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.actions;

import android.os.Parcel;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.annotation.Nullable;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.backup.BackupException;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.backup.BackupManager;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.batchops.struct.BatchBackupOptions;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.progress.ProgressHandler;
import io.github.muntashirakon.AppManager.types.UserPackagePair;

public final class RestoreBackupAction extends PackageScopedAction {
    public RestoreBackupAction(@NonNull ActionTargetSpec target,
                               @NonNull ActionParameters onParameters) {
        this(UUID.randomUUID().toString(), null, CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION, target, onParameters,
                Strictness.STRICT, RevertMode.NONE);
    }

    public RestoreBackupAction(@NonNull String id, @Nullable String name, int schemaVersion,
                               @NonNull ActionTargetSpec target, @NonNull ActionParameters onParameters,
                               @NonNull Strictness strictness, @NonNull RevertMode revertMode) {
        super(id, name, schemaVersion, ActionKind.RESTORE_BACKUP, target, onParameters, null,
                strictness, revertMode);
    }

    private RestoreBackupAction(@NonNull Parcel parcel, @NonNull ActionKind kind) {
        super(parcel, kind);
    }

    @NonNull
    static RestoreBackupAction fromParcel(@NonNull Parcel parcel, @NonNull ActionKind kind) {
        return new RestoreBackupAction(parcel, kind);
    }

    private BatchBackupOptions mOptions;
    private BackupManager mBackupManager;

    @Override
    protected void onPreExecute(@NonNull ActionContext context, @NonNull ActionMode mode,
                                @NonNull List<UserPackagePair> targets,
                                @NonNull List<ActionExecutionRecord> previousRecords) {
        if (mode == ActionMode.OFF) return;
        mOptions = createOptions(getOnParameters());
        mBackupManager = new BackupManager();
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    protected ActionResult onExecute(@NonNull ActionContext context, @NonNull ActionMode mode,
                                     @NonNull UserPackagePair target,
                                     @NonNull List<ActionExecutionRecord> previousRecords)
            throws BackupException {
        ProgressHandler subProgressHandler = newSubProgressHandler(context);
        try {
            mBackupManager.restore(mOptions.getRestoreOpOptions(target.getPackageName(),
                    target.getUserId()), subProgressHandler);
            return actionResult(target, ActionResultStatus.SUCCESS, null);
        } finally {
            finishSubProgressHandler(subProgressHandler);
        }
    }

    @NonNull
    private BatchBackupOptions createOptions(@NonNull ActionParameters parameters) {
        return new BatchBackupOptions(requireInt(parameters, "flags"),
                optionalStringArray(parameters, "backup_names"),
                optionalStringArray(parameters, "relative_dirs"));
    }
}
```

```java
                              @NonNull ActionParameters off) {

                Strictness.STRICT, RevertMode.EXPLICIT);
    }

    public SensorAccessAction(@NonNull String id, @Nullable String name, int schema,
                              @NonNull ActionTargetSpec target, @NonNull ActionParameters on,

                              @NonNull RevertMode revert) {
```
